tei:div.tei:p: rte kāzin (rwa/ ca/ stoci47lha//du — ji ——zhe:— /skyo//rdoX sku —— chi 9ki spya ci〉 7 ñtsāṭ+wāṃ / 4 ཿtsho— phyirto4 — phro ‘mnga' ris rgyal po skyid lde nyi ma mgon dgung lobagres pa'iskabs su rang gi sras gsum la mnga' ris so sor ༷ gnang ste/ che ba dpal gyi margon la mnga' — ris mar yul/ 'bangs gzhu nag can/ r+shar ru thos dang — — gser kha 'argog lad kyi sde mchog dkar bo/ ༷ sdu mtshams kyi ra ba dmar bo/ wam le yi mig bi pha bong la — me mgo bar nub kha che'i la rtsa/ rdo bug pa can yan chad byang gser kha 'argog po tshun chad kyi sa rgya la gtogs pa rnams yin no/ /bar pa bkra thes mgon la gu be spuhrangs/ya rtse dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad/ chung ba we gtsug mgon la/ zangs dalar sgo gsum/ spi ti/spi lcogs dang bcas pa lamanga' mdzad ces pa ltar lags so/ /dzo// /1duthas/
snye//gu ge che ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs /krung go bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i thun min gyi rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas la sogs pa bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / snying por rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gnyis 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa 'di nyid dar 'phel ji yong ni mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs bod yig gi 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉dpe bsdur ma zhes bya ba'i dpe tshogs rgya chen po par bskrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa phud/ da phan bod rang nyid kyi 1

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum nang nas rig gnas che chung bcus mtshon pa'i 〈〈gangs ljongs shes rig gi nying bcud 〉〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs par dang par bzhin yod pa dang / de min da dung bod kyi srol rgyun rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa yangs shing zhib 'jug thad deng rabs kyi thabs lam dam pa thugs su chud pa'i deng gi mkhas pa rgan gras kyi dpyad rtsom 〈〈deng rabs mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs dang / nye lo'i sngon du mi rigs slob grwa khag nas ched thon byung ba'i hra'o hri'i slob ma'i sbyang 'bras rtsom yig phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i 〈〈bod kyi shes rig dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉zhes pa sogs par skrun byas pas spyi tshogs thog bsngags brjod chen po thob/ da lan nga tshos dus rabs gsar ba'i nang 'tshar longs byung ba'i bod rigs mkhas pa dar ma'i khrod nas zhib 'jugagi thabs lam gsar ba spyad pa dang zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras spam mi dma' ba thob pa'i mkhas pa dar ma skor zhig gi ched rtsom rnams phyogs bsdus kyis mu 'brel gyi tshul du par skrun byed rtsis yod pas deb 'dir rtsom pa po gu ge tshe ring rgyal po lags kyi ched rtsom bdams pa yin/ de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni gcig nas bod rigs gzhon nu rnams la skul ma dang dpe ston gyi nus pa thon pa'i re ba dang / gnyis su mkhas pa 'di rnam pa'i brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu dus thog tu bod rig pa'i gnas la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyi mdun sa dang dpyod ldan klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar phul nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu sos pa'i ro mchog mnyam myangs dang / zhib 'jug thabs lam gyi dge skyon mnyam dpyad kyis bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi 'phrin las sgo kun nas dar rgyas yong na ci ma rung 2

༄7//dpe slun gsal bshad/snyam pa'i 'dun pa dkar po 'chang ba yin mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i chu tshad zhan pa dang mthong rgya chung ba sogs kyi dbang gis nang don gdam gses dang dpe sgrig gi thad zhib cha ma thon pa dang tha na nor 'khrul yang yod srid pas/dgongs 'char lhugs stsol yod pa zhu'o// zhes/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis/2005lo'i zla 6par/

dkar chag༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/ (1)dang po/ mnga' ris skor gsum ji ltar byung ba'i skor/ (1)gnyis pa/ la dwags rgyal rgyud/ (4)gsum pa/ zangs dkar rgyal rgyud/ (5)bzhi pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud/ (9)lnga pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud/ (20)drug pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i gu ge'i rgyal rgyud/ (24)zur bkod/la dwags rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/ (69)spu rang rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/ (70)zangs dkar rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/ (70)spu rang rgyal rgyud nas mched pa'i ya rtse rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/ (71)spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/ (72)༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/(74)༄7//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'bab pa'i chu chen bzhi'i skor/ (193)

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/glang chen kha 'bab/(bya1 (sku) (93)rma bya kha 'bab/(6skusasprukhubya) (94)seng ge kha 'bab/(1sa75bya) (96)rta mchog kha 'bab/(21skukhrim sku95 1sku) (98)༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal za rang ru dpon gyi skor/ (102)༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya grul chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/ (109)༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/ (119)gcig (119)gnyis/ (130)༄7/gu ge'i yul lha mes ba'u yi skor rags tsam brjod pa/ (139)༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i gti g.yag khul gyi yul lha ji ltar gsol lugs skor/ (144)༄7//mnga' ris gu ge'i rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang srung ma mgon po'i skor/ (151)2

༄7//dkar chag༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor nags tsam brjod pa/ (159)༄༅//mnga' ris nub khul gyi mtha' ba khams pa dang khu nu'i skor/ (171)mtha' ba khams pa/ (171)khu nu/ (175)༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran tsam brjod pa/ (178)༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags jon lugs skor bajod pa/ (187)༄7ོ//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gtsod jon lugs skor mdo tsam brjod pa/ (213)༄7ོ//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/ (222)༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu cho pa'i skor gleng ba/ (247)༄khya//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor cho pa'i 3

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skor la dpyad pa/ (267)sger rtse tsho pa'i skor/ (268)bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor/ (278)༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/ (300)༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can dpal mi 'gyur rtsan gyis grub pa'i mtho lding gtsug lag khang / (308)༄khya//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi dgon sde grags can 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/ (333)༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/ (350)༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/ (365)༄7//lha ldan rme ru rnying pa dang de'i chos skyong skor phran tsam brjod pa/ (395)༄7ོ/g.yo ru kha 'khrug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/ (402)༄7//lha sa'i snang rtse shag las khungs dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon rnam gnyis kyi do 'gan 'khur 'os skor rags tsam brjod pa/ (418)4

༄7//dkar chag༄7/gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/(441)dang po/ mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi gdod ma'i dus su chos lugs gtan nas byung myong med pa/ (442)gnyis pa/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs/ (444)gsum pa/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi nang don gtso bo dang snang tshul/(446)bzhi pa/ gna' bo'i lha mang chos lugs dang lha gcig chos lugs/ (469)༄7ོ//rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (481)

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/dang po/ mnga' ris skon gsum ji ltan byung ba'i skor/mnga' ris rgyal po skyid lde nyi ma mgon dgung lo bgres pa'i skabs su/khong gi yab mes dag srid dang mnga' thang la ma 'cham pa'i dbang gis/sngar ya gling dbus mar snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs bsil bur thor zhing / khong rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs kyang yul khag gsum la bgos nas/ bu re la skor re gnang bas/ bod gangs can ljongs kyi lo rgyus thog ‘‘mnga' ris skor gsum ’’zhes pa'i rjes grub kyi tha snyad de yang dus de nas byung 'go brtsams pa red/ de yang khong gi bu gsum su dang su yin min dang / bu gsum la gnang ba'i yul lung khag gsum ste/mnga' ris skor gsum zhes pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i skor la 〈〈la dwags rgyal rabs 〉〉las gsal po bkod yod/ des na skor gsum ni/ lha chen dpal gyi mgon/ bar pa bkra shis mgon/ chung ba lde gtsug dang gsum mo// de nas sras gsum la mnga' ris so sor gnang ste/ che ba dpal gyi mgon mnga' ris mar yul/ 'bangs gzhu nag can/ shar ru thog dang gser kha 'gog lad kyi sde mchog dkar po/ mtshams kyi ra ba dam/ po/

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/wam le yi mig gi pha bong la mgo bar nub kha che'i la rtsa/ rdo bug pa can yan chad/ byang gser kha 'gog po tshun chad kyi sa rgya la gtogs pa rnams yin no// bar pa bkra shis mgon la gu ge spu hrangs/ ya rtse dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon la/ zangs dkar sgo gsum/ spi ti/ spi lcogs dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad ces pa ltar lags so//gong gsal dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs khag gi nang du stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi rgya khyon dang / sa mtshams/ khyab khongs bcas kha gsal bkod 'dug pa de dag ni skor gsum lo rgyus la rgyus mnga' shin tu che ba'i mkhas pas brtsams pa zhig yin pas yid rton rung bar mngon zhing / de bzhin mnga' ris khul du lo mang bzhugs myong zhing yul de'i lo rgyus sogs la zhib 'jug mdzad pa po rnying ma'i bla ma grags can ka thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus kyang drangs pa'i dpe deb las che ba rig pa mgon gyis mar yul bru sha'i bar dang / 'bring ba bkra shis mgon gyis zhang zhung ya rtse dang bcas pa/chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis pi ti cog dang zangs dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes kha gsal gsungs 'dug pas dogs pa'i drwa rgyar tshud dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga la mchis/ mdor na gong du brjod pa dag las mnga' ris skor gsum de ji ltar chags tshul dang ji ltar skyong lugs sogs kyi skor la nang gses sogs don dag chung tsag thad dgongs tshul mi 'dra ba phran bu mchis pa las/ spyi don la dogs 'char rkyen gyi dri mas mi 'bag pa kha gsal bstan 'dug dus rabs bcu bzhi nas bzung brtsams pa'i rgyal rabs deb ther du ma'i nang du spu rang dang zhang zhung mar yul gsum mnga' ris skor gsum yin khul du bris 'dug pa de ni mi dag cing lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang ye nas 2

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/mi mthun pa bod ljongs nub khul mnga' ris lo rgyus la dpyad pa phran bu yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal la ri bong cal 'drogs byed dgos don ga la mchis/yab skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' thang mnga' ris kyi yul de yul khag gsum la bgos nas bu gsum la khrims mgo rang btsan gyis dbang sgyur byed du bcug par ma zad/ tha na yab kyi rgyu nor dang dngos rdzas sogs kyang bu gsum la bgo bsha' gtsang ma mdzad yod pa ni 〈〈'khor chags jo bo'i dkar chag 〉〉las/ rgyal pos sras che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon la g.yu gong spe mo che'i mkhar sprad pa/ chibs kyi ling nyin skor/ rna g.yu dgos 'dod 'od 'phro/ gnam ral bdud po ske gcod/ gzhan yang rgyal nor khyad 'phags mang du phog bar pa bkra shis lde mgon la g.yu gong spe mo che'i mkhar sprad pas/ chibs kyi ling gnam rta dkar po/ rna g.yu 'dzam gling 'od 'phro/gnam ral nam mkha'i spu gcod/ gzhan yang rgyal nor khyad 'phags mang du phog chung ma lde gtsug mgon la g.yu gong spe mo che mkhar sprad pas/'brog mur la mtsho skyes/ phun rtse/ g.yu gong / gser kha gsung ngur rin chen 'byung gnas/ chibs spyang shes rlung gshog rna g.yu skar chen 'od 'phro/ gnam ral srin mo khrag 'dag gzhan yang rgyal nor khyad 'phags mang du phog ces pa yab chen skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis rang gi mnga' khongs kyi yul lung dag khag gsum du bgo bsha' brgyab pa sogs gnang nas 'khrugs rtsod langs pa'i rgyu dang rkyen gtan nas med pa bzos yod cing /bu gsum po de la dwags dang / spu rang / zangs dkar bcas yul lung gsum gyi rgyal po gsum la gyur nas/ khong gsum gyi bdag dbang du gyur pa'i yul khag gsum po der ‘‘mnga' ris skor gsum ’midu 'bod pa'i tha snyad 3

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de thog mar byung zhing / de nas bzung bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i thog ‘‘stod mnga' ris skor gsum ’’zhes pa'i snyan dbyangs kyi 'brug sgra de thog mar sgrog cing phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun du'ang khyab pa ni gong du brjod pa bzhin no//gnyis pa/ la dwags rgyal rgyud/lo rgyus thog bod btsan po'i rgyal rgyud skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi bu che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon mar yul la dwags yul du slebs nas rgyal rgyud bskyangs shing / rgyal rabs mnga' thang rab tu rgyas pa'i dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin chad med bskyangs par ma zad/ dus rabs bcu bdun gyi lo rabs sum cu nas bzung mi lo lnga bcu'i ring stod mnga' skor gsum mang che ba mnga' 'og tu bsdus so// de'i rgyal sa slel yin la rgyal po mang dag cig byung ba'i ring mi ser dag kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed cing / bod yig bod skad (mnga' ris yul skad gtsang ma rgyag pa/) bed spyod gtong ba/ yul srol goms gshis sogs gang thad nas bltas kyang bod rigs bkrus na ma dag pa yin pas/ deng sang da dung 'dzam gling thog 'ga' zhig gis ‘‘bod chung chung ’ zhes 'bod/ la dwags rgyal po rim byung gi rgyal srid mnga' thang la dar rgud ci byung dang / srid kyi sgrig gzhi/ dmag don/ phyi mtha' rgyal phran dang tsho pa khag dbar gyi 'brel ba/ dpal 'byor tshong don /chos lugs grub mtha'i skor sogs gang thad la zhib cing phra bar mkhyen dgos na 〈〈la dwags rgyal rabs 〉〉 nang rgyas shing rgyas pa 'khod yod pas der 4

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/gzigs na 'thus pas 'dir skyar zlos byed pa'i dgos pa ma mchis so//gsum pa/ zangs dkar rgyal rgyud/lo rgyus thog zangs dkar ni ri bo hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi lho nub phyogs te la dwags rgyal khams dang gu ge'i rgyal khams kyi dbar du chags/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i ri klung dang chu phran du mas rab tu brgyan cing / sa chu gtsang ba'i bsil ldan sman ljongs su grags pa der bod kha ba can gyi yul khams mthun rkyen mtha' dag tshang yod/ 'dir 'tsho ba'i mi 'bangs thams cad kyang bag yod tshul ldan/ ya rabs gshis bzang / zhi zhing dul ba/gzhan phan gtong phod kyi spyod bzang ldan la/ pha ma rgan rabs la gus bkur brtsi mthong che ba/ spun mched bar brtse dung drag po 'chang ba/bod skad dang bod yig bed spyod gtong zhing nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la dad pa shin tu che ba/ bod pa'i khang dbyibs can gyi khang bzang nang sdod cing / thab chas spyod chas zangs lcags rigs thams cad bod dang gcig mtshungs yin no// rtsam zan bod kyi lugs srol dang goms gshis ldan la bod pa'i 'du shes gtso bo 'dzin pa'i chas gos rgyan cha dang /yul lung gi lugs srol kun kyang stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi yul lung spyi dang 'dra ba'i yul khams dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa zhig go/zangs dkar ni mnga' ris skor gsum gyi yul khams gzhan dang 'dra bar yun ring gi lo rgyus dang tshar du dngar ba'i rig gzhung ldan yod pa ni mnga' ris skor gsum gyi ya gyal gcig ste/ 〈〈la dwags rgyal rabs 〉〉las/5

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chung ba lde gtsug mgon la zangs dkar sgo gsum/ spi ti/ spi lcogs dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad ces pa dang / ka thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mdzad pa'i 〈〈rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs su 'byung ba'i rtsa lag 〉〉las chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis pi ti cog 'ang zangs dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes pa 'di ni rigs shing 'thad la khungs dang ldan pa ste skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi sras mtha' chung lde gtsug mgon zangs dkar yul la slebs nas mnga' thang bskyangs pas de'i rgyal rgyud zam mi chad pa yul der dar nas dus deng gi bar du zangs lha'i rgyal rgyud dang rgyal khang pho brang sogs ma nyams par bsdad yod cing yul kyi 'bangs mi tshang mas gus bkur byed/ rgyal pos kyang yul mir byams skyong chen po byed pa'i sngar srol bzang po rang sor gnas slad 'bad rtsol byed kyin yod pa ni deng sang 'ga' zhig gis rang don ring lugs kho na gnyer nas phyi dngos po'i ched du bton pa'i zhe sdang gis nang byams sems bag la zha bar byas pa dag las khyad par shin tu che'o//dus rabs bco lnga'i nang mtha' khul rgyal phran dkar dkyil rgyal pos btsan 'dzul byas nas rgyal khams nyams la khad skabs gu ges kyang dmag btang nas ca dngos du ma zhig 'phrog bcom byas pa'i rkyen gyis nyams chag chen po byung yang rgyal rgyud ma chad tsam du gnas/ rjes su yul lung gzhan nas mi ser du ma zhig rim gyis yul der gnas spos byas gshis yang bskyar dar rgyas che tsam byung nas rgyal po rim byung gi rgyal rgyud kyis rgyal srid mu mthud legs par bskyangs/'dir zangs dkar rgyal rgyud kyi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod par bya ste/rgyal rabs dbu 'dzugs mkhan gyi rgyal thog dang po lde gtsug mgon/ khong 6

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/la sras gcig byung bar ming la seng ge lde brjod/ khong la sras gnyis 'khrungs par sras che bar 'dzom grags lde zhes pa des dpa' gtum gyi mkhar bzung nas rgyal srid bskyangs/ chung ba maṅgāl lde yin te des bzang lhar mnga' mdzad/ de nas bzung bzang lha'i rgyal rgyud maṅgāl lde'i sras rin chen dpal lde/ de'i sras dge 'dun dpal lde/ de'i sras bsod nams dpal lde/ de yi sras bkra shis dpal lde sogs kyis chab 'bangs legs par bskyangs shing rgyal srid mnga' thang rgyas/ bkra shis dpal lde la sras gnyis byung bar sras che ba mgon po dpal lde dang chung ba brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan no// chung ba cher longs nas zangs dkar gyi dgon sde grags can dkar sha byams gling gi bla ma mdzad nas chos phyogs kyi bya bar 'bad 'bungs skyed/ de tshe zangs dkar yul la dge rgan grags can med pas bod dbus gtsang khul du phebs/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i chos grwar zhugs nas chos la sbyangs brtson byas rting mkhas par gyur par ma zad/ mthar paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan la mdo sngags rig lam gyi gzhung mang dag zhus mthar khong gi dngos slob tu gyur nas drung pa rgyal tshab pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa che cher khyab/bkra shis dpal lde'i sras che ba mgon po dpal lde zangs lhar bzhugs nas rgyal srid bskyangs pa dang sbrags chos la'ang do snang chen po byas pa ni gcung gi shugs rkyen yin no// khong la sras gnyis byung bar sras che ba nam mkha' dpal ldes rgyal rgyud bzung nas zangs lhar bzhugs/ sras chung bas dgon par bzhugs nas bla ma mdzad cing / a khus skul te gtsang la byon nas paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyi drung nas bka' chos zhus 7

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa nas chos kyi rtogs pa rab tu rgyas shing dngos slob 'ga' shas byung ba'i nang nas rta phu ba dam chos rgyal mtshan zhes pa de snyan grags ha cang che'o//rgyal sras che bar sras gnyis byung ba ni che ba khri dpal lde dang chung ba tshe dbang dpal lde gnyis yin/ sras che ba khri dpal ldes rgyal srid bskyangs/de la'ang sras gnyis byung bar rgyal sras che ba tshe dbang rab brtan dpal lde zhes pas pha shul bus bzung te rgyal srid legs par bskyangs/ sras chung ba chos sgor zhugs nas mtshan zhabs drung blo bzang ye shes rgyal mtshan du grags shing dgon pa'i bla ma mdzad/ rgyal sras che ba tshe dbang rab brtan dpal lder sras gcig las ma byung bar mtshan la ye shes dpal lde brjod/ khong la rgyal sras gnyis byung bar che ba bsod nams dpal lde dang chung ba ye shes rnam rgyal zhes so//rgyal sras che bas zangs lha'i rgyal rgyud bskyangs/ khong la lha sras dang sras mo khyon bsdoms bzhi tsam byung bar rgyal sras rgan pa ye shes mtha' yas cher lon nas chos sgor zhugs te dgon pa'i bla ma mdzad/ sras bar pa ye shes don yod dpal lde/ sras chung ba ye shes phun tshogs dpal lder lcam mo bkra shis zhes pa bsus kyang khong gis tshe ring po ma thub par na gzhon skabs nas grongs so// des na lcam mo bkra shis hreng hreng la lus par bsam sgrub ces pa mag par blangs kyang rgyal srid skyong ba la rgyal rgyud min pas thob thang med khar phyir thon no// sras mo zla mdzes dbang mo cher lon nas don grub tshe ring dpal lde zhes pa mag par blangs te srid kyi 'go skyong mdzad/ zla mdzes dbang mor sras gsum byung bar sras che ba blo bzang rnam rgyal dang /sras bar pa sku mchog ba ku la/ chung ba ye shes tshul khrims bcas so// sras 8

༄//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/che ba blo bzang rnam rgyal ldes rgyal srid bskyangs/ khong la'ang sras gnyis byung bar sras che ba'i mtshan la tshul khrims nyi ma zhes brjod/ khong cher lon nas ri rdzong dgon pa'i grwa ba mdzad/ sras chung ba tshe brtan rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid lugs ltar bskyangs shing dar rgyas chen po byung / khong la sras gcig dang sras mo gcig byung bar sras kyi ming la bsod nams don grub rnam rgyal dang sras mor bstan 'dzin dbang mo brjod/ rgyal sras bsod nams don grub rnam rgyal lder sras gcig dang sras mo gnyis byung bar rgyal sras ming la nyi ma nor bu rnam rgyal lde dang sras mo che bar bsod nams dbang mo zhes cher lon nas ho na ku'i mkhar la bag mar brdzangs pas rang yul dang kha bral dgos byung / sras mo mtha' chung bkra tris lha 'dzoms la dpa' gtum rgyal po'i rgyal sras rig 'dzin zla ba mag par bslangs/ sras mo mtha' chung gi sras blo bzang don yod rnam rgyal ldes zangs lha'i rgyal rgyud bskyangs pa bcas so// zangs dkar yul de nang pa sangs rgyas dar ba'i yul lung zhig yin pa sngar lo rgyus thog skyes chen dam pa du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing dgon sde yang mi nyung ba zhig bzhengs yod la rgyal rgyud 'ga' shas dbus gtsang khul du byon nas chos la sbyangs pa ha cang che bas yul der yang dge lugs pa sogs bod brgyud nang bstan dar po byung yod do//bzhi pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud/mnga' ris skor gsum gyi ya gyal ste/ spu rang rgyal rgyud ni rgyal po mnga' bdag khri bkra shis mgon pha shul bu 'dzin gyis mu mthud dkar dung du 9

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pa'i pho brang sku mkhar nyi bzungs su chab srid bskyangs shing / btsun mo zangs kha ma khab tu bzhes par sras 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis 'khrungs/〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ srong nge'i mtshan la khri lde srong gtsug btsan kyang zer/ 'khor re la mnga' bdag chen po bkra shis 'khor res zhes zhu zhing ka thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus kyang srong nge dang 'khor re'i ming dngos gzhi drang srong lde dang / 'khor lo lde yin zhes mnga' ris gung thang du dpe hrul ka ni ka rnying par brdzangs pa zhig tu 'dug pa 'thad nges su snang zhes de gnyis kyi mtshan dngos ci 'dra yin min ha cang gsal po bkod 'dug mdor na gcen 'khor res spu rang la mnga' mdzad par ma zad/da dung gtsang phyogs la'ang dbang shugs nges can zhig slebs yod par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ gtsang gi 'tshong 'dus mgur mo nas 'khor lo tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus zhes pa 'di nas skabs de dus mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran dang yul lung du ma dbang 'og tu bcug cing mnga' thang gra rgyas chags pa'ang mngon no//'khor re'i sras gnyis te lha lde dang u ra za (sku chung ngu'i dus nas gshegs/)lha lde chung dus kyi mtshan la ba tsha la sde nag po 'dzum med ces 'bod/rgyu mtshan ni khong thugs rngam zhing shin tu sgam po yod par snang / khong gi mtshan gzhan la lha lde bkra shis btsan yang zer zhing khong chung ngu'i dus nas dbon srong nge dang rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta khag de min lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po sogs kyi bag chags 'og sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad zhen che ba dang /so so'i mnga' 'og gi 'bangs mi ser dag la'ang byams skyong che ba bcas kyis rgyal srid zhi 'jam gyi ngang nas bskyangs brtson mdzad/ lhag don du lo tsā ba 10

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/rin chen bzang po khong gis dbu'i bla mchod dang rdo rje slob dpon la 'dzin zhing / khong gis dngos su sbyin bdag mdzad nas spu rang zher pa zhes pa'i yul du stod mnga' ris spu rang gi lo rgyus thog don snying ha cang chen po ldan pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa thog ma de bzhengs par lo tsā ba'i rnam thar 'bring po las kha char ('khor chags kyang brjod/)rin chen brtsegs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang rten gtso 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dngul sku chen po de'ang bzhengs zhes gsal ba de nas khong gi spu rang khul du mdzad 'phrin rgya chen spel zhing / 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta dzha na dh+wa na spyan drangs te rin chen bzang pos lo tsā byas nas yan lag brgyad pa'i gzhung rtsa 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa dang rta'i sman dpyad bsgyur te bod gangs can gi gso rig dar spel mdzad nas mdzad rjes bla na med pa bzhag yod/lha ldes kyang tshe mjug tu rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo chen rin chen bzang po la sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mar 'bul ba rgya chen mdzad de nang chos gsan sbyangs la brtson cing mthar srid dang rgyu dngos phun sum tshogs par yid rton med par gzigs te rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes pa dang mtshan dharma pra bha wa zhes so// 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las khong gis mtho lding du gtsug lag khang (brgya sa min nam snyam/)dang mar yul du she yer byams pa gser thang bzhengs zhes pas de tshe la dwags dang / spu rang / gu ge sogs dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa mngon gyin 'dugamanga' bdag lha lde'i sku tshe stod la sras gsum byung ba ni 'od lde btsan/bkra shis 'od/ yongs srong lde bcas yin/ sras 'bring ba dang chung ba gnyis rab tu byung nas gu ge'i mtho gling dgon pa bskyangs nas mtshan pho brang 11

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byang chub 'od dang lha btsun zhi ba 'od ces gsol/ pho brang byang chub 'od dgung lo bgres pas khu mes ye shes 'od kyi bka' mngags bzhin khu bo de ba ra dzar rogs 'degs kyis mtho gling dgon pa rgya bskyed dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bzhugs gnas mtho lding gser khang gsar bzhengs byas shing /mang nang du byang chub dge gnas gling gi gtsug lag khang dang dpal byams pa 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang btab ste grags can gser gyi mchod rten yang bskrun/ da dung btsun pa'i 'tsho rten thog la dka' gnad sel slad du btsun pa re rer lo gcig gi 'tsho ba gos rnams dang nang gi rkyen sman/g.yog gi chas dang bcas pa spyi'i dkor yang mang po btsugs so zhes 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉su gsal lo//'dir dmigs su bkar nas zhu dgos pa zhig la lha bla ma ye shes 'od rab tu byung rjes gu ger rgyal srid skyong mkhan chad kyang pho brang byang chub 'od kyis mu mthud bskyangs yod pa ni khong gis bka' gdams chos lugs kyi shing rta chen po jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gu ge'i mtho lding dgon par gdan drangs skabs nyin phyed zhabs thang du byon nas bsu ba mdzad cing / mnyes par byed skabs jo bo rjes bod kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' yin pa bden par 'dug gsungs yod pa ni khong srid skyong mkhan rgyal po'i tshul du bkod 'dug de bzhin khong gis chos phyogs kyi bya ba mdzad dus yul gyi srid dang gna' srol goms gshis sogs la do nan chen po byed kyin yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las pho brang btsun pas dar dang rin po che la sogs pa la 'khor lo dang nor bu bzos/ blon po dang bud med btsun mo rin po che'i cha lugs su bcug glang po che gcig kyang bzos/ rta dang 12

༄tsho//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/dmag dpon rnams rang rang gi cha lugs su bcug nas rgyal srid sna bdun bzhengs zhes pas 'jig rten gyi 'tsho bar yang do nan chen po gnang gin yod pas mdor na rtse lde rgyal po 'dir ma phebs gong du rgyal srid khong gis gcig lcogs lta bur bskyangs par mtshon no// lar na khong gi mtshan gyi mdun du ‘‘pho brang ’ zhes brgyab pa de srid dang 'brel ba yod par mngon/pho brang byang chub 'od 'das rjes zhi ba 'od kyis lo sum cu rtsa bzhi ring mtho lding dang mang nang sogs bskyangs/ de'i tshe gu ge rgyal srid rtse ldes bskyangs pas zhi ba 'od kyi mtshan gyi mdun la btsun pa'am lha btsun du 'bod kyin yod pa las pho brang zhes srid don mtshon pa'i ming med pas rtogs thub bo// khong ni chos dang yon tan la brtson 'grus shin tu che bas bla ma mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur cing khong gi dam pa'i chos gzhung mang dag cig bsgyur yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ bla ma nyid lo tsā mdzad nas dpal mchog gi rtsa 'grel dang bud+dha tsa ri dang / cha 'grel dang tshad ma/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa 'grel ṭika dang bcas pa/ tshad ma rgyan 'grel ṭika la sogs pa'i bka' phyi nang gi gzhung che chung mang po dang / lhag don du gsang sngags kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba'ang bsgyur zhes pas 'dul ba stod rgyud dar zhing rgyas par nus pa chen po thon yod cing / mthar lcags mo yos lor sku 'das so//gcen 'od ldes rgyal rgyud bskyangs shing srid kyi bya bar 'bad 'bungs skyed de thugs ru gtum zhing drag po'i dpung gi las la 'jug par lhag par sbyangs pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las gcen 'od lde btsan sku shed shin tu che bas sku na gzhon nu nas thugs rgyal can du 'khrungs pa/ 'khrug pa la 13

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'jam thengs gcig mar yul du gshegs pa'i dus mjug tu bru sha'i yul du dmag mdzad pas der dbu 'jams zhes pa dang yang gcung gnyis kyis gcen gyi sku srog blus slad du 'bad rtsol bgyis pa'i tshe dgra ngan nas khong nyid kyi sku dang mnyam pa'i gser dgos zer nas gser gang sar btsal kyang ma khugs te re zhig rang sor lus shing mjug tu gcen blu ba'i gser sdud du dbus kyi na sra gser kha tshun du phebs nas gser mang po gzigs so//gcen grongs pa gsan nas der thugs dgongs brdzangs zhes pa ltar khong rang yul la phyir log bya rgyu lta ci gzhan gyi dpung 'og tu tshud de 'das grongs byung bar mngon/ de min drang don mun sel gyi gtam rgyud las/ sngon pu hrang gi rgyal po dang gar log sog po bskyung skad kyi dmag 'thab pa la mi thams cad ni gri ru bsad/ nor zas thams cad ni gar log dmag gis khyer/ bud med thams cad ni kho'i yul du khyer nas rang yul mig gis mi mthong zhes pa de yang lo rgyus kyi don rkyen 'di'i skabs min nam snyam yang dngos gzhi ci 'dra yin min kha tshon gcod par dka' bas mu mthud dpyad par 'bad do//mnga' bdag 'od lde btsan la sras gsum te che ba blog rtsa btsan srong /'bring ba phye tsha rtse lde/ sku chung shos lde rtsa khri srong lde'am mtshan gzhan la grags btsan rtse zhes so// sras che ba btsan srong gis mu mthud spu rang la mnga' mdzad pa dang / 'bring ba rtse lde gu ger mngags gtong gis mes ye shes 'od dang khu bo pho brang byang chub 'od kyi rgyud 'dzin du bcug pas/ glang chen gtsang po'i lho ngogs su mchis pa'i gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du srid skyong ba'i rgyal po grags can zhig tu gyur/ sras chung ba grags btsan rtse yis ya rtser 14

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/byon nas rgyal rgyud bskyangs/ de nas bzung mnga' ris skor gsum gyi ya gyal skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi bu 'bring ba khri bkra shis mgon gyi rgyud pa ste/ spu rang rgyal rgyud de rgyal khag gsum du gyur/ rjes su gu ge'i rgyal rgyud de stobs shugs dang mnga' thang je cher rgyas nas/ tha ma spu rang rgyal rgyud dang ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud bcas kyang de'i dbang 'og tu bcug rjes su don dngos thog khri bkra shis mgon gyi rgyal rgyud kyi lte gnas de gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du chags te/bod gangs can gyi lo rgyus thog gu ge rgyal po zhes pa de spu rang rgyal po las grags pa che ba byung 'dug la/ de nas dar ba'i glu gar dang sgyu rtsal sogs shes rig la 'gran zla ni bod yul gzhan du ma mchis so/btsan srong gis yab mes dag gi shul bzung nas spu rang rgyal rgyud mu mthud legs par bskyangs shing khong la bu gcig byung bar mtshan ni khri btsan lde dang / de'i sras btsan phyug ldes chos phyogs kyi bya bar shin tu brtson pas spu rang khul gyi dgon pa grags can gnyis pa sha rdza'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing sbyin bdag thon nas dkor nor gya nom phul te chos gnas gzhan pa la'ang zhig gsos legs par mdzad/ de'i sras grags btsan ldes rin chen brtsegs kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par ma zad/ spu rang yul gyi rab byung ba nyis brgya tsam la bdag dbang du spyod chog pa'i sa cha phul ba dang mi re ngo rer gser zho re phul lo// de'i sras khri bkra shis btsan stobs lde'i ring la zhang zhung ngam gu ge'i lho stod dang ma 'cham par 'khrugs rtsod byung ba thag ma chod par rjes 'bras ci yang ma byung bas gu ge dang spu rang dbar la 'gal rkyen byung 'go tshugs so// de'i sras khri 'bar btsan gyis rma bya gtsang po'i byang ngogs thang sder zher du mchis pa'i 'khor chags dgon pa'i 'du khang rgya 15

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/che ru btang ba dang / mthing shog ngos la gser chus mdo'i gzhung mang dag dang rgyud 'bum chen la sogs pa bskrun no// khong gi skabs la gangs rin po che dang lha mtsho ma pham g.yu mtsho'i sku mdun du 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa je cher dar bas de'i shugs rkyen gyis spu rang rong yul du'ang 'bri gung pa'i chos par dad pa byed mkhan mang du byung / tha na rgyal pos dngos su 'bri gung chos rgyun la rgyab skyor mdzad cing / dad gus chen pos chos zhus so//de'i sras khri bkra shis dngos grub mgon po chos la sbyangs pa yangs shing sku yon rab tu 'phel la/ dbang shugs kyang ha cang che bas gangs rir bzhugs pa'i 'bri gung gi gangs ri rdor 'dzin pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad cing dkor nor phon chen phul te 'bri gung bka' brgyud par dud nas 'bri gung pa'i ri pas mnga' bdag tu dbang bskur ro// de'i sras mnga' bdag khri btsan lde ni chos kyi sku yon che bas rtse nan gyi gtsug lag khang rgya bskyed dang 'khor chags su gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing dbu lde bzhi bcu btsugs/der sras gnyis 'khrungs par sras gnyis pa rnam lde mgon spu rang rgyal rgyud kyi lte ba'i mkhar rtse rgyal zhes par bzhugs nas yab ltar 'bri gung gi chos sgor zhugs nas sgrub pa mtha' gcig tu mdzad de mkhar gong du bzhugs/ phyis su khong gis dad ldan pas phul ba'i dngul dkar phon chen las 'khor chags dgon pa'i 'du khang gi gtsang khang nang gi rdo chen a mo li ka'i steng na bzhengs yod pa'i shes rab kyi lha 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi g.yas g.yon du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor bzhengs nas 'khor chags jo bo rnam gsum zhes snyan pa'i grags pa mtha' phyogs rgyal phran kun tu khyab bo//da dung khong gis yum chen pu ti rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mthing shog la gser 16

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/chus bris pa dang / 〈bka' 'gyur 〉dngul yig gis bris pa'i rten rin thang bral ba mang dag bzhengs par ma zad/ rdo rje gdan gnyis par grags pa'i 'bri gung mthil du rin chen gser yig gis bris pa'i po ti brgya dang mchod rdzas dngul gyi tha li (sder ma/)dang dngul gyi skyogs brgyad cu/ rin chen g.yu byur mu tig gi phreng ba brgya la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rgyu 'bul mod mi dma' ba phul lo//spu rang stag la mkhar gsham gyi rma bya gatreng po'i nub phyogs gad steng g.yang gzar can du dgong khung ngam dgung phur (chos rgyal nor bzang gi btsun mo yid 'phrog ma dgung la 'phur ba'i gnas yin pas ming de byung skad/)zhes phug pa ya mtshan can zhig yod pa der 'bri gung gi rten gzhi btsugs/ khong la bu rgyud shul 'dzin med khar/ gcen po dngos grub kyi sras rgyal stobs ldes rgyal rgyud bzung / khong gis mnga' thang rab tu rgyas par mnga' khongs rgya bskyed btang ste shar tsha gyi gye khod kha la bya ba yan chad dang nub gser gdung shing tshun chad mnga' 'og tu bcug te phyi mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran dang yul lung dag tu grags pa che cher khyab cing nang gi rgyal mkhar ram pho brang du dgra zon slad du lcags ri legs pos bskor/ gser chus yum pu ti rgyas pa'am 'bum bzhengs/ yab mes kyi srol rgyun ma nyams gong du spel slad gangs dkar ti ser sgrub par bzhugs shing 'bri gung pa'i ri pa dag la zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa sogs kyi 'phrin las rgya chen spel lo//khongagi sras khri bkra shis rgyal lde dang tsha bo bkra shis stobs lding btsan gyis spu rang gi lho phyogs byang la bubs nas kha gong khang bcas dbang 'og tu bcug pa dang byang pa (tshopadagu yod/) dang pi ling sogs tsho pa dag mnga' 17

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'og tu bcug nas dbang bsgyur gyis khral bsdu khrims gnon mdzad par ma zad 'khor chags 'du khang gi byang phyogs su mchis pa'i gtsug lag khang la nyams gso dang rgya bskyed kyang mdzad do// bkra shis stobs btsan la sras gsum byung bar ar lde dang / chos btsan lde/ lha btsan bcas so//gcen gnyis spu rang rgyal sa dkar dum (spyir dkar dung zhes so/)gyi mkhar sor bzhugs nas chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa bskyangs shing / gcung lha btsun rdo rje seng ges rgyal srid legs par bskyangs so//khong gi sras bkra shis bsod nams lde yin/ khong ni chung ngu'i dus nas chos dang yon tan la sbyangs brtson shin tu che bas mkhyen rgya che zhing grub mtha' ris med la lta skyong byed mkhan rgyal po 'jon thang can zhig yin pas chos rgyal chen po'i mtshan thob/ de yang ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las 'di ltar bkod 'dug par/ grong spang du sku 'khrungs nas/ sku bsod shin tu che bas gzhon nu nas pu hrang gi rgyal srid tshul bzhin du bskyangs nas gon go phra la sogs pa btul/ kha char ('khor chags/)yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang phal che ba la zhig gsos mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu pa la ya rtse'i rgyal sa la mnga' mdzad/ lha sar jo bo rin po che'i dbu'i steng du gser tog gser kong / gzhan yang gdan sa thel/ sa skya/ 'bri gung / tshal gung thang rnams la gser chab/ gser tog la'ang dngul rkong 'bul rkyen sogs pa mang du mdzad cing / bu ston sogs la 'bul ba mang du mdzad do// gser gyi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉gtsang nas bzhengs te 'dir gdan drangs zhes rgyal po 'di stod mnga' ris phyi nang mtha' gsum du dbang thang gi grags pa che ba ma zad/18

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/dbus gtsang phyogs la'ang mtshan snyan shin tu che ba ni chos lugs grub mtha' ris med kyis bskyangs shing / dus rabs bcu bzhi'i nang dbus gtsang khul du chos srid gnyis kar dbang shugs nges can ldan pa'i phag gru bka' brgyud dang / 'bri gung bka' brgyud/ tshal pa bka' brgyud/ sa skya dgon pa/ zha lu dgon pa sogs dang 'brel ba btsugs pa spyi dang yang sgos bod kyi lo rgyus thog dgon pa'i rtse thog la gser gyi rgya phibs sgron pa'i lugs gsar du btod pa dang / gser yig gi bka' bstan bzhengs pa sogs mdzad rjes ha cang che la/ dbus gtsang khul gyi grub mtha' grags can khag gispyi'i sbyin bdag gi tshul du snang bas de ni bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus thog gi don chen zhig dang / lar na spu rang rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang / dbang shugs/ stobs 'byor rtser son par mngon la skabs de dus bod dbus gtsang khul du de lta bu'i mdzad pa bskyangs pa'i rgyal po byung ma myong / sa skya dpon chen dang dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum gyi khri dpon khag la'ang de 'dra'i mnga' thang stobs 'byor ldan pa ma lags so// de yang 〈〈deb ther dmar po 〉〉sogs su mdzad pa chen po de lta bu bskyangs mkhan ni ya rtse'i rgyal po yin zhes brjod 'dug kyang don dngos thog ya rtse ni spu rang gi rgyal po grags can de'i mnga' 'og tu tshud zin cing / khong gis ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud la bkod pa byed bzhin pa'i skabs su yin pas tshal pa kun rdor sogs 'khrul bar mngon/chos rgyal chen po bkra shis bsod nams lder 'bod pa'i rgyal po grags can der sras gsum byung bar gcen lnga sde dang / 'bring ba dpal mgon lde/chung kyir ti mel lo/(ya rtser yod pa'i chung ma'i sras/)'bring ba dpal mgon ldes 19

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal rgyud bskyangs nas spu rang khul gyi dgon pa mang por nyams gso dang gser dngul phon chen btang nas mdo sngags kyi dpe cha du ma bzhengs shing /yab chen kyi shan shugs dang bcas dbus gtsang khul du sbyin bdag tshul du dgon sde dag la 'bul ba rgya chen mdzad de grub mtha' mi 'dra bar btang snyoms kyis bya byed spel/ khong la sras gcig las med par mtshan la gnya' khri lde brjod/ pha rgyud bu 'dzin gyis pu rang ya rtse tshang mar mnga' dbang sgyur 'go brtsams kyang sku tshes ma thub nas sku na gzhon dus nas 'das grongs su byon/ khong gi khu bo kyir ti mel yum dang mnyam du ya rtser bzhugs nas der mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing / spu rang du'ang mnga' bskyangs/ khong chos la dad pa shin tu che bas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang po zhig ya rtser spyan drangs nas chos dpe mang po bsgyur du bcug cing / rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mchod rgyun mang dag btsugs pa dang 'bul ba rgya chen phul lo// kyir ti mel gyi sras rgod lam ldes ya rtser mnga' mdzad pa las spu rang du 'khom pa ma byung /des na spu rang du gdung chad nas gu ge rgyal rgyud kyis gcig gyur 'og tu btsud nas spu rang la 'go pa'am sde pas the jus byas pa'i lo rgyus 'go tshugs so//lnga pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud/spu rang rgyal po 'od lde'i sras mtha' chung khri lde grags btsan lde ya rtser byon nas rgyal srid bskyangs/ khong gi sras khri grags lde btsan/ de'i sras khri grags pa lde/ khong gi sras a seng lde yin/ de'i sku ring la ya rtse'i rgyal 20

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyud kyi mnga' thang rab tu rgyas shing stobs 'byor che bas phyi mtha'i tsho pa mi nyung ba dbang 'og tu bcug de nas rim gyis mdze ta ri mal/ de'i sras a khyi mal dang a dzha mal lo// gcung gi sras ka mal lde bcas gong du bkod zin pa'i ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud bdun po des ya rtse'i rgyal rabs kha gtsang skyong ba phud/ ka mal lde'i rjes su spu rang rgyal rgyud dang gu ge rgyal rgyud kyis ya rtser dbang sgyur byas yod kyang ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud sa gnas kyi 'go pa'i tshul du mu mthud du gnas yod pa ni 'bri gung pa'i gdan rabs so bzhi pa chos kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈gangs ri dang mtsho rin po che'i dkar chag 〉〉las ka mal rgyal gyi sras rgyal po bar tab rmal/ de rjes pu ṇi rmal/ de'i sras rgyal po bra ti rmal sogs nas kun mkhyen lnga pa dang rje 'phrin las bzang po'i sku dus kyi rgyal po bi kra ma sha dang de'i sras na ra sing ha zhes pa'i bar lo lnga brgya'i ring gi rgyal rabs rim byon thams cad thub pa'i bstan pa spyi bor mchod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs 'dzin 'ba' zhig dang / 'di la'ang dzum li ra dza/ nar lang ra dza/ kha las ra dza/ rdo ram ra dza/ phu ye ra dza ste rgyal po spun lnga las rgyal phran ltar gyes pa de thams cad/ spyir rgyal bstan/sgos 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'gran zla dang bral ba yin cing / dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i bsod nams kyi mnga' thang yang 'gran zla med pa sha stag byung ba ste/ ji skad du/ rje 'phrin las bzang pos 'dzum lang rgyal por gnang ba'i chab shog las/ khyod sngon ngos cag 'bri gung pa chen po'i// bstan la sri zhu mdzad pa de'i mthu yis// brgyud nas brgyud mar bsod nams dpung ba'i stobs// dar drags shis pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rgyal po na ra sing ha zhes 21

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chos rgyal gyi tha mar gyur pa 'dis kyang rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang / chos 'khor lha sa sogs su phebs/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po la'ang gus pas btud 'dug de'i rjes su rgyal po ka rañdza dang bhiṣ+ṭi ra dza zhes pa la sogs pa byung ba de dag gis lha mo u ma dang ma hwa de wa/ khyab 'jug sogs lhar bsten nas mu stegs byed kyi chos lugs bzung / chab 'bangs rnams la'ang mnar gcod cher byas/ bsod nams kyang dgun gyi chu phran bzhin skad cig rer zad nas mnga' thang je chung du song / de nas lo bdun cu tsam gyi mthar rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags bya lor(spyilo1801)bal yul tsha ba tsha shod kyi rgyal po gor shwa ra dza ra ṇa ba dur zhes bya ba'i dmag gis 'dzum lang rgyal sa bcom zhing mnga' thang thams cad 'phrog nas 'bangs su bcug pas de phyin la rgyal po'i bya ba byed pa'i dbang thang ni med mod/ rgyal rgyud tsam ni da lta'ang snang ngo zhes pa 'di nas ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud kyi phyi ma'i lo rgyus rags tsam shes thub/ de bzhin dus rabs bcu bzhi'i gong gi ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud kyi skor tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes mdzad pa'i deb dmar dang / yar lung jo bo shākya rin chen sdes mdzad pa'i 〈yar lung jo bo'i chos 'byung /〉 sa skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉bcas su bzhed pa mi 'dra ba dang rgyal rgyud mang dag cig bkod gnang 'dug pa de dag tshang ma gser tog pa rin rdor gyis bkod pa ltar bris zhes 'khod 'dug kyang lo rgyus kyi deb ther de da bar stod mnga' ris lo rgyus sogs la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi bod rig pa ba rnams kyi spyan lam du 'char ba'i go skabs ye nas ma mchis la/ deb ther de dag nang na drangs pa dag ni spu rang rgyal rgyud dang / gu ge rgyal rgyud/ ya rtse rgyal rgyud bcas 22

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/nya nyung mnyam bsres kyi tshul du bkod cing / klog pa po rnams dogs pa'i drwa rgyar btsud pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig las yid rton bya thabs bral/ des na mnga' ris su sa skyes rdo skyes byas pa'i gu ge pa ngag dbang grags pas dus rabs bco lnga'i nang mdzad pa'i 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉zhes pa dang stod mnga' ris yul la yun ring bzhugs myong ba'i 'bri gung gdan rabs so bzhi pa chos kyi blo gros kyis dus rabs bcu dgu'i mjug tu mdzad pa'i 〈〈gangs ri'i dkar chag 〉〉ni shin tu yid ches 'os pa zhig yin/ gang lags she na/phyogs gcig nas ngag dbang grags par gu ge rgyal rabs khag gi rgyal rgyud kyi lo rgyus sogs dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rin thang bral ba du ma longs su spyod rgyu'i go skabs legs po thob yod pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas khong gis gu ge rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po khag cig mig mthong lwag zin byung bas/ khong rgyal rabs de dag la rgyus mnga' shin tu che bar ma zad/ da dung brtun pa dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin btegs te/ mnga' ris rgyal rabs khag gi dpe rnying mang por gzigs pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog zhib 'jug zab nan gyis deb ther de nyid brtsams gnang bas so// yang chos kyi blo gros kyis 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud dbar gyi 'brel bar zhib 'jug do nan yun ring byas rting bris gshis dogs gzhi byed dgos pa gang yang med/ 'on kyang ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud kyi lo rgyus dngos ci ltar yin min dang zhib cing phra ba'i lo rgyus la mu mthud brtag dpyad zhib 'jug nan tan gyis dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang tsam btsal nas dpyad bsdur byed dgos pa dang / sa gnas der dngos su bcar nas zhib 'jug rgya chen byed dgos pa las kho bos 'dir dpyad gzhi'i yig cha nyung shas la brten nas kha mtshon chod mi thub bo//23

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/drug pa/ spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i gu ge'i rgyal rgyud/gu ge zhes pa zhang zhung gi skad de don du mun pa sel bar byed pa'i nyi ma ste skye bo'i smag rum gyi mun pa sel bar byed pa'i yi ge la'ang go bar grags/tha snyad de sngar zhang zhung skabs nas yod pa bod kyi rgyal rabs deb ther khag nang gsal zhing 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉las bod dang sum pa'i mtshams na gug ge cog la gnyis zhes zhang zhung stong sde bcu'i nang gses su bkod yod la/ kyi le gu ge rgyul po un chen dung gi bya ru can zhes skyabs ston las brjod pa/ lhag don du tun hong gi yig rnying nang la'ang gu ge zhes pa'i tha snyad de mang dag cig bkod yod pa de las yul de'i ming gna' snga mo nas thogs shing / zhang zhung skabs su rgyal phran shugs chen zhig yin pa dang /de'i rgyal sa gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du yod pa'ang gsal po yin/ rjes su gu ge rgyal po rim byon skabs mnga' thang rab tu 'phel nas chu mo glang chen gtsang po'i bzhur rgyun lho stod dang lho smad/ byang stod dang byang smad sogs dang /seng ge gtsang po'i bzhur rgyun dang sgar gtsang po'i bzhur rgyun tshang ma tshud yod/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mjug tu bod sde pa gzhung gis dbang 'og tu bsdus nas yul der rtsa rang rdzong dang mda' pa rdzong btsugs shing /rdzong khag de gnyis kyi khyab khongs sa gnas gu ge g.ya' yis bskor zhes g.ya' ri sngon pos phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad yongs su bskor ba'i yu la lung rgya chen der go dgos/ 'on tang gu ge'i thog ma'i rus rgyud dar yul ni glang chen gtsang po'i byang smad rab rgyas gling dang / zha ye/ shangs rtse/24

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/byang steng pa/ shed shed sogs yul lha mes ba'u bsten mkhan las go gi med pa ni dus deng sang yang spyir gu ge zhes pa sa gnas de dag gi rgyud la brjod pa las shes thub/spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu pa'i nang bod batren po'i rgyal rgyud kyi dbang shugs rma bya kha 'bab sogs stod kyi gtsang chen bzhi'i bzhur rgyun gyi sa char slebs nas yul der rim gyis dbang sgyur byed skabs mnga' ris rgyal po skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi tsha bo srong nge'am khri lde srong gtsug btsan cher longs nas sngar zhang zhung skabs stobs shugs nges can ldan pa'i lte ba'i gnas gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du byon nas yul der dbang sgyur byed pa'i ston mo 'khrab 'go btsugs so// srong nge'am khri lde srong gtsug btsan nam drang srong lde ni bod kyi me mo lug lo ste spyi lo 947lor rma bya kha 'bab shang shang rgyugs pa'i khul spu rang yul du sku 'khrungs shing / chung ngu'i dus nas shes rig bkra zhing skyes pa las thob pa'i shes rab mchog mnga' ba/ shes bya mtha' dag la ni 'jug pa yangs pa/ thugs dkyel che ba/ thugs sgam zhing 'jig rten skyong ba'i thabs la shin tu mkhas pa/ klog yig rtsis gsum legs par sbyangs pa/lus kyi rtsal sbyong byed par yang 'bad 'bungs legs par skyed/ de bzhin 'jim pa'i sku brnyan gyi rten bzhengs kyi bzo rig pa dang ri mo mkhan gzugs mchog tu gyur pa 'bri ba'ang phul du phyin pas rig pa'i gnas du ma khong du chud pa'i skyes chen dam pa phul du byung ba zhig lags/khong gis sku tshe'i stod du btsun mo gnyis khab tu bsus nas chen mar seng dkar zhes te der sras gnyis sku 'khrungs par mtshan khri lde mgon btsan dang lha 'khor lo btsan zhes gsol zhing rjes su dhe ba pra bha dang na ga pra bha zhes 25

༄khya//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bod do// btsun mo chung mar sras mo gcig byung bar mtshan lha yi me tog ces gsol mdor na khong sku tshe hril por sras dang sras mo khyon bsdoms gsum tsam byung zhing / sras gnyis mtho lding du bzhugs nas chos phyogs kyi bya ba spel ba dang btsun mos glang chen gtsang po'i byang phyogs dung dkar sogs su mnga' bskyangs shing lha khang bzhengs nas yun ring sgom sgrub mdzad do//khri lde srong gtsug btsan thog ma gu ge'i yul la phebs pa'i tshe zhang zhung gi gnas gzhi gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i gnas der bon po'i chos lugs shin tu shugs chen po yod par khong gi rnam thar las gtsug lag ni bon/ shing ni nag po tha gcig bon shing khra'o// gson po log chos spyod la shin (gshin )po'i rjes su sa 'og dur khung dang gson sbas byed pas gshin la sdig slong 'debs/ lta log yang ba'i myur lhung nyong (myongs )su myos/ sdig can nyams dar 'khyam pa'i khrod tsho gsung / mi'i lus la lha'i lhar bsgrub pa/ya mtshan ngo mtshar e ma ho smad re che/ lha'i byin rlabs lha rjer gang 'khrungs pa/ lha'i rjes 'brang lha'i chos spyod cing / lha'i mchog gyur lha'i dbu rim ste/ lha'i chos lugs dam pa dar mdzad/ rnam par dag pa'i lha'i lung bstan cing / dri ma med pa'i lha'i bstan pa skyong / lha la 'khrungs par gyur pa lha'i sras/ lha'i lhar gyur thub pa'i thugs kyi sras/ de phyir chos skyong rgyal po ring po dang / lha'i sras su mtshan gsol don dang mthun zhes dang /〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ gtsug lag ni bon/ gshin ni nag po/gson po rnams log chos spyod cing / gshin po rnams dur du 'grub/gshin po sdig rdzong 'debs te/ dkon mchog gi skyabs dang bral zhing chos kyi phongs zhes dang / yang dur srid la sogs spyod tshul sna tshogs pa dang /26

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/〈lha bla ma'irnam thar〉las/ ra rog po'i khog par lag pa rdzangs pa dang /phad bu nag po'i khog tu lag pa rdzangs pa la khyad par med ces bon gyi blta chos dang lugs srol ya mtshan can sna tshogs spyod kyin yod pa de yang lha bla ma'i rnam thar las sbyor sgrol chos su smra ba dang sdig pa la chos ltar spyod pa du ma byung ba de dag rdeg par mdzad/ ji skad du yang ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo dang dge sdig bstan pa'i mdo gnyis ka las/ tshe 'di la bon byed cing 'dre 'ongs so zhes rdzun zer bas nor len pa de ni/ gsham la sdug bsngal gyi bzod gsan bral ba'i dmyal bar skye'o// tshe 'di la bon byed cing /sems can gyi srog gcod du bcug de lha srin mchod du bcug pa de ni sa res bstums pa'i dmyal bar skye'o// tshe 'di la bon byed cing gshin dgos bskur ba dang khams bde mi bde lta zhing glen pa bslus de nor len pa de ni/lcags kyi dra bar bcug pa'i dmyal ba chen por skye zhes gsal skabs de dus gu ge'i yul der bon chos shin tu shugs chen yod pa brjod du med/des na sngar lha bla ma nyid kyi mes pos bod phrug mang po rgya gar du brdzangs nas chos dang yi ge bslab pa dang dam pa'i chos kyi gzhung mang dag bod yig tu bsgyur cing rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta grags can mang po gdan drangs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nyin byed gsal ba'i dbus gtsang gi btsan po'i rgyal rgyud rgyal sras khri lde srong gtsug btsan gyis sa pho khyi'i lor gu ge'i blon po zhang rung phyogs kyi sna'o las pa yul gyi gtso bo dang dgung lo bgres shing nyams myong ldan pa'i rgan po/ 'bangs dkyus nang nas blo rig bkra la/ shes bya che ba 'ga' bsdu bskong gis bon 'gog pa'i bya thabs sna tshogs spyad yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ bon po thams cad bsdus nas khang pa 27

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig nang du bcug nas me la bsregs/ bon dpe thams cad bsdus nas chab la rdzangs/ gshin po'i don du nor dur la sbed pa'i lugs yod pa bkag nas dge ba byed pa'i srol btsugs/ bod thams cad mtshan brjod kha ton byed pa dang bud med btsun ma byed pa'i srol btsugs zhes pa dang /lha bla ma'i rnam thar las bon po thams cad bsdus nas khang pa gcig tu bcug ste hom la gshegs gsungs so// bon dpe rnams 'ga' zhig chab la sbyangs/'ga' zhig zhugs la gsol/ 'ga' zhig sar bzhugs par gsol cing /'ga' zhig dri gzhon la spyan drang bar bya/ mdor na bon sogs log lta'i tshang tshing mtha' dag bsregs/ gshin po'i don du nor dur du sbed pa'i lugs yod pa bkag nas dge ba spyod du bcug ces khong gis bon chos la rdung rdeg shin tu drag po btang nas bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi 'dul ba legs par bskyangs par brtun pa dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin btegs par ma zad/ tha na blo rtse gong bu gcig sgril gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la 'jug phyir rang gi rgyal srid mnga' thang rgyas bzhin pa de'ang spu rang du rgyal rgyud bskyangs bzhin pa'i gcen 'khor re la phul lo//lha bla ma'i rnam thar las rang gi gcen 'khor re pu rangs nas gu ger phyag phebs/ gcen dang snga sor mol du gros pa ltar rgyal srid thams cad la mnga' mdzad par bcol te phyag tu phul/ gcen pos mnga' ris dang 'bangs skyong zhing 'jig rten gyi mdzad 'phrin dang du len par zhal gyis bzhes/ rgyal po srong nge yab sras thams cad kyi rab tu gshegs par thugs thag gtsang bar bcad phyi nang gi blon chen dag dang nye du 'ga' zhig gis zhu phal yang ma gsan pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na rin chen kun 28 ༄

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/'dus rdo rje zhes bya ba'i nor bu chen po yod de/ de ni gang du yang bsgyur bar mi nus sus kyang gzhig par mi nus pa bzhin gu ge rgyal po srong nges blo thag rbad de bcad zin pas rgyal srid bskyur nas chos phyogs lam la 'jug par som nyi ci yang ma mchis par lhag pa'i tshul khrims ngur smrig gos kyis bklubs shing lung rtogs yid bzhin rin chen nor bus rab tu brgyan la thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal 'bar bar mdzad/ de ltar sa mo glang (spyi lo 989)lor 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog mkhan po chen po'i mtshan can gnas brtan yod do'i drung du rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad de/ ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ rgyal po rab tu byung ba'i mtshan can te/ rgyal po lha dang rab byung gi rten yin pas bla ma zhes brjod/ de ni gangs can nang bstan gyi bstan pa phyi dar skabs 'dul ba stod rgyud dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa po yongs grags su lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces pa de'o//shing mo lug (spyilo995)gi dbyar zla 'bring po la lha bla ma ye shes 'od gu ge nas rdog thon gyis rang nyid 'khrungs yul spu rang du phebs shing / sru rang gi 'bangs mi dag la gsung chos thengs mang gnang / gcen po dang mnyam du bzhugs nas spu rang dang gu ge'i srid la phyogs lhung med par bskul/ de tshe 'khor res spu rang dang gu ge'i rgyal po gcig lcogs byas pas 'bangs yongs kyang rje gcig nyid la brten nas mnga' ris lo rgyus thog rje gcig gis rgyal khag gnyis su dbang sgyur mdzad pa'i dus thun mong ma yin pa zhig lags so// lo rjes ma ste me pho spre'u'i lor (spyilo996)gu ge'i yul du phyir log nas stod mnga' ris lo rgyus thog grags pa'i ba dan lhab lhub g.yo bar byed pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon sde thog ma ste mtho lding dgon pa de glang chen 29

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtsang po'i lho ngogs sang dar gzhung gi kha sprod du bzhengs shing / ming du mtho gling khang dmar dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes gsol/dbus su bstanapa'i gtso che'i sku bzhengs/ gling so sor yo ga rdor dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug lha tshogs sman spos kyi sku dang logs ris su bgyis pa dag me sprel nas shing pho 'brug gi bar lo hril po brgyad song ring / mchod pa'i rkyen dang zhabs tog gi rkyen yang mang du btsugs te sangs rgyas chos kyi gnas gzhi'i rmang bting ngo //gzhan yang pu rangs kyi 'khor chags yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'du khang ka ba brgya tham pa gling phran dang bcas pa dbus su byams pa mgon po'i sku bzhengs/ de min spi ti rta bo lcog la rgyan gyi lha khang / dbus su sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku bzhugs pa'i mar yul nyar ma'i lha khang mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang la nga ra'i ka nam gyi lha khang drugasag gi mo na'i lha khang / rong chung gi sru'i lha khang / gzhan yang pu rangs su tsha ba sgang la sogs pa lha khang brgya rtsa dang mchod rten dang gser sku dngul sku li ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bzhengs so// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing / chos khrims dang rgyal khrims legs par bskyangs/ yi ge bka' bstan mang du mdzad cing ban de dag la bka' lung nan tar dang dbon rabs byang chub 'od sogs la'ang bka' lung nan tan bcol te dgung lo smin tshe chos phyogs kyi bya ba khor nar brtson gyin yod par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las sku na shin tu bgres pa'i tshe na yang / mtho gling la phyag mkhar bsnams nas skor ba mang du mdzad cing /gzhan yang mchod pa'i las la mi mdzad kyang skul zhing rang gzhan kun gyis 30

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/bsgrub pa yin/ de'i tshe mtho gling du nye gnas gcig ma gtogs pa su dang yang mi mjal bar bka' bstsal te lo gsum gyi bar du sku mtshams bcad nas thugs dam du mdzad/ mtshams la thon pa dang re zhig 'dul lugs rnams la zhal bstan pa dang chos rtsigs kyi bka' lung mtha' ma bstsal ba'i phyir mang rgyud du gshegs pa la 'bangs thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi dad gus dang spro bas phyag 'tshal ba dang zhal lta zhing du bka' lung nyan pa'i phyir bsu ba rgya chen po byed cing / rab tu byung ba rnams kyis rang rang gi cha lugs tshang ba'i ser phreng dang rol mo'i tshogs mtha' dag gi shis brjod dpag tu med pas bsu ba zhus/ rgan po dang rgan mo rnams kyis kyang dad gus byed pa/de dag dang mthun pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas zhag lnga'i bar du sgrengs ma chad par bsu ba zhus shing / so so nas phyag dang bskor ba dang smon lam gsol 'debs la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas su gzigs nas lha la zhabs su thogs pa'i cha rkyen dang smon lam 'debs par mdzad ces sku tshe'i smad thugs dgongs yod rgu chos la 'jug pa gsal po mtshon la/ mthar sa mo lug (spyilo1019)lo ste dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis su mtho gling gzims khang du zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan te gzims khri'i mtha' mar gyur pa'i rtags bstan no// mdor na rgyal sras khri lde srong gtsug btsan sku tshe stod la gu ger phebs nas rgyal srid legs par bskyangs shing tshe mjug tu rab tu byung nas rgyal srid gcen 'khor rer gtad de gu ge'i rgyal rgyud bskyangs pas khong ni gu ge'i rgyal thog gnyis pa de'o//phyis su khong gi tsha bo byang chub 'od gu ger phebs nas chos srid gnyis ka legs par bskyangs pas mtshan la'ang pho brang byang chub 'od ces byung zhing 31

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las btsan po skya bo gdung chad na btsun pa nas gso ba zhes pa ltar pho brang byang chub 'od kyis mtho gling dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong dang gu ge'i rgyal srid zung du thugs 'gan bzhes yod pa gsal po rtogs thub bo// khong gi gcung po lha btsun zhi ba 'od kyis gcen gyi shul bzunge nas mtho lding dgon par mdzad 'phrin spel skabs gcen 'od lde'i bu 'bring ba rtse lde gu ger phebs nas gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal srid legs par bskyangs nas khong la khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes brjod cing / khong nas bzung ya gling dbus shar phyogs su snyan grags shin tu che ba'i gu ge'i rgyal rabs rgyal rgyud khag gi srid skyong dbang thang dngos su 'go btsugs pa dang khong ni mnga' ris lo rgyus thog mdzad rjes dang grags pa shin tu che ba'i rgyal po zhig yin pas yongs grags su gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/ sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdagabod kyi lha btsan po rtse lde zhes 'bod do//khong gu ge'i rgyal po mdzad rjes thog ma srid kyi sgrig gzhi legs par btsugs yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las chab srid kyi blon po ni thod du zangs kha ba rje blon gtag zig zhang rung ljid ldan ring mo/ cog ru dal ba bkra shis/ dpal 'bar rnams kyis mdzad ces pa ltar khong gis srid skyong rogs 'degs mkhan blon chen khag gcig bskos nas rang gi mnga' thang sra brtan du gtong ba'i 'dzin skyong gi rmang gzhi legs par bting /de nas mnga' thang rgya skyed gtong slad du phyogs mtha'i dgra bo tshar bcad cing /gzhan khongs kyi sa cha mang po dbang 'og tu bcug yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las gye sar 'dul ba'i dbus byang nges pa thang nas gdan stegs nas rgya'i du ram thang du rgya dang snol thabs mdzad pa'i tshe rgya'i 32

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/rgyan po bcu gsum skum nas chab srid phyag tu phul/ de nas gdan sa te byang go la gongs su gdan gting nas bzhugs pa'i dpung / gye sar gyis phyag phul nas gling gi mi bzhi phyag la btang te phyag 'bul shar phyogs mdo smad la sogs pa sna gsum brgya'i gong kha dmag ru tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ lho phyogs bre srang gi yul dang ya rtse chu la me 'bar sogs tshang lcags kyi rdo tshun chod dgu/ bod shing cher ma 'gor po bdun spyod shing btsugs/ra gan gyi 'breng shing / tshong 'dus 'ba' ra/ kha che tse steng tshun chod byang phyogs la 'jings la gnan/ de'i mchod rten tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus zhes pa 'di nas khong gis phyi mtha' rgyal phran dang tsho pa mang dag cig dbang 'og du btsud nas kha lo ji ltar bsgyur min dang drag po'i dmag gis thabs lam spyad de ci 'dra byas nas gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su bsdus nas rang gi mnga' thang rgya bskyed sogs gsal por shes thub nges so//gzhan yang rgyal po rtse ldes phyi mtha' rgyal phran khag gi rgyu nor longs spyod dang drag po'i mtshon cha sogs mkho rgu'i ca dngos yod do cog bsdu rub kyis bdag dbang ji ltar byas yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyul rabs 〉〉las ge sar gyi rmu khrab zil pa ma mo'i bdun sgribs/ lha khrab dkar po mgo byas/ khrab bco brgyad/ g.yu 'od ldan dkar po/ dkar chen spangs sa la sogs pa g.yu grags pa can nyi shu/ sgyu (rgyu )skar zla brgyad/ gza' rgyad (brgyad)/skus (spus )legs nor bu chung phyangs ma la sogs pa'i 'gur cha bcu phul/nor gyi gab rtse/ phya(phywa)'i gab rtse/ 'phrul gyi gab rtse gsum dang / ral gri srin mo khrag ldag 'brong rtse ring / glog dmar me bsod (gsod )la sogs pa ral gri bco brgyad/ rdzing khung dang bdud gri nag po/ dmu gri 33

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhung brgyad rnams kyi mgo byas pa'i skyed gri bco lnga/ sga ma 'ji khri steng /bkra shis bzhi 'degs la sogs pa sga nyi shu/ chibs bro bo lnga bcu/ ngang pa lnga bcu/ 'ol ba nyi shu/ bro bo sum cu/ 'bri zal mo nyi shu/ kham pa bcu/gzhan yang lug la sogs pa nor mang po phul/ khral bca' 'bul ba mang po bsnams zhes pas nang gi rin chen nor bu'i rigs dang phyi'i sems can sgo phyugs rigs/ drag po'i dmag la 'jug dus med du mi rung ba'i go mtshon rigs mchis so cog bdag gir bzung bar ma zad/ tha na bca' (dpya/)dang khral yang bsnams pa sogs rang gi mnga' thang dar zhing rgyas par byas yod cing / grags can gu ge rgyal po'i stobs dang mnga' thang rab tu 'phel ba'i rmang gzhi sra brtan btsugs pa gsal por mngon no//de nas rgyal po rtse ldes rang gi srid dbang sra brtan dang 'bangs mi tshang ma'i sems pa dog po gcig tu sgril slad yab mes khu bo sogs kyis 'bad 'bungs bskyed nas btsugs pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs la bcos ma min pa'i dad pa dang ram skyor mtha' gcig tu byas yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las yab mes kyi batsho' srol ltar/ dkon mchog la shin tu dad pa/khu lha rje bla ba'i gtsug lag khang dang dbu sde dang mdzad tshul thams cad kyi bdag rkyen dang gzhi len thams cad bla chen po rtse ldes mdzad ces de ni bon chos dar ba'i sa khul la gal 'gangs shin tu chen po yin pa brjod du med/lhag don du gu ge'i khul 'di sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lte bar brtson nas bod kha ba can gyi nang bstan 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus ring mo'i thog grags pa shin tu che ba'i me pho 'brug lo'i chos 'khor bskor yod pa ni 〈〈deb ther sngon po 〉〉las dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa chen po phal che ba yang 'dus/34

༄//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/chos kyi 'khor lo legs par so sor bskor/ zangs dkar lo tsā bas tshad ma rgyan yang de'i dus su bsgyur bar mdzad de/ spyir na mnga' ris stod kyi rgyal po de rnams kyis bstan pa'i zhabs tog bgyis pa de lta bu ni yul gzhan gang na yang ma mchis/ chos 'khor de la rwa lo tsā ba dang gnyan lo tsā ba dang /khyung po chos brtson dang / btsan kha bo che dang / rngog blo ldan shes rab dang mar thung dad pa shes rab ste lo tsā ba rnams 'dzoms zhes pa de nas skabs de dus bod dbus gtsang khams sogs kyi chos la mkhas pa'i lo tsā ba grags can mang dag mnyam 'dzoms byas nas 'dul ba stod rgyud bod yongs su dar bar nus pa chen po thon yod/ rgyal po rtse ldes bdag rkyen mdzad cing / rkyen legs par bskrun dbang gis khong gi mtshan snyan gu ge g.ya' ri'i yul du ma zad/ bod kha ba can gyi yul lung yongs khyab la gu ge rgyal po'i srid dbang sra brtan dang dar rgyas 'gro bar yang nus pa chen po thon no// mdor na gu ge'i khyad 'phags can gyi rgyal po rtse ldes thog ma rang khongs su srid kyi sgrig gzhi legs par btsugs te dpon blon 'jon thang can dag la go sa dbang thang sprad/ de nas drag po'i dpung dmag drangs nas mnga' khongs rgya bskyed btang ste stobs 'byor ldan par byas pa ste/ dbang shugs can gyi rgyal phran 'dzugs slad sngar phyi mtha'i rgyal phran khag gi rgyu dngos tshang ma bdag rkyen byas shing / mthar sangs rgyas chos lugs la rgyab brten bcol nas srid dbang sra brtan dang snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs mtha' kun tu lhab lhub g.yo ba sogs gu ge rgyal po'i lo rgyus thog khyad du 'phags pa'i mdzad rjes bskrun yod pa gor ma chag go/ des na rgyal po rtse lde rgyal srid skyong ring bya ba mod mi dma' ba sgrub yod kyang sku na bgres rjes su 'bangs chos la mi dga' ba 'ga' 35

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig gis lkog bsad btang yod pa ni 'di ste 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las mjug tu 'bangs mo la 'khus nas dkrong ste khu'i sngon la dgung gshegs so zhes bon chos byed mkhan gyis lkog ngan gnod 'tshe'i 'og rang gi khu bo bla chen btsun pa zhi ba 'od ma gshegs sngon la 'das so// ma gzhi rgyal po rtse lde phul du byung ba zhig yin kyang mtha' ma chos lugs grub mtha'i 'thab rtsod kyi sbyin bsregs tu gyur to//rtse lde'i sras che ba'i ming la seng grags zhes 'bod/ khong brang mkhar zhes pa'i mkhar du bzhugs te gdung rgyud bskyangs/ khong la gdung rgyud gsum tsam las byung med par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las de'i sras rtse 'od/ de'i sras jo rtse/ de'i sras rdo rje gdan zhes gsal zhing de nas gdung chad pa'am gang ltar 'khod med pa ni khong gi gdung rgyud kyis gu ge rgyal po'i srid la nus shugs de tsam chen po thon med par mngon/rtse lde'i sras gnyis par lha btsun dbang 'od ces pa der rtse lde rgyal pos mthong chen byas ste dkar po'i te lder zhes par bzhugs nas rang gi gdung tshab 'dzin du bcug nas rgyal srid bskyangs mod kyang khong gi gcung po'i bu zhang zhung lho (mang nang dang mda' pa/ ldong po/ khyung lung /)byang (dung dkar phyi dbang dang sang dar brgyud/) khul du dbang sgyur byed po mnga' bdag bsod nams rtse dang 'khrugs nas drag po'i dpung dmag bskul te 'dzings pas mthar mtho gling gi thang ka'i 'od du dkrongs zhes 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉na gsal bas khong la bu ma mchis pa'am rgyud pa byung ba sogs 'khod mi 'dugartse lde'i sras gsum pa'i ming la tsa me dī ḍa zhes pa de chung ngu'i dus nas grongs zhes so//36

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/rtse lde'i sras bzhi pa'am mtha' chung gi ming la zangs kha tsha khri bkra shis 'bar lde btsan nam ming gzhan la dbang lde'ang brjod/ khong gis gu ge'i mnga' khongs su gyur pa'i yul lung skya rgyas shing 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas zhang zhung lho byang gi mkhar chen sku mkhar du gdan sa chags par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉su sku bsod me ltar 'bar zhes pa ni sngar zhang zhung gi lte ba khyung lung sogs mnga' thang gra rgyas can la dbang bsgyur pa'i skal ba 'char bar mngon/ khong gi srid la ram 'degs byed mi blon chen 'ga' byung yod par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las de'i sku ring la blon po zangs kha/rje blon dga' skyid/ mda' pa rje blon grags dpal gyis byas zhes pa dang /yang yab mes kyi srol bzhin mdzad de lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel dang rgyan bsgyur pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad de yab kyi sngon la grongs so zhes pa sogs khong gi yab mes ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa che zhing chos lugs 'phel ba'i byed sgo sna tshogs spel yod cing / mthar yab chen rtse lde ma dkrongs gong las 'das grongs su gyur nas sku tshe ring mo bzhugs mi 'dug go/gu ge'i gal che'i mnga' khongs zhang zhung lho byang khul du mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i dbang lder bu gcig byung ba'i ming la che chen tsha bsod nams rtse zhes 'bod/ khong cher longs mtshams yab gshegs pas sdug bsngal drag po skyes pa dang 'jig rten 'khor bar snying po med pa sogs nges 'byung skyes nas rab tu byung bar dgongs kyang 'bangs mis re smon shugs chen bton nas srid skyong re byas pa bzhin mnga' bdag gi go 'phang bzhes nas blon po kyin hor ba zhes shugs drag chen po zhig byung ba'i ram skyor dang lcam lha sgron dang mnyam du 37

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mol bsdur byas nas gu ge dbus phyogs su mes rtse lde dkrongs pa'i dgra sha len ched dang chos log par 'dzin mkhan rmeg med bcom slad dpung drangs nas rgyal kha'i ba dan mthon por 'phyar yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las mes kyi sku sha go mo sum cu rtsa drangs bsad/ gzhan yang nag can phal cher bsad/ nag chen gyi lhag ma rnams kyang med par bya dgos dgongs zhes dgra ngan thams cad thal ba'i rdul du brlags par brtsams pa la a khu lha btsun nas 'gog rkyen sprad pas dgra lhag btul ma thub kyang a khu lha btsun dbang 'od dkrongs nas gu ge dbus kyi stobs shugs las rnam par rgyal nas gu ge'i mnga' khongs yongs su dbang sgyur byed mkhan rtse lde rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan phul du byung ba zhig chags/ phyis su mtho gling la bdag dbang mdzad yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las khu dbon 'khrugs pa byung na'ang / gar btabs rgyal te lcam lha sgron dang mol ba gang du 'gro nas rgya dmar mtho gling dgra bor rin chen gling gsum mthon por bzhengs zhes pas ni mtho gling brgya sa'i sgrol ma lha khang gi rten gtso sgrol ma yid bzhin re skong bsod nams rtse'i lcam gyis bzhengs shing / da dung dgon pa'i nang gi dge 'dun bzhi bcu tsam la mthun rkyen bskrun nas rtsal lag yod rgu bton te mes lha rje ste lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi gdung rten 'dzam gling rgyan zhes pa'ang legs par bsros pa'am bzhengs so//gu ge'i rgyal po che chen tsha bsod nams rtse la sras gsum byung yod par che ba bkra shis rtse dang / 'bring ba jo bo rgyal po/ mtha' chung 'od 'bar rtse'o//sras che ba bkra shis rtse yis yab kyi rgyal rgyud bzung nas gu ge'i lho (glang chen gtsang po'i lho phyogs su gnas pa'i mnga' thang /)byang (glang chen gtsang po'i byang 38

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/phyogs su gnas pa'i mnga' thang /) gi khyon yongs su mnga' dbang bsgyur nas gdan sa'am lte ba de dun bstar du byas nas chab srid bskyangs/ rgyal po bkra shis rtse'i sras che ba a ka ra dang gnyis pa tsan ṭa bho ti/ gsum pa a mi sogs tsa/ bzhi pa phyogs tsa/ lnga pa rtse 'bar btsan te lnga byung ngo //bsod nams rtse'i bu 'bring ba'am bar pa jo bo rgyal po khu nu'i rgyal po la bskos/ de nas khu nu'i rgyal rgyud dar/ khu nu ni srib skyes la'i nub phyogs la yod pa'i rnam rgya dang spu sogs kyi yul la gnas pa'i tsho pa zhig lags shing khu nu'i rgyal rgyud kyang gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud bkrus na ma dag pa yin pa gsal po 'dugargyal sras mtha' chung 'od 'bar rtse rong chung la mnga' bsgyur pa'i dbu gtsor bskos/ rong chung ni lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'khrungs yul dang gu ge'i lho nub khul la yod/ der rad nis dang / gser khung / kyug pa/srib skyes bcas glang chen gtsang po'i lho phyogs na gnas pa'i yul lung rtsi shing sna tshogs kyis gtams pa dag dang / phu ri/ ku rang / rong stod/gti g.yag ma yang sogs glang chen gtsang po'i byang phyogs su gnas pa'i chu phran mtshe'u sman rtswa du mas khengs pa'i yul thun mong ma yin pa zhig ste de'i lte gnas ni gti g.yag yin cing / dus deng sang yang lung chung gang sar mkhar gog phon chen yod pas rgyal sras 'od 'bar rtses dbang bsgyur skabs mi 'bor mang la mnga' thang gra rgyas phun sum tshogs po yod par sems/ lo chen skabs bzhengs pa'i dgon rnying mang che ba yul der gnas shing / bud med kyi rgyan gos dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa dang glu gzhas sogs gna' snga mo gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud skabs kyi gna' srol rig gnas dag la de tsam 39

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi nyams chags shugs chen po rang byung ba med pa bcas stod mnga' ris sa khul gyi gnas thun mong min pa zhig go/rgyal sras bkra shis rtse dang gcung po gnyis la sogs pas sngar yab mes skabs med pa'i mtha' khul sa gnas mang dag cig dbang 'og tu bsdus shing /gu ge'i mnga' khul rgya skyed shugs che tsam btang bas phyi'i rgyal phran mi nyung ba zhig khros 'khrugs brngams nas tshur rgol drag po byas yod par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las gar log gis dmag ston/ gnyi gong gis phu rogs bkra shis rtse dkrongs/ gcung 'od 'bar rtse sog po'i yul du dbu 'jam zhes gzhan yul la brnyas pa'i rjes 'bras su rgyal sras che chung gnyis kar rang yul dang gzhan yul du srog skyon dang god chags chen po byung ngo // des na rgyal sras 'bring ba khu nu'i yul la mnga' sgyur mkhan jo bo rgyal pos gu ge'i rgyal po'i rgyal srid gcig lcogs su bskyangs nas dpung dmag phon chen bsdu rub kyis phyi'i dgra ngan tshang ma btul/ nang gi nyams pa sor chud byung ste 'bangs mi dag la byams dang gces skyong zhabs zhu legs par byas pa'i dbang gis 'bangs mispu rgyal por 'bul ba nyams mi dma' ba phul lo// jo bo rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud ni rgyal sras gcung lde/ de'i sras lde/ de'i sras jo bla ma khong lha btsun byas nas mtho gling dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs pas de nas bzung rgyal po'i gdung rgyud gsal po 'khod mi 'dugabakra shis rtse gar log dmag gis dkrongs rting khong gi sras rtse 'bar btsan gyis mu mthud dun bkar (gong du brjod zin pa'i dun mkhar dang dun bstar zhes pa dang dag cha mi gcig pa las don du rgyal mkhar gcig rang lags so/)du bzhugs te rgyal rgyud zin nas rgyal khongs su mnga' gsol/ khong la rgyal 40

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/sras gcig byung bar ming la le lo mi zhes 'bod/ khong mtho gling gi dril bu rtser bzhugs/ dge 'dun gyi tshul khrims legs par bskyangs pas gdung chad la khad skabs su snga rting du pi ti rgyal mo lha rgyan dang cho chen blo ldan rgyal mo gnyis khab tu bsus par rgyal mo lha rgyan la sras gnyis byung bar rgan pa spyi lde btsan dang gzhon pa rtse ldan mngal lo// cho chen blo ldan rgyal mo la'ang sku sras gnyis 'khrungs par rgan par dpal 'od btsan dang chung bar 'dul srid 'dul btsan du grags/ rgyal po rtse 'bar btsan gyis btsun mo gnyis bzhes rkyen gyis gu ge'i rgyal rgyud la bar chad chen po byung ngo //〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las slad na yab rtse 'bar rtse grongs nas sku 'das chen mo mtho gling du mdzad pas zhes pa ltar bu bzhi'i yab chen rgyal po rtse 'bar rtse sku gshegs rjes 'das mchod dang zhabs brtan mtho gling dgon par byas so// khong gi 'das mchod gzhug ma bsgril tsam la btsun mo gnyis dbar 'gal zla chags nas 'khrugs rtsod chen po langs yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las chang btsos pa'i sbang ma ma skam la byang ngos kyi btsun pa 'ga' dang lho phyogs kyi mi 'gas dkrugs brgyab nas rgyal mo lha rgyan dang blo ldan rgyal mo sde/ jo bo gnyis ma 'chams pa'i rkyen byas nas 'khrugs te mnga' ris bzang dpe gcig la phyogs ris ngan pa gnyis su gyes zhes par thog ma'i 'khrugs rkyen slong mkhan ni 'das mchod kyi zhabs brtan sgrub mkhan glang chen gtsang po'i byang ngos (phyis su yul der phyi dbang du 'bod/de'i khul la lha bla ma shes 'od kyi sras mo lha yi me tog yun ring bzhugs nas chos khang kyang bzhengs yod/)kyi btsun pa mi nyung ba zhig dang lho phyogs(glang chen gtsang po'i lho phyogs gu ge rtsa rang mkhar gyi rgyud/)kyi mi 'gas ma rung khog 'jug byas te 41

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal srid sus 'dzin dgos min skor la dkrugs shing bzos te mthar rgyal mo gnyis dbar la 'gal zla chen po langs nas mi rabs du ma'i ring dog bu gcig tu sgril nas yod pa'i gu ge'i rgyal po'i mnga' dbang khag gnyis su gyes nas lho stod khul du blo ldan rgyal mo'i sras dpal mgon btsan gyis mnga' thang bskyangs mod kyang khong gi rgyud pas gu ge'i rgyal po'i rgyud 'dzin thub med gshis gu ge yongs su dbang— sgyur thub med kyang / khong gi rgyud pas lho stod du 'dzin skyong byas te phyis su mda' pa chos rgyal zhes dmigs bsal dbang thang yod la/ gu ge rgyal por gtugs mi dgos par 'dra mnyam tshul du yod pa ni gu ge jo bdag po dang mda' pa chos rgyal zhes go 'bab cha 'dra ltar lags shing phyis su gu ge'i rgyal rgyud nyams kyang mda' pa chos rgyal gyi rgyud pa mu mthud gnas par mngon no//byang phyogs su rgyal mo lha rgyan gyi bu rgan pa spyi lde btsan pos mnga' byas/khong dgung lo chung dus blo rig bkra bas yi ge sogs legs po mkhyen yang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las mol mi mkhyen zhes smra ba mi mkhyen pa'am lkugs pa zhig yin pas rgyal po dang blon po dbar don chen che rigs ci byung la mol bsdur mdzad dus phan tshun yi ge bris nas gros thag gcod kyin yod/phyis su sman bcos legs po byas rkyen gyis ngag grol nas smra lce bde ba/thugs mdzangs shing khog yangs dkyel che'i rmad du byung ba'i rgyal po zhig byung bas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉nang 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes 'bod do// khong 'jon thang shin tu che bas gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud dngos su 'dzin mkhan du gyur nas gu ge lho stod phud/ de byings sa khongs yongs khong gi mnga' 'og tu btsud cing mnga' thang rab tu rgyas so// khong la sras gnyis 'khrungs shing 42

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags trem dpyad pa/sras che ba'i ming la nyi lde btsan dang chung ba'i ming la khri bkra shis rnam rgyal lde btsan zhes brjod/ gcen nyi lde btsan chung byis pa'i dus nas bzung chos dang yon tan la shin tu smon nas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las dam pa'i chos la dad pas mnga' bdag tu dbang ma bskur thugs rtse dam la rtse gcig tu mdzad ces pa ltar chos phyogs kyi bya ba kho nar brtson nas gu ge'i khul du chos sngar bzhin dar bar 'bad pa bskyed kyang khong gi skabs dang mes po'i skabs te bstan pa phyi dar skabs 'dul ba stod rgyud dbu brnyes dus dang bsdur na nyams chags ha cang chen po phyin zin pa gor ma chag go/spyi lde btsan gyi sras chung ba rnam rgyal sde srid la 'jug par 'bad nas yab rgyal po'i mnga' thang dar bar bskyangs/ khong la sras gsum byung yod de rgan pa gung lde btsan dang / 'bring ba nyi ma lde/ mtha' chung lha btsun lde'o// bu 'bring ba nyi ma ldes rgyal srid bskyangs/ khong gi skabs la gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' thang rab tu rgyas shing phyi nas dgra med pa dang nang nas bgegs dang bar chad sogs rang byung gi gnod tshe gang yang ma byung ba ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las sku bsod dang dpal 'byor shin tu che zhes pas 'bangs mi thams cad dga' skyid kyi 'tsho ba longs su spyod rgyu'i dus skabs legs po shig shar ba lags so// khong gis chos phyogs bya ba spel bar 'bad brtson rags tsam byas yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las rgya maragaser gyi stong phrag brgya pa dang gser dngul spel ba'i mdo mang tshang ba bzhengs/ pu hrang la jo bo rgyal tshab bzhengs zhes pas 'thus so//rgyal po khri bkra shis rnam rgyal btsan la sras gsum ste che ba dge 'bum dang / 'bring ba byams pa/ chung shos la sems dpa' zer ro// rgyal 43
