༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sras rgan pa dge 'bum gyis rgyal srid bzung ba'am mnga' dbang bskur/khong gis 'jig rten phyi nang gi bya ba mtha' dag la 'phyug pa med par mdzad cing / lhag don du rgyal khang gi rgyu dngos rin chen sa le sbram mang po bed spyad de sku mang dag bzhengs yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las tho ri brgya rtsa brgyad/ bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi sku brgyad/ sgrol ma'i sku gcig gser gyi sgrol ma'i sku tho phyed du slebs pa cig bzhengs/ gsung gi rten yum rgyas 'bring gnyis gser la bzhengs zhes pas gu ge rgyal pos chos kyi bya bar mu mthud 'bad 'bungs skyed kyin yod pa mtshon la/ skabs de dus kyang da dung yum rgyas 'bring sogs gser bris byed pa'i gna' srol bzang po nyams med pa mthong thub/ spyir mnga' ris khul gser bris kyi yum rgyas 'bring ha cang mang po bzhengs yod kyang phyis su dmag 'khrugs sogs kyis gtor brlag mang po byung yang gu ge'i rong chung khul phu ri dgon par gser bris kyi yum rgyas pa cha tshang glegs shing la brkos dkrol legs par sgron pa nyams chag gang yang ma byung ba cha tshang bsdad yod do// rgyal po dge 'bum sku tshe ring ba'i dgung lo bdun cu bar bzhugs so//chos phyogs kyi bya bar thugs shin tu chud pa'i rgyal po dge 'bum la sras gsum byung bar rgan pa kye rdor dang / 'bring ba la ga chung ba thos pa'o//rgyal sras rgan pa dang chung bar rgyud pa ma byung pas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉su snga phyi gnyis gdung gum zhes pas mthar sras 'bring ba la gas rgyal srid bzung nas chos phyogs kyi bya bar chos sems che bas gu ge lho stod dang lho smad gnyis kyi dbus su chags pa'i mang nang du gtsug lag khang bzhi bzhengs nas mang nang dgon pa rgya skyed du btang / thang du chags pa'i mang nang dgon pa 44

༄//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/deng sang yang mthong rgyu yod/ gtsug lag khang bzhi bzhugs med kyang sngar mang nang la mkhar chen 'ga' shas byung zhing nye 'khor la lha khang mang po byung ba'i shul 'dug pa de tsho min nam snyam/rgyal po des phyogs mtha'i dgra bo las rnam par rgyal bar byas pa'i tshul ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las shar gyi phyag stod go gsum/ pe khung gnyag dang mnga' ris skor gsum mngar bsdus zhes pas khong gis gu ge'i mnga' khongs rgya skyed shugs che tsam btang yod pa ni mnga' ris skor gsum mngar bsdus zhes pas shes thub/ khong ni do nan la thugs sgam pas nang srid kyang legs bsgrigs mdzad de phyi nang bya ba gang la'ang 'thus sgo je tshang du btang bar mngon no// rgyal po der rgyal sras gcig las ma byung bar khong gi mtshan la chos rgyal grags pa zhes so// khong dang blon po rgyud dpal dar phan gnyis 'cham mthun dang sbrags rtogs pa che gshis zhi 'jam dal bas gu ge mkhar gyi shar phyogs su gnas pa'i mtho lding dgon pa'i bla chen dag dang thugs mthun skyabs bcol mdzad res gnang bas rgyal srid la gnod pa nyung la brnyas gtser byed mkhan sogs med cing / zhi bde lhing 'jags lta bur gnas kyang khong sku tshe ring po ma thub par dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la 'das so//chos rgyal grags par sras gcig 'khrungs par mtshan la bla chen grags pa zhes brjod/ khong ni gu ge rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus thog gzi byin shin tu che la byas rjes brjod kyis mi lang ba'i khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhig yin/khong gis tshe gang ring dka' ba du ma spyad nas gu ge rgyal rabs kyi dbang thang dang / stobs 'byor/ dpung shugs bcas phyogs gang gi thad nas kyang mtho rlabs gsar pa zhig 'phyur bar byas yod/ khong gis chab srid 'dzin 45

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyong gi khri steng la 'dzegs ma thag par glo ba nye shing 'jon thang che ba'i blon chen yar dkar gung ldog dang mnyam du mnga' khongs rgya bskyed kyis bya ba shugs chen spel nas phyogs mtha'i rgyal phran dang tsho ba mang dag cig rang gi dbang 'og tu bcug yod pa ni 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las pu gug (pu rang dang gu ge/)gnyis ka la mnga' mdzad/ ya rtse chu la me 'bar tshun chad mngar bsdus pa gus pas btud cing gdung rgyud kyi rgyal tshab re gnang ba'i zhu 'bul byed pa/ de dag dang mthun pa'i bka' bstsal zhing / mnga' ris shar nub kyi rje sgo rnams zil gyis mnan cing / kya nom/ nyi ti/ grum gnyis/ hrang nam/ sang wang / ad ru rnams btul nas khur shud 'jug khul sogs kyi khral yang bsdus nas 'gran zla med pa byas so zhes rgyal po 'di nas bzung sngar stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi ya rgyal gu ge rgyal rgyud kyi mes po'i mnga' dbang spu rang rgyal po de gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu bcug cing spu rang rgyal rgyud nas mched pa'i ya rtse rgyal rgyud kyang gu ge'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus par ma zad/ gu ge'i lho phyogs kyo nam dang nyi ti/ hrang nam sogs tsho pa grags can drug kyang gu ge'i mnga' 'og tu bsgyur nas bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus thog stobs 'byor mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i grags can gu ge rgyal rabs zhes pa'i snyan dbyangs phyogs bzhir khyab nas ya gling dbus shar rgyud du'ang 'gran zla bral ba'i rgyal rabs shig tu gyur/rgyal po grags pa sde phyi'i mnga' bsgyur gyi mdzad 'phrin rab tu rgyas par ma zad/ nang srid dang chos la'ang bya ba chen po mdzad yod par 〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉las dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la yang shin tu dad cing mnga' ris dgon pa rnams la rta'i 'gyed rim par mdzad cing / bla ma 46

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas rgya (rgya gar/) nas spyan drangs nas phar phyin gyi bshad grwa btsugs shing / dbu sde go gsum la sogs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/bla ma mkhas btsun mang po la dbang dang gdams ngag zhus shing / khyad par du yi dam jo bo bcu gcig zhal la thugs dam mdzad/ rin po che las sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs pa'i tshad tsam dang yum rgyas 'bring bsdus (rgyas par pu ti bcu drug dang 'bring bar pu ti bcu gnyis bsdus par pu ti brgyad yod pa brgyad stong zhes pa de'o/) gsum gser chu las bzhengs/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po dang yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i mtho gling dang dpal rgyas la sogs par zhig gso mdzad do// khong ni sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa che ba kho na min par sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rig gzhung la rtogs pa ldan zhing do snang chen po yod pa ni bla ma mkhas btsun dag la brten nas dbang dang gdams ngag zhus shing / lhag par du gong du brjod pa ltar phar phyin gyi bshad grwa btsugs pa sogs rig gnas kyi rin thang ldan pa'i dgon rnying mtho gling sogs la zhig gso byas pa bcas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rig gnas la do 'khur chen po byas 'dugalhag par du rgyal po de'i dus nas bzung gu ge'i rgyal rgyud dang 'bri gung bka' brgyud dbar 'brel 'dris thog ma byung yod par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las khyad par du chos kyi rje 'jig rten mgon po'i dbon rabs drug pa gu ru dha rma ra dza'i drung du gces phrug brgya dang / gser/ zangs/sman la sogs pa gtong 'bul bcas te 'bul du brdzangs zhes gu ge rgyal khongs kyi dmigs bsal can gyi thon khungs gser zangs dang sman rtswa sogs gya nom pa gces phrug brgya tsam la bskur nas 'bri gung dgon pa ga la ba der 47

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcar nas 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan rabs drug par zhal mjal dang bcas 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang gu ge rgyal po dbar la 'brel ba dam zab btsugs pa ni gangs rin po che'i rgyud kyi 'bri gung gangs ri rdor 'dzin la mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba btsugs pas las lhag pa zhig yin pa ni 'bri gung chos kyi blo gros kyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈gangs ri'i dkar chag 〉〉las/gu ge rgyal po grags pa sde dang lha lcam bsam grub rgyal mo yab yum gyis pu rang rgyal di mkhar du gdan drangs nas chos zhus pa'i yon du pu rang thang yab stod smad la sogs pa phul zhes so// dus mtshungs khong gis yab mes kyi spyi nor du grags pa'i lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la'ang mchod rdzas mang po phul bar 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las pha mes kyi mchod rdzas mang po dang mi brgya la phyag brgya mdzad nas mi re res kyang jo bo'i drung du phyag brgya brgya phul ba phyag gis bkur ba dang smon lam 'debs su bcug ces pas khong thag ring gangs can nub phyogs kyi yul gyi rgyal po zhig yin kyang rang gi yab mes kyi mdzad rjes la gus bkur yid rangs dang yab mes kyi bzhag pa'i rtsa chen rig dngos la rjes dran dang mthong chen byed kyin yod pa'ang gsal por mngon/ rgyal po 'dis chos srid kyi mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che du ma bskyangs nas mthar dgung grangs bzhi bcu zhe brgyad du phebs dus 'das so//rgyal po grags pa lde la btsun mo gnyis dang btsun mo re la sras re ste sras gnyis byung ngo // mon yul gyi grong khyer u ti pur gyi rgyal po'i sras mo zhig khab tu bsus nas rgyal sras rgan pa dpal 'bar lde 'khrungs shing /khong sku tshe ring po ma thub par dgung grangs bcu gsum thog la gshegs/btsun mo bdag mo sku rgyal la rgyal sras mnga' bdag khri rnam rgyal lde 'khrungs/48

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/khong sku 'khrungs ma khad du dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan zhing bltas ha cang bzang po byung yod pa 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las dbu gdugs dang 'dra ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes phye ba/ smin mtshams ring ba/ phyag ring zhing sor mo byin gyis phra ba/ phyag mthil la bkra shis ri mo yod pa/ smin ma gnyis kyi bar du mdzod spu dkar po sor bzhi pa 'khyil nas gnas pa/ spyan dang pags pa'i mdangs shin tu dwangs pa zhig ces khong la bkra shis dge mtshan ldan pa'i mtshan rtags yod pa bkod do// de tshe rgyal po'i rgyal khang gi sku mched dag dang sku 'khor thams cad kyis bkra shis par mngon nas dga' ston rten 'brel dang sku rim rab dang rim pa gnang zhing snyan pa'i mtshan yang mkhan chen chos dpal grags pa'i drung du lha btsun mdzad nas mtshan rnam rgyal lde dpal bzang po zhes btags so//khong chung byis pa'i skabs nas mthu rtsal dang blo rig rnam par bkra ba'i bu chung khyad 'phags shig mchis pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/chung ngu'i dus nyid nas sku stobs shin tu che bas gzhan stobs che bar grags pa'i byis pa bzhi bzhis drangs pas mi thub pa/ gzhon nu'i dus su gzhu rgyud thengs re tsam phyag sor la bkan pa tsam gyis skud pa gcod/ bang dang mchongs dang / mda' dang / sgyu rtsal thams cad/ thugs shin tu rno zhing thugs zhib pa/ thugs rab che bas gsung mkhyen nas yi ge dang klog la shin tu dgyes/ yi ge bris nas de'i don dang / dbyibs dang / tha snyad dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos dang gtsug lag la sogs pa'i chos tshul thams cad la brtson zhing / sku dang gsung gi mdzad spyod thams cad dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par dge zhing gzhan la gnod pa dang rtsed mo tshig rtsub 49

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la sogs mi mdzad/ skabs su ma babs pa dang gzhan rtsi chung co 'dri ba dang mtho 'tsham pa dang klag cor dang rdzun dang / phra ma dang / gzhan la snyad 'tshol dang bag med kyi spyod pa gang yang mi mdzad ces rgyal po'i rgyal sras la 'dzoms dgos pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang babs chags pa/ shes bya yon tan che ba 'jig rten mi chos dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha chos tshang mar rmad du byung ba'i cha rkyen mtha' dag 'dzoms shing rgyal sras lha yi spyod pa ldan pa zhig ltar bkod 'dug go/rgyal sras khri rnam rgyal lde cher longs nas nang gi rgyal srid skyong bar 'jon thang shin tu che zhing bka' khrims dam la btsan pa las la brtson 'grus che ba/ 'bangs mi ser thams cad la byams skyong che ba sogs kyis rgyal po'i mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing / dro skyid nyi zer 'og la 'tshar longs byung ba ltar dmigs bsal can zhig mchis par 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las de nas bzung ste mnga' ris yul 'brog thams cad dar zhing rgyas la legs pa/ rkang 'gros kyi khyu 'phel ba/ skye bo 'du tshogs mang ma nad dang mu ge med pa/ phyogs kyi tshong zong mod pa/ dus kyi 'khrugs pa med pa shin tu bde zhing rgyas pa yin no zhes bkod 'dug la gu ge'i byang stod na mchis pa'i deng sang phyi dbang zhes par khong bzhugs myong ba'i mkhar gog brjid nyams ldan pa zhig yod la yul der gnas shing rgyu ba'i mi ser tshang mas dus deng sang (spyi lo 2001gi ston dus kho bo der bcar nas rtog zhib byed skabs su yul de'i gna' rabs kyi chos lugs skor brjod yod/) yang bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi gtam ldar ldir du brjod kyin yod par khong tsho'i kha rgyun du mkhar la mkhar rtse rnam rgyal// mi la mi dbang rnam rgyal// zhing la gser ral g.yu 50

༄༅//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/ral// rta la 'ol ba rting dkar// khyi la dom bu snying dkar// dud grangs phyi stong nang stong // mi zhar rta zhar brgya re// zhes rgyal po'i mkhar gyi ming dang rgyal po'i ming / 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i zhing kha legs po/ rgyal po'i chibs pa rta yi phud gzugs 'ol ba'am nag po yin pa la rting pa dkar rkyang yin pa ni rta mchog dmigs bsal can zhig go/ khyi dom gyi bu ltar gzugs stobs che la shed mo yag par snying gi thad kar dkar thig yod pa de'ang khyi'i nang nas khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/ dud grangs ni mkhar gyi phyi la stong dang mkhar gyi nang du stong yod pa ni ha cang phon che la gra rgyas skal ba bzang ba ma zad/ rgyal srid mnga' thang phun sum tshogs shing dpal dang dge mtshan chen po yod pa mngon/rgyal sras khri rnam rgyal lde dpal bzang pos phyi phyogs la bstun mkhas dang dbang sgyur gyi mdzad 'phrin yang shin tu legs po bskyangs yod pa ni yab chen rgyal po nang bzhin spu rang dang ya rtse sogs la mu mthud de mnga' mdzad yod pa'ang thengs gcig phyi mtha'i 'go dpon khab so'i nang rdor rgyal dang dkon mchog mgon po rgyal nas spu rang rgyal ti mkhar (deng sang spu rang rdzong chags sa'i skyid thang gi byang phyogs ri steng gi mkhar gog der brjod/) btsan bzung byas nas spu rang yul dag btsan 'og tu 'jug rgyu'i nyen kha ha cang che ba'i skabs su khong gis gu ge nas dpung dmag btang nas dgra ngan lam seng phyir sgyugs pa dang khong gi glo ba nye ba zhig sku tshab tu bskos nas spu rang lhing 'jags yong bar 'bad/ sa mo yos lo la mar yul la dwags gyi mnga' bdag khri btsan lde la phyi dgra ble ye'i jo bo lha btsun dang / 'od lde spun/she ye ba dang bsdongs nas ngo log byas nas rgyal srid mnga' thang la 'o brgyal 51

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen po bzos nas skyabs bcol zhu dus rgyal po rnam rgyal ldes dpung dmag drangs nas so spo la'i bar du cham la phab ste she ye dmar bzung byas shing kho'i phyogs gtogs la rgol rdung drag po sprad nas mnga' bdag khri btsan gyi mnga' 'og tu bcug te yang skyar rgol ba'i nus pa spu tsam yang med pa bzos/de min yang rgyal po de'i skabs phyi mtha' zangs rgyud (zangs lha rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud de ni skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi sras chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyi rgyud pa lags/)kyis ngo log gam jag pa btang nas 'phrog bcom sogs bya ngan sna tshogs spel bar dang thog dpung shugs chung tsam btang nas rgol lan sprod skabs zangs rgyud pas nyams chung la bzung nas tshur rgol de bas che tsam byas nas ngo lan drag po sprad skabs dmag thengs rim pa gsum btang nas mgo bo bkyags yas med pa bzos te mnga' 'og tu bsdus zhes 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉na gsal bas rgyal po 'di'i skabs la zangs dkar yang mnga' 'og tu bcug pa min nam snyam/ mdor na khong gi sku tshe'i ring gcig nas stod mnga' skor gsum gyi mnga' khongs yongs kyi dgra ngan la rgol rdung dang gnyen nye nyam chung la bsam pa rnam dag gis rogs 'degs bskyangs pa dang / gnyis nas gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su mu ge dang 'khrugs pa med pa zhi bde zhod 'jags bde zhing skyid par byas te mthar tshe mjug bzhugs yul mang nang rgyal mkhar na dgung lo drug bcu re brgyad la gshegs so//rgyal po rnam rgyal lde'i sku tshe gang por btsun mo bzhi trem byung yod/mdun gyi btsun mo gsum la rgyal sras ma 'khrungs par gdung rgyud chad la dogs nas phyis su gu ge lho stod kyi bdag mo lha 'dzoms zhes pa khab tu bsus par sa mo glang gi lor gu ge lho stod khul btsun mo'i pha yul du sras gcig 52

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/'khrungs par mtshan la khri nam mkha'i dbang po phun tshogs lde dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ khong dgung lo bcu drug b.rarnadu yum gyi lung pa lho stod du 'tshar longs byung nas yon tan sogs la sbyangs/ de nas yab kyis lte ba'i mkhar gu ge'i byang ngos phyi wang ga la ba der spyan drangs rting yab rgyal po sa skyong rnam rgyal ldes gtso bo mdzad pa dang sbrags blon po blo rig ldan la 'jig rten 'tsho bar myong ba smin pa rgyun gtan rgyal po'i don chen bka' gros la tshud pa dag dang mnyam du mol bsdur byas nas la dwags mar yul gyi rgyal mo khri lcam zhes pa khab tu bzhes/ de tshe shar tsong kha pa'i slob ma grags can mkhas dbang mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa dang bcas ri bo dge ldan gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rab byung btsun pa ngur smrig can mang dag cig der chos sgo spel gyin yod pa 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉nang 'khod 'dug yab rgyal po'i sku tshe smad la gu ge lho stod dang mang nang sogs la bzhugs skabs bu khri nam mkha'i dbang po phun tshogs lde dpal bzang pos rgyal srid bskyangs yod pa'ang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las/ khri rnam rgyal lde dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung nas gdan chags/ blon po 'dun na 'don/ drung 'khor skye bo'i tshogs kyi kun nas gang ba'i dbus su mes lha bla ma ye shes 'od nas gtsos te nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyal tshab mtha' dag gi zhabs kyi rdul dang 'grogs par 'os pa'i gnyis 'thung dbang po'i khri steng du yangs pa'i rgyal khams legs par skyong ba'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la mngon par dbang bskur zhes gu ge'i rgyal thog dang po srong nge'am lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags pa'i yab mes dag gi dka' ba du ma spyad nas btsugs pa'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol byas pa bcas mkhas dbang ngag dbang grags pas 53

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mig mthong lag zin byas pas ji ma ji bzhin bkod yod do// khong gi lha lcam khri lcam rgyal mo yang chos la dad pa che la chos sems rab tu brtas pas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉su chos 'phrul chen mo'i dus mchod la zhal 'byed lta bu'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gos 'phan chen mo sogs rgya ma mang du mdzad do zhes rgyal po dang mnyam du chos dang 'jig rten gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar mang du bskyangs so// rgyal po khri nam mkha'i dbang po phun tshogs ldes sku tshe'i mjug tu pu rang zhar du gnas pa'i 'khor chags dgon par phebs nas stod mnga' ris grags can jo bo rnam gsum te 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dang /'jam dpal dbyangs/ phyag rdor gsum gyi mdun du rab tu byung nas lha rje btsun shākya 'od du mtshan gsol nas chos sgor zhugs/ mthar dgung grangs don gnyis par la ca rang ga'i pho brang rtser zhi bar gshegs so zhes so//rgyal po khri rnam rgyal lde dang mar yul nas khab tu bzhes pa'i btsun mo khri lcam rgyal mo la sras gcig las byung med par de'i mtshan la khri rnam ri sangs rgyas lde dpal bzang po zhes so// khong cher longs nas yab rgyal po'i rjes shul bzung nas mnga' ris khul gu ge spu rang sogs yongs su dbang sgyur byas nas mnga' thang rgyas so// khong gis gu ge'i mnga' khul gyi chos srid yab mes ltar legs par bskyangs pan ma zad yab mes kyi rigs rgyud gcig pa yin pa'i la dwags rgyal rabs kyi rgyal rgyud dang 'brel ba legs po btsugs nas phan tshun srid don dang chos rgyud 'brel 'dris dam po byung / rgyal po de'i yang mes dang yab chen sogs kyi skabs su mar yul la dwags dang spu rangs nas btsun mo gu ge rgyal po'i khab tu bzhes pa sogs mes skyid bde nyi ma mgon gyi bu gsum nas chags pa'i mnga' ris skor gsum dbar gyi rgyun srol 54

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/mdza' rtse'i 'brel ba dam po sngar rgyun ltar legs po yod do// rgyal po des phyi'i rgyal phran che chung khag dbar 'brel ba dam zab dang nang gi srid skyong bar yab mes ltar nus pa chen po thon pa smros med yin par ma zad da dung gangs mdun dang mtsho rin po che'i sku mdun du sgrub pa mdzad cing chos phyogs bya bar brtson pa'i 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad nas rgyu dngos gya nom pa phul ba bcas so//khong la rgyal mo nam mkha' rgyal mo btsun mor bzhes kyang gdung sras ma byung / mthar yang skyar pu rang gi dpon po (de dus pu rang gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu yod pas yul gyi dbu gtso der dpon po'am sde pa brjod/)sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi sras mo bsod nams bzang mo khab tu bsus pas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉las stag gi lo drag la sgang du lha rig bdag po blo bzang rab brtan 'khrungs zhes pa bzhin rgyal sras gcig las byung mi 'dug rgyal po de'i sku tshe'i ring sngon la btsun mo gsum tsam khab tu bsus kyang gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i sras gcig kyang ma 'khrungs kyang tshe mjug tu yang skyar btsun mo gcig bzhes par rgyal sras gcig 'khrungs par mtshan 'phags pa lha zhes gsol te rgyal srid bskyangs shing ri bo dge ldan gyi ring lugs dar bar yang rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu byas te shar tsong kha ba'i slob ma grags can drug gi ya gyal du gyur pa'i mkhas dbang ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs pad la spyi bos bsten pa sogs byas nas 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉nang bkod pa'i rgyal rgyud gdung sras khag lags so// (rgyal po de'i rjes kyi gu ge'i rgyal rgyud khag beḍūr+ya ser po ltar bris pa'o/)gu ge'i rgyal po 'phags pa lha la sras gnyis 'khrungs par rgan pa shākya 55

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'od dang gzhon par shākya rin chen zhes brjod/ bu gzhon pa shākya rin chen gyis rgyal rgyud bzung nas mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran khag dang 'cham mthun bgyis shing nang srid yab bzhin bskyangs so// khong la sras gsum 'khrungs par rgan pa 'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar lde dang / 'bring ba 'jam dbyangs pa/ mtha' chung phyag rdor dang gsum mo// sku mched 'di gsum gyi skabs su gu ge rtsa hrang mkhar gsham gyi lha khang dkar po dang 'jigs byed lha khang sogs su sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs shing ri bo dge ldan pa'i gdan sa chen po 'bras spungs dgon par zhabs sor 'khod cing tā la'i sku phreng galpis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor 'bul tshan dang gdan sa der mnga' ris grwa tshang 'dzugs gnang ba'i mthun rkyen bskrun pa sogs be+e ser nang bkod yod do// rgyal po des da dung pu rang dpon po bsod nams rab brtan dang mnyam du gangs ri'i rgyang grags dgon par dbu skyong byed bzhin bzhugs pa'i 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma grags can rdor 'dzin kun dga' grags par sku ngo mar chos zhus nas bdag rkyen phul/khong la rgyal sras gnyis byung bar che bar ngag gi dbang phyug dang chung bar lha btsun shes rab 'od zer ro// sras che bas rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bya ba skyong zhing chung bas chos sgor zhugs nas chos phyogs las la brtson no//rgyalasras ngag gi dbang phyug gi skabs la gu ge'i mnga' khongs su mchis pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa grags can mtho lding ( rje rin po che'i slob ma grags can ngag dbang grags pa nas bzung dge lugs par bsgyur/)sogs la nyams gso dang btsun pa khag la sku 'gyed phul ba spyi dang yang sgos gangs rin po che'i sku mdun du gsung chos gnang bzhin skye dgu du mas gus bkur lhad med byed 56

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/pa'i 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i mkhas dbang bla chen rdor 'dzin nyi ma mgon por chos zhus shing khong rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas mthong chen dang gus bkur tshad med byas te khong gis chos kyi snying po bum pa gang byos gnang bar thugs rje legs 'bul gyi ched du gangs mtsho dang cung thag nye ba'i yul lung dkar dung khul gyi yul phug dang / dpal phug chos phug sa rang gong 'og bcas gnas gzhi'i tshod du rdor 'dzin rin po che'i ma dgon gangs rin po che'i lho phyogs su gnas pa'i rgyang grags dgon par phul lo//de nas bzung 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i rdor 'dzin bla rabs dang gu ge rgyal po dbar gyi 'brel ba gang legs gang yag tu gyur/ spyir de'i skabs gu ge rgyal po la mtshon na 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang 'brel ba btsugs yas de gal chen yin/ gang lags she na/ ri bo hi ma la ya'i lho phyogs mon yul du grags pa'i mon pa mang che ba'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud la dad pa chen po byed pa dang nub phyogs la dwags rgyal pos kyang 'brug pa bka' brgyud dang 'brel ba je dam du gtong bzhin yod par ma zad/ shar phyogs gangs mtsho'i mdun na mchis pa'i 'bri gung la'ang 'brel ba 'dzugs kyin yod pas dge lugs pa'i shugs rkyen che ba'i gu ge'i rgyal rgyud la nyen kha chen po yod par mngon la 'bri gung bka' brgyud par cha mtshon na 'brug pa bka' brgyud ni 'bri gung pa'i kha gtad gtso bo yin la gangs ri'i sku mdun gangs sa sogs la pho brang bzhengs nas stobs shugs che ba dang rong rgyud rong chung dang chu mo ti'i rgyud la su mo ru dang yi ri dga' ser sogs la mchis pa'i 'brug pa'i dbang thang chen po yod la nub la dwags rgyal pos 'brug par do snang che ru 'gro dus gu ge rgyal por rgyab brten ma bcol tshe stod na mu mthud gnas thub par dka' 57

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ngal yod pas gu ge rgyal po dang 'bri gung bka' brgyud dbar gyi 'brel ba ni phan tshun gnyis phan gyi 'brel ba zhig lags/rgyal sras ngag gi dbang phyug la'ang sras gnyis byung bar rgan par khri nam mkha'i dbang phyug dang gzhon par lha btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi 'od ces so// rgyal sras 'di gnyis kyi skabs su mes po'i skabs kyi gsang sngags lugs su do snang byas te mes pos bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor sna mang la mchod rgyun btsugs yod pa ni beḍūr+ya ser po las des bre ldan du gung nas g.yas su rim par dus 'khor gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gshin rje dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ mi 'khrugs pa/tshe dpag med/ g.yon phyogs su bde mchog lo dril nag gsum/ dgyes rdor/ 'khor chen/ 'byung 'dul/ kun rig rnam snang dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bdun gyi lha khang so sor yod pa dang steng du sman bla'i pho brang bcas par cho 'phrul zla bar chog grwa so so'i sgrub mchod zla re lhag tsam du bsnyen bkur bzang pos mchod pa'i srol btsugs zhes bstan pa phyi dar skabs lha ris sogs bzo rig pa'i mkhas dbang mang dag cig gis bskrun pa'i dkyil 'khor phon chen de dag las gna' srol gyi rig gzhung la do snang chen po byed pa'i dus skabs legs po zhig yin par mngon no//rgyal po khri nam mkha'i dbang phyug la rgyal sras gcig 'khrungs par mtshan la nyi ma dbang phyug go/ khong gis kyang yab chen skabs kyi srol bzang shul 'dzin gyis chos la dad gus byed cing dar rgyas btang / khong la sras gnyis byung bar rgan par khri grags pa'i dbang phyug lde dang / chung bar lha btsun blo bzang ye shes 'od ces zer rgan pas srid bskyangs pa dang / chung 58

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/bas chos sgor zhugs nas chos dar bar nus mthu gang yod bton nas 'bad pa skyed/ rgyal po khri grags pa dbang phyug lde la rgyal sras gcig las ma 'khrungs par mtshan la khri rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po'i lde zhes brjod/khong dang khong gi a khu lha btsun blo bzang ye shes 'od thun mong thog gtsang bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gu ge'i yul du gdan 'dren zhus te bkur sti legs par mdzad/gu ge'i rgyal po mtha' ma khri grags pa bkra shis lde'i skabs la dge lugs par do snang chen po byas nas paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gu ge'i yul du gdan 'dren zhus te gu ge'i khul gyi dgon pa grags can mtho lding dang / rdo gsham mu mkhar dgon/ mang nang byang chub gling / shang rtse rab brtan byams pa gling dgon/ mda' pa bkra shis lhun po sogs su sku ngo mas bcar nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i chos legs par bstan/ tha na khyim pa rnams kyang bsnyen gnas sogs dge ba'i lam la bkod pas mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dad ldan mi 'bangs tshos dge lugs par dad gus shin tu chen po byas/ des na dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i dar shugs stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul du rtser son pas na 'brug bka' pa brgyud par dad gus che ba dang skyabs brten bcol mkhan la dwags rgyal pos dga' po ma byung ba dang 'brug pa'i bla ma grags can stag tshang rin po che sogs kyi skul slong 'og la dwags rgyal pos gu ger dpung dmag 'dren pa'i ngan jus spel ba dang / bod dbus gatreng khul du bka' brgyud pa (karma bka' brgyud/) dang dge lugs dbar 'gal ba shin tu che la 'thab rtsod rno ngar can gyis phan tshun dpung dmag drangs nas khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod ha cang dza drag pa dang bstun 59

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas stod mnga' ris khul gyi dge lugs par rdung rdeg gtong slad la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyis drag po'i dpung drangs nas gu ge rgyal po khri grags pa bkra shis lde gson bzung byas pas khong gu ge'i rgyal po mtha' mar gyur nas ya gling dbus shar khul du snyan grags shin tu che la mi lo bdun brgya'i ring dbang sgyur byas pa'i gu ge rgyal rabs de ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur to//dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs sum cu 'char ma khad la bod btsan po'i rgyal rgyud dang mnga' ris rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal 'brug pa bka' rgyud pa'i rgyab phyogs su langs nas gu ge'i khul du shugs je cher 'gro ba'i dge lugs par kha gtad gcog slad dang gu ge rgyal po'i rgyu dngos la rngams pa dang / rang gi mnga' khongs rgya bskyed gtong slad bcas rgyu mtshan du mar brten nas dmar dmar rjen rjen du drag po'i btsan 'dzul byas so// gu ger btsan 'dzul byed dus gu ge rgyal pos rgol lan sprad yod kyang stobs shugs che chung shor nas ya lan sprad ma thub par pham nyes byung nas rgyal po'i 'khor dang blon chen drag gras tshang ma gu ge rtsa rang mkhar gyi dbu rtse'i rgyal khang ngam pho brang nang la gab nas phyir thon ma nus kyang mkhar de mtha' bzhi g.yang rong yin pa'i dbang gis shin tu gzar ba dang mkhar gyi steng thog nas mkhar gsham chu mig bar chu len sa'i sa phug rta thar tsam sogs 'gog zon gyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang bar yod pas mkhar gsham la lus pa'i dgra bo re zhig ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas 'dzin bzung byed thub med do//mthar g.yo sgyu can gyi dgra ngan gyis mkhar 'og zhol du gnas sdod byed mi gu ge rgyal po'i 'bangs mi ser mtha' dag bkol spyod kyis rtsa rang mkhar 60

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/dang thag ring tsam gyi nub byang phyogs kyi brag ri nag po (mkhar gyi nye 'khor la bru sa sha stag las rdo tog tsam yang brnyed par dka')zhig yod pa de nas nyin mtshan ltos med du rdo che chung sna tshogs dbor du bcug te mkhar gyi shar ngos mdun nas rdo brtsigs bslangs te rgyal po'i pho brang dang mnyam pa'i rdo brtsigs (de'i brtsigs shul phyed cha tsam deng sang yang ma nyams par cha tshang bar bsdad yod pas skye bo tshang ma'i spyan lam du 'char ba'i lo rgyus kyi dpang rtags gson gson rjen rjen zhig lags/)brgyab nas rgyal po gson bzung thub pa'i ngan jus bting / nyin zhag mang po'i ring gu ge rgyal po'i mi ser la thag ring nas rdo dbor du bcug te mi ser la dka' sdug tshad med myang rting khag cig gis ya lan sprad pas rang sor bsad pa dang / khag cig dka' sdug ma theg par bros byol byed rtsis byas na'ang rdung rdeg gis mnar gcod btang / mang che bar rta lcag dang rdog rgyag gzhus nas bsnad skyon tshabs chen bzos/ kha cig sgal par rma bzos nas khrag chu dang rnag chu 'dzir ba/ khag cig ltogs shi thebs pa/khag cig lus kyi rtsibs ma chag nas glo ba dang mchin pa phyir mngon pa bcas mi gson por rta zog sems can ltar gdug tsub drag pos bkol spyod byas shing / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dngos su myang du bcug pa dag mkhar steng gi rgyal khang na bzhugs pa'i rgyal pos mthong dus mi ser gyi sdug bsngal bzod glags bral ba myong dus sems gyis ma bzod pa'am ya nga snying rje lhad med skyes nas phyag gcig la gser sder ma gang dang phyag gzhan zhig la dngul sder ma gang bsnams nas rang 'gul gyis mar mkhar gsham la babs nas srin po'i bya spyod 'dzin pa'i dgra ngan la mgo btags zhus par dgra bo'i dmag dpon des khyed kyi dur rgyags (mnga' ris skad de mi shi zin nas gshin por mchod pa'i — 61

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshul du phul yas kyi zas rigs/) de phyi drag song zer nas khrel rgod dang tho 'tshams par byas te de ma nyid du gson bzung byas/ de rting gu ge'i gna' srol gyi rgyan gos spras pa'i rgyal po'i lcam dang / sras mo/ zhal ta ma sogs mtho zhing brjid chags ldan pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang steng nas mar g.yang rong zab mor gson por bskyur bas 'bog (mnga' ris skad ras cha khra bo las bzos pa'i phyi gyon/) khra lhing lhing byas pa mthong dus dgra bos ki sgra dang skad cor brgyab nas ltad mo chen po 'dug da dung mang tsam mar gting mthil la bskyur shog ces 'bod sgra brgyab pa sogs mi sems med par gdug tsub gdon 'dre'i spyod pa 'dzin pa'i la dwags dpon dmag gis gu ge rgyal rabs thal ba'i rdul du brlags so//de tshe gu ge rgyal po'i blon chen blo rig bkra la thabs jus bzang zhing dpa' blo khog ldan pa gcig gis rang gi chibs rta gro dkar 'phying pas btum nas mi rta zung du chu len sa'i sa dong nas mar babs te mkhar gyi gsham 'og tu slebs ma khad khong gi sring mo dang spun 'khor khag gcig dang mnyam dang rtab rtab tu ku dong rong sa'i bde lam nas thon cing mkhar rtse dang pu ling brgyud lung mang po brgyab ste gu ge'i lho smad yul tsho spun bdun gyi nang gses bye dkar ga la ba der sgro gshog ldan pa'i bya rgyal rgod po bzhin skad cig tu bros/ khong bye dkar yul gyi mar spu tsho pa'i yul la slebs dus mar spu ba tshang mas 'khrul nas khong gis rang sger gyi srog blos gtong ma phod par rgyal po dang rgyal mkhar tshang ma dgra ngan lag tu tshud pa shes bzhin tu wa skyes sdar ma'i tshul du g.yo dang khram bshad nas bros yong bar dogs nas de ma nyid rang gi sring mo'i mdun du gcer bur bton nas sho dkar thang mar pha bong zhig la 62

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/bsdams nas zhugs me spar nas dmar bsad btang / brjod srol la pha bong de'i sgang la thag pa'i ri mo deng sang da dung mthong rgyu yod skad/ sring mo de ngo tsha tshad med byung nas yid mug te de ma thag rang shi brgyab nas 'das/phyis su bod sde pa gzhung gis mnga' ris tshur mnga' khongs su bsdus mtshams gnas tshul de ha go nas bye dkar gyi mar spu'i mi ser la srog lan la stong 'jal dgos pa'i bka' phab nas lo re bzhin 'bru ru'i khal chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam 'bul dgos pa'i nyes chad bcad de sgar na mchis pa'i sog po'i srung dmag dang / gzhung so hrug sgar lha mo khang nang gcod gtong mkhan bkra shis sgang gi grwa pa bcas la phogs thob sprod spyad byas pa sogs ni sgro btags byas pa min par lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang mtshungs so//de min blon po dmar gsad btang ba dang sring mo rang shi brgyab sa'i sa khul der zhing 'debs mi chog pa'i bka' rgya dang bcas yur po bkag par ma zad bye dkar bzhi gling lnga brgya (khang gsar dang / khang rnying / lung smad/byang ngos bcas gling bzhi la mi 'bor lnga brgya yod/)yi skye pa pho tshang ma 'du bskong byas te ba phyugs dmar po bsad rjes de'i ko ba gdan la bting nas skyes pa pho re re bzhin de'i sgang la sdod du bcug nas kha nang la sha dmar rkyang za ru bcug shing mna' bskyal te rjes su zhing nang la chu ye nas 'khrid rgyu med cing gal te chu 'khrid pa'i gnas tshul thon tshe khrims gcod nan po gcod rgyu byas skad/ phyis su zhing kha mu mthud 'debs chog pa'i chog mchan byung nas mon yul nas mi 'khrid yong ste chu yur gsar du bzos nas ming la mon yur zhes pa de'o// da dung mon yur nas chu log ma thon pa'i slad du mchod rten zhig kha gnon du bzhengs pa bcas kyang sgrung gtam min par don dngos yin zhing 63

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus deng sang yang de'i shul sogs mthong rgyu yod/'dir dmigs bsal brjod dgos pa zhig la deng sang gu ge'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed mkhan khag cig gis gu ge rgyal rabs nyams shing rtsa thor du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo de nub phyogs ye shu'i chos pa gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du slebs nas gu ge rgyal por phyi pa ye shus chos kyi dam pa'i gsung rab sogs 'chad stabs gu ge rgyal po blo 'gyur nas phyi pa'i chos la dad pa chen po byas te khong tshor rgyab skyor tshad med byas par ma zad/ tha na ye shu'i chos khang yang rgyag tu bcug cing sangs rgyas chos lugs la khyad gsod byas gshis/khong gi gcung po ri bo dge lugs pa'i chos pa yin pa dang khos dge 'dun pa mang po ngan skul byas nas la dwags dmag nang du drangs shing / sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan tshos rgyal pos chos phyi pa byed par ma dga' bar gyen log byas te gu ge'i rgyal rabs nyams rgud du phyin pa dang rgyal po tha ma jo bdag po bkrongs pa sogs byung bar gsung gin 'dug kyang / de ni lo rgyus dngos dang mthun thabs med cing / phyi phyogs ye shus chos pa khag gcig gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du bcar ba ni lo rgyus don dngos dang mthun zhing kho tshos phyi pa'i chos dar bar 'bad brtson tog tsam byas yod nges red/dper na dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang rgya bod gna' rdzas rtog zhib ru khag gcig gis gu ge'i gna' bo'i mkhar gog tu bcar nas dpyad zhib byed dus lha sku'i dbu thod gcig rnyed par de'i nang shan du phyi pa'i yi ge yod pa'i shog bu mang dag yod par rtag dpyad byed dus shog bu'i ngos kyi yi ge ni yo rob nub phyogs su gnas pa'i h+phu tho gid mi rigs kyi yi ge dang de'i nang don tshang ma dam pa'i gsung rab kyi skor red/ des na ye shu'i chos pa 64

༄khya//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du bcar ba dang dam pa'i gsung rab khag gcig der bzhag pa ni don dngos yin kyang rgyal po nang chos la dad pa log pa ni bden pa min snyam/ gang lags she na gu ge rgyal po tshang ma chos la dad pa shin tu che bas gu ge chos rgyal zhes 'bod cing bod brgyud nang bstan la dad pa chen po ji tsam yod med gong du brjod zin pa'i lo rgyus dngos nas gsal po shes thub/lhag par du dus rabs cu bdun pa'i lo rabs nyi shu dang sum bcu'i nang dge lugs pa shugs ha chang che ba dang paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bzhi pa'ang sku dngos su phebs shing gsung chos gnang ba dang de bzhin 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang sa skya sogs kyang shugs chen yod mus su phyi pa'i skad dang yi ge gang yang mi shes par chos la dad pa byed pa ni mi srid pa zhig red/ de bas phyi chos skyong phyir mi lo bdun brgya tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i rang rang mes po'i chos lugs rtsa brlag btang ba ni rgyus med 'ol tshod brjod pa rang las bden pa ye nas med do// lar na ye shus chos pa khag cig gis gu ger dus thung zhig bsdad nas rgya gar du log ste phyi chos kyi lte ba'i sgrig 'dzugs la gu ge rgyal pos khong tshor rgyab skyor dang tha na rgyal po yang phyi chos la do snang byed kyin yod pa'i skor snyan seng zhus pa'ang so so'i rjes byas mtshon ched dang so so'i legs skyes bzhag pa'i nga rgyal gyis che ba brjod pa kho na tsam las don dngos dang mi mthun pa ni rgyun shes shig yin pas lung drangs nas dgag rtsod byed pa'i dgos pa rtsa ba nas ma mchis so//'dir mnga' ris skor gsum gyi rgyal rgyud che ba gsum dang nang gses chung ba gnyis kyi re'u mig stabs bde zhig bkod pa'i la dwags rgyal rgyud ni 〈〈la dwags rgyal rabs 〉〉las drangs pa dang / zangs dkar rgyal rgyud 65

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zangs lha'i lo rgyus gzhir bzhag gis bkod yod/ sru rang rgyal rgyud dang de las mched pa'i gu ge rgyal rgyud/ ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud bcas ni gu ge mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉gzhir bzhag gis bsgrigs pa mjug tu zur bkod byas yod/mdor na phyis su dga' ldan tshe dbang gis g.yul thog byas rjes bla na med pa bzhag pa dang sbrags/ rgyal kha'i ba dan mthon por bsgrengs nas lha ldan du phyir log byed skabs/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis khong la gzengs bstod bya dga'i tshul du bar skor byang chub byon lam gyi shar du khong g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dran rten du dga' ldan dar chen (dar chen de ni mnga' ris skor gsum bod sde pa gzhung gi dbang 'og tu bcug pa'i rtags mtshan yin par ma zad bod btsan po'i rjes su bod yongs gcig gyur byas pa'i mtshon rtags yin no/)btsugs pa dang / bar skor byang phyogs kyi dga' ldan khang gsar zhes pa gsol ras su sprad/ da dung sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dmigs su bkar nas dga' ldan tshe dbang la mnga' ris phyogs su dpung 'jug byed skabs dka' ba ji ltar byung min skor bka' 'dri zhus pa na/ khong gis dris lan btab don du/ dpung dmag gi ru sne khrid nas thog ma spu rang du 'byor ba'i tshe/ yul de btsan bzung byed mkhan dgra bo dag btul sla ba ni spu gri ngar mas spu hreng hreng gcig bcad pa ltar byung zhes pa dang / rtsa rang la slebs nas dgra bo rim gyis tshar gcod byed dus spu gris rtswa hreng hreng gcig bcad pa ltar cung dka' ba/ yang ru rog na btsan bzung byed mkhan dgra ngan dag mtha' skrod gtong skabs/ ha cang dka' ba ni dgra bo ngan jus can dag ri sing dang / lung shur/ brag phug sa phug gad rong bcas gang sar 66

༄7//mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byung bar rags tsam dpyad pa/gab nas bsdad pas/ lug gi mjing rus kyi sha rus gseng la 'thims pas shin tu btogs dka' ba ltar byung zhes gsungs skad/ dus de nas bzung bod sde pa gzhung gi gzhung yig dang bka' rgya tshang ma'i nang la pu rang la spu hreng dang / rtsa rang la rtsa hreng / ru rog gam ru thog la ru thog bcas brjod 'go dngos su btsugs mod kyang / mnga' ris yul skad la deng dus kyang da dung spu rang dang rtsa rang / ru rog bcas brjod kyin yod/des na dus de nas bzung / stod mnga' ris bskor gsum zhes pa ni ru thog mtsho yis bskor ba dang / gu ge g.ya' yis bskor ba/ spu hreng gangs kyis bskor ba bcas spu hreng dang / rtsa hreng / ru thog gsum las tshud med pas skabs de'i mnga' ris skor gsum gyi khyab khongs ni/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi bu gsum gyis dbang sgyur bya skabs kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang bsdur tshe gzhi rgya ha cang chung du phyin yod/ gang lags she na/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i la dwags dang / zangs dkar/ dkar dkyil/ toganag kho/ bal ti/ rkang phran/ khu nu/ sgar zhwa/ nyung ti/ spi ti/kyo nam/ sha khog gu rum/ rta mang / dol po/ ya rtse bcas tshud med pas so// dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus mjug tsam nas byung ba'i ‘‘mnga' ris bskor gsum ’ zhes pa de ni ri dang mtsho dang gangs sogs kyis mtha' bskor ba'i yul khag gsum zhes pa las dbang sgyur bya yul mnga' khongs skor gsum zhes pa min/ des na de dang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang byung ba'i ‘‘mnga' ris skor gsum ’ gyi tha snyad gcig mtshungs yin kyang ‘‘bskor ’’zhes par sngon 'jug ba yod med kyi dbye khyad yod la de gnyis kyi don dngos kyi go don dang / gzhi rgya khyab che chung dngos la'ang dbye khyad shin 67

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tu chen po yod/ mdor na dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus mjug nas bzung / bod kyi gzhung yig dang bka' rgya sogs kyi nang brjod pa'i mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi khyab khongs su spu hreng rdzong dang / mda' pa rdzong / rtsa hreng rdzong / ru thog rdzong bcas khag bzhi dang / za rang ru dpon/ chu mo gti dpon/ gnam ru dpon/ gtsos tsho dpon/ 'brong pa dpon/ru thag do gal che dpon bcas dpon khag drug tshud pa sgar rdzong drug sbrel zhes pa de yin zhing / de'i chab srid dang / 'grim 'grul/ dpal 'byor/dmag don sogs kyi lte gnas ni sgar dbyar sa dang dgun sa zhes pa de'o//de yang stod mnga' ris ni bod kyi mtha' mtshams sa khul yin pas gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i gnas shig yin stabs sgar dpon la phyi'i rim bzhi'i go gnas yod pa ni phar 'gro dus snye thang lha chen mo yol ba dang rim bzhi'i dbang cha spyod pa'i thob thang yod pa bcas so//68

༄//zur bkod/zur bkod/༄//la dwags rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/dpal gyi mgonadzabyiṭ+wāṃ ༵py-iṭ+wāṃṣa/ lha chen grags pa lde/—byang chub sems dpa'aṣalha chen rgyal poṣalhachen ur pa laṣalha chen nag lugadzalha chen dge bhe/dge 'bumaṣalha chen jo ldoraṣabakrashis mgonaṣalha rgyalaṣalha chen jo dpalaṣalha chen dardos grubaṣalha chen rgyaṭ+wāṃ bu rizlo ṭ+wāṃnadālha chen shes rab/bhelha chen khri gtsug ldedzalha na grags pa 'bu~X ṣa sa mag ldan/grags pa 'bumaṣasbyi na bharaṣalha chen bha gnadza—lha na lha dbang rnam rgyalaṣabakra shis rnam rgyalaṣatshe dbang rnalha rgyal/rnam rgyal man po/(de/(blo/ 〈rwa(::gucan/ thab//bya/thabadu/sa/ dzad(54 dre//474/———nga rnam rgyal/khong nas bzung mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lo rgyus la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung gshis rjes 'byung gi la dwags rgyal rgyud du ma zhig byon yod pa 'dir re re bzhin bkod pa'i dgos pa ma mchisarjodhi la dwags rgyal rabasaltar bsgrigs/ 69

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/༄//spu rang rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/khri bkra shis mgonadza'akhor reṣalha ldeṣa'odaldeṣabatsan srong ṣasrong nge /bhekhri btsan ldedi btsan phyug lde/—grags btsan lde/—khri bkra shis btsan stobs ldeṣakhri 'barabatsanaṣakhri bkra shis dngos grub mgonabaskomanga' bdag khri btsan lde/rnam lde mgon rgyalatisnorgyalastobs ldedi khri bkra shis rgyal ldetisno(ar lde/bkra shis stobs lding btsanajogaṭ+wāṃkā ༵tram̐/ sa/chos rgyal chen po bkra shis bsod namadro ldekhaskodapal mgon lde/kyir ti melaṣatswaganya' khri lde/rgol lam lde/rjo༄//zangs dkar rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/lde gtsug mgonaṣaseng ge ldedze'ajomagrahūṃs lderi/ che ldege lde theṭa mang gal lde/de na shin dpal lde/de dahūṃdunaX ༷sa// ༷sa ༷ra ༷sduX ༷pal ṣabakras dpal ṣa

༄khya//zur bkod/hūṃmagon po dpal ldetisno bkronam mkha' dpal ldetisno /stokyibartson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ /rta phu dam chos rgyal mtshan/hūṃkhri dpal ldetisno hūṃtshe dbang rab brtan dpal ldetisnoyeshesadapal ldetisno(tshe dbang dpal lde/(zhabs drung blo bzang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ye shes mtha' yas/hūṃbasod nams dpal lde/ ye shes don yod dpal lde//ye shes rnam rgyal/ ye shes phun tshogs dpal lde/zla mdzes dbang motisno(khong gi sku zla don grub tshe dbang dpal lde/)blo bzang rnam rgyaladijo sku mchog tshul khrims/sku mchog ba ku la/ zi rīye shes tshul khrims/ cha brtan rnam rgyal ldaṣa(bsod nams don grub rnam rgyal ldedi nyi ma nor bu rnam rgyal lde/)sras mo bstan 'dzin dbang mo/ sras mo bsod nams dbang mo/bkra shis lha 'dzoms/(sku zla rig 'dzin zla ba/)/choblo bzang don yod rnam rgyal lde/(gong du bkod zin pa dag ni zangs dkar gyi rgyal rabs dang chos 'byungazhes pa'i deb de'i rtsom pa pos zangs lha'i mkhar du yod pa'i ma yig ltar go bde bar bris zhes 'khod 'dug)()༄7//spu rang rgyal rgyud nas mched pa'i ya rtse rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/khri lde grags btsan ldetisnokhri grags lde btsanakhrisnokhri grags pa ldedi aseng lde//chodhi dzñozangs dkar gyi rgyal rabs dang chosa'abyung 〉ltar bsgrigs/ 71

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdze ta ri malak+ṣ-i—a khyi mal///cho.adzhamaladi ka mal lde/rjo/choka mal rgyalatisnobaṭ+wāṃtabyi rmalatisnosdoḍi dīḍi tre dza/ //chopuṇirmalatisnobra ti rmalatisnobi kra ma shadi na ra seng ha kha las ra dza/rdo ༵ma kā dza/ri (—karañdza phu—ra —ṣan ra sang hadzabhiṣ+ṭi ra dza/rjo༄khya//spu rang rgyal rgyud las mched pa'i gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud/srong nge (lha bla ma ye shes 'od/)/cho'akhor re/chopho brangabyang chub 'od /chortselde/chordzu/ sna dzño di/ /seng grags/ bkrashis rtse phyogasatsa/lha ༷sngon dbang 'od/ rtse 'bar btsanaṣacamaha // ོ ri jo borgyal po—gcung sdeṣazhongasdeṣadabang lda —bsad nams rtsaṣa jo bla maṣalha btsun/'od 'bar rtsedi lelomatisno8 〈〈mnga'asdisargyalañtshaṭ+wāsasdilha/sngabasgrigs/ sgri72 〈〈gangs dang ma na 'a dkar chag〉〉ltar ba —gas/

༄7//zur bkod/skyid lde btsanaṣa (rurī tsho gung lde btsan/rtse ldan ngal/ tswanyaldaducan/ nyimaldeṣadapal 'od btsan/ rnamalda bcanaṣa lha btsun lde'adul srid 'dul btsan/dge 'bumatisno kye rdor/byams pa/ lag/chochos rgyal grags padi bla chen grags pa ldedi sems dpa'/ thos pa/wadapala'abaralde/ khri nam mkha'i dbang po phun tshogs lde dpal bzang po/(mnga' bdag khri rnam rgyal ldetisno/jokhri rnam ri sangs rgyas lde dpal bzang po/med blo bzang rab brtanadi shākya 'od/ 'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar ldeṣa—'phagasapalhaṣa shākyarin chenaṣa ༵snalja tābya/ ngas pa/hūṃ—ngag gi dbang phyug—hūṃkhri nam mkha'i dbang phyug—/lha btsun shes rab 'od/ /lha btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi 'od/khri rnam rgyal grags pa bzang potisnogrags pa bkra shis lde/dhi(khri rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po'am grags pa bkra shis lde ni gu ge rgyal po mtha' ma de yin zhing khong dang gu ge rgyal po rim byon la jo bdag po'ang brjod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gu ge rgyal po thams cad gu ge'i rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan yin par ma zad da dung gu ge jo ba bcu gsum ste sang dar jo ba dang jog rtse rjo ba/ khu rtse jo ba/ lhug jo ba/ ri jo ba bcas jo ba'am sngags pa bcu gsum gyi dbu 'dzin nam bdag po yin pas de ltar byung /)8 shāshād+dhit+yā~X trīs+dza glubyi ṭ+wāṃt+nasdujisprinā /bsgrigs/ 73

༄khya//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud 'od srung gi tsha bo'am dpal 'khor btsan gyi bu skyid lde nyi ma mgon zhang zhung gi yul grur bros byol du phebs nas/zhang zhung mkhar chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal spu rang stag la mkhar dang thag mi ring ba'i sa gnas rma bya kha 'bab gtsang po'i byang ngos te dkar dung khul gyi glang chen ri bo'i sgang na pho brang sku mkhar nyi bzungs brtsegs pa dang sbrags der lte gnas byas shing / sngar zhang zhung rgyal rabs rim byung gis dbang bsgyur byed myong ba'i yul lung dag mnga' 'og tu bcug rjes yul der ‘‘mnga' ris zhes pa'i tha snyad de thog mar byung / dus de nas bzung sngar zhang zhung zhes ya gling dbus mar snyan grags che cher khyab pa'i yul gru de ‘‘mnga' ris ’ zhes pa'i ming gis 'thus tshab byas pa dang khong gi bu gsum cher longs nas mnga' ris zhes pa'i rgyal khams de yul khag gsum tu bgos te dbang sgyur byed du bcug pas/ bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus thog ‘‘stod mnga' ris bskor gsum ’’ zhes pa'i tha snyad de9rang thog mar byung / bu 'bring ba bkra shis mgon btsan la sras gnyis byung bar/ chung ba'i mtshan la srong nge'am drang srong lde zhes khong gi sku tshe stod la gu ge'i rgyal po mdzad pa dang7 snro tshe smad la rab tu byung nas mtshan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces 'bod/

༄༅//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/dus rabs bcu bzhi'i dus dkyil tsam nas bzung / bod brgyud nang bstan gyi mkhas dbang grags can tshos ljags rtsom gnang ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag nang / bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bstan pa phyi dar skabs lha bla ma ye shes 'od ni 'dul ba stod rgyud dar zhing 'phel bar mdzad rjes chen po 'jog myong mkhan zhig la gdeng 'jog chen po byas yod cing / lhag don du khong gis pa la rnam gsum gyis gtsos pa'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas can du ma gu ger gdan drangs shing jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sogs paṇ+ḍi ta grags can spyan 'dren slad phyi pa mu stegs pa'i yul gar log tu rang srog blos gtong byas pa yin zhes 'khod pa de ni khong gi mdzad rjes je cher gtong rgyur dmigs pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi gtam kho na las lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang ye nas mthun gyi med/de yang dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus dkyil te bod rab byung drug pa'i me khyi lor (spyilo 1346)tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈deb ther dmar por 〉‘‘yab ni lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya'o// khong rang yang rgya gar du byon pas lam du gar log gi dmag gis bzung ste/ bod kyis gser bsdus nas blu bar brtsams pa na'ang / sku lus tsam gcig rnyed pa la dbu tsam gcig ma rnyed par dkrongs/’’(nyezhes 'khod pa ni kho bos da phan mthong myong ba'i deb ther khag nang lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log dmag gis 'dzin bzung byas nas bkrongs tshul bkod pa thog ma de yin yang khong rgya gar la byon dgos pa'i dmigs yul jo bo rje gdan 'dren phyir yin pa 'khod mi 'dugadus rabs bcu bzhi'i dus mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa'i sa 'brug lor (spyilo 1388)sa skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i 75

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i rjed rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long 〉du ‘‘'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa la dgongs nas rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren par byon pas lam du mu stegs pa'i dmag gis bzung / dge phyogs kyi yon tan skyed pa'i rtsa sgo thams cad me btsas bsregs te rmongs par byas so// de'i gtam lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gsan te nor dpag med bskur nas blu ru btang bas gser dang ljid mnyam pa dgos zer ba dang / yang gser gang yod bskur bas rgya ma la bteg dus dbu'i cha tsam cig gser gyis ma long par khong na re/ da ni khyed rnams kyis bdag blus kyang yon tan med jo bo rje bod du gdan drangs/’ () zhes deb ther 'dir ye shes 'od rgya gar la byon pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa stod phyogs su dar slad/paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren par phyi pa mu stegs yul du byon pas/ phyi pas bzung ba sogs shin tu gsal po 'khod 'dug kyang bzung yul gar log yin min 'khod mi 'dugade min dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus dkyil te bod rab byung bdun pa'i shing stag lor(spyilo1434)stag tshang pa dpal 'byor bzang pos brtsams pa'i 〈rgya bod yig tshang chen mo 〉las ‘‘lha bla mas kyang paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen gyi gser 'tshol ba la/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob la byon pas mtha' 'khob tu mu stegs rgyal pos btson du bzung lha bla ma mtha' 'khob tu sku gshegs so ’ ①zhes ye shes 'od paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren phyir rgya gar mu stegs yul du gser 'tshol bar byon pa dang mthar der 'das zhes gser 'tshol ba'i skor thog mar bkod yod kyang rgya gar mtha' 'khob kyi yul de gar log yin min 'khod mi 'dug76

༄༅//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/yang dus rabs bco lnga'i dus mjug ste bod rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel lor (spyilo1476)'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈deb ther sngon po 〉〉las ‘‘lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rang gi rgyal srid gtad zin kyang dmag gi dpon mdzad de/ gar log dang 'thabs pas pham ste gar log gis btson du bzung / gar log gis ye shes 'od la khyod dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa gtong na nged kyis btson las gtong / de lta ma yin na lus ril po dang ljid mnyam pa'i gser byung na gtong zer/’’dhizhes pa 'dir ye shes 'od dmag dpon mdzad pa'i skor thog mar bkod cing /dmag drangs yul gar log rang yin pa kha gsal 'khod 'dug la dmag 'thab byas pa'i mtha' mjug pham ste btson du tshud pa sogs kyi skor las gar log tu dmag drangs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren phyir gser 'tshol ba'i skor sogs kha gsal 'khod mi 'dugaphyogs mtshungs dus rab bcu drug pa'i lo rabs sum cu'am bod rab byung dgu pa'i sa khyi lor (spyilo 1538)paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈〈deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉〉las ‘‘phyis jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i don du gser 'tshol bar byon pas gar log gi rgyal pos bzungs/ mnga' ris nas gser mang pos blu bar brtsams na'ang jo bo gdan 'dren la gnod dogs nas blur ma bcug par chos phyir sku srog btang ba yin 'dug’ ()ces ye shes 'od jo bo gdan 'dren zhu phyir gar log tu phebs pa dang khong gar log tu byon dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gser 'tshol ba'i ched du yin pa gsal shos brjod 'dugade bzhin dus rabs bcu drug pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'am bod rab — 77

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byung dgu pa'i shing sbrul lor (1545)mkhas dbang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i mkhas pa'i dga' ston du ‘‘lha bla ma 'dis jo bo rje spyan 'dren pa'i phyir sku lus gar log gi rgyal po la btang nas 'das/ (kyezhes deb ther 'dir ye shes 'od gar log tu sku srog btang ba'i rgyu mtshan de jo bo rje nyid spyan 'dren pa'i ched du yin pa mngon gsal dod po bkod 'dugagazhan yang dus rabs bcu drug pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang ste bod rab byung bcu pa'i lcags 'brug lor (spyilo1580)'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos brtsams gnang ba'i 〈chos 'byung bstan pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i nyin byed 〉du ‘‘de'i dus lha bla mas gser btsal ba la jo bo spyan drangs dgongs mtha' 'khob tu gser 'tshol ba la dmag du ma zhig dang bcas te byon pas gar log gis shes nas dmag btang / de dang thug 'thab pas pham nas lha btsun rang brtson la shor’’()zhes gong gi 〈〈deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉〉dang 'dra mtshungs yin zhing lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu byon rkyen dang 'das rkyen sogs je rgyas je zab 'khod 'dugangag kun bsod grags rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i 〈bka' gdams chos 'byung 〉las ‘‘dus der lha bla ma ye shes 'od gser 'tshol du byon pa/ gar log gi rgyal pos bzung bas/ de'i dbon po lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis khu bo blu ba dang / a ti sha spyan 'dren pa/’’()zhes deb ther 'di'i lta ba'ang gong du brjod zin pa'i deb ther 'ga' shas dang 'dra mtshungs las dmigs bsal mi 'dugadus rabs bcu dgu pa 'go tshugs ma thag pa'am bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags bya lor (spyilo1801)thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas 78

༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/mdzad pa'i 〈thu'u bkwan grub mtha' 〉las ‘‘da dung gser mang po btsal nas spyan 'dren par mngags dgongs nas gser 'tshol du phebs pa gar log gi rgyal pos bzung nas ma btang / ye shes 'od kyi dbon po byang chub 'od kyis gser mang po btsal nas khu bo blu bar phyin kyang gtong ma nyan/ de nas ye shes 'od gar log gis bkrongs ’ ()zhes deb ther 'di nyid brtsams pa'i dus ches phyi po yin gshis brjod pa'i lta ba dag kyang gong du brjod zin pa'i deb ther byings dang 'dra mtshungs yin pa brjod med red/mdor na gong du brjod zin pa'i deb ther khag gi nang 'khod pa'i don snying gtso bo ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od nyid rgya gar gyi grags can paṇ+ḍi ta'am jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gu ger gdan 'dren pa'i ched du/ gar log gi yul du gser 'tshol bar byon pa'am dmag 'dren par byas pas yul de'i rgyal pos 'dzin bzung byas nas btson du bcug pa dang mthar rang yul la phyir log bya rgyu lta ci mi yul du khrims gcod nan po'i 'og rang srog blos gtong bya rgyu 'khel ba sogs kyi skor yin 'dug 'on kyang deb ther de dag gi gzhi 'dzin sa mang che ba ni deb dmar dang rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long sogs yin la/ dus rabs bcu bzhi'i rjes su'am dus rabs bco lnga nas bzung brtsams pa'i deb ther rnams dus rabs bcu bzhi'i nang brtsams pa'i deb ther khag dang bsdur na nang don phun sum je tshogs dang je rgyas su btang ba kho na las don gyi snying por dbye khyad ye nas ma mchis/ 〈deb ther dmar po 〉〉ni dus rabs bcu bzhi'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang brtsams pa zhig yin pa dang / de dus gangs can ljongs kyi lte gnas dbus khul la 'dul ba stod rgyud kyi zhen shugs che la/ don du jo bo rje'i thugs sras rmad du byung ba 79

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum ste khu rngog 'brom gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa sol nag thang po che da nga / gsang phu sne'u thog rwa sgreng sogs kyis gtsos pa'i bka' gdams grub mtha' 'am 'dul ba stod rgyud kyi shugs rkyen de bas chen po yod stabs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta grags can a ti sha'i che ba brjod rgyu'i dgos pa sngar bzhin che la khong gis bod kha ba can gyi ljongs su bstan pa slar yang dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa dang bka' gdams grub mtha'i shugs rkyen je cher gtong slad byas rjes chen po bzhag par bstod pa mod mi dma' ba 'bul rgyu trem ma zad/ de dang de 'dra ba'i grags can gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'am mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams gdan 'drongs phyir dang / sngar mnga' ris gu ge'i rgyal po ste rjes su rab tu byung nas 'dul ba stod rgyud dar rgyas dang bstan pa phyi dar la mdzad rjes brjod kyis mi lang ba 'jog mkhan nam snyan grags shin tu che ba'i lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi bla na ma mchis pa'i mdzad rjes dang / gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin la bsngags pa'i snyan dbyangs tam bu ra dkrol phyir dgos pa'i dbang gis lo rgyus kyi byung ba dngos la cung zad sgro 'dogs kyi cha dang ldan par byas snyam/don dngos thog lha bla ma ye shes 'od rgya gar mtha' 'khob yul gar log tu gser 'tshol bar phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang ma mchis/ gang lags she na/ bod gangs can ljongs kyi dbu rtser gnas pa'i stod mnga' ris kyi yul gru 'di ni gna' snga mo nas gser thon sa'i 'byung khungs gtso bo yin la/ yul de'i sa gnas gang sar gser khrog pa du mas gtams yod pas/ sngar nang chos la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po bod yul la gdan 'dren pa'am yang na bod phrug chos la don gnyer can tsho rgya gar yul du chos zhu bar 80

༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/mngags gtong bgyi ba gang gi tshe na'ang gser phon che 'khyer srol yod pa las gsal po shes thub/ des na lha bla ma ye shes 'od rang yul la gser khrog pa phun sum tshogs po yod bzhin du gzhan yul gser gyis phongs pa'i yul la gser 'tshol bar byon pa'i dgos pa ci yang med/de bzhin ye shes 'od kyi skabs/ gu ger lo chen rin chen bzang po dang lo chung legs pa'i shes rab sogs mkhas can dam pa du ma bzhugs yod pa 〈〈deb ther sngon por 〉〉‘‘jo bo'i zhal nas/ e khyed lta bu bod na bzhugs nas snag pas/ kho bo bod du 'ong mi dgos par 'dug’ 4)ces gsungs pa ltar dang / yang sgos rgya gar nas spyan 'dren zhus pa'i pa la rnam gsum sogs kyi shugs rkyen che bzhin du da dung grags can gyi paṇ+ḍi ta jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sogs mgyogs nas myur du gu ger gdan 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ma mchis/ lhag don skabs der gu ger mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas can lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang khong gi slob ma sogs kyis chos dang yon tan gyi rtsa ba zab mo btsugs yod la/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i gzhung lugs sogs kyi rmang gzhi yang ha cang legs po bting yod/ de yang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus mjug gam dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus 'gor/ lde'u jo sras kyis brtsams pa'i 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉dang mkhas pa lde'us mdzad pa'i 〈rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa 〉las ‘‘yang lo tsā ba de'i sku tshe'i smad la lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du btang nas hi pang ka ra spyan drangs nas sngags mtshan nyid gnyis ka'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mang du phab ’ ⑪ces dang ‘‘lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i smad la lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du btang nas/ rje di 81

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pam ka ra spyan drangs nas sngags mtshan nyid gnyis ka lag tu len pa'i rim pa gtan la phab ’’khyaces deb ther 'di gnyis mdzad pa'i dus cung snga bas der jo bo rje'i mtshan yang hi pang ka ra'am di pam ka ra zhes legs sbyar gyi skad rang sor bzhag yod la/ de nyid spyan 'dren mkhan yang lha btsun byang chub 'od yin pa las lha bla ma ye shes 'od yin skor ye nas 'khod mi 'dug cing lha bla ma ye shes 'od jo bo rje spyan 'dren phyir gar log tu dmag don la byon pa sogs bcos ma'i lo rgyus kyi gleng tshul ni de bas dri ma tsam yang ma mchis so//dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i gong du nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer gyis brtsams pa'i 〈chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud 〉du ‘‘byang chub 'od kyi thugs dgongs la paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa zhig spyan drangs na phan che bar 'dug bsams pas rgya brtson 'grus seng ge la dpon bgyis nas/rgya gar shar phyogs za hor gyi yul na rtse di pam ka ra shri dza nya na zhes bya bar zhu rten phul nas zhus pas bod du byon par zhal gyis bzhes nas mtho ling du byon/’ tso zhes 'khod cing deb ther 'di nyid kyi brjod bya dang rjod byed gang gi thad nas kyang gong du brjod zin pa'i 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉rgyas bsdus gnyis dang de tsam dbye khyad chen po med la lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang yang mtshungs cha che ba zhig yin/dus rabs bcu bzhi'i lo rabs nyi shu'i nang ngam bod rab byung lnga pa'i chukhyi lor (spyilo1322)bu ston rin chen grub kyis brtsams gnang ba'i 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉nang ‘‘byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho tshul rgyal ba la sogs pa mi lnga la gser bskur/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dpon du bskos nas paṇ+ḍi ta bzang po gdan drongs la shog byas pas dī bam ka ra shri dza nya na 82

༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/spyan drangs/’ (1zhes 'khod yod cing chos 'byung 'di ma gzhi dus rabs bcu bzhi'i nang mdzad mod/ 'on kyang de'i nang drangs pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i lung khungs shin tu btsan la brjod don rnams dus rabs bcu gnyis nang mdzad pa'i deb ther khag gi srong po'i lta ba dang mthun pa zhig 'dugade min tshal pa'i deb dmar las lo sum cus phyi ba'am dus rabs bcu bzhi'i lo rabs bdun cu'i nang yang lung jo bo shākya rin chen sdes mdzad pa'i 〈yar lung jo bo'i chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘de'i sras 'od lde dang pho brang zhi ba 'od dang / btsun pa byang chub 'od gsum gyis nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba la sogs pa'i mi lnga la gser mang po bskur/ rgya brtson seng ge dpon du bskos nas paṇ+ḍi ta bzang po spyan drongs la shog byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta di pam ka ra shri dza nya naspyan drangs/’ (nazhes 'khod la deb ther 'di'i lung gang nas drangs pa'i skor la ‘‘lha bla ma khu dbon gyi skabs 'dir lo tsā ba bu ston gyi chos 'byung ltar bris pa yin/’ zhonazhes gsal po 'khod 'dug pas/ 'di'i lta ba 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉dang gcig mtshungs yin pa smos mi dgos/yang ka thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu ni/ stod mnga' ris khul gyi yul lung mang por gnas skor du byon myong zhing yul de dag tu yun ring 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba'i dbang gis/ yul de'i lo rgyus sogs kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs khungs btsan du ma gzigs pa'i skal ba dang ldan gyur pas/khong gis mdzad pa'i rgyal bstan rin chen byang phyogs su 'byung ba'i bod rje lha btsan po'i gdung rabs las ‘‘byang chub 'od des jo bo rje bod du spyan drangs pa sogs bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che/’’(1zhes 'khod pa lo rgyus dngos dang mthun cha mang zhing / grub mtha'i phyogs zhen gyi bcos lhad med pa zhig 83

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin/dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'am bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu lug lor (spyilo1643)rgyal ba lnga pa chen mos mdzad pa'i 〈〈bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 〉〉su ‘‘lha bla ma ye shes 'od gser 'tshol du byon pa/ gar log gis btson du bzung par bshad pa ni/ skye bo phal pa nor slong ba lta bu'i rnam pa shar ba blo gros dman pa ste/ 'di nyid mnga' ris kyi btsad po chen po yin pas/ rgyu mtshan zhib tu ma dpyad pa'i skyon no//’ (me zhes deb ther 'di brtsams pa'i dus phyi po yin rung / lo rgyus kyi don rkyen der dgag bya'i lta ba bris pa thog ma yin la dogs gzhir bzung nas khong nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i dgongs tshul yang sba gsang med par gsungs yod/ 'on kyang dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs kyis dben pa'am gang ltar gnad la 'phigs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal po zhig gsungs thub med la/dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs kyi khungs lung sogs de bas kyang gsal po zhig drangs thub med pas/ dus rabs bcu bzhi nas bzung lo rgyus mkhas pa grags can tshos don rkyen der 'dzin pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta bar dag bcos gtsang ma zhig ye nas gnang thub mi 'dugades na dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus 'go tsam gyi mkhas pa lde'u dang lde'u jo sras nas/ dus rabs bcu bzhi'i lo rabs nyi shu'i nang gi mkhas pa'i dbang po bu ston rin chen grub pas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus deb ther khag nang / paṇ+ḍi ta di pam ka ra shri dza nya na gu ge'i mtho lding dgon par spyan 'dren mkhan lha btsun byang chub 'od yin zhes pa las/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'am jo bo rje gdan 'dren slad gar log tu gser 'tshol bar 84

༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/byon nas/ rang srog blos btang ba dang khong gi zhal chems ltar tsha bo byang chub 'od kyis 'bad 'bungs bskyed nas jo bo rje gdan zhu gnang lugs rtsa ba nas 'khod mi 'dug pa ni/ phyogs gcig nas skabs der 'dul ba stod rgyud dbus khul du de tsam gyi dar rgyas chen po med pa dang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'am des btod pa'i bka' gdams pa'i shugs rkyen yang de tsam chen po med cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas de dus lo rgyus mkhas can tshor grub mtha'i lta ba'i phyogs zhen de tsam shugs chen po ma mchis pa'am/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta grags can nam jo bo rje gdan drangs pa'i dbang gis lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi mdzad rjes la che bstod dang gdeng 'jog de tsam chen po mdzad dgos don med pa lta bus/ spyir lo rgyus thog byung myong ba'i don rkyen dag kyang don dngos dang mthun che ba'i sgo nas brjod pa las sgro 'dogs sogs byas pa nyung zhing / de rjes 〈yar lung chos 'byung 〉phud dus rabs bcu bzhi'i lo rabs bzhi bcu nas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung deb ther khag nang grub mtha'i phyogs zhen gyi rkyen pas/ lo rgyus dngos la 'khyog bshad byas pa mngon gsal du rtogs thub/'o na lo rgyus kyi don rkyen de'i gnas tshul ngo ma ji 'dra yin min skor la 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉nang shin tu gsal po 'khod yod pa ni khong gi sku tshe'i mjug la gu ge'i mtho gling dang mang nang sogs la bzhugs nas 'tsho ba ji ltar rol ba'am mdzad 'phrin ji ltar bskyangs tshul skor la ‘‘sku na shin tu bgres pa'i dus su yang nyid kyi thugs dam gling la phyag 'khar bsnams nas bskor ba mang du mdzad cing / gzhan yang mchod pa thams cad la skul zhing /rang gzhan kun gyis mdzad pa yin no// de yi tshe yang nye gnas gcig ma 85

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtogs pa su yang mi mjal bar bka' stsal nas/ lo gsum gyi bar du sku mtshams bcad nas thugs dam mdzad cing mtshams las thon pa dang / re zhig 'bangs kyi tshul gyis gdul bya rnams la zhal bstan pa dang chos rtsigs kyi bka' lung mtha' ma stsal ba'i phyir du mang rgyud du gshegs/ slar yang sku tshe mtha' phyin pa'i bar du mtho gling du bzhugs shing bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no//’’(gyezhes 'khod yod pa 'di las/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta grags can jo bo rje gdan 'dren slad gzhan yul du gser 'tshol bar byon nas mthar rang srog btang med pa gsal po mkhyen thub/de yang lo rgyus dngos su 'khor re'i tsha bo'am lha lde'i bu 'od lde rang gshis gtum zhing dregs pas/ stod mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi ya gyal mar yul la dwags rgyal por dmag drangs pa dang / mthar bal ti'i mnga' khongs gru sha (bru sha )sogs la'ang dmag 'khrug bslangs pa'i rjes 'bras la/yul de'i rgyal pos 'dzin bzung byas nas khrims bcad nan po btang ste/de'i gcung byang chub 'od dang zhi ba 'od gnyis kyis gser phon chen bsnams nas blus kyang / gnas skabs de'i lus kyi ljid tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser lam seng ma 'byor bar 'das grongs byung ba sogs kyi skor 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉su 'di ltar bkod 'dug ste/ ‘‘gcen 'od lde btsan sku shed shin tu che bas sku na gzhon nu nas thugs rgyal can du 'khrungs pa/ 'khrug pa la 'jam thengs gcig mar yul du gshegs pa'i dus su dpe thub kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs mjug tu bru sha'i yul du dmag mdzad pas der dbu 'jam so/gcung gnyis kyis sku blus pas/ khong nyid dang skar ba'i gser dgos zer 86

༄7//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/nas/ ma khugs te re shig de nyid du bzhugs so lcags drang grol nas bros pas sngon las kyi rkyen gyis lcags dug byung nas/ bshul dkar grong so zer mjug tu gcen blu ba'i gser bsdud du dbus kyi na sra gser kha tshun du phebs/ gser mang po gzigs so//ri’6)zhes pa 'di nas lo rgyus dngos su 'od lde gru shar grongs pa las/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od rgya gar mtha' 'khob mu stegs pa'i yul gar log tu bkrongs pa min pa gsal po shes thub/ lha btsun byang chub 'od sogs kyis rang yul nas bsdu rub byas pa'i gser yod do bsnams te/ gcen blu bar byon kyang grongs zin gshis/ blu rin gyi gser de dag lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ge sogs la bskur nas/ jo bo dhi pam ka ra shri dza nya na gdan drangs pa'i skor yang 〈〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉〉nang gsal po bkod 'dug pa ni ‘‘gcen grongs pa gsan nas/ der thugs dgongs brdzangs pas/ gcen ni grongs khong gi don du rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa gcig gdan drangs nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sngar bas kyang dar bar mdzad dgongs nas/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba dpon g.yog lnga/ rgya brtson seng ge la thig po shing srang bcu gcig 'khor gcig dang / gser gyi phye ma mang po bskur nas brdzangs pas/ jo bo dhi pam ka ra shri dza nya na gdan drangs nas phebs pa na/ pho brang btsun pa nyid kyis nyi ma phyed zhabs thang du byon nas bsu ba mdzad/’ k+ṣices pa 'dir mthar gcung pho brang lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis gcen 'od lde'i sku lus blu yas kyi gser de dag bed spyad nas/ jo bo rje gu ger spyan drangs pa dang /khong rang sku ngo mas jo bo rje'i sku mdun du bcar nas bsu ba mdzad tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus dngos ji ma ji bzhin brjod 'dug de min yang lha bla ma ye 87

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shes 'od sku tshe mjug gi mtha' mar snyung gzhi drag pos mnar nas gshegs pa dang lo chen rin chen bzang po sku ngo mas gdung mchod gnang ba'i skor sogs lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar 'bring po las ‘‘lha bla ma ye shes 'od snyung bar gnas nas/ myur du zhal mjal du byon pas la snyung gzhi drag po gcig gis zin nas zhal ma mjal lo// gdung mchod ngan song sbyong ba la sogs pa ni/ lo tsā ba khong rang gis mdzad do//’ tun+t+razhes lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar 'bring po 'di yul der sa skyes rdo skyes kyi mkhas pa chen po gu ge khyi thang pa dza nya na shris mdzad pas lo rgyus dngos dang je mthun yin pa ni brjod med red/mdor na skabs de dus stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lo rgyus dngos su rang yul la phyir log byed rgyu lta ci gzhan yul du sku lus dor mkhan ni lha lde yin pa las lha bla ma ye shes 'od min/ rjes su dus rabs bcu bzhi'i dus dkyil tsam nas bzung bod brgyud nang bstan gyi lo rgyus mkhas can tshos lo rgyus kyi don rkyen de bed spyad nas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od yin khul gyi sgro 'dogs byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ stod nas bstan pa'i me ro gso ba dang gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur 'go btsugs pa/ 'dul ba stod rgyud dam pu tsho mkhan brgyud dar 'phel mdzad pa/ lhag don du bka' gdams pa'i mdzad po jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod la gdan drangs pa bcas la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis byas rjes chen po bzhag par dgongs nas/ khong la che bstod byas pa 'ba' zhig yin pa las lo rgyus kyi don dngos ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dgung lo shin tu smin pa'i bar 'tsho bzhugs kyis mthar gu ge mtho gling rang du gshegs pa de rang lags so//88

༄༅//lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log tu 'das min skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/'dir bdag gis 'bad 'bungs yod rgus lo rgyus kyi don rkyen der dag bcos byas khul yang kho bo ni lta rgya dang mthong rgya ha cang dman pa'i khar lo rgyus kyi shes tshad kyang shin tu nyag phra phyir/ go ba log sgrub dang ma rtogs col chung gi skyon nor dri mas 'bags rigs la/ mkhas dbang rnam pa tsho dang rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams nas dgongs 'char dang slob ston lhug por stsol ba'i re ba snying dbus nas 'chang bzhin yod lags/mchan/me 〈deb ther dmar po/〉 tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams/ 1981lo'i zla 10par pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par thengs dang po brgyab/ shog grangs 42nas 43la gsal/() 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long /〉 sa skya ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams/ 1981lo'i zla 5par pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par thengs dang po brgyab/ shog grangs 244la gsal/rjo 〈rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/〉 stag tshang ba dpal 'byor bzang pos brtsams/1983lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun/ shog grangs 218nas 219la gsal/(nye 〈deb ther sngon po/〉'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis brtsams/ 1984lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun/ shog grangs 299nas 300la gsal/() 〈deb ther dmar po gsar ma/〉 paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas brtsams/1989lo'i zla 3par bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas par thengs dang po brgyab/shog grangs 435la gsal/me 〈〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' stonata〉 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas 89

༄7//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'bab pa'i chu chen bzhi'i skor/glang chen kha 'bab/(bya1twe'i) glang chen kha 'bab gu ge'i yul la 'bab//gu ge glang shed che ba de nas byung // zhes pa bzhin/ gangs dkar ti si'i nub phyogs ri glang po che 'gying ba'i sna khug 'dra ba'i ri shur nas chu bo chen po gagi nub tu 'bab kyin yod pas ming de ltar thogs/ sgar rdzong mon mtsher khul gyi rnying ma'i dgon sde grags can mdun chu zhes pa'i nye 'dabs nas chu mgo btsugs te rtsa mda'i mtho lding dang / gu ge rtsa rang mkhar/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'khrungs yul rong chung bcas brgyud nub khul sa mtshams nas rgya gar phyogs la rgyugs 'gro gin yod/ rgya gar yul la chu der su the ri ji zhes 'bod/ pa ki si than gyi ji na bu gtsang po dang 'brel nas phen rje na lde gtsang po zhes 'bod cing mtha' ma hin du gtsang po dang 'brel nas hin rdu rgya mtsho chen por 'bab bo// gtsang po de'i ring tshad la spyi le 1450yod cing chu rgyun bzhur yul gyi rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma khri/ 40lhag tsam yod/ gtsang chen de'i bzhur yul stod mnga' ris mnga' khongs sam phyi mtha'i rgyal khab kyi sa gnas gang du 'khel kyang glog shugs chu 'bab dang zhing chu 'dren par shin tu legs gshis sa gnas de'i dpal 'byor gong 'phel dang mi sogs sems can gyi 'tsho gzhes la'ang shin tu smin/ lhag par9 hā rgya

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gar yul du zhing las thon skyed la med du mi rung ba'i skye bo'i lus zungs kyi khrag rtsa lta bur snang / rgya gar gyi h+phe lo tse po ler dngos rigs dbor 'dren dang 'grim 'grul sogs su dgos mkho ha cang che ba zhig yin/mnga' ris sa khongs su sngar zhang zhung rgyal rabs skabs kyi rig gzhung dang gu ge rgyal rabs skabs kyi rig gzhung gi lte gnas mang che ba de'i rgyud du 'khel yod/ dper na khyung lung dngul mkhar dang / mda' pa mkhar/phyi wang dbu rtse mkhar/ mkhar rtse'i khar rdzong / pi rti mkhar/ 'chi med dga'u mkhar/ gu ge rtsa rang mkhar sogs gtsang po'i de'i chu rgyun du mchis/de bzhin yang bod brgyud nang bstan bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi 'dul ba stod rgyud dar khyab yong sa'i sa gnas gal chen dag kyang de'i bzhur rgyun du yod do// chu rgyun de'i bzhur rgyud ni dus deng sang yang mnga' ris gna' bo'i rig gnas dar khyab shin tu che ba'i khul zhig yin par mkhar rdzong dang / lha khang / ldebs ris/ grags can sa phug gna' sgrung / thun mong min pa'i glu gar/ bud med kyi rgyan gos sogs khyad du 'phags pa yod do//rma bya kha 'bab/(6klusmospru2bya) rma bya kha 'bab pu rang yul du 'bab//pur mo kha 'bras legs pa de nas byung // zhes pa ltar mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i rma bya'i gzugs 'dra ba'i brag ri'i 'og gam ri bo rma bya gnyis bsnol ba lta bu'i kha nas 'bab kyi yod pas ming de ltar thogs/ ri bo hi ma la ya'i lho phyogs rgyud de hin du yul la 'bab dus chu mo gang gā zhes 'bod do// chu bo de'i bzhur rgyun mang che ba rgya gar dang bhang ga la ṭa yin cing / mthar bhang ga la ṭa'i mtsho khug tu 'bab bo// mi dang / dud 'gro/ tha na rtsi shing skyes dngos sogs kyi bla srog tu gyur pa'i chu mo de'i ring tshad ni khyon bsdoms 94

༄7//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'bab pa'i chu chen bzhi'i skor/spyi le 2700dang chu rgyun bzhur yul gyi rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi ma khri 106tsam zin gyi yod/ chu zhugs ba rag kha ma phu te dang 'dres mtshams su gling phran zur gsum ma zhig chags yod cing / der 'bru rigs thon 'bor legs la/shing sna phun sum tshogs shing 'bras bu g.yur du za'o// rgya gar dang bhang ga la ṭa'i khul du gtsang po che chung mang po mnyam du 'dres rkyen gyis chu shugs che la chu 'bab bzang bas zhing chu 'dren yas dang / chu thog dngos rigs dbor 'dren sogs la phan pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo // chu rgyun de'i mjug rgyud la mi 'bor mang bar ma zad/ 'bras dang / so ma ser po/ bur shing bcas skyes dngos kyang shin tu legs po yod/stod mnga' ris mnga' khongs kyi chu rgyun du pu rang gi nam mkha' khyung rdzong dang / dkar dung sku mkhar nyi zung / stag la mkhar/ rgyal ldi mkhar/ zhi sde lha sde mkhar/ 'khor chags dgon sogs lo rgyus dang rig gnas ldan pa'i gna' bo'i mkhar dang dgon sde sogs mang po yod/ lhag don du yul 'dir rgyal po nor bzang gi sgrung gtam ha cang dar zhing / gang sar 〈nor bzang gtam rgyud 〉dang 'brel ba'i gna' shul shin tu mang la/rngon pa'i rgyud pas dpon byed myong ba'i dpon phun tshogs dbang po zhes pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/ yul pa'i rgan rabs myong ba can tshos brjod par zhi sde khul gyi dpon po de skabs shig na dbang thang shin tu chen po yod pa dper na spu rang rgyal ldi mkhar sogs kyi mi ser rta hrag bsgrigs te rma bya gtsang po'i byang ngogs nas 'khor chags dgon par chos mjal la 'gro dus zhi sde mkhar gyi kha thug tu slebs pa dang zhon rta nas lam seng mar 'bab dgos/ gal te rta la zhon nas snang med du phyin tshe zhi sde'i dpon phun tshogs dbang pos ring 95

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mda' 'phangs tshe srog shor rgyu las bya thabs med pas tsho pa phyi'i mi 'bangs dag kyang kho la gus gus zhum zhum byed dgos pa las nga rgyal dang spobs pa byed mi nyan par grags/ yul de'i bud med kyi rgyan gos la dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan par nam zhag rgyun gtan du gyon yas phyu pa phur ldan ma dang /zhwa mo gtum zhwa/ ra lpags rgyab slog rgyab gdan mgo shubs can bcas yod/ zab mchor spras yas rgyan gos ni thun mong ma yin pa zhig ste/ bzo dbyibs dang bzo rtsal legs shing / rin thang bral ba/ lo rgyus ring ba bcas bod kha ba can gyi yul ljongs gzhan du de ltar khyad 'phags can ni spyan lam yangs por 'char ba'i skal ba ma mchis/ de bzhin bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bstan pa phyi dar skabs bzhengs pa'i grags can dgon sde ste 'khor chags dgon pa dang de'i rten gtso jo bo rin po che dngul sku mched gsum/gnas rdo a mo li ga mdo dang rgyud kyi phyag dpe bris ma rnying pa/ ldebs ris sogs rten sku gsung cha tshang ba'ang rma bya gtsang po'i chu rgyun dang shin tu thag nye ba'i dgon sde de'i nang la yod do//seng ge kha 'bab/(1saspunebya) seng ge kha 'bab la dwags yul la babs//la dwags dpal rtsal ldan pa de nas byung // zhes te/ gangs dkar ti si'i byang phyogs ri bo dpa' nyams ldan zhing / rtsal chen seng ge 'gying 'dra'i dbyibs can gyi kha nas 'bab pas ming de ltar byung / chu chen de'i stod rgyud du 'bong pa seng stod dang / kong chen/ 'bong pa seng smad/ sna phug bcas 'brog sde khag dang karma bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dgon sde grags can brag skya dgon pa/ gna' shul grags can dpa' mar mkhar/ pho rog mkhar/ mon zhing / mon tho/ mon mkhar bcas yod 96

༄7//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'bab pa'i chu chen bzhi'i skor/la/ sngar zhang zhung skabs sum pa ru'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rgod tshang stod dang rgod tshang smad/ lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i gna' rdzas sna tshogs sngog 'don byung ba'i glang bcu'i mkhar sa/ gyam mug mkhar gog bkra shis sgang dgon pa (bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi dgon sde grags can gzhan zhig ste rten sku srung gya nom pa yod/) bde mchog lha ri dkar po/ lcags rigs gter khas gtams pa'i lcags khang yul/ tshong sa rnying pa dum rtse bcas yod/ chu rgyun de rgyugs khul du yangs shing mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i rtswa thang dang / rngam brjid dod pa'i gangs ri/ pir gyis ri mo bris 'dra'i do po(mnga' ris kha skad de ri chung chung la zer/) dbyibs gzugs sna tshogs ldan pa/ dri za'i gnas dang 'dra ba'am 'phrul ba'i rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i rang byung khams kyi bkod pa/ sngo 'jam rtswa yi mal stan 'bol zhing bde ba'i spang ljongs ngos su dwangs shing bsil ba'i gtsang chu lhung lhung 'bab/ 'dod dgu yid bzhin rnyed pa'i ri klung khyon ri dwags sna tshogs brtse 'jos rab tu myos/ lar na gnas der rin chen gter rdo sna tshogs kyis yongs su gtams shing / chu tshan gyi thon khungs dang phyugs zog thon khungs kyang ha cang legs pa bcas so/da dung der mnga' ris lo rgyus thog grags pa shin tu che ba'i gna' shul rnying pa ra la mkhar dmar dang rting 'grum rtse'i gna' rdzas rnying pa ste rdo chas gsar rnying dus kyi rdo yi yo chas sna tshogs/ rdza bzos dus kyi rdza ris mtshon khra can sogs gna' snga mo'i rig gnas kyang ha cang phun sum tshogs po yod/chu rgyun de'i smad rgyud rgya gar dang mnga' ris sa mtshams thog pu ga ru le nas thon rjes su rgya gar pas gtsang po der hin du gtsang po zhes so// der ka shir rmir dang pa ki si tan brgyud mtha' ma ha de ra ba zhes pa nas a rab rgya 97
