༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho chen mor 'dres so// gtsang chen de'i khyon bsdoms ring tshang ni spyi le 3180yod cing / chu rgyun bzhur yul rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi ma khri 96tsam zin gyi yod/ de min stod mnga' ris kyi sa'i char chu rgyun de'i yan lag gtso bo zhig ni sgar gtsang po dang phyi rgyal khul gyi yan lag gtso bo zhig ni sa the lan ji'i gtsang chen yin/ gtsang chab de'i chu rgyun bzang pa'i dbang gis pa ki si tan shar byang khul du sa gshis gshin pa'i thang chen dag la zhing las thon skyed 'phel bar nus pa chen po thon yod do// a rab rgya mtshor ma 'dres tsam du spyi le gru bzhi ma 8000zin pa'i gling phran zur gsum can zhig chags nas yod gshis khul der gtsang chen des zhing las dang nags las thon skyed la shin tu smin no//rta mchog kha 'bab/(21sku'ikro'iji5shu1'i) rta mchog kha 'bab gro shod gzhung la babs// gro shod rta rgyus bzang ba de nas byung // zhes pa ltar/gangs dkar ti si'i shar phyogs dang bye ma g.yung drung gi byang ngos te/ ri bo dbyibs gzugs rta mchog 'tsher ba cang shes rta yi dbyibs can gyi kha nas chu bo chen po gyim shang 'khyil ba'am g.yung drung lu gu rgyud lta bur lhung lhung du 'bab pa dang 'dra bas ming de ltar byung / sngar lo rgyus kyi yig rnying nang la yar chab gtsang po zhes shing 'brong pa rdzong dang sa dga' rdzong khul du rta mchog kha 'bab ces 'bod kyang lha rtse'i gzhung la slebs dus yar klung gtsang po zhes 'bod pa ni yar phyogs ri klung mtho sa stod kyi yul nas 'bab pas so/des na dbus gtsang khul dang / dwags po/ kong po/ spo bo sogs brgyud rgya gar sar ma slebs bar du yar klung gtsang po zhes pa'i tha snyad de rang sor gnas so//98

༄༅//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'bab pa'i chu chen bzhi'i skor/yang khag cig gis yar klung gtsang po'am yar lung gtsang po zhes pa'i tha snyad de chu shul nas 'go btsugs te 'bod par grags zhes pa dang khag cig gis bod lho kha khul gyi grags can gnas ri'am srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i ya gyal du 'bod pa'i yar stod yar lha sham po'i gangs chu te yar lha gsham chur grags pa'i chu rgyun yul yar mo klung gi sa cha brgyud de byang phyogs la rgyugs nas rtse thang du rta mchog gtsang po'am yar chab gtsang por 'dres pas de nas gtsang chen de'i ming la yar klung gtsang po zhes 'bod kyang phyis su stod lha rtse man chad kyi gtsang rgyud spyi yongs su ming de byung bar grags mod/ 'on te don dngos ci 'dra yin min mu mthud brtag par 'tshal/ gtsang po de'i stod rgyud du 'brong pa tsho pa dgu dang la stod byang sogs yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang thog 'brog khul kyi rig gnas dang tsho ba dar khyab che/ kong yul gyi ri bo gnam lcags 'bar bar skor ba nang skor rta rmig gzugs 'dra ba zhig brgyab te lho khul tshang tshing gi nags shing dang gcong rong can gyi g.yang gzar 'grims nas sa bab dma' la tsha ba che ba'i glo yul rgyud rgya gar a sam zhes par 'bab/mdor na chu rgyun de'i 'gram ngogs su yul 'brog rong gsum gyi rang lugs khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gzhung sna tshogs dar ba'i bod mi mang dag 'tsho gzhes byed cing dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dar bar nus pa chen po thon yod pas bod mi'i rig gnas skyong ba'i yum chen ma zhes 'bod pa de yang thal cha che drags pa rtsa ba nas min/ rgya gar yul du slebs pa dang bu rag ma bu the gtsang po zhes shing rgya gar shar phyogs dang bhang ga la brgyud chu mo gang gā dang 'dres nas bhang ga la'i rgya mtsho 99

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen por zhugs so// grags can gtsang po de'i khyon yongs kyi ring tshad ni spyi le 2900mchis shing bod nang gi ring tshad ni spyi le 1787tsam yod cing /smad rgyud du rgya gar dang bhang ga'i khul du spyi le 1113tsam yod la/ zhing chu 'dren pa'i rin thang dang phan yon sogs ni gang gā gtsang po dang cha 'dra tsam yin no//gtsang po de'i spyi'i chu rgyun bzhur yul rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi ma khri dgu bcu go lnga tsam dang / bod kyi mnga' khongs su spyi le gru bzhi ma khri sum bcu zin no// bod nang gi rgya mtsho'i ngos las cha snyoms mtho tshad rmid gsum stong bzhi brgya tsam zin cing / rgyugs yun shin tu ring gshis bod kha ba can na mchis pa'i gtsang po du ma'i dbus nas ring shos de yin/ yar klung gtsang po'i yan lag chu phran grangs kyi gzhal bar dka' ba yod kyang gtso che ba ni smar tshang gtsang po dang / mar yum gtsang po/ rdo gzhong gtsang po/snod byin gangs ba bzang po'i chu rgyun myang chu gtsang po/ 'bri gung phu chu'i chu rgyun lha sa'i skyid chu/ kong po'i gzhung nas rgyugs pa'i nyang chu gtsang po/yar lha sham po nas rgyugs pa'i yar lha gtsang chu/ phar lung gtsang po bcas yod do//〈gangs ri chen po ti se dang mtsho chen ma dros bcas kyi sngon 'byung lo rgyus shel dkar me long 〉las/ chu chen bzhi po de'i skor la 'di ltar bkod yod de/ shar rta mchog gi gnas pa ka shu dngul gyi bye ma 'dren bzhin ma dros pa la lan bdun bskor nas chu bran lnga brgya dang bcas te shar gyi rgya mtshor 'bab/ lho khyung mchog gi kha nas sin dha rin po che sna tshogs kyi bye ma 'dren bzhin du lho phyogs su 'bab/ nub glang chen gyi kha nas gang gā gser 100

༄7//mnga' ris sa khul nas 'babapa'ichuchenabazhi'iskor/ da gyi bye ma 'dren bzhin du nub phyogs su 'bab/ byang seng ge'i kha nas si ta rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren bzhin du byang phyogs su 'bab pa sogs kyi yon tan du ma'o zhes so//de bzhin 〈blon po bka' yi thang yig 〉las grags can chu bo chen po bzhi po de'i skor la gsham gsal ltar bkod yod de/ phyogs bzhi dag na sems can kha 'dra bzhi// chu bo chen po bzhi ni phyogs bzhir 'bab// nub phyogs glang chen kha nas gang gā 'bab// dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing ma dros bskor// chu bran lnga brgyar bcas nas shar mtshor 'bab// lho khyung 'dra ba'i kha nas sin du 'bab// beḍūr+ya yi bye ma 'dren cing bskor// shar phyogs rta yi kha nas pa rag 'bab// shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing sngar bzhin bskor// byang phyogs seng ge'i kha nas si ta 'bab// gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing gong bzhin bskor// zhes bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grags can bla ma sogs kyis gna' srol gyi bkod stangs shig go/101

༄//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya grul za rang ru dpon gyi skor/za rang ru dpon ni stod mnga' ris khul na mchis pa'i dpon khag drug gi ya gyal zhig ste/ dbang thang che la sgar dpon rim byung gis kyang mthong ha cang chen po byed kyin yod pa ni/ lo re'i sgar 'char can skabs g.yon ru dang por sdod dbang yod/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa 'go tshugs ma khad la bod nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang / sog po dwa le han/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bcas kyis bod sog 'go sbrel gyi dpung dmag btang nas mnga' ris mnga' zhabs su 'jug skabs mnga' ris yongs su dbang sgyur mkhan la dwags kyi rgyal po'i dbang shugs mtshon pa'i dpung dmag la dmag 'thab thengs mang byed dus sog po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi dpung rogs dmag dpon rdo rjes dpa' ngar 'dzems med kyis dgra dmag mang po bkum zhing byas rjes chen po bzhag yod pas khong la gzengs bstod dang bdag rkyen du gu ge lho smad khul kyi yul tsho dag gnang bar ma zad/dpon gyi rgo dbang dang dpal ldan lha mo'i btsan mdung gi bka' gtan ṭ+wāṃngo// sa su gnang ste/ pha shul bu 'dzin gyis mi bdag dbang spyod chog pa byas gu ge lho smad khul gyi yul tsho ma bu spun bdun du grags pa ni ri lte sgang pa 102

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal za rang ru dpon gyi skor/dang / ri pa/ chu gser/ kab rag za rang / steng pa/ bye dkar bcas yin/ za rang ru dpon sdod sa de yul tsho de tsho'i dbus sam lte bar chags/ de yang ru dpon gyi sdod gnas dang thog gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du yod kyang phyis su dgun dus gangs chen po 'bab pa'i tshe la klung tshang ma gangs kyis bkag gshis bye dkar dang steng pa sogs bdag med du gyur cing / mtha' khul gyi dgra dmag gis nyen kha chen po bzo gi yod rkyen gyis za rang du gnas spos kyis gtan sdod byas/ ru dpon la khang pa gong 'og gnyis yod par ru dpon mtha' ma'i skabs su khang pa gong la ru dpon dang 'og la sring mo'i sdod khang byed/ ru dpon bzhugs gnas khang bzang thog brtsegs sum ldan zhig yod par ming la bkra shis khang gsar zer gyin yod/ khang bzang de'i gcig thog la dud 'gro 'jog pa dang bar khang ni 'bru rigs 'jog sa dang dgun kha sdod sa yin/ steng khang ni mchod khang dang gzims chung bcas so//za rang ru dpon dpon rabs mang dag cig byung yod kyang mang po zhig gi ming sogs mi gsal kyang dpon zla ba rnam rgyal dang / dpon mgar bstan/dpon ngag rnam bcas 'jon thang che tsam byung yod skad do// za rang ru dpon mtha' ma de ni ru dpon rnam rgyal gyi bu zla ba rgyal po yin/ ru dpon la g.yog rgyugs mkhan rta g.yag ra lug sogs sgo phyugs 'tsho mkhan dang / yos 'thag mkhan/ chang btso mkhan/ gad pa zhes nang g.yog rgyugs mkhan nang gzan khyon bsdoms mi grangs nyi shu lhag tsam yod/ lo re'i lo gsar skabs la khos yul mi tshang ma skad btang nas mgron nam gsol tshigs rgyas po zhig gtong zhing / chang btung ba dang gzhas gtong ba/ zhabs bro rgyag pa sogs spro skyid la rol tu 'jug pa dang / yul 103

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mis ru dpon la mjal dar legs po zhig dang mgron zhes bag leb srab po'i thog la mar khu blugs shing / mang po mnyam du brtsegs pa phul nas bkra shis bde legs zhu srol yod do//za rang ru dpon zhes stod mnga' ris mtha' mtshams sa khul la phyi'i dgra dmag byung na dpung dmag gi ru sne 'khrid de kha gtad gcog mkhan nam ya lan sprod mkhan gyi dmag dpon che shos de yin/ khong la go sa dang dbang thang mtshon pa'i gser rgyan sgron pa'i chu shel nor bu'i tog ja dkar las chung tsam zhig dang / dmag zhwa thun mong min pa zhig yod de grib sbyangs rma bya'i sgro mdongs can rin chen sa le sbram gyi mdog tung skud ser pos brgyan pa/mdun ngos su rin chen gser gyi rgyu las sgrub pa'i pa ṭa dang nyi zla/ mtha' bzhir rin thang gzhal bar dben pa'i rin chen nor rdo rnying ma sha stag ste/g.yu dang / byu ru/ mu tig mchong smug pad ma ra ga rdo rje pha lam/gzi sgor dkar po/ khog nang la sbrang ma bzhugs pa'i spos shel bcas kyis rgyan yod/ tog dang zhwa mo de lo gsar skabs dang sgar 'char can skabs la sgron pa ma gtogs nam rgyun sgam chung nang la bcug nas gsang thabs kyis bsdus nas 'jog lhag par du sgar 'char can skabs su dbu zhwa ser chen 'bog to la tog dang cha 'grigs gyon/ rna cog la sog byil sgron/ lus la gos chen smug po'i phyu pa dang de'i steng la sog lugs kyi sgog rtse smug po ṭam thig sgor mo can zhig gyon/ mdo la rgya gri phur shubs btags shing /zhabs lham yu ring nag dob ces lham sgrog bcings dgos pa de gyon (mtshams re 'ja' can spus legs shig kyang gyon no/) da dung rta chas cha tshang gzab legs thog rta dom (dbang thang mtshon ched rta'i ske la bsgrogs pa'i rag gi dril bu lce med 104

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal za rang ru dpon gyi skor/rtsid pa tshos dmar po gtong ba dpyang 'phrul du 'dogs yod pa zhig)btags pa der zhon te rngam brjid dod pos 'gro'o//za rang ru dpon za rang yul du sdod dus dbang thang chen po yin pa mngon gsal dod po med kyang lo re'i sgar 'char can skabs dbang thang shin tu che ba ni bzhugs gral gyi g.yon ru dang por sdod cing / rta rgyugs sogs 'gran bsdur gyi las ka'i byed sgo mang che ba'i 'gan kho rang gis 'khur dgos/ru dpon rang gi rgyugs rta g.yog por rtsis sprod kyis rgyugs su bcug kyang ang ki yag po len thub kyi med pa ni chu mo ti dang ru thog gi rta shin tu legs pa'i dbang gis so// za rang ru dpon gyi dpon thog mang che ba 'jon thang che bas stod mnga' ris sgar dpon nas mthong chen byed/ za rang ru dpon gyis lo gsum re'i thog la spu rang rdzong 'og la byon nas sen mo ṭam ka drug cu'i khral bsdu gin yod la/ de min khral bsdu yul gzhan dag bkra shis sgang dang rtsa rang bcas kyang yod do// de tsho'i skor khong la bka' gtan cha tshang bstan rgyu yod pa ni gos chen ser po'i thog la 'bru tsha'i yig gzugs snag tsha nag pos bris pa'i bka' shog smyug mdong nang la bcug nas yod skad kyang deng bsdad med/ lo re'i ston khar khong dang dpon g.yog 'khor bcas tshang mas steng par steng 'phags par chos mjal du bskyod cing / zhor la bem khral cha tshang bsdu'o// steng par ru dpon gyi zhing las byed mkhan dang shing sgrug mkhan rkang grong dud bcu gnyis yod/ kho tshos thab chas te zangs snod gcig thum bu (mnga' ris yul skad skyog la go)gcig dang mkho chas rang 'grigs te thong gshol dang rta 'khyer nas za rang du bcar te zhing las cha tshang byed kyin yod/ mdor na nang gzan ni nang las 105

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ba' zhig byed mkhan dang steng pa tsho ni phyi'i las ka byed mkhan yin/za rang ru dpon dbyar kha lcang rwa can zhes sa bab cung mtho la bsil ba'i lung shur rtswa sna chu sna 'dzoms pa der zla ba gcig dang phyed ka sdod kyin yod/ ru dpon gyi sgo phyugs sems can g.yag nyis brgya lhag tsam dang lug bzhi brgya lhag tsam yod pa spyir btang mi tshang gnyis kyis bdag po brgyab cing kho tsho dbyar dus lcang rwa can du sdod pa dang / dgun dus su rong mo che zhes 'brog sa legs pa'i gras shig yod pa der sdod par yul de sman lung du grags shing / sman rtswa mang bas sems can sha shed rgyas la shi chad byung ba nyung ngo //za rang gi yul 'dir phyi phyogs kyi tshong pa ste skyo nam rong pa dang / spu rong pa/ rnam rgya rong pa/ khab rong pa bcas thon yong gi yod/ skyo nam rong pas ras cha sna tshogs 'khyer yong ba phud gzhan dag tshos mang che bar 'bras dang / bra phye 'khyer cing star ka ku shu/ cu li(kham bu skam po/)snum sogs 'khyer ba mang zhing / yul 'dir byang 'brog gi tshwa tshong mang po 'dzoms nas glang bcu'i tshwa ba'am tshwa tshong mkhan gtan du yong gin yod pa/kho tshos lug stong phrag mang por tshwa bkal nas la klung mang po brgyab ste/ r+bha ba gsum tsam dka' ba du ma spyad nas 'dir slebs ma thag tshwa dang 'bru rigs shing tog sogs dang brje tshong byed/ glang bcu'i 'brog pas dgun kha byang tshwa kha la tshwa len par phyin nas tshur 'khor ba dang glang lung 'bub ces par tshwa khang chung chung mang po zhig brgyab yod pa der bcug nas 'jog dpyid ka shar ba dang de tsho lug khal nang la blugs ste lug gi sgal bar bkal nas za rang la dbor/ glang bcu tshwa pa'i gzhug skyel mkhan de'i ming la glang bcu 'jam dpal zer zhing / khong la tshong shag mang bas lo ltar tshong zog gya nom 106

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal za rang ru dpon gyi skor/pa yong gin yod/za rang nas thon yong ba'i khu nu'i tshong pa mang che bas yul der slebs ma thag g.yog po tshang ma rang yul la slog gtong zhing sbyin bdag tshang mas 'bong seng stod seng smad/ dge rgyas/ bse 'khor/ sger rtse sogs la sru bal dang pags rigs nyo bar 'gro zhing / byang thang la slebs pa dang sbrags kho rang tshos 'brog pa'i lug 'tsho bar phyin te/ skrad (ra'i khu lu'am le na tshur bton yas kyi lag cha dmigs bsal can zhig) brgyab nas ra'i le na len pa dang lug bal yang kho rang tshos bregs kyin yod pa ni 'brog par spu bal lag len bstar du bcug na mang po zhig 'phro brlag gtong bar bsam mo// khu nu'i sems can mang po zhig gu ge'i khul du rtswa rin dang chu rin la 'bru rigs sogs sprad nas 'tsho skyong byed du bcug pa'am dud khyim la bcol 'tsho byed du 'jug ri lte sgang dang kab rag pa'i mi 'ga' shas khu nu'i lung par ma slebs bar du rogs la phyin nas tshur log yong dus khu nu'i lug ded yong gin yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni phyogs gcig nas khu nu'i lung pa ri rong sha stag yin pas rtswa thang med pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sa bab dma' bas tsha ba sogs kyis lug tshang ma shi 'gro gi yod skad/guge lho smad yul tsho bdun kyi skyes pho mang che ba re mos kyis lo gsum re'i thog ‘‘lo gsum pho nya ’ zhes mi gnyis rkang btsugs nas (tshos las kyi don du)rgya gar spor ba ṇi gir saṇa bar du lan skyel bar mngags gtong byed/mi de gnyis kyis sgal bar khur bu 'khyer nas gom pa spos te nyin ma gar slebs la 'gro dgos/ kho gnyis rang yul ma yol bar gyi rgyags phye 'dang nges las phyi rgyal yul la 'byor ba dang sbrags zas sdod 'gro song tshang ma khu 107

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nus gtong dgos/ spyir kho gnyis za rang nas rdog thon gyis bye dkar rgyud 'gro gin yod/ kho gnyis kyi las 'gan ni bod yul du/ mi phyugs la nad yams sogs yod med/ rang byung gi gnod 'tshe ji byung min/ yul gyi chos srid la bar chad byung min/ tshong zog gnas babs legs min sogs zhib cing phra ba zhig skabs de'i rgya gar srid gzhung la snyan seng zhu'o// lhag don du nad yams dza drag dang dgra nyen gdug pa can sogs byung tshe lo der kho tsho'i tshong pa tshur bod du thon ma yong zhes brda gtong byed/ tshur log yong dus rgya gar yul du gong gi gnas tshul yod med brtag dpyad kyis stod mnga' ris sgar dpon la snyan seng zhu dgos pas mi de gnyis kyi las 'gan lji po yod/ gal te rdzun bshad pa'am 'go skor btang na srog la nyen kha yod skad do//phyis su za rang ru dpon dang chu rti dpon gnyis dbar la gnyen 'brel sogs brgyud de 'brel ba yag po yod/ lo ltar za rang nas bod rag (nas chang gi rlangs chu las bzos pa'i a rag)legs shos 'khyer nas chu rti dpon la sprod pa dang chu rti dpon gyis 'bri mar g.yag khal gnyis gsum 'khyer yong nas za rang ru dpon la sprod kyin yod/ tha na chu rti dpon thog gcig ni za rang ru dpon gyi nu bo yin pa bcas so//108

༄//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/chu mo rti zhes pa'i tha snyad de bod skad kyi chu mo dang zhang zhung gi skad rti (chu zhes pa'i don/)zhes pa mnyam du sbrel nas byung ba yin/ yul der mkhar gog rnying pa rngam brjid ha cang dod po zhig yod pa de'i ming la mkhar 'chi med dga' po dpal 'byor zhes zer gyi yod/ de ni sngar zhang zhung skabs kyi 'chi med ga'u mkhar zhes pa de min nam snyam/ gu ge'i rgyal rabs rim byung gi skabs su rgyal po'i gnyen rgyud kyis bskyangs par grags/ yul pa'i rgan rabs myong ba can tshos brjod pa ltar na/ sngar mkhar chen de bzhengs pa'i tshe dbu 'dzin der thog ma nas rngan pa tog tsam yang ma sprad pas khos mkhar gyi rmang gzhi legs po ma bting / rjes su rgyag zin grabs yod dus mkhar brtan po med par shes ste kho la gser rlid bu (ra lpags gang tshang gcer bshus brgyab pa'am sbubs bshus brgyab par brjod/) gang rngan par sprad nas yang skyar bzhengs re byas kyang / khos da phyi drags pa red ces rngan pa ma blangs par mkhar mu mthud de bskrun cing / mkhar de mgyogs po nyams rgud 'gro gi red ces brjod/ des na phyis su ltas ngan pa 'grub pa bzhin nyen kha chen po byung bas chu rti'i dpon rgyud dag mkhar de'i shar phyogs gser rtir ma spos thabs med byung 'dug kyang mkhar shul rnying pa de deng dus kyang mthong rgyu yod 109

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/do//chu mo rti'i dpon gser rtir gnas spos byas rjes su der mkhar gong 'og gnyis bzhengs yod pa la/ dpon rabs tsho mkhar 'og la sdod kyin yod kyang / dus rabs nyi shu'i nang ‘‘rig gnas gsar rje'i ’’skabs su rtsa med btang bas deng sang gyang ro tsam las med pa de'ang lhas rwa chen po zhig gi 'khris su mchis/ chu rti dpon gyi las 'gan gtso bo ni stod mnga' ris khul la phyi phyogs mtha' khul gyi dgra byung dus mtha' mtshams srung mkhan nam dpung dmag gi ru sne 'khrid mkhan dmag dpon yin gshis sgar dpon nas dgra nyen ga par yod pa de rang la mngags gtong byed/ de tshe khos nyen khar ma bltas par de ma nyid du dang blangs zhu dgos/ khos gzhis par sdod dus mkhar nang la bzhugs khri sngon po zhig brgyab nas sdod cing dbyar kha gur chen zhig phub nas sdod kyin yod/chu rti dpon gyi 'og la rogs skyor zhu mi ste spyi yongs kyi 'gan 'dzin byed mkhan rgan po gcig rjodang / 'brog sde so so'i dngul khral bsdu mkhan bka' blon gnyisadu/ rgan pos do nan gyis 'brog rigs mi ser gyi lag nas dngul khral bu lon bsdus pa dag mang che ba dpon la bdag kyang gang la gang 'tshams shig stod mnga' ris dbu gur gong 'og gam sgar dpon gong 'og la thad kar phul dgos/ de min chu rti dpon la gsol dpon gcig dang /gnyer pa gnyis/(kho gnyis mi drang po blos 'khel chog pa zhig dgos)/ mkhar dpon gcig (mkhar la gad phyis gtsang sbra byed mkhan/) chibs dpon gcig(chibs rtar g.yog bcos byed mkhan/) nang g.yog gnyis/(thab g.yog rgyugs mkhan sogs/)dang zhal ta ma gnyisarjobacas yod cing dkor pa ni grong pa bcu 110

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/grangs yod par/ dbang pa'am 'gel ba zhes byang la tshwa len par 'gro dus lug khal ma 'tsho ded byed mkhan dang / nas 'bru brje po rgyag mkhan grong dud gsum/ zhing kha 'debs mkhan grong pa gnyis/(gcig gsan sgang du sdod cing gcig yul dgon par sdod/) g.yag 'tsho mkhan grong pa gsum/ ma mo(ra dang mnyam du bsres nas yod/)'tsho mkhan grong pa gsum/ ba mdzo 'tsho mkhan grong pa gsum/ rong stod khul du cul sdong (kham bu'i sdong po/) lcang gling chung chung zhig yod par der chu gtong mkhan grong pa gnyis/ jog rtser grong dud lnga/(dpon po phyogs la 'gro dus rta g.yag btang ba'am g.yog rgyugs mkhan/)/ shinga'athu mkhan (lo rer shing 'khur g.yag rgyab bzhi bcu rgyag dgos)grong pa bdun bcas yod cing / kho tsho'i las 'gan gzhan dag ni rta 'tsho rogs dang / rtsam pa btags rogs/ rtsid pa 'khel rogs/ dgun rtswa bsdu rogs bcas byed dgos/ de min 'brug pa'i dgon pa su mo ru la rtswa thang sogs bed spyod gtong chog dbang gis de nas bogs ma mi nyung ba len rgyu yod do//de min pa phyi phyogs te tsho rub gsum dkyil pas chu mo rti dpon la 'bru khral khal gsum brgyar nye ba dang rta'i dwa ga (rta'i rmig mthil la rgyag yas rmig lcags/)sogs lo ltar chad med skyel dgos pa dang / rong stod nas 'bru so ba (nas rigs phyi lpags can/)dang 'bru dkar mo (phyi lpags bshus zin pa'i nas rigs spus legs can) yi khral lug rgyab nyi shu rtsa lnga trem rgyag dgos pa phud/da dung tog rtse ('jor ram sta re kha gnyis ma/) dang lcags khyem (sbyag ma) gyi yu shing cha tshang / g.yag sga che chung sna tshogs bcas bzos nas dus thog tu skyel dgos shing / tha na lug gi sgal bar 'byug yas sa dmar btsag dang tshwa lug 111

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la rgyag yas cha ru lnga brgya lhag tsam kyang lo ltar chad med skyel dgos so// de min bod sde pa gzhung nas ja dang tshwa yi sho khral sprod dus su chu rti dpon gyis snga khyu rta zam la g.yag bcu grangs gtong dgos la/ lcog rtse dang mdong mo sogs kyang sgrig sbyar legs par byed dgos/ stod sgar dpon rgya nyi ma'i tshong rwa dang dar chen sku bzhengs la yong dus kyang chu rti dpon gyis de'i rogs 'degs byed dgos shing dgun thog tu g.yag legs shos gnyis 'dems nas chad med gtong dgos pa bcas so/chu mo rti'i g.yag ni stod mnga' ris yongs la skad grags chen po yod/gang lags she na/ g.yag gi rog to (rmig pa/) ha cang mkhregs po yod de/yul de'i g.yag dus rgyun du shin tu mkhregs pa'i g.ya' gseb dang rdza gseb la 'tsho skyong byed kyin yod gshis/ g.yag tshang ma be'u nas bzung sbyong brdar yag po thebs yod par mngon no// des na stod mnga' rir gnas shing rgyu ba'i yul 'brog rong gsum gyi mi sde tshang mas chu mo rti'i g.yag 'byor thabs la brtson zhing yul de'i g.yag re zung lag son byung tshe phyi mir ngom yas dang nang gi nor bur 'dzin gyin yod do//lo gcig dus bzhi'i nang tshwa len rgyu'i las 'gan ni chu mo rti dpon gyi don dag gal 'gangs che shos shig yin/ kho tsho'i tshwa len khungs ni ru thog byang khul gyi mi 'grum tshwa kha rjodang dge rgyas khul gyi brag tshwa kha sogs yin/lo re'i dgun mjug tu lug gu 'khrid (skyes pa'i don/) zin rting ma mo tshang ma gzhis lug 'tsho mkhan gyis bdag skyong byed cing / khal pa ('bras bu bton zin pa'i lug pho/)yod do cog tshwa len mkhan gyis byang la ded 'gro bzhin yod/byang tshwa khar tshwa len par 'gro dus glang dmar brgyud dgos pas dgun kha zla ba 112

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/bzhi'i ring tshwa lug dag glang dmar yul la sa chu longs spyod byed cing / sos ka seng ge gtsang po dang sgar gtsang po'i gzhung du 'tsho skyong byed/ glang dmar nas thon te tshwa khar ma slebs bar du zla phyed tsam 'gor gyin yod/ tshwa len par 'gro mkhan ni gsol dpon gcig dang / 'gyed pa gsum/ lug 'tsho mkhan bzhi/ khyon bsdoms mi bdun tsam yod/ khong tshos lug mang dus stong dang nyung dus bdun brgya lhag tsam la khur bo 'gel ba dang g.yog bcos cha tshang byed dgos/ de'i nang nas tshwa rgyab gsum brgya drug cu tsam zhig stod ding ri'i dmag dpon la tshwa sho'o khral tshab tu phul dgos gshis/kho tshos 'dems sgrug gis dam phrug brgyab nas 'khyer 'gro gin yod pa phud/tshwa tshong brgyab rjes kyi khe bzang gzhan dag tshang ma chu rti dpon rang la za dbang yod/ de bzhin chu rti dpon gyis spus sgyur zhes ja dang spu phrug thig ma sogs tshong gin yod pas de'i thog nas khe bzang cung che ba yong ngo //tshwa pa mi bdun po dag byang la ma 'gro gong du chu rti dpon gyis rang khyim du 'gugs 'bod kyis mgron (gsol ston bshams pa/)rgyas po zhig gtong gin yod/ de tshe ra lug gi sha lhu mang po btsos nas bsgrigs pa dang / chang tshod lnga drug bsnyal nas longs spyod byed kyin yod/ khong tsho byang la thon rting zla re'i nang mi re la gla yon 'bru bre bco lnga dang mar rgya ma brgyad tsam yod/'on kyang mar ni byang thang 'brog pa'i sa nas khe po byas nas thob kyin yod gshis/ chu rti dpon gyi lag nas mar gyi tshab la rong ja dang bag phe (gro zhib/)blangs te byang thang 'brog rigs la mar dang brje po brgyab na khe bzang chen po yod/ tshwa pa tsho zla ba bzhi'i ring la ri klung mang po brgal nas gom pa rgyag dgos pas lham mang po'i mthil rdol gyi yod treng / chu rti dpon nas 113

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lham mthil brje yas g.yag gi gdong lpags 'ga' shas gnang zhing / lug gi ol thag (ske la 'dogs byed thag pa/)bzo yas ra spu yang do po kha shas sprod do// spyir btang byas na bu lo bco lnga lon tshe tshwa pa'i gral la tshud kyi yod cing /tshwa pa rgad po dang mnyam du thag ring byang thang la tshwa len par 'gro 'go 'dzugs so// tshwa pa dag tshur log yong dus kyang dpon pos gdong chang btsos nas skyid skyid gtong ngo //chu rti dpon la ra lug stong phrag mang po dang / g.yag brgya phrag rta ni mang dus lnga bcu drug bcu dang nyung dus nyi shu sum cu bcas byung myong yod kyang / dpon thog so so'i 'jon thang mi 'dra bas sems can gyi kha grangs kyang gcig mtshungs min/ dpon pos dud 'gro dag skye med 'chi med kyis dkor par bdag skyong byed du 'jug gal te phar snon byung na so sos rang 'gar bed spyod btang dbang yod cing / dud 'gro stes dbang gis shi skyon byung tshe pags pa dang rwa co mig ston rgyu yod na gu yangs gtong ba dang /gtor brlag sogs byung ba'am spyang ki sogs gcan gzan gyis bzas tshe gcig la gcig tshab dang gnyis la gnyis tshab sprod dgos/chu rti dpon thog rim byon gyi skabs su lo re'i lo gsar ha cang 'khrugs po gtong gin yod de/ lo gsar tshes gcig nyin zhogs par 'bangs mi ser gyis kha btags dkar gtsang re bsnams nas dpon la phul ba dang sbrags gzan gong rjosder ma gang re dang / lug sha rgyags pa rkang lag cha tshang ngam brang dang dal mo (rtsib ma'i tshigs rus ma phral bar mnyam sbyar dang rnga rus kyang cha tshang yod pa zhig) kha sbrar cha tshang bubs btsos brgyab nas dpon la mgron gtong gin yod/ nyin phyed tsam nas dpon pos kyang ra lug bco brgyad kyi 114

༄༅//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/sha khog bshig ste mi ser la mgron chen gtong la/ de dang mnyam du ro bcud ldan pa'i mar gzan dang nas chang btsos pa sprad nas dpon 'bangs thams cad dang mnyam du longs spyod byed do// lo re'i bod zla gsum pa'i tshes drug la dkor pa mi tshang re nas chang phud kang rtse gang re dang lug sha bzang logs sha lhu re khyer nas dpon gyi sar bcar te kha btags dang bcas 'tshams 'dri zhu'o// chu mo rti'i yul lha ni mes jo gsum zhes pa de yin cing / i phi g.yung stod kyang rten gyin yod/ de gnyis lo gsar skabs su gsol ba phud bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga ni mes jo gsum gsol ba'i dus ston che shos shig yin cing / bod zla bdun pa'i tshes bco lngar i phi g.yung stod gsol ba'i dus ston tshugs/ de dus zhim zas bcud ldan gyi phud phul ba spyi dang yang sgos bsang gsol rgyas po gtong la/ lha lug dkar po dang / btsan lug dmar po/ klu lug sngon mo sogs la yar rgyan brgyab ste tshe thar gtong gin yod/ chu rti dpon sdod sa'i mkhar gong ma'i stod tsam la mes jo gsum gyi pho brang tshar du dngar ba zhig yod/ de ni ma ṇi rdo brkos dang dud 'gro bsad pa'i rwa co sogs phung brgyab pa'i lab rtse chen po zhig dang de'i phyogs bzhi la dar thag ring po 'then nas rngam po zhe drag yod/chu mo rti dpon la nor bu sngon po'i tog zhig las gtsod tsho dpon dang za rang ru dpon nang bzhin rta la dom med pas khong gnyis las go bab cung dma' bar grags/ rta'i dom zhes shing la tshos brgyab pa zhig ste de ni thob thang chen po yod pa'i mtshon rtags yin/ de bzhin gtsod tsho dpon dang za rang ru dpon gnyis dbang thang chen po yin pa'i mtshon rtags gzhan zhig ni/115

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stod mnga' ris khul gyi lo re'i dus ston che shos te sgar 'char can skabs su g.yas gral dang po dang g.yon gral dang po la sdod dbang yod/chu mo rti pa'i mi ser dag kyang mnga' ris 'brog khul gzhan gyi mi ser dang 'dra bar/ dud 'gro'i sha tshil gyi za rigs sna tshogs longs su spyod rgyur ha cang dga' bo yod la/ da dung dmigs bsal can zhig yod par ‘‘kyus’ zhes 'bod/ de ni bag phe (grozhib/) dbyibs dog dog ril ril bzos pa dang dud 'gro'i sha tshil 'dres ma rdog por btub rjes su chu nyung tsam zhig blugs te/ me chung chung btang nas ga ler yun ring btsos pas na zhag can khu ba tshang ma bag ril la sim par byas rting ri sgog skam po brgyab ste ngang ring gis dkrugs dkrugs btang nas snod chas la ma sbyar ba byas te me mtshams bzhag ma khad/ lam seng tsha thog la bzas tshe lus gcong rigs kyi stobs rgyas par ma zad/ thun mong min pa'i ro bcud ldan no//chu mo rti'i dpon rabs rim byon mkhar gog rnying par sdod dus su khyon bsdoms dpon thog bcu gsum tsam byung bar grags/ mkhar gsar par gnas spos byas rjes su'ang dpon thog 'ga' byung yod/ dper na dpon bsod nams stobs rgyas dang / dpon a nu/ dpon shes rab/ dpon rgya mtsho bcas dang / dpon rgyud mtha' ma ni deng sang sa gnas srid gros la yod pa'i stobs rgyas lags yin cing / khong gi pha rgyud ni 'bong pa dpon rgyud yin pa dang ma rgyud ni gtsod tsho dpon gyi sras mo'o//lo rgyus thog chu mo rti'i dpon thog cig gi skabs su yul gyi mi ser dang kha 'doms nas ri dwags rgyag ste/ ri dwags mi nyung ba zhig gsod/thengs shig tshe rtsa rang rdzong dpon gyis mi btang nas zin rtsis bgyis skabs 116

༄7//mnga' ris sgar dpon skabs kyi dpon drug ya gyal chu mo rti dpon gyi skor/dpon rgyud bu spun gnyis bros pas rdzong dpon gyi mis me mda' brgyab nas gcig bsad/ mthar kha mchu thengs mang brgyab kyang shor rting chu mo rti'i mi ser sgar 'og la bdag cing / sgar 'char can skabs su sgar dpon la ṭang ka chig stong lhag tsam phul dgos byung yang bod sde pa gzhung gis gnang ba'i chu mo ti dpon gyi dbang thang mtshon pa'i dam kha'am thel rtse rang bdag dang sbrags dpon rgyud mu mthud skyong dbang byung ngo // lar na sde pa gzhung gis phul ba'i bka' gtan yang cha tshang yod la sa rgya che chung sogs shin tu gsal po 'khod yod pa bcas so/mchan/du sgo phyugs sogs rgyu nor phyug tsam dang dmigs bsal rta legs po yod mkhan dang rtsis yig shes mkhan zhig dgos shing / kho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni mi ser lag nas dngul khral bsdus te bka' blon gnyis la rtsis sprod byed dgos so//rjo khong gnyis mang tshogs kyi re ba gzhir bzung gis 'os tho ltar 'dems shing /las ka rkang ni gser dpon dang gzhung tshong tshwa sho zhes par khral sna tshogs brgyab dgos la/ spyir lo gsum re'i thog brje po rgyag go/dhi de gnyis nang nas gcig 'brog khrod 'grims nas 'bri 'jo ba dang / 'o ma dkrogs pa sogs dkar las thams cad sgrub kyin yod/ gzhan pa des yul gzhis la bsdad de yos rtsam rngos 'thag rgyag cing / chang las sogs nang las dag byed kyin yod/rjo tshwa kha der yul gyi 'go pas tshwa tshong tshang ma'i lag 'khyer la lta rtogs nan tan byed cing / lug brgya re nas lug gcig khral du sdud/ de rting tshong lug tshang ma rtswa gang za dang chu gang 'thung byed chog kyang / zhor la bul nya ga lnga spus sgyur gtong gin 117

༄7/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pas de yang ma blangs na mi 'grigadhilug sha btsos pa'i khu ba tsha bor rtsam pa brgyab te spags gong bzos nas sder ma'i nang la 'jog cing / de'i dbus kong kong bzos pa'i nang la mar khu tsha rkyang dang bu ram blugs pa'i zhim zas shig te/ de za dus thur mas spags gong phyi nas skog ste mar khur sbang tsam byas nas za gin yod do//118

༄/ / glang bcu'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/gcigabadag gi pha yul glang bcu ni mnga' ris sa khul sgar rdzong gtsod tsho shang gi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'brog khul kha gtsang gi yul lung zhig yin/ de nyid da lta'i mnga' ris sa khul gyi lte ba'i grong brdal seng ge kha 'bab ste sgar rdzong gnas yul nas shar ngos su spyi le bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi gnas su chags yod/ sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lte gnas sgar yid 'ong ngam sgar dgun sa nas byang ngos spyi le sum bcu lhag tsam mchis lags/spyi lo 1992lor bod ljongs rig gnas do dam lhan tshogs kyi zhib 'jug tshogs pas mnga' ris sa khul gyi rdzong khag bdun la khyon yongs nas rtog zhib zab nan byas pa'i 'bras bu ltar na/ mi lo khri brgya'am nyis brgya tsam gyi gong du yul 'dir 'gro ba mi'i ches stabs bde'i thon skyed dang ngal rtsol byed myong yod pa ni/ kho tshos ru thog dang dge rgyas sogs nas rnyed pa'i rdo chas spyod pa'i dus rabs rnying ma'am gsar ma'i skabs lag bzo byas pa'i rdo chas du ma rnyed par gzhigs na/ rdo leb dang rdo rdog rtse rno ba'i / ༵sa

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dag gis rdo chas rnying ma'i dus rabs su bzos pa ra sprod byed thub/ ru thog shar mda' mtsho byang shar nas thon pa'i rdo chas te rdo leb dang gcod chas rdo/ lpags rigs sogs bshu chas rdo'i sta gri lta bu dang rtse rno ba i khung brtol yas rdo'i snyung bu bcas yod/ de tsho yod sa nas glang bcu'i bar spyi le brgya lhag tsam las med/de min sgar rdzong ting grum rtser rdza khog chag hrug sum cu tsam thon pa'i nang / khag cig bye mas bzos pa dang khag cig 'dam 'bag gis bzos 'dug rdza khog gi ngos su ri mo yang mi nyung ba zhig bris yod/ des mnga' ris khul gyi gna' mis thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rig du ma bskrun yod pa mtshon gyi yod/ khul de nas glang bcu bar spyi le lnga bcu tsam las med/mnga' ris sa khul ru thog rdzong rog gsum sa gnas kyi ri mo dong / lho phyogs o byang khul gyi mtha' khams pa dang / stabs chen/ rdo dmar khul bcas la lha 'dre ri mo zhes brag dang pha bong gi ngos su ri mo sna tshogs mthong rgyu yod pa de'i nang shwa ba dang rta g.yag ra lug khyi spyang ki gzig sogs srog chags rigs yod par ma zad/ ri dwags rngon pa dang / ra lug 'tsho ba/zhabs bro rgyag pa/ mi rnams zog la chibs pa sogs spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i rigs dang / de min nyi zla ri chu skye dngos mang po'ang yod pa/ de tshos mnga' ris kyi gna' mi tshos rig gnas dang lo rgyus gsar bskrun byas myong ba mtshon gyi yod pa dang / de dag gi rten gzhi ru thog nas glang bcu bar la spyi le brgya lhag tsam yod/ mnga' ris ni zhang zhung shes rig gi 'byung khungs gtso bo yin/ mnga' ris yul skad du zha yi sgra med pas/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du ya yis 'thus tshab byed kyi yod par brten zhang zhung la yang yung 120

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/zhes 'bod/ de yang rgya skad kyi yang thung zhes pa'ang de nas zur chag pa min nam snyam/ zhang zhung rgyal po rim byung gis dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus rabs kha gsal ba dang dbang sgyur bya thabs/ spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi sogs dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dkon pas zhib phra rtogs thabs bral mod/ 'on kyang spyirasbyi lo'i dus rabs dang po nas drug pa'i bar stobs shugs rtse mor son yod par 'dod/ lo rgyus dpe rnying khungs ldan 'ga' shas su zhang zhung ni bon po'i 'byung gnas su grags shing / zhang zhung nyid sgo phug bar gsum du dbye ba las phug bar gnyis la bshad pa rgya che la 'grel ba yang mang bas phyogs gzhan du gsal/ zhang zhung sgo pa la'ang sgo phug bar gsum du dbye bar/ phug pa ni gangs ri dang g.ya' ri mtsho sogs kyis skor ba'i zhang zhung gu ge'i yul yin par brjod/ bar pa ni byang thang yul gyi gnas ri grags can rta sgo khra ring dang dwangs rwa g.yu mtsho'i rgyud nag tshang dang sga cha/ phyogs bcu sogs yin/ sgo pa ni khyung po steng chen khul gyi gyim shod ri bo rtse drugadzisogs yin/zhang zhung gi mkhar rdzong grags che shos ni khyung lung dngul mkhar dang gu ge rtsa rang mkhar yin/ de min da dung spu rang stag lha mkhar dang / ma spang spos mo mkhar/ sme shang byi ba mkhar/ kha yug mda' mkhar/ byang gi rā bzhi mkhar/ gad kyi byi ba mkhar sogs dang / dwangs rwa khyung rdzong dang se rib 'brug mo rdzong / ru thog seng ge rdzong / mang yul stag mo rdzong / sbal ti hrang rdzong sogs mkhar rdzong khag du ma dang / yul che ba bco brgyad/yul khams drug cu/ sde brgyad cu/ rgyal po grags can bya ru thog pa brgya dang brgyad bcas yod/ zhang zhung gi lte gnas gu ge rtsa rang mkhar nas glang 121

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcu dbar la spyi le nyis brgya lhag tsam yod/dus rabs bdun pa'i nang bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bod yongs su dbang sgyur byed skabs/ zhang zhung lam seng dbang 'og tu bsdu ma thub pas mthar gnyen 'brel gyi 'brel ba btsugs te zhang zhung rgyal po li mi skya'i sras mo li thig sman srong btsan gyi btsun mor bzhes par brten gnyen 'brel thabs lam gyis mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa red/ de nas bod sil bur ma thor bar du btsan po rim byung gis zhang zhung la dbang sgyur byas yod kyang zhang zhung rgyal rgyud kyi rgyun srol goms gshis dang srid kyi sgrig gzhi sogs la de tsam gyi 'gyur ldog chen po gtong thub med/spyi lo'i dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil tsam du/ bod btsan po nang khul gyi srid 'dzin pa phan tshun dbar srid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod rno ngar je cher phyin pa spyi dang yang sgos bon chos dang ban chos kyi phyogs gtogs mtho rim srid 'dzin dbar gyi 'gal zla dza drag tu song nas/ mthar spyi lo 842lor btsan po'i rgyal rgyud mtha' ma glang dar 'das bkrongs su phyin pa'i rkyen gyis/ mi lo nyis brgya lhag tsam gyi ring la snyan grags kyi ba dan gnam du bskyod pa'i bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs rtsa thor du song ba dang / glang dar gyi rgyud 'dzin du grags pa'i yum brtan dang 'od srung gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i phyogs gtogs sku drag rnams shog khag gnyis su gyes te/ phan tshun bar drag po'i dmag 'khrug tshabs chen langs nas 'bangs mi rnams la brdab gsig chen po bzos pa'i dbang gis/ spyi lo 869lor 'bangs gyen log shugs chen langs pa des stobs shugs mnga' thang ldan pa'i btsan po'i rgyal rabs de khyon yongs nas sil bur gtor ba red/122

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/'od srung yum bu bla sgang du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo so dgur pho brang 'phang thang du sku 'das/ de'i sras dpal 'khor btsan yab dgung lo bcu dgur 'khrungs shing sman lung la sogs pa'i lha khang brgyad bzhengs/ dgung lo so gcig par sku 'das/ skabs der dbus su yum brtan gyi stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i dbang gis de'i btsun mo chen ma'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon der gnas thabs bral nas stod zhang zhung lte ba'i yul la bros byol du phyin dgos byung / blon po zhang pa tshab rin chen sde dang cog ro legs sgra lha legs gnyis kyi bye ma g.yung drung bar du bskyal/ dpon blon kha gyes mtshams su pa tshab kyis spyang thul gyi na bza' dang cog ros dre'u gcig phul bas phan tshun bral mi phod pa'i gdung bas mnar zhing skyid ldes rang nyid stod zhang zhung gi yul du 'byor rjes rgyal srid 'dra zin srid na blon po gnyis nas bu mo re brdzang ba'i re ba dang bcas stod phyogs su byon/ lam bar du dka' ngal sna tshogs myangs te nya sgong sogs za dgos byung yod/skyid lde nyi ma mgon sogs thog mar zhang zhung gyam smyag yul seng ge gtsang po'i byang ngos kyi nye 'gram ra lar phebs/ de na gnas sdod byas rjes der ra la mkhar dmar zhes mkhar chen zhig bzhengs/ 'on kyang yul de ni sa 'bab mtho zhing grang ngar shin tu che ba/ brlan gsher nyung ba'i dbang gis khong tsho 'u thug nas dge bshes bkra shis btsan sogs yul phyogs gzhan du sa babs legs tsam dang dbus gtsang phyogs su 'brel lam stabs bde'i yul zhig batrel bar mngags/ kho tshos phyogs gang sar phyin nas mthar zhang zhung mkhar chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal spu rang stag lha mkhar dang thag mi ring ba'i rma bya kha 'bab gtsang po'i byang ngos su dkar dung zhes yul lung rtswa 123

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sna chu sna 'dzoms pa/ sa babs dma' zhing dbus gtsang dang 'grul bzhud bde ba der gtan 'khel nas/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon sogs kyang myur du yul der gnas spo byas/yul de'i glang chen ri zhes pa'i steng du stod mnga' ris lo rgyus thog don snying ldan la snyan grags shin tu che ba'i sku mkhar nyi bzung zhes pa de brtsigs/da lta'ang glang chen ri bo'i sgang na mkhar shul rnying pa yod par ma zad/ brgya grong gnas pa'i shul sogs kyis yul de skabs shig shin tu gra rgyas byung bar mtshon/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon ni bkrus na ma dag pa'i bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud yin la spyod pa bzang zhing shes rab dang nus pa ldan pas/ yul de'i 'bangs mi ser tshos gus bkur chen po byed par ma zad mthar yul de'i rgyal por gyur te/ sngar zhang zhung rgyal pos dbang sgyur byas myong ba'i yul lung yod do cog la mnga' dbang mdzad/ dus de tsam nas 'go brtsams te yul de bod btsan po'i rgyal rgyud kyis thad kar mnga' mdzad nas yul der yang mnga' ris zhes pa'i tha snyad de thog mar byung / de nas bzung sngar zhang zhung zhes grags pa je cher khyab pa'i yul lung der mnga' ris zhes pa'i ming gi 'thus tshab byas pa dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon ni mnga' ris yongs su dbang sgyur mdzad mkhan gyi bod btsan po'i rgyal rgyud thog ma de yin/skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis bod dbus phyogs su 'brel ba byas te cog ro bza' btsun mor bzhes rjes sras gsum byung bar che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon/ bar ba bkra shis mgon/ chung ba lde btsun mgon bcas yin/bu gsum po cher longs pa dang / khong nyid bgres por gyur zin nas chab srid skyong ma thub tsa na/ khong gis bod btsan po'i rgyal rgyud rtsa thor song ba'i 124

༄༅//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/rgyu rkyen gyi bslab bya dang len byas te/ mnga' ris rgyal pos mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i yul gru de yul khag gsum la bgos te bu re la yul khag re sprad/sras rgan par lho nas mar yul/ spang khu nag btsan/ shar nas ru thogase mkhar sgo/ bde mchog dkar po/ re ba dmar po/ mi skye ba phun dmag sde/ mdo phug bar chen sogs dang / byang se mkhar mgon po/nub kha rtse rgyal bcas dang / sras 'bring ba bkra shis mgon la gu ge/ spu rang / ya rtse bcas/ sras chung bar zangs dkar sgo gsum/ spi ti/spi cog bcas te/ de ni mnga' ris lo rgyus thog thengs dang por mnga' ris skor gsum zhes nus ldan gyi dbang sgyur khyab khongs kyi yul 'khor khag gsum yin pa dang / bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus thog stod mnga' ris skor gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad de'ang dus de nas dar bar mngon/rjes su lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim nang sras rgan pa dpal lde rig pa mgon dang de'i rgyud pa tshos mar yul la dwags kyi sa gnas su stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rgyal rabs shig btsugs pa dang de'i rgyal sa ni sle yin la rgyal rgyud des skabs shig la khu nu dang nyung ti/ gru sha bcas tshud pa'i mnga' ris skor gsum gyi sa khyon yongs la dbang sgyur byed myong yod/sras chung ba lde btsun mgon gyis dbang shugs ldan pa'i rgyal phran zhig btsugs thub med/ de'i mnga' khongs spi ti spi chog sogs gu ge rgyal po'i dbang 'og tu bcug pa dang sgar zha sogs la dwags rgyal rabs kyi mnga' 'og tu shor te zangs dkar rgyal rabs zhes rgyal phran chung chung zhig las ma lhag par mngon/sras 'bring ba bkra shis mgon gyi rgyud pas bod kyi lo rgyus thog stobs 125

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang mnga' thang snyan grags je cher khyab pa'i gu ge rgyal rabs btsugs shing spu rang gi rgyal rgyud dang ya rtse'i rgyal rgyud yang des dbang sgyur byas/ gu ge rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa ni zhang zhung rgyal khag gi rgyal sa'am zhang zhung mkhar chen bco brgyad kyi lte gnas gu ge rtsa rang mkhar de yin/ yab skyid lde nyi ma mgon sku mkhar nyi bzungs su 'das rjes/ khri bkra shis mgon gyis spu rang sogs su mu mthud dbang sgyur byas/ des rjes su 'bro bza' 'khor skyong btsun mor bzhes te/ sras gnyis byung ba ni 'khor re dang srong nge'am 'khor lo lde dang drang srong lde yin/ sras chung ba srong nge cher longs rjes/ yab kyis sa 'bab legs shing dmag don dang dpal mnga' thang sogs phyogs gang thad kyi 'phel rgyas la dgongs nas/ gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du mngags gtong byas/ gang lags she na yul der zhang zhung rgyal rabs skabs kyi rmang gzhi legs po yod pa spyi dang yang sgos gnam gshis dang 'grim 'grul thon khungs sogs kyi cha rkyen ha cang legs po dang phun sum tshogs po yod/srong nge'am drang srong lde gu ge rtsa rang mkhar la slebs ma thag yab chen gyi bka' bzhin rang 'khri'i srid don legs po bskyangs te stobs 'byor dang mnga' thang je cher 'phel na'ang / sku tshe'i smad la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan pa yul der dar ba dang yab mes rnams kyi thugs 'dun sgrub slad 'bad 'bungs mod mi dma' ba bskyed nas/ rang lo sum cu ste bod me spre lo'am spyi lo 996lor bod kyi lo rgyus thog snyan grags shin tu che ba'i mtho lding dgon pa bzhengs pa dang / mthar dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis bod me 'brug lo'am spyi lo 1016lor sras na ga rwa dza dang dhi wa rā dza gnyis bcas 126

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/yab sras gsum kas rtags rang gis blangs te dkon mchog gi rten drung du skra phud phul nas/ rab tu byung ba dang mtshan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces btags pa red/ dus mtshungs khong gis lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po sogs khyi'u blo rno ba nyi shu rgya gar du nang chos bslabs par mngags shing / bstan pa phyi dar dus su 'dul ba stod rgyud legs par dar bar mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pa red/srong nges srid kyi bya ba bskyur rjes chos phyogs kyi las la zhugs pas gu ger srid skyong mkhan mtshams chad/ rjes su bkra shis lde'i sras rgan pa 'khor re'am 'khor lo lde'i sras lha lde/ de'i sras 'od lde/ de'i sras rtse lde spu rang nas gu ge rtsa rang mkhar la srid skyong par slebs/ khong ni srid skyong ba'i nus mthu rtser son zhing / 'bangs mi ser la byams skyong che ba zhig yin pas/ yun ring ma phyin par gu ge rtsa rang mkhar de rang nyid kyi chab srid dang rig gnas/ 'grim 'grul bcas kyi lte gnas su bsgyur/ de'i rgyal rgyud bco lnga pa bla chen grags pa lde dang bcu drug pa mnga' bdag khri rnam rgyal lde'i skabs spu rang dang ya rtse/ 'dzum lang / slo mi/ glo bcas kyang de'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags che ba'i rgyal rabs shig btsugs te snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur khyab yod/gu ge'i rgyal rgyud des rang khul du mi lo bdun brgya tsam dbang sgyur byas pa'i rjes su/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs sum cu tsam la/la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyis phyogs gcig nas gzhan rgyu la brngams pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas gu ge rgyal rgyud nyams rgud du 'gyur ba dang stabs bstun nas gu ger dmag shugs 'bor chen drangs te dbang 'og tu 127

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsdus/ gu ge rgyal po jo bdag po'am bkra shis grags pa gnas dbyungs btang nas mnga' ris yongs la mi lo lnga bcu tsam dbang sgyur byas/ dus rabs de'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa mgo btsugs ma thag la dwags rgyal po'i ham sems je cher phyin nas mthar 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi phyogs su langs khul gyis bod dbus gtsang phyogs la btsan 'dzul gyi 'dre lag thog mar brkyangs nas sa dga' dang shel dkar/ ngam ring khul sogs rim gyis btsan bzung byas/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi skabs rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang sog po da yan san rnam gnyis kyis sog po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis gtsos dmag dpung phon chen mngags gtong gis/ la dwags kyi dbang shugs yod do cog sngar gu ge'i rgyal po rim byung gi dbang sgyur bya yul nas mtha' gcig tu phyir spyugs byas te/ ru thog dang gu ge/ spu rang sogs mnga' ris khul de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi thad ka'i dbang 'og tu bcug dus de nas bzung stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lte gnas ni sgar dgun sa dang dbyar sar chags/ der sgar dpon dbu gur gyi srid dbang btsugs nas/ stod mnga' ris sgar dpon sbrel po rim byung gis la dwags phud mnga' ris yongs la mi lo nyis brgya brgyad cu ring dbang sgyur byas/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byas rjes/ spyi lo 1959lor bod rang skyong ljongs mnga' ris sa khul gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung dngos su dbu brnyes shing lo rgyus gsar pa zhig 'go brtsams pa red/sngar sgar dpon sbrel pos stod mnga' ris la dbang sgyur byed skabs glang bcu ni thog ma gtsod tsho dpon gyi khongs su gtogs/ bar skabs shig 128

༄༅//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/la rtswa thang sogs kyi dka' rnyog gis 'brong pa dpon 'og tu mi lo lnga bcu tsam tshud/ de la 'go ba gcig dang bcu dpon 'ga' shas yod pa de tshos tsho pa lnga dang dud tshang lnga bcu lhag tsam bkod 'doms dang khral bsdu byed kyi yod/yul de 'brog khul kher rkyang gi yul lung khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin gshis/der 'tsho sdod byed pa'i 'brog pa tshos bdag skyong byed yas sgo phyugs ni g.yag dang ra lug rta bcas yin/ 'brog khyim tshang mar med du mi rung ba'i sgo khyi nyung na re gnyis dang mang bar gsum bzhi tsam yod/ 'brog pa tshos khyi dang rta la bcangs pa'i brtse sems shin tu zab mo yod/ kha rgyun du'ang mi rta khyi gsum mno bsam gcig ces brjod/ gang lags she na rta dang khyi gnyis dud 'gro gzhan dang bsdur na mi sems de bas go shes che ba dang mi nang bzhin gyi dga' skyo brtse dung sogs kyi tshor snang ldan pas so// glang bcu'i 'brog pa tshos sgo phyugs cher long rim bzhin ming mi 'dra bar 'dogs kyi yod pa der dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan yod pa ni dper na g.yag la spo ba dang pho g.yag 'bri mo/ be'u/ lo gsum/ g.ya'u/ lug la ru bo dang / khal ba/ ma mo/ thong pa/ lag po/ lu gu/ ra la pha ra dang ra pho/ ra thong / rtsid bu/ ri'u/ rta la dang pho chen/ rgod ma/ co ba/ co ma/ thu ru/ rti'u bcas kha gsal por dbye srol 'dugade tsho rang gshis mi 'dra ba dwang sa babs mtho dma' mkhregs gshin sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis 'tsho skyong byed sa'ang gnas yul la gzhigs te dbye 'byed byed kyi yod/ glang bcu'i 'brog pa tsho pho mo'i dbar gnyen 'brel byed skabs rus rgyud ded nas mi rabs bdun tsam gyi dbye khyad med na phan tshun bar gnyen sgrig rtsa ba nas byed michog mag pa dang mna' ma phar 129

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshur len res byed skabs dbye ba med/ de yang zog ya zhes dmigs bsal zhig kyang yod/ khyim gyi rgyu nor sogs spyir pha brgyud bus 'dzin byed pa las bu mos 'dzin srol med/gnyis/'dir brjod par bya ba'i glang ni bcu'i yul lha mes lha btsan glang bcu gling mtsho mo yod sa dbyar sa'i sdod gnas dang dgun sa'i sdod gnas glang lung 'bub ces dbyar dgun gnyis kyi sdod gnas la phar tshur 'gro sa'i lam gyi 'gag sgo lta bu'i la kha ste lha btsan la mgor gnas yod/ de nyid sa babs kyi ngos nas brjod tshe dbyar sa dang dgun sa'i dbye mtshams dang /dus kyi ngos nas brjod tshe dbyar dus dang dgun dus kyi dbye mtshams su chags yod pas/ de ni yul lha de nyid la mgo der gnas pa las g.yas g.yon gyi ri mgo sogs la chags med pa'i rgyu mtshan yin skad/glang bcu gling mtsho de yang glang bcu'i yul mi tshos rtsa chen zhig yin zhes brjod/ bshad srol la sngar rgan mo zhig mtsho 'gram du lug 'tsho zhing thag lham bzo gin bsdad pa'i tshe/ glo bur du mtsho'i nang nas mtsho lug sngon mo mang po phyir thon yong ste/ rgan mo'i lug dang mnyam 'dres kyis rtswa za bar mthong / rgan mo ya mtshan skyes nas hob langs brgyab pas mtsho lug tshang ma rtab rtab tu de ma nyid mtsho nang du mchongs/ rgan mo ci bya gtol bral gyis lham ya gcig dbyugs pas/ lug gcig la grib phog nas rang sar lus pas rgan mos zin thub/ de'i dbang gis rgan mo de'i drin las glang bcu'i 130

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/yul la phyugs zog mang shos dang rgyu nor phyug shos chags par grags/de min yang mtsho'i nang du mtsho rta dang mtsho glang sogs sems can du ma yod par brjod/ yul der glang bcu zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang mtsho'i nang nas glang po che bcu skam sar thon yong nas lha btsan la brgyab nas glang lung 'bub la thim pas yul der ming de ltar thogs/ glang bcu'i 'brog pa tshos dgun sa glang lung 'bub nas dbyar sa glang bcu gling la gnas spo byed skabs/la mtshams de nas dbyar gnas la sdod ring nad na tsha dang bgegs bar chad mi yong ba'am bya ba lam 'gro dang phyugs rigs skya rgyas yong ba/ rang byung gi gnod 'tshe las thar ba bcas kyi ched du smon lam 'debs pa dang / yang dbyar gnas nas dgun gnas la yong dus gong ltar 'char can gyi cho ga de dag chad med gnang gi yod/'brog pa tshos la der lab rtse mtshar du dngar ba zhig bzhengs yod pa ni/gdan khri chen po sgor mo'i dbyibs can zhig gi dbus na srog shing btsugs/srog shing de'i mtho tshad kyi gsum cha gnyis tsam nas phyogs bzhir dar thag 'then te dar tshon sna lnga bsgrogs yod/ de snga srog shing dang dar thag sgrog mtshams der mi bsad myong ba'am lam bkag nas mi phyugs la ngan bskyel mkhan 'brong g.yag chen nam bdud 'brong bzhi yi mgo bkal yod/ yul mi rnams kyi brjod srol la de dag ni mes lha btsan gyi srung ma yin la phyogs bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad 'gog thub ces brjod/ gdan khri'i sgang na sgo phyugs g.yag dang ra lug ri dwags 'brong dang gnyan gna' ba dgo ba gtsod bcas kyi rwa co sna tshogs dang / tshon sna tshogs btang ba'i ma ṇi rdo brkos bcas las grub pa'i 'bum chen bzhengs yod/ de'i nang na gser 131

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dngul dang zangs lcags g.yu byur mu tig sogs nor bu'i rigs 'dra min sna tshogs grangs las gzhal bar dka' ba dang bod dang rgya gar bal bo'i tram dkar yang phon chen phul nas yod la/ tha na lus kyi gos gzan sna tshogs dang zas rigs/ phor pa/ dbu skra sogs kyang phul yod/ da dung mda' mdung sogs drag po'i mtshon cha yang mang po 'dug de ni rngams brjid ldan zhing lta bas chog mi shes pa'i yul mes lha btsan yin/der 'brog pa yul mi tshos bde sdug re bcol zhu sa'i lhar ngos 'dzin nas dad pa chen po dang mchod pa'i cho ga'ang rgya chen po byed kyi yod/ bod zla dang po dang bzhi pa drug pa bcu pa bcas kyi tshes lnga dang bcu bco lnga la cho ga dang mchod 'bul rgyas shing phun sum tshogs shos yin/mes lha batren la lha gsol gtong ba'i nyin dang po'i thog mar ser khyim pas rnam dag chos sku zhal 'don gnang bzhin sku bsang gtong gi yod/de'i rgyu cha ni ba lu dang shug pa 'khan pa bcas yin/ de nas btsan gsol zhes khyim dud so so'i mar phud dang phyur phud 'o phud rtsam phud ka ra dang bu ram gyi phud sogs mnyam du bsdu rub byas rjes spags g.yos nas rdzis legs po thebs par byas nas gtor tshogs te skyo mdzub dang mthe bong dkyil mdzub gsum gyis shugs 'bring tsam brgyab ste/ zur gsum dbyibs can bdun bzos/ de dag la smug rtsi btang ba ni khrag gi dmar mchod mtshon pa dang khrag sogs dmar gra rgyas po yong ba'i 'dun pa mtshon/ yang der dkar rgyan brgyab pa ni 'o zho phyur sogs skya rgyas po yong ba'i smon 'dun mtshon/ de dag spags kyis bzos pa'i mchod kong zur gsum nang blugs nas spags leb mo sder rtse 'dra ba'i sgang la bzhag rjes/ spags gtor che chung sna tshogs 132

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/kyi mtha' skor rjes mes lha btsan la zhal phyogs nas mchod sbyin du ma mdzad/dbus kyi mchod gtor che shos de mes lha btsan yin zhes pa de'i ring tshad ni dkyil mdzub nas mkhrig ma tsam yod pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon la chu phud bkang ba'i mchod kong gnyis/ 'bru phud bkang ba'i mchod bkong gnyis/dbus su me tog spos bsang mar me/ zhal zas phye mar bcas yin/dus mtshungs mchod dpon ser khyim pa des rnga dang ḍa ma ru/ rkang gling / sbub chal/ rdor dril bcas sgrogs pa dang bsang khug nang gi sman bsang yod dgu sbyang nas du zhag gis gang sar khyab/ de tshe khyim dud kyi pha tshang ma rang khyim gyis dar lcog dang zas rigs kyi phud/ bsang sogs khyer nas kha 'don dang sbrags mchod khang la skor ba gsum brgyab rjes/ mes lha btsan la zhal phyogs nas mchod sbyin rgyas po gnang gi yod/ lha gsol gtong ring la ser khyim pas rtsa gsum dang bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ rnam dag chos sku/ klu 'bum dkar nag khra bo bcas 'don gyi yod/mdor na yul lha mes lha btsan gsol ba'i go don gtso bo ni/ glang bcu'i 'brog pa tsho gnas sdod chags sa'i yul dang de dang gtan du 'tsho zhing rgyu ba'i sems can thams cad la srung skyob byed re/ sa bcud yul bcud ma nyams pa/ bkra shis don 'grub pa/ bgegs bar chad dang nad na tsha med pa/ dus nam yang bya ba lam 'gro yong ba'i 'dun pa gtsang rkyang lags/de yang bod zla drug pa'i nang yul lha gsol skabs/ gong du brjod zin pa'i 'brel yod cho ga sna tshogs phud da dung yul mi thams cad mnyam 'dzoms kyis dga' skyid longs su spyod kyi yod pa ni rta rgyugs 'gran bsdur 133

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang rta rtsal 'gran pa/ mda' 'phen pa/ ab dang rtse ba/ mi rgyugs thag ring thung mi 'dra ba 'gran pa/ rdo sgo mo zhes rtsed 'jo dmigs bsal can bcas lus rtsal gyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel ba dang gzhas zhabs bro khrab pa/glu shags 'gran pa/ pho mo'i rtse glu 'gran pa sogs kyang byed kyi yod/ dus mtshungs phan tshun mnyam du 'dzoms nas mnyam za mnyam 'thung dang dga' skyid la rol ba/ dper na phan tshun mgron gtong res byed pa'am sha rkang lag cha tshang dang brang mgo cha tshang / dal mo zhes rtsib log cha tshang sogs btsos nas gtong ba/ yang bag leb chen po brgyab pa dang de gnyis re kha sbyor btang ba'i dbar la mar khu dang rtsam pa tog tsam bsres pas ro bcud dmigs bsal ldan la de min 'bras gzan mar khu dang mi rgan am chog bcas glang bcu'i 'brog pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i zhal zas phul gyi yod/ da dung yun ring 'tsho ba'i nyams myong la brten nas byung ba'i ra lug gi rgyu ma rgyang lugs mi gcig pa'i zas rigs bcud ldan der glang bcu'i 'brog pa tshos ha cang mnyes po gnang gi yod/ de bgo bsha' rgyag dus mi tshang so so'i yab chen gyis khyim dud mi 'dra ba'i mi tshang la gzhigs te/ sna re byas nas btubs zin rjes sder rtse'i nang blugs nas/ mi lo bgres rim bzhin g.yas nas g.yon phyogs su skor nas so so'i skal ba len du bcug pa/ de bzhin lug rdzi sogs gral la ma slebs pa tsho la'ang skal ba ma chad par 'jog gi yod pa ni dga' skyid mnyam myong gi lugs srol legs po zhig yin/yul lha mes lha btsan dang yul gyi chab srid dbar la'ang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ dper na yul gyi 'go pa sogs 'dems bsko byed dus/ nges par du yul lha la bka' 'dri zhu dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gal srid yul lha 134

༄༅//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/mnyes po ma byung na yul du chu rud rdol ba'am gangs skyon tshabs chen nam than pa/ nad yams rigs sogs bar chad du ma byung srid par 'dod/ gal srid de ltar byung tshe yul gyi 'go pa de lam seng gnas dbyungs gtong gi yod la 'go pa gsar pa zhig de ma nyid du bsko bzhag byed dgos/ de tshe khos nges par du yul lha de legs po byas nas gsol dgos/yul gyi 'go pa ni sa gnas de rang gi mi yin/ de gsar rnying brje po rgyag dus yul lha nges par du gsol dgos pa ni med du mi rung ba'i 'os 'gan zhig kyang yin/ de min 'go pa khag cig bsko dus yul lha'i gam la bcar nas gzan ril bsgril te dbyugs nas thag gcod byas pa'ang 'dugamador na yul gyi dbu 'dzin nam 'go pa bsko bzhag byed mkhan dngos de yul lha de rang yin/yul la rtsod rnyog shugs chen byung tshe yang yul lhas thag gcod byed kyi yod/ dper na rtswa thang sogs kyi thog la rtsod rnyog rno ngar can byung nas phan tshun bar thag ye nas gcod ma thub tshe yul lha'i mdun la bcar nas bskang gso btang ba dang sbrags mna' sho zhes cho lo dbyugs nas mig grangs che chung la brten nas bden rdzun rgyal pham thag gcod byed srol 'dug pas yul lha des yul gyi khrims dpon gyi nus pa'ang thon gyi yod/bshad srol ltar na/ sngar spyi khyab yul gyi dbang phyug dang mi skyon can sbi ri don grub ces pa kho gnyis dbar rtsod rnyog chen po byung ste/ yul dpon rim pa che chung mang por gtugs kyang thag gcod rtsa ba nyid nas byed ma thub/mthar yul lha'i gam du bcar nas cho lo dbyugs skabs/ mi skyon can sbi ri don grub la tog ge zhes grangs mig bcu gcig thon pa dang / spyi khyab yul 135

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi dbang phyug la ca mo zhes grangs mig bcu gnyis thon/ de'i tshe mi skyon can sbi ri don grub ngo tsha kha skyengs dang ham sems che bas ca mo de skad cig nyid la khyur mid btang yang yun ring ma 'das par kho la rkyen ngan du ma byung nas shi lugs shin tu ngan pas 'das/ de nas bzung yul mi thams cad yul lha der ma skrag pa gcig kyang med ces brjod/gna' bo'i glang bcu'i yul mi tshos yul lha mes lha btsan ni yul srung gi dmag dpon chen po zhig gi nus pa'ang thon gyi yod par ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug yul la dgra sogs kyis rkyen ngan byung tshe dmag mi mi dgos par yul lha de nyid kyis srung skyob byed kyi yod ces brjod/ dper na dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang / ha sag mi mang po zhig stod mnga' ris yul la slebs rjes mi bsad rta khyer nor phyugs 'phrog bcom byas pa sogs bya ngan sna tshogs spel nas/ mnga' ris mi 'bangs la brjod kyis mi lang ba'i brdab gsig dang sdug bsngal tshad med bzos yod/ 'on kyang rgan rabs rnams kyi brjod srol la glang bcur nyams rgud dang sdug bsngal lta ci/ de las ldog te/ de dus ha sag glang bcu gling mtsho rgyud lha btsan la mgo ga la ba der thad kar bcar nas yong dus/ la rtser ma slebs tsam la glo bur du mes lha btsan gyi lcog chen yod sa de nas mi dmar rta dmar la chibs pa mdung dmar khyer ba phon chen thon yong nas/ ha sag gi rta dmag la 'dzing ba dang pha bong chen por me phung 'bar gin 'bab rdor 'gril bas ha sag gi mi rta mang po brdzis nas de gar bsad/ mthar ha sag zhed thag chod nas phyi mig kyang lta dbang med par bros nas shul la rta'i da ga dang yob rdo la brdar ba'i ri mo sna tshogs mthong rgyu 'dug pa dang / kho tshos da dung pham 136

༄7//glang bcu'i lo rgyus dang de'i yul lha mes lha btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/nad ma thegs par phyogs gzhan nas yong rtsis byas kyang / yang na brag dang chu 'byar nas ma thar ba'am grog rong phan tshun kha 'byar nas ma thar bas mdor na skabs de dus yul lha srung dmag gis go rbad de chod nas glang bcur ha sag gi gnod ye nas bskyal thub med ces brjod/ des na glang bcu'i mi 'bangs tshang mas yul lha mes lha btsan de drag po'i srung dmag gi nus pa thon par ngos 'dzin byed/glang bcu'i yul lha mes lha btsan de sngar zhang zhung skabs nas bzung /mnga' ris khul gyi yul lha gzhan dag dang 'dra bar/ gangs te si'am gangs rin po che'i gangs ri lha btsan gyi khongs su gtogs kyi yod la de'i 'khor zhig kyang yin par grags/dad ldan pa'i dad mos yul du gangs ri lha btsan ni mnga' ris yul yongs kyi yul lha'i rgyal po yin la/ des yul chung chung so so'i lha che chung thams cad dbang 'og tu bsdus nas dbang sgyur byed kyi yod/ sangs rgyas chos lugs ma dar gong zhang zhung mi 'bangs tshang mas gangs rin po che de nyid yul lha yongs kyi lte gnas la 'dzin nas dad pa chen mo byed pas/ de ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa lte bar 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar gna' bo'i spyi tshogs kyi lha'i sgrig gzhi dang lugs srol thun mong ma yin pa zhig red/ dus da lta'ang mnga' ris kyi dad ldan mi dmangs yongs dang yul gzhan gyi dad ldan mi 'bangs tshang mas gangs rin po che la dad pa shugs chen po byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni gna' bo'i lugs srol rgyud 'dzin byas pa trem gyis yin/ bdag gi pha yul glang bcu'i 'brog pa tshos lo ltar nyung thar yang gangs rin po che la skor ba thengs gcig rgyag thub par byed 137

cing / phru gu btsas ma thag gangs rin po che'i gam la bcar nas mchod mjal zhu ba phud/ nges par du mes lha btsan la mjal mchod byed kyi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rang yul gyi yul lha mes lha btsan ni gangs rin po che'i gangs ri lha btsan gyi 'khor yin pas so//

༄7//gu ge'i yul lha mes ba'u yi skor rags tsam brjod pa/gu ge'i yul lha ni gu ge yul gyi lte bar chags pa'i gnas ri mtho shos dang / yul lung gzhan la grags pa shin tu che ba'i gu ge'i gnas bdag mes ba'u zhes pa de'o// yul mi myong ba can rgan rabs tshos brjod pa ltar na/gna' snga mo'i dus su yul lung 'di rgya mtsho chen po'i 'og la yod cing /rjes su rgya mtsho rim gyis skam ste/ dbus kyi ri mtho shos de'i rtse mo ba phyugs ba'u (be'u ) yi gzugs tsam zhig thon yong bar brten/ de'i gzugs dbyibs la gzhigs nas ming btags pas ‘‘ba'u ’’dang / de ni ri'i thog ma dang / yul gyi thog ma/ gnas kyi thog ma/ yul de'i 'gro ba sems can gyi gnas sdod byed sa thog ma bcas yin gshis ‘‘mes ’’zhes brjod cing /ming cha tshang bar ‘‘mes ba'u ’’zhes par grags so//gu ge rgyal po'i lha chen mes ba'u zhes pa'i gnas ri de'i rtse la lha btsan dkar po dang / btsan rgod dmar po/ klu bdud nag po zhes pho brang tshon mdog mi 'dra ba chung chung gsum yod/ sngar gu ge rgyal po rim byon skabs su bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal po dang blon po sogs rkang btsugs nas gnas ri'i ri gsham du yul lha'i phob rang (mnga' ris kha skad de pho brang zhes pa'o//)zhes rdo phung gsum yod pa der bcar nas gnas ri gsol ༵ 3py-ing /

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mi tshang rigs rus gtsang ba lo phyed ring 'khrig spyod ma byas pa'i skyes pa gsum la rta rgan pho chen spu mdog mi 'dra ba gsum khrid du bcug ste ri rtser cho ga rgyas po gtong ba'i rgyun srol de rtsa rang rdzong dpon gyis kyang ma nyams par byed kyin yod pa ni/ tshes bco lnga'i zhogs pa skya rengs skya mda' btang tsam dang ri rgyal lhun por ser 'od ma 'phros tsam la rtsa rang rdzong dpon lhan rgyas dang /g.yog po kha shas/ shang rtse'i yul gyi grong pa'i pha tshang ma gnas ri mes ba'u yi gsum mdor rdo phung chen po gsum yod sa der bcar nas bsang gsol gtong ba ni/ mngar gsum skyur gsum gyi rdzas cha'i mchod gtor 'bul ba/dar lcog 'dzugs pa/ nang mi'i lo tshad gzhir bzung gis rdo phung spungs pa sogs byed/ de min byang tang / reb rtse skyog shar lam/ zur khang /jog rtse/ ra ga shag shang pa/ zhwa ye/ lhag pa/ she she sogs nas kyang 'thus mi rta pa re rkang btsugs nas der bcar te cho ga cha tshang byed pa dang smon lam 'debs srol yod pa bcas so//lhag don du rigs rus ldan pa'i mi tshang gsum gyi pho gzhon dar ma lo phyed ring 'khrig spyod spangs pa gsum gyis bla rta ngang pa dang btsan rta zag pa/klu rta sngon po zhes rta spu mdog mi 'dra ba gsum gyi thor gtsug dang / ze ba/rnga ma sogs la dar lcog sngo dkar dmar ser ljang sogs sna lnga bsgrogs ste mdzes rgyan legs par spras rting mes ba'u yi ri rtse'i lcog gsum yod sar khrid de lcog gsum la skor ba lan gsum rgyag tu 'jug de nas lcog dkar dmar sngo gsum so sor dkar rag dang / btsag 'dam khu sngon po byug cing / de'i lhag ma rta gsum gyi sgal par byug de rting lcog gsum so so'i tshos gzhi ltar steng la 'o phud dang / smug rtsi/ lu ma'i lu chu'i phud bshos 140

༄7//gu ge'i yul lha mes ba'u yi skor rags tsam brjod pa/rjes lhag ma rta gsum la ster ma thag rta gsum gyi spu mdog gzhir bzung gis so so'i ze nas dar lcog dkar dmar sngo gsum dkrol nas lcog gsum gyi tshos gzhir gzhigs te dar shing la bsgrogs/ de bzhin sngar gu ge rgyal po'i skabs su rgyal po dang / blon po/ btsan mo so so'i mda' dar dag lcog dkar dmar sngo gsum gyi steng la btsugs pa bzhin rdzong dpon gyis dar lcog lcog dkar po dang / rdzong 'og dar lcog lcog dmar/ lcam gyi dar lcog lcog sngon steng du btsugs srol yod/ 'bangs mi gzhan gyi dar lcog so so'i re ba ltar gang 'os ci 'tshams la 'dzugs pa ni sems can dkar chu rgyas slad lcog dkar sgang la btsugs/ zhing la 'bru rigs lo legs yong slad lcog sngon sgang la btsugs/ sems can sha shed yong slad lcog dmar steng la btsugs pa bcas so// de bzhin 'brang rgyas che chung cha 'dra gsum bzhangs kyi yod par dkar rgyan brgyab pa dang smug rtsi btang ba/ tshon sngon po byug pa bcas ni steng lha dang / bar btsan/ 'og klu sogs mtshon gyi yod skad/de dag gsum rdo leb chen po zhig yod pa de'i sgang la mchod nas bzhag rjes su bsang gsol sogs btang ba dang cho ga mjug sgril nas rta gsum gnas ri de'i sgang la brgyab nas tshe thar gtong zhing / skyes pa gsum pos gnas rdo tshon mdog dkar dmar sngo gsum khyer nas phyir bltas ma bslogs par ri gsham la bab te gnas rdo rdzong dpon sogs la 'bul srol yod do//dmigs bsal gna' srol ldan pa'i cho ga de zin rjes su rdzong dpon gyis dbu sna khrid de rta rags thal rlung gis ri klung khengs bzhin ngang skyes pa pho'i skad sgra 'ur chil le/ rta'i er ka'i sgra snyan sil ler log yong rting rdzong nas 'gro gron che tsam btang ste thugs spro dang / ja chang btung ba/ zhabs 141

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bro rgyag pa sogs dga' skyid longs su spyod/ lo gsar skabs la mkhar steng na mchis pa'i rtse lha gsol ba dang dgon pa'i nang la bskang gso gtong ba/srung mar 'phrin bcol byed pa bcas so rtsa rang rdzong dpon 'dir sdod pa'i skabs su shang rtse khul du mi tshang brgyad yod par drug gis rtsa rang rdzong la khral rgyugs shing / gnyis kyis dgon pa'i dkor pa byas te dgon par zhabs phyi zhu ba/ de min da dung rtsa rang rdzong khongs kyi yul gzhan du sa bcud bum pa skyel ba'am tshwa sho skyel bar 'gro dgos pa'i las 'gan yang yod/ rdzong dpon gyis ja spus bsgyur gtong dus ja phon che tsam nyo dgos/ phyis su rtsa rang rdzong dpon kyang ri'i sgang gi mkhar la ma sdod par ri gsham ste shang rtse gtsang po'i lho ngogs la rdzong dpon dang gnyer pa sdod sa'i khang pa cung legs tsam yod la thab tshang /bang mdzod/ rta rwa bcas stabs bde las med pa'i shul deng sang yang mthong rgyu 'dug rdzong dpon de lo gcig dus bzhir khang gsar brgyab sa'i zhol la sdod cing / mi tshang dkyus ma brgyad po de ni bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu gnyis nas lnga bar du yar ri ldebs sa phug nang la spos te/ dgun thog zla ba gsum der sdod cing / bod zla dang po'i nyi shu gnyis dang lnga la mar yul la spos nas/ zla ba dgu tsam zhing las sogs byas te sdod/ shang rtse'i khul der ma gzhi bru sa bru rong sha stag yin mod kyang yul lung so sor dmigs bsal khyad chos yod pa ni yul mi'i kha rgyun du'ang zur khang bye ri btsog se yod// rag shag khyi mo nyal 'dra 'dug / jog rtse gnam gyi ka ba yin//byang tang ba tshwa se tshar ro// zhes so//spyi lo 1992lor gsar du bzhengs pa'i shang rtse dgon pa de shang grong tsho 142

chung chung de'i lho phyogs thang sder du bzhengs/ de'i rten gtso bo yum pu ti bcu drug dang thub pa'i zangs sku rnying pa khru gang ma sogs yod/ de min yang zangs rag las bzhengs pa'i sku che chung bcu grangs dang thang sku mi nyung ba yod kyang gsar pa sha stag red/ der grwa pa med kyang dus rgyun du spo bo rgan khog zhig gis phyag mchod 'bul ba sogs bdag skyong byed do//

༄khya//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i gti g.yag khul gyi yul lha ji ltar gsolda lugs skor/gu ge'i gti g.yag khul la yul lha grags can spun gsum byung 'dug pa ni gcen zla ba bkra shis dang / phu bo karma tshes brgyad/ gcung mo a ni chos lha bdag mo bcas so// de gsum rta gro dkar gsum la bcibs shing phyag la go mtshon thogs nas lha khang sgo steng gi ldebs ris su bris yod/ de snga gcen yul lha zla ba bkra shis 'bebs mkhan sku khog zhig yod par khong pha tsha bu rgyud du lha phab nas bka' lung btsan zhing ha cang thig po yod tshul brjod/ de'i sku khog mtha' ma'i ming la bsam 'grub zer/ khos lha 'bebs dus lag pa re la mda' dar re 'khyer ba ni gnam sa gnyis kyi dbang gzung tshur blangs nas rang lus su 'jags pa dang / kha nang gi 'gram sbug gnyis su lcags sgor mo gnyis bcug pa ni kha nang me drod kyi ngar bcag cing 'jam mnyen ldan pa'i lce leb so 'og la ma gtsab pa'i slad du yin/ lha phab te bka' lung gnang zin nas lag pa g.yas su bsnams pa'i mda' dar de sku khog rang gi khyim nang la 'jog pa dang cig shos lag pa g.yon par zin pa de yul lha'i pho brang gi sgang la btsugs nas bzhag pa de ni las dang rten 'brel legs po yong ba'i smon 'dun yin/ sku khog des bka' lung kha gsal go bde gnang gin yod1 ༵4 la/ nang don gtso bo yul la gegs dang bar chad dang / god chag

༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i gti g.yag khul gyi yul lha ji ltar gsol lugs skor/gnod 'tshe/ nad na tsha'i rigs ji yong gi skor dang / de 'gog thabs ci 'dra byed dgos min yang re re byas nas bshad/ khos lo gsar (so nam lo gsar te bod zla bcu gcig pa'i mjug la 'go 'dzugs/) la lha 'bebs pa ni lo gsar pa'i nang gi dka' nyen srung ba dang yul la don chen byung dus yul spyi pa'i don du sku khog phebs pa spyi dang yang sgos dus rgyun du yul mi grong pa su la nad na tsha byung ba'am gnod 'tshe ga dus byung kyang skad btang ma khad la khos lam seng bcar nas lha 'bebs pa dang bka' lung gnang / 'on tang lha 'bebs yas de dus tshod thung thung nang la thengs grangs mang drag na kho'i gzugs po'am tshe srog la gnod pa che tshul zer bas mtshams re 'then 'gyangs kyang byed/bod zla dang po'i mjug la yul mi yongs rdzogs smyung gnas la zhugs kyi yod pa ni/ nyin gcig ring nyin gang lto chas mi bza' ba dang ngag sgros dam zhing phan tshun bar lag brda mdzub brda byed pa las skad cha shod mi choganyin gnyis par bla mas bum chu'i nang nas yon chab tog tsam gnang ba de 'thung rjes su gsol tshigs gnang ba de bzas pa dang sbrags gzhi nas smyung gnas sangs nas ngag sgrol te skad cha shod pa dang ro bcud ldan pa'i zas rigs sna tshogs bsgrigs gshom gyis mnyam za mnyam 'thung ngang longs spyod byed kyin yod do//bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nas bsang gsol rgya chen btang ste yul gyi sa chu'i snying bcud khug tu bcug cing / de ma nyid du shing 'debs rtswa 'debs nags bzo bcas kyi las 'gul rgya chen po zhig spel/ de rjes chang 'thung ba dang / zhabs bro 'khrab pa/ gzhas gtong ba sogs dga' skyid 145

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mnyam 'dzoms byed/ de tshe sku khog des lha 'bebs pa dang dus mtshungs su grong khyim so so'i yab chen tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms byas nas shing shug pa la me spar nas du bsur gtong skabs lung pa dud zhag gis khengs nas bya bye'u rigs tshang la nyal ba dag mar thon yong ste gsung dbyangs sgrog cing / gang sar 'phur lding gis dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad par bsu ba zhu ba dang /lar na kho tsho'i 'phur phyogs dang mtho dman snyan dbyangs bcas nas lo de'i nang skyid sdug ji yong mtshon zhes zer/ yang gnas ri'i dbu rtser dar lcog 'dzugs par 'gro mkhan gyi 'thus mi ni lo re bzhin yul de'i grong khyim mi 'dra bar brjes res bgyid/yul mi tshos zhing 'debs pa'i dus ni gang byung tshod dpag min par nyi ma'i 'gro phyogs la brtag par byed pa ste/ de ni mdun gyi brag ri tsog tsog gsum po de'i dbus kyi rtse la nyi ma rim bzhin bzhud kyin yod na zhing 'debs ran pa'i rtags mtshan yin/ de tshe zhing nang la yul mi mnyam 'dzoms kyis dud gsur rgya chen gtong la/ mngar gsum skyur gsum gyi mchod phud dang gser skyems mchod sprin byed/ de dus lhag par du chang la dang dod byed dgos pa ni btsog pa rtsa ba nas ma shor bar spus legs kyi bdud brtsi'i khu ba zhes brjod/ gal srid btsog grib shor tshe lo legs yong rgyu lta ci gnod pa dang sdig pa ha cang chen po yong ba'i bltas yin zhes zer srol yod do//dpyid gsol nyin dang po lha khang nang la gtong bar yul lha mtshon ched ri bo che (dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i 'brang rgyas de mi tshang yod do'i rtsam phud dang zas rigs phud thams cad mnyam du bsdu rub kyis bzhengs/)zhes 'brang rgyas chen po zhig bzhengs nas lha khang nang la mchod cing chang dang po de yang lha 146

༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i gti g.yag khul gyi yul lha ji ltar gsol lugs skor/khang nang gi chang phud 'bul sa ting chen po zhig yod pa de'i nang la bkang /de nas 'brang rgyas sam gtor ma chen po de zhing nang du gdan 'dren zhus nas chang gnyis pa de zhing nang gi lha rdo dkar po spungs brgyab pa de la mchod/chang gsum pa so so'i nang la mchod/ chang gi sbag ma'i phud dang slu ma'i phud kyang lha khang la phul gyi yod/ gong du brjod pa'i 'brang rgyas ri bo che zhes pa de'i phyogs gsum la yar kha legs pos sgron mar gyis dkar rgyan rgyag gin yod la/ de bzhengs sa ni yul de'i thog ma'i grong chen brgyad kyi gras mi tshang gong ma zhes pa zhig nas shing gi sder ma chen po gcig yod pa de'i sgang la 'jog 'brang rgyas bzhengs mkhan gtso bo de yul na shon 'khrab dus rnga brdungs mkhan gyi mi tshang zhig yod pa de kho na las mi tshang gzhan pas tshab byed chog gi med par grags/'brang rgyas ri bo che bzhengs zin rjes shing gi gzhong pa sgor mo'i nang gi lhag lus dag zur cha bzhi la bgo bsha' brgyab te/ zur cha gcig shing gi gzhong pa'i bdag po la thob pa dang zur cha gcig rnga brdungs mkhan nam 'brang rgyas bzhengs mkhan la thob/ zur cha gcig gzhas dang zhabs bro 'khrab mkhan la thob/ zur cha gcig yul mi tshang mar gang 'dang ba zhig bgo bsha' rgyaga'abrang rgyas ri bo che zhing nang du gdan 'dren zhu dus yul mi bu mo tshang mas gu ge rgyal rabs skabs kyi gna' srol ldan cing / thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan gos legs po bklubs nas gzab mchor spras te lha yul gyi lha mo sa steng la bab pa ltar 'dren byed dbang po rang dbang med par 'dren par 'gyur/gcod gtong mkhan gyis rnga brdungs sbug 'chal dkrol mtshams su/ yul mi 147

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na chung tshos shon sna drangs shing gzhas gdangs 'gyur khug can gyis rna ba'i dbang po 'phrog par byed/ de tshe pho gzhon tshos zhabs bro 'khrab 'go brtsams pa dang gyad mi stobs chen gnyis kyis 'brang rgyas chen po ri bo che lha khang nas phyir bkyags yong / ru sne 'khrid mkhan bla mas(ser khyim pa bla ma mtha' ma de'i ming la spo bo rab sbyor rtogs ldan zhes chos dang yon tan gyi mkhyen rgya che bas yul mi tshang mas brtsi 'jog dang gus bkur chen po byed/)phyag gcig la chos dang gcig la ba dan 'phyar/ kho'i rjes su sbug 'chal dkrol mkhan gcigade nas dung gtong mkhan mi gcig de nas rnga brdungs mkhan gcig de nas 'brang rgyas ri bo che byon/ dgon pa dang dgon pa'i mdun gyi mchod rten la g.yas skor lan gsum brgyab rting 'brang rgyas ri bo che dgon pa dang mchod rten dbus su bzhugs khri zhig yod pa de'i sgang la 'jog de tshe gzab mchor legs par spras pa'i dad ldan mi ser chos mjal la bcar mkhan rgan dar gzhon gsum gyis phyag sor snyim pa bkums te 'dren byed dbang por dad sems drag pos ma 'chil zhags 'khor zhing / snying khong rus pa'i gting nas smon lam 'debs kyin skor ba lan gsum brgyab rjes su/'brang rgyas ri bo che zhing nang la gdan 'dren zhus nas bsang gsol sogs cho ga rgyas po gtong / de nas nyin gung nyi phyogs ma log tsam la sngar bzhin bla mas ru sne khrid nas 'brang rgyas de lha khang nang la gdan 'dren zhus te yum pu ti bcu drug mdun du khri chen po zhig yod pa de'i sgang la mchod nas lo 'khor mor 'jog gin yod/ de nas bzung mi ser tshang ma glu gar rgya mtshos myos par byed do//sngar zla re'i tshes bcu gtong skabs yul mi mang che ba mnyam 'dzoms 148

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i gti g.yag khul gyi yul lha ji ltar gsol lugs skor/byas nas rtsam pa dang gtor rdzas bsdu rub byas te gtor tshogs dang gsol tshigs bzhengs shing / tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis kha 'don rgyas pos yul mir bde legs yong ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang gtor tshogs khang thog dang ri mgor bskyal nas pho rog sogs bya tshogs rnams tshim par byed/ de bzhin yul la rkyen ngan nam mi shi sogs byung tshe tshang mas rang nus gang yod kyis rogs skyor byed pa dang / zla ba re gnyis trem ring sdug mnyam 'khur byed pa sogs kyi lugs srol bzang po yod/yul de'i pho mo'i gnyen sgrig byed stangs ni gu ge rgyal rabs mnga' khongs kyi yul gzhan dang 'dra bar pha mas bkod sgrig byed pa las bu dang bu mos gang 'dod rtsa ba nas byed mi chog thog ma mna' ma dang mag pa slong mkhan des spun mched nye du zhig la chang dang kha btags bskur nas ster rogs zhes slong ja bskol ba dang slong chang 'bul/ gal srid mos mthun byas tshe nang la phar log nas slong mkhan gyi pha mar lan sprad ma thag lam seng chang dang dod kyis btsos nas nang gi pha de dngos su ster mkhan nang la bcar nas zhib phra'i gros bsdur byas te chang sa'i rten 'brel gyi dus dang sa cha sogs gtan 'khel byed/ de nas dngos su rten 'brel byed skabs sngon la mna' ma'i nang la dgong mo bsdad nas pha ma spun mched dang mgron po rnams la chang dang gsol tshigs rgyas po zhig gtong dgos/ de nas bu'i nang la gdan 'dren zhus dus nang mi gcig bu mo dang mnyam du 'gro dgos/ de byings kyi mgron po tshang ma nyi ma gnyis par snga rting gis 'gro dgos so// spyir btang rten 'brel rgya chen po byed pa ni bu mo'i nye ring dang bu yi nye ring thams cad mnyam 'dzoms byas nas dga' dga' skyid skyid ngang bag len gtong ngo /149

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yul de'i mi'i za rigs nang dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod pa ni cul rtsam dang cul thug lags/ cul li ni mnga' ris kha skad de don du kham bu skam bsang btang bar brjod/ de yang cul li'am kham bu'i kham tshig bton rjes pags pa skam po de rdo yi brdungs nas hrug hrug gam zhib po bzos rjes rdul phran rtsam pa nang bzhin chags kyi yod par cul rtsam dang de chu'i nang la blugs te dkrug dkrug gtong gin bskol te gar tsam chags tshe cul thug yin/ dus rgyun du de 'dra mang tsam 'thung bas na de'i bcud kyis lus stobs rgyas shing pho ba bde po yod ces zer gyin 'dugade min pul li (mnga' ris kha skad de bag leb yin/)zhes bag leb srab po bsreg cing bra dang gro pul/ rtsi rtsi pul li/ rgya bra'i pul li (de legs shos yin/) bcas mdor na bag leb sna tshogs bsregs nas bza' gin yod/rgyun gtan so so'i bza' yas yin na gang yang ma brgyab par skya zas yin kyang sku mgron sogs la gtong dus sngon la mar khu bzhus/ de la rtsam pa dang be ma ka ra (mnga' ris yul skad don du bye ma ka ra'am cir ni/)tog tsam brgyab nas dkrug dkrug btang rjes mar khu'i skyo ma gar sla 'tsham po zhag bzos nas bag leb sgang la blugs/ de'i sgang la bag leb gcig 'jog par ma zad/de'i sgang la mar khu'i skyo ma blug nas yang bskyar bag leb gcig brtsegs pa sogs mgron chen gtong dus bag leb drug bcu bdun bcu brtsegs kyin yod pa de yang ro bcud ldan pa'i zhim zas legs gras shig yin/ mdor na yul 'dir bza' btung gi bsnyen bkur bzang zhing gya nom pas nam dus ci la'ang dga' bdes myos par byed do//150
