gyi//mnga' ris gu ge'i rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang srung ma mgon po'i skor/rdo gsham ni stod mnga' ris rtsa mda' rdzong rtsa rang shang gi khongs su gnas/ yul de'i yul lha ni i phi (smobo) bkra shis bde legs zhes pa de yin cing de dang mang nang i phi sgang sman/ mtho lding gi i phe ha se 'phags ma gsum la bu mo spun gsum yang brjod/ rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs ni bka' gnyan mthu rtsal can zhig yin par yul mi tshang mas bsngags brjod dang yid smon lhad med bcangs/ brjod srol la sngar la dwags dmag gis 'dir gnod skyel thub med pa'ang de'i bka' drin yin skad/de'ang la dwags dmag thengs dang po yul 'dir slebs la khad skabs su/yul srung bkra shis bde legs kyis i phi rgan mo lo rgan brgyad cur slebs pa zhig la sprul te phyag la 'khar ba bsnams/ rgyab la lcags lham mthil rdol ba sle po gang khyer nas gom gros 'khyar 'khyor ngang lung shur zhig nas mar babs yong nas lu chu'i mgo la gnas mjal ba yin khul gyis kha 'don ldar ldir ngang tsha phog brgyab nas bsdad/ la dwags dmag mi der slebs pa dang sbrags rta la lu ma'i lu chu ldud cing / i phir rdo gsham mkhar la slebs graba~X ḍid

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/med skad cha dris pa la/ i phis lcags lham sle po gang de mig bstan nas nga rdo gsham mkhar nas thon te la lung bdun cu brgyab gshis/ lcags lham 'di tsam mthil brdol te 'dir slobs tsam byung zhes lan btabs pas la dwags dmag mi tshang ma rang yul nas thon te yun ring song ba dang mi rta thams cad thang chad pa'i khar rgyags phye'ang rdzogs la khad pas yid thang chad nas phyir bshig brgyab skad/ yang rjes su la dwags dmag thengs gnyis par yong dus mkhar gyi 'khris su bcar/ 'on tang mkhar ga la ba der mig lta dus mda' gri mdung sogs drag po'i mtshon cha bsnams pa'i dmag mi phon chen gyis srung cha byas yod par mngon/ gang lags she na/ yul srung i phi bkra shis bde legs kyis 'dab chags mu gu (mnga' ris skad de phug ron la zer/)stong phrag mang por sprul nas mkhar gyi mtha' bskor nas bsdad pas dgra dmag gis khrab rmog go mtshon thogs pa'i dmag mi dang nor nas kho tsho dngangs 'tshab skyes nas bla khyer ba ltar yul 'di nas kha bral te mtho lding rtsa rang phyogs la phyin pas/ yul 'di dgra lag nas thengs gnyis pa thar pa'ang yul srung 'di'i bka' drin yin par brjod/ yul lha bkra shis bde legs kyi zhal 'bag dang ldebs ris mgon khang nang la yod cing / de'i lcog gam pho brang de 'du khang steng du bzhengs so// spyir lo gsar tshes gsum dang dbyar bsang skabs la yul mi tshang mas rang khyim gyi dar lcog khyer yong nas lcog steng la 'dzugs kyin yod pas de tshe thag ring rgyang nas blta dus 'du khang steng thog khra cha ler gnas pa brjid nyams dod po zhe drags yod skad do//mdor na yul lha bkra shis bde legs kyis mu gur brdzus nas rdo gsham mkhar srung bas la dwags sogs dgra dmag gis mtshon char mngon nas gnod pa ye 152

༄7//gu ge'i rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang srung ma mgon po'i skor/nas skyel thub med pas rjes su rtsa rang rdzong dpon gyis do snang dang mthong chen byas nas yul lha'i tshab tu dge lugs pa'i srung ma mgon por gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i mthong chen bgyis shing lo re'i lo gsar skabs dngos su mgon po'i sku mdun du bcar nas lo gsar pa'i nang legs nyes rtags mtshan ga re yod med brtag dpyad zhib tshags dang cho ga rgyas po byed kyin yod pa'i skor gsham gsal ltar lags/lo re'i bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad nyin chab sgo phye zhes mgon khang sgo phye ste rtsa rang rdzong dpon ngo ma bcar nas brtag dpyad byed/ khong sgo 'gram la langs nas blta ba las yar mgon po'i 'khris la bcar mi choga'akhris su bcar mkhan de grwa pa sdom gtsang ba blo rig bkra la gzhung drang po gcig dgos/ khong gis lcags drwa lcags kyi a long gis drwa rgya btang nas sgo lcags rgyag pa de'i sgang la la ca'i thel tse rgyag pa de rdzong dpon mdun du phye nas dus rgyun lcags drwar kha btags dar bus bsgribs pa de dag bsang nas mgon po'i sku mdun du rtags mtshan ga re shar min rdzong dpon chen po dang mnyam du brtag dpyad byed pa dper na mgon po'i sku lus dang phyag la thal bas tshos yod na mi la nad yams dang bgegs bar chad yong ba'i rtags/mgon po'i sku lus dang zhabs la thal ba rtsa ba nas ma gos par da lta rang phyis pa nang bzhin gtsang mar bsdad yod na bkra shis bde legs yong ba'i rtags/mgon po'i phyag rgyab la mdung rtse shin tu rno ba zhig bzhag yod pa dang mgon po'i sku mdun la ral gri ngar ma rtse rno ba gsum mnyam du bsgrigs nas rkang gsum gyi tshul du bzhag yod pa gal te mdung dang gri de tsho mar zags nas mar gyi 'brang rgyas chen po chung byis pa lo brgyad kyi gzugs tshad tsam yod pa 153

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de'i sgang la zug yod na mtha' yi dgra dmag yong ba'i rtags/ maṇ+ḍal nang gi 'bru nyung du phyin yod na zhing la lo nyes yong ba'i rtags mtshan dang lo kyung (mnga' ris skad don du mchod kong /) nang gi mar khu tshang ma rdzogs yod na lo de'i nang la sems can la dkar chu nyung zhing skya rgyas po mi yong ba'i rtags dang mchod mes dbus 'bar nas kong kong chags shing mtha' cha tshang bsdad yod na lo legs po dang skya rgyas po zhe drag yin pa'i rtags mtshan red/ mar gyi 'brang rgyas chen po dang de'i mtha' skor la chung chung bcu bzhi yod par kha shas la khab zug yod na yul la rten 'brel mdzad sgo mang zhing rgyan gos gzab mchor legs po spras rgyu yong ba'i rtags/ kha shas la mda' sogs zug yod na yul la dmag dang dgra ngan yong ba'i rtags/ kha shas la nas 'bru dang 'bras sbyar yod na yul la mu ge yong ba'i rtags/ kha shas la sha skam zug na sems can shi chad mang po yong ba'i rtags mtshan yin pa bcas su brtsi gi yod pa red/ gong gi rgyu cha de dag mgon khang thog kha'i drab shing gseb gang sar mchod nas yod/ mdor na rtags mtshan de dag tshang ma rdzong dpon gyis do nan gyis re re byas nas zhib cing phra ba tho bkod rjes mgyogs dang myur du a drung mngags gtong gis rta zam sum cu lhag tsam brgyud bod sde pa gzhung la lo ltar snyan seng ji ma ji bzhin zhu dgos/ des na rdo gsham gyi lha chen mgon po de ni bod sde pa gzhung gi gnas chung chos skyong dang la mo tshangs pa dang 'dra bar srid gzhung gi 'phel 'grib sogs la brtag pa'i lha chen gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i gras shig tu brtsi'o//mgonakhang gi lcags dra'i phyi la zla kyung zhes zla ba re bskang nas bzhag pa'i mchod kong zhig 'jog de'i rtags mtshan nam ltas ga re yin pa 154

༄7//gu ge'i rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang srung ma mgon po'i skor/dgon pa'i bla mas tho bkod nas zla rer rtsa rang rdzong dpon la snyan seng zhu dgos/ cho ga'i ring gi sha mar 'bru nas 'bras bcas gtong sgo tshang ma rtsa rangardzong nas gtong ba dang dus rgyun du rdzong dpon nas dgon pa der blta skyong ha cang che ba zhig dmigs bsal do snang chen po byed do//zla ba de'i tshes bcu nas bzung rtsa rang rdzong dpon gyis sbyin bdag thon nas gtong sgo yod do btang nas bla ma dang grwa dmangs tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms thog bla mas 'gan bzhes nas grwa pa dmangs kyis nus shugs gang yod bton te zhabs zhu byed cing / mgon po'i sku mdun du mchod yas mar gyi 'brang rgyas chen po zhig dang chung chung mar tsog pu tho gang ma bcu bzhi bcas bzhengs pa re re'i sgang la mtheb skyu gsum brgya drug cu sbyar/ de nas 'brang rgyas chen po de dkyil la 'jog 'brang rgyas chung ba bcu bzhi de dag kyang mdun la bdun dang rgyab la bdun mchod/ mar gyi 'brang rgyas de tsho bzhengs zin rjes bla mas 'khrud gsol 'khrud gzhong kha phye zhing yon chab blugs nas khengs par byas/ lag pa g.yon mas me long zin/ g.yas pas bum pa zin/me long 'khrud gzhong nang la mar blugs yar len thengs gsum byas rjes 'khrud gzhong nang gi yon chab yang bskyar tshur bum pa'i nang la blugs pa sogs phar blugs dang tshur blugs thengs bdun byas/ de nas yon chab ting gi nang la blugs nas mgon po'i sku mdun du bshams/ mar gtor tshang ma 'khrud gzhong nang la bsgrigs nas mgon po'i sku mdun du mchod/mar gtor bzhengs pa'i mar lhag 'khrud gsol byas te skam thag chod rting bzhur rjes lo kyung nang la blugs te mgon po'i sku mdun du mchod me 'bul cing lo re la brje po thengs re rgyag pa de ni lo kyung zhes pa de'o// nam rgyun 155

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'char can du zla re bzhin yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang mar ngo'i nyi shu dgu la yul lha dang dgon pa'i srung ma tshang ma'i bskang gso 'char can gtong ngo //lo ltar bsgrigs gshom tshang ma zin rting bskang gso rgyas po zhig btang nas mi ser tshang ma mgon por zhal mjal byed du 'jug cing gsol tshigs gtong / de tshe stod mnga' ris mi ser ma tshad mtha'i yul khag dang dbus gtsang mdo khams sogs nas mgon po'i zhal mjal la yong mkhan mi ser ha cang mang po yod pa ni rdo gsham dgon pa'i lha chen mgon po de snyan grags shin tu che la stod mnga' ris sa char yod pa'i sde pa gzhung gi srung ma gal che shos de yin par brtsi bas so// de yang lo gcig dus gcig las dus rgyun du lcags dra 'then pa dang de'i sgang la kha gtags g.yogs nas 'jog stabs dad ldan mi mang tshos sgo'i phyi nas smon lam 'debs pa dang sku phyag 'bul tsam byed pa las zhal mjal gyi go skabs rtsa ba nas med/ sngar stod mnga' ris lha chen mgon po de'i skor la bka' gtan dang sgrog deb cha tshang yod kyang rjes su me la bsregs skad/rdo gsham yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang mang nang yul lha i phi gangs sman/ rtsa rang yul lha ha se rgyal mo (sgrol ma lha khang gi lho phyogs la yod )bcas bu mo spun gsum yin skad/ spyir btang byas na bkra shis bde legs kyis chibs pa sngo nag dang gangs sman chibs pa g.yag kham pa/ ha se rgyal mo'i chibs pa g.yag dkar po yin kyang ldebs ris khag gcig la chibs pa'i tshos gzhi mi 'dra'ang 'dug pa dper na mkhar rtse'i ldebs ris ltar ro// de tsho ni gu ge khul gyi mo lha gtso mo gsum yin cing mthu rtsal shin tu che bar grags/zer srol la gu ge jo bdag po'i mkhar chags sa'i lho phyogs rgyab ngos la ri 156

༄7//gu ge'i rdo gsham gyi yul lha bkra shis bde legs dang srung ma mgon po'i skor/dang mkhar gnyis thog ma 'brel nas yod/ de tshe dgra zon byed dka' zhing nyen kha thams cad de nas yong bas gu ge rgyal por dgra bo dang jag rkun sogs kyis dka' las ha cang chen po bzos skad/ mthar yul lhar skyabs bcol bas des nyin gcig ri rgyal lhun por skya mda' ma btang tsam la chibs g.yag dkar po dung ltar la chibs/ chibs g.yag gis lce leb dmar dmar glog ltar 'khyug kha chu 'dzar 'dzar char ltar 'bab/ ngur skad ldir ldir 'brug sgra grags pa ltar spu gri rno ngar can 'dra'i rwas brdungs thengs gcig la sho re chen po zhig bzos nas su yang gzhogs de nas mkhar la 'dzegs thub yas med cing de nas bzung gu ge'i mkhar la gnod pa skyel mkhan shin tu dkon cing bde 'jags su gyur skad do//rdo gsham dgon pa'i mgon khang nang la gri sna tshogs nyar tshags byas yod pa ring thung 'dom phyed tsam yod/ de'i nang nas chu ris can yang 'ga' shas 'dug par lag pa 'khris la slebs tshe lhag ngar grang bsil bsil byed cing thag ring rgyang nas 'od rgyag pa sogs dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan par ma zad lag shes bzo rtsal shin tu legs shing rin thang bral ba sha stag red/ zer srol la gri de dag lha chen bka' srung mgon po'i phyag mtshon yin pas su zhig gis kyang 'khyer mi nyan par rnam rtog chen po byed/ brjod srol la rtsa rang rdzong dpon dpon thog gcig gis gri ring chu ris can legs shos der sems pa shor nas kha khar rkun ma brgyab te khyer phyin kyang lam phyed la slebs pa dang stod gzer drag pos mnar te kha nas khrag bskyugs pas gri de lam sang phyir skyel dgos byung skad/de bzhin gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' 'og gi mkhar gzhan dang 'dra bar rdo 157

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ gsham mkhar de la'ang rtse nas shod bar du sa 'og chu len sa'i phug lam shar gtong drus yod cing rtse thog la dgra bor gzhu yas chu rdo phon chen bsags yod/gu ge rgyal po rim byung skabs rdo gsham de gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i sa gnas zhig dang rgyal po'i spun 'khor 'jon thang can zhig 'dir bzhugs nas 'bangs mi skyong zhes grags so// 158

—༄khya//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/lo rgyus thog gu ge rgyal po rim byon gyi mnga' khongs su grags can jo ba bcu gsum yod pa ni/ lugs jo ba dang / snub jo ba/ jog rtse jo ba/tsho rub jo ba/ ser kha jo ba/ mkhar rtse jo ba/ sang dar (mtho lding dgon pa'i byang phyogs thang gshongs chen po yod pa'i lung shur der zer/)jo ba/ ri jo ba sogs yin/ jo ba de tshor mthu rtsal ha cang chen po yod par grags te/dper na mes pos brjod srol ltar na ri jo ba dang lugs jo ba gnyis mthu gtong res byed skabs su/ ri jo ba mthu rtsal shin tu che bas lugs jo bas rdo yi ser ba 'bebs pa tshang ma bkag nas ma ṇi lha khang yod sar g.ya' rdo rdza rdo che chung sna tshogs nyil le ba lung shur nang la mthong rgyu yod pa de dag yin skad/ rjes su ri jo bas rdo de tsho bed spyod btang nas jo ba mthu rtsal can gzhan gyi kha gnon du ma ṇi lha khang bzhengs so brjod/ des na lugs jo ba ngo tsha kha skyengs nas phyi phyogs la 'grul bzhud tsam yang byed nus kyi med ces so// mdor na ri jo bar kha gtad gcog thub mkhan su yang ma byung bas gu ge rgyal po'am jo bdag po rim byon gyis ri jo ba rim byung la dmigs bsal mthong chen byed kyin yod par grags/sngar gu ge rgyal rabs skabs su rgyal por dka' gnad dang rkyen ༵spya ga

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/re byung yang jo ba bcu gsum gyis mthu rtsal sna tshogs bstan nas sel gyin yod skad/ dper na rang byung gi gnod 'tshe sna tshogs te dgun dus gangs dang 'khyag pa'i skyon/ dpyid dus gangs zhur chu log dang mu ge'i skyon/ dbyar dus ser ba dang than skyon/ thog rgyag pa/ shwa 'od rgyugs pa/ rbab rdo 'gril ba bcas kyi skyon/ ston dus sad brgyab pa'am rtswa ngan 'bras bus dud 'gro du ma'i srog 'phrog pa'i skyon sogs dang de bzhin sa yom brgyab pa'am me shor ba/ khyi smyon spyang smyon langs pa/ nad na tsha dang bgegs bar chad bcas dang tha na rgyal po'i lcam la phru gu btsas pa'ang phru gu lo bcu gsum gyi skag sogs la'ang jo ba gdan 'dren zhus nas gto mdos kyi cho ga byed du bcug pa'am sngags lung 'dren du 'jug skag zlog gi cho ga gtong ba bcas byed/cho ga che ba'i skabs ste lo gsar dang / dbyar gsol/ yang don chung ba phru gu'i skag zlog bcas la jo ba mthu rtsal can mang che ba gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du 'gro dgos/ des na gu ge blos thub mkhar gyi rtse thog na mchis pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang gi 'og tsam la khang chen bcu gsum gyi shul deng sang yang mthong rgyu yod/ dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i lha khang de tsho dang gu ge rgyal po'i nyams rgud dar 'phel dbar 'brel ba shin tu chen po yod pa phyi'i rnam pa tsam nas mtshon thub bo// rjes su ri jo ba dang gu ge rgyal po dbar la dmigs bsal 'brel 'dris legs po yod pa ni/ khong mthu rtsal ha cang che zhing bsam pa rnam dag gis zhabs phyi zhu gin yod skad/ gu ge'i rgyal rgyud yin pa'i bu lo bcu gsum la slebs tshe khong nges par du rtsa rang mkhar ram blos thub mkhar du bcar nas skag zlog gto mdos kyi cho ga byed dgos/ de 160

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/min lha gsol skabs su bsang gsol phul mkhan dang lo gsar skabs su zhabs brtan sgrub mkhan tshang mar khong 'bod 'gugs byed kyin yod do//phyis su gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' thang ming gi lhag mar gyur nas rtsa rang rdzong dpon gyis yul der dbang sgyur byed skabs su ri jo bas gu ge rgyal por zhabs phyi zhu ba nang bzhin rtsa rang rdzong dpon la'ang de ltar byed dgos pa ni/ lo mjug tu nges par du rtsa rang rdzong la thengs gcig bcar nas zhabs brtan sogs byed pa dang / yul lha gsol ba/ tha na rtsa rang rdzong gi byis pa'i skag bzlog te byis pa lo bcu gsum la slebs tshe ri jo ba gdan 'dren zhus nas skag zlog gi cho ga byed du 'jug des na khong la dmigs bsal dbang thang yod pa ni ra lug brgyad cus spang kha nyi ma gang shar gyi rtswa thang gang sar 'gro chog yul la dgra sogs byung yang dmag sar jo ba'i khyim gyi mi su'ang 'gro dgos kyi med pa de'ang ri jo ba'i dmigs bsal gyi dbang thang yin/ de min dbang thang rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa'i bka' gtan khungs thub ha cang btsan po zhig 'khyer rgyu yod pa la/ gzhung dam brgyab yod cing gos chen la bsgril nas smyug mdong nang la blugs te gzab gzab byas nas nyar sdod kyi yod/ gzhung gis khong la lo 'khor mar 'gro gron ga re gtong dgos min sogs kyis lag deb cig kyang yod/bod kyi lo gsar dgun gting la 'khel bas mtshams re kha ba chen po bab nas dka' las shin tu che mod/ 'on tang de ni lo ltar 'char can sgrub dgos pa'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig yin gshis ri jo bas chos g.yog khrid cing ra pho dgu la chos rdzas dang cho ga'i yo chas gos gzan dang zas rigs bskyal nas 'khyag shi thebs nyen yod kyang 'gro dgos/ gal te 'gro ma thub tshe chad 161

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa chen po bcad tshe de bas 'tsho ba'i thog la dka' las chen po bzos pa spyi dang yang sgos lo gsar pa'i nang la jus nyes kyis rtsa rang rdzong dpon la dka' las byung tshe tshang ma jo bas 'gan len byed dgos/ lar na lo rnying pa mjug sgril ba'i zhabs brtan dang lo gsar pa mgo tshugs pa'i zhabs brtan 'thus shor rtsa ba nas 'byung mi nyan/ byung na rnam rtog chen por 'dzin no// ri jo ba'i khyim nang la gu ge rgyal po'i skabs kyi mchod rdzas rnying pa ste sngags yig dang sems can sna tshogs par brkos pa'i par shing mang po yod la/ tsan dan gyi mchod rten che chung sna tshogs/ rnga dang ḍā ma ru che chung mang dag yod/lhag par du lugs pas lugs brgyab pa'i sil snyan dang sbubs chal shin tu srab la skad gsang rgyang grags mang po'i sa nas thos thub pa sogs dmigs bsal can gyi rgyu rnying ha cang mang po yod/ri jo ba gu ge rtsa rang mkhar du lo gsar gyi zhabs brtan dang 'phrin bcol la phebs rting gu ge rgyal po'am jo bdag po rim byon gyi pho brang du phebs nas gtor ma bzhengs shing bskang gso gtong / bsang gsol dang gto bcos sna tshogs byed pa sogs sngar lugs ltar cho ga cha tshang byed do//sngar jo bdag po'i snyan grags dang dbang thang ma nyams gong du 'phel bar mtshon pa'i 'brang rgyas dmigs bsal can zhig yod pa de'ang lo ltar 'char can gyis ri jo ba sku ngo mas bzhengs nas rgyal po'i pho brang nang la lo 'khor mar bzhag ste lo rjes mar gsar pa bzhengs pa dang rnying pa brje po rgyag jo bas nyi shu lnga nas bzung dgu gtor bzhengs kyi yod pa la/ drag po'i tshul du phyi la smug rtsi btang nas dmar rkyang bzo zhing / mgo dang snying dbus su thig nag po brgyab te nyi shu dgu'i dgong mo mkhar gyi rgyab phyogs rong nang la bskyur/162

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/gal te gu ge rtsa rang mkhar mdun gyi thang steng na yod pa'i blos btang dgon pa'i gtor ma bskyur ba dang dus mnyam du 'khel tshe dgon pa'i gtor ma mkhar gsham gyi gsum mdor bskyur dgos pa las rgyal po'i pho brang gi gtor ma dang gnas gcig dang kha phyogs gcig tu bskyur mi nyan/ tshes gnyis la r+shanyin gang bskang gso chad med gtong dgos/ tshes gsum nyin gu ge jo bdag po'i pho brang nang mchod 'bul byas rjes pho brang rtse thog la dar lcog btsugs shing yul lha dang rgyal po'i skyes lha gsol/ khong gi cho ga gtong rogs su chos g.yog gnyis dang khang gnyer gcig mdo sur zhes sur r+ṇa gtong mkhan gcig mtho lding dgon pa nas gnas skabs btang ba'i grwa ba bcu gsum bcas yod/ de tshe ri jo bas gza' 'khor gcig bsdad nas cho ga rgyas shos de btang zin par byed/ mdor na rtsa rang rdzong dpon skabs su'ang gna' srol de ma nyams par skyong bzhin yod do// khong der cho ga gtong ring la rtsa rang rdzong dpon nas lug sha sha khog gcig dang mar ltang chung ba gcig rtsam pa phri khug gang sprod par ma zad/ kho'i chos g.yog rgyugs mkhan khral rkang grong pa bdun yod pa de tshos nyin rer res mos byas te chos g.yog rgyugs pa sogs zhabs phyi legs par sgrub dgos/ de dus mda' pa'i bla ma dang / dung dkar/ mang nang sogs nas grwa pa re sku tshab btang nas jo bar ram 'degs 'thus shor med par byed dgos/ri pa yul na mchis pa'i ri jo ba'i sdod gnas pho brang ltar khang bzang legs po zhe drag yod cing / chos khang (ldebs ris la dam pa rigs brgya'i zhi khro'i lha tshogs cha tshang yod/)dang gcod khang (tsan dan shing dang gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i lha sku phon chen yod/)sogs yod pas yul phyogs ga sa gang nas 163

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dir phebs ba'i dad ldan mang tshogs mang pos chos mjal zhus shing / jo ba'i mthu sngags las sgrub pa'i rdzas cha nas 'bru dang byin 'dud bcas slong pas rtsa chen la bzung nas nyar tshags legs par byas te dud 'gro shed rgyas nas nad yams mi gos pa dang / lu ma'i lu mgor bzhag na chu dwangs gtsang chogs pa/ khang pa'i thog khar bzhag na thog mi rgyag pa/ lug rdzis btags na ri gzar rbab rdo mi phog pa/ rgyun du khyi smyon sogs 'gog pa bcas dge mtshan du ma yod skad do//ri jo ba ni mi rgyud mang po'i lo rgyus ldan pa'i jo ba grags can zhig yin cing / jo ba gzhan dag tshang ma nyams pa'am srid don sogs la nus pa chen po thon gyi med kyang khong ni mi rabs mang po'i ring srid gzhung la zhabs zhu mthil phyin pa zhu mkhan gyi jo ba dmigs bsal can zhig lags/ dus rabs nyi shu'i nang tsam nas bzung de'i shul 'dzin mkhan chos pa zhig dang chos g.yog gnyis yod/ khong tshos bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum bzhir ri pa nas rdog thon gyis rtsa rang rdzong ga la ba der bcar te lo mjug gi zhabs brtan sgrub dgos/ chos pa de'ang sngar gyi jo ba nang bzhin gza' 'khor gcig tsam rtsa rang rdzong du bsdad nas bskang gso gtong ba dang gtor ma bzhengs pa sogs chos phyogs kyi cho ga cha tshang sgrub kyin yod do//sngar gu ge rgyal po'am jo bdag po rim 'byung gi skabs su rgyal po'i pho brang gi gsham 'og shar ngos ri ldebs la lha khang bcu gsum yod pa ni jo ba bcu gsum gyi chos lugs cho ga dang phyag mchod/ rgyal por zhabs brtan sgrub sa'i gnas gal 'gangs shin tu che ba zhig yin/ lo gsar skabs su jo ba bcu gsum mnyam 'dzoms kyis rgyal po'i skyes lha gsol bar ma zad/ so 164

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/so'i yul lha'ang gsol gyin yod par grags/ gu ge rgyal po'i pho brang gi nub ngos su bde mchog dkyil 'khor yod/ de'i 'khris su mgur lha'i sku skyes pho brang zhes lcog shin tu che ba zhig mchis par de'i sbom phra ni skye pho'i 'dom pa bcu gsum yod skad/ gang lags she na/ lo ltar lha shing bcu gsum btsugs pas chen po de ltar chags/ lcog chen de la gzhis kyi mgur lha bcu gsum gnas yod skad/ de gsol dus yang ki ki swe swo lha rgyal lo// skyid do// bkra shis so//zer ro//rtsa rang rdzong dpon skabs su jo ba mang che ba nyams zin stabs ri jo bas kho tsho'i tshab byas nas mgur lha bcu gsum gsol ba dang gu ge'i yul lha mes ba'u la'ang gsol mchod sngar ltar byed/ de bzhin rtsa rang rdzong dpon la dmigs bsal zhabs phyi zhu dgos pa ni/ dbyar dus shang rtser bcar nas lo re'i rtsa rang rdzong mnga' khongs su byis pa lo bcu gsum la slebs pa tshang ma'i skag zlog gi cho ga byed dgos la/ mkhar rtse'i rgyal po dang chu mo ti dpon/ rag shag dpon bcas kyis gdan zhu ltar bcar nas zhabs brtan sgrub cing / skag zlog dang sri gnon gyi cho ga sna tshogs byed kyin yod pas ri jo ba de rtsa rang rdzong mnga' khongs kyi mi sna gal chen zhig dang rdzong gi don chen sogs la the jus byed thub mkhan dang nus pa thon mkhan med du mi rung ba zhig chags yod do//rtsa rang rdzong dpon skabs su ri pa'i yul gyi 'go 'dzin mkhan ni rgan po gcig dang / drung yig gcig bla ma gcig bcas yod/ kho tsho gsum po lo gsum re'i thog la brje po thengs gcig rgyag de dag ni yul 'dir mchis pa'i grong pa'i pha 'jon thang che la/ kha bde po ste gzhan gyis 'khrugs 165

༄khya//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtsod bslangs yar kha gtad gcog thub pa/ yul mi'i skyid sdug yar mar zhu thub cing rdzong dpon la bstun mkhas po yod pa sogs bsko'o// gal te bya ba gang yang sgrub ma thub par jus nyes sha stag byung tshe rdzong dpon gyi rta lcag yang se gzed dgos pas las sla po med/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs drug cu tsam la ri jo ba'i shul 'dzin chos pa des lcam dang phru gu gcig sring mo gcig nu bo grwa ba gcig bcas dang mnyam du phyi phyogs la bros byol phyin kyang bu mo gcig ri pa'i yul la lus par ming la sgrol ma zer/ khong dang bkra shis dge 'phel dgon gyi bum 'dzin bstan 'dzin lhun grub gnyis kha thug nas khyim zin gshis ri jo ba'am jo ba'i chos chas sogs rgyu dngos tshang ma kho gnyis kyis bdag po byed/‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’skabs su khong la dka' ngal 'phrad nas ca lag mang po gtor brlags song kyang chos rgyal yab yum sogs khag gcig sbas nas bzhag pa dag rjes su khos lo rtswa ba'i lha khang dkar po'i rten du phul lo//sngar lo rgyus thog la ri jo ba der rgyu nor gya nom yod pa ni/ skabs shig la rta brgya tsam yod cing / khong gu ge rtsa rang mkhar sogs phyogs la 'gro dus rta gral bsgrigs nas byon pas brjid nyams ha cang dod po yod skad/ri jo ba'i skor la yul mis sgrung sogs sna tshogs bshad rgyu 'dug pa dper na ri pa'i yul gyi nub ngos su lcang lung zhes shing nags mang po skyes pa'i dgun sa drod shin tu che ba zhig mchis pa la/ brjod srol la ri jo ba sku thog cig gi skabs su kha chems bzhag ste khong shi rjes phung po de rtswa med chu med lung pa skyo bo zhig la skyel rogs zhes mngags kyang de'i 'das mchod sgrub mkhan jo ba gzhan zhig gdan 'dren zhus gshis/ khos rkang btsugs ched mngag gis 166

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/phung po dgun sa'i ri rgyab drod yod sar bskyal nas rul du bcug nas nus mthu nyams par byed re ba bcangs kyang ri pa'i mthus byin rlabs la brten nas shing nags de ltar byung zer zhing / da dung yang brjod par ri jo ba'i zhing kha tshang ma sa khad cung dma' ba'i skya'u 'obs la 'debs kyin yod la/ri jo ba gcig gi sku thog la lo tog shin tu legs gshis sgo phyugs sems can rta g.yag ra lug sogs tshang ma bed spyod btang yang dbor ma thub par khong gi sring mos ri dwags gna' ba brgya phrag mang por ston thog bkal nas ser chag chag dbor yong gin yod ces ri jo ba dang khong gi nang mi tshang mar yul lha'i sgo phyugs ri dwags kyang bkol spyod byed thub pa'i nus pa dmigs bsal yod par grags so//ri jo bar mchod rdzas dang rgyan gos sna tshogs yod pa'i nang nas rin thang bral ba zhig ni lus yongs la khyab pa'i rus pa'i rgyan can cha tshang zhig yod pa de ni cho ga dang dbang gnang dus gyon gyin yod/ de'i rgyu cha tshang ma spus legs sha stag yin/ de ni ba so'i rus pa lhob mo stong phrag gcig dang rus pa lhob mo re re'i sgang la sangs rgyas kyi sku re brkos yod par sangs rgyas stong sku cha tshang sgyu rtsal rang bzhin ldan pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod do//sri gnon cho ga sri langs zhes pa de sa cha zhig la rkyen ngan gcig byung rjes de'i shul du rkyen ngan de ltar yang yang byung bar zer/ de ltar yang bskyar ma yong ba byed pa'am 'gog pa'i ched du de'i kha gnon la khyi mgo sogs rkyen ngan langs sa'i sa 'og la mnan pa'am sbas pa'i cho ga der sri gnon cho ga zer/ sri gnon gyi cho ga de ni ri jo bas sgrub pa'i dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i gna' srol zhig lags/ spyir btang yul der lo gsum re'i 167

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thog la thengs re byed kyang rkyen ngan byung na dus nges med du byed do//sri gnon byed skabs su ri jo bas mgo la zhwa nag rigs lnga'i cod pan dbyibs ldan zhig dang lus la'ang phod ka nag po gyon/ de ni sri ngan bdud nag btul bar gos nag gyon zhes pa de'o// sna khug dang mkhur tshos sgang la sbrul chung nag po'i 'dra ris 'bri/ klu bdud btul bar klu sbrul nag po dgos pa'i don/ lag g.yon la rta mgo can gyi phur pa (brjod srol la thengs gcig ri jo ba rtsa rang rdzong nas tshur log yong ba'i lam bar rta ku can la slebs nas tsha phog rgyag dus dka' las khag thag chod nas gnyid la zhur/ de tshe rting dum gyis gnod 'tshe byung ba'i khad la phur pa des rta skad 'tsher nas kho skrag thag chod nas snying rtsa 'dar gyin bros pas jo ba'i srog bskyabs/ de nas yul de'i ming la rta ku can zhes pa'i ming de byung skad/ rting dum ni mnga' ris yul skad de don du dred mong la go/gang lags she na/ dred mong tshang ma rting pa med pa ni skabs shig la rtas rdog brdzis btang nas bcad skad/ de nas bzung dred mong tshang mas rta'i skad go ba tsam gyis zhed thag chod nas bla 'dar gyi yod par grags) 'khyer cing g.yas la dmigs bsal lag cha gtsod kyi rwa co phra sbom snyoms la ring thung skyes pa dar ma cig gi 'dom pa phyed tsam yod pa de 'khyer/ des sa steng gang sar gzhus nas ldir sgra sgrog par dmigs nas lam seng thig sgor mo zhig rgyag pa dang phur pa de'i dbus su 'dzugs/ de nas phyag gcig la rdo rje dang gzhan zhig la dril bu khyer nas 'dre phu tshub (brjod srol la gnas nges med du rgyu zhing skor lhag dang bstun nas yong ba'i gdon 'dre zhig)zhes pa de dril bu'i nang du dam la btags/ de ma nyid shing sgrom nang la blug pa'i khyi mgo'i sgang na dril bu kha sbubs/ ḍā ma ru dkrol bzhin skad cig nyid du khyi mgo bskung sa'i sa dong gting ring thung khru 168

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i lho smad khul gyi ri jo ba'i skor rags tsam brjod pa/gang tsam 'dru/ khyi mgo de sa dong nang la ma bcug gong 'cham 'khrab pa'i phyag rgya byed cing kha 'don myur po 'don gyin mthu mtshams ma chad par brgyab te phyogs bzhi'i gdon 'dre las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul byas/ de nas khyi mgo la yar kha bcu gsum sgron/ khyi mgo'i ka li kha phye ste klad pa phyi la bton pa'i tshab la ling ka ste sne ma sna kha bcu gsum gyis bslas pa'i gdon 'dre gzugs can g.yag gi rtsid pa nag pos bsdams nas ka li'i nang la bcug rting ka li rang 'jags bsgrigs nas lug gi bal (zhi 'jam khu sim yong ba'i don/)nag pos kha mig rna cog sogs i khung yod pa thams cad bkag ra yi ral (kha chag sna ral mi yong bar brtan po yong ba'i don/)las bzos pa'i ral thag nag pos ka li bsdams nas sa dong nang la blugs/ dur khrod nas bsgrugs yong ba'i rdo leb mo bzhi yis dong kha bkag cing / de'i thog la thal ba dang bye ma zhib zhib bshos pa dang sbrags shag ma zhes rdo hrug 'ding /de'i sgang la rdo leb srab po cig 'jog par ma zad/ jo bas sngags rgyag cing gtsod kyi rwa cos sngags yig bris pa'i gtor ma zur gsum de rdo leb steng du mchod/ der rtswa la me spar dud gsur btang nas sri gnon cho ga mjug sgril/gal te khyi mgo med na de'i tshab la lug mgo bskung na'ang 'grigaspyir btang sri gnon cho ga lo gsum re la thengs re byed srol 'dug pa de la dus sri zer/ 'on tang yul la rkyen ngan byung na cho ga skabs 'phral du sgrub dgos so// thun mong min pa'i cho ga de yul 'dir ma zad/ za rang ru dpon dang bye dkar phyug po bcas kyis re ba zhus tshe ri jo ba sri gnon byed du 'gro dgos pas cha snyoms lo re la sri gnon thengs re byed dgos/ sri gnon byed yas thengs grangs mang drags na ri jo ba'i tshe srog la gnod 'tshe chen po 169

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pas khong gis las sla por khas len gyi med skad do//ri jo bas da dung mi shi ba'i bla srog ga par yod med dang phung po ga par skyel dgos min sogs rtsis rgyag cing lag len tshang ma byed par ma zad sku rim kyang tshang ma byed kyin yod pa ni dbus gtsang khul gyi rtogs ldan dang 'dra la sngags pa'am lha pa'am chos pa sogs kyi nus pa cha tshang thon gyin yod/ kho la lag rogs byed mkhan wa ba zhes skad gsang mthon pos rgyang skad btang nas ca lag ga re dgos min 'bod mkhan zhig yod par de'ang pha tsha bu rgyud du chos g.yog rgyugs shing mi tshang che khag gras shig yin/ yul gyi gtam dper yang jo ba la sku stod bcu gsum/ wa ba la smad do bcu gsum/ zhes kho la'ang 'gyed skal phon chen rag skad do//170

༄༅//mnga' ris nub khul gyi mtha' ba khams pa dang khu nu'i skor/mtha' ba khams pa/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i gong ste stod mnga' ris sgar dpon srid gzhung skabs su mtha' ba khams pa zhes dbyar dus stod mnga' ris sa khul la thon yong ba dang dgun dus rgya gar byang khul la gnas sdod byed mkhan khams pa mi tshang bcu gnyis yod pa der mnga' ris yul 'brog rong gsum gyi mi tshang ma'i kha rgyun du khams pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis zhes 'bod kyin yod do// de'i nang nas mi tshang brgyad phyug tsam dang mi tshang bzhi cung skyo tsam yod par grags so//mtha' ba khams pa de tsho thog ma smad khams khul gyi mi yin cing / kho tshos rang yul du rkun ma brgyab pa'am mi bsad pa/ kha mchu shor ba/ gyod gzhi bzos pa bcas kyi dbang gis rang yul la mu mthud sdod thabs bral nas yul gyar byed dgos byung / de yang dang thog slong mo slong bzhin thon yong ba dang mnga' ris yul du slebs rjes su rtag tu gnas nges med du 'khyam slong ltar 'tsho ba skyel la/ za yas med dus rkyang sha dang 'phyi ba'i sha za ༵༵ ma

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zad/ mtshams re shan pa dang 'dra bar yul mi khyim tshang pa'i sems can bsad de sdig gla blangs nas 'tsho thabs byed do// rjes su khong tshos dbyar dus 'brog pas sru bal bsdu skabs su khom pa med dus lug 'tsho rogs byas nas gla rin bal snyigs dang khu lu'i snyigs ma byung ba dag khu nu ba dang sgar zhwa ba'i tshong pa'i ras cha dang shing tog mngar cha sogs la brje po brgyab ste/ de nas byung ba'i ca dngos tshang ma 'brog pa phyi tshong la 'gro mi thub par btsong nas ma rtsa bsags te ma rtsa gang la gang 'tshams byung dus tshong tog tsam rgyag 'go tshugs shing / dbyar kha byang thang gi 'brog sar phyin nas spu bal sgrug pa dang dgun kha sa bab dma' sa mon yul rong la phyin nas rgya gar rong par btsong ste 'brog pa'i mkho chas ras cha dang shing tog mngar cha sogs khyer yong nas 'brog pa'i spu bal dang brje bo brgyab pa sogs byas nas tshong pa'i tshul du 'tsho ba skyel lo//phyis su khag cig 'jon thang che la dka' las rgyag thub tsang rim gyis phyug tsam chags nas mon yul la khang pa nyos nas gtan sdod byas shing /tshong don rgya cher spel bas rgyu dngos mi dman pa'i tshong par gyur/ des na kho tsho ni bod sde ba gzhung gi mi ser min cing khral kyang rgyag mi dgos la mon yul sogs khu nu rong pa dang / sgar zhwa rong pa/ la dwags sogs kyi khongs su yang mi gtogs pas rgya gar dang mnga' ris ga par the jus med par gnas nges med la sdod cing / yul gang gi yul khrims nang la'ang ma chud pa'i tshong don spel mkhan tshogs pa ya mtshan can mtha' ba khams pa zhes pa de yin no//kho tsho tshang mar mtha' ba khams pa zhes 'bod kyang don dngos su khong tsho'i nang gi re 'ga' zhig khams pa dang 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med/ dper na 172

༄7//mnga' ris nub khul gyi mtha' ba khams pa dang khu nu'i skor/dus rabs nyi shu'i snga char byung ba'i gong du brjod pa'i khams pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis zhes mtha' ba khams pa'i mi tshang bcu gnyis kyi dbu 'dzin g.yung drung mgon po ni ri bo dge lugs pa'i gdan sa gsum gyi ya gyal lha sa'i ser rwa dgon pa'i dge bskos zhes dgon pa'i khrims srung ba zhig yin/ kho shed shugs che la ru ngar ba/ spro thung bas grwa ba gzhan dang 'khrugs pa shor skabs khos grwa ba kha shas la nyes brdungs drag po btang bas de tshos 'khon lan slog par skrag nas rgya gar du bros byol du byon nas mthar thug mtha' ba khams pa'i tshong gi sgrig 'dzugs nang la 'dzul ba dang tshong lam rgyugs po byung nas phyug po chags shing / mtha' ba khams pa mi tshang bcu gnyis kyi dbu 'dzin du gyur par ma zad/ skye dman zhig btsal bar ming la bco lnga lha mo zhes so// de ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs sum bcu dang bzhi bcu'i nang la yin/thengs gcig khams pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi 'go dpon g.yung drung mgon pos bco lnga lha mo la rgya gar mon yul du yod pa'i tshong don gyi 'gan 'khur du bcug cing / kho rang lha sar tshong zog sgrug par phyin nas gos chen sogs tshong zog phon chen khyer ba dang sbrags chung ma gcig kyang khrid de g.yog po gsum tsam glas nas mon yul la log 'gro skabs su dbus gtsang khul du dgra zon dang jag zon chen pos mtshams re nyin gung du gnyid tog tsam nyal ba las nyin mtshan bstud mar ded shar btang nas yong gshis/ dus thung ngang mnga' ris bar ga rta zam khul du slebs/ yul de ni gnas chen gangs dkar ti si dang lha mtsho ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'khris su yod pas der yod mi tshang ma sdig sbyong dge sgrub mkhan gnas mjal ba sha stag yin pas dogs 'char de tsam byed mi dgos par bsam la/ lar na nyin mtshan bcu grangs 173

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ring dka' las shin tu khag pas blo bag phebs pa'i sgo nas mgo bo rta sgro'i sgang la bzhag nas dbugs ngal tog tsam gso dus rang dbang med par gnyid la bzhur/ de tshe g.yog po gsum po des ngan pa lag sbrel gyis kho'i mgo la tsha phog rgyag yas kyi sgyed pu'i rdo rtse rno ba zhig mchis pa de gzhus nas de ma thag tu bsad cing chung ma gsar pa de yang me mda' brgyab nas de ga rang ridu lnga ba'i lam du drangs te tshong zog rgyu dngos thams cad bcom khyer gyis lha sar logade tshe mon yul du yod pa'i bco lnga lha mos ha go nas dbus gtsang lha sa phyogs la ra mda' thengs mang mngags gtong byas kyang mtsho nang du bskyur ba'i rdo ril ltar rtsad gcod rtsa ba nas ma byung / de nas khams pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi 'go pa gu ru nyi mas byas/ khong 'jon thang che tsam dang kha bde lce mgyogs pa zhig yod kyang tshags 'dzud pa zhig byung med pas tshong pa de'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi stobs je chung du song ngo /mtha' ba khams pa de tsho rgya gar mon yul dang stod mnga' ris sgar dpon srid gzhung su phyogs la'ang khral rgyag mi dgos shing the jus byed dbang med kyang gal te mnga' ris su sdod ring yul 'brog rong gsum gyi mi ser dbar la rtsod rnyog dang 'khrugs rkyen sogs byung tshe bcu dpon dang 'go pa'am rgan po/ rdzong dpon sogs dpon po go gnas dma' rim nas mtho rim brgyud rim pas gtugs bsher byas nas thag gcod dgos/ dper na rtsa rang rdzong 'og gi mi ser cig dang mtha' ba khams pa dbar la 'khrugs rtsod rnyog 'dzing byung tshe thog ma bcu dpon la zhu dgos/ khos thag ma chod na 'go pa'am rgan por zhus/ —khos kyang thag gcod ma thub tshe rdzong dpon la zhu 174

༄7//mnga' ris nub khul gyi mtha' ba khams pa dang khu nu'i skor/gtugs byed dgos shing / da dung thag ma chod tshe sgar dpon dbu gur gong 'og la zhus rjes khong tshos thag gcod kyin yod par mtha' ba khams pas nor yod tshe rta lcag gzhu rkyang dang nyes chad gcod rkyang byed do// yang mtha' ba khams pa dang mon khu nu sogs dbar rtsod rnyog byung na khu nu'i ra rjas thag gcod byed dbang yod kyang khams pa'i 'go pa dang go bsdur byed kyin yod pas khams pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dog por sgril nas sdod pa dang de'i nang nas 'jon thang che ba 'go par bskos pa sogs la don dag med pa min/mtha' ba khams pa dag la phyis su sgrig 'dzugs yod cing / yul ga par slebs kyang yul de'i yul khrims 'khur gyin yod gshis khong tsho tshong sa rong dang / stong po ra'i tshong rwa/ rgya nyi ma'i tshong rwa sogs ga par slebs kyang 'gro sdod chog pa las sgar dpon srid gzhung nas khong tshor rnyog dra bslangs dbang med cing / khu nu sogs mon yul mi rigs kyis kyang dgun dus mtha' ba khams pa rgya gar la sdod ring dka' ngal chen po dang 'phrad dus bsam pa rnam dag gis rogs 'degs byed kyin yod pa'i rgyu rkyen yang mtha' ba khams pa khag cig rgyu dngos stobs chen chags nas kho tshor skabs 'gar re ba bcol ba'am rogs 'degs zhu dgos pa bcas so//khu nu/ stod mnga' ris sgar dpon sbrel pos srid dbang skyong skabs mnga' ris yul 'brog rong gsum la tshong don du bcar mkhan phyi mtha'i tshong pa mang dag cig yod par la dwags dang / sgar zhwa/ nyung ti/ nyi ri/ khu nu sogs 175

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal phran dang tsho pa du ma'i khongs mi'o// lhag par du dbyin ji'i 'og tu tshud pa'i khu nu ba mang po zhig lo ltar re bzhin dbyar dus mtshams ma chad par thon yong gin yod/ mnga' ris yul 'brog mi ser gyis khong tshor khu nu bdun stong bdun brgya (khu nu'i yul la gnas sdod byas pa'i mi 'bor)zhes brjod/khong tsho yong sa lte ba stong po ra'i tshong rwa yin cing der zla shas bsdad zin nas byang thang phyogs kyi 'brong pa seng stod seng smad dang / dge rgyas/ gzhung pa/ yag ra/ bse le phug bse 'khor/ sger rtse/ tha na phyogs bcu dang nag tshang / sga cha/ bkra bsam/ gnam ru bcas su spu bal dang lpags rigs bsdu bar 'gro bzhin yod/khu nu'i tshong pa phon chen zhig lo ltar re bzhin mnga' ris byang 'brog khul du yong bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis mnga' ris yul mi dang rtsod rnyog thengs mang yong gin yod/ de dus tshong dpon dang mnyam du bka' mol byas nas thag ma chod tshe thad kar phyi gling pa dbyin ji dang 'brel gtug byas nas thag gcod dgos/ yang khu nu nang tshags la 'khrugs rtsod dang dka' rnyog byung na'ang phyi gling pa dbyin ji'i dpon por zhu gtug rgyag dgos kyi yod/ kho tshos mnga' ris sa khul du tshong rgyag pa phud da dung phyi gling pa'am rgya gar la dbang sgyur byed mkhan dbyin ji ste ya gling gi phyi nas yong mkhan de'i tshong 'brel skor dang yi ge sogs 'phrin skyel gyi las 'gan yang khur yod pas sgar dpon sbrel po dang yang se 'brel ba yong gin yod/ des na stod mnga' ris srid gzhung nas khong tshor dmigs bsal gyi lta skyong dang mthong chen byed dgos pa las gang byung snang med 'jog pa'ang khyad gsod byas na rtsa ba nas mi 'grig dper na kho tshos dbyin ji la gzhus pas na dbyin jis thad kar lha 176

༄7//mnga' ris nub khul gyi mtha' ba khams pa dang khu nu'i skor/sa'i sde pa gzhung la snyan zhu 'bul tshe sgar dpon gnas dbyung gtong ba'i nyen kha yod pas so// lhag don du sgar 'char can la bcar nas tshong don rgya chen spel dus rogs skyor shugs che tsam byed dgos gshis/ phyis su khu nu'i tshong pa stobs je cher phyin pa'ang rgyu mtshan med pa min/ khu nu pa 'tsho sdod byed khungs ni hi ma la ri rgyud kyi lho phyogs rnam rgya dang / khab/ spu/ ka nam bcas glang chen gtsang po'i 'gram ngogs ga la ba der sdod kyin yod/de bzhin stod mnga' ris khul du tshong don la yong mkhan la dwags dang sgar zhwa ni seng ge gtsang po'i gtsang rgyud ded nas bde mchog dang lcang gcig ma brgyud de stod bkra shis sgang nas thon yong bzhin yod la/ khong tsho mang che ba dmangs khrod du tshong shag btsal nas sdod kyin yod pas mnga' ris mang tshogs dang tshong 'brel ha cang dam po yod do//177

༄//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran tsam bajod pa/stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs la dbye na lo 'khor bcu gnyis te sems can bcu gnyis gzhir bzhag gi mo dang / ril nag dgu skor gyi mo/ lde'u brgyad skor gyi mo/ phreng ba'i mo/ ge sar mgyogs sang zhes pa'i mgyogs mo/ lha mo dmag zor gyi sho mo bcas yod/ 'brog pa tshos mo rgyag pa'i dmigs yul ni phyugs zog sems can bor brlag byung tshe mgyogs ngang myur du rnyed thub min dang / nang mi phyogs la thon tshe bde legs ngang log thub min/ nang la nad pa yod tshe myur du bcos thub bam drag skyed yong min/ de bzhin tshong lam rgyugs min/ ri dwags gang mang gsod thub min/ sems can la dkar chu legs po yong min/ re'u lu gu be'u sogs mang nyung ji tsam 'tsho sdod byed thub min/ pho mo'i gnyen 'brel sogs don chen sgrub tshe bya ba lam 'gro yong min/ yul la lo legs yong min/sa bcud yul bcud nyams 'gro min/ yul la rkun jag dgra sogs yong min/ drag po'i dmag brgyab na rgyal kha thob min bcas gsal po shes rgyu'i ched du lags so//17ṭāng po/ sog pa'i mo/ sog pa'i mo zhes pa ni lug gi sog pa ste lug

༄༅//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran tsam brjod pa/gi lag pa g.yas pa'i rta rdzi rkang dang bar rkang gnyis dang 'brel ba'i rus pa zur gsum 'dra ba der brjod/ sog pa de'i yu bar bal dkar nag gnyis dkris shing rtse la mar ram tshi lu'i yar kha brgyab te zhugs me'i dbus su bzhag nas gang 'tshams shig na skya ling nger chags pa'am skad tshag ces brgyab pa dang sbrags phyi la bton/ grang sang btang ma thag de'i logs la ser ka 'dra min sna tshogs gas yod pa der brtag nas legs nyes ci yong blta ba de ni sog mo zhes pa de'o// yang khag cig gis me sgong sog pa'i rgyab logs ther ther sgang la bzhag rjes su/ mo rgyag mkhan des sog pa grang sang gtong ba de lag nang la 'jus nas g.yab g.yab lan gsum byas rjes su kha nas ‘‘mo thig mo thig lha sog dkar po'i mo thig jus rgyugs jus rgyugs btsan sog dmar mo'i jus rgyugs/ bzang ngo bzang ngo klu sog sngon mo'i skal ba bzang mi zhes shing / rtags mtshan legs nyes ci mchis brtag yang mi mang dag cig gis dgong mo nyal khar sog pa me nang la bsregs shing mtshan sgang bzhag nas nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs pa yar langs ma thag rtags mtshan la bltas nas brtag dpyad byed do//sog pa'i dbus su rus pa khyur rer thon pa zhig yod pa de'i g.yon phyogs gzhong gzhong chung ba de grogs sa dang g.yas phyogs kyi gzhong gzhong che ba der dgra sa zhes brjod pas de'i dbus su gri rtse btsugs nas gtor tsam byed srol yod/ de'i thog la ser ka gas pa thams cad rang la rgyal kha chen po thob pa'i rtags yin/ sog mo de ri dwags rgyag mkhan dang / jag rgyag mkhan/ dmag rgyag mkhan gyis mthong chen byed cing / lhag don du dmag rgyag dus dpyad mkhas po byung na ha cang tig po yod skad/ dper na ser ka 179

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dgung sum dkyil la gas yod na grogs ngo dang gzhung gshags la gas yod na mgyogs ngo yin te ri dwags mang che ba gsod thub ba'am dgra bo mang che ba gtor thub pa mtshon pas rang gi don dag tshang ma sgrub thub kyin yod par grags/ dus mtshungs su sog pa'i ser ka gas tshul thog nas don dag ci rigs la blta yas yod de/ dper na/ za yas 'thung yas rgyu nor longs spyod 'phel 'grib ji 'dra yong min bcas so// sog pa'i yu rtse lhum lhum nang la mar khu sogs lbu bas khengs yod na bang mdzod nor gyis khengs zhes phyug po chags pa'i rtags mtshan yin/ ri dwags rgyag tshe de nyin ri dwags phon chen gsod thub pa'i rtags yin/ sog pa'i rtse'i rked der ser kha 'phred la gas tshe tshe mjug la dbul phongs thon 'gro ba'i don yin/ rked kyi gzhung phyogs su rang sar gas yod na mi de tshe thung thung zhig las sdod kyi med skad/ dgra sa'i rked mgo la ser kha gas yod tshe dgra dpung bcag ces rgyal kha thob rgyu mtshon/ dgra sar yar gyen la gas yod na dgra bo bros nas thub glags mi rnyed pa mtshon/ — dbus su gas yod na dgra sa gtor zhes bzang ltas su 'dzin/ sog pa'i yu bar ser ka 'phred la gas yod tshe mu ge'i sgrog thag bcad ces don dag gang yang sgrub mi thub pa'i ltas/ sog pa'i thog gi khyur khyur de'i rked chod la gas yod na don dag bsam don bzhin sgrub thub pa'i ltas/ sog pa'i mo de dgos pa yod na ga dus brgyab kyang 'grigaganyis pa/ lde'u yi mo/ de ni lde'u rdog che chung mi 'dra ba brgyad lag mthil sbar mo'i nang la blugs te lag sor snyim pa bkums nas dkrug dkrug thengs mang btang rjes su lag g.yas kyi sbar nang la grangs ka mang nyung ci tsam thon pa de gzhir bzhag gis brtag gyin yod de/ gcig thon tshe lha ngo mtho 180

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran trem brjod pa/zhing mgyogs ngo yin/ gnyis thon na kha tshig brtan pa'i mis skad cha shod ngo red/ de mjug lde'u che na mkhar rgyug phyi la thon zhes yag rtags red/gsum ni che lde'u sngon la babs na lha ngo mtho ba dang bar la babs na grogs ngo /rting mthar babs na grogs kha phyi shor zhes rgyu yin na 'bor gtor yong bar brjod/ bzhi ni mi la yin na kha so can gyi gyod kha nas thar zhes mi nad pa'i nad gzhi drag skyed chen po gong ba'i rtags/ che lde'u sngon la babs na gzhi khams bde po dang yag po yong / che lde'u bar la babs na mo bzhi kha brtan po zhes lam seng 'gyur ba mi yong ba brtan po'i don/ che lde'u phyis su babs na phyi sa bzhi gnas zhes 'byor na lam seng 'byor ba dang ma 'byor tshe dus yun ring po zhig lus 'gro ba'am 'gor 'gyangs yong bar 'dzin gyin yod/lnga ni che lde'u de sngon ma dang bar ma la babs na dmar ngo yin zhes ri dwags gsod ngo dang mi la kha ya so can gyi mo zhes spyir btang yag po yin par 'dzin/sems can stor brlag byung na lam ngo yin pas tshur mgyogs po sleb sa red ces pa'o// che lde'u mjug tu babs na lam ngo zhes legs po zhe drag yin/drug ni che lde'u snga rting ci la babs kyang ltag drug ces mo yag por brtsi/bdun ni nor dang nag mo'i don du babs pa yin na yag por brtsi/ de'ang che lde'u sngon la babs na lha ngo mtho po mi 'dug ces legs ngo min/ bar la babs na nor nag mo zhes nag gsum gyi sa thob ces yag por brtsi/ brgyad ni rjes 'dren zhes lam seng mi slebs pa'i 'gor ngo yin/gsum pa/ lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi mo/ lde'u 'am dbyugs pa'am 'gron bu sogs nag po bcu gcig dang dkar po gcig (lde'u skya ril ma zhes brjod/)khyer nas byi ba/ glang / stag yos/ 'brug sbrul/ rta/181

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lug sprel/ bya/ khyi/ phag ces rim gyis 'bod kyin lde'u mar gtong ba'i tshe skya ril de ga par 'khel ba der brtsis te gnyis par babs na glang dang drug par babs na sbrul bcas sems can bcu gnyis kyi ming ltar rtags mtshan ci yod med blta'o// de'ang lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi mo 'debs dus 'go tshugs pa'i tshe 'di ltar brjod pa ni/ lo 'khor zla ba bcu gnyis/zhag ma gsum brgya drug bcu// gling gi dpa' brtul sum cu// seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul// mo 'bob cig mo 'bob cig/ bla ma dkon mchog gi mo 'bob// spra dang spre'u yang rtsal che// mi nor phyugs gsum lha dang mnyam//yul zog gong nas gong du 'phel// yul mi thams cad lam 'gro shog/yul bsod yar ngo'i zla dang mnyam// yul la bkra shis nyi ma shar// zhes so// lo 'khor so so'i mtshon rtags ci 'dra yin min gsham gsal ltar te/byi ba dkar pos rang mgo thon// lha chen tshangs pa rgyang so tshugs// rkang mi yong nas ra bzhi bsdus// zhes yag po yin te ri dwags yin na gsod thub cing dgra bo yin na btul thub bo// glang po ches skyid pa'i rkang pa phar brkyangs// drod ldan nyi ma tshur la lde// zhes pa'am skyid pa'i nyi ma tshur lde//sdug pa'i ba mo phar zhur// zhes so// sems can gtor ba'am ri la song na bsdad yod ces mo gzhi chen po yod/ glang po che dpyid kyi nyi ma mgo nas shar// sdod kyi tshe rogs rkang nas bsus// zhes legs ngo yin/ stag mi dmar rta dmar btsan gyis skyobs// srung ma rnams kyis bdud dag btul//zhes rlung rta mthon po dang bya ba lam 'gro yong ba'i rtags so// yos tsog se sdod nas dkug se byas// 'gro 'dod gom pa rlung gis bskyod// 'gro mi thub phyag gsham bye mas mnan// zhes 'gro dgos pa zhig la 'gro mi bde ba 182

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran tsam brjod pa/zhig ste gnas tshul col chung bar yod pas don dag legs po zhig sgrub mi thub par mngon/ 'brug khag khog khug khog stong pa red// skad grags che yang char pa med// 'ja' kha la yod kyang don mi smin// zhes phyi nas skad grags che yang don dngos thog don dag gang 'grub mi thub pa'i don no// sbrul nor bu klu yi sgo zog yin// don bya ba ci byas bzang ba'i rgyu// zhes mgyogs ngo yin te don dag mgyogs po 'grub pa'i don yin/ rta bo yul khams skor ba 'dra// mi bo gnyid la shor ba 'dra// bya bo tshang la nyal ba 'dra// grogs ngo yin kyang zhi che ba// 'gor yun ring tsam yong ba'i don/ lug rgyal po khri la bzhugs/ brgya byin gdan la bzhugs/ rgyal mtshan dbang gis 'dus/skad grags gtam snyan rgyang nas go/ zhes so so sems khral med par skyid por bsdad kyang don dag lhun gyis 'grub thub pa'i don/ spra dang spre'u yang rtsal che// mi nor phyugs gsum lha dang mnyam// zhes don dag nges par sgrub thub pa'i don/ bya de khyung chen gshog rtsal che// bya sgro dar nas nam 'phang gcod// ja tsha gcig la ma 'byor na// nyin zhag bdun la mi slebs pa'o// zhes lam seng 'grub ma thub tshe nam yang 'grub thabs zad pa'o//khyi rnga nag dbyugs nas bya nag srung // gtor ma dmar po me ltar 'bar//chos skyong rnams kyis da mgyogs// srung ma rnams kyis da myur// zhes de mgyogs ngo yin pas da lta rang lam seng rgyugs pa'am phyin tshe don dag myur du 'grub pa'o// phag mjug ma zang zing gnas sa slog/ dus tshod skal ba me ltar 'bar// rgyal po'i gsung dang mthun min tshe// bya ba 'grub pa'i re ma byed// ces grogs ngo yin kyang rgyal po'i bka' nang bzhin don ma sgrub tshe rnyog 'dra yong gi yod ces gal te bya ba de yag po ma byung tshe bar chad sogs 183

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yong gi yod pa'i don no//bzhi pa/ ril nag dgu bskor/ ra lug gi ril ma nag po dgu khyer nas gcig la rtags brgyab ste/ de dang por babs na gcig ri bo 'grim nas bstan pa dar zhes rlung rta shin tu mtho ba'i rtags dang las ka gang dang ci byas kyang 'grub thub pa'i don/ gnyis par babs na gnyis mi hreng kha nas gtam bzang khyer// pho rog kha las sha bzang khyer// zhes skad cha'am gtam zhig mgyogs po go ngo yod pa'am grogs zhig 'khor grabs yod pa'i don/ gsum par babs na gsum seng ge dkar mo khri la bzhugs zhes lhing po dang skyid po byas nas bsdad pa'i don yin kyang don dag 'grub mi thub/bzhi par babs na bzhi nyi ma dros nas gling bzhi skor zhes don dag sgrub pa la dka' ba spyad nas gang sar 'gro dgos zhes so// lnga par babs na lnga zla ba lta bus mun pa gsal zhes lam seng nam langs pa nang bzhin don dag mgyogs myur du 'grub thub par go dgos/ drug par babs na drug chu 'thung wa mo sga la thebs zhes bar chad yong nas don 'grub mi thub bo//bdun par babs na bdun sha gzan spyang pho de ri la 'grim zhes bya ba sgrub par phyin kyang don dag rtsa ba nas mi 'grub par lag stong kha stong byas nas 'gro ba'i don no// brgyad par babs na brgyad pho rog grog yag khyim la 'gugs zhes don dag che chung ci zhig byas kyang grub thub bo// dgu par babs na dgu skyes pa'i mi la ming dang byas pa'i bya ba'i don dgos zhes don dag tshang ma blo 'dod bzhin 'grub thub par brjod do//lnga pa/ phreng ba'i mo/ mo de ni mi dang phyugs kyi na tsha drag skyed yong min dang / ca lag stor brlag phyin tshe rnyed min/ sems can ri khrod du 184

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i mo rgyag lugs skor phran tsam brjod pa/shor na 'du min/ ri dwags gsod thub min/ dmag rgyag dus dgra ngan btul thub min bcas tshang mar rgyag srol yod/ phreng mo ni dngos su rgyag mkhan des mkhas po gcod shes pa dang don gnad la 'khel thub pa dgos/ma gzhi mo de sus rgyag na'ang 'grigs mod kyang don dag legs po zhig gcod ma shes na go ba log par rtogs nas don chen grub rgyu lta ci don chung yang 'grub mi thub bo// rgyag dus phreng rdog brgya dang bcu med brgyad yod pa'i phreng sgor lag nang la bcug nas phur phur len gsum btang rting lag pa gnyis kyis bzung nas lag pa re'i skyo mdzub dang mthe bong gis mtshams shig gcod de phyi nas nang phyogs la phreng rdog gsum re nur shug gis grangs ka mi 'dra ba ci rigs babs pa de la 'grel bshad gsham gsal ltar rgyag gin yod pa ni/ gcig lha ngo mtho la mgyogs ngo che zhes rlung rta mtho la don dag myur du 'grub thub pa'i don/ gnyis pho rog sha khyer ri mgo'i rtse la 'grims//gtam bzang lung pa'i sbug la 'khor// zhes ri dwags rgyag mkhan yin tshe dus rgyun thug rgyu med kyang de ring thug cing grogs bzang 'khor ba'i don/gsum gzugs ring can gyis bltas na mthong // rting pa bkyag bkyag byas na mthong // skad 'bod can gyis bos na go/ btsog se song na har se thug/ces mgyogs ngo yin/ bzhi bya rog sbyang ma'i rgyugs lam la// kha g.yar sa'i btso ngo phran bu bsam// nyi ma dros nas gling bzhi skor// zhes ma gzhi legs sam kha brtan kyang lab ngo gleng ngo tog tsam 'dug zer bas 'gog rkyen phran bu 'phrad rgyu'i don/ lnga mdzo mo la dgu lung dgu bud// gyi ling rta bos 'gugs nas bkugs// zhes dud 'gro brlags pa 'du sa 'dug/ ri dwags gsod pa'i skal ba 'dug/ 'grul ba 'gog rkyen med par slebs 185

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas kyi don no// drug rgyal po gser khri'i thog la bzhugs// btsun mo dngul khri'i thog la bzhugs// rgya (rgya gar la go) rgyal pos bod la ham mi thub// mgo rgya gling gis brdungs kyang de mi shi// zhes rgyal po chen po dang btsun mo khri thog la bsdad de btsan po dpe med yin gshis sus kyang las sla bor gtor mi thub pa ni don dag 'grub kyang dka' ba che tsam 'phrad pa'i don yin/ bdun a ma mi yi yul du song // khyos ma rang gi yul la 'khur//zhes grogs ngo ha cang che bas don chen 'grub thub par go/ brgyad rgyal mtshan mgo nas nyi ma shar// pho skya bo yin na rang mgo thon// ban chos pa yin na chos mgo thon// skya bos skya srid bskyangs bas srid don 'grub//ban bla grwas chos 'go thon nas skya mi babs// zhes chos srid ci rung yang rang rkya 'dzin thub pa dang / brtan po/ ha cang phun sum tshogs po yong ba'i don/ dgu rnga nag 'brong gcig ma bsad na// mgo nag mi zhig thug sa 'dug/ ces don der dpag pas dka' las tog tsam yod kyang mthar 'grub thub pa'i don no// mdor na mo de dus nges med dang dmigs yul ci rigs gang la brgyab kyang 'thus so//186

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags chon lugs skor brjod pa/yangs shing mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du phyugs zog sems can dgung sngon gyi rgyu skar 'tshogs pa ltar brjod kyis mi lang bar ma zad/ ri dwags kyang shin tu mang ba grangs kyis gzhal bar dka' ba ni thang la gnas pa'i dgo ba smug chung dang / khra chung gtsod/ rdza la gnas pa'i bre ser 'brong / brag rir gnas pa'i sngon mo'i gna' ba/g.ya' rir gnas pa'i rwa rgyal gnyan bcas yod la/ gcan gzan rigs kyang mod mi dma' ba mchis te rdza ri dang brag gseb tu gnas pa'i rting rdum dhimam dred mong / yul lha'i sgo khyir grags pa'i gcan gzan te sa rgan dhidang g.yi/ wa mo/ bre ze bcas yod/ byang thang 'brog pa tsho'i ri dwags rgyag pa'i gna' srol goms lugs de ni mi lo stong phrag mang po'i ring rim gyis chags pa zhig yin/ 'on te khong tshos 'phyi ba dang ri bong rngon gyin med pa ni 'phyi ba sgom chen zhes de ni dmigs bsal gyi nus pa yod pa'i sems can zhig yin par bsam zhing / ri bong ni sho to yin pas ltas ngan zhig la 'dzin gyi yod/ ri dwags dag rngon lugs sna tshogs ldan kyang gcan gzan rigs spyir btang sga ba dubatsugs nas gsod pa mang ngo //de yang khyi ra ba tshos ri dwags rgyag par ma song gong la smon lam di~Xḍis

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsal zhig 'debs kyin yod pa ni/ khyi ra mgon po rdo rje/ khyi mo long spyang dmar mo/ me mda' thog bla dmar chung / sha kham ma shugs skyed ma/lham sna la btso (slo/)'gos rgyu yong ba shog phyu pa la khrag 'gos rgyu yong ba shog sbo dkar po gnam la blang rgyu yong ba shog shul srug smug sa la sbyor rgyu yong ba shog ces pa de'o//byang thang 'brog pa'i khyi ra ba tshos brjod pa ltar spyir btang byas na nyin gcig ring ri dwags rngon pa'i dus tshod legs shos ni zhogs pa snga po dang phyi dro bsil grib 'gugs tsam la yin skad/ gang lags she na/ ri dwags mang che ba mtshan mo'i ring mtshan gang dang zhogs pa tsha ba ma bab bar du rtswa za gi yod/ tsha ba thog ma slebs pa dang nyal sdod pas de dus btsal kyang rnyed dka' po zhe drag yod/ dgong dag grib bsil 'gugs tsam la yang bskyar yar langs nas chu 'thung ba dang rtswa za mgo tshugs gshis de dus btsal na rnyed bde'o// de bzhin lo gcig dus bzhi'i nang ston ka ni ri dwags rngon pa'i dus shin tu yag pa zhig te de tshe ri dwags yod do cog sha shed ha cang legs po yod/ rngon pa tsho pho lo bco lnga slebs tshe ri dwags rngon pa'i thob thang ldan pas khyi ra rgan dang mnyam du phyin nas ri dwags rngon lugs cha tshang ba khong du chud pa byed do// yang rang lo drug cu yol tshe srog gcod spangs shing sdig bshags tshul du gnas ri dang gnas mtsho skor bar ma zad/ rdo la ma ṇi brkos shing mchod rten sogs kyang bzhengs par 'bad do// gsham du ri dwags rigs mi 'dra bar rngon lugs mi gcig pa'i skor rags tsam brjod rgyu yin/'brong gi skor/ 'brong ni byang thang gi nor bu yin zhes shing g.yag lta 188

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/bu'i bkol spyod byed yas med kyang sha lpags rus gsum ni shin tu go chod pas so// de la dbye na 'brong g.yag chen dang / 'brong 'bri/ 'brong be'u/(logacig ma/) lo gnyis sug ser/ lo gsum ar/ bzhi lo so gnyis/lnga lo so drug drug lo kha tshang / bdun lo bdun tshigs lo brgyad nas bzung rwa co'i tshigs ris kyi rim pa la gzhigs te tshigs ris gcig dang tshigs ris gnyis gsum bzhi zhes 'bod do// de bzhin tshon mdog ngos nas dbye na 'brong rog po dang / kham pa/ zal pho/ bre ser/ tha na dkar po dang sngon po yang yod skad/ 'brong gsod dus lhag phyogs la rgyab kyis phyogs nas thag nye por bcar cing / 'jab mda' brgyab te spyir btang snying dbus dang rgyu ma(rgyu mar 'khel tshe lam seng ma shi yang gang ltar nyin shas rjes su 'chi bar nges/)dpral dbus su 'khel ba byed dgos/ de min na gzugs gzhi ga par phog kyang 'brong ko shin tu mthug la bod mda'i mde'u yang shugs dben pas rmas pa tsam las lam seng gsod mi thub/ gal te rmas ma chags tshe des mi la shin tu sdang zhing tha na gsod kyi yod/ gzhan yang 'brong la 'brong khyi gtong ba'ang yod de/ ras thag gi sring skud gru bzhi bslas pa zhig gzi tshwa dkar po blug pa'i chu'i nang la rgyun ring tsam sbang ste ngar chud rjes su yar bton nas skam bsang bzos/ de'i sne gcig la me spar la sne gcig me chib pa dang lam seng chad 'gro yas kyi bal skud phra mor sgrog cing bal skud de'i sne mo khyi'i ske skor la btags te glod dus khyis 'brong sne bkugs pa dang 'brong tshang ma zi tshwa'i du bar zhed thag chod cing / 'khyil nas sdod pa'i tshe khyi ras thag nyer bcar te me mda' brgyab nas ga tshod gsod gsod yin/ yang 'brong la sgog rtse btsugs nas gsod pa'i lugs srol 189

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyang yod de sgog rtse'i rnyi thag ha cang sbom po dang rwa co bco lnga nas bcu drug bar dgos/ 'brong rnyi'am sgog rtse mang che ba 'brong chu la bab sa dang rdza ri'i lam phreng dog po 'brong lam zhes pa'i dmigs bsal lam chung bcas su 'dzugs/ 'brong la sgog rtse btsugs dus spyir btang dgun dus legs/rgyu mtshan ni sa dong nang 'khyag pa chen po chags pas shugs ci tsam che yang 'then mi thub bo//spyir btang byas na 'brong g.yag chen zhes na so rgan por slebs pa dang 'brong spo ba ('brong thug ste 'bras bu ma bton par brjod/) gcig re tsam byas nas rdza khrod dang g.ya' khrod 'grims nas sdod pa las 'brong byings dang mnyam du mi 'gro/ 'brong 'bri ni khyu dang khyu byas nas sdod pa las re gnyis kyis khyer rkyang du 'gro gi med/ khyi ras 'brong bsad zin rjes su rgyu ma dang glo mchin grod pa sogs nang khrol thams cad 'don/ de nyin 'brong gi sha khog de gsod sar kha sbub nas nyal ba'i dbyibs ltar bzos nas bzhag cing de'i mtha' bzhir tho po 'ga' shas slong zhing gos slog mang tsam sgrog la/thag pas bya ra zhes tho po phan tshun la a bkra pa bkra btang / log 'gro dus 'brong gsod mkhan des rnga ma rked gzhogs g.yas par sgrog gi yod pas yul mis de mthong ba dang de ring 'brong bsad nas grogs byung bar shes te 'brong gsod mkhan de skad grags chod kyi yod/ sang nyin zhogs pa snga po nas g.yag ded de yul gyi skyes pa mang che ba thon nas 'brong sha len du 'gro dgos/'brong chen po yod na sha khog gcig la g.yag rgyab brgyad tsam yod/ 'brong sha len mkhan tshos 'brong mgo'i ya kha dang ma kha gnyis bkral te ya kha'i dpral ba'i sgang gi gdong lpags bshus (pags pa des rta sgro bzo ba'am lham mthil la 190

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/brgyab na spus ma yin/)shing rwa co bkog('brong gi rwa co bkog nas khyer 'gro yod par ra lug gi 'o ma 'jo sa'i snod legs po zhig la 'dzin/) de nas dpral mgo spyi gtsugs su i khung chung chung zhig brtol nas dar lcog btsugs pa dang sbrags gzhi bdag la dgongs dag thugs gdan zhu ba'am mchod pa zhu ba'i don yin pas de 'brong gsad sar bzhag de bzhin lce le sogs za yas la khyer 'gro'o//'brong g.yag chen rdza ri'i khrod nas mar bab yong ste yul gyi g.yag khrod la 'dres tshe lo der nor g.yag mang du 'gro zhing phyug po chags kyi yod pa'i mtshon rtags yin par grags/ yang g.yag gi spo ba (g.yag pho sha ma bcad pa/)'brong 'bri la shor nas be'u khrid na 'brong tsha zhes des mi la gnod pa chen po byed/ dus mtshungs su 'brong kha sa zhes pa 'brong 'bri'i be'u chung dus a ma dang mnyam du sdod pa'i tshe khyi ra bas me mda' sogs brgyab nas 'bri mo gsod cing be'u de gcig por lus tshe khos chung dus dud 'gro'i khrod du rgyugs yong nas dud 'gro chung chung dag la gnod pa byed pa dang / g.yag gu dang lo gsum chags nas sgo phyugs dud 'gro'i dkyil la rgyugs yong ste shed shugs zhan pa dag la brdungs nas gsod la/ de bas che ru lon tshe gcig por sdod pa las khyu dang mnyam du ma 'dres pa dang rta lug sems can la sdang sems drag po bcangs shing / lhag par du mi la dmigs bsal gnod pa chen po skyel gyin yod la nyen ha cang chen po bzo gi yod/ gang lags she na/ khos a ma gsod pa'i dgra sha len tshul lags so// 'brong gsod yas kyi dus tshod legs shos ni bod zla bdun pa ste 'brong pho mo sdeb sbyor ma byas gong la yin/de tshe sha la tshi lu mang la ko ba'ang mthug po yod par ma zad/ spus tshad ha 191

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/cang yag po yod/ khyi ra bas 'brong bsad ma khad me mda'i kha mdel khung gi rma yod sar 'byug nas rjes sor mu mthud mang po gsod thub pa'i re smon bcangs/ de yang thog ma byang khog dbral nas snying khrag blangs te tsha bor 'thung / de nas ko ba bshu zhing grod khog gshags te nang khrol yod do bton nas sha lag rim gyis dkrol lo//rkyang gi skor/ rkyang zhes pa ni bong bu'i rigs kyi ri dwags shig yin/de la dbye na pho chen dang / rgod ma/ thu ru/(rti'u/)co pa bcas so// de ni ya so can rta'i rigs kyang yin gshis rkyang sha za mkhan nyung nyung yin/ lar na de'i sha la shul dri zhes lcags kyi dri ma dugs pa can zhig ldan pas sha rigs btsog par 'dzin gyin yod/ de gsod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gcig nas ko bar dmigs pa te ko ba dmigs bsal mthug cing / lham mthil la brgyab tshe dgun thog gcig tsam thub kyi yod/ yang rkyang gi tshi lu ha cang 'jam mnyen ldan la ngar bcud kyang che bas dgun dus su rta g.yag dang ra lug gi rmig par 'byug pas na rmig pa legs po gso thub bo// 'on tang gangs skyon chen po byung nas 'tsho ba shin tu dkon dus bsad de za rigs la'ang spyod kyin yod/rkyang gsod dus ri khug dang chu mgo sogs la 'jab mda' rgyag gi yod par ma zad/ thabs shes legs shos ni sha khyi ngar ma lnga drug tsam 'khrid nas zhogs pa snga por phyin te thog ma bul shos de gtong zhing / de nas rim gyis khyi mgyogs la shugs che ba res mos kyis glod de dgong dag bsil grib 'gug tsam la rkyang gi gzugs po yongs rdzogs jul cingangachu'i dkyil du bcug pa ltar nag sang chags nas bros mi thub pa'i tshe me mda' brgyab te gsod kyi yod/rkyang khag gcig khyu 'brel nas mnyam du sdod cing / de'i nang nas gcig 192

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/gis sne khrid de bros kyi yod gshis gal te sne 'khrid de gsod thub na gzhan pa dag bros 'go ma thig par sa cha gcig tu skor ba brgyab nas sdod kyi yod/de dus me mda' sogs brgyab nas ga tshod bsad bsad yin/ spyir btang rkyang rigs mtha' dag mi la zhed thag chod pa las gnod pa rtsa ba nas skyel gyi med kyang gal te gseb rkyang zhig dang hob te thug tshe mi la rmug pa dang 'phra ga brgyab nas gnod skyon bzo bzhin yod skad do// de bzhin rkyang rnyi btsugs nas gsod pa'ang yod kyang gsod lugs de rgya khyab che ba min/gnyan gyi skor/ gnyan ni lug gi rigs shig te mnga' ris byang thang la gnas pa'i gnyan tshang ma lus stobs che la rwa co dmigs bsal che mang che ba lus mdog smug po dang skya smug can yin/ de bsad de sha zas na shin tu ro bcud ldan par ma zad/ pags pas lheg rtsag (spu btogs zin pa'i pags pa mnyed ma/)bzo ba'am dgun dus gdan la bting na drod ha cang chen po yod/ gnyan pho'i rwa co lug lhas sgang la bzhag tshe nad rims dang gnod pa mtha' dag 'gog thub skad/ gnyan pho ni rwa co shin tu che bas mang che ba rgas rjes su rwa co rgyas nas sa la thug pas rtswa za ma thub par shi 'gro gi yod la/yang khag gcig ston dus rdung ga rgyag skabs rwa co bud nas shi gi yod/ de dus gnyan pho rdung ga rgyag mkhan de gnyis lung pa'i mda' g.yas g.yon nas shed shugs chen pos rgyugs yong nas rdung ba'i tshe thag ring la rdig sgra sgrog pa dang rwa dud sogs kyi dri mas lung pa yongs khengs/ gal te gnyan gnyis rdung ga rgyag pa'i tshe de dbar la mi sogs thar bas na mi de'i tshe gang ring gi bgegs dang bar chad nad dang na tsha thams cad sel 'gro gi yod skad/gnyan gsod dus snga dgong la chu sgug gtong ba'am 'jab mda' rgyag pa/193

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnyi 'dzugs pa/ khyi btang ste brag la bkugs rjes su brag steng nas rdo rdog 'phen pa'am brag gsham nas me mda' rgyag pa bcas byas na las sla por gsod thub bo// gnyan bsad rjes su byang khog nang gi khrag nyi 'od ma phog par byas nas bton te bsil grib la bsil skam du 'jog dbyar dus lug la rtswa dug phog dus sprad na shin tu phan/ de bzhin gnyan gyi slo khrag de'ang med du ma rung ba'i sman zhig te lu gur rtswa skyon byung dus sprod kyin yod la/ de chu nang la sbang nas lug gi lus steng la gtor na lo gcig gi nad rigs tshang ma len gyi yod par grags/ gnyan phrug chung chung skabs la lu gu dang lo gcig lon na gnyan ri/ lo gnyis la thong pa/ lo gsum la gnyan nyi/ lo bzhi nas gnyan g.yag ces pho la brjod cing / mo la gnyan mo zhes 'bod do// gnyan mo'i sha shin tu zhim la dro ba che zhing gnyan pho'i tshil lu kham mdog can de'ang zhim la ro bcud khyad du 'phags/ gnyan g.yag mang che ba ma ngar gong la bsad na sha de bas zhim po yod do//gna' ba'i skor/ gna' ba ni ra yi rigs shig te brag rir 'tsho sdod byed pa mang / de bsad tshe sha tshil bro ba che la ro bcud ldan par ma zad de'i pags pa ni 'brog pa'i skyes pa tsho'i lhog rtsag bzos yas kyi rgyu cha legs shos shig yin la/ gna' ba'i rwa co yang 'o ma 'jo sa byed par ma zad/ bod mda'i rdzas blugs sa'i yo chas med du mi rung ba zhig go/ gna' ba gsod dus chu sgug gtong ba zhes brag ri nas mar chu la bab yong dus chu 'thung sar rlung phyogs su rgyab kyis phyogs nas sgug rwa brtsigs pa ste rdo yi skyor gru bzhi'am sgor sgor thog med cing / mtha' bzhir me mda' rgyag sa'i i khung bzhi bzhag rjes su/ de'i nang la mi gab sdod byas nas gna' ba snang med la chu 194

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/'thung nas sdod skabs snga sa nas gra sgrig ang gsar yod pa'i khyi ra bas de ma nyid du me mda' 'phangs nas gsod kyi yod/ sgug rwa de'i mtho dman ni pho gzhon gyi gzugs tshad chad kha lhag tsam mchis/ de min gna' bar khyi btang nas gcig gnyis tsam mtha' bkar te lam sang brag yod sar bkugs shing / de nas mi ma slebs bar du skad sgra hang chol ler bsdad de bkag bzhag pa'am srung nas sdod kyi yod/ de rjes mis brag sgang nas rdo brdzog dbyug de gna' ba'i mgo la 'khel ba byas te g.yang rong la bskyur nas gsod pa'am brag 'og nas me mda' 'phangs te brag 'og tu lhung nas gsod pa'ang mang ngo / kha rgyun du'ang / am btsan po'i gna' ba gsod mkhan de// pho rgod po'i phru gu yin le red// ces zer gyi yod do// am zhes pa ni brag ri ste brag ri btsan po la gna' ba slebs thub na khyi ra 'jon thang can pho rgod pos ma gtogs rtsa ba nas gsod mi thub ces so// gna' ba bkug mkhan gyi sha khyi de'ang mtha' la bkar shes mkhan dang sne nas bkug shes mkhan/ mi yod sar tshur ded thub mkhan sbyang ma zhig dgos so//gtsod kyi skor/ gtsod ni ra yi rigs shig te dbyar dus rdza dang g.ya' la sdod cing dgun dus gnam gshis grang ba'i skabs su thang la bab nas bsdad pa mang ngo / de gsod pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni khu lu'i dhiched du yin/ gtsod kyi khu lu la 'jam mnyen ldan pa'i gser btso ma zhes brjod cing shin tu nas rin thang bral ba'o// gtsod kyi sha la lcags dri ya mtshan can zhig ldan pas za mkhan cung nyung tsam yin/ gtsod kyi rwa co ni sman la 'gro bar ma zad/ me mda'i ru byed cing / ston dus su gro ma slog yas kyi lag cha med du mi rung ba zhig kyang yin la/ da dung ra lpags dang lug 195

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lpags mnyed dus kyang de med thabs med pa zhig yin/ lar na zhing pas ston dus g.yul las skabs sog ma'am gzan pa a log rgyag yas kyi lag cha'ang legs shos de'o// gtsod gsod pa'i thabs shes gtso bo ni gog rtse btsugs rgyu dang de bzhin ri khug dang chu sgug btang nas 'jab mda' 'phangs nas gsod pa'ang yod mod kyang gtsod la khyi gtong ba'i lugs srol ye nas med/ gang lags she na/ gtsod ni rgyugs rim bzhin rlung gshog skyes nas je mgyogs tu 'gro bzhin yod pas khyis glags rnyed thabs bral/khyi ra ba rgan pos brjod par gtsod la rlung gshog bco brgyad yod pa'am dbugs skor thengs bco brgyad ldan pas sha khyi ci tsam legs kyang rjes zin thabs bral/ yin na'ang spyang ki la rlung gshog bcu dgu'am dbugs tshang bcu dgu skor yas yod pa'i dbang gis gtsod rjes ded btang nas gsod thub kyi yod skad/ spyir btang gtsod gsod yas kyi dus tshod legs shos ni dmar ling skabs yin/ de tshe gtsod yu mo tshang ma mi med lung stong gi byang phyogs la gnas spos kyis phru gu btsas par 'gro gi yod pas de'i 'gro lam gtso bo'am la mgo nges can dag la rtse sga rjozhes tho po du ma bslangs nas la mgo 'phrang lam dog sar sgog rtse medu ma btsugs nas brgya phrag mang po gsod thub pa ni sgog rtses gtsod zin pa dang sbrags mgo steng la brdzog rdo gzhus pa'am sko gcus brgyab nas gsod srol yod/ gtsod dag rgan gzhon dbang gis dbye na lo gcig la re'u dang lo gnyis lon tshe mo la tshe re dang pho la gar 'dzugs/lo gsum lon tshe pho la ldeb gsar dang mo la so bzhi zhes so// lo bzhi lon tshe pho mo gnyis kar so drug ces brjod/ de nas pho la gog po dang mo la yu mo zhes so// spyir gtsod mo thams cad la rwa med dbu yu ma sha stag lags kyang 196

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/gal te rwa yod pa re tsam thon tshe de ni nor bu yin pas g.yang la 'dzin gyin yod/ gtsod gsod yas lag cha sgog rtse phud da dung chab sga dang yu log bcas yod pas de tshos gtsod zin rting thar par gtong gi med/dgo ba'i skor/ dgo ba ni ra yi rigs shig yin la lus gzugs chung zhing rwa co phra ba/ spu mdog smug cing rkub dkar rkyang yin pa/ rgyugs dus mchong rgyag brgyab nas 'gro bas kha rgyun du'ang rgyugs dus dgo bo mchong mchong zhes brjod/ de dag mang che ba thang la sdod cing mi la de tsam gyi dogs zon byed kyi med/ dgo ba gsod pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni sha dang pags pa'i ched du yin la/ rwa co sman la 'gro zhing gri yi yu ba bzo yas kyi rgyu cha legs po zhig kyang yin/ dgo ba gsod dus 'jab mda' rgyag pa dang chu sgug btang nas yu log btsugs pa/ tha na 'ur rdo brgyab nas gsod pa'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod/ dgo ba'i sha la dri ngad ldan pas sha skyag sha zer gyi yod tsang mi mang che bas za gi med kyang / de'i sha dgun dus gangs rag che ba'i skabs dang dpyid dus skya zad sngo gtugs skabs su dud 'gro shed mo zhan par byin na bcud chen po yod skad/ni dwags bsad zin rjes sha ji ltar bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i skor/ spyir btang byang thang 'brog pa tsho ri sing gang sar kha gram nas sdod pas mi tshang so sos bsad pa'i ri dwags rang khyim kho nas longs su spyod kyi yod mod kyang /gal te mi tshang mang po mnyam du sdod pa'am ri dwags rgyag pa'i dmigs bsal sgrig 'dzugs dmar khungs rjogacig pa yin tshe ri dwags gsod mkhan nam srog bcad mkhan der dmigs bsal thob thang duyod pa phud/ de min sha dang pags pa'am ko ba tshang ma spyi snyoms kyis bgo bsha' gtsang dag rgyag gi 197

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pas der dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod de/dang po/ phyi nang gi 'grul ba sogs slebs tshe der skal ba sprod kyin yod de/ dper na mi gcig gis ri dwags cig bsad ma thag tu 'grul ba zhig slebs nas pags pa bshu rogs dang / nang cha brgyangs rogs/ sha gsil rogs sogs las rogs cha tshang byas tshe ri dwags de'i sha lpags rus la sogs pa cha tshang 'dra mnyam du bgo bsha' tag tag rgyag cing / yang las ka mang che ba byas zin nas tog tsam zhig las rjes ma zin tshe chung tsag gcig las sprod kyi med par dmar sne zhes brjod/ gal te 'grul ba bud med zhig dang 'phrad tshe dman sha lag pa zhes ri dwags kyi sha lag pa g.yas pa gcig skal bar thob kyi yod/gnyis pa/ grogs bskor ba ni/ ri dwags che 'bring chung gsum ci 'dra zhig yin kyang sha lhu drug gsum bco brgyad cha snyoms su bgo bsha' rgyag dgos te mi mang na nyung trem dang nyung na mang tsam thob bo// de yang mi la gzhigs te che chung yag sdug ye nas med par bgo bsha' rgyag skabs su/ mi gcig gab yib byas shing / gzhan dag tshang mas mig bltas nas ri dwags gsod mkhan des grogs mgo zhes sha gang dang ci rigs shig gi sgang la gri btsugs pa dang sbrags mi gcig la mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘grogs drangs so ’’zhes bos ma thag gab sdod mkhan des de ma nyid du ‘‘gsum la mchod ’ zhes pa dang gri btsugs sa'am grogs mgo de nas g.yas bskor la brtsis pa'i gsum pa ste mdzub mo btsugs sa de la bdag de nas yang mi gzhan dag cig la mdzub mo btsugs nas sngar ltar grogs drangs so zhes mtshams su gab mkhan gyis lnga la mchod ces tshe mi der bdag de'i rjes su gsum la bzhi brgyud 198

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/kyis rim gyis gong gi thabs shes de bed spyad nas bgo bsha' gtsang dag brgyab te mtha' ma der grogs mgo'am gri btsugs sa de thob/ 'on te gab mkhan des grangs ka gcig dang gsum/ lnga bcas ya grangs sha stag 'bod pa las cha grangs rtsa ba nas 'bod mi nyan no//gsum pa/ yib rgyan brgyab pa ste/ mi ci trem mchis pa der gzhigs te re res lde'u rdo'am shing ngam/ ril ma'am ci rigs shig bsdus nas mnyam du bsres/ de dag snga sa nas gab yib byas te sdod mkhan zhig yod pa kho'i lag la sprod/ mi des sha khag re re'i steng la lde'u re 'jog mtshams su mi so so'i lde'u bzhin 'khyer ro//bzhi pa/ shog rgyan dbyugs pa ni/ mi so so'i ming shog bu chung chung zhig gi sgang la bris rjes su shog bu ril ril cha 'dra ba ltebs rtseg brgyab nas sha'i bgo skal gyi steng la bzhag nas so so'i ming gang thon pa de ltar khyer bas na che chung dang legs min ga re byung kyang bsam 'char gang yang med la blo 'dod ha cang khengs po yong gi yod/ 'brong bsad rjes su tshigs rus g.yas g.yon kyi ko ba legs shos der gzhung ko brjod cing de ni gsod mkhan la thob kyi yod cing / de byings tshang ma dmar khungs kyi mi yod dor bgo bsha' rgyag dgos pa bcas so //sha khri'i skor/ mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i khyi la dbye na sne kha gnyis tsam yod de/ gcig ni sgo khyi'am bul khyi ste lus stobs che la glen rtags tsha ba/ spu bzang ba/ mgo che ba/ rnga ma sbom pa/ tshos mdog nag po dang / dmar nag khra khra/ gzhi nag la mig gi mtha' dag ser po/ dom pa snying dkar/ rgya'u bcas dang ming la'ang dom phrug dang ser 199

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skya/ 'ol phrug rgya phrug rgyags lhug sogs so// khyi de'i rigs spyir btang mang che bar sbra sgor yog pa'am rtsid pa'i si ri nag chung gi dra lung gis btags nas yod/ gzhan zhig ni sha khyi ste skam zhing rkang lag ring bar ma zad/ gzugs gzhi chung la phra ba/ spu 'jag thebs nas thung thung chags pa/ shin tu spyang grung dod pa/ sna yi rdzi ha cang rno ba/ bde lcag 'khyug po/rna lcog gsang ba/ pha ma gnyis ka sha khyi yin pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod/ sha khyi sbyong brdar byed dus chung chung nas nyams myong che ba'i sha khyi rgan po'i 'khris la btang na ming don mtshungs pa'i sha khyi legs po zhig rang bzhin gyis chags 'gro gi yod/ dper na mi dang mnyam du 'gro dus mdzub brda dang kha brda shu sgra bcas shes shing / ri mgo 'grim shes pa/ ri dwags brag rir 'gug thub pa/ dbugs skor shes pa/ 'jab rgyugs sgug gsum la byang chub pa/khyi ra ba'i gshis rgyud khong du chud pa bcas dgos so// sha khyi'i ming la byi khra dang / sgog po/ mgyogs phra/ skya khra/ khra lhug bcas zer/ sha khyi'i tshos gzhi mang che ba ngang dkar dang / skya mdog can/ dmar dkar can/dmar po/ dkar po/ skya khra bcas sa mdog sha stag dgos/ de min tshe gtam gyi dpe la'ang khyi nag pos ri dwags rgyang nas dkrogs zhes pa ltar khyi nag po ri dwags rgyag par phan thogs kyi med la/ ci tshos mdog khra khra pa khra'ang phan thogs rtsa ba nas med/ sngar sha khyi yag gras la bod ṭam stong phrag re tsam sprod dgos kyi yod/ khyi yi rigs gsum pa ni sha tsha zhes sha khyi dang bul khyi 'dres ma zhig yin/ des kyang sha khyi'i go mi chod do//dredameng gi skor/ dred mong ni dom gyi rigs shig ste der dbye na mi dred ces mi la gnod pa byed cing mi'i gshis rgyud rgyus lon che ba/ lus stod 200

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/rgyas shing lus smad cung chung ba/ mjing pa'i ze rngog gi spu ha cang ring bas gyen la rgyugs bde yang thur la rgyugs dus dka' ngal yod pa bcas so de min phyugs dred ces ste phyugs zog sems can la gnod byed mkhan zhig yin kyang gal te me mda' brgyab nas rmas tshe de ma nyid du rgyugs yong nas mi la'ang nyen kha ha cang chen po bzo gi yod/ de'i tshos gzhi ni mang che ba kham pa dang nag po yin/ nyung shas shig dkar po'ang yod pa de dag mang che ba gangs mtshams na sdod kyin yod/ dred mong mang che ba g.ya' ri dang rdza ri'i khrod tu sdod cing dbyar dus rtswa long dang rgyu long / gro ma sogs bsngogs nas za ba phud/ 'phyi ba za yas la shin tu dga' po yod pa ni/ 'phyi khung gtor nas 'phyi ba zin gyi yod kyang mang che bar 'gram lcag gzhus rjes ma go yu 'khor nas ril ba dang sbrags de ma nyid du rkub 'og la bcug ste mu mthud 'phyi ba gzhan dag la'ang de ltar byed/ dngos su za yas ni mtha' mjug de las med pas dred mong gis 'phyi ba zin zhes pa'i gtam dpe de'ang de nas byung ngo // don du dka' las brgyab kyang 'bras bu med pa'ang gcig zin dus gcig brjed pa'o// dred mong gis da dung tsi tsi dang a bra zin nas 'tsho thabs byed la/ sgo phyugs sogs kyang za gi yod do// dred mong thams cad dgun dus su so so'i sbar mthil la lces bldags nas brag phug nang la nyal sdod kyi yod pas de tshe gsod na las sla po red/ dpyid dus 'brug skad dang po sgrog pa dang sbrags 'phyi ba dang tsi tsi 'dra bar yar sa steng du thon yong nas 'tsho thabs byed do// dred mong dbyar dus gsod dka' bas de dus re zung gsod thub na gsod mkhan de skad grags chen po chags kyi yod/ spyir na 'brog pa tshos dred mong ni yul lha'i sgo khyir bzung nas gsod mkhan nyung nyu nga 201
