༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/red/ lar na de'i bse dri dug pa can de btsog par 'dzin no// lo rabs drug cu tsam nas bzung dred mong gi mkhris pa/ sbar mthil/ pags pa/tshil lu bcas bcud ldan zas rigs dang sman la bzung nas dred mong gsod mkhan mang po byung / dred mong ni byang thang ri khrod kyi sems can dmigs bsal can zhig yin gshis/ de'i skor 'brog pa'i khrod la kha rgyun gyi sgrung gtam du ma zhig dar yod de/ dper na 'brog pa'i bu mo dred mong gis khyer nas skye dman byas lugs dang 'brog khul gyi sman pa dred mong gis bzung nas na tsha lta ru bcug tshul/ dred mong dang 'brog pa dbar 'thab rtsod sna tshogs byed pa'i sgrung rgyas shing rgyas pa yod kyang 'dir zhib phra brjod mi dgos so//spyir btang byas na byang thang la stag mthong rgyu med/ de'i skoral sgrung gtam thung thung zhig yod pa des rgyu mtshan gsal tsam bkral bar lags te/sngar byang thang la stag du ma zhig yod skad/ phyis su stag dang ri bong gnyis dbar la rnyog 'dzing byung ste ri bong gis blo rig la brten nas stag lho rong yul la mthar skrod btang bar grags/ de yang thog ma byang thang la stag tshang zhig yod cing / de'i nang la stag mo cig dang stag phrug 'ga' shas mchis/stag mo des dus rgyun du za rigs 'tshol du phyin te stag phrug stag tshang nang la 'jog de tshe yul der ri bong zhig yod par khos stag phrug yod sar yong nas stag mo ga par 'gro min skad cha dris pa la/ stag phrug tshos a ma za yas 'tshol du phyin song zhes bshad/ khyed kyis nga'i a ma btsal nas ga re byed kyi yin nam zhes 'dri skabs su/ ri bong gis ‘‘btsan g.yem byed dgos bsam ’ zhes brjod/ nyin ltar re bzhin de 'dra byas pas/ stag phrug tshos a mar ri bong gi ci zer brda lan sprod skabs su/ stag mo de rlung langs 202

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/thag chod nas brjod par ‘‘than ri bong spo sho khos nga tshor brnyas bcos bshad pa red/ nyin ma de ring kho gsod kyi yin ’ zhes phyi la zas 'tshol bar ma song bar bsgugs nas bsdad/ ri bong stag tshang sgo la slebs nas phru gu tshor a ma ga par phyin zhes ma thag stag mo hob te thon yong nas ri bong 'ju la khad pa'i tshe ri bong bde lcag ldan pas bros phyin/ de nas mgyogs shing myur bar stag mos 'ded shar btang nas yang skyar 'ju grabs byed pa'i tshe na/ ri bong gis stag mo'i mgo bo kho na thar tsam gyi sa dong zhig snga sa nas drus yod pa de'i nang la 'dzul/ de skabs nga rgyal drag pos myos pa'i stag mos sa dong nang la rtab rtob tu 'dzul ba dang sbrags mgo bo thar ba las gzugs byings phyi la lus/ de ma nyid du ri bong gzhogs gcig nas thon te rdo ba zur zur gcig khyer nas stag gi mo mtshan nang la bcug nas yang yang brdar zhing ‘‘byang thang ri bong spo sho ngas lho rong stag mo kha chen bzos ri’brjod pas stag gis sems par ri bong gis log g.yem byas byung bsam nas ngo tsha thag chod de ‘‘da byang thang la tshe 'gro sa ma red/ sdug spo bo ri bong gis kyang mthong chung blta gis ’’zhes byang thang nas kha bral te lho rong la log phyin gshis de nas bzung byang thang yul la stag mthong ba'i skal ba ye nas ma byung zhes so//me mda'i skor/ byang thang 'brog pa'i bed spyod gtong ba'i me mda' la dbye na rus pa'i ming 'dogs pa dang lcags ming 'dogs pa khag gnyis yod/ lcags ming la dbye na rgya mig mang dang / sog rnying / sog gru bzhi/sog khra bo/ sog gsar pa/(de rjes su thon pa yin/) bod mda' bcas so//bod mda'i grub cha ni ru medang / si mime/ bod shing / lcags mdong ⑪/sna khebasayi/ sna chu/ sbi sdi/(me len gyi skud rdzas shig) skam pa/ gsham shing 203

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs yin/ bod mdar lag 'khor zhes smad sbom zhing stod phra tsam zhig yod de/ de ni bod rang nas bzos pa yin/ rgya sog ‘‘rgya sog wa mo mgo dkar// rgya sog po'i khra dkar chu ris//’’ zhes pa de ni gru bzhi zhig ste rgya dang sog pos thun mong thog bzos par grags/ de'i khyad chos ni dgung gsum dkyil gru bzhi yin cing / zhabs dang mgo gnyis kar bubs ril byas pa zhig lags/ de bzhin sog mda' zhes pa de ni kha nas slad gsham bar du tshang ma bubs ril rkyang pa'o// de min shed khrab gling bzhi zhes lcags rdum rdum gcig la gling bzhi dang ri lding zhes pa kha slad gnyis gru bzhi yin par ma zad/ lcags mdong bubs ril zhig kyang yin pas rngam brjid dod po zhe drag yod/ de'i khyad chos gzhan zhig ni lcags phra la rgyang thag ring por 'phen mi thub la shugs chung tsam zhig yin/ da dung rgya rnying zhes gru bzhi zhig dang sog rnying zhes bubs ril bubs rkyang zhig yod/ de tsho'i dbye ba gtso bo lcags la bltas na lam seng shes thub bo// sngar me mda' legs shos la rta pho 'ga' shas kyi gnas 'bab yod/me mda'i rdzas ni rtswa slang ma me bsregs btang ba'i sol ba'am 'om bu dang lcang ma'i shing sdong mer bsregs btang ba'i sol ba la zi tshwa dang mu zi tshad gzhi legs par skor nas mnyam du sbyor bsres byas pa zhig go/ de'i rgyu cha gtso bo'am phon nam 'bor 'don mkhan de sol ba yin cing / de nas mu zi cung tsam las mi dgos/ gal te mu zi mang drags na me mda' 'khrugs che bas gnad la 'khel ba'am phog yas nyung / yang nyung drags na shugs chung rkyen gyis de bas gnad la mi 'khel bas mdor na der sbyor ba 'tshams po zhig dgos/ rdzas bzos zin te 'brong gi rwa co'i nang la blugs/ rdzas kyi sdeb 204

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/sbyor gras zi tshwa la khag gnyis yod de rong gi zi tshwa dang 'brog khul rang nas bzos pa'am khag cig brag ldebs nas bkog rgyu yod do//me mda'i mde'u bzo dus sngon la lcags skyor skyor nang la zha nye bzhu/de nas mdel par (mdel ril lugs rgyag sa'i par gzhi/)zhes rdo tho lor i khung drus pa'i par gzhi gnyis yod de mde'u che ba de or or che ba dang chung ba de or or chung ba'i nang la blugs rjes su gzhogs g.yas g.yon gyi shur shur de gnyis khengs ma thag lam seng grang bsang btang nas phyi la bton na zha nye'i mde'u de'o// mde'u la rdo stan zhes phyi skogs zha nye dang nang la rdo ril chung chung zhig yod/ gal te rdo blugs med tshe dkar blugs zhes zha nye kho na yin pas shugs chen po de tsam med la ri dwags lus la phog ma thag leb leb chags pa'am kha thor du 'gro gi yod/ zha nye'i yong khungs gtso bo ni byang thang ri gseb kyi zha nye'i gter rdzas dag dang rgya gar nas nang 'dren byas pa khag gnyis yod/ de bzhin mde'u khag cig shing kong kong nang la zha nye blugs nas bzos pa'ang yod cing / mde'u blugs sa ni ko bas bzos pa'i khug ma che chung sna tshogs yod/ mde'u legs shos kyis 'brong gsum tsam sdebs gcig la gsod thub kyi yod/ de ni skyes pho yi mtshon srung med du ma rung ba zhig go/spyir bod mda' la dgra lha yod par grags/ des na lo ltar re bzhin 'char can du me mdar gsol kha byed kyi yod pa ni/ gsol mchod byed dus me mda' de sbra gur phu'i ka ba la sgrog cing / dgra lha'i gsol mchod kyi bskang ba 'bul ba dang sbrags bsang gsol dang 'phrin bcol byed la/dgra lha 'gugs dus me mda' tshang ma mnyam du byur byur spung bar dgra lha'i 205

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gur khang brjod/ ru la dar cog dmar po dkris/ bsang gsol rgyas po gtong / bdag po tshang ma rta la bzhon nas der skor ba rgyag gi yod la/ ri dwags rigs mi 'dra ba'i spu tog tsam bkog nas me mda'i lung thag la sgrog pa bcas byed/ de nas gdon 'dre'i gzugs shig la me mda' rgyag gi yod tshul byas nas sus der phog na rten 'brel legs shing dpa' blo khog yod pa zhig la 'dzin gyi yod/de bzhin me mda' kha log tshe bsang gtong zhing / ri dwags bsad pa'i khrag dang tshil lu me mda'i ru la 'byug dgos par ma zad/ ri dwags ci rigs la me mda' brgyab kyang bsad ma thag khrag tsha bor me mda'i kha dang zhabs gzhug (mjug shing )la 'byug gin sha ngas za khrag khyod kyis 'thung shig brjod/ me mda'i kha la khrag 'byug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni da dung ri dwags mang tsam gsod thub pa'i smon 'dun mtshon/ me mda'i lcags la khrag 'byug na yun ring sdod kyi med kyang shing la khrag 'byug na dus yun ring tsam sdod do// dus mtshungs su me mda'i zhabs la khrag 'byug pa ni ri dwags gsod pa'i rtags mtshan dang kha la khrag 'byug pa ni da dung mu mthud bsad thub pa'am bsdigs khung sprad tshad la ri dwags gsod thub pa'i re smon yin/byang thang 'brog pa'i lugs srol gzhan zhig la bud med kyis me mda' la 'jus tshe rnam rtog la 'dzin pa'am tha na bud med me mda' la 'ju ba'i thob thang med/ gal te 'jus pa yin tshe gnod pa dang skyon chen po yod par grags la/ rjes su ri dwags gsod par dka' las chen po yong ba'am rtsa ba nas gsod thub kyi med skad/ de min me mda'i 'khris su chos dpe klog 'don byed mi chog la chos dpe me mda'i nye 'khor la 'jog mi nyan pa ni/206

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/me mda' kha log gi yod skad/ da dung me mda' sgal bar thog bzhin du chos dang ma ṇi kha 'don byas na'ang me mda'i kha log 'gro gi yod par brjod/ ri dwags bsad rjes su de'i gzugs logs nas spu phran bu btog nas me mda'i lcags mdong dang zhabs shing dbar la bcug gi yod pa'ang ri dwags bsad pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa'o//ri dwags kyi lus steng na sman la 'gro ba'i rigs shin tu mang ba ni/'brong gi snying khrag ni snying gi na tsha yod na drag skyed che ba dang blo stobs che ru 'gro gi yod la/ 'brong g.yag chen gyi rtsid pa btog nas sbra gur gyi snam cha bzos na gnam lcags kyi thog 'gog gi yod skad do// gnyan gyi rwa co de lug lhas rtsig pa'i sgang la bzhag na re'u dang lu gu'i kha la rma mi bzo bar phan thogs chen po yod cing / gnyan thong pa'i khrag de ra lug gi rims nad spyi la shin tu phan/ de min gtsod kyi rwa co dang / khrag dred mong gi mkhris pa/ gla ba'i gla rtsi (gnyan kha gcog cing rma rigs la phan thogs yod/)bcas sman legs po yin/ dper na dred mong gi mkhris pa ni ro kha ba dang zhu rjes bsil ba/ rtsa kha sdom pa'i nus pa ha cang che la rma rul gso ba/ bshal gcod la sha'u skye bar byed/ gtsod khrag ni ro mngar la bska/ zhu rjes snyoms/ nus pas 'khru ba gcod/ skye rgyun 'gog ces dang gtsod ru ni ro lan tshwa ba dang zhus rjes snyoms pa/ nus pas zla mtshan mi snyoms pa dang mngal du khrag skran 'dril ba/ bu ro lus pa/ khog pa bshal ba sogs la phan nus chen po yod ces so//byang thang 'brog pa'i goms srol gal chen zhig ni/ yul lha gnas sa'i ri bo dang de'i 'khris kyi gnas la ri dwags bda' mi chog cing / dgon 207

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i nye 'khor la'ang ri dwags rtsa ba nyid nas rgyag mi chog go/ gang lags she na/ ri dwags de dag yul lha'i sgo phyugs yin par 'dzin gshis de bsad na gnod pa skyel kyi yod la/ yul lha sprang po chags nas mi'i sgo phyugs yang rang bzhin gyis nyung du 'gro bar ma zad/ mi la na tsha dang sgo phyugs la god kha mang dag yong bar 'dzin zhing / dgon pa'i nang gi snying rje can gyi lha skus kyang ri dwags kyi pags pa lus steng la dkris yod pa bcas so//mchan 'grel/du dred mong ni rting pa rdum rdum yin pa'ang rting pa med pas 'brog pa tshos rting rdum zhes ming 'dogs shing / dus rgyun du rting rdum zhes 'bod pa las dred mong zhes 'bod pa nyung / de'i rgyu mtshan de sngar dred mong gis rta la rtag tu gnod pa skyel ba ni rgod ma la rte'u skyes ma khad du khyer nas longs spyod byed kyi yod pas thengs gcig rtas dred mong ded shar gyis rdog brdzis btang nas dred mong gi rting pa bkog dus de nas bzung dred mong tshang ma rting pa rdum rdum yin zhing / rta mthong ba tsam gyis bla chad pa ltar skrag gi yod gshis mi hreng rta hreng zhig dred mong du ma'i dkyil du slebs kyang dred mong gis gnod pa rtsa ba nas skyel nus kyi med skad do//rjo sa rgan ni 'brog pas gzig la 'bod pa'i tha snyad cig yin/ byang thang na gnas pa'i gzig stod chung la smad rgyas pa rgyugs dus shin tu mgyogs pa/ kho'i lus kyi tshos gzhi ni sa mdog dang mtshungs pas las sla bor mthong mi thub/ lar na khos 'jab shud brgyab nas 'gro ba las mngon gsal dod pos thon yong gi med/ khos chung sa re'u lu gu dang che sa g.yag sogs gsod thub kyi yod cing / thog ma dud 'gro'i mjing par 'chang nas khrag rtsa che shos de brtol/ de rting khrag 'jibs nas dud 'gro gsod do// dud 'gro shi rjes su khos gzhug gu shin tu ring ba des bsdams nas sa cha 208

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/khug kyog la khyer te gzig mang rub brgyab nas longs spyod byed/ kho bo chung dus pha yul la g.yaga'atshos nas sdod skabs su nyin gcig g.yag byings rnams ri'i thur gzar po nas mar bab kyang g.yag gcig kha gyen la phyogs nas 'gro gi 'dug par ya mtshan chen pos ki sgra dang shu sgra ci tsam brgyab kyang snang med ltar rang sor yar gyen phyogs su 'gro gi 'dug mthar mgyogs dang myur du rgyugs phyin nas g.yag de'i gam du bcar nas legs par blta skabs sug bzhi 'gul bskyod gtong gi mi 'dug pas yang bskyar zhib blta byed dus gzig gcig g.yag gi sbo 'og tu 'dzul nas gzhug gus g.yag dam por bsdams nas khyer 'gro gi 'dug pas gzig gi gzhug gur dmigs bsal shugs drag yod pa shes byung la don dngos kyang de ltar lags so//(nye sga ba ni gcan gzan zin yas kyi lag cha dmigs bsal can zhig yin/de'i grub cha ni gnyan mo'i rwa co dang skud pa si ri/ char rdo/ g.yag gi lci ba sgor mo bcas dgos shing / de sa dong nang la 'jog pa dang sgang la rtswa sob sob bting /de'i sgang la sa zhib dang rdo hrag hrug bshos/ de'i sgang la sha dang rus pa sogs 'jog pas gcan gzan gyis de za ba dang sbrags lam seng de'i nang la rkang lag tshud nas bros thabs bral lo//me gtsod ni bsad na ma gtogs khu lu 'thog mi thub/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gtsod lpags rlon par khu lu dang spu mnyam du 'dres nas skyes yod pas rtsa ba nas btog mi thub cing / bsad rjes su pags pa skam rting gzhi nas khu lu 'thog thub pa'am len thub kyi yod/ gtsod lpags skam na khu lu dang spu'i dbye ba 'byed de len gyi yod par dmigs bsal gyi lag rtsal dgos pa ni/ dang thog gtsod lpags ther sha brgyab nas skam/skam thag rbad de chos rjes su gri zhig khyer nas brad brad btang nas rim gyis len/gal te khu lu rnying pa chags na phan thogs yas med la/ dra dang khu lu 'dres ma la'ang phan thogs ye nas med/du rtse sga zhes pa ni mtho gangs ri'i mtshamasanas dma' mtsho dang mtshe'u 'am 209

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtsod dus rgyun tu 'gro sa la mgo'i lam 'phreng gu dog sa'i mtshams bcas su 'dzugs pa'i grangs las 'das pa'i tho po'i spyi ming yin/ gtsod ni gtsod khrims dam po yod pa'i sems can thun mong min pa zhig yin/ kho tsho dmar ling skabs su gnas spos byed dus lam rnying gcig rang la ma gtogs gang byung du 'gro gi med/ des na khyi ra bas rtse sga zhes pa'i tho po mang dag btsugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gtsod kyi 'grod lam je chung dang gu je dog tu gtong ba'i ched du yin/ gal te la mgo rgya che sar gtsod dag kha 'gram nas phyin tshe sgog rtse btsugs kyang re zung las gsod thub kyi med/rjo sgog rtse la dbye na rnying ma dang / gru bzhi/ khra bo/ gsar ma bcas yod/de ni stabs bde la nus pa che zhing dmigs bsal can gyi lag cha zhig kyang yin/ de'i grub cha ste gtsod kyi rwa co gzhogs brgyab pa bcu grangs shig dang / rnyi thag(nor gyi rtsid pa las bzos pa'i bu ril zhig) 'om mo zhes smyug ma lhas btang ba'am bya sgro zhig da dung char rdo bcas dgos/ de sa dong nang la bzhag rjes su sgang la rtswa dang rta'i ong ril hrug hrug bzos nas 'jog de'i sgang la sa zhib zhib dang rdo chung bkab pas ri dwags gtsod sogs snang med du zin thub bo//rjo dmar khungs zhes ri dwags rgyag dus kyi dmigs bsal sgrig 'dzugs shig yin/ de la'ang gnyen nye spun mched kyi dmar khungs dang grogs 'dris 'cham mthun gyi dmar khungs/ yun ring mnyam gshib kyi dmar khungs bcas yod/ kho tshos dus rgyun tu ri dwags rngon par mnyam du 'gro zhing / dka' ba mnyam spyod dang longs spyod mnyam myong byed par ma zad/ phan tshun dbar blo gcig sems gcig gis rogs ram dang rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu byed pa las rang shed dang rang khe can gyi bsam ngan rtsa ba nas bcangs srol med/me ri dwags dngos su gsod mkhan la dmigs su bkar ba'i thob thang yod de/ri dwags kyi snying dang mgo/ mjing rus sam gnyags ril/ sgal ba'i gzhung lpags/gzhug gu bcas thob la/ mtshams re brang mgo dang glo ba'ang thob kyi yod mod kyang 210

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i gna' srol ri dwags rngon lugs skor brjod pa/snying ni kho'i rang bdag yin pa brjod med dang gzhan pa tshang ma skabs 'phral gnas tshul la gzhigs te khyer dbang yod/rjo bod mda'i ru ni rkang pa gnyis ldan ma ri dwags gtsod kyi rwa co'i dbyibs 'dra ba zhig ste rtse mo gnyis su lcags ru chung tsam gnyis dang de'i nang la shing drongs po gnyis gzhogs brgyab nas bcug cing / dbus tsam nas gcus zer gyis bsdams te mnyam du sbrel yod/ 'ga' shas cha tshang lcags las bzos pa'ang yod la/ 'ga' shas shig gtsod kyi rwa co kho na las bzos shing / 'ga' shas la dngul shan brgyab pa'ang yod/ de'i nus pa ni me mda' rgyag dus 'gul skyod ma thebs cing brtan po yong ba'i chad du lags/ ru de sa la btsugs pa'i rjes su rlung lhags chen po brgyab pa'am khyi ra ba'i lag rtsa brtan po med pa'am sems 'tshab skyes pa bcas kyis shugs rkyen rtsa ba nas thebs kyi med/⑩ si mi ni lcags mda' lta bu zhig ste ring thung lcags mdong kha nas phyed cha lhag tsam la snyobs tsam dgos/ de ni dus rgyun du me mda'i 'og gi bod shing dang sgang gi lcags mdong dbar du bcug de'i nus pa ni me mda'i lcags mdong nang du zha nye'i mde'u ril ril 'jug dus kha nas ma 'gro ba'i skabs su des mar bsags brgyab nas mthil bar du slebs pa byed cing / lcags mdong nang la rdo dang shing sogs 'dzul ba'i tshe bton yas dang gtsang ma bzo yas shig yin/ mtshams re rdzas khung ngam sna mchu'ang bsang yas kyi lag cha legs po zhig go/(smo lcags mdong la gru bzhi dang zlum ril khag gnyis tsam yod pas de nas rgya rnying dang / sog rnying / bod lugs bcas yin pa shes thub/ mtshams re de'i sgang la ri mo sna tshogs bris yod la/ rtags kyang du ma rgyag srol yod/ de ni me mda'i spus tshad blta yas kyi rdo ka shu ka ltar lags shing / de'i spus tshad gzhir bzung gis rin gong rgyag gi yod/ kha rgyun du'ang khrag 'thung lcags mdong la brten nas ri dwags kyi sha tshil sgrub ces zer gyi yod pa de nas lcags mdong de shin tu gal 'gangs che ba yin 211

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par shes thub bo//yi sna khebs ni sna mchu srung yas kyi khebs shig yin/ de ni sems can ab ra'am a bra'i pags pa mnyed rjes 'tshem bu legs par brgyab nas bzos pa zhig lags/ de'i phyi sha la dar dang gos chen sogs kyis g.yogs brgyab nas 'dra chags po zhe drag yod/ me mda'i bdag pos de la dang dod chen po byed kyi yod pa ni/ rdzas gsog 'jog byed yas dang skam rlon 'tshams par sdod pa/ me lam seng sgron thub pa bcas kyi nus pa ldan no//

༄khya//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gtsod jon lugs skor mdo tsam brjod pa/ri dwags gtsod ces pa de pho tshang ma rwa co ring po yod pa sha stag dang mo tshang ma rwa med yu mo rkyang pa yin/ sems can de'i khu lur rin thang shin tu che bas 'jam mnyen ldan pa'i gser btso ma zhes zer gyi yod/ gtsod rngon dus rnyi rgyag pa'am rtse sga btsugs nas gsod pa las sha khyi btang na gsod thabs bral/ gang lags she na/ khyis gtsod rjes 'ded gtong skabs sa thag ji tsam ring ba'am dus ji tsam ring yang de tsam gyis rlung gshog rgyas zhes lhang bu nang la rlung 'tshang nas mgyogs su mgyogs su phyin nas rtsa ba nas rjes zin gyi med gshis rngon thabs bral lo//yangs shing mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i byang thang yul du gtsod sogs ri dwags rngon par rnyi ni med du mi rung ba'i lag cha gal 'gangs shin tu che la/ri dwags chung gras rngon lugs kyi thabs shes kyang legs shos shig lags/'on tang sngar byang thang khul du lcags rigs shin tu dkon pas lcags rnyi sogs kyi lag cha shin tu dben/ des na byang ri gzhi rjodapa' mo a dwags kyis byang thang yul la dbang sgyur byed pa'i tshe ri dwags rgyag rgyu de ni 'tsho rten gtso chen zhig yin pas na/ mos gros 'go bton pa ltar na/ gtsod gsod byed la lcags rigs 'ba' zhig gi dgos pa med/ gtsokā 1dhi yu

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsod byed gtsod kyi mgo la 'dug ces te gtsod pho du ma bsad nas de tsho'i rwa co kha gshags btang nas yar bkug mar bkug byas rting rnyi bzos pa red/dus de nas bzung gtsod gsod byed kyi rnyi ste ‘‘gog rtse’’zhes pa de byung ba yin/der rtse ngo ma bcu gnyis yod/ gtsod kyi rwa co la mnyen cha dod cing chag yas med par ma zad/ 'phar shugs che ba/ btsa' skyon bral ba/ yang ba/ sna ldem pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod do//ri dwags gtsod ni rang khrims ha cang dam po yod pa'i sems can zhig yin/ dper na chu la bab dus sa cha gtan 'khel ba gcig rang la yong nas chu 'thung ba dang / la klung du ma brgal nas byang thang mtha' la re'u khrid par ༷'gro ba'i skabs su spyir btang rgyun du 'gro sa'i lam gtan 'jags gcig rang 'grim pa las gang byung du lam btsal nas 'gro srol ye nas ma mchis/ des na rngon pa rgad po myong ba can tshos lam kha der rtse sga zhes pa de 'dzugs kyi yod/ rtse sga 'dzugs sa ni la mgo'i dbus su yin/ de yang la mgo'i g.yas g.yon thag ring ri ldebs nas tho po merim pas brtsigs te la mgor slebs dus zheng chung du btang nas gtsod bcu grangs thar tsam las med pas der rtse sga ci tsam mang na gtsod de tsam gyis mang ba gsod thub kyi yod do// tho po'i dbar gyi ring thung ni thag ring ri'i rtse nas mgo btsugs yong dus gom pa brgya phrag lhag tsam dang / de nas thag je thung du btang nas mthar gom pa bcu tsam las med/ gtsod mo khyu dang khyu byas nas 'grims dus thengs re la stong phrag gcig gam lnga brgya drug brgya tsam yod/spyir btang byas na gtsod brgya tham pa'i nang nas bcu trem rtse sgas zin thub/dmar lings skabs/ lo 'khor zla ba bcu gnyis zhag po gsum brgya 214

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gtsod rngon lugs skor brjod pa/drug cu'i nang la dmar lings zhes pa de ni gtsod mo khyu chen 'dres nas byang mthar 'grim pa'i dus gal chen zhig gam gtsod mor re'u skye pa'i skabs te dpyid dus yin/ ma gzhi gtsod kyi pha yul lam gnas sa dang sdod sa gtso bo byang thang yin mod kyang / gtsod mor re'u skyes dus byang thang gi mtha' ste mi med lung stong la gnas spos byed do// nam zhag rgyun du byang thang yul gyi rtswa bzang sa dang chu legs sar gnas sdod byed kyi yod/ dmar lings mgo tshugs ma thag gtsod pho de yangs shing rgya che ba'i byang thang gi lho ngos la sdod pa dang gtsod mo thams cad byang phyogs mi sde ye nas med pa'i sa la 'grim 'gro gi yod/ gtsod khrims shin tu dam stabs dus thog tu phar phyin pa dang dus thog tu tshur log yong la/ gong du brjod zin pa ltar lam kha'ang gcig kho na brgyud pa las gang byung du mi 'gro/ sngar ri dwags rgyag mkhan rgad po myong ba can gyi gtam dpe la'ang gtsod khrims bya dang 'dra dhi zhes pa ltar ro//brjod srol la dmar lings skabs su gtsod mo tshang ma byang mthar 'gro ran gshis lo snga mar byung ba'i gtsod phrug dang kha gyes nas 'gro pa'i tshe na gtsod a mas skyo snang ha cang chen po byed kyi yod skad/ dper na gtsod mos kha chems skyo shes can 'di ltar 'jog gi yod pa ni/ da a ma byang la 'gro ba'i dus la slebs song bas khyod dang kha bral rgyu yin stabs/ a ma khra chung rnyi yi ma zin na mgyogs dang myur du rang yul la log yong / chu rtsa skyi gtsang pos ①ma khyer na/ dga' ba dang spro ba'i ngang nas log slebs yong / gal te log yas med na a mar rkyen ngan byung bas khyed kyis g.ya' ri dang rdza ri 'grim nas rtswa bzang chu bzang longs su spyod nas bsdad de rngon pa'i rnyi 'og la ma shor ba byed dgos zhes mig chu lhung lhung du gtong gi yod skad/ de nas 215

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtsod phrug gis a ma thag ring lam du ma yal bar phebs skyel du bcar nas mthar mig ce rer bltas nas sdod kyi yod/ a mas phyi bltas yang yang slog gin rkang 'khrab dang lag 'khrab byed cing / mtsher snang chen pos phru gu dang kha gyes kyi yod pa ni shi gson ci yong ha go gi med la yang skyar thug yong min yang de bas cha rtogs med/ yin na'ang gtsod khrims shin tu legs dbang gis gtsod mo byang la 'gro dus gtsod sgog po (gtsod pho/)rwa co legs po byas pa tig tig (shed shugs legs pa)re gnyis mo gtsod mnyam du byang mtha' la 'gro gi yod par spyir gtsod yu mo brgya tham pa byang mthar phyin pa yin na sgog po gcig nges par du 'gro gi yod/ gang lags she na/ de tshos gtsod yu mo phru gu skye mtho ba khag cig chu brgal dus chu shugs kyis 'ded nyen yod pas gtsod sgog pos rwa cos bskyor nas 'gro ba dang tshur log yong dus gtsod phrug chung la shed med khag cig chus khyer 'gro skabs sgog pos rwa co'i shugs kyis 'don no//dmar lings ni bod zla gsum pa 'char ma khad la mgo tshugs kyi yod/de tshe gtsod mo de tsho bang rim bsgrigs nas re re bzhin rtsa skyi gtsang po'i byang phyogs brag ri nyung sa dang spang rtswa mang po yod sar 'gro'o// byang thang mtha' yi sa cha der gtsod mo'i re'u 'khrid sa zhes pa las ming gzhan rtsa nas med/gtsod mo tshang ma re'u 'khrid sar slebs te nyin shas shig 'das pa dang sbrags lho rong nas yong ba'i nam mkha'i bya dmigs bsal can gzugs nag po ‘‘bya long ’’zhes pa zhig kyang sa cha der slebs/ ya mtshan che ba zhig la gtsod mo dang bya long gnyis dus mnyam par rtsa skyi gtsang po'i byang phyogs su skyod pa dang dus gcig la gtsang po de'i lho la log yong ngo// bya long de'ang khrims shin 216

༄khya//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gcod rngon lugs skor brjod pa/tu dam po yod pa ni bya long nam 'phang gcod pa'i dus zhes byang mtha' la 'phur 'gro dus kyang lnga bcu drug cu byas nas bang rim bsgrigs te skad sgra 'ar 'ur ngang lding 'gro'o// de tsho mang dus su brgyad cu dgu bcu tsam yod/ de yang bya tsho mang po byas nas 'phur 'gro gi yod/ gtsod mor re'u khrid dus byang thang mtha' yul la sbag rtswa zhes tshwa bul 'dres pa'i rtswa thar thor las med pas des gtsod mo'i grod khog ye nas rgyags thub kyi med gshis gtsod mos bya long gi bya skyag dag zas nas bkres ltogs sangs shing / gtsod mor re'u khrid ma thag re'u yi phru ma de dag bya long gis longs su spyod/ des na ri dwags rngon mkhan rgad pos sngar gtam las bya drin gtsod la che rgyu med/gtsod drin bya la che rgyu med ces pa ni gtsod mo dang bya long gnyis phan tshun gnyis phan yin pa las sus su la'ang dug yud khyer mi dgos zhes so//gtsod yu mo dang phru gu mnyam du lho la tshur log yong dus su gtsang chen de'i chu rgyas nas gtsod phrug chu la khyer grabs byed skabs pho gtsod sgog po'i rwa cos yar bskyor nas chu phar kha la thon thub pa byed do// gtsod ma bu lho la log zin pa dang bya long de yang lho la yong gi 'dug pas rang byung khams kyi bya dngos ya mtshan can de lta bu ni bcos ma min la stes dbang yang min no//ngar gtsod skabs/ bod zla bcu pa'i mjug dang bcu gcig gi mgo tsam la ngar gtsod ces pa zhig langs rgyu yod/ de ni pho gtsod dang mo gtsod mnyam du 'dzoms nas sdeb sbyor byed pa'i dus zhig go/ skabs de dus gtsod sgog po ngar nas lce leb mar bsnar nas skad sgra dmigs bsal can zhig rgyag rgyu yod cing / byang thang gi gnam gshis kyang grang ngar ha cang che bas sgog po stong phrag mang po'i kha rlangs gis sa gnam la smug pa 'khrigs pa 217

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nang bzhin chags shing tha na skabs mtshungs su sgog po'i kha rlangs yin zhes gangs 'bring ba zhig 'bab kyi yod pa'ang dngos bden yin par ma zad/rgyun gtan yang nam dus der slebs skabs 'brog pa tshos da sgog po'i kha rlangs kyi gangs 'bab ran yod ces gangs skyon 'gog thabs grabs gshom byed kyi yod/ spyir na ngar gtsod kyi dus yun ni nyin ma nyi shu'i yas mas zhig yin/ ri dwags rgyag mkhan la mtshon na de dus gtsod chu sgug gtong ba'i dus tshod yag shos de'o// gtsang chu mang che bar 'khyag pa chags kyang ong ka (chumig) che sa dang yang na ri ldebs kyi gangs 'khyil sar ri dwags rgyag mkhan gyis sgug rwa dhibazos nas de'i nang la gab bsdad nas gtsod la me mda' brgyab te gsod kyi yod/ sgug rwa khag cig sa dong zhig drus shing de'i kha mthar rdo chung tsam gyis brtsigs pa brgyab nas gang sar bod mda'i bsdigs khung bzos nas yod/ ngar gtsod skabs su sgog po tshang ma phar tshur 'ded shar gtong res byas nas kha skom sla ba dang / blo khog kyang dmigs bsal che la dogs pa de tsam med (spyir na gtsod ni dzi rno la dogs zon shin tu che ba'i ri dwags shig yin/)pas chu la babs yong ba dang me mda' rgyag sla bas thengs gcig la gnyis gsum tsam gsod thub kyi yod/ des na byang thang na chu mig che sa dang gangs shud che sar ngar gtsod kyi sgug rwa red ces pa gang sar rdo brtsigs che chung mang po mthong rgyu yod/ ngar gtsod ces pa de ston mjug skabs la yin tsang gtsod sha shed rgyas la ha cang rgyags pa dang lpags pa de la'ang khu lu shin tu legs pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod/ nyin nyi shu'i rjes su pho gtsod pho khyu 'dres pa dang mo gtsod mo yi sa la phyin nas pho gtsod dang mo gtsod rang bzhin gyis kha gyes kyi yod do// pho gtsod sgog po 218

༄khya//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gtsod rngon lugs skor brjod pa/de mang che ba sa btsan sa rdza dang g.ya' 'grim zhing mo gtsod tshang ma lung kyog dang brag khug drod che la rtswa legs sar sdod do//rus gtsod kyi skabs/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa dang / dang po/gnyis pa'i skabs su rus gtsod ces pa'i dus de yin/ de tshe ri steng la skam rtswa dam zhes brlan gsher nyung la/ bul tshwa shin tu dkon pas gtsod sogs ri dwags tshang ma tshwa dad ha cang che/ skabs de dang bstun nas gtsod rngon mkhan gyis dud 'gro'i sha btsos pa'i rus pa dag brdungs nas ga sa ga la gtor nas 'jog gi yod/ ri mgo'i gtsod ni rdzi shin tu rno bas sha btsos pa'i rus pa'i tshwa zhen che bar rngam nas rus pa dag za bar yong gi yod/ de skabs su khyi ra bas sgug rwa'i nang la bsdigos khung sprad nas sgug bsdad de gtsod rus par 'khor ma thag de ma nyid du me mda' brgyab nas phon chen gsod pa dang / de min sgog rtse btsugs nas gsod pa'ang mang ngo / lhag don du de dus mo gtsod tshang ma lus sbrum tsam yin stabs rus par 'khor ba mang gshis mo gtsod gsod thub na khog nang gi bskyur ro (re'u dmar 'byar/)yang len thub pas de btsos nas zos na ro bcud ldan la rgan khog lus gcong la shin tu smin par grags/ lar na de ni skabs bstun gyis ras rus par dga' bo yod pa nang bzhin red/ dper na 'brog pa'i ra tshwa zhen che ba'i skabs su sha btsos pa'i rus pa brdungs nas sbra gur gyi nye 'khor la bshos bzhag na rus pa'i dri ma dro ba dang sbrags ra ma tshang ma rang dbang med par der byur byur byas nas 'khor yong gi yod la/ 'tshang kha shig shig ngang rus pa mur gyi yod/ mdor na de dus kyang gtsod gsod yas kyi go skabs legs shos shig yin no//219

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsha gtsod kyi skabs/ bod zla lnga pa dang drug pa'i nang tsha ba che ba'i skabs la tsha gtsod ces pa'i dus la slebs/ de tshe byang thang lung par tsha ba che sgang yin pas sa 'og gi 'bu srin thams cad yar langs yong gi yod/de'i nang nas gtsod 'bu zhes gzugs sbrang 'bu dang 'dra zhing skad ngan ldar ldir sgrog mkhan zhig mchis/ 'bu de gtsod yod sar slebs pa dang gtsod thams cad sun thag chod pas gang sar rgyugs 'gro gi yod cing / mtshams mtshams la lus zungs kyis shugs brgyab nas gang sar bros 'gro ba dang mtshams mtshams la hob de nyal sdod pa/ mtshams mtshams gtsang po'i nang la yar mar gshar ba/ lhag par du gtsod rang gis drus pa'i tsha dong zhes sa dong bsil grib can sna tshogs yod pa de tsho'i nang la 'dzul nas sdod kyi yod/de dus gtsod rngon mkhan tshos tsha dong yod sar rnyi dang sgog rtse btsugs nas gtsod mang po gsod do//gangs gtsod kyi skabs/ bod zla drug pa'i mjug tsam dang bdun pa'i nang la gangs gtsod ces pa'i dus la sleb/ de ni byang thang dbyar kha'i nyi zer shin tu che skabs yin pas gtsod yod do cog tsha ba tsha thag chod nas sa cha dma' sar sdod thabs bral nas sa mtho sa dang bsil sa/ lhag par du dus bzhir zhur ma thub pa'i gangs yod sar phyin nas tsha g.yol byed do// gangs kyi 'khris su gcig nas bsil ngad ldan zhing / gnyis nas 'bu srin sogs gang yang med pas gtsod khyu dang khyu byas nas der 'khor yong gi yod/ de dus kyang gtsod rngon mkhan tshos gangs che sa'i gad 'khris su rtse sga dang sgog rtse btsugs pa'am sgug rwa sprad nas gtsod pho mo ci byung bsad nas dbyar sha dkon pa sangs thabs byed pa bcas so// mdor na byang thang 'brog pa'i 220

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang 'brog pa'i ri dwags gtsod rngon lugs skor brjod pa/rngon pa tshos gtsod kham dmar yod dus zas yod yin/ gtsod kham dmar med dus zas med yin zhes pa ltar gtsod ni nam dus ci la'ang gsod sla la/rngon pa tshos 'tsho rten med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa smros med red/mchana'agrel/bu ri gzhi/ ri dwags kyi sha la gzhi bcol nas 'tsho sdod byed pa'am ri dwags kyi sha 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi byas nas gnas sdod byed pa'i tsho pa dag la brjod de dper na ri gzhi ru thor dang ri gzhi a ru zhes pa ltar lags so//du khrid pa/ stod mnga' ris kha skad de don du skye bar go dgos/ dper na byang thang 'brog pa'i sa la dgun dus su re'u dang lu gu khrid pa dang dpyid dus be'u dang rte'u khrid kyi yod ces pa lta bu'o//metho po/ sa rdo sogs kyis mi'i dbyibs lta bur brtsigs pa'i gzugs can zhig yin/ 'ga' shas ni rdo brtsigs pa'i steng la ras dzar sogs bskon cing khag cig rgyugs par dud 'gro'i pags pa g.yog nas 'jog gi yod la/ tho po mang la tho thag ring ba'i skabs rtsid skud dang thag pa phra mos phan tshun sbrel nas 'jogarjo byang thang na gnas shing rgyu ba'i bya rigs mtha' dag kyang khrims shin tu dam po yod pa ni/ dpyid dus dus thog tu byang thang yul la thon nas dbyar ka'i ring sdod pa dang dgun shar ma khad lam seng lho rong mon yul du log 'gro bar ma zad/ log dus bang rim 'grigs po bsgrigs nas su yang ma lus pa byed kyi yod/me gtsang chen de ni byang thang 'brog yul dang byang mtha' mi med lung stong dbar gyi dbye mtshams su mchis/ gtsang po'i byang phyogs ni gtsod mos phru gu skye sa dang lho phyogs ni pho gtsod dang ma gtsod tshang ma'i rgyun gtan gyi gnas sdod byed sa de yin la 'brog pa'ang de khul la sdod pa mang ngo //me sgug ra/ phyogs bzhir rdo'i skyor brtsigs pa'i khang chung thog med pa zhig te chu dang gangs la phyogs sa der bsdigs khung sprad sa che chung sna tshogs yod pas rngon pas de'i nang la me mda' rgyag chog chog byas nas sgug sdod kyi yod/221

༄//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/stod mnga' ris khul gyi mi dmangs tshos lo gcig dus bzhi'i nang dus chen sna tshogs gtong gi yod mod kyang lo gsar pa 'char ma khad kyi dus ston ni gra rgyas shos dang phun sum tshogs shos shig lags/ 'dir brjod par bya ba ni stod mnga' ris khul gyi byang thang 'brog pa tshos lo gsar ji ltar gtong ba dang der dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ci 'dra yod pa'i skor rags tsam brjod rgyu yin pa gsham gsal ltar lags/'brog pa'i lo gsar de ni 'brog las thon skyed kyi dus bab dang sems can sha shed kyi gnas bab la bstun dgos pa ni nam dus skal pa bzang ba/sa chu 'dzom sa pa/ re'u dang lu gu skyes ma ran pa/ dus khom che ba'i skabs dang 'khel bar byed do// de yang lo gsar gyi sngon la grong pa so so'i kha phor snod chas dang thab chas tshang ma gtsang ma bzo bar ma zad skyes pa'i yog las ('a ba bed spyod btang nas spu bal 'khel ba'i las/) yog 'phro dang tshem bu tshem 'phro/ pags pa mnyes 'phro tshang ma las tshar ba byed dgos la/ bud med kyi thags btags 'phro dang u mu su slas 'phro tshang ma'ang mjug sgril zin pa byed dgos/ tha na rtsam pa btags yas rang 'thag kyang gtsang ma bzo daswā~X ༵ lte bar lte tsab brgyab pa dang lteb nang gi rtsam shul dag rtsam khug

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/nang la blug pa/ lo rtsam dang lo yos ma lhag pa byed cing mdor na lo de'i nang gi las ka tshang ma mjug sgril dgos/ sbra gur phyi'i chon thag① dang nang gi rgyal thagadhi tshang ma gsar pa brje ba dang sbra gur gyi shar lho gnyis kyi gzhogs re nas snam cha re brje po rgyag dgos kyi yod/ lhag par du sbra gur gyi rgyab mdun (rgyab nub la phyogs pa dang mdun shar la phyogs yod pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni byang thang la nub lhag ha cang che la shar lhag mtshams re ma gtogs rgyag gi med/) du yod pa'i snam cha dkar po yug gnyisamel gad brdar dang gtsang sbra legs po byed cing sbra gur phu la 'brang rgyas (yul lha mtshon byed kyi gtor ma zhig) dang spags las bzos pa'i rta g.yag ra lug sogs bsgrigs gshoms byed/ de nas nyi shu dgu la bud med tshang mas skra 'khru ba dang dgu thug skol dgos/gnam gang la skyes pa tshang mas sku 'khru zhing thud brdzis pa/ sha btsos pa'i khu bar rtsam pa brgyab nas gzan g.yos shing de rdog rdog bzos te sder ma zhig gi sgang la bzhag ste dkyil kong kong bzos nas mar khu rdag rdag gang blugs nas phyi la lud du bcug gi yod/ de 'khyags tshe lag pa gcig gis bkyag thub tsam yod/ de nas bag leb kyang mang po bzos te tshang ma brtsegs brgyab nas bsgrigs rjes su cu gang zhes sa dkar po zhig yod pa des ri mo sna tshogs 'bri bzhin yod de/ nyi zla dang nor bu/ tshwa tshong la 'gro ba lta bu dang lhas ra'i nang la lug phon chen nyal ba 'dra ba/ gangs ri rin po che dang mtsho mo ma pham/ de'i 'og la dpe cha dang de'i 'og la shon ma yin zhes zhabs bro'i phyag rgya byas pa'i bud med gna' chas spras pa dag bris shing rgyal thag sgang la dkar thig che chung sna tshogs bris nas rten 'brel mtshon par byed kyi yod do//bod zla bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu dgu'i dgong mo dgu thug 'thung ba dang 223

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ glud dbyugs pa sogs nang tshan khag gnyis tsam yod de dgu thug btung ba'i dgong mo mi tshang so so'i nang mi thams cad mnyam du 'dzoms thub pa byed dgos/ dgu thug phor pa dang po de ma 'thung gong la sbra gur gyi phu la mchod sgron brgyab cing thug phud gang phu'i mchod gshom gyi lcog rtse'i steng du mchod do//nyi shu dgu'i dgu thug gi grub cha gtso bo bag phye ril ril dang phyu ra/ gro ma/g.yang dkar lug gi brang rtsib sha tshil 'dres ma dum tsam gtub pa/ o ro'am mjing pa'i sha nag sti ga gtub pa/ lug gi mkhal tshil zhun po hrug hrug btsab pa bcas yin la/ de'i mnyam du zas sna dgu dgos pa ni/ la phug dang / nyung ma/ 'bras/ gro ma/ tshwa/ bu ram/ sha/ bag phye bcas sne dgu'o// lhag don du bag ril (gro zhib brdzis nas dbyibs ril ril bzos pa/)la bzo blta sna tshogs dang de'i nang la rdzas cha sna tshogs bcug nas bzo gi yod par/ phyi'i dbyibs sna tshogs nas go don sna tshogs mtshon pa ni/chos lugs dang 'brel ba yod pa ste gzungs 'dus dhidabyibs can gru bzhi nar mo/ 'brang rgyas dbyibs can/ steng lha yi lha khang dang bar btsan gyi btsan khang / 'og klu yi klu khang mtshon ched zur drug ldan gyi khang bzang dbyibs can/ rang byung khams dang 'brel ba yod pa ni nyi ma'i dbyibs can sgor sgor/ zla ba'i dbyibs ldan sgor sgor phyed gshags can/ skar ma'i dbyibs ldan zur mang can yin/ de dag thon na bsod bde bsod nams che ba'i don/ ri yi dbyibs can rtse rno la zhabs zheng che ba/ klung gi dbyibs can zur sne gnyis sbyar zhing zur sne gnyis ther du bzhag pa/ chutshoyi dbyibs can chu ris shig shig can/ go gnas dbang thang dang 'brel ba yod pa ni rgyal po'i pho brang dbyibs can gru bzhi mthug po zhig bla ma'i 224

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/bzhugs khri rgyab la khri 'gyogs ldan pa/ yab kyi bzhugs khri bkyag gsum ldan/ yum gyi bzhugs khri bkyag gnyis ldan/ 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa ste/ nar mo gcig la ril po chung chung gcig sbyar bar nya lu (mnga' ris skad de byi phrug)rgyab khur gyi mtshon rtags/(de su'i phor pa'i nang la 'dzul kyang ngo tsha kha skyengs dgos pa zhig yin/)gru bzhi nar mo sked pa skyog tsam byas par mi las sked skyog (las ka mi bgyis pa/)ces ga dus yin kyang sked pa skyog tsam byas nas gnyid nyal bsdad pa las brtson 'grus med pa'i don/ ra sug dbyibs can zhig blug pa de bud med la thon na su thug gan rkyal zhes 'chal mo'i don/mi lus dbyibs can mgo bo kyog tsam byas pa cig yod par grong pa mgo myul zhes rang gi nang la las ka byas nas hra tag tag byas te ma bsdad par mi tshang gang sar 'dzul phyin nas mi tshang gzhan gyi nang la ga re yod pa blta ba dang skad cha stong pa bshad nas nyi ma skyel mkhan gyi don/ dbyibs nar mo la rtse skung gu 'dra ba zhig bzo gi yod pa ni ltogs sla rtse snyung zhes ltogs sla tsha bo byas nas mi tshang gang sar 'dzul phyin nas gzhan zas longs spyod byed mkhan/rang 'thag dbyibs can sgor sgor zhig yod par ong to rang 'thag ces las kar ab yang po rtsa ba nas med par bsdad sa gcig rang la bsdad bzhag mkhan/ mi'i lag pa'i dbyibs can zhig bzos par rkun skye sbar ra zhes mi nor la rkun ma rgyag mkhan/ mi'i lce leb dbyibs 'dra ba zhig yod par rdzun kyus (rdzun bshad/)ma lce leb ces skad cha rdzun ma sha stag bshad mkhan drang po min pa/ gru bzhi sgor mo zhig la nu ma'i rtse bzhi 'dra ba zhig yod par 'bri mo nu bzhi zhes 'bri tshang mar be'u ster cing dkar chu skya rgyas yong ba'i don/ gru bzhi chung chung zhig la nu ma'i rtse 'dra ba gnyis yod phar g.yang dkar nu gnyis 225

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhes g.yang dkar lug la lu gu mang po bed ster ba'i don/ a long dbyibs can sgor mo zhig bzo gi yod pa ni rtsis dang 'char gzhi a long skor ba nang bzhin rtsis 'khor po zhe drag yod pa'i don/ phyug po'i mdzo sna zhes zur gsum gcus ril brgyab pa zhig bzos pa ni rgyu dngos dar zhing rgyas pa'i don yin la de nang la nor bu dang zas sna phun sum tshogs po yod pa'i don/ de tsho bud med la thob na yag po zhe drag yin pas tshang mas dga' tshor chen po byed kyi yod/gro zhib nang la rdzas cha sna tshogs blug nas go don 'dra min sna tshogs mtshon pa ni/ bag ril (gro zhib dbyibs ril mo/)gyi nang la tshwa blug pa cong to (mnga' ris skad de rkub la go/) tshwa las lji ba zhes sgyid lug ngan pa'i don/dar lcog blug pa rlung rta dar ba'i don/ lug gi bal blug pa ni mi sna ring po gshis ka shin tu 'jam zhing dal ba khog yang dkyel che ba'i don/ skud pa gcig la mdud pa dgu yod pa blug pa ni pho rab rtag ma dgu dkri zhes dpa' blo khog yod pa'i don/ skud pa phra mo zhig la mdud sne lnga ldan blug pa ni pho 'bring lag sprod sne lnga zhes pho 'bring po zhig mtshon/ skud pa 'bom tsam la mdud pa gsum brgyab pa zhig blug pa ni pho mtha' ma 'gyod pa rnam gsum zhes las ka ga re byas kyang 'gyod pa'i dbus su thim nas bsdad mkhan zhig mtshon/sol ba blug pa dug sems sol ba las nag par brjod/ skud pa mdud pa dgu brgyab pa blug pa ni pho rab rtag pa dgu khri/ mdud pa drug brgyab pa ni pho 'bring rang mgo rang thon/ mdud pa gsum brgyab pa ni pho mtha' ma las lo'i rdzong rdzong zhes so// bu ram blug pa ni gur rdzus zhes las ka mi las pa'i don/ rus pa blug pa sems pa dung ltar dkar bar brjod cing khag cig gi 226

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/rus mgo mtho shos yin zhes pa'am yang snying rus ha cang chen po yod pa la'ang go/ shwa bcug pa ni shwa pho'am shwa mo mang po yod ces dga' rogs mang po yod par go la dmar dad chen po yod pa la'ang go'o// tshwa blug pa ni thabs jus legs pa'am mkhas pa'i don/ sur pan blug pa kha tsha po'am kha zan po ste kha btsum tsam ma byed par gzhan la skyon 'dzugs byed mkhan/ rtsam pa tog tsam blug gi yod pa ni dug dri shin tu tsha po yod pa'i don/ 'bras rdog rkang cig blug pa ni bsod bde 'bras dkar spung spung zhes so// lham gzugs can zhig blug pa ni dpal lham gang zhes dpa' blo khog ha cang chen po yod pa'i don/ skud pa sgor sgor zhig blug pa ni mi de rgyal khams bskor nas gang sar slebs kyi yod pa'i don/ de bud med la don na rang yul bskyur zhes yag po min/ dbyibs mi'i gzugs can la dbu rtse me la bsregs nas nag tshub tsam zhig blug pa ni rdzun chen nag tshugs zhes skad cha bden pa med pa skyag rdzun rkyang rkyang bshad pa'i don/ zhwa mo'i bzo blta zhig blug pa ni jur zhwa gang zhes 'ur che ba las don dngos thog dpa' blo khog gang yang med pa'i don nam gzhan don la jus gtogs byed par dga' ba'i don no// g.yag gdang blug pa g.yag mang po 'phel ba'i don/ 'bri yi sgyid thag① blug pa 'bri mar mang po bsdu rgyu yong ba'i rtags/ ra ma dang ma mo'i bstar thag blug pa ni lu gu dang lu gu khrid pa'i ma mo mang ba'i rtags bcas so// de min skud pa phyi bran nang bran gnyis blug pa ni rkun ma phyi rkun nang rkun zhes spyod ngan rkun ma rku mkhan gyi don/ re'u dang lu gu 'dogs sa'i 'dogs gdang blug pa ni re'u dang lu gu phon chen 'phel nas lo legs skya rgyas yong ba'i don/rta 'dogs sa'i rtod thag blug pa ni rta bo mang po 'dogs rgyu yong ba'i rtags/ 227

༄༅/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rdo blug pa ni snying chen po'am dpa' blo khog ldan pa'i don/ ra lug gi ril ma blug pa ni mgo bde 'khrab mkhas pa'i don/ shog gu blug pa ni a gsar tsha po brtan po med pa'i don/ g.yag gi khu lu blug pa ni mi sna thung thung phog thug 'gro sa med pa'i don/ nya ga chung chung zhig blug pa ni mi de'i rnam 'gyur nya ga'i mda' ltar phog thug rtsa ba nas 'gro sa med pa lam seng rlung langs pa'i don/ g.yang 'gugs smug ril zhes de'i nang la 'bras sogs 'bru sna yod do dang ja tshwa bul sogs blugs par rgyu nor 'dzoms pa'i don/ra lug gi grod pa blug par thug grod sgor mo zhes de thon tshe thug phor gang thol pa 'thung dgos/ rgyug pa dmar po zhig blug pa ni gser rgyug ces phyug po yong ba'i don dang dkar po zhig blug pa ni sprang rgyug dkar po zhes rgyu nyams nas skyo po chags pa'i rtags yin/ spos phran bu blug pa ni gtsang sbra dod pa'i don dang ka ra blug pa ni mngar dad che ba'i don no// phyu ra bcug pa de bud med la thon tshe skyur dad che ba ni mngal 'khums par 'gyur ba'i don/ srang dang bre bcug pa de thon na 'bru rigs sogs lo legs yong ba'i don/mdor na dgu thug 'thung dus mi so sor ga re thon min tshang mar mig bstan nas 'phya lad rgyag pa dang bstod bsngags gtong ba/ yid smon byed pa/dgod bro'i skad dang 'ar sgra 'ur sgras yongs su khengs par byas pa sogs 'khrugs cha shin tu che zhing dga' skyid mnyam 'dzoms longs su spyod par byed do//thug pa phor pa dang po de 'thung skabs phor mthil la thig pa dgu tsam 'dang nges cig bzhag nas glud bzhag sa'i sla nga'i nang la blug glud bzhag sa'i sla nga'i nang dbus su spags las bzos pa'i kyung (mchod kong)228

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/gcig bzhag nas mchod me sbar/ de bzhin sla nga de'i nang du da dung ja skam dang / gro ma/ bse sdong sogs rtsi shing sna 'dzoms dang mar dang phyu ra sogs dkar sne 'dzoms pa/ ka ra dang bu ram sogs mngar sne 'dzoms pa/chang dang phab sogs skyur sne 'dzoms pa/ nas dang / gro/ rtsam pa/'bras sogs 'bru rigs sne 'dzoms/ sha dang / glo ba/ tshi lu bcas dmar sne 'dzoms pa sogs blug par ma zad/ spags las bzos pa'i pho gzugs gcig dang mo gzugs gcig sla nga'i mthar zur la blug gi yod par ming la a co dang i ci zer/ a co'i lus la ra lpags kyi ra slog chung chung zhig g.yog pa dang gdong la tshi lu 'byug cing phrag par mar ltang (ko ba'am lug gi grod lpags kyis btums pa'i mar do po/)skyel/ mgo la lu gu'i tsha ru'i lpags zhwa bskon/ i ci de la reb shag (sbragur gyi snam cha nag po rnying hrul chung chung /)nag po g.yog ste ngo gdong la thab nang gi dud dreg 'byug cing mgo la be rag (ltag rtse nas mar leb tu btang ba'i g.yu bcal bting ba'i rgyan cha)mtshon ched kyi spags leb mo zhig sgron/ pho gzugs sla nga'i byang phyogs dang mo gzugs sla nga'i lho phyogs su bzhag gi yod la mchod kong zhig gi nang la mar khu bskang ste me sbar nas bzhagade bzhin sha dang / rus pa/ sbang ma/ slab ro (ja ro'i don/)bcas mi kha ldog pa'i rdzas sna yang cha tshang ba blug gi yod pa ni lo gcig gi nang la mi kha'i gnod pa rtsa ba nas mi yong ba'i ched du yin pa'ang ja 'thung slab ro mi kha'i zas/ chang 'thung sbang ma mi kha'i zas/ sha zos rus pa mi kha'i zas/mi kha zas nas grogs la song zhes pa de'o// dus mtshungs su thug phor dang po de 'thung zin ma thag mi res lam seng spags rdog rdog re 'khyer nas lus 229

༄7/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po yongs te rkang pa'i mthil nas mgo'i rtse gtsug bar du sgril rgyag gi yod par kha nas skad chen po brgyab nas sgril lo sgril lo rdar ro rdar ro dag go dag golo gcig rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhag ma sum brgya drug bcu/ de'i nang nad dang na tsha 'khyer la song / bgegs dang bar chad 'khyer la song /gdon dang gnod pa 'khyer la song / lus kyi na tsha 'khyer la song / sems kyi sdug bsngal 'khyer la song / dpon po'i 'gong po 'khyer la song / nye ba'i chag sgo 'khyer la song zhes smon lam gsol 'debs yang mtshams ma chad par 'debs shing mgo'i skra rkang gcig gam lus steng gos gzan gyi spu rkang re zung ngam hrul hrul ral po zhig spags kyi mnyam du bsres so so'i lag pa'i sbar mo'i mdzub mo lnga yi rjes gsal bar byas te glud dbyugs sa'i sla nga'i nang du bzhag pa dang dus mtshungs su tha na sgo phyugs ra lug rta g.yag khyi sogs la'ang spags kyis lus yongs su rdar sgril zin rjes su tshang ma sder ma de'i nang la 'jog gode nas de bskyur bar 'gro mkhan nang mi pho mo mi gnyis te skyes pa des lag pa gcig gis me mda' dang 'ur rdo 'khyer ba dang lag pa gcig gis sbur rtse(mnga' ris khul du yod pa'i rtsi shing me 'byams sla ba zhig) mgo zing zing la me spar nas ‘‘'a sha be 'a sha bemi’zhes skad brgyab cing nang la skor ra nang skor zhig brgyab nas mar don shog mar don shog ces gdon 'dre tshang ma phyir spyugs byed khul byas shing / bud med des lag pa gcig la glud dbyugs sa'i sla nga 'khyer ba dang lag pa gcig gis tshags ma'i nang la me blug de'i thog la bsang spos dang tshwa brgyab rjes su mi tshang de'i mi re re'i mgo thog la bskor tsam byas ma thag phyi la thon nas sbra gur dang lug lhas/ g.yag gdang /230

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/rta ra bcas la g.yas skor lan gcig brgyab ste skyes pa de'i gzhug ma tsam la phyin nas sdod gnas dang cung thag nye ba'i ri dang brag sogs gsum mdo khar phyin nas gnas ri dang dgon pa med sa'i sa la dbyugs kyi yod de/ sngon la skyes pa des mar me bskyur ba dang de steng bud med kyis glud blug pa'i sla nga kha sbubs rjes su skyes pas 'ur rdo dang me mda' brgyab nas phyi nang gi 'dre la sogs pa gdon 'dre gdug pa can tshang ma phyir smyugs byed khul byas rjes su phyi mig tsam yang mi blta bar skad shugs chen pos/ rta ra gru bzhi rta yis khengs// lug lhas gru bzhi lug gis khengs// ra lhas gru bzhi ra yis khengs//g.yag gdang gru bzhi g.yag gis khengs// dpal khang gru bzhi mi yis khengs//‘‘shog spa le shog spa le ’ (mnga' ris skad de shugs rgyag shig ces so/)zhes skad brgyab nas gnyis kas mig btsums nas rdo re len/ nang mi zhig gis tha li'i (sder rtse'i don/)nang rtsam pa dang mar yod pa de 'khyer nas phyi la 'gro mi mi de gnyis la ci 'khyer yod ro ci 'khyer yod ro zhes ma thag de gnyis kyis da gser gyi pha long (pha bong gi don/) 'khyer yod do// dngul gyi pha long 'khyer yod do// g.yu drug dkar ra pho'i mchin pa 'khyer yod do// dung byur mu tig dar dang gos chen rta g.yag lug gsum sogs mi nor sne lnga tshang ma 'khyer yod do// da thegs kyi mi 'dug ces sbra gur gyi sgo rdo 'gam ma thag rdo rdog rdog gnyis po de rtsam pa dang mar yod pa'i sder ma'i nang la bzhag nas mchod sgron zhig byas te mar tog tsam kha nang la bcug nas yar nang la 'dzul yong ngo // de dus sgo 'gram la nang gi a mas chu skyog nang chu 'khyer yong nas mda' dar rtse sgros chu thig pa 'ga' shas bshos/ chu bshos kyi yod pa ni glud dbyugs par phyin nas btsog grib sogs shor yod tshe gtsang mar 231

༄7/khu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dag pa'i ched du red/ yang g.yang rdo de gnyis lo gsar ma thon bar du g.yang sgam sgang la bzhag cing lo gsar rjes su nang gi pha rgan des g.yang rdo tshur blangs nas tshos gzhi legs min/(smrag po yin na snum zhag yod par 'dzin cing se bo yin na dbul bar 'dzin/) ri molegs min/(ri mo cha 'dra yin tshe shin tu legs shing ya yin tshe mi legs/) brtag pa dang / kong kong dang kyong kyong med na bkra shis bag bro ba dang yod na grod khog ma rgyags zhes thabs skyo 'u thug la 'dzin no//de min lo gsar gyi bsgrigs gshom gras su rta g.yag ra lug khyi sogs sems can lnga'i gzugs dbyibs spags las bzhengs shing rta la mar gyi mig dang rnga ma la smug rtsi byug nas gson nyams dod po zhe drag yod/ de'i mtha' 'gram du zas rigs kyi phud sna tshogs dang lhag don du zan gong zhes pa'i zhim zas dmigs bsal can zhig yod pa ni lug sha btsos pa'i khu ba la rtsam pa brgyab nas brdzis rjes su phor pa'i gzugs dbyibs ltar sgor mo bzos shing mar gyi yar kha zur gsum du rgyags te mar khu zhur nas phyed ka lhag tsam brgyangs/ de nas de'i nang la bu ram dang / phyu ra/ rtsam pa bcas mnyam du bsres nas blug gshis khengs rjes su phor pa'i dbyibs can gyi lug sha'i khu bas brdzis pa'i spags la thur ma brgyab nas bkog gin mar khu'i nang la sbang bzhin za gi yod/ da dung lug mgor rma rtsa ba nas ma bzos pa cha tshang ba zhig bsgrigs te rwa co dang / rna cog so/ sna khug bcas la mar gyi yar mtshon shin tu legs po zhig brgyab yod de gtam dper yang / lo gsar btang ba 'char can yin// lug mgo dgos pa rgyus yod yin//zhes dang der do 'gan chen po byed cing lo gsar pa'i bsgrigs gshom yod 232

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/do'i lte bar gyur pa de'o//tshes gcig nyin zhogs pa snga po nam ma langs gong ngam skar ma smin drug ma skyod gong la nang gi mna' ma'am bu mo langs nas lu ma nas gser chu dang dngul chu'am smin drug thor chu zhes lu chu dublangs te chu phud phul ba dang 'brang rgyas rjobardzi yas spags khu byed par ma zad/ chag tshe'i duthug par chang phud tog tsam blugs pa dang phyu ra skyur mo brgyab nas bskol te nang mi tshang mar bkyags kyi yod pa de dbus gtsang khul gyi chang skol dang 'dra/ de nas nam langs ma thag nang mi tshang mas thog ma phu'i 'brang rgyas sogs la phyag 'tshal nas bla ma dkon mchog gsum la dbu ma zhes shing kha phye mar rjonas mchod sgron bsnams te thab la mchod gtor byas rjes thab lha rgya'u la dbu ma/ sgo phyi la mchod gtor byas te sgo yi khyi mo dmar mo la dbu ma zhes pa dang / phru gu tshos thog ma yab chen la phyag 'tshal ⑫nas a pha la dbu ma zhes shing yum chen la'ang phyag 'tshal nas a ma la dbu ma zhes so// de'i tshe pha ma gnyis nas kyang phyag 'tshal mkhan phru gu so so'i ming bos nas lo so ma (mnga' ris skad de gsar pa/)la bkra shis/ lo gsar pa la zhal rgyas/ phyag 'tshal yul dkon mchog gsum po yin zhes shing / de tshe nang mi tshang mas kha phye mar tog tsam blangs nas yar gnam la mchod cing / lo gsar pa'i nang kha bro po dang bkra shis po yong ched gro yos rkang kha shas blangs nas kha nang du bzas pa bcas so//lo gsar ring 'brog pa tshos rgyan gos kyis gzab mchor legs par spras kyi yod de/ skye pho tshos mgo la wa zhwa spu gra shin tu legs pa dmar mdangs can zhig gyon pa dang / lpags rtsag 'og la 'bu ras 'og 'jug dang snam bu'i gos thung gsar rkyang zhig gyon cing lus la lu gu'i tshar slog 'go 233

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/snam smug mdog can dang sngo nag ldan pa'i g.yogs brgyab nas de'i mtha' la stag dang gzig sram sogs kyi pags pas brgyan pa'i lpags rtsag gyon zhing rkang par thag lham mam pa'u zhes pa ko bas btum pa'i lham sna tsog tsog zhigade min yang nag dob ces sog po'i lham gzugs can ko bas bzos pa'i yu ring mthil mnyam pa zhig go/ de bzhin sked par sked gri dang / me lcagakhab shubs sogs cha tshang btags kyi yod la mgul rgyan yang legs po zhig sgron gyi yod pa ni dbus su gzi dang de'i mtha' g.yas g.yon la byu ru dang g.yu sogs yod cing mdzub mor mdzub dkris nges par 'dogs dgos par 'brog pa tshos skye pho la rgyan cha 'dogs yas de gal chen por 'dzin gyin yod/gtam dper yang / pho rgyan yod bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs// pho rgyan med bzhugs gral thal bas khengs// zhes yod/ yang bud med tshos lu gu'i tsha ru'i zhwa mo dkar dkar dung mdog can zhig gyon cing gos chen gyi 'og 'jug har tsam zhig dang ras cha spu ma'i gos thung gyon la lu gu'i tsha ru'i slog par rgyab sha 'go snam ljang khu'am dmar dkar can gyis g.yogs btang ba'i lpags rtsag la mtha' dang gong par sram lpags chung tsam gyis brgyan cing /rgyab slog 'ja' ma gu ge'i rgyal rabs skabs kyi gna' srol ldan pa'i gos slog dmigs bsal can zhig gyon la mgo la be rag ces pa'i rgyan cha g.yu byur mu tig spos shel mchong sogs dang gser dngul bcas kyis brgyan pa'i dbu rgyan thun mong min pa zhig dang sked par gser dngul gyi ga'u bdun tshar btags pa bcas so//de nas yab chen des yar bzhengs nas kha phye mar dbus su mchod pa'i 'bri mar de nas chung chung zhig bzhes te bu rgan gzhon rim par mchod gtor 234

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/byas nas shar rgya tsha khra bo dpa' rtsal che/ dpral bar yar brgyab nas da lo'i lo gsar pa mdun du len zhes shing ltag rtser yar brgyab nas na ning gi lo rnying pa rgyab tu bskyur zhes so// yang dpung mgo g.yas la yar brgyab nas gtan du bde ba thob par shog dpung mgo g.yon du yar brgyab nas bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog spyi gtsug la yar brgyab nas nam mkhar (mnga' ris skad du de dus sang ngam sang lo'i don/)da gzod khra hrog ge 'dzum sag ge(gad mo'i 'dzum mdangs bstan pa'i rnam pa/)yong bar shog ces dang / bu mo rgan gzhon rim par mchod gtor byas nas lho g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i mdzes sdug ldan zhes pa dang yar kha brgyab stangs dang smon lam 'debs don skyes pa bu dang mtshungs so// de bzhin yul lha gzhi bdag la dbu ma (mnga' ris kha skad de phyag 'tshal lo zhes so/) pha mes rgyal po la dbu ma/ i phi (smo bo'i don/) klu mo la dbu ma/ thab lha rgyal mo la dbu ma/ sgo lha rgyal mtshan sder bzhi la dbu ma/ yab kyi ming bos nas dbu ma/ yum gyi ming bos nas dbu ma/ ming po thams cad la dbu ma zhes mdor na nang mi lo che chung gzhir bzung gis phyag 'bul du bcug gi yod pas chung shos de yis phyag mang shos 'bul dgos so// 'on kyang sring mo la phyag 'bul ba'i thob thang med pas gcung pos gcen mo la phyag 'bul byed srol ma mchis/de nas 'o ma dkar yol gang re dang tshe zho ⑪thur mgo gang re 'thung ba dang lug mgo za rgyu'i mgo 'dzugs so// skye pho yin na mi re la lug mgo re thob pa dang bud med yin na kha gshags phyed ka las mi thob/ lug mgo de dag sngon la spu tshang ma me nang du bshar nas gtsang ma bzos/ de nas chu la bkrus te zangs snod nang la blugs nas me chung tsam btang nas rgyun ring 235

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btsos pas dmigs bsal ro bcud ldan no// de rting chu tig ger (bag leb chung chung chu btsos brgyab pa zhig) ya grangs bsgrigs nas btang / de rjes sha rum (sha rdog tsam rdog tsam btsos pa sha lhu las chung ba yod/) btang / de tshe mi tshang mas rang rang so so'i skal ba blangs nas rang gi phor pa'i nang la bzhag pa las lam seng za gi med/ de nas so so'i skyes rtags gzhir bzung gis sha lhu bsgrigs gshoms byed kyi yod par khag cig la brang thob pa dang khag cig la dal mo (sha khog smad kyi rkang pa gnyis bkog zin rjes lhag pa'i rtsib ma kha sbyar ma dang smad rus gzhug gu'i rtsa ba rang sbyar ma/) thob pa/ khag cig la bar rkang /(smad rus dang rta rdzi rkang 'brel mtshams/) khag cig la rta lcag(rkang pa'i bar rkang dang sub rtse 'brel mtshams/) khag cig la rta rdzi rkang /(lag pa'i bar rkang dang sub rtse 'brel mtshams/) khag cig la sog pa/(sog pa ma red tshogs pa red/ lha phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel red ces legs po yin) dang dpyi mgo (smad rus)bcas thob/ de rting pu li zhes bag leb srab po zhig btang / nyin dgung tsam la sha mog te lug gi khal tshil zhun po dang rkang pa'i sha gnag pa/ ri sgog bsres ma'i ro bcud ldan pa'i zhim zas shig btang gi yod do// mjug tu gsol ba chen mo zhes sha dal mo cha tshang ba dang rkang lag cha tshang ba/ brang khog cha tshang ba/ o ro(mnga' ris skad de mjing pa'i don) cha tshang ba btsos nas mi tshang mar thugs spro rgyas po zhig btang gi yod cing dgong mo lug rdzi tshur nang la 'khor zin nas chang 'thung 'go btsugs nas dga' skyid longs su spyod do// tshes gnyis nyin sha mog mog dang / bag tsha mar khu/ 'bras bsil mar khu/ lug gi rgyu ma dkar nag bcas rim pas btang / mang che ba so 236

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/so'i skal ba yin zhes tshur blangs nas bsdus bzhag pa las za thub kyi med/dgong dag sha tshil 'dres ma'i sha hrug ri sgog brgyab pa tsha po zhig btang gi yod/ de zin ma thag mchod chang drangs kyi yod/ thog ma ‘‘g.yang rtse ’’zhes gsol skyogs chen po gang re 'dren/ de 'thung zin pa dang tshang ma ngo tsha bshangs nas gzhas dang zhabs bro 'khrab 'go btsugs te 'khrugs po zhe drag yod/ dgong dag lug sha sha lhu re btang ba dang dgong mo nyal khar thug pa 'jam thug (chu grang mor rtsam pa hrul nas dkrug dkrug rgyun ring btang rjes su thab thog bzhag nas 'khol du bcug pa dang sbrags sdor dang phyu ra brgyab pas lus la ha cang smin pa'i zhim zas thun mong ma yin pa zhig) sprad nas mtshams bzhag go/tshes gsum nyin lha gsol byed kyi yod par zhogs pa dkar sder ram shing sder nang la 'brang rgyas smug rtsi btang zhing dkar rgyan brgyab pa gcig bzhag de'i rgyan gyi tshod du shing tog mngar gsum skyur gsum bsgrigs shing dar mtshon sna lnga phra phung nger sgrog te nang gi phu'i mchod gshom 'og tu gshams shing mchod kong nang la mchod me sbar ba dang ting bdun tshar nang la chu phud phul nas 'bru gtor te gsol ba smon lam 'debs/ nang gi pha yis gzungs 'dus zhal phye nas bar chad lam sel dang / mi kha sgrol thog rta g.yag ra lug gi gzungs tshang ma 'don gyi yod/ de rting nyi ma 'char ma khad la sbra gur phyi'i phu phyogs kyi dar lcog btsugs shing dar thag 'then/de nyin zhogs par zhogs ja 'thung zin pa dang grong pa'i skyes pa pho tshang ma phyi la thon nas kha shar la 'khor/ gsol lug ral rdo brgyab/(gsol yas su zin pa'i lug de dag bstar la brgyus/) sngon la lug kha rgya zhig gsol nas mi kha ldog zhes/ de nas rim gyis lha lug dkar po dang btsan lug btsag dmar 237

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/te gzugs gzhi dkar rkyang la mig gi mtha' bzhi dmar sgor re yod cing spor dmar ling nge ba zhig dang rna cog gi rtse dmar mo yin pa zhig go / klu lug sngon mo/ mgon po rog po bcas rim gyis gsol/ de nas bsang btang zhing kha phye mar gyi sgang la mchod pa'i mar leb mo che chung sna tshogs yod pa de dag 'khyer yong nas yar rgyag bzhin kha nas/ gsol lo gsol lo zhes lug gi rwa co'i sgang la mar gyi yar brgyab nas ru sde ru sde ra ru brdar nas rgyal kha thob/ rna cog la brgyab nas rna bar nam yang gtam snyan 'khrol/ kha 'gugs g.yas g.yon la brgyab nas kha 'phrod po yong bar smon/ dpral bar brgyab nas brtan no brtan no mi tshe brtan/ zog gi g.yang brtan/gos kyi bkrags brtan/ zas kyi bcud brtan/ mi nor phyug gi rgyud la brtan zhes/ ze ba'i sgang la yar brgyab nas ze ba'i rtse ltar 'phel ba shogade nas snying gi thad sgang la yar brgyab nas thugs sems bde bar shog ces/mig sgang la yar brgyab nas spyan rno'o rno'o zhes/ kha la yar brgyab nas zhal bzang ngo zhal dro'o zhes/ rna lcog gru la dar phru sna lnga btags/ de nas btsag 'khyer yong ste lha lug dkar po'i sgal par btsag btang nas kha nas steng lha yi lha lug dkar po de/ 'gro ba'i dus su chibs pa byas/ chibs pa de las mgyogs pa med/ bsdad pa'i dus su sku mkhar byas/ sku mkhar de las mtho ba med/ bso bso zhes sgal pa'i tshigs rus nas mar smad rus phyogs su ded nas yar brgyab/ rwa co g.yas par yar brgyab nas rdar ro rdar ro// g.yas kyi zangs ru dmar po de/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs kyi kha gnon spu gri ngar mo'o// rwa co g.yon mar yar brgyab nas mi brdar ro mi brdar ro// g.yon gyi mchong ru smug po mi brdar ro mi brdar ro 238

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/mchong ru 'jam mnyed des/ pha ma bu phrug dang gnyen tshan nye ring / yul mi khyim mtshes/ kha shes ngo 'dris tshang mar gnod dang 'tshe ba'i skal ba ma 'gyur/ mi brdar ro mi brdar ro mchong ru smug mo mi brdar ro zhes de'i don ni g.yon gyi rwa co gri nang bzhin rdar gyi min nam kha gtad bcags kyi min gnod pa skyel gyi min zhes pa'o// de nas mar sgor sgor bzos te kha nas/thig 'khyil thig 'khyil/ sngon mo 'bru yi bang ba 'khyil/ gser po gser gyi bang ba 'khyil zhes shing / yang btsan lug la yar brgyab nas gsol lo gsol lo bar btsan gyi btsan lug dmar po de/ 'gro ba'i dus su chibs pa yin/ chibs pa de las mgyogs pa med/ bsdad pa'i dus su sku mkhar yin/ sku mkhar de las mtho ba med/ tshe thar ro// tshe thar ro// 'jig rten gyi 'jigs pa'i tshe las nam yang thar ro// 'gro ba mi'i 'jigs skul las thar ro// tshe thar la sus gnod kyang dmyal khams bco brgyad la lhung ngo zhes so// de nas yang btsan lug dmar mo'i rwa cor khrag ltar dmar pa'i btsag dmar lan gsum byug nas kha 'don du/ g.yas kyi zangs rwa dmar mo de kha mar las 'jam pa dang snying tsher ma las tsub pa bso bso zhes shing /g.yon gyi rwa cor btsag dmar lan gsum byug nas kha 'don du/ g.yon gyi mchong rwa smug mo de dgra yod tshad la brgyab gnyen yod tshad la ngoms kha mar las 'jam pa snying tsher ma las tsub pa bso bso zhes so// de nas yang lag pa g.yas la brdar nas g.yas gom 'gros mgyogs pa'i rlung rta dar ba shog g.yon la brdar nas g.yon ma ri rgyal lhun po bzhin brtan cing lhing ba shog bso bso/ yang mkhal ma g.yas la brdar nas ser po gser gyi bang mdzod khengs/ mkhal ma g.yon la brdar nas g.yon ma dkar mo dngul gyi 239

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bang mdzod khengs zhes shing dus mtshungs su lha lug dkar po dang mdongs po ngor chung ste lus po dkar por ngo gdong dang / sug rtse dmar po zhig klu lug sngon po/ btsan lug dmar mo/ mgon po rog po/ khar rgya yibacas rim pas gsol lo//lug gsol zin ma thag lam seng gong gi cho ga dang kha 'don bcas te ra dag gsol gyi yod par/ lha ra ngang pa dang klu ra sngon mo/ btsan ra dmar smug mgon ra 'o la ('ol ba'am nag po/)bcas rim gyis gsol cing mi yi tshe ra dang sems can gyi tshe lug ces ra lug cha gcig tshe thar btang rjes su thod klad dang sgal par btsag 'byug cing rwa co'i rtse la yar kha brgyab pa dang kha nang la phye mar tog tsam blug gin bkra shis/ tshe ring / kha dro/ nad ma yong / yul bde/ rtswa chu bzang / sems can 'phel/ dkar chu rgyas/mi bde/ khyi skyid bcas smon lam 'bul bzhin du 'brang rgyas kyang lug lhas nang la 'khyer gyi yod par sems can gyi spu phud phran bu btogs nas skud pa nang sgrim brgyab nas 'brang rgyas la mchod/ ra lug gsol yas de tsho'ang rwa cor chag skyon med pa dang rna lcog o pa (rna lcog dum zhing thung ba/)min pa/ spu gra legs pa/ shed bzang ba bcas dgos so//de nas lha lug dang / btsan lug klu lug tshang ma bstar las brgyus pa nas bkrol dus 'o ma chu skyogs gang 'khyer yong nas gang ga'i steng la mchod gtor byed kyi yod/ kha nas skad shugs chen pos 'khrus gsol lo 'khrus gsol lo zhes 'bod/ lug thag pa'i bstar las bkrol zin nas lug byings kyi sar rgyugs 'gro dus mda' dar 'khyer nas khug shog khug shog phywa khug shog g.yang khug shog ces lug re re bzhinajigyi mgo yi sgang la g.yab 240

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/tsam byed kyi yod do// de nas g.yag gdang nang la phyin nas lha g.yag dkar po dang /btsan g.yag kham pa/ klu g.yag sngon mo/ mgon po rog po bcas la dang dod byas nas rwa co dang sgal dgung la btsag dmar 'byug pa dang ze bar dar lcog sna lnga sgrog pa/ rna lcog la rna phra brgyab pa/ rnga mar dar phru btang ba bcas byed kyin lha g.yag dkar po gangs ri'i khrod du 'grim/ gangs dkar mo'i gangs chu rgyas shing 'phel/ btsan g.yag kham pa rdza ri 'grim zhing skyod/ rdza khra lu'i rdza chu rab tu 'phel/ klu g.yag sngon mo g.ya' ri 'grim nas byon/ g.ya' chu sngon mos rtsi shing ri klung khengs/ mgon po rog po spang stod 'grim nas 'gro/ spang rgyan me tog nam mkha'i skar ltar rgyas/ gsol lo gsol lo nyi zla skar gsum gsol/ gsol lo gsol lo lha klu btsan gsum gsol/ gsol lo gsol lo ri klung chu gsum gsol/gsol lo gsol lo bla ma dkon mchog gsum gsol/ gsol lo gsol lo rgyal po dang yab yum gsum gsol/ gsol lo gsol lo ra lug g.yag gsum gsol/ gsol lo gsol lo mi rta khyi gsum gsol zhes g.yag gdang la bsang gi dud zhag bdug cing 'brang rgyas 'khyer nas nang la log te 'brang rgyas phu la rang sor mchod pa dang mda' dar de yum phyogs kyi phu la mchod de mchod chang gi phud gtor byas shing / nang mi tshang mas chang phor nang la blug cing mnyam du spags zan zas rjes lug rdzi dang g.yag rdzis g.yag lug ri la 'ded 'gro gi yod la lo gsar pa'i nang la dga' skyid 'tsho ba longs su spyod rgyu yong ba'i smon lam yang yang 'debs pa bcas so//rta gseb dang spo ba (dbus gtsang khul du g.yag thug ces so/ )yin na 241

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/leb khral khongs su tshud med la tsho pa gzhan gyi rtswa za'i sa khungs la phyin kyang nag nyes rtsa ba nas med/ kha rgyun du sgo phyugs de'i rigs la rang dbang thob zin pa yin zhes ra gnam g.yeng ste rwa co gnam la bstan nas phyin tshe phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar slebs 'gro chog la gar slebs bsdad chog mig sa g.yeng ste mig mthong sa'i sa cha gang 'dra zhig la slebs kyang tshang mas bdag gnyer byed dgos kyi yod pa las gang byung du phyir sprugs byed mi nyan/de'i dgong mo nang mi rgan dar gzhon gsum mnyam 'dzoms byas nas thud btang / thud ces pa de lug mar kha mdog kham dkar dwangs shing gtsang ba dkar sder nang la blug ste me drod la bzhag nas mar khu bzhu ru bcugade nas tshags mas btsags pa'i phyu ra zhib zhib mar khu bzhus zin pa'i nang la blug pa dang / bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar po ⑫brgyab nas brdzis shin tu 'theb po byas nas bzo lta sgor mo che chung sna tshogs bzos shing kha thog la smug rtsi byug ste 'khyag tu btang / dgun kha 'brog khul du shin tu grang bas rdo ltar ha cang mkhregs po chags/ de nas nang gi yab chen gyis mdo gri gar sog gi rtse btsugs te zur nas dra/ zur dang chung ba de tsho phru gur btang zhing dbus kyi che ba de tsho nang gi pha mar btang nas mchod sgron byas te so so'i skal ba'i khrod du bcug nas gnas skabs bsdu gi yod/ thud (spyir btang che gras shig g.yag gi dol rgyab thub tsam yod/)btang zin ma thag sha bzhi gling btsos pa dag pha ma la bzhi gling gi smad (rus pa nyung zhing sha phon che bar yod/) dang phru gur bzhi gling stod (rus pa dang rtsib ma mang bas sha nyung ba yod/) btang ba der tshang mas mar dang rtsam pa'i yar kha brgyab nas bsdu'o⑫/ / de nas glu gzhas btang ba dang zhabs bro 'khrab nas dga' skyid longs su spyod cing nam phyed 242

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bar bsdad de tshes bzhi nas lo gsar mjug sgril lokamachan/me sbra gur phyi'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'then yas thag pa der brjod/de dag med na gur 'bubs mi thub/ chon thag re la ka ba re dang chon rdo'am phur pa re dgos/ sbra gur spyi la chon ga brgyad las med kyang sbra chen dmigs bsal can la chon thag bcu drug yod/ mnga' ris yul gyi sbra gur che shos dang legs shos dmigs bsal dang dod yod pa ni sgar rdzong mon mtsher yul la yod cing yul de'i sbra gur tshad mar 'dzin gyi yod/rjo sbra gur nang la btang ba'i thag pa leb mo rim pa gnyis yod/ de tsho ni khang pa'i gdung ma ltar yin pas der phyi'i chon thag sgrog nas 'then tshe sbra gur yar bsang nger bkyag thub bo// g.yon phyogs bud med sdod sa'i rgyal thag la phyu ra btsags sa'i btsags sgye sgrog pa dang g.yas phyogs skyes pa sdod sa'i rgyal thag la ra lug nang cha'i nang nas rdzi sha zhes pa de sgrog nas dus yun ring tsam 'das rjes su dreg pa 'khor te skam bsang chags/ de btsos nas zas na dmigs bsal gyi bro ba dang ro bcud ldan no//du sbra gur gyi snam cha dkar po de gnyis la ru dkar dang sgo dkar zhes te 'dre dang sems can gdug pa can tshang ma skrag mi yong ba'i ched du yin la gnas spo byed dus gur gyi gzhogs g.yas g.yon yug cha nag po de gnyis dbye mtshams lam seng phye bde ba'i ched du'ang yin la/ yang rgan rabs 'ga' shas kyi brjod srol la sbra gur nag po de thog ma g.yag khra bo kha nub la phyogs pa'i gzugs shig ste rgyab kyi snam cha dkar po des g.yag gi gdong mdun dkar po mtshon pa dang mdun ngos sgo phyogs kyi snam cha dkar po de ni g.yag gi rnga ma dkar po mtshon pa'i rtags yin skad do//du dpe cha der 'brog pa tshos ha cang mthong chen byed cing spyir btang mi tshang rer glegs bam re yod/ de ni jo nang pa twa ra na thas mdo rgyud khag nas bton pa'i 243

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzungs sngags glegs bam zhig ste chos tshan brgya dang brgyad yod skad/ 'brog pa tshos gnas gsar par slebs ma thag lam seng bsang gsol byed pa dang phyag dpe de zhal phye tsam byed kyi yod do//du 'bri'i 'o ma bzho dus rtag tu sgyid thag rgyag gi yod pa ni gal te sgyid thag brgyab pa na 'o ma mang la 'phra ga brgyab nas 'o ma gsho yong bsam pa'i sems khral byed mi dgos/ de ni thag pa sne khug gsum ldan rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa gcig la rgyag pa'i sgrog thag lta bu yin te 'gugs chung gi sne mo gsum la cha ru (shing bu thung ngu rked nyag can/)gsum yod/rjo lo gsar pa'i nang lu ma'i lu chu blangs nas btung ba ni bya las thams cad la bgegs bar chad ma yong bar lu chu'i rgyun rgyugs pa bzhin bkra shis bde legs yong ba'i smon 'dun gyi bsam pa rnam dag bcangs pa dang / lu chur bsang gsol gtong ba ni klu gsol te sa bcud ma nyams par smon pa'o//du spyir btang yul so so'i lha'i dbyibs can zhig ste kho bo'i pha yul glang bcu la rgyal ba zhes pa zhig dang sku ngo zhes pa zhig khyon gnyis bzhengs shing rgyal ba ni dbu la ral pa shig shig yod pa zhig dang de'i thor gtsug tu nyi zla dang sku mdun la g.yung drung gi ri mo bris yod/() nas chag brgyab pa'i thug pa ste lo gsar pa'i nang kha chag sna ral sogs ma yong ba'i don yin cing de ni nas hrog por btags te chu 'khol la brgyab pa'i thug pa tshwa dang sdor gang yang med pa'i thug pa bcud ldan 'ju sla ba zhig go/rjo kha phye mar zhes pa mar spags skam sil sil brdzis nas sder ma chung chung zhig gi nang kha mthon por brgyang zhing de'i sgang la gro/(kha dro ba/) yos bshos shing dbus su 'bri mar (phyugs las dkar chu dar zhing skyid pa'i mar khu chu rgyun ltar rgyugs pa'i rten 'brel/)ser po dog tsam zhig bzhag pa der brjod/ phyis su dbus gtsang khul du sku drag tshos rgyas spros kyis gro so phye mar zhes par bsgyur kyang mnga' ris 'brog khul du 244

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang khul gyi 'brog pa'i lo gsar gtong lugs skor gleng ba/gna' snga mo'i lugs srol rang sor gnas/ ⑪ lo gsar tshes gcig nyin gyi zhogs par rang gi khyim nang la bsdad pa'i bu phrug tshang mas rim gyis pha ma gnyis la ‘‘dbu ma ’’zhes phyag 'tshal dgos par ma zad/gnyen sgrig byas zin nas pha ma'i sgo sa nas thon te phyi la song zin tshar ba tshang mas kyang pha mar phyag byed par yong gi yod de bu mo yin na kha phye mar dang kha btags 'khyer ba dang bu yin na kha phye mar dang 'brang rgyas 'khyer nas pha ma'i sku mdun du bcar nas phyag 'tshal ba'i lugs srol yod/ de ni thag ring po ci tsam du bsdad yod kyang 'gro dgos pas rta la zhon nas 'grul bzhud byed pa'ang mang po yod/ mdor na stod mnga' ris 'brog pa'i lugs srol la kha phye mar skor ba'ang kha btags phul ba sogs rang khyim gyi gnyen nye spun mched bar du byed pa las lha sa'i lugs ltar gnyen nye dang ngo shes kyi dbye khyad med par grong pa khyim mtshes tshang ma'i nang la 'gro ba'i lugs srol med/⑪ tshes gcig zhogs par tshe zho zhes tha li'am sder ma'i nang la 'bras phyed cha tsam blug cing de'i thog la 'bri zho blug rjes su de'i sgang la mar khu spus legs ldan pa blugade'i kha thog la ka ra dang bu ram brgyab nas rdzog rdzog byas pa'i ro bcud ldan pa'i zhim zas de 'thung gi yod do//yi lus dkar por kha zur smrag thig can gyi lug kha la rgya brgyab pa'i don te mi gzhan dag gis khyed kyi nang la nor yag po 'dug rgyu phyug po red ces kha btang mkhan nam mi kha 'gog pa'am ldog yas ched du yin/⑫ mnga' ris yul gyi bu ram rdog rdog mar spro kha'i dbyibs gzugs dang che chung mnyam pa zhig lags/ de spyir spu rang yul nas thon gyi yod/(deng sang sa cha de bal yul 'og la tshud/)bu ram la yag sdug khag gnyis yod par yag pa de mdog dkar zhing lus la phan pa spus legs shig yin/ sdug pa de mdog dmar la spus tshad zhan zhing des khrag shed 'phar ba dang glo brgyab pa bcas byed kyi yod pas mang che ba gar ma (mar khu dang mnyam du bskol nas 'khyag tu bcug tshe mkhregs po chags nas za shan chen po 245

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod la bud med lo chung tshos ngo gdong la byugs na nyi mas bsregs mi thub cing dkar la dmar mdangs ldan par chags/)dang gur yos (sngon la tsha bo bzos nas zhur de nas yos brgyab ste grang bsang btang rting rdog po chags pa'i kha zas legs po zhig go/)bzo yas kyi rgyu cha byed kyi yod/⑫ de dag la mgron btang zhes tig ga tsam yang ma bkog par rang rang so so'i nang la khyer phyin nas lo gsar thon rjes ga ler za gi yod/ de yang bzhi gling btang ba ni cha tshang zhing ma nyams pa'i don yin/ dus rgyun du sha lhu btang ba las bzhi gling btang gi med/ spyir na sems can gyi lus la gling bzhi dang lhu bco brgyad yod par mjing pa dang o ro sbrel bar sha lhu gnyis/ lag pa re la sha lhu gnyis re/ brang logs re la sha lhu re ste khyon gnyis/ rkang pa re la sha lhu gsum re/ dal logs re la sha lhu gnyis re ste khyon bsdoms sha lhu bco brgyad yod/ sems can gzugs logs kyi sha lhu bco brgyad de grangs ka gal chen zhig la bzung nas gna' snga mo'i 'brog rigs tsho pa khag gis grangs ka bco brgyad bed spyod btang bar shin tu mang ba ni rdzong chen bco brgyad dang / mkhar chen bco brgyad/ rgyal phran bco brgyad bcas pa'o//246

༄khya//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu cho pa'i skor gleng ba/mtsho chen rdzong gi lte ba'i grong sde chags yul ni byang gi 'phred thig 31 01༷dang shar gyi gzhung thig 85 15༷trem la gnas shing de'i rgya mtsho'i ngos las brtsis pa'i mtho tshad ni rmid bzhi stong drug brgya bdun bcu don gnyis tsam yin no// sngar lo rgyus thog deng sang mnga' ris sa khul mtsho chen rdzong khyab khongs kyi sa khul la phyogs bcu tsho pa zhes shing / mnga' ris sa khul byang shar phyogs kyi byang thang du gnas yod do// phyogs bcu zhesi 'bod pa'i yul lung de yangs shing rgya che ba/ gna' snga mo'i lo rgyus thog la zhang zhung sgo phu bar gsum nang nas zhang zhung bar pa'i sa khongs su 'khel gyi yod/'dir gnas ri chen po rta sgo khra ring dang gnas mtsho grags can dwangs rwa g.yu mtsho bcas kyang mchis/ sngar yul der ri dwags rkyang rkyang 'tsho sdod byed pa las mi sde mang po chags med skad/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi dbang sgyur byed dus sa gnas der phyogs bcu zhes brjod cing /de'i go don ni phyogs bcu nas bsdus pa'i sde yin par brjod/ mthar bod kyi shar phyogs khams khul nas stod kyi gangs rin po che la chos mjal yong mkhan mang dag zhig gis chos mjal zhus zin pa'i rjes su rang yul la log ma thub par 'dir bsdad pas gzhi rgya che ru phyin par grags/ 247

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/der ra sde dang zhi sde zhes tsho pa che khag gnyis dang rtsa tsho shog khag brgyad yod de lho stod lho smad gnyis/ byang stod byang smad gnyis (deng cha shas shig sger rtse'i khongs su gtogs/) dar stod dar smad gnyis/ bar khog dang smad kha bcas so// deng sang lho stod la stag gdong shang dang / lho smad la sman gdong shang / byang stod la pe ring shang / byang smad la zla ba shang / dar stod la stobs chen shang / dar smad la nyin lung shang / bar gog la gad dmar shang / smad kha la rgya rabs shang bcas brjod do//phyogs bcu zhes pa'i 'brog pa kha gtsang yin pa'i yul de'i thog ma'i mi rgyud ni stod mnga' ris skor gsum rang nas yin zhing gos slog kyang bse 'khor dang 'dra bar bud med tshang mas rgyab slog spu gu zhes pa de gyon gyi yod/skad lugs dang lugs srol goms gshis kyang gu ge mi ser dang 'dra mtshungs yin/ khri tsho'i 'go 'dzin dpon thog gcig 'jon thang ldan la skad grags shin tu chen po byung / khong gi ming la dpon bka' blon bu chung zhes so//skabs de dus phyogs bcu la grong pa brgyad dgu tsam las med pas rtswa kha'i sa khungs sogs rgya chen po med/ des na dpon bka' blon bu chung zhes pa des rtswa thang rgya che tsam dang mi sde gang mang zhig pha tsha bu thog du mar spyod dbang yod pa'i bka' rgya bcas yong rgyu'i re ba bcangs nas lha ldan na mchis pa'i bod sde pa gzhung gi dpon rigs ga la ba der bcar skad/de dus bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mes rgyal nang sa'i gong ma dbar la dka' rnyog chen po zhig byung yod pa ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag sger pa zhig gis mes rgyal nang sa'i gong mar mthu gtad brgyab te gnod skyon chen po byung nas gong mas sa gnas srid gzhung la re ba zhus te mthu gtad kyi 248

༄༅//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/byed gte gtso bo yin pa'i sku drag de lam seng mes rgyal nang sa'i gong mar rtsis sprod byed dgos zhes tsha 'ded btang zhing / gal te de ltar min tshe rjes 'bras ngan pa yong ba'i 'jigs skul gyis byed gte rtsis sprod ma byed thabs med kyi skabs su phyogs bcu'i bka' blon bu chung gis ma skul dang blang gis brjod par/ da lta sku drag re zung gi dbang gis sa gnas srid gzhung la dka' rnyog chen po de ltar 'phrad 'dug par/ dka' rnyog bsal bar nga 'gro chog 'on tang nga la dgos yas ni rtswa thang rgya che tsam zhig dang der dpag pa'i sde zhig dang sbrags bka' rgya cha tshang ba gnang rogs/ gal te nga'i re ba de ltar bsgrubs tshe ngas srog la phangs med kyis sku drag nyes can de'i tshab byas te gong ma'i sar 'gro rgyu'i blo thag bcad zin zhes so//de nas khos skabs 'phral rang yul la log nas rtswa thang rgya che chung ci tsam dgos min tho po'i tshad brgyab cing / mi sde ga tshod dgos min brtag pa nan tur byas nas tshur lha ldan du 'khor rting gzhung la tho yig rtsis 'bul zhus rjes su/ the tshom spu tsam yang med par mes rgyal nang sa'i gong ma'i sar byon te dka' rnyog 'os shing 'tshams par bsal/ de'i rkyen gyis kho la phyogs bcu'i rgya nag shel bam zhes pa'i bka' rgya shin tu btsan pa de byung ngo //bka' shog nang gsal por brjod don du/ shar dang / lho/ nub/byang / lho nub/ nub byang / byang shar/ shar lho sogs phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi rtswa thang bsdus shing phyogs bcu nas mi sde bsdu bskong ga tshod byas na'ang 'grig gi yod ces so// mdor na kho la phyogs bcu nas mi sde dang rtswa thang bsdu yas gzhung gi bka' rgya byung bas sde yongs kyi ming la phyogs bcu zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang dngos su byung zhing phyogs bcu 'go pa phyag snang nyi 249
