༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shu rtsa lnga zhes mi'i mgo la tog dang rta'i mjing 'og la dom bcas byung ngo //gang ltar de dus kho la byang thang gi sa cha ha cang rgya chen po byung bar grags/ bka' blon bu chung khong rang yang phyogs bcu zhes pa'i sde'i dbus su bsdad/ de'i gong la khos skye dmar sbub la sdod kyi yod/ sa cha de g.ya' ri mang bas phyug po g.ya' rgyas pa zhes yag rtags rtsa ba nas med par dgongs nas mar sa bab cung dma' sar spos/ de nas chu lho zhes par sdod rtsis byed skabs sa cha de yang yag rtags med par dgongs yod par der ni ri snum zhag yod pa smug mdog can de kha phyi la gtad pa dang ri thal mdog can skya shog shog snum zhag med pa de'i kha nang phyogs gzhung la gtad pas legs nyes gab phyi sing nger log yod/ des na bkra ma shis pa'i rtags shig mchis pa ni nang mi smug po kho phyi la thon pa dang phyi mi skya bo kho nang la 'dzul 'dra bas sa cha 'di yag rtags min pas khos der sdod kyi min zhes so//de nas phyogs bcu'i sa cha'i lte bar slebs dus sa cha rten 'brel legs pa shig mthong ba ni ra brgyad (ra shar lung dang / ra dpung 'dzoms/ ra spu lu/ra rdzong / ra rdzing / ra me 'bar/ ra thi'u/ ra g.yu khra bcas brgyad/) bal gsum de bsngas la bcug gag glang rgod gsum de gos la gyon/ so gsar gzhung gsum de gdan la bting / thal sne shod gsum (chu gsum yin pa/)de zhabs nas btegs 'dug par dngos su mthong nas khos der sdod rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de phyogs bcu zhes pa'i yul lung kun la dbang sgyur byas shing / 'brong pa dang / sger rtse/ nag tshang sogs dbar la sa mtshams bzos/ bka' blon bu chung gis rang srog blos btang gis dka' ba du ma spyad de sa khungs rgya chen rag pa dang yul lung skyong ba'i nus pa'ang ha cang che 250

༄khya//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/bas khos mtshan snyan dang grags pa che cher khyab bo//dpon bka' blon bu chung la rim bzhi'i go gnas yod cing rta la shang shang gi dom dang mgo la ril ril tog yod pa ni dmigs bsal gyi thob thang zhig go/ rjes su 'go pa lha dbang gis dbang sgyur byed skabs su sa rgya che chung rang sor gnas shing / yul gyi lte gnas kyang deng sang sman sdong dgon pa yod sa'i nye 'khor du bsdad/ de nas rus pa ra pa'i 'go pa dbang ma zhes pa zhig byung / de'i bu khang thog dbu zhwa'am 'go pa rag skya zhes pa de yin/ ming dngos la bsod nams nor bu brjod/ khong 'jon thang che la dbang thang yang gang la gang 'tshams yod pa/ rgyu nor la 'dod pa che bas khong la phyogs bcu'i rgyal po zhes 'bod par ma zad/ khos tshe mjug tu bka' ci bas btsan la gtum drag che bas rtswa tsho bzhi'i mi ser tshang mas rub brgyab nas kho dmaratshobasad btang ba red/ de nas sa gnas srid gzhung nas 'go pa chos mdzad ces pa'i grwa pa zhig btang zhing khong lo gcig bsdad/de nas sku shog gron thang nyi ma rgyal pos 'go pa'i tshab byas/ de nas sbrang gi mi rgyud kyi rgyud pa bzung / de nas chags pa'i mi rgyud karma mgon pos dbang 'dzin byas/ de nas ras pa lha dbang gi mi rgyud dam kho'i spun ras pa tshe dpal/ de nas ras pa karma bcas kyi skabs la bka' blon zer zhing rjes su 'go pas dbang bsgyur byed skabs 'go pa mi thog gnyis bod nas btang yod kyang chos mdzad lags dang 'gron thang nyi ma rgyal po'i skabs la mi ser la rdab gsig shin tu che bas sdug nad ma theg par mi ser rub bsdus kyis kho gnyis la nyes rdung drag po btang bas de nas bzung bod pa 'go 'dzin gtong ma nus par yul de ga'i mis rang yul skyong 'go btsugs so// mdor na phyogs bcu 251

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la 'go pa mi thog drug tsam byung ba 'dra/phyogs bcu'i 'go pa rim byon la bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas gnang ba'i thel rtse zhig dang mes rgyal nang sa'i gong ma chen mos gnang ba'i thel rtse'am shel bam zhig yod pa der mthong chen byed kyi yod/ bka' blon karma'i rjes su phyogs bcu tsho pa'i dbang bsgyur mkhan go 'bab mtho shos de ni 'go pa yin/ de dang nag tshang tsho pa drug gi dpon po mtho shos nag tshang spo bo dang / 'bong pa tsho pa dgu'i 'go 'dzin mtho shos spyi mi/ 'brong seng stod dang seng smad kyi 'go 'dzin mtho shos 'bong pa dpon zer ba dag dang dbang thang cha 'dra yin par grags/phyogs bcu 'go pa'i 'og la rtsis pa'am rtsis dpon gnyis yod/ de'i 'og la lding dpon bzhi (dar stod dar smad la gcig byang stod byang smad la gcig lho stod lho smad la gcig smad kha bar khog la gcig) yod pa khong tsho bzhi'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rkun ma dang jag pa btul yas de yin/ de tsho'i 'og la 'don rta pa nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/ de'i 'og la rkun ma rdzab chen shor dus dngos su kha gtad gcog mkhan yul dmag drug bcu re gcigatshobacas so//de tshos dmag rta gra sgrig ang gsar byas nas sdod dgos/ kho tsho rang la rta yod na yod pa dang rta med na phyug po mi tshang khag nas gtong dgos kyi yod/gal te dgra ngan jag tshogs dag dmag dpon 'go 'dzin dang yul dmag tshos glags ma rnyed na rtsis dpon dang 'go par zhus shing khong tshos re skul bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas stod ding ri'i dmag mis rgyab skyor byed kyi yod do//yul 'di la khams phyogs nas yong ba'i jag pas ha cang sdang po yod 252

༄khya//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/gshis/ spyir dgun dus phud pa'i dus mang che bar jag pa mtshams chad yas med pa yong gi yod/ kho tshos rta g.yag ra lug sogs bcom pa dang mtshams re 'brog pa'i sbra gur cha tshang bcom pa'ang mang ngo // lhag don du dbyar dus su zla ba gcig nang la jag pa thengs mang yong gi yod pas phyogs bcu'i yul dmag de tshos bzhon rta dang lag thog drag chas bod mda' sogs gra sgrig ang gsar byas nas dus dang rnam pa kun du thon chog chog byed dgos so// jag pa mang che ba khams nas yong gi yod kyang byang thang 'brog rigs kyi jag pa'ang mi nyung ba zhig yong gi yod pa dper na/ skad grags shin tu che ba'i jag dpon gla zar sngon po zhes pa zhig dang nag tshang drag po zhes pa bcas byung myong yod/ de gnyis kyis phyogs bcu'i sa cha tsam ma zad/stod mnga' ris khyon yongs su god chags ha cang chen po bzos nas mthar stod mnga' ris sgar dpon dang phyogs bcu'i yul dmag hrag bsdus/ phe gong nya ma dang / kru kru 'go pa/ a gong tshes brgya'i 'go pa sogs 'brong pa tsho dgu'i dhi'ago dpon dag dang lhag don du 'brong pa byang ma'i dhiyul dmagatha na bod ding ri'i dpung dmag bcas sgrig 'dzugs byas nas gtor brlag tshar bcad btang ba'o//khams kyi jag pa ste mang che ba ni khams nang chen dang sbra chen sogs nas stod mnga' ris gangs rin po che dang mtsho rin po che la gnas mjal yong nas rang yul la log ma phyin par gnas nges med la bsdad nas/ yod dus sems can 'tsho skyong byed cing / med dus slong mo slong ba'am jag brgyab te 'tsho sdod byed la yang khag cig mtha' ba khams pa'i sgrig 'dzugs nang la 'dzul nas rgya gar dang bod kyi sa mtshams su phar g.yol tshur g.yol byas nas 253

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'tsho sdod byed kyi yod do//sngar 'bong pa ('brong pa ste mnga' ris kha skad nang la ra btags bskyur ba mang bas so/)tsho ba dgu'i nang nas deng sang mtsho chen khongs la rkyang rang (de'i khongasasu chu lho chu byang tshud yod pa der rtswa tsho gcig) dang / byang ma/ nya gnyi gzhung (nyi gzhung dang mtsho chen gnyis bla brang ste gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i khral khungs yin/)/ dud ma bcas ni sngar nag tshang spo bo'i sa khongs yin/ phyogs bcu'i tsho pa yod do'i khral de bod sde pa gzhung la rgyag rjodagos par khral ming la leb skar zhes zer/ de yang lug drug la leb gcig dang / ra bdun la leb gcig g.yag gcig la leb gcig bcas so// leb la leb skar zhes skar ma re re byas nas brtsi dgos/ ṭam dkar gcig la skar ma gsum re yin tsang phyogs bcur khral phog yas nyung tsam yin/ gang lags she na/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gser dpon gyi g.yag bzhi brgya lnga brgya yod/de tshos yar zhor dbus zog ste ja dang spu hrug ser thig smug thig bcas dbor 'dren dang mar zhor stod zog ste mnga' ris kham bu sogs shing tog skam zan rigs dang ras cha sna tshogs/ stod kyi bu ram dkar sgong / ka ra pi tsogadar lcog bcas dbor 'dren byed pa'i rta 'ul dang g.yag gi rgyab gla la 'gro dgos/ de tshe phyogs bcu'i mi ser la rgyab gla ci tsam byung yang tshang ma gnyer par rtsis rgyag dgos/ gnyer pas rtsis zhib cing phra ba brgyab nas ston dus tshong 'dus sogs kyi skabs su nag nyog duzhes gla rin len rgyu yod/phyogs bcu'i yul kyi yul lha ni spu gri 'bar ba dang btsan po sha ra dmar chen (de khams nas yong ba'i khams btsan drag po zhig yin/)zhes pa de'o// yul lha de gnyis dgon pa'i grwa pa dang bla ma la ha cang sdang po yod pas phyogs 254

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/bcu'i yul gyi dgon sde grags can smon sdong sogs khug kyog la bzhengs yod/de min tshe grwa pa tshang ma na tsha gdug pa can sna tshogs na nas 'das rkyen yong gi yod skad/ dper na karma zhwa nag pa'i gdan sa bod dbus khul gyi mtshur phu dgon pa nas grwa tshang bla ma'am gung ru bla ma 'od zer zhes pas yul lha'i mthong sa'i ri steng la gnas sdod byed skabs snyung gzhi drag po zhig phog nas grongs song bar yul mi tshos khong la yul lhas gnod pa bskyal pa red zer ro//yul de skyong ba'i gzhi bdag shar ra dmar chen zhes pa'i ri bo chen po zhig yod par tshes bzang dus bzang skabs la de dang de'i 'khor bcas la gsol kha legs po zhig gtong dgos/ de la bskang gso'i dpe cha rgyas po zhig yod de ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’ skabs su gtor brlag tu phyin song ngo //de'i 'khor phyi blon bzhi ste sba lu dang / pan/ byang la yus/ dmar ru zhes pa bcas so// nang blon bzhi yod de g.yag tshang dang / lha sde/ khyung 'jog ma/ dge rgan bcas de dag mang che ba ri che chung rkyang pa red/yul lha gsolawā'i dus ston ni bod zla bdun pa'i nang la yin zhing yul misakha rgyun du phyogs bcu'i dbyar 'dun rtsed mo zhes pa de yin/ de dus yul lha gsol ba'i cho ga rgyas po zhig byed par ma zad/ rta rgyugs gtong ba sogs lus rtsal kyi byed sgo yang sna tshogs spel lo// yul lha gsol skabs thog ma yul lha'i gsol mchod dpe shog drug tsam yod pa de 'don gyi yod la mtshur phu'i gar bsang zhes rgyas pa zhig yod pa de yang cha tshang kha 'don byed cing rgyal lan lha bzang de'ang ma chad par 'don dgos so// de rting gtor ma bshams/ gser skyems btang / rta hrag gis yul de'i grong mi tshang mas dar lcog khyer nas yul lha'i pho brang gi steng la btsugs te dar 'bul byed cing 255

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lha rgyal lo zhes rtsam pa bshos nas rgyal kha'i ngang nas yul par log yong ngo //yul lha'i ri steng la mda' gri mdung sogs mtshon cha du mas gtams nas yod/de min yang dpon po zhes pa'i yul lha de ni stobs chen ri la chags shing de'i blon po ni zla gzhung gi sa la chags pa'i gnas ri de'o// dpon blon de gnyis shin tu 'cham pas ri de gnyis kyang mgo sbrel du gnas yod/ sngar phyogs bcu'i yul lha lha 'bebs mkhan phyogs bcu'i skad la dpa' 'u zhes pa'i sku khog de mi skya zhig go/ lha 'bebs dus 'khrus bcol dang bka' lung btsan po gnang gi yod skad/spyir na mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du 'jig rten pas brten pa'i yul lha mthu rtsal ci ltar che yang de la dgon pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bcol zhu ba bzhin gyi skyabs gnas rtsa ba nas zhu gi med cing skyabs 'gror yang rtsa ba nas bcol gyi med la phyag 'tshal ba sogs de bas kyang byed srol med/'brog pa tshos kha rgyun du 'di ltar brjod par/ 'jig rten lha 'dre mthu rtsal su che yang / skyabs gnas zhu ba'i sems pa bcangs mi rung // bsang btang dar cog sgrogangan 'gal ba med// mi 'khon dga' ba skye ba'i thabs shes yin// zhes pa'o// phyogs bcu'i yul la so so'i yul lha brten pa phud da dung gnas chen ri rgyal rta sgo khra ring dang / gnas mtsho dwangs rwa g.yu mtsho sogs la gnas skor 'gro la gsol kha yang byed srol mchis shing / de bzhin lo gcig dus gcig nang gnas kyi rgyal por gyur pa'i gnas mchog gangs dkar ti si dang ma pham g.yu mtsho mjal bar nyung thar yang thengs gcig bcar gyi yod cing / phyogs bcu'i yul la yul pa zhes pa'i ri zhig yod pa de ni zhi ba zhig yin/ yang yul dpon zhes pa'i ri ngo mtshar can 256

༄//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/zhig yod pa de ni phyogs bcu'i khongs su gtogs pa'i yul lha yod do'i dpon po yin skad/ de dag la srid pa'i lha zhes gna' snga mo'i lo rgyus ldan no//phyogs bcu'i yul mi dag lag shes ha cang mkhas pa yod par skye pho tshos tshem bu legs po brgyab nas pho mo rgan gzhon gyi gos slog 'dra min sna tshogs bzo ba dang skye dman tshos lug sgye dang g.yag sgye spus ma 'thag shes par ma zad ska bo dang / lham sgrog rtsam khug ja khug tshwa khug phyur khug bcas 'thag par spus tshad rtser son la u mo su ri mo legs shing spun rgyu shin tu phra ba bslas thub pas dmigs bsal gyi lag rtsal ldan gshis kho tsho'i lag shes thon skyed thun mong ma yin pa dag la mnga' ris khul du dar so chen po zhe drag byed cing phyogs bcu'am mtsho chen gyi lag shes ca dngos lag son byung tshe dga' tshor dang spobs sems zhe drag byed do//phyogs bcu'i yul 'dir lo gcig nang dus ston sna tshogs mchis par dgun dus kyi lo gsar dang / dbyar kha'i 'dun ma/ ston kha'i sdeb bsang bcas yod par lo gsar skabs sems can gsol dus khyad chos che tsam yod pa ni/ tshes gsum zhogs pa lha klu btsan gsum mtshon pa'i lug dang / ra/ g.yag bcas kyi rna cog dang / ze ba/ rnga ma bcas la dar tshon sna lnga sgrog cing sgal bar btsag gi ri mo bris shing brla sgang dang smad la nor bu'i dbyibs can gyi par mtshon bris/ de yang yul lha mtshon ched du g.yag kham pa dang / ra zag pa/ lug gro dmar bcas gsol dgos ste/mi rgyus chu las ring ba'i gzungs yin zhes rnga ma la yar gcig rgyag brla rang dar las rgyas pa'i gzungs yin zhes brla sgang la yar gcig sgrogasgal tshigs brag ltar brtan pa'i gzungs yin zhes sgal par yar gcig rgyag257

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi gnon pa'i gzungs yin zhes sbo mtha' la yar gcig rgyag lha mngon par bstod pa'i gzungs yin zhes sog pa g.yas g.yon la re rgyag go/de yang rus lha ltar gsol ba ni/ thang lha la dkar po gsol ba dang /rta sgo la gtsa'u gsol ba/ phyogs bcu'i yul lhar kham pa gsol ba/dper na rwa co la yar kha rgyag gin/ kha nas brtan no brtan no mi'i kha brtan nor gyi g.yang brtan/ bstan pa'i rgyu brtan zas kyi bcud brtan gos kyi srog brtan/ brtan no brtan no zhes dang / de nas rwa co g.yas par btsag rgyag gin/ g.yas kyi zangs rwa dmar po 'di brdar ro brdar ro dgra chags sdang che gnyan za rang che/ ma byas par byas zer mkhan/ ma byung bar byung zer mkhan/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams su brdar ro brdar ro zer/ rwa co g.yon mar btsag rgyag gin/ g.yon gyi zangs rwa dmar mo byams mo byams mo spun nye ring / shag ya do/ grogs mdza' bshes/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ dad can mos gus can tshang ma thams cad la byams mo byams mo zer/ sog pa'i sgang la btsag brgyab nas sro swo dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag srung ma bzhugs pa'i dus la kun dga' ring / kun dga' ring las brtan pa med/ shar ra dkar chen gcig lha yi chibs pa yin/chibs pa 'di las mgyogs pa med/ so so sdang dgra bo'i dmu khebs ja ra khob/ gnyen spun mched gsol byed me long de/ dpa' bo'i dpung byas/snod kyi kha byas/ 'og gi rta byas/ bsam don grub te chos ldan ye shes 'dra/bsam don myur du grub bo ya sro swo zhes zer/ chag pa'i lha de shed khyung mi dkar rta dkar yin/ ras pa'i lha de gnyan chen thang lha yar yu zer ba 258

༄༅//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/de'o//bod zla brgyad pa'i nang la 'brong pa tsho dgu sgrodang 'dra bar ston 'dun gtong ba'i skabs su cho ga ha cang phun sum tshogs po yod pa ni/ grong pa tshang ma 'du 'dzoms kyis bsang gsol rgyas po zhig btang rjes su rta pa gcig rkang btsugs nas yul mi tshang ma'i dar lcog khyer te yul lha ri smug mdog can shin tu rngam po zhig yod pa de'i dbu rtser 'dzugs par 'gro'o// de'i mdun la ri dkar po skya tsug gcig yod pa de'i steng la yul lha'i pho brang mchis shing de la'ang dar tshon sna lnga btsugs nas bsang gsol gtong bar ma zad/grong pa so so'i nang la sdod pa'i skye pho tshang mas rta la bcibs nas tshogs skor zhes brang btab pa'i gur tshogs la bskor ba lan gsum byed do//de min lus rtsal gyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel gyi yod pa ni rta rgyugs gtong gi yod de 'gros sdur dang rgyugs ma (rgod ma'i rgyugs ma dang pho chen gyi rgyugs ma/co pa sgar rgyab kyi rgyugs ma bcas khag gsum tsam yod/)dang rta rtsal rtsed kyi yod de rta rgyugs kyin rta sgang la zhon nas bod mda' lag la thogs te skor ba g.yon skor lan gsum byas rjes 'ben la rgyag gi yod par thog ma dmag dpon dang de nas lding dpon/ de nas 'don rta pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang rgyugs ma drug cu re gcig re re byas nas rgyag gi yod la/ rta thog nas 'gyur rtsal sna tshogs rtsed pa ni ṭam dkar po kha btags la dril zhing / mdud pa grol mdud brgyab te thang sder la bzhag nas len du 'jug gi yod/ mang shos la bco lnga dang de nas bcu/ drug lnga/ bzhi/ gsum bcas yod/ de nas rta rtsed 'gran mkhan tshos rta yar mar bshar nas rim pas len gyi yod/su yis mang nyung ci tsam bsnyabs thub na de tsam gyi khe bzang red/ da dung 259

༄khya//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhwa bang len zhes zhwa mo lag pa ya gcig gis rta yi bang kha nas btang rting lag pa ya gcig gis de ma nyid du len pa bcas kyang byed do// yang mtshams re rta yi sgal pa'i steng du gan rgyal du nyal nas rta yi rnga mar lag pas 'ju thub pa byed kyi yod/ mtshams re rta thog nas me mda' rgyag gi yod pa ni/ thog ma thang der ri mo yod par me mda' gcig 'phangs/ de nas yar gom pa brgyad kyi sa thag la rta shugs chen po rgyugs nas yong gi yod/ de'i ring la rdzas mdel tshang ma rdzong thub pa dang rta'i mjing thog la g.yab tsam byas te me mda'i mde'u gnyis pa de brgyab nas ‘‘mnga' ris gong skor ’zhes bskor ba brgyab mtshams su lam sang me mda' 'phen thub pa dgos so// mdor na nyin gang rtsed mo rtsed kyi yod/ de nas mda' rtsed rtsed kyi yod pa ni shing gnyis dbar la ko ba zhig sgrog cing de'i sgang la ri mo bris nas sus lte bar 'khel tshe de la bya dga' mtho shos thob kyi yod/rta rtsal 'gran rting su rtsal lag legs shos la bya dga' lug gcig dang ra gnyis sprod kyi yod la lu gu'i tsha ru brgya tshar yang sprad de nag nyog rtsis skabs su yong sgo 'thol pa len rgyu yod/ rta rgyugs kyi rgyal kha thob mkhan dang mda' brgyab nas rgyal kha thob mkhan tshang ma dmag mi byed pa'i 'os 'gan rtsa ba nas med/ de bzhin mi rgyugs 'gran pa dang / thag mchong 'gran pa/ber shugs che chung 'gran pa bcas kyi byed sgo dag kyang skye pho sha stag las skye dman la the jus ye nas med/rta rgyugs rgyugs ma dang rta rtsal 'gran dus rta'i rngog la dar ras kyis tshems bu brgyab nas khyur khyur bzos shing / rnga ma gcus ril shig shig tu lan bu brgyab yod/ rgyugs ma rgyugs dus ras gdan re brgyab pa las 260

༄//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/gzhan gang yang med par rgyugs phrug mang che ba phru gu lo bcu nas bco lnga dbar du slebs pa dag yin/ kho tshos mgo la dar thod dkris nas phyu pa yang po zhig gyon gyi yod/ 'gros rgyugs dus rta sga brgyab cing rnga ras dang ze ras phra phung nger btags nas rdzigs po zhe drag yod la spyir skye bo dar ma sha stag dang lus la pags tshag dang mgo la sog zhwa dmar po gyon nas gzab mchor legs par spras yod do// rta rgyugs dang rta rtsal mjug sgril rjes su 'go pas rta ngang pa dung 'dra ba zhig la bzhon te dar mdung ring po zhig 'khyer/ khong gis sngon du phyin te rta pa gzhan dag tshang ma khos rjes 'brangs kyis sdings cha'i khri rgyab la skor ba rgyag gin 'gro'o// de nas mar rta thog nas 'bab ma thag sdings cha'i sgang na sgrig gshoms byas pa'i 'brang rgyas sogs la mchod gtor dang mchod 'bul byed kyin de'i sdings cha'i steng gi bzhugs khri mtho tsam zhig yod pa de'i thog la bsdad nas bya dga' sprod pa'i byed sgo 'go 'dzugs so//phyogs bcu'i khul du khral bsdu stangs ni gong du brjod pa ltar leb la rtsis brgyab nas bsdu gi yod de lug drug re la leb re dang / ra bdun re la leb gcig g.yag gcig la leb re bcas so// leb re la skar ma gsum re dang ṭam dkar gcig byas nas bsdu bas leb khral de'i ming gzhan la skar gsum ṭam gcig kyang brjod do// phyogs bcur rtswa thang rgya chen po zhe drag yod pas phyogs mtha'i tsho pa khag ste rkyang ma rang dang / skye dmar/ 'bong pa('brong pa/)/ nag tshang sogs la phyugs 'tsho ru 'jug pas rtswa rin mi dman ba len rgyu yod/ rtswa rin mang che bar ra lug g.yag sogs len rgyu yod kyang nyung shas shig nag nyog la rtsis kyi yod par grags/ des na grong pa che gras mi grangs mang po yod na yong 'bab che la rtswa rin chu rin dang nag nyog mi 261

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyung ba len rgyu yod gshis 'tsho rten legs po yod do// grong pa chung gras mi lag med na yong 'bab zhe drag med kyang phyi'i rtswa rin chu rin dang nag nyog sogs kyis 'tsho bar dka' ba ma mchis/phyogs bcu 'go pa'i za sgo mang che ba khral thog nas yong gi yod kyang 'bab tshong spus sgyur bcas kyi thog nas kyang yong 'bab che tsam dang mi tshang phyug po ra lug mang po'i sa nas rtswa rin bsdu ba ni brgya cha gsum la nye ba te spyir grong khyim phyug gras lag nas ra lug bcu grangs len rgyu yod cing / skyo gras nas ra lug re zung bsdu rgyu yod pas 'go par za sgo chen po yod/ spyir khral ni ston dus sdebs bsang skabs la bsdu bzhin yod cing de tshe rtsis dpon nas gtsos pa'i 'go yod mi sna tshos stod hreng (gal te stod hreng ma thon tshe phu thung dang am phrag nas dngul rku gnyer byed pa'i nyen kha yod skad/)thon nas sgug bsdad dus khral rgyag mkhan tshos dngul dag lcog rtse'i sgang la bzhag cing / de tshe stod hreng thon pa de tshos chad lhag gang yang med par khug ma'i nang la blugs shing /'bangs mi tshang ma'i mthong sar kha brgyab cing de ma nyid du thel rtse brgyab nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la bskur ro// mdor na de tshe dpon rigs tshos khral bsdu ba dang nag nyog rtsis rgyag pa/ cho ga dang byed sgo'i 'go skyong byed pa bcas las ka mang la brel ba shin tu che yang yul gyi mi sde dkyus ma tshang mas sho dang sbag brgyab nas rol rtsed du mas myos te nyin nyi shu nas zla ba gcig bar du bsdad nas dga' skyid 'tsho bar longs su spyod do//phyogs bcu'i yul la sngags pa grags can mi tshang bzhi tsam yod par kho tsho tshang mas skra ring zhing dbu ral shig ger 'jog gi yod/ kho tsho tshang ma rus rgyud mi 'dra ba bzhi nas yin te/ gcig ni bya rigs dang / gcig ni 262

༄7//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/'gro ba/ gcig ni chag pa/ gcig ni gnam ru bcas so// dus rgyun du ser ba 'gog pa dang sngags rgyag gi yod la gcod gtong bar shin tu mkhas/de tsho'i rgyun spyod lag cha ni ḍā ru dang / rol mo/ rnga/ dril bu/ rkang gling bcas yin zhing khag gcig gser dngul gyis brgyan pa'i spus ma rang yin/ mtshams re nad pa gcod 'og tu nyal du bcug nas sman bcos byed cing dka' gnyan gnod pa'i rigs kyang bsal thub ces so//phyogs bcu'i bud med kyis sha lag ces pa'i gos shig gyon gyi yod/mgo la byu ru dang gor ṭam zhes de dag mdun la lhod/ rgyab la theg po zhes gzhi dngul la dbus gser phra gsum re gtong / de'i 'og la rgyab gling zhes thog snam kha sgrig cing mtshams su gor ṭam dang rda yang gtong ba la 'od chil chil byed pa/ gsham 'og la stong g.yab dmar po mang po bsgrigs shing de'i steng la jib kha mang po sgrog ste gom pa spos dus job rag job rag ces grags kyi yod/ de ni bud med dag gi gzab mchor legs shos shig ste spyir btang lo gsar sogs dus ston gal che ba dang / bkra shis dga' ston rten 'brel/bla mar mjal ba sogs kyi skabs su gyon no//mchan 'grel/me stod mnga' ris khul la 'brong pa sa khag gnyis yod par 'brong pa dpon gyi sa khungs te 'brong ba seng stod dang / seng smad/ sna phug kong chen bcas yin/de tsho'i mi rgyud tshang ma khams nang chen nas yin/ gang lags she na/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs brgyad bcu'i nang bod sog dpung pa mgo sbrel gyis stod mnga' ris skor gsum dbang 'og tu bcug par la dwags nago dpon dang dmag 'thab 263

༄7//gu ge tshehoring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byed skabs khams nang chen nas dmag gi dpung rogs su btang ba'i nang chen rta pa bcu bdun dang de'i 'go 'dzin be'u(rgya skad de khyim tshang brgya yi don/)a rgya zhes pa yong nas bod sog dpung dmag gi dmag dpon chen mo dga' ldan tshe dbang la rams 'degs kyis rjes byas ha cang chen po bzhag pas dmag thag chod nas sde pa gzhung nas seng ge kha 'bab dbus smad rgyud kyi sa khungs de dag khong la gnang nas dbang bsgyur byed du bcug par sgar dpon mnga' 'og dpon drug gi ya gyal 'bong pa dpon zhes te dpon thog brgyad tsam byung / gzhan zhig ni 'brong pa tsho dgu zhes pa de'i ming la 'brong pa zhes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phyis su 'brong pa byang ma'i 'go pas yul tsho de dag spyi yongs kyi 'go 'dzin byed skabs tha snyad de byung bar grags/ de yang khams nang chen 'brong pa zhes pa'i tsho pa'i mi rgyud be'u a nam gyis dga' ldan tshe dbang gi dpung rogs mtha' gcig tu byas te byas rjes mod mi dma' ba bzhag pas sde gzhung nas bka' rgya phab te 'brong pa byang ma'i sa khongs su dbang bsgyur byed tu bcug 'brong pa tsho ba dgu ni rkyang rang dang byang ma/ skye g.yang / skye dmar/ glag tshang / bar yang / bub stod/ tsho lho dang chu shar gnyis/ dar rog bcas khyon tsho pa dgu'o//du 'brong pa byang ma'i khongs su rtswa tsho bzhi tsam yod pa ni byang stod dang / byang smad/ g.yu tsho/ glang stod bcas yin zhing de tsho'i spyi pa'i dbu 'dzin mtho shos ni rgan po yin par rgan po ka dpe dang / khri'u/ dgun po a ti/ dbang rgyal/dmar rtsi rgan po rtsi ti bcas so// rgan po'i 'og la 'go pa bzhi/ de tsho'i 'og la rtswa dpon bzhi/ gnyer pa gnyis/ bcu dpon bzhi/ dmag dpon gcig bcas so//yul la dgra byung na dmag dpon des grong pa'i skye pho lo bco brgyad yol ba tshang ma skong bkugs kyis jag pa sogs dgra ngan tshar du gcad par brtson no// rgan po'i rtsa la zla ba re la mi lnga re sdod dgos/ rgan po'i dbyar kha'i sdod sa sbra gur dang dgun kha'i sdod sa ni rtsig skyor stabs bde btang ba zhig go/ 'brong pa byang ma'i khral rgyag stangs ni 264

༄༅//stod mnga' ris byang thang phyogs bcu tsho pa'i skor gleng ba/leb grangs la gzhigs te rgyag dgos par ra lug bcu re dang nor g.yag gcig la leb gcig yin/ tsho ba'i rgyab gla sogs kyi don du song na nag nyog ces tshur sger la gla rin len rgyu yod/ yul de'i yul lha gtso bo ni zhal gangs 'jam zhes pa de yin/ spyir lo gsar skabs la gsol kha'i cho ga rgyas po zhig byed kyi yod par rta pa kha shas song nas yul lha'i pho brang zhes lcog gcig dang phug gcig yod pa der dar lcog btsugs pa dang bsang gsol gtong ba sems can tshe thar gtong ba bcas byed/ de'i gam du zhal mtsho chung zhes pa'i mtshe'u lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig yod par denas mtsho chu blangs nas sgo phyugs sems can dang sbra gur bcas su mchod gtor byed do//rjo phyogs bcu'i mi ser dag gis khral bod sde pa gzhung la thad kar rgyag gi yod kyang dmag sogs skul dus mnga' ris sgar dpon gyi khongs su gtogs kyi yod cing lhag don du phyogs bcu'i mi tshang grags can ras pa dang / chag pa/ bya rigs sogs dang stod khul gyi tsho pa gzhan dbar 'brel ba dam po yod la khyung po dang / tsha ru/ tsha bo bcas kyang phyogs bcu'i mi tshang drag gras yin/dhi nag nyog ces pa ni bod sde pa gzhung gi gser dpon zhes lo ltar gser khral bsdu mkhan g.yag sde bzhi brgya tsam zhig yong gi yod cing / dus mtshungs su yar zhor dbus zog ja dang spu phrug ser thig dang smug thig can gyi gos chen stod sgar dang la dwags phyogs su skyel ba dang mar zhor stod zog te bu ram dang dar cog stod phor bcas bod dbus gtsang phyogs su dbor 'dren byed kyi yod pa'i rgyab glar phyin pa'i gla rin len rgyu yod pa'i yongs 'bab dngul te phyogs bcu'i 'brog rigs kyi yong 'bab gtso bo zhig yin/ lar na phyogs bcu ni sa khongs rgya che la mi 'bor nyung bas yul de'i rtswa khongs nag tshang dang 'bong pa byang ma/ skye dmar bcas tsho pa tshos rtswa thang bed spyod byas tshe gla rin du'ang nag nyog ces dngul len rgyu yod/ de min dbyar 'dun sogs skabs su rta rgyugs ang dang po blangs pa'am rta rtsal 'gran nas ang dang po blangs pa/jag dmag btul nas rjes byas bzhag pa dag la'ang nag nyog ces dngul len rgyu yod 265

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa bcas mdor na phyogs bcu'i 'bangs mi ser tshos lo gcig nang dka' las ci tsam mang bar rgyag thub na nag nyog de tsam gyis mang po len rgyu yod pas za sgo chen po yod/me 'brong pa tsho dgu'i khral ni ston skyid 'dun ma chen mo ste bod zla brgyad pa'i skabs su rub bsdus byed do// de tshe 'brong pa tsho dgu'i spyi'i dbu skyong ba spyi khyab dang rgan po dgu bcas mnyam 'dzoms thog yul mi tshang ma 'du 'dzoms kyis yul lha gsol ba dang dga' skyid gtong ba'i byed sgo sna tshogs spel kyi yod de/ thog ma bur dkar dgon pa'i bla mas gtso skyong 'og grong pa'i skye pho mang che ba rta la bcibs nas gur dkar drug bcur skor ba lan gsum brgyab/ de nas rta rgyugs 'gran pa ni ang dang por bya dga' lu gu'i tsha ru brgya thob par rta la lnga bcu dang mi la lnga bcu'o// rta rtsal 'gran pa ni sa thog nas kha btags len pa dang sa dong nang nas dngul ṭam dkar snyob byed pa bcas so// de min yang shed 'gran pa/ mi rgyugs 'gran pa sogs lus rtsal kyi byed sgo du ma spel/ de nas mdzes sdug ldan zhing yangs shing mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i rtswa thang sgang la sha mar thud gsum longs su spyod cing na gzhon tshos sho sbag sogs kyi rol rtsed myong bar byed cing rgad po tshang mas g.yog las byed pa/ skye dman tshang ma dud 'gro 'tsho bar 'gro ba bcas byed do//266

༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor cho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/sger rtse rdzong gi grong sde de'i gnas yul ni byang gi 'phred thig 32 30༷dang shar gyi gzhung thig 84 50༷tsam la chags shing rgya mtsho'i ngos las brtsis pa'i mtho tshad ni rmid bzhi stong bdun brgya drug cu re gsum tsam yin/ rdzong yongs kyi rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi ma khri bcu gsum dang lnga stong brgya lhag tsam yod cing / da yod mi 'bor ni chig khri bdun stong tsam yod la/ grong sde gcig dang grong brdal drug grong tsho lnga bcu lhag tsam mchis/ 'dir yangs shing mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i rtswa thang dang grangs las gzhal bar dka' ba'i mtshe'u che chung sna tshogs/ gangs ri rdza ri g.ya' ri bcas kyis gtams gshis mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i yul lung gces su 'os pa zhig lags so//yul der sger rtse brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni tsho pa de'i mi mang che ba'i rus ming sger rtse yin pas so// lo rgyus thog sa cha der mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byang pa rjoganas sdod byed kyi yod/ yul de'i mi'i kha rgyun la'ang byang pa har shi stong shul la sger 'brong gnyis kyi leb sgar chags zhes bshad srol yod/de ni stod mnga' ris lo rgyus thog gal 'gangs shin tu che/ gang lags she na/sngar mnga' ris skor gsum gyi byang phyogs su gnas pa'i byang pa zhes mi sde mang tsam yod kyang phyis su mdo khams khul nas grong sde 'ga' re nad yams ༵ lton

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nam 'khrugs rtsod kyi rkyen pas stod byang thang khul du bros byol du yong ba dang sbrags stod gangs mtsho gnyis la gnas mjal du bcar/ de nas 'tsho khungs dben gshis dus nges med du byang pa'i gnas la jag brgyab te phyugs zog 'phrog bcom byas te gnas sdod byas/ des na byang pa'i 'brog sde la rdab gsig che ba'i rkyen gyis byang thang 'brog rigs dag sdod glags ma bzod par ru thog dang gu ge'i byang khul du mi 'gro ka med byung stabs rang yul rim pas stong nas khams nang chen 'brong pa'i mi rgyud dang a mdo sger rtse'i mi rgyud kyis mnga' ris byang thang du gnas gzhis zin nas 'tsho sdod byas/ der rten deng sang mnga' ris kyi shar phyogs rdzong khag gsum ste dge rgyas dhidang /sger rtse/ mtsho chen dhigyi cha shas bcas ni stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi mi sde'i skad lugs dang / lugs srol goms gshis/ gos slog rgyan cha sogs gang gi thad nas kyang gcig mthun min/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong tsho tshang ma khams dang a mdo'i mi rgyud yin pa las mnga' ris skor gsum pa'i rgyud pa min pas so//sger rtse tsho pa'i skor/dang po/ lo rgyus skor/ bod kyi shar phyogs a mdo khul sog po dung tog can gyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i sger rtse'i yul nas yong ba'i grong pa mi tshang bdun mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du slebs nas gnas sdod byas par sger rtse dud bdun zhes brjod/ thog ma slebs tsam la kho tshos jag rgyag pa dang 'brog pa'i dud 'gro 'phrog bcom byed pa/ rtswa thang cha shas zin pa 268

༄tsho//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/sogs brnyas bcos tshod med byas stabs byang pa'i 'brog pa dag sdod glags ma bzod par stod ru thog khul du gnas spos ma byed thabs med byung / de nas sger rtse dud bdun der gzhis chags shing gnas sdod byas skad/ yul de yangs shing rgya che la 'brog sa shin tu skyid cing / tshwa yang dus nges med du rin sprod ma dgos par len rgyu yod pa/ tshong khungs phun sum tshogs pa bcas pha yul gyi mis thos nas yang skyar grong grangs lnga bcu nga gnyis tsam slebs pas khams sde grong pa lnga bcu nga dgu zhes pa byung / de tshe sa cha der khams sde mi 'bor mang du phyin pa dang rtag tu jag brgyab nas rdab gsig tshod med bzo gi yod gshis byang pa bse 'khor 'brog sdes bod sde pa gzhung la zhu gtug brgyab/ bse 'khor ni sde pa gzhung gi khral khungs ma zin zhig yin stabs de la srung skyob byed rgyu gal 'gangs shin tu che bar dmigs nas lam seng bka' rgya phebs te sger rtses phyi lcags ri lta bu bse 'khor la srung dgos zhes shing / sger rtse phyi'i lcags ri bse 'khor nang gi nor bu zhes pa'ang de dus byung ngo // de nas rim gyis 'phel nas mi tshang mang po byung la/ 'brong rgyud dang / gtsang rgyud/ nag shod rgyud/ se ro'i rgyud/ har shul rgyud/sga rgya'i rgyud/ dong pa'i rgyud bcas mnyam du 'dres nas phyis su sger rtse'i mi rus lnga brgya zhes so// mdor na sger rtse tsho pa der chags shing mi rabs mang dag zhig der gnas pas sger rtse pa'i kha rgyun du'ang sa de ni ‘‘pha mgo dkar gyi thod rus bzhag sa// bu rkang dmar gyi lte khrag gcod sa// pha rgan gyi skyid sdug skyong ba'i gnas// bu chung dag tshar longs byung sa'i gnas//’’zhes so// 'on te sger rtse'i mi rgyud ni mdo khams khul nas yin pa ni gsal po zhe drag red/ dper na kho tsho'i lugs srol goms gshis sogs mdo 269

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khams phyogs dang gcig mtshungs yin la/ skad lugs kyang 'dra ba ni mi la ‘‘myi ’ dang mig la ‘‘myig ’ med la ‘‘myed ’’zer gyi yod pas so// dus phyis su sger rtse dpon khungs su 'brog pa dud grangs lnga brgya tsam byung bar yongs grags su sger rtse mi rus (dud tshang /)lnga brgya zhes pa de'o//gnyis pa/ srid kyi sgrig gzhi'i skor/ sger rtse zhes pa'i khams sde de mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du slebs nas bzung khyon bsdoms dpon thog lnga tsam byung yod de dpon dang po dge chung / de nas dpon lce lodhi/de nas dpon mgon po don grub rjo/ de nas dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/ de nas dpon tshe dbang mgon po bcas so// sger rtse'i dpon khungs su rtswa tsho du ma zhig yod pa ni brag po dang / rngo rodhi/ rdo sngon/ deng go/ seng stod/ khra mdong / stong mtsho/ ri dmar bcas so// sger rtse dpon khongs su rus ming rgya che shos ni sger rtse yin zhing de min har shul dang /nag shod/ 'o zong / dmar rtsa/ khri bo/ tsang rgyud/ khyung po/mgar ra sogs phud/ da dung sger rtse mi sna sha bo dgu sdud ces rus pa 'od sang dang / skya sang / hor/ tsha bo/ rga dmar/ shi li/ tshe ro/ga rgya/ sgo dkor/ chag bcas so// sger rtse dpon 'og la rgan po gsum yod de rgan po karma don grub (seng stod dang khra mdong du sdod/)dang / rgan po a mong / rgan po ri gyam zhes pa grags pa ha cang che/ khong tsho pha tsha bu rgyud du sa gnas de'i 'brog pa rang nas yin pas lha sa sogs ga pa la'ang mi 'gro bar dpon 'og gi 'brog sde dag legs par bskyangs nas sdod kyi yod/rgan po ri gyam zhes pa 'jon thang che la dbang shugs ldan gshis phyis su ri dmar dang / a mar/ rol ba bcas su sdod do// de min rgan po nor 270

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/bzang ni sger rtse dpon gyi spun yin/ spyir rgan po so so'i 'og la drung yig gnyis yod de las 'gan gtso bo snyan zhu dang kha mchu'i yi ge 'bri mkhan yin/de min rgan po'i 'og la dmag dpon 'ga' shas yod pa de ni sger rtse yul la rkun ma dang jag yod dus 'go khrid de bkod 'doms dang sgrig 'dzugs byas nas drag pos kha gtad gcog pa'i 'gan 'dzin de'o//sger rtse'i dpon la rim pa drug pa'i tog gser rdo rje'i bzo 'dra ba zhig yod par zer srol la de ni se ra dgon pa'i spyi sor dngul srang stong lnga yi lkog rngan sprad nas nyos pa yin skad/ ming la'ang lnga stong drug tog ces dngul srang lnga stong sprad nas rim pa drug pa'i tog nyos pa'i don no// des na nye 'khor tsho pa gzhan gyi dpon khag gis sger rtse dpon la zur za byas nas brjod par/ tog de legs grags nas gnang bzhag pa min te go gnas dang dpon ming la zhen thag chod nas se ra dgon pa'i lag nas nyos bzhag pa red ces brjod par ma zad/ sger rtse sger gyi sger sde se ra theg chen gling la bdag pa'i sger sde zhes so// mdor na sger rtse dpon la rim pa drug pa'i gser tog yod pa la/ da dung rta'i snying kha'i thad du 'dogs pa'i dril bu 'dra ba zhig la rtsid pa dmar po sgrog nas yod par rta'i dom zhes zer/ mi la tog dang rta la dom ni dbang thang mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan che shos shig yin/khong gis dus ston sogs skabs su gos chen ser po'i phyu pa mdo gnyis 'brel ba zhig gyon zhing rna cog la sog byil dang rked par rgya gri phor shubs 'dogs kyi yod/ sger rtse dpon khungs de khag gnyis su dbye bar lho ma dang byang ma'o// byang ma'i khongs su shar ma dang / rngo ro/ dkor pa/ seng stod/khra mdong / ding sgo/ lu sgo/ dong ngo bcas so// lho ma'i khongs su tshe 271

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ring mo dang / 'bri ze/ zhe bye gu dgu/ rta lung / brag dkar po/ ro khung / na ra/ 'om lung / se ra/ byu ru ma/ sman chu zhes so//gsum pa/ dpal 'byor skor/ sger rtse dpon gyi khral khungs ni se ra bla spyi yin zhing der dngul dmar sha stag rgyag dgos/ de yang dud 'gro leb la brtsis nas dngul la 'bebs dgos ste/ leb re la ra lug brgyad re dang g.yag re yin/ ra lug re la mtshams re ṭam dkar gcig dang mtshams re ṭam dkar gnyis re bsdu gi yod/ de nas dbyar kha dang ston dus su khang thog (dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor skabs su bzhengs shing sger rtse dpon tshang yang brjod/)la bsdad nas yul gyi rtswa sgrig chu sgrig byed cing / rus mi lnga brgya'i spu bal dang / lpags rigs/ mar phyur sogs bsdu rub byas nas de'i rin babs la ja dang 'bru/ spu phrug shing tog bcas rtsis len rtsis sprod byed kyi yod/ stod la dwags dang / khu nu/ sgar zhwa/ nyung ti bcas kyi tshong par spu bal dang lpags rigs tshong gi yod par ma zad/ tshwa tshong yang rgyag gin yod pa ni mang che ba mnga' ris rang gi rong pa'i tshong par 'tshong ngo // sger rtse dpon gyi mi ser mang che ba 'brog pa sha stag yin kyang khag cig gis gser las byas nas pha tsha bu rgyud du gser khral brgyab te sdod pa'ang yod do// dpon pos khral bsdu ba/ mi ser la nag nyog gi rtsis brgyab ces rang 'khri'i khral phud/ da dung rta 'ul dang g.yag gi rgyab phyin glar nas dpon po'i ched du don mang po sgrub yod tshe nag nyog gi gla rin phon chen len rgyu yod pa spyi dang yang sgos tsho pa spyi'i don chen sgrub par rjes byas chen po bzhag yod na'ang der gla rin du rta dang / g.yag me mda'/rta sgro/ thur mgo/ 'phying gdan/ lhe ge/ rta sga sogs ca lag dod 272

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/chen len rgyu yod/ gal te gar yang ma phyin pa'am spyi don rtsa ba nas sgrub med tshe yar dpon dang spyi la dngul dang rta g.yag ra lug sogs sems can phul dgos pa ni tsho pa spyi'i 'gro song yin no// mdor na sger rtse dpon gyi las 'gan gtso bo'i gras shig ni se ra phur mjal nyin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon ser rar phebs kyi yod cing de nyin gyi 'gro song tshang ma sger rtse dpon gyis gtong gi yod/ der rgyal ba tsan dan gyi phebs khral dang khab gong ser gyi rtsis khral zhes pa de'o// sger rtse dpon lha sar 'gro dus khal g.yag bdun cu brgyad cu tsam dgos shing / sa tshigs du ma zhig brgyud dgos te khang thog dang / lu ring / dang chung / nag tshang bcas mang dag yod pa de'i 'gro song tshang ma dpon tshang nas gtong dgos/ spyir dga' ldan lnga mchod gong la lha sar slebs par 'gro dgos la/ dus sang sa ga zla ba'i rjes su sger rtser log yong gi yod/ lha sar sdod ring drung 'khor gyi tshogs 'du yod tshad nang la 'dzul dgos/bzhi pa/ dus ston skor/ sger rtse dpon bod zla bcu pa'i nang la lha sar khral rgyag par phyin te dgun kha'i ring lha sar bsdad de lo phyi ma'i bod zla lnga pa'i nang lha sa nas rdog thon gyis bod zla drug pa'i nang sger rtse'i khang thog ces pa dpon thog rim byung gi lte gnas su slebs kyi yod/ de tshe dbyar 'dun zhig 'dzoms ste lha sa nas khyer yong ba'i tshong zog thams cad spus bsgyur btang nas rta rgyugs pa/ rta rtsal 'gran pa/ mda' rtsed rtse ba sogs dga' dga' skyid skyid gtong ngo // bod zla brgyad pa'i nang la 'brog pa tshang ma 'du 'dzoms kyis 'dun ma zhig 'dzoms kyi yod pa de ni dus ston rgyas shos de'o// de tshe yul lhar bsang gsol byed cing / sku rim sna tshogs 273

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtong ba/ 'bum cha tshang klog pa/ de bzhin rta rgyugs (rgyugs ma dang 'gros ma zhes khag gnyis yod/)dang mi rgyugs 'gran par ma zad/ rta rtsal sna tshogs 'gran pa (ja sgam thag ring thung mi 'dra bar bzhag nas me mda' brgyab te me mda' sus phog kyang ja der bdag)bcas spro skyid lhad med gtong ngo //sger rtse'i yul de yangs shing gzhi rgya che bas 'brog pa pho mo tshang ma rta la zhon rgyur ha cang dga' po yod la/ de ni 'grim 'grul gyi lag cha gtso bo de'ang yin/ des na kho tshos rta chas la dang dod ha cang chen po byed kyi yod par rta sga la sna gnyis yod de lcags sga dang shing sga'am sber ga ste shing sber rdor bzos pa'o// der dngul shan dang chu srin pags pas legs par sgron zhing / gser tshags gtong la g.yu byur pha lam sogs kyi phra tshom btang nas rin thang bral ba'o// rta'i sgyid sgrog ni tsher dre dang gsum sgrog ces nor gyi rtsid pa legs shos kyis bzos/ srab la rong pa'i grig srab ces pa ko ba'i sgang la dngul khrab gtong ba dang ko srab ces ko ba mnyes nas phyi nang gnyis bsgrigs nas btsem pa zhig srab dbus te rta'i kha nang la bcug yas der lce mdud ces nges par du lcags zhun spus ma zhig dgos/ rta'i lus sbyar bem po mang che ba lu gu'i bal gsil nas 'phying pas bzos cing / de la spu phrug dang go snam gyis g.yogs brgyab nas bzos pa'o// de'i sgang la grum rtse che ba zhig rgyag de'i steng la rta sga sgron zhing / rta sga'i thog la grum rtse chung tsam shin tu mdzes pa zhig g.yogs pas dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan no//rta sgar sgrog pa'i glo ni 'brong ko mnyes nas char ma sgrog pa zhig dang smad ni ko ba'i sgang lcags dang dngul khrab bsgrigs pa zhig gam 'brong gi lag pa'i sug pa'i ko ba dang / rkyang gi rkang pa'i sug lag gi ko ba mnyam du kha sbyor byas 274

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/nas bzos par rkyang 'brong ko ba kha sprod ces legs po zhe drag yod do//sger rtse'i yul de'i yul sa'am yul lha gtso bo ni rol ba rtsa chen zhig yin/ston tshogs skabs su ched mngags lha ldan gtsug lag khang nas dge bshes gsum gdan 'dren zhus nas zhabs brtan rgyas po zhig bsgrub rjes su yul gyi grong mi rus pa 'od bsang (rus pa de yul lha'i 'khor yin/)yin pa des grong pa re nas dar lcog gnyis re khyer nas gcig mtho sa rol pa'i dbu rtser btsugs shing / cig shos de ri mtshams kyi pho brang steng la 'dzugs kyi yod/ gtsug lag khang gi dge bshes tshos dpon bzhugs sa'i khang thog la bsdad nas kha 'don rgyun mi chad pa byed la bsang btang ste dud zhag gis yul lung khengs par byed do//sger rtse tsho pa spyi'i srung ma ni pha yul a mdo nas khyer yong ba'i dpal ldan lha mo'i thang sku shin tu mtshar ba zhig yod/ dus ston gal che rigs su de'i sku mdun du mnyam 'dzoms byas nas mna' bskyal te khrims 'gal lugs 'gal kyi bya ba gang yang byed kyi min zhes dam bca' 'jog gi yod/gal te mi cig gis tsho pa spyi'i khrims lugs las 'gal ba'i tshe dpal ldan lha mo bzas pa dang khyad med pas mi de sger rtse'i dpon khungs nas thon pa'am phyir spyugs byed kyi yod/ des na dpon gyis 'bangs mir gang byung gis btsir gnod byed mi chog cing / dbang yod bshad pa'am rdung rdeg de bas btang mi chog tsho pa'i mi tshang ma dpal ldan lha mo'i 'og tu 'dra mnyam rang yin/ rjes su dpon mgon po don grub gyis bod pa'i bu rta mgrin rgyal po zhes pa mag par blangs nas bzung khos khrims ngan sna tshogs bzos pa ste rkub la lcag tshan rgyag pa dang 'gram par ko lcag rgyag pa bcas byed 'go tshugs/275

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/des na sngar dpal ldan lha mo'i sku mdun du mna' skyel ba las khrims ngan rtsa ba nas med pa'i lo rgyus mjug sgril lo//lnga pa/ gna' shul skor/ sger rtse'i khul la mon dur dhiphud da dung gna' shul sna tshogs yod pa ni/ byang rngo ro'i yul du yod pa'i ngo mtshar shin tu che ba'i gna' shul byang ri gzhi dpa' mo a bdag gi mkhar ram gling gi dpa' mo'i sha shed khang zhes pa'i rdo dmar pos bzhengs pa'i khang pa thog so gnyis ldan brtsegs pa slas 'thag brgyab pa dang 'dra ba ya mtshan can zhig mchis/ deng sang de'i steng thog brdibs yod kyang brtsegs shul ha cang gsal/ de'i nye 'gram na rdo ling gis bcad btang ba'i gna' shul dbyibs gru bzhi ring mo dang / gru bzhi kha gang ma/ zur gsum/ sgor mo bcas 'dra min sna tshogs yod par khag cig gi ring thung ni rmid brgya lhag tsam dang khag cig rmid gnyis gsum re bcas du ma zhig mchis/ sa gnas de ga'i 'brog pa tshos de la 〈gling sgrung gtam rgyud 〉nang gi byang ri gzhi dpa' mo a bdag gi dbyar gnas sam dbyar kha'i ring mos rgyal khang der bsdad nas yul la dbang sgyur byed kyi yod par brjod/ de min yang mo'i dgun kha'i sdod gnas de brag phug ngo mtshar can zhig yod par de'i nang la dpa' mos dud 'gro bsad pa'i slo 'jog sa dang / dpa' mos me btang nas go thal 'jog sa'i thal phung / dpa' mo'i gsang spyod red ces pa'i shul sogs 'dug cing / brjod srol la slo de dang thal ba 'dres pa de nas tog tsam rko 'don byas nas re'u dang lu gu sogs la sprad na phyugs nad 'gog thub kyi yod skad/ brag phug de'i nang la 'od mdangs 'tsher ba'i nor rdo mchong gzi dang / rdo nyi ma'i kha chu/ rdo chu shel/ rdo ka ma ru bcas mang po yod 276

༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/stabs 'brog pa tshos de tsho'i sgang du mar gyis yar brgyab pas snum zhag dod po zhe drag 'dug 'on kyang gna' shul de gnyis yang snying gang 'dra yin dang lo rgyus kyi dus rabs ci tsam du bzhengs pa sogs gsal po med pas rjes su gna' rdzas rtog zhib rig pas dngos su sngog 'don gyis zhib 'jug byas tshe don dngos ci ltar yin min shes thub nges dang byang thang khul gyi ya mtshan can gyi gna' shul de tshor lo rgyus dngos dang mtshungs pa'i 'grel bshad byed thub nges red/ de min nag ra'i phu la rdzong ga zhes gzhogs gcig la brag dang gzhan cig la rdo yi brtsigs pa thun mong min pa mang dag brgyab nas yod cing de'i nye 'gram kun tu'ang khang ros gtams nas 'dugadrug pa/ rgyan gos skor/ sger rtse tsho pa'i skyes pa pho tshang ma pho lo lnga gsum bco lnga lon tshe bod mda' nges par du gnyer dgos pa ni gcig nas mtshon srung dang gnyis nas 'tsho khungs kyi yo chas gsum nas rgyan cha med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ de la skyes pho rabs mgo yi rwa co dang / pho mtha' ma'i las kyi sdig bshags zhes gal te me mda' med tshe rnam rtog la 'dzin gyi yod/de min gri dang / snyung / khab shubs gsum kyang nges par du 'dogs dgos pa ni/ gri gu khab gu snyung gu gsum mchor 'dod ma yin dgos 'dod yin zhes pa'am khab gu gri gu snyung gu gsum pho mtha' ma gcig la'ang med thabs med ces so// sger rtse'i skyes pas dus rgyun du ra slog dang lug slog gyon pa mang zhing / dus ston khag gi skabs su gzab mchor spros tshe tshar slog dang lhog rtsag gyon pa mang / tshar slog gi mtha' rgyan du stag lpags dang gzig lpags/ sram lpags bcas kyis brgyan zhing / lteg rtsag ces nang shar lu gu'i tsha ru dang phyi la ri dwags gna' ba sogs kyi spu btogs nas 277

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lpags pa mnyen por gnyes pa de rgyab shar rgyag la/ de'i sgang la tshem drub kyi ri mo sna tshogs bris yod de/ rgya nag cha kha dang / g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil g.yon 'khyil/ me ri khyi sna/ nyi zla mgo sbrel/ nor bu me 'bar/ nor bu dga' 'khyil ba bcas so// bu'i mgo la wa lpags dang / lu gu'i tshar dkar/ re'u yi re la 'jam mnyen ma sogs kyi zhwa mo dmigs bsal can gyon gyi yod/ lham ni khams phyogs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i thag lham gyon la lus la 'dogs yas rgyan 'chang dumang po yod/ bu mo tshos slog pa ra slog dang / lug slog tshar slog ji 'dra zhig gyon kyang lnga bsgrigs dang bdun bsgrigs gtong gi yod pas shin tu mdzes po yod/ bud med tshos dgun dus su tshar dkar kyi zhwa mo sgor sgor thun mong ma yin pa zhig gyon zhing /dbyar dus su nyi grib bam ngo g.yol zhes pa ngo gdong la nyi ma rgyag mi thub pa dmigs bsal can zhig gyon la/ dus bzhir ngo gdong la nyi mas bsreg mi thub cing / grang ngar can gyi lhag pa sogs 'gog thabs su stod cha zhes mar khu dang bu ram dmar po mnyam du bskol ba'i sha gsos thun mong ma yin zhig 'byug gi yod/bse 'khon cho pa'i skor/dang po/ lo rgyus skor/ bse 'khor yul der bse dang / smugaldong sogs kyi rus rgyud phud da dung ra ba dang spom pa/ 'a pa/ hor/ ru rog cu bzang bcas kyang yod do// bse 'khor zhes pa'i tsho pa de ni sger rtse tsho pa'i nub phyogs su gnas shing / de yang tsho pa de'i tha snyad la 'bri srol 278

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/mi 'dra ba khag gnyis yod par bse 'khor zhes pa ni rus ming bse zhes pa'i gnyen dang 'khor rgyud tshang mar gnas sdod byed pa'i cha nas tha snyad de byung 'dug la/ de min gser 'khor zhes pa ni sngar lung pa der gser mang po sngog rgyu yod pas de la mi sde 'khor nas bsdad par gser 'khor zhes skad do//mdor na tha snyad de gnyis kar ming don mtshungs pa zhig yin pa ni yul de'i gser thang rgyud la gser ha cang mang po yod pa'ang don dngos dang yul de'i mi'i rus rgyud mang che ba ni bse bo dang / smug po/ ldong po bcas yin pas de la'ang rgyu mtshan med pa min/ yul de'i 'brog pa rgan rabs tshor yul kyi tha snyad skor la bcar 'dri zhu skabs kho tshos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur tu brjod pa ni/ bse'i gdung rgyud yul der chags pa ni shin tu snga zhing gser la 'khor nas chags pa zhes pa ni dus phyis su yin par snyam zhes so// yang khag cig gis yul der thog ma bse mi grong bdun zhes rus ming bse yin pa'i grong pa bdun 'byor nas gnas sdod byas pa yin kyang brjod/ gang ltar yul de'i mi'i gshis rgyud dang / skad lugs/ rgyan gos/ lhag don du bud med kyi ras gos sul mang ldan pa dang spug ces pa'i rgyab slog sogs ni gu ge'i khul gyi lha khang rnying pa 'ga' shas nang yod pa'i ldebs ris nang gi bud med kyi rgyan gos dang mtshungs shing / skyes pa'i lham dpa' 'u zhes pa de'ang gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs kyi mi ser spyi'i gyon pa dmigs bsal can zhig yin pa bcas la gzhigs na tsho pa de'i mi tshang ma phyi nas gnas spos byas pa min par mnga' ris skor gsum gyi mi rgyud rang yin pa gsal po 'dug la/yul de'i gnyen 'brel byed skabs nye ring dbar mthun 'jug byed pa'i lugs srol de'ang gu ge'i rgyal po'i mnga' khongs rong yul mi ser khag gi 279

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs srol dang mtshungs pas so//dus rabs bcu bdun trem la stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lo rgyus la 'pho 'gyur ha cang chen po byung nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dga' ldan pho brang nas dmag btang te la dwags dang / zangs dkar/ sgar zhwa/dkar dkyil sogs phud/ gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs sa gnas tshang ma tshur bsdus nas stod mnga' ris sgar dpon gyi gtsos pa'i rdzong bzhi dpon drug gi sgrig gzhi gsar pa 'dzugs skabs su bse 'khor yul de sgrig gzhi de'i nang la ma tshud par khrims 'go rang btsan tshul du sdod/ de dus su la'ang brten sa med par nyams rgud chen po byung bar ma zad/ rtswa thang skor la rtsod rnyog yong dus su la'ang zhu gtug byed sa med stabs dka' ngal du ma 'phrad kyi yod cing / tha na mi ser gyen langs byed rgyu'i nyen kha chen po yod dus su'ang bya thabs spyod thabs med pa bcas so// des na tsho pa de'i dpon thog gcigaspyang drung dod la 'jon thang che tsam yod pas khos so so'i dbang thang dang mnga' khongs la 'gyur ba gang yang ma byung bar thad kar bod sde pa gzhung gi 'og tu chud pa'i slad du blo rgya che skyed kyis bod sde gzhung ga la ba der bcar te bod gzhung nas bka' rgya dang 'ja' sa yong re byas te/ bse 'khor bod gzhung khongs su thad kar 'jug re dang rang gi mnga' dbang ched du dka' ba du ma spyad de/ sde gzhung dpon rigs bzhugs yul lha sar bcar ro//khong lha sar slebs nas dus yun ring tsam 'das kyang rgyu dngos po gya nom pa bsnams rgyu med gshis lha sa'i dpon rigs khag la zhu ba 'then pa'i cha rkyen rtsa ba nas med/ des na mtshams re zhu ba 'then tshul byas mod kyang sus kyang kha ya byed mkhan ma byung / der brten yar zhu ba'i spobs sems je nyams su 280

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i sgor la dpyad pa/gyur pa'i skabs su/ bse 'khor gyi dpon de'i bya thabs gzhan zad nas mtharakhos blo rig gcig bton yod pa ni/ khos 'phying pa'i zhwa mo ring po gcig bzos/ de la 'ja' tshon dkar dmar ljang sngon ser po sogs kyis rgyan ya mtshan can zhig brgyab/ de'i sgang la da dung 'gron bu dang thag skud mdud pa sogs nyal nyil sna tshogs btags nas lha sa'i bar skor la bskor ba rgyag skabs sde pa gzhung gi zhabs pad chen pos gtsug lag khang gi thog so gnyis pa'i lho phyogs su mchis pa'i bka' shag gzhung las khang gi sge'u khung nasagasung chos ra ba phyogs la mig blta ba dang sbrags/ mi zhwa mo dmigs bsal can gyon pa zhig mthong nas hang sang mdog gis de ring mi ya mtshan zhig slebs 'dug pas de yar khrid shog ces g.yog po zhig la mngags bya byas/de tshe g.yog pos mgyogs dang myur du rgyugs phyin nas bse 'khor gyi dpon de sde gzhung gi gzhung las khang bka' shag tu khrid/ sde gzhung gi sku drag sa dbang chen po phrad pa dang khos 'dzems pa med par de ma nyid du rang yul gyi skyid sdug ji ma ji bzhin dang / sa cha'i rgya che chung ngam dgun kha'ang 'khyag yas med pa'i grags can lu ma bzhi'i sa rgya/ der gnas pa'i mi 'bor ji tsam yod med/ phyi mis brnyas btsir ji 'dra byed min/ phyis 'byung re ba sogs zhib cing phra ba zhu ba'i khar rjes su mkhyen ldan lhan rgyas rnam pa tshor khral yang dus thog tu rgyag rgyu yin par ma zad/ gzhung gi khrims rigs la dang len zhus nas spus ja'ang dus thog tu len rgyu'i khas len byas/ mdor na kho'i dbang thang la 'gyur ba med khar sa khungs gtan 'khel gnang tshe khos nam gnas ji srid bar du gzhung la khral rgyag cing gzhung khrims gtsang dag 'khur gyi yin par brjod pas sde gzhung sa dbang chen pos kho la lu ma bzhi'i 281

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sa rgya cha tshang sprad cing / bka' rgya dang 'ja' sa'ang gnang bar ma zad/nam gnas yun gyi bar du bse 'khor sde gzhung la thad bdag gis khral rgyag dgos pa dang bse 'khor la god chags ji byung yang sde gzhung nas thag gcod byed rgyu khas blangs pas/ ‘‘bse 'khor zhwa mo ring po ’ zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyang dus de nas byung ngo //phyis su mdo khams sger rtse'i yul nas mi tshang bdun tsam thon yong nas bse 'khor 'brog par 'phrog bcom byas pa sogs dka' las chen po bzos pa'i rkyen gyis bse 'khor dpon gyis sde gzhung la snyan zhu phul bas sde gzhung nas lam seng bka' phab don du/ bse 'khor zhes pa'i byang 'brog der dus rgyun du jag pa dang rkun mas brnyas bcos che bas nyen kha shin tu che lags/ der brten da thengs bse 'khor tsho pa'i shar phyogs kyi yangs shing gzhi rgya che ba'i rtswa thang dag mdo khams sger rtse'i mi la sprad nas phyis 'byung sger rtse bas phyi'i rkun jag sogs dgra ngan thams cad la 'gog rgol drag po sprad de bse 'khor la mtha' gcig tu srung skyob byed rgyu'i las 'gan dang re ba bcol nas ‘‘sger rtse phyi'i lcags ri dang bse 'khor nang gi nor bu ’’zhes dus de nas bzung sger rtses bse 'khor la srung skyob legs par byed rgyu dang /bse 'khor gyis sger rtser gnas sdod byed sa'i sa cha sprod cing 'tsho khungs la rogs ram byas te sger rtse dang bse 'khor phan tshun 'cham mthun du gnas so//des na sger rtse'i mi dpa' blo khog che la gzhung drang ba/ ya yud che ba/ drag po'i dmag la 'jug par shin tu 'jon pas bse 'khor la yun ring dus bde zhod 'jags byung dbang gis bse 'khor tsho pa'i mi 'bor mang du phyin pa dang dus mtshungs su stobs shugs kyang che ru phyin/ yin na'ang sger rtses srung 2 82

༄༅//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/skyob byas pa'i bka' drin la bsam shes ma byas par/ de las ldog te kho tshos sngar sprad pa'i sa khungs rtswa thang khag cig tshur slog dgos pa'i re ba zhus kyang sger rtse mi shin tu mkhregs pas mos mthun rtsa ba nas byas med pa'i khar/sger rtse dang bse 'khor dbar la kha mchu yang yang thug pa thag chod ma byung bas sger rtse'i dpon thog de dang bse 'khor spyi khyab gnyis kar kha mchu sngas 'og la brgyab nas 'das grongs su gyur/ de nas sger rtse dang bse 'khor dbar la 'gal ba chen po byung nas rtag tu rtswa thang sogs kyi don du rtsod rnyog gcig rjes gnyis mthud yong gi yod la tha na dbyar dus rta rgyugs sogs gtong dus kyang rtsod 'gran che shos sger rtse dang bse 'khor dbar la yong gi yod do//gnyis pa/ srid kyi sgrig gzhi'i skor/ bse 'khor tsho pa'i 'go pa byed mkhan thog ma dpon po yin pa dang dpon zhwa mo ring mo dang dpon mes le po zhes grags pa shin tu che/ phyis su dpon lugs nyams nas spyi khyab byung ba la/ spyi khyab 'jam nor dang / spyi khyab 'go khrab/ spyi khyab bsod nor bcas kyang ming grags che tsam byung / mdor na rjes sor bse 'khor tsho pa'i 'go dpon mtho shos ni spyi khyab yin/ gna' snga mo'i dus su de'i sdod sa ni bse 'khor bse lding dkar po zhes gur shin tu che ba zhig yod/ de ni bud med khyo ga med mkhan mo hreng du mar lo khral gyi tshod du lo rer 'dom pa gang re byas nas btags su bcug pa'i khyad ldan gur zhig yin/ de'i nang la bse 'khor tsho pa'i 'dun ma tshogs sa'ang byed kyi yod/ sngar bse 'khor gcig gyur skabs su spyi khyab dang / 'go pa/ drung yig dmag dpon re re las med kyang / phyis su bse 'khor lho byang gnyis su gyes rting spyi khyab gnyis/283

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'go pa gnyis/ drung yig gnyis/ mthar dmag dpon gnyis yod/dmag dpon gyi las 'gan gtso bo ni yul la jag pa byung dus skul brda btang nas grong pa'i skyes pa rang lo bco brgyad yol ba tshang ma 'dzoms nas dgra ngan jag tshogs tshar gcod byed dgos/ jag pa mang che ba shar phyogs smad nas thon pa'i khams pa sha stag red/ bse 'khor tsho pa'i spyi khyab gnyis ni sa cha de'i mi rang yin pa las sger rtse dpon nang bzhin lha sa nas gtong gi med/bse 'khor spyi khyab bsko gzhag byed dus 'os tho'am skyer bsags zhes mi re re'i bsam 'char tshang ma mnyam du bsdu rub byed/ de nas 'os tho spyi dmangs yod sar mig bstan nas spyi khyab dngos su bsko/ de'i khyad chos shig ni dpon rgyud 'ded kyi med par 'jon thang che chung dang / gzhung drang min/ lhag par du rgyu dngos che chung la blta rgyu de gal 'gangs che/ gang lags she na/ rgyu phyug po med na bya ba gang yang sgrub dka'/ dper na gzhung nas ja sogs spus sgyur phon chen gtong dus rin pa tshang ma dus thog tu 'bul thub pa byed dgos pas gal te rgyu phyug po med tshe glags rnyed thabs med pa spyi dang yang sgos 'jon thang can kha shugs chen po rtswa thang sogs la kha mchu rgyag thub mkhan nam ya lan dus thog tu sprod thub mkhan zhig yin dgos so//rgad po lo drug cu yol tshe drug cu go thal zhes 'dems mi chog go/ bse 'khor spyi khyab dang 'go pa drung yig sogs kyi thob thang gtso bo ni go rim la gzhigs te rtswa kha dang chu kha legs shos de 'dems pa'i dbang cha yod/lo rgyus thog bse 'khor gyi sa rgya ha cang chen po yod pa ni nub zal po'i lu rgan/ byang spang dkar sog gshong / shar lu ring gtsang po/ lho ka ba lu ma bcas tshud yod cing / da dung ri phud yar rgyugs mar rgyugs kyi yar 284

༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/ro mar ro// spang dkar rdo khra/ lig lung de ma sngo gyur/ rdo sngon la dkar nag ngag rong chu rdor rgyug bre ze nyi/ a mar dkar gong / 'bum khe lung / ti ge la/ 'gag po'i rtswa/ i khang dmar/ ka lu ma/ zal po'i lu rgan bcas tshud yod/ phyis su sger rtses rim bzhin sim 'dzul byas nas sa rgya chung du phyin te tha na mi rabs du mar brten pa'i gnas bdag gam yul lha mes a ma ri rgan de'ang sger rtses zin/ sngar lu ring zhes pa de bse 'khor gyi dgun kha sdod sa gtso bo zhig te kha rgyun tu'ang ‘‘bse 'khor lu gu'i pha yul// lu ring lu gu'i bsti gnas//’ zhes so// tha na yul sa gsum po de'i yang rtse bse 'khor la bdag pa dang rked pa sger rtser dbang ba'o//mnga' ris byang thang khul du sde pa gzhung gi khral khungs gtso bo bse 'khor phud da dung ru rdor ma zin dang gzhung pa ma zin nam gzhung pa ma tshan zhes pa de'o//ma gzhi bse 'khor de dpal 'byor thog nas bod sde pa gzhung gi gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin mod kyang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lo gcig dus gcig dus chen rgyas shos sgar 'char can skabs su bse 'khor gyi sku tshab 'go yod kha shas nges par du 'gro dgos shing / skabs shig la nus pa'ang chen po thon skad/ de dus nyi ri rong pa dang / sgar zhwa/ khu nu/ skyo nam/ la dwags bcas phyi mtha'i tsho pa dang rgyal phran khag gi sku tshab kyang bcar nas ltad mo lta ba dang tshong don rgya chen po zhig spel ba phud/ rtsal mchong 'gran rtsod kyi byed sgo'ang mi nyung ba zhig spel gyi yod/ dper na nyi ri rong pa bas mi hreng shed shugs 'gran pa'i byed sgo'i nang zhugs kyi yod cing / de'i mi bang rtsal che la shed shugs 'gran zla bral gshis lo mang ring sgar dpon 'bangs mi su gcig gis kyang glags ma rnyed do// de tshe mnga' ris sgar dpon gyis yul 285

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gang sar mi shed shugs ldan pa rtsad gcod skabs su/ mthar bse 'khor yul der rus pa khyung po byas pa'i khyung po pad ma dang rus pa bse 'khor byas pa'i bse 'khor pad ma zhes pad ma cha gcig tu grags/ de gnyis la dmigs bsal nus rtsal chen po yod pa shes nas de gnyis sgar 'char can la khrid shog ces brda tho slebs pa dang sbrags gyad pa de gnyis bse 'khor sku tshab 'go yod dang mnyam du khrid phyin/mnga' ris sgar dpon sdod sa sgar dbyar sar slebs pa dang kho gnyis la sha tshil za ru ma bcug pa dang ja mar khu chen po 'thung du ma bcug par nyin ltar re bzhin ja nag 'thung zhing rtsam nag bzas nas sbyong brdar legs par sprad pa ni zla shas ring rkang mdun nyi ma shar med du kho rang gnyis phan tshun shed shugs 'gran du bcug khyung po pad ma lo rgan pas pad ma rgan pa dang bse 'khor der pad ma gzhon pa zhes 'bod/ de nas lo de'i sgar 'char can 'go btsugs pa dang thog ma rta rgyugs 'gran/ de zin 'phral du phyi nang gyad pa shed shugs 'gran skabs su nyi ri rong pa'i shugs pa'am gyad pa rgan gzhon gnyis kyang thon yong nas pad ma rgan gzhon gnyis dang shed shugs thengs gnyis re 'gran par 'gran thengs tshang mar bse 'khor pad ma rgan gzhon gnyis la thob cing de gnyis ngar sha tshad med skyes nas pad ma nged gnyis kyi a lugs yin zhes nyi ri rong pa'i shugs pa gnyis kyi mgo bo'i thog la mchong nas langs yas med par bzos gshis nyi ti shugs pa gnyis pham par khas ma blangs thabs med byung / de nas mnga' ris sgar dpon gyis bse 'khor la mthong chen byed cing dpe sang yang gya nom pa byung ngo //gsum pa/ dpal 'byor skor/ bse 'khor yul ni bod sde pa gzhung 286

༄khya//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gi khral khungs gtso bo ma zin zhig yin stabs lo ltar dus thog tu khral dang 'u lag rgyag dgos/ de'i nang nas sde gzhung gser dpon la gser khral (gser thang dang deng 'dreng zhes par gser phon chen thon/)te gser zho brgya dang bcu drug rgyag dgos la/ 'bam tshong spus sgyur zhes ja sgam mang po len dgos shing / khrims kyang bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu dgos kyi yod/ de min dpal 'byor thog nas sde pa gzhung la khral thad kar rgyag dgos mod kyang chab srid thog nas stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dbu 'dzin sgar dpon gong 'og la bstun dgos pa dang / sgar dpon dang mnyam du mnga' ris spyi'i dgra bor kha gtad gcog dgos la/ sgar dpon nas yul srung gi las ka ga re skul na'ang sgrub dgos pa las min zhes srol med pa bcas so// gong du brjod zin pa ltar bse 'khor sde pa gzhung gi gzhung sde yin zhes pas der bse 'khor ma zin zhes zer gyi yod/ rgyu mtshan ni sde pa gzhung gi ma zin mkhan gyi sde'i gras shig yin par brjod pas rgyun du gser mdzod gser gyis bkang /dngul mdzod dngul gyis bkang / dung mdzod 'o mas bkang ba ltar sde pa gzhung gi nor gyi bang mdzod lta bu'am rgyu nor gyi ma rkang zin mkhan nam sde pa gzhung rtse phyag khral sde las khungs kyi khral rgyag dus ma zin mkhan gyi sde zhig yin/ bse 'khor tsho pa'i nang la leb grangs gzhir bzhag gis khral rgyag dgos te ra bdun la leb gcig lug drug la leb gcig g.yag gcig la leb gcig yin zhing / leb grangs mang shos kyis gser zho gsum/ de nas gser zho gnyis dang gcig phyed ka dngul zho bcas don dngos su gser dngul gyi khral 'jal dgos/ dus mtshungs su lo re'i nang nag nyog gi rtsis bsher byed rgyu de'ang gal 'gangs shin tu che ste/ gser dpon gyi 287

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhabs phyi dang / spus ja'i do g.yag skyel 'dren/ spyi khyab kyi rta rdzi/'dun ma'i skabs kyi me shing sgrug mkhan/ dmag dpon gyis bkod 'doms ltar ri mgor dgra nyen brtag mkhan/ mnga' ris sgar la yi ge bskyal ba'am snyan seng zhu bar 'gro mkhan/ gzhung rgyugs dang sdebs bsang skabs dud 'gro gtong ba'am 'bol gdan dang / sa gdan/ gur/ lcog tse bcas sgrig cha sgrig mkhan sogs kyi las 'gan mang po sgrub yod na tshur yong 'bab phon chen len rgyu yod/ gal te gong gi las 'gan dag ci dang gang yang sgrub med tshe yar dngul dang dud 'gro rgyu dngos bcas 'bul dgos/tha na gzhan gyi sa nas g.yar po zhu dgos byung yang nag nyog gi rtsis la dang len zhu dgos/ mdor na bse 'khor la gser khral phud/ da dung la mgo rgyag dus la khral dang / zam khral/ lug gi bal khral/ tshwa tshong 'gro dus tshwa sho zhes tshwa khral/ me gtong ba'i thab khral bcas yod do// gal te tsho pa'i nang la khral yag po bsdu ma thub tshe/ sde pa gzhung nas phyi char pa'i char thag chod na'ang nang thigs pa'i thigs thag chod mi 'dug ces nyes chad drag po gcod kyi yod stabs 'go dpon che chung tshang mas khral la do dam ha cang chen po byed kyi yod de/ lo gcig nang sde gzhung la nyung mthar yang gser zho brgya dang drug cu/ lug brgya tham pa chad lhag med par 'bul dgos/ da dung 'don rta pa drug cu thon chog dgos la/ rta zam khag la khral skyong dgos pa/mang ja spus sgyur gyi las 'gan 'khur dgos pa bcas so/bzhi pa/ rgyan gos kyi skor/ bse 'khor gyi skad lugs dang mi'i gzugs gzhi'i chags stabs/ yul srol goms gshis bcas tshang ma mnga' ris skor gsum mi'i khyad chos yod la/ lhag don du skyes pa dang skye dman gyi 288

༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/gyon chas tshang mar dmigs bsal khyad chos yod pa ni/ skyes pa tshang mas phyu pa'am slog pa ci gyon kyang mar 'jol lhod du bzhag cing / rgyab kyi rkub sul la dang dod dang do snang ha cang chen po byed pa las khams lugs ltar ska bo (ska rags)pus mo dang mnyam par mtho por bcings pa'i lugs srol med/da dung gong du zhus pa ltar dpa' 'u zhes mthil ko bas btums te sna khug rtse yar bkugs pa mnga' ris skor gsum spyi'i khyad chos ldan pa'i lham de'ang so sos bzos pa de rang gyon srol 'dug de bzhin skye dman tshos spug gu'am spug lding mezhes pa'i rgyab slog thun mong min pa zhig dang ras gos zhes rgyab mdun tshang mar sul shig shig yod pa dag gyon no// de tsho sger rtse'i mdo khams lugs dang gcig mtshungs min/ spug gu zhes pa mang che ba lu gu'i tsha ru las bzos shing / rgyab sha brgyab pa dang ma brgyab pa sna tshogs yod mod kyang rgyab kyi rgyan cha mang dag sgrig gi yod pa ni rgyab stod dang / rgyab smad/khal ma/ khal phrug gong rgyan/ bar rgyab khra bcas mda' gzugs dang /mdung gzugs/ mchod rten gzugs/ ri'i gzugs bcas ri mo dang tshon khra ha cang phun sum tshogs po yod/ mdor na bse 'khor gyi spug gu ni dgon pa'i grwa ba'i gyon yas zla gam gzugs dang cha 'dra ba yin gshis/ ma gzhi rgyab slog yin kyang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi bud med spyi'i gyon pa rgyab slog ces gru bzhi kha gang ma dang cung mi 'dra ba 'dug de bzhin bse 'khor bud med kyi rgyan gos spi chung zhes gzhi 'phying pa dang de la dngul gyi sgor mo khra ling sha stag gis brgyan pa/ de'i dgung tshugs la g.yu dang / byu ru/dngul sgog bcas btang yod la/ shar dar zhes g.yas g.yon la dngul dkar leb po gnyis kyang btags yod cing / mtha' zur la dung dkar 289

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhes dung rgod gtsang ma brgyab nas yod/ brang steng dang rked par ga'u tsho sgor dang zur drug dngul drug ces bzo dbyibs dang che chung mi 'dra sna tshogs 'dogs/ bse 'khor yul gyi skyes pa tshos ske la g.yu byu ru gzi btags shing rna cog la gser gyi a long che chung gang yang 'dogs/ de dag ni mnga' ris skor gsum gyi skyes pa spyi mtshungs kyi rgyan cha yin pa las khams dang a mdo'i lugs dang mi 'dra/ dus mtshungs su rgyab kha zhes skyes pa'i ga'u yi lung thag la dngul gyi pa ṭa brgyab pa bcas dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos shig go/ skyes pa tshang ma'i rked par ri mo sna tshogs bris pa'i khab shubs/me lcags/ glo gri 'dogs mod kyang khams rigs dang mi 'dra bar bud med tshos gri 'dogs pa'i lugs srol med/ skyes pa'i ra slog dang lug slog la mtha' rgyan nag po rgyag pa dang tsha ru'i slog pa la sram lpags mtha' rgyan gtong yang zheng chen po med/ de min lhog rtsag kyang gyon gyi yod par de'i mtha' la mtshal rgyan dmar po dang de'i 'og la gzig lpags kyis brgyan zhing / phyi skog lhog ge zhes ri dwags gna' ba sogs kyi lpags pa spu btogs nas mnyes pa'i lpags pa 'jam mnyen ldan pa zhig rgyag la/ rgyab phyogs su me ri khyi sna dang / sgor rwa cha 'dzin/ rgya nag lcags ri'i bzo dbyibs 'dra ba/ rgya ṭam gyi gzugs dbyibs bcas gtong gi yod pa bcas so//bse 'khor yul la yul lha grags can gsum yod de/ lha hrug dang /nyi ma sgrol ma/ ba sma klu batren bcas so// sngar sdebs bsang gtong dus cho ga rgyas po'i ngang nas gsol gyi yod/ de tshe lha bla ma'i sku rim gtong ba dang /bsang gsol gtong ba/ dar lcog 'dzugs pa/ yul sa'i pho brang la bsang gsol byed cing / mda' gri mdung gsum gyis mchod pa dang sa bcud bum 290

༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/pa g.yang 'dzin sa 'og sbas nas sa bcud yul bcud ma nyams 'gugs srung thub pa bcas byed do// spyir na sdebs bsang de mar mig dgon par btang nas chos phyogs kyi cho ga ha cang phun sum tshogs po byed/ spyir zla phyed tsam ring lha klu btsan gsum la gsol kha gtong ba dang / chos dpe sgrog pa/zhabs brtan sgrub par ma zad/ rta pho chen dang co pas rta rgyugs gtong ba dang rta rtsal sna tshogs 'gran pa/ mda' mdung rtsed 'jos rol cing /gzhas gtong ba/ zhabs bro 'khrab pa sogs dga' skyid 'tsho ba longs su spyod kyi yod do// mdor na bse 'khor la grong pa gsum brgya bzhi brgya tsam yod pas sde pa gzhung la khral mang po len rgyu yod/ bse 'khor mi ser tshang ma las la brtson zhing / gnyom chung ya nga snying rje ldan pa sha stag yin la/yul der kha rgyun rig gnas shin tu phun sum tshogs te rtsod rabs brgyad bcu ⑩la dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan no// bse 'khor yul der lo gsar skabs su yul lha gsol ba phud da dung lha lug dkar po dang / mgon lug nag po/ btsan lug dmar mo/ klu lug sngon mo/ bse 'khor gro bo ra dkar/ rta sgo ngo dmar/ mi kha rgya bo/ nor lha gwa ba/ ab se mi dmar rang dmar/ tsha rong gnam ra brtan/ ru thog rgya 'od ces lug dkar po/'dam gyi gnyan chen thang lha zhes lug gro bo bcas gsol/ de dus gnyan dkar sum brgya drug cu/ gnyan nag bye ba 'bum bcu gsol gsol zhes so//mdor na thog ma kha la yar brgyab/ de nas rna cog la dar tshon sne lnga 'dogs/de nas rwa co dang sgal bar btsag dmar 'byug cing / yar brgyab dus kha dro/bkra shis/ don grub/ mi la na tsha mi gtong / phyugs la god kha mi gtong zhes dang / rna cog la rgyan rgyag dus/ rgyan no rgyan no// zog g.yang rgyan 291

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/no// gos kyi bkrag rgyan no zhes/ rwa cor btsag 'byug dus g.yas kyi zangs rwa dmar mo de mda' mdung brdar dgra yi kha brdar/ snying na ba tshang ma brdar/ brang tsha ba tshang ma brdar zhes/ g.yon gyi mchong rwa srug mo mi brdar ro mi brdar ro khyim mtshes gnyen nye grogs sogs mi brdar ro zhes/de nas sgal bar btsag thig rgyag gin ser po gser gyi thig rgyal lo// kham ma dngul gyi thig rgyal lo// g.yu byu ru mu tig gi thig rgyal lo bcas so//mchan 'grel/du byang pa zhes pa ni byang phyogs la 'tsho sdod byed mkhan la go dgos shing /stod mnga' ris skor gsum la cha bzhag na gu ge byang pa dang / la dwags byang pa/ ru thog byang pa sogs mang dag zhig mchis mod kyang 'dir byang pa zhes pa de ni sngar ru thog khul gyi byang stod byang smad dam khu nu ri bo'i byang rgyud du yangs shing rgya che ba'i byang thang khul du gnas sdod byed mkhan byang thang 'brog pa'am byang pa zhes pa de'o//dhi dge rgyas zhes pa deng sang mnga' ris sa khul gyi rdzong zhig yin zhing / de'i lte ba de ni sngar 'brong pa dpon gyi mnga' khul 'bong pa seng smad kyi sa cha sna phug tu chags mod kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dga' ldan pho brang skabs su dge rgyas zhes pa de'ang khams phyogs nas gnas spos byas pa'i tsho pa zhig ste/ ming la'ang dge rgyas mtsher gsar dud dgu zhes khams dge rgyas yul nas yong ba'i dud grangs dgu byung ba yin zhing / de'i chags yul ni sger rtse dpon dang thag nye ba'i sa byang tshwa kha'i 'khris su mchis/ tsho pa der rus rgyud mang che ba dge rgyas yin la/ de min da dung shung tsha dang / ba rong / dmar tsa bcas yod/ dge rgyas zhes pa'i tsho pa de'i dpon po mtho shos ni spyi khyab dpon zhes shing / lo rgyus thog la dpon thog mang po byung 'dug la dpon thog dang po'i ming la rdzo skyes zer gyi yod skad/ de nas chos dbyings/292

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/chos 'dzin zhes dpon mtha' 'jug de'i ming la bka' lha srung zhes btson bzung 'og shor nas lha sar 'das so//me mtsho chen zhes deng mnga' ris sa khul gyi shar phyogs 'brog khul rdzong khag gsum gyi nang gses shig yin mod/ sngar phyogs bcu tsho pa'i khongs su gtogs shing mtsho chen zhes mtsho zhig yod pa de'i nye 'khor du yod pa'i ming de ltar thogs/ da lta rdzong gi lte ba de sman dong dgon pa'i gam dang mtsho chen gtsang po'i nub ngogs su chags yod/ rdzong de'i khyab khongs su de snga phyogs bcu tsho pa mang che ba dang 'brong pa byang ma'i rtswa tsho kha shas dang nag tshang dpon gyi rtswa tsho'ang re zung tshud yod do//du dpon lce lo zhes pa de kha lkugs tsam yod pas ming de ltar byung / khong chung byis pa'i dus nas gshis rgyud ha cang mkhregs shing pha ma'i kha la mi nyan pa/ rta zhon gri rtsed la dga' ba'am rtag tu 'khrugs rtsod bslangs pa bcas byed/ cher longs nas gnas nges med du 'khyams 'gro zhing 'chal po rgyugs pa/ gang sar dpung pa ngoms nas rgyag res rgyag pa/ tsho pa gzhan la rkun jag brgyab nas rgyu dngos du ma bcom pa bcas sus kyang do zla byed thub kyi med pas mis bu min btsan phrug gam dgra lha'i srung ma yin zhes zer kyi yod do//me khong gi skabs su mi la tog dang rta la dom byung / kho'i bu mo zhig la bod pa'i mag pa zhig blangs pas des dmigs bsal can gyi tsho pa'i srid kyi sgrig gzhi ste mnyam za mnyam 'thung dbang thang 'dra mnyam spyod pa dang dpal ldan lha mo'i bka' dbang ci gnang la nyan 'jog byed pa de gtor nas 'go pa dang bcu dpon dmag dpon bcas go gnas bzos shing / mi ser la ko lcag rgyag pa dang rta lcag rgyag pa'i khrims nag dar bar byas so//me rngo ro'am rngo ro skor chad kyi mi rgyud ni nag chu'i a mdo khul nas gnas spos byas pa'i rus rgyud ga rgya dang rngo ro skor ched/ se ro bcas mang che ba yin zhing / da dung 'brong pa dang / bya rigs/ gnam ru/ khyung po/ skyer ba/ brag tsha bcas 293

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod/ ga rgya dang se ro'i mi rgyud shugs che shos yod pa ni de gnyis dpung 'brel gyis gtser bas ru thog byang stod pa'i 'brog pa rang yul dang bral par byang pa spud stong gi gnas zhes pa de byung la/ yul der rngo ro zhes pa'i tha snyad de yang byung / deng sang rngo ro'i 'brog pa tsho'i skad dang lugs srol goms gshis bcas tshang ma nag chu'i a mdo rdzong gi 'brog rigs dang gcig mtshungs yin/ phyis su rngo ros sger rtse'i dpon la mgo btags nas de'i dbang 'og tu tshud de rdo gram zhes pa rngo ro'i dpon du bskos/de dus rngo ro rdo gram dang de'i g.yog mgon po gnyis kyis sger rtse'i bu lce lo dang mnyam du gang sar jag brgyab/ thengs gcig dpon g.yog gsum gyis byang pa'i yul du jag brgyab te ca dngos du ma zhig 'phrog bcom byas/ de dag bgo bsha' rgyag skabs dpon phrug lce los ham sems dang dpung shugs kyis dngos po thams cad bdag gir bzung / rngo ro'i dpon g.yog gnyis phan tshun gcig gdong gcig la bltas nas sdod pa las thabs shes gang yang ma byung / des na mi ring bar lce lo'i 'dod rngams cher bskyed nas ‘‘bu 'jigs le/ bu rgod le/ bu dpung pa yod le ’’zhes nas sger rtse'i mnga' dbang rgya skyed kyis lo rgyus thog grags pa che cher khyab pa'i sger rtse'i dpon lce lo zhes pa de'o// rngo ro'i dpon mtha' ma de'i ming la rngo ro grwa ba zhes 'jon thang che la kha shugs kyang che bas mtshams re sger rtse dpon la'ang bkod pa gtong gi yod de khyod kyis gos chen ser po gyon nas dus rtag tu lha sar bsdad de bod pa'i rkub g.yog rgyugs pa las rang yul legs par bskyangs na 'thus zhes skad do//dhi mon dur zhes pa de stod mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du rgya khyab shin tu che ba'i dur sa zhig yin te/ 'brog pa tshos skal mon kyang brjod/ de'i go don ni shin tu snga ba zhig ste yul der skal ba chags yong dus nas yod pa'i don no// de bzhin 'brog pa rgan rabs khag cig gis brjod pa ltar na gna' snga mo'i skabs su byang thang gi sa cha de mon pas bzung yod cing / phyis su bod nas gling seng chen (mnga' ris skad 294

༄7//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/du bse chen rgyal po'ang zer/)rgyal pos dmag du ma zhig khrid yong nas mon pa'i mi phyir sgyugs byas/ de dus su mon pa'i mi mang dag cig bsad nas dur sbas byas stabs mon dur zhes pa de nas byung bar grags shing / dus mtshungs su mon pa'i mi mang po zhig la na tsha gdug pa can zhig byung nas shi bas de tsho yang dur du sbas skad/ gang lags she na/ deng sang yang 'brog pa tshos dur sa de tshor 'gul skyog rgyag rgyu lta ci tha na thug tsam yang byed kyi med pa ni/ gal te de nas rdo sogs bkog nas phyir khyer tshe na tsha mu 'byams su phyin nas yul mi stong pa'i nyen kha yod ces zer gyi 'dug mon dur zhes pa'i dur sa de dag ni rdo ling gis mtha' skyor ba'i dbyibs gru bzhi che chung sna tshogs dang de'i phyi la yig med rdo ring che chung dang / ring thung / bzo dbyibs sogs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa der mon tho brjod/ dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs bdun bcu'i nang la 'brog pa'i 'tsho rten shin tu dkon pa'i skabs su rngo ro nas yin pa'i 'brog pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin dang karma rdo rje zhes pa'i spun gnyis 'u thug nas mon dur tog tsam sngog dus su kha thog rdo ling 'ga' shas bkog ma thag mar brdibs nas karma rdo rje mon dur gyi khung nang la lhung zhing / khos dngangs 'tshab ngang blta dus de'i nang la g.yu dang / byu ru/ gzi sgor cha tshang ba/ rdza ma/ me gtong ba'i sol nag bcas yod skad/ mdor na mon dur zhes pa der gna' rdzas rig pa mkhas can tshos dngos su tshan rig thog nas rtogs zhib byas med stabs yang snying dus tshod ga dus yin min dang mi rigs gang 'dra zhig gi rig dngos yin pa sogs phyi 'byung dpyad par 'tshal/ 'on tang mnga' ris byang thang 'brog khul du mon dur dang /mon mkhar/ mon tho/ mon zhing / mon khrog (mon pa'i gser sngog 'don byas pa'i shul/)zhes mon dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gna' shul mang dag yod pa dngos rton yin no// deng sang mnga' ris yul 'brog rong gsum gyi mi ser tshos mon zhes pa ni ri bo hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi lho phyogs su gnas sdod byas pa'i bod rigs dang / bal 295

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po'i rigs/ rgya gar pa bcas mnyam gnas byas pa'i rig gnas sne mang 'dres pa'i khul dang yul mi dag la brjod do//dhi sger rtse'i skyes pa pho tshang ma'i rked par me lcags (mthil la lcags ngar ma sgrog pa'i khug ma zhig de'i nang la me rdo dang spra ba ces me sbor byed kyi rtswa khyad par can blugs pa'i yo byad cig)dang / khab shubs/(phyi ko bas bzos shing nang na ras 'thum 'tshem sgrog byas pa der khab che chung phra sbom sna tshogs gzer nas yod de ga dus dgos kyang bed spyod gtong chog chog yod pa'i khab snod cig) rked gri/(de la dbye na glo gri dang / dpa' dam/ gar sog bcas kyi dbye ba yod/ legs shos sam spus ma'i shubs dang yu bar dngul shan dang gser tshags gtong bar ma zad/ g.yu byur mu tig sogs rin chen nor rdos phra tshom rgyas po brgyab yod/) 'ur rdo/(der dbye na bcu drug dgu sgril dang / chu mig dgu sgril/ sog leb rnying ma/ sog leb mig mang / mig brgya chu ris can bcas sems can la bkod pa gtong yas kyi lag cha gtso bo zhig dang gcan gzan la gzhu byed kyang yin la gnod pa'ang 'gog thub kyi yod skad de mdor na phyugs dzi'i yo byad cig)me bse 'khor bud med kyi gyon gos spug lding dang ras gos kyi 'byung rkyen skor la yul mi rgan rabs khag cig gis brjod don du/ de ni gling seng chen rgyal po'i lcam 'brug mo dang 'brel ba dam po yod skad/ gna' snga mo gling gi seng chen rgyal po de rma smad g.yu lung gsum mdor byu ru'i yul du bzhugs skabs/ gling yul la che rgyud dang /chung rgyud/ 'bring rgyud ces shog tsho chen po gsum yod skad/ che rgyud tshang gi dpon khro thung de stobs 'byor che bas 'bring rgyud tshang dang chung rgyud tshang la rtag tu khyad gsod byed kyi yod gshis gling yul 'khrug rtsod che la ma 'cham par sdod dus gling gsum gyi mi 'bangs tshang mas gros byas nas da thengs rta rgyugs 'gran nas sus ang dang po lon tshe des gling gsum la dbang sgyur byas nas gser khri'i thog la 'khod rgyu byas/ de tshe yab skya lo zhes gling tsho pa tshang ma'i nang nas rgyu phyug shos yin pa des khro thung gi g.yo sgyu 'khrab 296
