༄//mnga' ris byang thang gi sger rtse tsho pa dang bse 'khor tsho pa'i skor la dpyad pa/par dogs pa byung nas rang gi sras mo mdzes sdug ldan pa 'brug mo zhes pa de jo ru gdan 'dren par mngags shing / de'i rten 'brel mtshon ched du 'brug gu'i bsam lding spug mo zhes pa de bzos/ de ni deng sang bse 'khor yul gyi spug gu zhes pa de yin zhing / pha tsha bu rgyud du bed spyod gtong srol yod la dar khyab ha cang che/ des na gling che rgyud dang / chung rgyud/ 'bring rgyud gsum mnyam 'dzoms kyis rta rgyugs gtong skabs jo rus sprang phrug zhig la brdzus nas rta rgyugs nang 'dzul bas ang dang po lon stabs/ kho gling gsum gyi rgyal por bskos pa dang 'brug mo'ang kho'i lcam byas shing / de gnyis kyi rten 'brel skabs su 'brug mo'i mtha' sul zhes pa'i ras kyi phyu pa de bzos pas de yang bse 'khor bud med kyis gyon pa'i sul mang ldan pa'i ras kyi phyu pa de yin par grags so// mdor na bse 'khor ni gling (bse chen/)gi rgyud pa dang spug lding dang ras kyi phyu pa sul ldan de 'brug mo'i bzhag pa'i gyon gos yin skad do//rjo bse 'khor spyi khyab kyi khrims yig gam rtsod rabs brgyad bcu zhes pa ni/ sa pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi yar nang / gnam 'khor lo rtse brgyad gyi mar nang / yar rgyan spang ser lu ma/ 'dzam bu gling gi sa cha/ rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi chags tshul/bod 'dzam gling skyid pa'i nyi ma/ skye 'gro yongs kyi skyabs gnas/ sa gnam bar gyi ka ba/ mun nag nang gi mar me/ zhing mchog pho brang 'di la/ gser khri bar ba'i khri 'don/ brgya la sgrub pa'i brgya dpon/ stong la sgrub pa'i stong dpon/ g.yas bu rgyud dung dkar gyi mchod rten/ dung dkar po 'gran 'og ma dpog gi mchod rten/g.yu mo brgyud g.yu yi me long / g.yu phru dkar phru yis ma zin/ bar bu rgyud shel dkar gyi phreng dmar/ phreng lung dar gyis ma shes/ dpon rgyud rtag brtan bstan dkar/ rtag brtan bstan dkar ma bzhengs/ gcig zhus pa'i gcig lcogs rgyal po/ gnyis zhus pa'i nyi khri btsan po/ gsum zhus pa'i dkon mchog gsum po/bzhi zhus pa'i dga' ldan sde bzhi/ lnga zhus pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ drug zhus pa'i ma 297

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ṇi 'bru drug sa de dkar gtsang dri med/ lha bla ma'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs sa/nub de nas shing sgo lcags sgo de/ dpon dgon pa'i dgon shing 'bul sa yin/nub de nas mchong gi thang ka de/ dpon dga' ldan tshe dbang phebs sa yin/ yar zhus lcags kyi 'grim lam yin/ mar zhus gzi yi 'grim lam yin/ gzi phra mo gcig gis 'grim lam yin/ dkar drag po'i se ra 'bebs sa yin/ bka' khrims nyi ma shar sa yin/ pho bden yod bden pa'i bshags lam yin/ rdzun yod rdzun pa'i bshangs lam yin/ zhwa mi 'gyur gser gyi sa gzhi la/ gdan mi 'gyur grum tse kha gang yod/ gdan mi 'gyur grum tse kha gang la/ dpon mi 'gyur dga' ldan tshe dbang yod/ zhwa rtse gnam la mi reg pa'i khru gang yod/ zhwa gsham sa la ma reg pa'i khru gang yod/ phyi nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad yod/ nang nas lha ris cha tshang yod/mjug nas rgyal srid sne bdun yod/ ma a sri mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/ gong dpon po mjal ba'i khrims dar yin/ ban bla ma mjal ba'i chos dar yin/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa yin/ yar zhus lcags kyi 'grim lam yin/ mar zhus gzi yi 'grim lam yin/ gzi khra mo gcig gi 'grim lam yin/ nga bden tshig nyung dkar gyi 'bras bu de/ chung yang sa la mi thims gcig dang / 'go btsugs chu yi lbu ba de/ che yang gnam la ma yal gcig mkhyen mkhyen phul phul lo// dar dkar gyon pa'i gtso bo de/ steng lha nas byon pa'i gtso bo de/ spyi khyab rnam pa gnyis po yin/dar dmar gyon pa'i gtso bo de/ bar btsan nas byon pa'i gtso bo de/ btsan ngar drag che ba'i gtso bo de/ 'go pa rnam pa gnyis po yin/ dar sngon gyon pa'i gtso bo de/'og klu nas byon pa'i gtso bo de/ klu ngo mtshar che ba'i gtso bo de/ dmag drung yig rnam pa gsum po yin/ de 'dra'i dkar gtsang dri med der/ lha bla ma'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ dbyar dgun dbye ba 'byed mkhan de/ g.yu 'brug skad kyi dang po yin/ bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed mkhan de/ dpon po chos kyi rgyal po yin/ dkar 298

nag dbye ba 'byed mkhan de/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yin/ mkhyen mkhyen phul phul zhes so// kha mchu ma brgyab gong la phan tshun gnyis kas de nges par du lab dgos/de min tshe kha mchu rgyag pa'i dbang thang med/

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/bod rgyud nang bstan chos lugs ngos nas brjod tshe sa dge rnying gsum dang bka' brgyud sogs grub mtha' mi 'dra bar g.yang 'gugs cho ga'ang byed stangs mi 'dra ba sne mang yod/ 'dir brjod par bya ba ni stod mnga' ris gu ge khul gyi dmangs khrod du g.yang 'gugs ji ltar byed pa'i skor rags tsam brjod rgyu gsham gsal ltar lags/g.yang 'gugs kyi cho ga byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rgyu dngos dang /zas nor/ bsod nams/ longs spyod/ dpal 'byor/ legs cha mtha' dag rang ngos su 'gugs pa'i ched du'o// g.yang 'gugs kyi cho ga byed skabs su rgyu cha ni mda' dar dang / g.yang sgam/ lug sha lag pa/mchod kong / kha phye mar bcas dgos/ gna' snga mor mda' dar ni smyug shing khru gang gi rtse la zur gsum mda' gzugs can gyi lcags sgrog pa'i mda' mo rang yin zhing g.yang 'gugs skabs su de lag tu bsnams nas cho ga dang gsol mchod byed kyi yod/ phyis su mda' dar bed spyod gtong rgya cher phyin nas de'i nang don dang grub cha'ang phun sum je tshogs su btang te ma rkang mda' smyug dang rtse la zur gsum lcags mda' sgron/(tshe srog brtan pa'i don/)rtse la sdi~X0 sgro lnga tsam sgrog de nas kha btags dkar gtsang spus legs a sher

༄za//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/sgril brgyab/ der dar tshon sngo dkar ser dmar ljang sogs sgrog de dag gis 'byung ba lnga dang kha phyogs mi 'dra ba mtshon pa ni shar dkar po dang /lho ser po/ nub dmar po/ byang ljang khu/ dbus sngon po yin zhing /dngos grub thams cad gnas pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga'ang mtshon gyi yod par shar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dang / lho rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/nub snang ba mtha' yas dmar po/ byang don yod grub pa ljang khu/ dbus rnam par snang mdzad sngon po bcas so// mda' dar spus legs ni sku rgyu dar gos chen gyi mtshon sna lngas brgyan zhing / da dung g.yang dkar lug gi a cug gcig g.yang dkar lug bal 'khel yas kyi 'phang gcig las 'bras legs nyes bde sdug gsal ba'i me long gcig bsam pa dkar po mtshon pa'i dung dkar gcig khrab chung a long dgu dkris ni mtshon srung tshe srog brtan par mtshon/ rgyu dang dbang thang mtshon pa'i smug mdog can gyi mchong gcig mtsho nang gter bdag klu nor mtshon pa'am g.yang dang rten 'brel mtshon pa'i 'gron bu gcig bla srog mi 'gyur brtan par mtshon pa'i bla g.yu ljang khu gcig dbang thang gzi brjid mtshon pa'i sgor mo'i dbyibs can gyi gzi gcig bsod nams byur bur gtams pa'i byur dmar gcig bcas dang de min rin chen nor bu'i rigs gser dngul dang spos shel sogs kyang de'i sgang la sgrog go/de nas dngos su g.yang 'gugs kyi cho ga byed dus mda' dar g.yas dang phye mar g.yon la bsnams nas g.yang 'bod lan gsum byed cing /lug sha lag pa gcig khyer nas g.yang 'gugs byed do// de yang sa skya ba dang dge lugs sogs kyi ngos nas brjod tshe rnam sras dang mgon dkar gyi 301

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/g.yang 'gugs ni rgya chen po dang rgyas po yod/ stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi dmangs khrod g.yang 'gugs byed srol gyi cha rkyen ni dang po dgung sngon gyi rgyu skar 'dzoms dgos/ lhag par du skar ma rgyal ba dang gza' phur bu gnyis nges par du 'dzoms dgos/ de nas g.yang rdzas kyi bum chu ni yag shos byung na gangs rin po che'i gangs chu dgos/ de bzhin me rgyun ma chad pa'i me rdo/nag thig khab rtse tsam yang med pa'i spo ba dhidakar po'i rnga ma dkar gtsang zhigaru bo'i durwa co skyon chag rtsa ba nas ma shor ba gcig bcas dgos/g.yang 'gugs byed sar g.yang kha bsdams rjes su ca lag phar tshur dbor ba'am gtong mi chog cing / mi yar mar 'grul bzhud kyang byed mi chog de min dkar yol gas chag ma shor ba ri mo bkra shis rtags brgyad can cha gcig dgos pa la/ gcig gi nang la chang dang po gang bkang ba dang gcig gi nang la mar khus gang bkang nas kha ras dmar pos bsdams nas nyin gcig gnyis ring bskang gso gtong dgos/ de rting dkar yol kha phye ste chang dang mar khur rtags mtshan ci yod brtag dgos te/ dkar yol nang gi mar khu 'khyag pa de'i kha thog gi ri mor rtags mtshan ci yod min blta dgos pa ni/ gal te mar khu 'khyag pa de'i kha thog la ri mo gang yang 'char med tshe rtags thon med pas yang bskyar kha bsdams nas mu mthud de bskang gso gtong dgos shing / ri mo 'char ma khad de'i rtags mtshan gzhir bzhag gis g.yang sgam 'khyer yong ste de'i nang la g.yang nor mtshon pa'i mchod pa de tsho blugs pa dang g.yu byur mu tig dung sogs rin chen sna lnga sogs kyang blugs dgos la/ shing tog sne mang dang / mngar cha/ ja tshwa sogs ro bcud ldan pa'i zhim zas mngar skyur kyang cha tshang ba blugs kyi yod/302

༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/chang phor gang po de'i kha phye nas chang de'i kha mdog 'gyur min dang / mang nyung / dri ma bzang ngan la gzhigs te rgyu dngos 'phel 'grib ji yong yig thog la bkod de g.yang sgam nang la blugs/ de nas g.yang sgam la sgo lcags brgyab rjes su bla ma'am chos pa g.yang 'gugs mkhan des la cha'i thal rtse brgyab rting g.yang khug nang la bcug nas bsdus 'jog gi yod do//rjes sor yang skyar g.yang 'gugs byed skabs la cha'i thel rtse bkrol rim dang sbrags sgam nang gi g.yang mtshon pa'i ca dngos phyir 'don/ de dus kha 'don dmigs bsal can zhig yod pa de la gzhigs nas g.yang sgam gtsang ma bzo dgos/ sa dge'i grub mtha' gzhir bzhag g.yang 'gugs pa'i tshe/ rnam sras dang mgon dkar gnyis kar so so'i cho ga gtong stangs dpe cha kha gtsang re yod pa ni mchod pa bzhengs stangs dang / g.yang 'gugs go rim/ g.yang rdzas sna rigs bcas grub mtha' mi 'dra bar dbye ba chen po yod la dmangs khrod lugs srol dang rtsa ba nas 'dra gi med/zhing pa mi tshang dkyus ma'i nang g.yang 'gugs byed dus g.yang sgrom bang khri'i nang la nas 'bru sogs tshad ldan bzos nas blugs/ de'i sgang la mda' dar btsugs rjote cho ga byas rting lo hril por 'jog go/ lo gsar pa 'char ba dang nas 'bru dang gro/ 'bras sogs kyi phud tog tsam zhig g.yang sgrom bang khri'i sgang la blugs pa dang sems can phyi la ci tsam btsong yang de'i spu rdzob tsam gcig btogs nas mda' dar la sgrog go/ gal te nang mi dang yul la don dag sogs ma 'grig pa'am rkyen ngan byung na spags g.yos shing gzan ril sgril te de'i nang la shog gu'i sgang la nang don cha tshang bris pa de bcug nas mda' dar la sgril lo byed cing g.yang sgrom nang la dus nges can 303

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig blugs nas lag la ji thebs pa de bsnyabs nas ltas bzang ngan la brtag pa dang thag gcod byed kyi yod do//'brog pa tshos ra bu'i rjonang la g.yang 'gugs byas zin rting mda' dar de dkar phyogs rjokyi phu ngos kyi snam dkar dang snam nag rjomatshams su sgrog cing / dbyar dus su 'o ma dkrogs nas mar gsar thon pa dang de'i phud de mda' dar la dkar rgyan re brgyab rjes rtag tu de nas mar khu'i thigs pa rgyag gi yod/ gal te 'o ma sengs nas mar ma thon pa'i skabs la mda' dar mar 'bebs nas rkyal pa'i mesgang la brdar tsam byas tshe mar lam seng dog por 'gril thub ces zer/ nang gi a mas nyin ltar zhogs pa snga por langs ma khad mda' dar der bsang gsol gtong cing chu phud gtor/ de ltar byas na g.yang 'phel nas 'tsho ba phun sum je tshogs su 'gro gi yod ces brjod do//dbyar dus su lug gi bal 'breg dus klu lug sngon mo'i bal phud dang ra'i le na dushad dus lha ra ngang dkar gyi le ni'i phud/ g.yag gi khu lu 'thog dus btsan g.yag kham pa'i khu lu'i phud bcas g.yang 'gugs kyi mda' dar la sgrog gi yod/ de dus kha nas smon tshig 'di ltar 'don gyi yod par/ g.yang lug sngon mo nam mkha'i skar ltar 'phel bar shog g.yang ra dkar mo gangs ri'i dpangs dang mnyam par shog g.yang g.yag kham pa spang rgyan me tog 'char bzhin 'phel bar shog ces so//mchan 'grel/me spo ba/ 'bras bu ma bton pa'am sha ma gcod pa'i g.yag thug ste rwa co sbom 304

༄༅//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/la ze ba mthug pa/ stobs dang blo khog che ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan/ dus rgyun du g.yag khyu dang mnyam du ma 'dres par mtha' gyar nas 'gro zhing / ston dus su 'bri mor 'khor dus ru shin tu ngar bas rtag tu spo ba nang tshogs la rdung kha rgyag cing /pham pa'i phyogs de nyin gnyis gsum tsam rjes 'ded btang te yul de nas phyir 'bud gtong gi yod/rjo ru bo/ 'bras bu ma bton pa'i lug thug ste rwa co sbom la gzugs stobs che zhing bal sna ha cang ring ba/ ru bo nang tshogs rdung kha rgyag dus phan tshun kha sprod du langs nas thag ring tsam phyir 'then brgyab te shugs chen pos phar tshur rgyugs nas rwa rdung rgyag pas rwa co'i skad ldir ldir du sgrog pa dang me lce 'bar nas dud dris lung pa khengs par byed/① zhing pa mi tshang dkyus ma'i 'bru blugs sa'i bang khri'i sgang la btsugs yas kyi mda' dar de smyug ma'i dar shing sgang la dar tshon sna lnga sgrog pa stabs bde zhig las med/du ra bu/ mnga' ris skad de sbra gur nag por go dgos/ spyir de'i phyi'i chon thag (sbra gur 'bubs byed kyi phyi'i thag pa ring ba rtse la phur pa yod/)zhes g.yas g.yon gzhogs re la gsum re dang sgo dang phu la gnyis re khyon bsdoms rkang brgyad dgos/gur nang la rgyal thag ces thag pa leb mo rim pa gnyis gtong yod pa zhig dbus la dgung dkar zhesadu ba 'gro sa'i stong cha chen po zhig mchis so/bu dkar phyogs/ sbra gur nag po'i nang gi g.yon phyogs sam lho phyogs su bud med tshang ma sdod sa yin zhing / phu la yum chen dang de nas bu mo spun lo rgan gzhon gyis gral la 'khod/ der dkar phyogs zhes brjod/ gang lags she na/ dkar las byed sa ste zho dang / 'o ma/ da ra/ chu khu (da ra bskol nas phyu ra 'don zin pa'i khu ba/)/ la po ste bskol zin pa'i da ra/ mar sogs dkar las lag len byed sa dang dkar po'i rgyu 'jog sa yin pas so// g.yas phyogs su skyes pa pho tshang ma sdod cing phu la yab chen dang de nas bu spun lo rgan gzhon gyis gral ltar 'khod/ der 305

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dmar phyogs zhes 'bod par rgyu mtshan ni dmar las byed sa'am sha lpags rus gsum 'jog sa'i gnas yin/rjo snam dkar dang snam nag 'brog pa'i sbra gur nag po ma gzhi nag rkyang yin kyang g.yas g.yon gyi gling gnyis sbrel mtshams te phu dang sgo la snam bu dkar po'i snam cha yug re gtong gi yod pa ni/ kha dkar ngo dkar sems pa dkar ba'i don yin la/khag cig gis gdon 'dre ni tshan nag gung la yong gi yod/ des dkar po mthong na 'jigs skrag langs kyi yod pas de ltar bzos pa red zer/ mdor na gur la snam cha dkar po gtong ba ni gdon 'dre 'gog ched du yin par grags/rjo rkyal pa/ ra lug gi rlid bu ste tshem bu brgyab pa'i pags pa'i sgro ba zhig dang brang khog nas ma gshags par hril por bubs bshus btang rjes su spu tshang ma btogs nas gtsang rkyang bzos te mjug gsham dang sug rtse bzhi ltebs tshigs brgyab nas tshems shing / mjing pa'i zheng chung sa'am kha dog sar rkyal pa'i kha bzos te/ de nas 'o ma blugs rjes su phu brgyab rting lag pa gnyis kyis 'ju thub tsam bzos nas dkyil mo krung du sdod pa'i pang khar bzhag te dkrug dkrug thengs mang btang nas mar chags pa de 'don gyi yod/ spyir dbyar dus hril por 'o ma dkrogs nas ston dus su rkyal par dkar sha rgyas nas pags pa mthug po chags yod pa de me chung chung btang nas yun ring btsos te ldur ru ('bras hrog po dag rtsam pa nang bzhin zhib por btags nas chu nang la btsos pa'i skyo ma ldur ldur/)g.yos pa dang mnyam du bzas na ro bcud ldan pa'i zhim zas dmigs bsal can zhig yin/ de dus rkyal pa btsos zhes grong pa'i mi tshang thams cad mgron la bos nas mnyam 'dzoms kyis longs su spyod kyi yod/ de tshe byis pa lo chung tshang ma sbra gur gyi phyi la btang nas mi rgan pa tshos phyi la chu ti ger zhes bag leb chung chung sna tshogs yod pa dag sbra gur gyi dkar dgung nas phyi phyogs gang sar dbyugs nas hab thob rgyag tu 'jug pas 'khrugs po zhe drag yod la byis pa yod do cog lo gsar gtong ba ltar dga' tshor chen po byed do//306

༄7//stod mnga' ris gu ge'i khul gyi g.yang 'gugs byed srol/mele na/ stod mnga' ris yul skad de don du khu lu la go dgos/ mnga' ris ru thog khul gyi le na'am ra khul dkar po ni 'dzam gling na grags pa che cher khyab pa'i kasmir zhes pa de yin/ gang lags she na/ dus rabs bco brgyad dang bcu dgu tsam nas ru thog gi le na tshang ma kasmir brgyud yo rob la gtong gi yod pas yo rob pa tshos ra khul spus ma de kasmir nas thon par ngos 'dzin/ don dngos thog kasmir ni rong khul gtsang ma las 'brog las thon skyed gtong gi med par ma zad/ de khul gyi ra ni gzugs chung la mang che ba spu mdog nag po sha stag yin la/ ra khul spus tshad legs po med/ mnga' ris ru thog gi le na'am ra khul la khyad chos gsum tsam yod de/gcig nas khu lu'i spu tshang ma phra mthong che shel 'og la bzhag nas bltas tshe khog stong yin/des na ga tshod bed spyod btang yang 'byar thebs kyi med/ gnyis nas dus ci tsam ring kyang de tsam gyis 'od mdangs che ru 'gro gi yod/ gsum nas dmigs bsal gyi drod che la rlon gsher phog kyang lam seng skam gyi yod pa bcas so//307

༄7//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can dpal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i mtho lding gtsug lag khang /mtho lding dgon pa ni rtsa mda' rdzong grong sde'i lte ba glang chen gtsang po'i lho ngogs byang gi 'phred thig 31 48༷dang shar gi gzhung thig79 79༷tsam la gnas/ de rgya mtsho'i ngos las brtsis pa'i mtho tshad ni rmid sum stong bdun brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam yod/ dgon pa'i nye 'gram la grong khyim sum cu tsam dang grong mi brgya lhag tsam mchis/ zhing las thon skyed legs po yod par nas dang / gro/ pad kha/ tshal rigs sna tshogs bcas 'debs shing /thon 'bab kyang legs po yod/ phyugs las thon skyed ni 'bring tsam yod la/sgo phyugs ba mdzo dang ra lug rta sogs 'tsho skyong byed/ de ni shang khag dang dgon pa gzhan dag la 'gro sa'i lte gnas yin pas 'grul bzhud shin tu bde po yod/dgon pa de spyi lo 996lor lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis bzhengs/ stod mnga' ris sa khul gyi dgon pa snga shos dang skad grags che shos shig yin/de'i tha snyad skor la 〈beḍūr+ya ser po 〉las lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gaṇa ḍi nam mkhar 'phangs nas bdag gi gdul bya 'du sar bobs shig ces smos spar bdī spya~X mkhar mthon por lding zhing sa phyogs der babs sar gtsug lag

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /khang bzhengs pas mtho lding zhes 'bod pa la/ deng sang sgra 'chol te tho ling du grags kyang tho ling ni yul gyi kha skad dang yang mtho gling zhes 'bri srol 'dug pa mtho ni gong du brjod pa ltar gaṇa ḍi nam mkhar 'phangs pas mtho por lding zhes pa dang / gling ni sa cha der gling zhes shang rtse dang / chu mo ti/rong chung sogs kyi mi sde dgon pa chags sa'i sa der gling zhes 'bod do//gang lags she na/ sngar skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi rgyud lha bla ma ye shes 'od gnas der ma slebs gong la gling rje seng chen rgyal po'i bzhugs yul mkhar gong 'og bar gsum yod par grags so//sngar mtho lding dgon pa'i 'du khang ma bzhengs gong yul de'i bru sa'i gad rong gi ri mtho dman gsum 'brel gyi steng na mkhar gong 'og gsum yod par mkhar bar ma'i 'og tsam la lha khang dmar po zhig yod/ de'i nang gi rten gtso rtse lha nyi ma mgon zhes sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku chen thun mong min pa zhig bzhugs/ 'du khang bzhengs rjes rtse lha nyi ma mgon zhes pa'i sku de 'du khang gi gtsang khang nang du gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byas kyang de shin tu che bas las sla por gdan 'dren zhu ma thub pas byis pa'i kha ltas la blta dgos zhes byis pa yod do cog rub tu bskong nas rtsed mo rtse ru bcug par/ kho tshos 'dam bag gi sku bzos te cha lag bkrol nas sa thing thing zhig gi sgang du bskyal bas lha bzo ba tshos de la gzhigs nas lhu lag phral nas 'du khang nang du gdan 'dren zhus par grags/ mkhar gong ma'i gyang gog steng la dar lcog btsugs yod pa dang mkhar 'og ma'i phug pa'i nang la de sngon dpe cha mi nyung ba zhig yod skad/ dgon pa der lo chen rin chen bzang pos mkhan po mdzad cing khong gi 309

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhugs khri bcas yod/ spyi lo 1042lor lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha der gdan zhus pa ltar zhabs kyis bcags shing rgyud sde bzhi'i lha khang dang bcas 〈byang chub lam gyi sgron ma 〉brtsams te mtho lding dgon pa de mdo sngags zung 'brel 'chad nyan sgom sgrub 'dul ba stod rgyud dar zhing rgyas pa'i grags can lte gnas shig tu gyur/ gu ge'i rgyal po grags can rtse ldes bod dbus gtsang dang mdo smad yul nas mkhas pa mang dag gdan 'dren zhus nas bod kha ba can gyi lo rgyus thog grags pa che cher khyab pa'i me 'brug lo'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas bzung gsang sngags gsar ma'i lugs dar ba'i gnas khyad par can zhig tu gyur/dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang la ngag dab nga grags pa glang chen kha 'bab gtsang po'i byang phyogs dung dkar dga' gling khar 'khrungs nas cher longs te ri bo dge ldan gyi lugs dar zhing rgyas pa'i dbus gtsang yul du byon/rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs brtson che ba'i khar yun ring shar tsong kha pa chen por bsten nas dam pa'i chos kyi snying bcud 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang dang bcas 'jam mgon chos rgyal gyi slob ma grags can drug gi ya gyal du gyur/ de rting rang yul mnga' ris gu ge'i yul du phyir ldog gis dung dkar gyi phug nang sgom sgrub mdzad de yun ring bzhugs/phyis su dung dkar dgon pa'i dbu skyong gnang ba dang sbrags dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku bzhengs/ der slob ma mang dag la slob gnyer mdzad cing / 'bangs mi ser la gsung chos gnang bas kun spyod rnam par dag la/ legs bshad kyi dga' ston rab tu rgyas gshis grags pa je cher song nas gu ge'i yul la ri bo dge ldan gyi lugs spel mgo 310

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /brtsams/ des na gu ge rgyal po bkra shis 'od lde dang khri rnam rgyal 'od/shākya 'od sogs sngar sa skya dang 'bri gung par dad gus che yang de tshe ngag dbang grags par dad pa lhad med skyes nas ri bo dge ldan lugs la dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing mthar gu ge rgyal po rgyal mtshan bzang po'i skabs su rje ngag dbang grags pa mtho lding du gdan drangs nas der gsung chos bum pa gang byos mdzad rkyen gyis dgon pa de dang yul rgyal 'bangs tshang ma 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa'i lugs su gyur cing / ngag dbang grags pa mtho lding dgon pa dang gu ge rtsa rang mkhar gyi shar phyogs thang du chags pa'i blos btang dgon pa'i gdan sar bskos so//mtho lding dgon pa ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs su bsgyur rjes mkhan thog mi nyung ba zhig byung 'dug pa ni 〈beḍūr+ya ser po 〉las de nas bla rabs mang du song rjes gong du brjod pa ltar gu ge ngag dbang grags pa'i rjes su rim par/chos rje tshul khrims bshes gnyen/ rje legs grub pa/ kun spangs pa nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rje kun dga' dpal bzang / rje rin chen dpal bzang / pan cheṇa shin+ti pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon seng ge rgya mtsho/chos rje phyag rdor dpal bzang / chos rje bde legs dar/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje grags pa 'od zer/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi 'od/ 'di skabs paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan spyan drangs nas dam pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar phye/ phyir phebs khar mkhan po lha btsun blo bzang ye shes 'od de nyid kyis khri lo bcu gnyis tsam mdzad rjes mda' lngas rnam par bcings pa'i byed po la dwags seng ge rnam rgyal gyis mkhan po dang gu ge bdag po bkra shis grags pa bcas rang dbang dang 'phral 311

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/te gdan drangs/ kho pas gu ger dbang bsgyur/ de nas bskos pa dung dkar ba bshes gnyen bzang po/ gu ge bye dkar bzod pa rgyal mtshan/rtsa hrang pa sku skye blo bzang chos 'phel/ phyis skor gsum du rje bla ma'i chos srid gdugs dkar gyis khyab par nye ba nas la dwags bsod nams dpal grub/ byang rtse chos rje a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ da lta shar rtse khams spo 'bor ba blo bzang chos 'phel gyis skyong zhing grwa grangs dang mchod gzhis sogs rgyas par gsar du khong gis btsugs pa gsham du 'chad la/ smon lam lha sa ji lta ba/ gzhis dgon lugs slob gnyer grwa rgyun se 'bras dge gsum mnga' ris grwa tshang bcas par 'gro zhes gsal po 'khod pa mang che ba mnga' ris rang gi bla ma grags can sha stag yin tshod 'dugabod rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta lo'i (spyilo 1618)zla ba gsum pa'i mjug tsam la paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gtsang bkra shis lhun po nas rdog thon gyis zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum la mtsho rin po che ma pham g.yu mtsho dang gangs dkar ti sir zhabs kyis bcags nas 'bri gung pa'i rdor 'dzin dang sha la tsa gong du mjal te bka' mol lhug por gnang nas chos phyogs cho ga du ma spel rting mu mthud du byon par bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco gsum la gu ge'i lho stod spa'i lding zhes par zhabs drung chos rje (mtho lding mkhan po lha btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi 'od min nam snyam/)dang gu ge jo bo bdag po bkra shis grags pa lha sde mi sdes gtsos pa'i rta pa du mas sa gzhi khebs pa lta bur bsu ba rgya chen mdzad nas btang rag dang bcas tshes bco lnga dkar phyogs bzang bar mtho lding gser gyi lha khang gi lo chen rin chen bzang po'i bzhugs khrir dngos su gdan drangs te me tog gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba dang ser 312

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /tshogs spyi yongs la mang 'gyed mod mi dma' ba brgyab cing bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel byas pa sogs so// de rting chos grwar bzhugs nas gu ge khul gyi lha sde mi sde dang 'bangs mi ser dag la gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bskyed rdzogs dang / snar thang brgya rtsa/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/bka' gdams chos 'byung gi lung sogs pa bka' chos gzab rgyas gnang bar de mtho sa gu ge'i rgyal po dang dma' sa 'bangs mi dag gis ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs la dad pa tshad med skyes pa dang sbrags grub mtha' de gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs yongs su dar bar shugs rkyen chen po thebs so//dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang la rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pas khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan (spyi lo 1677—1751lo/ khong ni rwa sgreng dgon pa'i sprul sku'i sku thog dang po dang dga' ldan khri thog lnga bcu nga bzhi pa yin/) mngags gtong gis mkhan por bskos te se ra byes grwa tshang gi dgon lag tu bsgyur ro//dus de nas bzung mtho lding gi mkhan po dag se ra byes grwa tshang nas mngags gtong byed mgo btsugs/ khri chen dag se ra byes nas btang ba'i mkhan thog dang po de'o// mtho lding mkhan thog rim byon la dge bshes kyi go 'phang yod cing / mtshan snyan grags dang dbang thang mtshon pa'i gser gyi tog gcig kyang yod pa ni rgyal mchog sku phreng rim byon sku ngo mas gnang bar grags/mnga' ris la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma btang bar la mtho lding la mkhan thog lnga bcu nga bzhi byon zhing / mkhan thog mtha' ma'am sku phreng nga bzhi pa'i mtshan la khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis (dge bshes tshogs rams pa yin/)zhu/ khong lha sar phebs nas der 'das/bla brang mkhan po lo gsum re'i thog la brje thengs re byed/ mkhan po 313

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang mnyam du phyag mdzod sogs dpon g.yog 'khor khyon bsdoms nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam mngags gtong byed/ mtho lding mkhan po ma gzhi lo tshad gsum tsam sdod dgos kyang khag cig lo drug bdun bsdad mkhan yang yod/ lhag par du yong 'bab legs po yod na dus tshod ring tsam sdod thub pa byed kyi yod skad/ mtho lding dgon pa ni thag ring mtha' mtshams yin gshis mkhan po de rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon nam srid skyong gis se ra byes grwa tshang gi dge bshes mang po'i nang nas 'dems kyi yod/ thog ma grwa tshang gis dge bshes 'ga' shas shig gi ming tho yar rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon la phul te khong gis phyag dam su la bskyon pa de phebs dgos/ mkhan po'i las rogs phyag mdzod de grwa tshang tshogs 'du nas 'dems kyi yod kyang mkhan po rang dang 'brel 'dris legs shing yid rton bcol 'os pa zhig dgos/ de min las g.yog rigs tshang ma phyag mdzod kyis khams tshan so so'i nang nas gzugs khams kyi mthun rkyen legs shing gnyom chung skul bde 'dems kyi yod/dgon pa'i mkhan po ni rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon nam srid skyong gang yin gyis se ra byes grwa tshang nas dge bshes yon tan chen po zhig 'dems nas mngags gtong byed cing gser gyi tog kyang dmigs bsal can zhig gnang srol yod/ da dung grwa tshang gis grwa tshang gzhung gi snam bu ther srab bubs ma lnga ldan cha tshang ba sprod kyi yod/ mkhan po'i dam phrug ni dung dkar dmigs bsal can cig yod/ khong se ra byes pa grwa tshang gi rdo bkyag nas mtho lding dgon pa'i sgo ra'i nang bar rta la zhon nas thad kar yong chog pa'i dbang thang yod/ khong gi dbu la gser gyi tog dang gos gzan la gos chen dkar dmar ser sogs kyi phra btang ba zhig gyon zhing rta la dom bsgrogs nas rngam 314

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /brjid dod po'i ngang rta zam khag nas sgrig cha legs po byas te zla ba gcig tsam 'grul bzhud byas rting stod mnga' ris dgon sde grags can mtho gling la slebs pa byed do//mkhan po log yong dus 'byor phyag tu mnga' ris kham bu spus legs ser bol zhes pa do po gcig dang / kha gtags/ gser gyi tog khyer nas rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon sar bcar nas mtha' khul dgon sde dang lha sde mi sde bcas kyi skor zhib phra snyan seng zhu'o// de bzhin lo gsum ring gi dmigs bsal yong 'bab cha tshang se ra byes pa grwa tshang la rtsis rgyag dgos shing / grwa tshang nang la khams tshan ji tsam yod pa tshang mar 'gyed rgyag dgos/ dus mtshungs dbyar kha dang ston kha'i zla ba drug ring dge bskos byed du bcug ste tshogs chen la thug pa kyang gtong ba dang / ja skol ba/ gsol tshogs bzhengs pa bcas kyis stod mtho lding dgon par sdod ring byung ba'i dmigs bsal yong 'bab dag gtong sgo cha tshang ba gtong dgos/ des na dge bskos kyi ming de snyan po yin kyang gtong sgo tog trem gtong yas med na dka' las chen po yod cing / tha na khag cig gis gzhan nas g.yar po g.yar te gtong sgo gtong thub pa byed dgos so//mkhan po mang che bas lha ldan nas thon dus ja sogs phon chen khyer nas stod du slebs rting spus sgyur gyis tshong rgyag gi yod/ spyir btang byas na lha ldan nas bod zla gsum pa'i nang rdog thon byas te lho lam gyi rta zam sum cu lhag tsam brgyud zla ba gnyis dang phyed ka'am gsum tsam 'gor ba'i rjes su thog mar mda' par slebs/ de tshe mkhan po rnying pa'i sku tshab phyag mdzod dang / dbu mdzad/ dge bskos bcas nas zas rigs kyi phud dang kha 315

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btags khyer nas mda' pa rdzong gi mkhar thog bar phebs bsur bcar/der dakhyes ston btang nas gza' 'khor gcig tsam ngal gso byas rting mang nang brgyud mtho lding du byon/ mtho lding du mkhan po gsar rnying gnyis zla ba gnyis ring mnyam bzhugs kyis chos phyogs byed sgo spel ba dang ca dngos yod do rtsis len rtsis sprod byas rjes thugs spro gtong ba dang dge 'dun spyi dmangs la 'gyed rgyag pa sogs byed/ mkhan po rnying pa log phebs dus yang gsar pas mda' pa rdzong bar du skyel mar phebs pa dang mkhan po rnying pas dam phrug dngos su gsar par rtsis sprod byed/ de nyin nas bzung mkhan po gsar pa'i gser gyi tog dang rta yi dom sogs dngos su nus pa thon 'go tshugs so//mtho lding dgon pa'i mkhan po rim byung gis bod zla drug pa dang bdun pa'i nang la sgar bkra shis sgang dgon par tsha g.yol du phebs nas gsung chos gnang ba dang / grwa khrims sdom pa/ dbyar gnas cho ga'i dbu skyong gnang ba bcas byed do// mkhan po lo gsum sdod ring nyung thar thengs gcig tsam mtho lding dgon pa'i dgon lag nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa dag re re byas nas bskor ba de la mkhan po dbu skor zhes so// de tshe khong gis gsung chos gnang ba dang / mi ser la phyag dbang gnang ba/ dgon pa'i phyi nang rten gsum la brtag pa bcas byed/ mkhan thog mtha' ma ngag dbang bkra shis dang byang rtse'am shang rtser sdod mi rtsa rang mkhan po la 'thab rtsod drag po phog nas lha sar log phyin pa red/ khong gis rgyun du bla brang nang bzhugs nas phyag dpe gzigs te chos phyogs kyi bya ba sha stag sgrub pa las 'dzin skyong sogs la the jus byed pa nyung / dgon pa'i dpal 'byor sogs gtong yong skor la phyag mdzod nas thad kar 'gan 'khur byed/ dgon pa'i grwa ba tshos zhogs pa 316

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /zhal 'don byed cing / zhogs ja'i rjes su dbu mdzad kyis dpe cha slob/nyin gung chos rwa'i nang du rtags gsal rtsod/ dgong mo so so'i shag nang la dpe cha klog pa dang rgyun spyod byed sgo spel lo//dus rabs bcu dgu'i lo rabs bzhi bcu shar ma khad la sing pa'i dmag mtho gling la slebs nas dgon pa'i dkar rgya (gsog 'jog gam gra sgrig tu bsag pa'i 'bru rigs/) batren dbang gis bed spyod btang ba dang sgo rwa'i nang la rnga mong btags pa/ 'khar rnga 'dzam gling kun khyab ces li las bzos shing mtha' la rgya nag lcags ri bris ris yod la skad gsang 'brug sgra ldir 'dra de dang rnga rgyugs chen po sba las bzos pa bcas kyi gna' rdzas 'ga' shas 'khyer bar brjod do//dgon pa'i dus ston gtso bo ni smon lam chen po'am ser tshogs te bod zla dang po'i tshes gsum nas nyi shu gcig bar mtho lding du 'tshogs shing / de ni khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan skabs rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pas bca' yig gnang ste gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ smon lam skabs su mkhan po bzhugs khri'i sgang la bzhugs pa dang sngags rams pa gnyis yod cing /(gcig dus rgyun du sgar ba sgang dgon du sdod/) 'du khang nang tren dan gyi ka ba gnyis yod pa de gnyis gam du bzhugs khri re yod pa de'i sgang la sngags rams pa de gnyis bzhugs/ smon lam skabs dgon pa'i 'gro gron tshang ma rtsa rang dang mda' pa rdzong dpon gnyis nas gtong zhing / sde pa gzhung gi sku tshab stod sgar dpon nas kyang 'gyed shugs chen rgyag srol mchis so/bod zla gnyis pa'i nang gza' 'khor gcig ring dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga byed pa dang / bod zla gsum pa'i nang dpal rdo 317

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang cho ga byed cing / bskang gso gtong ngo // bod zla bzhi pa'am sa ga zla ba'i ring skung gnas nyin gsum tsam gtong gi yod par de tshe 'bangs mi ser dang dgon pa'i grwa ba tshang mas ngag bsdams nas bzhugs shing mkhan pos yon chab gnang rting gzhi nas ngag bcad glod kyi yod/bod zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bdun pa'i tshes sum cu bar la dbyar gnas 'tshogs nas grwa ba tshang ma dgon pa'i phyi la gang byung du 'gro mi chog cing /zho 'o sogs dkar zas longs su spyod par byed/ bod zla brgyad pa'i nang chab zhugs nyin gsum ring sho rgyag pa sogs dga' rtsed rol ba'i ston mor longs su spyod kyi yod/ bod zla dgu pa'i nang lha khang dkar po dang mchod rten khag cig la dkar rag gsol ba/ de bzhin 'bangs mi ser gyi sdod khang tshang mar yang dkar rag ces 'dam khu dkar po bshos ste lha 'bab dus chen gtong ba dang dpal lha'i gsol mchod rgyas po zhig 'bul ba/ bod zla bcu pa'i dga' ldan lnga mchod skabs dgong mo dgon pa'i phyi nang tshang mar mar me spar nas lung par nyi ma 'char ba ltar chags pa dang kun rigs kyi cho ga nyin grangs lnga tsam gtong / bod zla bcu gcig gi zla mjug la brgya sa'i (dkyil 'khor dbyibs can gyi lha khang thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod cing mtho lding dgon pa'i ar skrun nang nas snga shos de lags/) srung ma khang dang 'du khang shar lho'i phyogs kyi mgon khang nang gi gtor ma rnying pa yod do gsar par brje po rgyag pa dang 'du khang nang la tshogs tshugs nas sman bla'i cho ga cha tshang 'bul ḍiṅge//rgyal mchog bdun pa chen po skal bzang rgya mtshos gnang ba'i bka' bstan dang bca' yig nang la mtho gling gser tshogs skabs gral mgor 318

༄7//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /bzhugs mkhan gras su dang por dung dkar dgon pa'i bla ma (bla rabs dang po ngag dbang grags pa yin pas so/)dang de nas mda' pa'i bla ma/ de nas chu gser bla ma (khong lho smad yul tsho bdun gyi spyi yongs dbu bla yin/)bcas so//ka ba sum cu so drug yod pa'i 'du khang nang la ma 'dzul gong sgo rwa chen po zhig yod par lho byang gnyis la sgo re 'dug lho sgo'i phyi la sgo rwa chung chung zhig yod pa der grwa shag dang rung khang sogs yod/ sgo rwa'i lho sgo 'am byang sgo gang rung nas yar 'dzul rjes de'i dbus tsam la yul lha'i pho brang yin zhes lcog chung chung zhig dang de'i 'khris la dar lcog sna tshogs kyis bsgrogs pa'i lcang sdong rnying gog cig yod/ sgo rwa'i nang la gnas gtso che ba gnyis yod par kha nub la blta ba'i 'du khang dang kha byang la blta ba'i mgon khang yod/'du khang gi sgo mchor nang la srid pa 'khor lo dang / lha mo mchod pa/ rnam bcu dbang ldan/ kun bzang 'khor lo/ sdom brtson dam pa/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi bcas kyi bris ris gsar rnying mang po 'dres nas 'dug gzhung sgo'i steng la yul lha rnam gsum rta ngang dkar la bcibs shing mda' shubs legs po rta'i ze yi khu thug la bsgrogs pa'i bris ris yod pa/ gu ge khul gyi dgon pa spyi dang 'dra mtshungs yin pa lags/'du khang gi gzhung sgo nas yar 'dzul rjes kha byang la phyogs pa'i lho ngos gyang ldebs la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang kha lho la phyogs pa'i byang ngos gyang ldebs la rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor sogs mchis/ kha shar la phyogs pa'i nub ngos gtsang khang sgo'i g.yas phyogs gyang ldebs la lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / khong gi sras gnyis/ tsha bo byang chub 'od dang zhi ba 'od sogs kyi ldebs ris dang gtsang khang sgo'i g.yon phyogs gyang ldebs la rje yab 319

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ sras gsum kyi ldebs ris bcas 'dug 'du khang nang la lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i zhabs rjes gsal ba'i rdo zhig yod/ 'du khang nang gi gtsang khang la 'dzul sa'i sgo'i g.yon ngos kyi kha shar la phyogs pa'i nub ngos gyang ldebs la 'di ltar bris nas 'dug ste/ khyams chen g.yas kyi phugs su lha bla ma/ ye shes 'od la shradha lo chen dang / de ba na ga pra bha sras mchog gnyis/byang chub 'od dang zhi ba 'od kyis bskor/ g.yas phyogs su dang po'o//sangs rgyas gtor lugs ma tog chos dbyings zhes so// gtsang khang nang lho nub byang sogs kyi ldebs la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis cha tshang ba bris 'dug pa shin tu mtshar ro// mtho gling dgon pa'i nang la mda' pa bla ma'i bzhugs khri legs po zhig yod pa ni smon lam dang dus rgyun du don chen ci rigs mchis skabs 'dir phebs dus bzhugs sa yin/'du khang nang gi rten gtso bo ni gser zangs las bskrun pa'i 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang / da lta'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ ma 'ong pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa bcas thog tshad ma sha stag mchis/ dbus kyi ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku'i gzungs gzhug tu thog ma dgon pa de bzhengs sa'i gnas 'tshol dus lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gnam la 'phangs pa'i dbyug pa'am daṇ+ḍi de mchod yod pas de'i ming gzhan la thub dbang daṇ+ḍi ma'ang brjod do// de bzhin 'du khang de'i rten gyi gras su gser zangs las bskrun pa'i rje yab sras gsum dang sang mda'i jo bo'i sku dbu la ba so'i rigs lnga mchod pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku/ li ma las bskrun pa'i bka' brgyud dbu bla rje btsun mi la ras chen dang / li ma las bskrun pa'i gu ru'i sku/ dzhai k+shim las bskrun pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku bcas skye bo dar 320

༄za//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /ma'i gzugs tshad sha stag yod/deng sang gtsang khang ka ba drug can de'i nang gi rten gtso sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i 'jim sku de srid jus don 'khyol skabs gsum dkyil pa'i lha bzo mkhas can sku zhabs 'od zer lags kyis gsar du bzhengs shing / dad ldan mi ser dag gis phul ba'i rin chen phra tshom sogs sna mang gis brgyan pa de'o// sngar der gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku rnying pa rtse lha nyi ma mgon zhes stod mnga' ris skor gsum na yongs su grags pa de ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’ skabs la bud med sngon thon khag cig gis rtsa brlags btang / de gtor skabs gzungs gzhug tu phung po ya mtshan can zhig thon yod par rgad po dbu skra ring po skya chol yod cing / zhabs rdo rje dkyil dkrung du bzhugs pa/ tshems so 'bu ras dmar ser la sgril nas pang khar bzhes pa/ spyan dong tsam chags nas mar dim pa/ zhal ras dmar mdangs can gson nyams ldan pa/phyag mthil gnam la bstan nas gcig thog la gcig 'jog pa/ da lta 'das ma khad kyi sku phung ltar zhig thon pa skabs der bud med de rnams tshang mas 'then shar brgyab cing / khag cig gis rdog rgyag gzhus pa dang /khag cig gis dbu la rdog brdzis gtong gin du 'du khang phyi la bton te lha 'bab mchod rten bar drud 'then byas nas der bskyur rting yun ring lus skad do// sku de'i mtshan la gzhigs na phung po de skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi phung po min nam sems/ brjod srol la gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i sku thog tshad ma de thog ma mkhar bar ma'i 'og ri ldebs lha khang de'i rten gtso yin skad/ rjes su lha bla ye shes 'od kyis mtho lding dgon pa bzhengs rjes 'du 321

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khang gi gtsang khang nang du gdan 'dren zhus zhes so//'du khang yod sa'i sgo rwa chen po'i lho phyogs su mgon khang chung chung zhig yod/ de'i nang gi rten gtso sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi dang shugs ldan gyi sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad tsam zhig mchis/deng shwa ba'i rwa co sogs khyad nor dag kyang de'i nang la mchod cing dge lugs pa'i lugs kyi srung ma dpal ldan lha mo sogs gzhan dag kyang 'ga' shas yod do//lha khang dkar po/ 'du khang gi byang phyogs la yod cing yangs shing rgya che ba ka ba bzhi bcu zhe gnyis mchis so// de'i gzhung sgo lho la bstan zhing /rgyab byang phyogs glang chen gtsang por gtad/ gzhung sgo nas 'dzul ma thag kha byang la phyogs pa'i lho ngos gyang ldebs la rnam snang 'khor tshogs kyi ldebs ris yod/ kha shar la phyogs pa'i nub ngos gyang ldebs la rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'od dpag med/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab bcas kyi ldebs bris 'dug kha nub la phyogs pa'i shar ngos gyang ldebs la lo chen rin bzang dang / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ lha mo sna tshogs bcas dang / kha byang la phyogs pa'i lho ngos gzhung sgo'i g.yon ngos gyang ldebs la rnam thos sras kyi 'khor tshogs bcas bris yod/ lha khang gi sbug la jo bo shākya thub pa'i sman 'dam 'jim sku zhig yod do//gser khang / gser khang zhes pa thog brtsegs gsum can gyi khang mig so so'i nang gi ldebs ris thams cad gser bris yin pa spyi dang yang sgos dbu rtser gser zangs kyi bya skyibs yod pas nyi ma 'char ma khad la dgon pa yongs la gser 'od chem chem 'phro bzhin yod pas ming de ltar byung ngo //322

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /thog so dang po ka ba bzhi yod pa de'i nang la lo tsā ba'i bzhugs khri dang dbus su dkyil 'khor bcas dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan la/ lo chen gyi dbyar kha'i bzhugs sa yin/ da dung 'jim sku brgyad trem byung ba'i shul mthong rgyu 'dug de'i ldebs ris logs la pho brang btsun pa byang chub 'od ces deng sang yang gsal po mthong rgyu yod/ gser khang de'i dbu rtser lo chen rin bzang dbyar kha'i bzhugs yul dang tshon mdog dkar po yin zhing / de'i nang la bya rgyud rigs gsum lha tshogs kyi ldebs ris dang / thog so gnyis pa'i gyang ldebs la gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor thun mong min pa gser chus bris yod pa ngo mtshar shin tu che'o// dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang rgyal mchog lnga ba chen pos lha ldan gyi gtsug lag khang bar khyams la zhig gso byed dus de'i gyang ldebs na ldebs ris rmad du byung ba zhig dgos nges su bod yongs kyi dgon pa mang por brtag rting mtha' ma mtho lding dgon pa'i gser khang thog so gnyis pa'i ldebs ris la dpe byas te dkyil 'khor ldebs ris phul du byung ba de dag byung ngo // mchod khang de'i phyi'i tshon mdog dmar po yin zhing / lo chen rin chen bzang po'i dpyid ka dang ston kha'i bzhugs gnas so// gsham 'og thog so dang po ni tshos gzhi ser po yin par dgun kha'i bzhugs gnas yin/ gser khang de ‘‘rig gnas gsar rje'i ’’skabs la rtsa gtor song ba dang deng sang thog so gcig ldan stabs bde zhig bzhengs yod/jo bo rje'i lha khang / de ni gser khang gi mdun ngos sam shar ngos la mchis shing / jo bo rje dpa' ldan a ti sha mtho gling la lo gsum tsam bzhugs ring gsung chos gnang sa dang gzims khang yin/323

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brgya sa lha khang / de ni 'du khang gi nub phyogs su gnas shing ming gzhan la mtho gling gtsug lag khang yang brjod/ sngar ma gtor gong la sgo mchor gyi g.yas g.yon na thog tshad ma'i rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i sman 'dam 'jim sku shin tu mtshar ba yod/ gzhung sgo nas 'dzul ma khad mdun dbus su bdud 'dul bslangs yod cing / rten gtso bdud 'dul thub pa thog tshad ma mchis/ de'i rgyab sprod du rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor dbyibs ldan shar lho nub byang kun tu lha khang chung ngu re yod/ de'i phyi la nang skor lam dang nang skor phyi phyogs su lha khang bco brgyad tsam yod pa ni/1 'jigs byed lha khang / rten gtso 'jigs byed/ 2 a tsa ra'i lha khang / de'i nang la a tsa ra'i 'cham gos gsol nas yod/ 2 bkra shis 'od kyi lha khang / rten gtso gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i sku skye bo dar ma'i sku tshad tsam drug bzhugs/ 4 sman lha lha khang / rten gtso sman lha bde gshegs brgyad kyi sman 'dam 'jim sku thog tshad ma/ 5 thugs rje lha khang /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dzhai k+shim las bzos pa'i ker bzhengs thog tshad ma/ de bzhin da dung dzhai k+shim las sgrub pa'i byams pa chos 'khor byis pa lo brgyad kyi gzugs tshad can dang / shar li/ nub li bcas kyis bzhengs pa'i thub dbang sogs kyi sku brgya dang sum cu lhag trem yod/ 6 sgrol ma lha khang / rten gtso li las bzhengs pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo skyes pa dar ma zhig gi gzugs tshad tsam zhig dang sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sku li ma las bskrun pa khru do ldan ma sha stag yod/ 7 rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha khang / rten gtso rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ldan pa'o// ṭ+wāṃ srung ma lha khang / rten gtso sman 'dam las bskrun pa'i rdo rje 324

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /'jigs byed sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma/ gser zangs las bskrun pa'i chos rgyal yab yum dang rdo rje chen mo'i sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma bcas yod/ lha khang de'i rgyab na se ba'i shing sdong mtshar du dngar ba gsum yod pa ni srib skyes bu mo spun gsum gyis phyag 'khar btsugs pa las skyes skad/de yang srib skyes bu mo spun gsum nang nas gnyis lam bar nas phyir log byas te der slebs ma thub kyang bu mo mtha' chung des dka' ba du ma spyad nas gcen mo gnyis kyi phyag 'khar bsnams te der slebs pa dang phyag 'khar gsum btsugs te rang sar thim/ de nas khong gu ge'i yul gyi srung ma rdo rje chen mo'i sprul bar 'dzin pa dang se ba'i shing sdong gsum po de rdo rje chen mo'i bla shing la bzung nas dad gus tshad med byed kyi yod/ kha byams pa lha khang /rten gtso sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i 'jim sku ker bzhengs thog tshad ma/ 10 phyag rdor lha khang / rten gtso gser zangs las bskrun pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma/ 11 yum lha khang / rten gtso sman 'dam las bskrun pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i 'jim sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma/ 12 byams pa ngal gso'i lha khang / rten gtso sman 'dam las bskrun pa'i rgyal ba byams pa ngal gso'i tshul du khri sgang na bzhugs pa'i 'jim sku'o// 12 rje lha khang / rten gutso gser zangs las bskrun pa'i rje tsong kha ba chen po yab sras gsum gyi sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma/ 14 tshe dpag lha khang / rten gtso sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sman 'dam 'jim sku skyes pa dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma/15 bka' 'gyur lha khang / rten gtso 〈bka' 'gyur 〉gser bris ma cha tshang gcig dang glegs shing yod do cog lha sku'i brkos dkrol sgyu rtsal thun mong 325

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma yin pa sha stag yin/ 16 bstan 'gyur lha khang / rten gtso 〈bstan 'gyur 〉gser bris ma cha tshang dang glegs shing brkos dkrol can rnying pa sha stag yod/ 17 'jam dbyangs lha khang / rten gtso bo 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi 'jim sku skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad tsam/ de min li ma'i sangs rgyas sku mtho gang ma brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam yod/brgya sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun du gsung chos rwa ba'am 'cham 'khrab sa'i tshoms chen yod pa der smon lam chen mo'i skabs 'cham rgyag gi yod/de'i byang phyogs na lo chen rin bzang dang jo bo rje a ti sha'i gsung chos gnang sa'i bzhugs khri mtho sang can zhig dang de'i rgyab ngos gyang logs su dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i rjes su bzhengs pa'i dge lugs mdzad po rje yab sras gsum gyi ldebs ris yod/ de'i lho phyogs su ma ṇi lha khang yod cing de'i nang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags ma ṇi dung phyur bzhugs pa'i ma ṇi 'khor lo zangs kyis btums par rag shan brgyab pa thog tshad gnyis ldan ma yod/ de'i shar phyogs su gdung rten ring mo zhes mchod rten thog tshad lnga ldan ma rngam brjid dod po zhig mchis/ mchod rten de'i shar tsam du gnas bcu lha khang yod/ lha khang de'i rten gtso ni sman 'dam las bzhongs pa'i 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug skye bo dar ma'i gzugs tshad ma'i 'jim sku yod/ gnas bcu lha khang gi byang phyogs la mkhan po'i bzhugs gnas bla brang thog so bzhi ldan ma zhig yod/ de'i thog so bzhi par mchis pa'i mgon khang gi rten gtso sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang / mgon po phyag drug chos rgyal/ dpal ldan lha mo bcas kyi 'jim sku tshang ma drag po'i tshul du bzhugs/326

༄za//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /mtho lding dgon pa'i grub cha gzhan dag grwa tshang dang gnyer tshang /grwa grangs brgya dang nyi shu'i sdod gnas grwa shag mang dag yod/ dgon pa'i phyi'i lcags ri rgya che zhing shar lho nub byang sogs phyogs bzhi la sgo bzhi yod/mtho lding la deng sang 'du khang dang lha khang dkar po gnyis rnying pa rang 'jags yin pa ni ‘‘rig gsar ’ skabs la 'bru rigs blugs sa byas pas ma gtor tsam byung / de min dkyil 'khor dbyibs can gyi brgya sa/(lha khang mang po yod pa'i don/) lha khang dang gser khang / jo bo rje'i lha khang bcas zhig gso byas pas nang rten med cing phyi'i gyang ni gsar rkyang yin/ srib skyes bu mo spun gsum gyis bsnams phebs pa'i se ba'i 'khar rgyug gsum gyi se shing sdong po gsum po de ni mtho gling dgon pa'i brgya sa'i lho nub ngos srung ma khang gi rgyab phyogs su yod pa ni dgon pa'i mdzes rgyan lta bu lags so//srung ma khang nang la srung ma dpal ldan lha mo dang / bstan srung rdo rje chen mo/ rgyal po sku lnga'i 'jim sku/ rdo rje chen mo'i mkhar dbyibs/mgon po bcas yod par bstan srung bskang gso tshes bzang la gtong gi yod/de'i nang la zhwa nag sogs kyi 'cham 'bag bcu drug yod cing / 'cham chas spus legs rnying ma cha tshang yod/ srung ma rdo rje chen mo dang / lha mo dmag zor ma/ chos rgyal/ mgon po/ shugs ldan gyi 'khor a tsa ra bzhi/lcam sring gnyis/(dmar po dang sngon po/) mgon po'i 'khor/(sngon po gnyis/)khyi ṭa pa la dang ma ṭa bkur/(g.yas la rwa co yod pa gnyis/) shwa ba pho mo gnyis/g.yag gnyis/(shwa ba re dang g.yag re bsres nas 'khrab/) gling rje seng chen rgyal po/(zhal 'bag sprug nag) lhalcama'abrug mo/(zhal 'bag ngang dkar/) pho rgad po spu sud/(ra lpags kyi zhal 'bag) a tsa ra seng ge (lus dkar po ge 327

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sar gyi chibs pa/) bcas smon lam skabs la 'cham gzhung cha tshang ba 'khrab kyi yod/ 'cham 'go btsugs dus dang mjug sgril dus gling seng chen rgyal po dang lha lcam 'brug mo thon nas mchod sgron cho ga rgyas po byed kyi yod/smon lam chen po'i skabs tshes bcu bdun nas nyin gsum tsam ring 'cham rgyag gi yod par de dus 'cham chas cha tshang srung ma khang nas 'don no//tshes bco lngar byams pa gdan 'dren zhes phyogs bzhir 'khrus gsol byed dus/ seng chen rgyal po 'khrab mkhan de skya bo mi nag gi chas gos mchod yod de/ dbu la 'phying zhwa gsol cing phyag g.yon la zangs kyi bum pa dang phyag g.yas la lcags kyi ja dkrug bsnams nas mchod sgron lan gsum byed do//lus la na bza' spu phrug dmar rkyang dang zhabs la lham nag tshos gzhi dmar rkyang gsol zhing / gangs seng dkar mo dung ltar dkar bar bcibs/ lha lcam 'brug mos bod chas phyu pa phu med dang pang gdan lho ston pa gyon/ zhwa 'bog la be rag sgron/ mgo ras dmar po kha dkris hril nas yod/ rgyab slog tshab la kha dkris spu smug po zhig yod/ rna g.yu shin tu legs po zhig btags/ brang steng la ga'u zur drug zhig btags shing ltag tshar gcig las med/ 'khrab mkhan de bu zhig yin/ 'brug mo'i phyag la khug ma zhig khyer nas dngul bsdu bzhin 'gro/ 'brug mos gos sku bkram dus seng chen rgyal po dang mnyam la phyin/ rgad po spu sud kyis ra lpags dkar po'i zhal 'bag gyon zhing / lus ra slog phyi nang slog pa zhig gyon/ des seng chen rgyal po dang 'brug mo'i phru gu pang la khyer nas kho gnyis kyi gsham tsam la byon/de'i rjes su a tsa ra bzhi yod pa gnyis kyis zhal 'bag sngon po dang gnyis kyis zhal 'bag gser pa gyon yod/ kho tshos khrom la 'khrab kyin skor ba 328

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /brgyab nas 'gro'o// de nas rgad po spu sud des lug sha khog la zhon nas khrom la skor ba rgyag de tshe khos phru gu sa steng la 'jog gi yod/ tshur 'khor ba dang sha khog rgyag 'ben la btsugs te bod mda' zhig rgyag pa'i 'gran rtsed dang bcas mjug sgril lo// sngar dgon pa de'i nang la gling seng chen rgyal po rgyal po'i khrab dang / rmog mda'/ gzhu/ rta sga/ phyu pa bcas cha tshang bsdad yod skad/sngar mtho gling dgon pa'i gsang rgya dam pa'i nang nor rin thang bral ba'i gras su 'brong ka la pa'i rwa co dang / bya khyung rgod po'i mchu to/ mtsho lug ma mo gro bo yi sug rtse/ seng chen rgyal po'i rta yi smad khrag srin po'i brang lpags/ ye shes 'od kyi dbu thod dam ka li/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i phyag dpe/ khong gi ga'u yi nang la blugs yas gser skur ba so'i rigs lnga'i cod pan gsol ba/ thub dbang sku/ rta mgrin phur pa/ gnam lcags rdo rje phur pa/ mang nang dgon pa nas gdan drangs pa'i shel gyi byang chub mchod rten khru gang ma/ spang stod shwa ba smug chung gi rwa bcu/(deng sang bsdad yod/) sang dar jo ba'i ba so'i cod pan/(deng bsdad yod/)gser shog can gyi dung dkar g.yas 'khyil spus legs shig yod pa des se ra 'gog pa dang char chu 'bebs thub kyi yod skad/(deng yang dung dkar zhig yod pa de yin brjod kyang gser gshog ni med/)chu shel sogs sku mang po yod/ de tsho tshang ma nam rgyun g.yang sgam nang la blug nas sgo lcags rgyag pa dang la cha'i thel rtse sgron pa dang mkhan po'i dam phrug brgyab nas gsang khung nang la bcug nas 'jogabod zla dang po'i smon lam skabs su mkhan po sku ngo mas kha phye ste rtsa rang rdzong dpon dang mda' pa chos rgyal mkhar rtse rgyal po lho smad yul tsho bdun gyi bla ma 329

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas la spyan 'bul zhus rting rang sor sgam nang la bcug te bsdus kyi yod/de min da dung lha lcam 'brug mo'i thag khri bzhi yod pa lo rer sgrig cha byas shing snel ma rkang re bcug ste btags kyi yod/mtho gling dgon pa'i nye 'khor la mchod rten du ma zhig mchis par mang dag zhig gi bum pa'i nang la ldebs ris yod skad/ dper na phyi yi ru gnon bzhi ste shar gyi pad ma mchod rten nam rtse brgyad mchod rten ni zangs las bzhengs shing zhing pa'i 'bru dang lo legs yag po yong ba'i rten 'brel lags/lho mchod rten khra bo/ nub kyi mchod rten ni chus 'khyer zin nas bsdad med/byang lha 'bab mchod rten (zer srol la de'i gzungs gzhug la chu shel las skrun pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku sa gnam gang la'ang khru gang gis ma thug pa zhig yod pa de skal ba sngon ma'i mar me ma shi ba dang skal ba phyi ma'i yon chab ma skam bar du gnas thub kyiyod skad/) de rin chen sna tshogs kyis btums nas 'dag zhal btang yod pas kha ba che chung ci tsam babs kyang lam seng zhu gi yod cing / tshes bzang dus bzang la ring bsrel sgrug rgyu yod skad do// gzhan yang bar gyi ru gnon bzhi/ nang gi ru gnon bzhi bcas khyon bsdoms bcu gnyis yod/ brgya sa lha khang steng la'ang mchod rten bzhi/ 'cham rgyag sar byang chub mchod rten yin pas de'i dbyibs ni dril bu kha sbubs la bzhag pa nang bzhin yod/dgon pa'i nub phyogs su tsha tsha'i mchod rten che chung sna tshogs pa brgya dang brgyad star gral du yod pa ni glang chen gtsang po'i kha gnon yin/ de dag gi gzungs gzhug tu lo chen rin bzang po'i phyag phreng rdog bu re bzhugs shing deng sang mang che ba chus 'khyer zin nas bsdad mi 'dugamatho gling mkhan po'am khong gi sku tshab kyis lo gcig nang nyung thar yang 330

༄༅//gu ge khul gyi dgon sde grags can mtho lding gtsug lag khang /dgon lag nyi shu rtsa lngar thengs gcig bcar nas sku 'dra dang mchod rdzas sogs cha tshang bsdad yod med zhib bsher nan tan byed dgos/ khong sku dngos su phebs thub sar mi ser la gsung chos dang phyag dbang gnang ba/las ka bkod sgrig byed pa bcas so// mtho lding dgon chen gyi 'og tu dgon lag nyi shu rtsa lnga yod par de dag la brjod srol mi 'dra ba 'dug par khag cig gis mda' pa bkra shis lhun po dang / ma nam byang chub gling / gser ti dam chos gling / rtsa hrang klu steng dgon/ bye dkar rnam rgyal rtse/ shang rtse rab brtan byams pa gling / ri dgon byang chub gling / snub bkra shis chos gling / lugs brag steng / (yang snu drag thong brjod/) mngon dga'/gdong po rab brtan lhun grub/ gzhal yas bkra shis chos gling / shangs dga' ldan rab rgyas gling / khyung lung dga' ldan lha btsan/ (lhun rtse/)dung dkar bkra shis chos gling / rdo gsham mu mkhar chos rdzong / ri ba bkra shis dga' 'phel/ lho (klu/) steng thub dbang mtho lding / za rang sgrol ma sgang 'og ri ti sgang bkra shis chos gling / chu ze dbu rtse mkhar bcas yin zer/mtho lding dgon lag nyer lnga re re bzhin grwa rgyun brtsis nas 'chad na/ru thog lhun grub chos sdings dgon/ dang thog dgon sde de nas grwa rgyun gcig bsdus pa dang rjes sor grwa rgyun spus tshad legs par bzung nas grwa rgyun gnyis la gtan 'bebs byas so// mda' pa bkra shis lhun po nas grwa rgyun gnyis/ gdong po rab brtan lhun po'am gdong po ri dmar dgon nas grwa rgyun gnyis/ khyung dga' ldan lhun rtse dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig ma nam byang chub gling dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig be bkra shis chos gling dgon nas 331

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grwa rgyun gcig dung dkar bkra shis chos gling dgon nas grwa rgyun gcigado shangs dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig ri bkra shis dga' dpal dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig bye dkar rnam rgyal lha rtse dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig za rang dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig steng mthong ba don ldan dgon nas grwa rgyun gcigasnub dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig lugs brag gdong mngon dga' dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig phur ri dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig rong byang chub gling dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig bar kyog phun tshogs rab brtan gling dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig shang rtse dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig shangs dgon pa nas grwa rgyun gcig mtho lding gser gyi lha khang nas grwa rgyun gcig bcas dang da dung da lta phyi rgyal la dgon pa lnga yod pa ste/ skyi nor bu dga' 'phel dgon nas grwa rgyun gnyis dang / lha lung dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig brang dkar dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig rta po theg chen chos gling dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig ma ṇi dgon nas grwa rgyun gcig rang rgyal du yod pa'i dgon sde nyi shu dang da lta phyi rgyal la yod pa'i dgon sde lnga bcas khyon bsdoms mtho lding dgon lag nyer lnga zhes yongs su grags/ grwa rgyun bsdu stangs ni cha rkyen gsum ldan dgos pa ste gcig nas dgon lag nyer lnga'i mnga' khongs kyi mi ser khrod nas bsdu ba las phyogs gzhan nas bsdu mi chog pa dang / gnyis nas sdud bya'i grwa pa spus tshad legs po zhig ldan dgos/ gsum nas khyim de'i bu bar ba de grwa par 'gro dgos pa bcas so//332

༄khya//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi dgon sde grags can 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/dgon pa de spu hreng rdzong 'khor chags shang 'khor chags grong tsho'i khongs zher mgar tshang gling du grags pa'i gnas te byang gi 'phred thig 30 19༷dang / shar gyi gzhung thig 81 26༷tsam la gnas shing rgya mtsho'i ngos las brtsis pa'i mtho tshad ni rmid sum stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam yod/ spu hreng rdzong grong sde'i lte ba skyid thang gi shar phyogs spyi le bco lnga tsam na gnas/spyir dgon pa'i khor ra 'khor yug tu chags pa'i yul tsho der chu bed shin tu legs gshis zhing las thon skyed shugs chen yod par nas dang / gro/pad kha bcas 'bru rigs sna tshogs dang tshal rigs zhog khog dang la phugapad tshal bcas 'debs shing phyugs las thon skyed phran zhan tsam yod par sgo phyugs ra lug dang rta g.yag ba glang mdzo mo sogs yod/ grong tsho der grong khyim sum bcu lhag tsam dang grong mi brgya lhag tsam yod/dgon pa de'i tha snyad la 'bri tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' shas yod par kha char dang / kha 'char/ 'khor chags bcas so// kha char zhes pa'i don gsal po med kyang 'khor chags zhes pa ni dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mjug tu spu rang rgyal po lha ldes zher nas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dngul sku rdepyi po

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ker bzhengs ma zhig shing rta 'khor lo'i steng du bzhag nas rgyal po'i bzhugs gnas dkar dung du gdan 'dren zhu skabs gnas de'i rdo chen a mo li ka zhes pa'i gnas rdo khyad 'phags can zhig mchis pa der 'thogs nas yar 'gro ma thub pas 'jam dpal dngul skus gsung byon nas nga 'khor yang 'dir 'khor chags kyang 'dir chags zhes pas 'khor chags zhes pa'i ming de ltar byung skad do// des na rgyal pos der lha khang chung chung zhig bzhengs nas dngul sku de'i rten du bzhag par lha khang de ni dgon pa de'i jo khang nang gi gtsang khang dang dngul sku rin po che ni de'i nang gi rten gtso de'o// phyis su spu rang rgyal po rim byon gyis dgon pa rgya skyed btang nas 'du khang dang mgon khang sogs bzhengs pas dgon pa'i ming la'ang ‘‘'khor chags ’ zhes byung zhing spu rang khul gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon sde snga shos de'o//dgon pa de'i grub mtha' sa skya ngor pa yin cing lo rgyus thog la grwa ba brgya lhag tsam byung myong yod kyang rjes su rim gyis nyung du phyin nas bcings bkrol ma btang tsam la sprul sku gcig dang grwa grangs nyi shu rtsa drug tsam yod/'khor chags dgon pa sa skya ngor dgon lag tu bsgyur rjes su bla rabs mang dag cig byung yod par bla ma sku phreng dang po 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin dbang po/ gnyis pa dam pa rin po che/ gsum pa tshe dbang rnam rgyal bcas yin no// dgon pa'i ar skrun gyi grub char mtshon na khang mig bzhi bcu lhag tsam yod cing lhag don du jo khang /(jo bo dngul sku mched gsum gyi bzhugs yul lho phyogs la yod/) la ka ba bcu dang lha khang chen por (byang phyogs su mchis shing dkyil 'khor dbyibs can zhig lags/) ka ba bzhi bcu tsam byung myong yod/‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’skabs la gtor skyon tshabs chen byung yod kyang 334

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/spyi lo 1982lo nas bzung srid jus don 'khyol gzhir bzhag gis khyon yongs nas nyams gso legs par byas so//'khor chags dgon pa ni dus rabs bcu gcig nang skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi tsha bo lha lde'i skabs bzhengs pa ni 〈lo chen gyi rnam thar 'bring po 〉las/ bla chen po lha lde'i dbu'i mchod gnas dang rdo rje'i slob dpon mdzad nas/ dgon nas pu rangs kyi gnas zhi phul nas gnas zhi dang dkon mchog gi zhabs tog mdzad pa'i lugs la pu rangs kyi zher nas ho su lang ka'i bar du gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa bzhengs pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad do// bla chen lha ye shes 'od ldes kho char gyi gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs su gsol ba zhes pa dang 〈mnga' ris rgyal rabs 〉las/ gzhan yang pu hrangs su kha char yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du byams pa'i sku bzhengs zhes shing yang 〈pu rang 'khor chags dgon gyi rten gtso jo bo dngul sku mched gsum gyi sngon byung gtam rabs brjod pa baiḍūr ya sngon po'i pi wam 〉(gsham nas dngul sku mched gsum zhes 'bri rgyu/)las lha mnga' bdag rgyal pos rten de nyid rang gi ri khrod dkar dung gi gtsug lag khang chen por spyan drangs pas sa rdo dang rtsi shing nags tshal gang la'ang thogs pa med par thal ler byon bzhin pa la bye ma'i thang dkyil gyi rdo a mo li ka de la 'thogs pa dang lhan cig rten 'di nyid kyi zhal nas nga 'dir 'khor zhing / 'dir chags so zhes gsung byon pas mnga' bdag rgyal po de rgyun par bzhad gad gtan nas mi thon pas mtshan yang lha nag po 'dzum med zhu ba la/ de'i nyin rten gyis gsung byon pa dang / mnga' bdag bzhad shor ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs pas sa cha 'di la yang 'khor chags zhes pa'i ming de dus thogs/ der gtsug lag khang yid 335

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhin lhun grub ces bya ba bzo khyad sna tshogs dang ldan pa 'di gsar du bzhengs shing / rdo chen a mo li ka 'di yi steng du jo bo bzhugs su gsol ba lags so zhes pa dag las dgon pa de ga dus bzhengs min dang ga par bzhengs pa sogs kyi lo rgyus kha gsal po zhe drags 'khod yod do//des na dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang gtsang khang nang gi rten gtso 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dngul sku chen po de spu rang rgyal po lha sde'i skabs la lugs brgyab nas bzhengs pa dang de'i gzhogs g.yas g.yon gyi spyan ras gzigs dang phyag na rdo rje gnyis spu rang rgyal po gnam mgon sde dang khong gi lha lcam jo 'bum rgyal mo gnyis kyi skabs su bzhengs yod pa ni dngul sku mched gsum las bzo bo bi shwa karma'i rnam sprul lha bzo mkhas pa 'ga' zhig yod pa dang rten 'brel 'grigs te/ mnga' bdag 'khor re dang lha sde yab sras kyis bzhengs pa'i jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i g.yas su rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa'i rang gzugs gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gnyis dbus su sku gtso bo dang /sku tshad mnyam par dngul gar blug gis bzhengs zhes pa ni dngul sku mched kyi lo rgyus rags bsdus lags/phyis su spu rang gi rgyal po rim byon te chos rgyal gnam mgon lde/ khri bkra shis dngos grub mgon/ khri bkra shis rgyal po sde sogs kyi skabs su dgon par nyams gso byas shing rgya skyed btang nas rten sku gsung kyang du ma bzhengs so// rgyal po khri bkra shis stobs btsan sde yis bkra shis brtsegs pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ de la sras gsum byung bas chung ba lha btsun rdo rje seng ge'i sras khri bkra shis bsod nams ldes ya rtse spu rang gi mnga' 'og tu bcug nas dbus gtsang khul gyi lha sa'i jo khang la gser gyi rgya phibs sgron pa dang sa 336

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/skya dang gdan sa mthil bcas la'ang nyams gso gnang ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad do// lhag par du rgyal ba'i 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 rin po che dang /〈bstan 'gyur 〉rin po che gtsang phyogs su bzhengs shing / 'khor chags dgon par spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol ba dang sa skya dgon pa'i dpe brtsegs lcags ri ma dang 'dra bar chos sogs glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu bzhengs nas bdag skyong legs par byed rgyu'i mthun rkyen bskrun pa bcas so//dus rabs bco lnga'i nang spu rang rgyal khag gu ge rgyal po'i mnga' dbang du shor ba'i skabs chu bo chen po rma bya kha 'bab rab tu rgyas shing che bar byung skabs dgon pa spyi dang yang sgos rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje bcas jo bo dngul sku mched gsum chus 'khyer ba'i nyen kha ha cang che ba'i skabs gu ge chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud khri bkra shis sde pu rang 'khor chags su phebs/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gtsug lag khang la chu yi 'jigs pa skyob thabs bka' khyab bstsal pas chu la rags rgyag pa'i lugs srol bzang po btsugs/ de'i rjes su chos rgyal a mgon bzang pos bstan 'gro'i bde skyid la dgongs te/ rten gsum la nyams gso dang / chu la rags rgyang grags rdo rje rab brtan zhes pa brgyab nas dgon par srung skyob mtha' gcig tu byas so//'khor chags dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog phyi phyogs dgra bos gnad 'tshe'i dbang gis gtor skyon tshabs che tsam byung yod pa ni dngul sku mched gsum las bod 'bangs yongs kyi bstan dgra stod hor gyi dmag dpung byung ba'i 337

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus su/ mi thams cad ri rong gang btsan du bros nas gcig kyang sdod mkhan med par sku gnyer gyis rang gi lus srog blos btang nas sku mdun du bsdad/ hor dmag sdig can 'ga' zhig gtsug lag khang du 'dzul/ jo bo dbus ma'i sku rgyan dbus kyi do shal rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis mdzes par spud pa dang / phyag mtshan/ par ral glegs bam dang bcas pa dngul las grub pa rnams bcad de 'khur/ jo bo mched gsum gyi sku rgyu dngul gar blugs su 'dug pa shes te/ brku sems kyi jo bo dbus ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhabs g.yon pa'i steng du lcags zong drag tu bsnun ma thag tu a tsha sdig can gsungs pas/ kho yang ha las shing / ya mtshan lta bus phyir thon pa dang tshogs sgo'i sgo them brgal ma thag kha nas khrag bskyugs te 'chi la khad par gyur/ gzong bsnun pa'i shul je chung du song shul phran tsam da lta yang yod/ gzong yang da lta pad sdong gi logs su yod pa 'di lags zhes stod phyogs kyi hor dmag zhig yul 'dir bcar nas dgon pa'i rten sku gsung mang dag 'phrog bcom byas nas nyams rgud chen po bzos yod srol 'dug kyang hor dmag de dus ci tsam la yin min dang hor yul ga nas yong ba yin min sogs kha gsal 'khod med pas rjes su mu mthud de zhib 'jug nan po byed dgos so// stod mnga' ris pa dang kha ba can gyi yul lung gzhan nas bcar ba'i dad ldan mi ser grangs las gzhal bar ma mchis pa du ma zhig 'khor chags dgon par bcar nas chos mjal zhu ba dang mchod me 'bul dus dngul sku rnam gsum gyi sku mdun du dngul la gser tshags shin tu legs shing bzo brkos rtser son pa'i mchod kong thun mong ma yin pa gsum mjal rgyu yod par 338

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/de ni spu rang gi khyim mtshes rgyal phran glo bo smon thang gi rgyal pos phul ba yin par dngul sku mched gsum las bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud dri mas ma gos pa glo bo smon thang gi rgyal po phu ne jo bo bod kyi rgyal po dang jo mo 'od kyi rgyal mo gnyis la rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i sras dang mi ngo 'dzin pa'i sras mo sogs ci yang med par thugs yid phyung nas jo bo mched gsum la mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang lus kyi sgo nas phyag dang skor ba mdzad/ ngag gi sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la brtson/ yid kyi sgo nas thugs bskyed smon lam tshad med nyin mtshan ltos med du mdzad pas/ re zhig na sku thang chad nas mnal du song ba'i rmi lam gyi nyams lta bur jo bo dbus ma'i zhal nas phu ne ma nyal phe ne longs/ phu ne longs la phyag gsum 'tshol/ khyod la dgos pa'i bu gsum nga yis ster gsungs/ thugs rab tu dgyes shing skyabs su gsol nas glo bor phyir log tu phebs nas lo dus su rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul rigs kyi me tog lha sras gsum byung bas/ sku drin gtang rag la dmigs nas dngul gyi mchod kong gsum rim par phul ba lags zhes pas 'khor chags dgon pa des lo rgyus thog rma bya kha 'bab kyi chu rgyun du gnas pa'i bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyi rgyal phran khag dbar mdza' mthun zhi bder gnas par dmigs bsal nus pa thon gyi yod pa'ang mtshon gyi 'dug la/ ma gzhi rgyal phran de dag ri bo hi ma la ya'i lho byang gnyis su tha dad du gnas yod kyang skad dang yi ge gcig rang la myong ba byed cing lugs srol goms gshis dang blo rig gi dad pa mthun pa'i mi rigs gcig gi tshul du yun ring gnas thub pa'ang 'khor chags dgon pa'i khyad 'phags rang bzhin can gyi nus pa thon pa lags so//339

༄7kugu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi rtsom pa po bod kha ba can gyi yul na snyan pa'i grags pa ches cher khyab pa'i gtsang smyon pa chen po he ru ka 'khor chags dgon par phebs nas chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa bskyangs shing dngul sku'i rgyab la yod pa'i byad gtad med pa bzos pa sogs byas yod pa ni dngul sku mched gsum las gangs can bod kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gtsang smyon he ru ka badza shi bha dra nye rgyu'i spyod pa bskyangs shing gnas yul gyi ma dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdu phyir phyogs 'dir phebs shing jo bo rnam gsum mjal ba'i dus/ nub gcig mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i ngang la jo bo mched gsum sgrib med du gzigs shing thugs smon mdzad pas jo bo dbus ma'i zhal nas/ gtsang spyonagatsang smyon/ nga yi rgyab phyogs 'di na snyigs dus skye bo rang rgyud ngan pa'i 'khon sems kyis phung gshis nyes pas byad gtad bcug 'dug pa 'di thon la khyod kyi mthu stobs nus pas me la bsregs shig dang sems can mang po la phan thogs pa yod do gsungs/ de'i sang nyin gtsang smyon gyis gzigs su phebs pas ma 'byor bar brten/ sku gnyer la bzhugs khri'i rgyab phyogs 'dir bu ga 'dra yod kyang dus phyis 'gag nas mi 'dug zhus/ gtsang smyon gyis sngar bu ga yod pa der gzigs pas de na jo bo'i bka' ltar byad gtad yod par gzigs te/ lcags kyi skam pas 'don par brtsam pa dang /gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang thams cad rdzas ngan gyi dri mas khyab pa byung /gtad te glo bo chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud la dmigs pa gzigs/ slar gangs ti si na grub dbang mi la ras pas grub rtags su brtsigs pa'i rdzu 'phrul par mer bsregs shing / byad gtad med pa bzos nas sems can gyi don chen 340

༄༅//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/mdzad pa yin zhes pa de'ang 'khor chags dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog byung ba'i don rkyen chen po zhig la 'dzin gyi yod do//'khor chags dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog da dung mdo khams shar phyogs kyi sangs tshangs sprul sku blo bzang nges don chos kyi nyi ma zhes yongs su grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyis kyang lam thag ring bar ma 'dzems par dka' ba du ma spyad de phebs nas chos phyogs kyi bya ba spel yod pa ni jo bo dngul sku mchedagasum las spyod pa rjes su skyong ba'i phyir rgyal khams kyi gnas rten la phyag mchod mdzad pa dang ḍā k+karu ḍa dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir phebs shing /lhag par jo bo dngul sku mched gsum mjal ba'i dus phyag dang por mdzad nas bzung dngos sam nyams kyi sgo nas/ sngon du stod hor gyis bcom pa'i jo bo dbus ma'i phyag mtshan nyams gso gsar bzhengs dgos pa'i rtags mtshan rim bzhin byung ba ltar/ rin chen gser dngul spel ma'i phyag mtshan pad ral glegs bam rnams bzhengs rgyu'i dbu brtsams nas zhag shas kyi dus shig mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i ngang la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od gur khang 'khyil ba'i dbus na/ rten gyi gtso bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' de/ ngos zin po gzigs byung bar smon lam rgya chen mdzad pas jo bo'i zhal nas/ zhing skyong be ḍūr mdangs 'dzin gyis// zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa mkha' 'gro'i brda ston gyis ma 'ongs gnas 'gyur sgrib med du ston pa'i lung bstan yang gsal bar gnang zhesakhong gis dngul sku rin po che rnam gsum la nyams gso legs par byas yod pa mngon cing khong ni 'khor chags dgon gyi lo rgyus thog byas rjes chen po yod pa'i mkhas dbang zhig kyang yin/341

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdor na dgon pa 'di dus rabs bcu gsum gyi gong du gsang sngags gsar ma'i grub mtha' 'dzin cing dge 'dun gyi sde shugs chen po med pa'i dgon pa zhig yin mod kyang phyis sutshobaka' brgyud pa'i gdung brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa stod mnga' ris gangs ri rin po che ti si dang mtsho chen ma pham g.yu mtshor phebs nas sgrub pa'i gnas gzhir bdag gir du bzung nas gangs ri'i sku mdun du mchis pa'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud las kyang shugs grags che ru phyin nas rim gyis gu ge rgyal po dang spu rang rgyal por 'brel 'dris btsugs te gnas gzhi dang dgon sde mang tsam de'i dbang 'og tu 'jug par rtsol ba bskyed skabs stod kyi rgyal phran khag gi rgyal por skyed rdzogs sogs bka' chos mang du gsungs pas de'i yon du spu rang gi dgon pa grags can 'khor chags kyang byung nas skabs shig la 'khor chags dgon pa 'bri gung bka' brgyud pas bskyangs so// spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga'i nang la spu rang rgyal po dang glo rgyal po gnyis dbar la 'gal rkyen che tsam byung mthar khros 'khrugs rngam nas drag po'i dpung dmag drangs skabs spu rang rgyal por pham nyes byung ste mtha' khul gyi sa cha mang dag glo 'og tu shor cing tha na 'khor chags kyang glo rgyal pos mchod 'phrin mdzad yul du gyur/ glo rgyal po ni sa skya ngor par dad pa shin tu che zhing ngor pa'i bla ma grags can mang po glo bor gdan drangs nas chos zhu ba dang sprags spu rang gi 'khor chags dgon pa de'ang sa skya'i ngor dgon pa'i dgon lag tu bsgyur cing de nas bla rabs btang 'go btsugs shing dus de nas bzung spu rang sa khongs na grags pa shin tu che ba'i dgon rnying ste 'khor chags dgon pa sa skya ngor pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa zhig chags shing deng bar sa skya ngor pas bskyangs mus so//342

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/'khor chags dgon pa'i grub cha gtso bo ni jo khang dang / dkyil 'khor dbyibs can gyi gtsug lag khang / de'i 'dabs su lha khang ka brgyad yid bzhin lhun grub zhu bar lho ngos su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi lha khang /(sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun bzhugs/) nub ngos su byams khang /(rten gtso rgyal ba byams pa thog tshad ma/) byang ngos su sangs rgyas rabs bdun lha khang /mgonakhang bdud dpung zil gnon/(rten gtso rje btsun ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku rgyu dzhai k+shim las grub pa ngo mtshar byin rlabs che zhing gzi 'od 'bar ba)ka brgya lha khang ye shes lhun grub/ bla brang dang grwa shag(da lta grong pa'i g.yul las byed sa las med/) de bzhin 'khor chags dgon pa'i phyi nang kun tu chos sku'i mchod rten ring bsrel gyis bkang ba bcas bzhugs pa lags so//'khor chags dgon pa'i jo khang gi gtsang khang nang gi rten gtso sogs dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod pa dngul sku mched gsum las rgyas par bkod 'dug pa gsham gsal ltar ro// jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bzhugs khri rdo chen a mo li ka ri rab kyi tshul du bzhugs nas gling bzhi gling phran brgyad zhig bzhengs par dgongs te/ gser dngul zangs lcags kyis gtso byas/mi yi nor bu rin po che dpag tu med pa bsags te blugs kha btsugs pa'i dus/ jo bo'i zhal nas sku gnyer zhag bdun gyi bar tshogs sgo rgyob/ bya byi'u tsam gyi gzugs can gyi 'grul pa dri ma med par gyis shig gsungs par brten sku gnyer gyis de ltar byas kyang zhag lnga song dus sku gnyer gyi sems la/da zhag de tsam song dus spyir phyag mchod kyi rgyun chad pa dang lhag par rten khyad par can 'di lta bu steng lha yul/ 'og klu yul/ bar dri za'i yul sogs su gdan 'dren 'dra yang zhus med dam snyam nas zhag lnga'i mtshams sgo 343

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phye bas/ sprul pa'i bzo bo rnams jo bo'i thugs kar thims pa mthong /de nas rdo chen a mo li ka dbus su drang por bzhag pa la/ mtha' nas bskor ba'i tshul gyis pad sdong rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i yal ga dang / 'dab ma rab tu rgyas shing 'bras bu kha phye ba dang / phye la khad/ma phye ba rab tu mang ba'i sdong po dbus ma'i 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis kyi lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shes rab kyi lha 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i gzugs sku rang byon bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon gyi sdong bu yal ga me tog 'bras bu dang bcas pa thur du cung zad 'phyang zhing / slar gyen du langs pas rtse mo'i phyogs 'dab ma sum cu dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan dang bcas ma 'ong pa'i dus na rgyal sras phyag na pad mo dang phyag na rdo rje gnyis bzhengs pa'i brda ston du grub/ pad sdong gi rtsa bar 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub phyir klu yi rgyal po dga' bo dang 'a jog po gnyis sgrul mgo'i gdeng ka bdun bdun gyi zur phud kyis brgyan/phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing 'dud pa'i tshul gyis gnas/de'i g.yas g.yon du mchod pa'i bstod dbyangs 'bul phyir dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa shang shang gi gzugs su pi wang gi sgra dbyangs bsgyur pa'i tshul du gnas/ de rnams kyi 'og tu lha klu mi yi longs spyod dpal 'byor/ stong 'khor lo'i bsgyur pa'i stobs dang mnga' thang lta bu rgyas phyir rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog rnams kyi gzugs su grub/'jig rten na dbang che zhing stobs che la/ nus pa che ba'i lha dbang phyug chen po dang tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ khyab 'jug klu yi rgyal po/ nam 344

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/mkha' lding gi rgyal po rnams kyis mchod cing bkur la bstod pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir rgyab yol la glang chen thal dkar dang / bya khyung tsu ru/ mi chung ko le/ ri dwags shwa ra bha/ chu srin pa tra/ bya khyung rgyal po dang bcas pa 'jig rten na che ba drug po dang rang rang gi gzugs kyis brgyan pa dang rtag tu mchod pa'i sprin phung kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul ltar rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur ston la/snyan pa'i glu len pa/ dga' ba'i gar rtsed pa'i tshul du 'khor ba dang bcas mdor na rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pa blos bsgrun du med pa 'jig rten mi yi byed las kyi dri mas ma gos pa 'di lta bu'i rang byon mngon sum du grub cing /sngon ma sku gnyer kyi tshogs sgo zhag lnga nas phye ba'i rkyen kyis me tog dang gzugs brnyan sogs la bzo 'phro phran bu lus pa lta bur snang ba da lta yang dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa 'di rnams lags zhes gsal po bris 'dugamador na gong du brjod pa ltar dgon pa de thang sder la chags shing chu chen rma bya kha 'bab dang ha cang thag nye bo yod gshis dbyar dus chu'i 'jigs yang se byung nas gu ge rgyal po rim byung gis chu rags legs po bzhengs pa nas bzung dgon pa'i rten sku gsung dag la srung skyob mthil phyin pa byas stabs mi rabs mang po ci tsam 'das kyang dgon par der god chags chen po byung med do//da dung jo khang 'di'i nang gi rten gtso'i gras su jo bo dngul sku mched gsum de'i g.yas phyogs su dzhai k+shim las grub pa'i jo bo mched gsum dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sman sku byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i sku brnyan bcas dang /345
