༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/g.yon phyogs su jo bo mched gsum dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'dra sku rin po che mched gsum dang / dzhai k+shiXlas grub pa'i rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gsung byon byin rlabs can/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i snang brnyan byin rlabs che ba ste/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang 'di yi phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' chos srung nor lha'i snang brnyan rgyu rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i lder sku dang bris sku'i rnam pa can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sgo srung rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ khro bo me brtsegs/ dpal rta mchog rol pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sogs sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs so//de snga 'khor chags dgon par zla rer dus ston mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod de bod zla bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu dgu la dgu gtor gyi cho ga tshugs shing bod zla bcu gnyis kyi tshes gcig la lo gsar btang ba ni gtsang pa dang 'dra ba bsod nams lo gsar 'go btsugs te nyin lnga'i ring yul mi tshang mas rgyan gos kyi gzab mchor legs par spras nas glu gzhas dang zhabs bros rol bar byed do//tshes brgyad la grong mi so sos thab gsol byed cing dgon pa'i btsun chung la gos gzan gsar pa g.yog tshes dgu la mgon khang 'phrin bcol byed/tshes bcu la jo khang mdo phyogs kyi sgrol ma 'jigs skyob ma la cho ga dang chu mi 'chir ched du rags brtsigs/ tshes bcu gcig la srung ma khang la 'phrin bcol gnang zhing dgong mo dkar po phyogs brgyad kyi snyung gnas 'go 'dzugs/ tshes bcu gnyis nas bzung nyin brgyad ring dgon pa'i sku shog (sku zhabs/)dang yul mi mang che ba snyung gnas la bzhugs/ de'i ring la nyin rer lto rgyas pa thengs gcig las za gi med/ nyin dgu par slung gnas 346

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/bsang bar sgrol nas dkar zas kyis myos par byed pa las dmar zas nyin shas ring spangs kyi yod/sum bcu nas tshes bco lnga bar du cho 'phrul smon lam tshogs/ tshes gcig nas bdun bar zhogs ltar kun rigs cho ga cha tshang gtong zhing dgong mo smon lam tshogs kyi yod/ tshes bcu nas 'cham 'khrab pa'i spyong brdar 'go btsugs nas ma shes pa phan tshun go bsdur gyis sbyang zhing shes par byed dgos/ bod zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis te jo bo grub pa'i grub ston la gur mgon sogs srung ma khag thon yong nas 'cham 'khrab bo// tshes bco lnga la dar po che brje po rgyag cing rdzong dpon sogs dngos su bcar nas sku shog tshang mar gsol ja dang zhal lag gtong ngo // bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga bar dgon pas rdo rje 'jigs byed sgrub pa'i cho ga gtong / yul mi tshos tshes bcu la lha gsol gtong mgo 'dzugs/ de tshe nyin mo gral glu gtong zhing mtshan mo rgan dar gzhon gsum pho mo tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyis gzhas btang zhabs bro 'khrab ste nyin lnga tsam ring glu gzhas 'tsho ba longs su spyod/de zin rjes su zhing las rmo 'debs 'go 'dzugs kyi yod do//bod zla bzhi pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar kun rigs rnam snang gi cho ga gtong ngo // nyi shu gsum la sgrub pa tshogs shing kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ bod zla lnga pa'i tshes nyi shur mgon po gsol lo// bod zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi pa ste 'dzam gling spyi bsang skabs la ri mgo mtho sa khag tu rlung bsang gtong / de rting dbyar gnas dkyil 'khor thig rgyag cing lha tshang mar mchod pa bzhengs kyi yod/ tshes bdun la lo sngon mar bzhengs pa'i rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor de bsdus nas rma bya kha 'bab kyi chu nang la bshams 347

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas klu gsol gyi cho ga rgyas po zhig gtong / tshes brgyad la thugs gsol kyi bskang gso 'bul ba dang sbrags gur mgon dang / dpal ldan lha mo/dpal mgon phyag bzhi/ srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron bcas rim gyis gsol lo//dus mtshungs dgon pa'i 'khor yug tu gnas pa'i grong pa mang pos gangs ri lha btsan la'ang gsol kha rgyas po zhig gtong srol yod do//bod zla brgyad pa'i nang g.yul las ma btang gong la g.yul thag nang du rdo dkar gong bsgrigs shing du ba'i bsang gsol gtong ba/ chang phud kyi mchod gtor byed pa/ nas 'bru'i phud snye ma dgon par phul ba sogs cho ga rgyas po zhig byed do// bod zla dgu pa'i nang tshes bzang dus bzang la sku rim bskang gso gtong ba las dmigs bsal cho ga med/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu nas dkon gnyer gyis gtong sgo sna tshogs bsgrigs cha byed kyi yod pa ni thud dang / kha zas/ nas 'bru'i phud/ chang phud/ 'o phud/mngar cha'i phud bcas phun sum tshogs pa dgos/ tshes nyi shu bzhir dgon pa'i sku shog tshos rten 'brel gyi byed sgo spel 'go 'dzugs shing gser skyems dang 'phrin bcol kyang 'bul lo// nyi shu lnga'i zhogs pa ngor lugs kyi bsang gsol rgyas pa de gtong zhing bskang gso cha tshang gtong / de'i nyin gung du lo gcig gi rtsis khra bsher cing dgong mo mig mangs brtsis nas bag g.yeng bar byas nas dga' spros rol lo// nyi shu drug nas gtor ma rnying pa bshams nas gsar pa mchod cing grwa ba tshang mas rnga brdungs shing sbub chal dkrol ba/ rgya gling dang sur r+ṇa btang te sa ngor gyi srung ma'i bskang gso cha tshang ba gtong ngo //dgun kha'i ring grwa pa mang che bas bsnyen sgrub dang slob gnyer la brtson 'grus byas nas bla ma'i go 'phang thob par brtson cing so so'i chos kyi rtogs pa je 348

༄7//mnga' ris spu rang khul gyi 'khor chags gtsug lag khang gi byung ba brjod pa/mthor gtong bar 'bad 'bungs bskyed kyi yod/ dgung lo bgres pas dben pa'i ri khrod la mtshams sdom mo//yul 'di'i yul lha gtso bo ni i phi klu mo zhes pa de'o// de ni lung pa'i zhing chu gtso bo yong sa yul de'i byang phyogs lung chung nang gi shing nags mang po yod sa'i chu mig der brjod/ dwangs shing gtsang ba'i lu chu khyad ldan des zhing la shin tu sman pas yul mis rang gi mig la gces spras byas pa bzhin srung skyob legs par byed do// yul lha de 'bebs mkhan ni bud med kyi sku khog zhig yod/ yul 'dir dus chen ci rigs dang rkyen che chung gang rigs byung dus lha 'bebs kyi yod/ kho mo ni chu lha zhig yin gshis lha dngos su 'bebs dus chang mang po btung dgos shing dbu la rigs lnga'i cod pan steng na gtsug tor yod pa zhig mchod/ lus la phyu pa sngo phra gyon cing pang gdan gos chen dmar phra rgyag mdun la lcog rtse skyon chag med pa zhig rgyag de'i sgang la dkar yol 'brug ris phra man phra rgyag cha tshang ba zhig bzhag nas chang bskang ngo // phyag gcig la mda' dar dang gzhan zhig la mchod 'bru bsnams nas lha bzhugs pa dang yul la dar rgud ci yong dang lung pa'i nang nad yams yong min dang lo tog legs min/ dud 'gro sgo phyugs la dkar chu skya rgyas min sogs la sku rim ci 'dra byed dgos min bka' lung sba gsang med par gnang / de dus dgon pa'i grwa ba der phebs shing yul mi mang che ba'ang bcar nas gsol ba smon lam 'debs shing bsnyen bkur byed do//de'i sbyin bdag mi tshang rnying gras khag cig yod pa de tshos res mos kyis byed do// sku khog des mi tshang so so'i nang la klu 'khrugs nas rkyen ci byung yang gdan 'dren zhus ma thag de ma nyid du bcar gyi yod do//349

༄//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/grib rdzong btsan gyi sku gsob ni lha sa skyid chu'i lho phyogs bum pa ri'i nub ngos grib khul du lha khang chung tsam zhig yod pa de'i nang la mchod nas yod/de ni grib khu gyi yul lha gtso bo de yin/ de snga yul der tsho pa khag bzhi tsam yod cing tsho pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i sdod khul gyi ming la mda' lugs dang /gsum pa la zhang lha/ bzhi pa la phu pa bcas brjod/ tsho pa de tsho'i gnas yul sa ming dang grib kyi tha snyad sogs lha lung dpal rdor gyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba dam po yodaX tsho pa bzhi po de'i khongs la khral rgyug mkhan them grangs che ba drug bcu re gcig yod/ khong tshos khral khungs gnyis la khral rgyug dgos pa ni/ phyi khral sde pa gzhung dang nang khral bla brang gzhis ka'am tshe mchog gling gi chos gzhis yin/spyir na tsho khag so sor spyi chen zhes dbu 'dzin mi re yod/ khong tsho ni grong tsho so so'i mi 'bangs tshang mas 'jon thang che min dang dbang grags rgyus stobs bcas gzhir bzung gis 'dems bsko byed kyi yod/ des na spyi chen ni yul de'i khral gyi 'gro lugs 'gro stangs cha tshang zhig gsal po shes la yi ge'ang phran tsam shes pa/ rdzun dang khram pa mi byed mkhan tshang mas 'jog sa dradī sbya0 zhig yin dgos/ mi 'bangs kyis 'dems zin rjes su tsho bzhi'i

༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/dbu 'dzin te rgan pos thugs thag bcad nas dngos su go gnas gtan 'khel byed cing lo gsum las byed dbang med/ spyi chen bzhi'i dbu 'dzin rgan po ni tshe mchog gling bla brang gis 'dems bsko byed kyi yod/ de'i go gnas la lo dus kyi tshad 'dzin med/ mtshams re lo bcu tsam dang mtshams re tshe gang ring byed mkhan kyang yod/ yang kho'i nang la bu 'jon thang chen po yod tshe pha shul bus 'dzin byas nas/ 'bangs mi skyong gi yod kyang mang che ba ni gsar pa zhig 'dems bsko byed srol yod/grib la mgar tshang shar pa dang nub ma zhes/ sngar btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs blon po mgar ba grib la rgyang 'bud btang bsaṇa khong gi pho brang yin zhes mkhar shul gyi gyang gog gnyis trem yod/ de yang shar ma de dgun kha bzhugs yul dang nub ma de dbyar kha bzhugs yul yin/ da lta mgar tshang shar pa de gyang gog zhig las lhag mi 'dug grib pa rgan rabs tshos brjod srol la sngar gyang gog der thog brtsegs gsum tsam yod skad/mgar tshang nub ma de da lta shul tsam yang bsdad mi 'dug la de'i chags shul la mi tshang gcig gis khang pa gsar pa zhig brgyab 'dug mdor na mgar tshang shar pa dang mgar tshang nub ma gnyis ni grib kyi lo rgyus thog gna' rnying snga shos shig yin par mngon/de yang grib rdzong btsan gyi lo rgyus skor la ngag rgyun 'dra zhig mchis te/sngon gyi dus su mes rgyal nang sa'i rgya rigs han gur gyi rgyal po shan dhi zhes bya ba zhig gi blon po yu'u yi rigs can dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa zhig byung /khong mthu stobs shin tu che bas dmag dpon chen po mdzad de yul gru tha dad pa'i dgra ma rung pa rnams tshar bcad nas/ rgya yul gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran 351

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grangs las 'das pa zhig mnga' 'og tu btsud/ dpa' rtsal gyis bsnyems pas dregs pa rnams kyang 'di'i gam du slebs pa na/ khyung chen dang byi'u'i rtsal lta bur gyur pas phyogs kun tu 'di'i ming thos pa tsam gyis mi 'dud pa gcig kyang medaṇayang khong sku tshe'i mthar slebs dus gzhan dang g.yul sprad pa zhig gi skabs su/ khro bzhin du 'das pa'i 'og rol tu zi khron gyi sa'i char yu'u chan zhan zhes bya ba rjes su zhang ming du grags pa'i ri chen po zhig yod pa der klu'i rigs kyi mi ma yin mthu bo che zhig tu gyur ba shin tu tsub drag pas ri de mthong sar gzhan gyis bgrod pa trem yang dka' ba zhig byung ṇa de nas lo bzhi brgya tsam 'das rjes sangs rgyas chos lugs dbu ma'i lta ba'i brgyud 'dzin slob dpon chen po ṭi tsi twa shi zhes bya gnas der sgrub pa skyon cing chos 'chad pa'i skabs shig na/ yul mi rnams kyis shin tu gnyan pa'i rgyu mtshan smras kyang ma ldog par ri de la bsgom pas/ mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul gyi sbrul chen po ri der lan gsum dkris pa zhig gis gzugs bstan cing / lha klu'i dmag dpung bye ba mang po drangs te ri chen por brdegs pa/ nyi zla cha lang brdeb pa/mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa/ thog gi bu yug 'tshubs pa/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston pa sogs ci byas kyang ting nge 'dzin las g.yo bar byed ma nus pas/ skabs zhig na go cha dang rgyan gyis spras pa'i dmag dpon chen po sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa mngon sum du byung nas slob dpon la phyag btsal zhing mtho 'tsham pa la bzod gsol zhus shing / bdag sngar gyi dmag dpon chen po yin pa zhe sdang gi dbang gis 'das pas sbrul gyi rnam pa can 'di lta bur gyur/ las drang po bgyis pas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che ba 352

༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/'di byung ṇa slob dpon gyis las 'bras kyi chos mang du gsungs/ da ni bdag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma bgyid/ sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan gang du gnas pa der sgo khang ngam g.yas g.yon gyi khang pa gang rigs shig tu bdag gi gzugs brnyan kyang bzhengs na dge 'dun gyi sde dang chos 'khor skyong bar bgyi'o zhes dam bcas te/ de nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung mar gyur/ de lta bu'i rgyal po chen po 'di nyid beg tse lcam sring dang thugs rgyud gcig pa yinaṇa yang rgya bza' bod du byon dus srung ma 'di nyid lha sa'i jo bo dang rgya bza'i rjes su 'brangs nas bod du byon pas lha sa'i grib kyi rdzong ri/ yar lung shel gyi brag phug 'phyes kyi lha lung btsan mkhar/ kong po bu chu lha khang / sbug ri phug mo che/ rtse chen brag sogs la gnas bcas pa da lta rdzong btsan bshan par grags pa de yin pa 'dugadhi ces pa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rdzong btsan gsol mchod du'ang gsal bas 'dir zhib tu brjod pa'i dgos dbang ma mchis/thog ma bum pa ri'i 'og la ri chung dbyibs legs shig yod pa/ de'i rtse la dmar ldi rgyang gog ces pa rdzong btsan gyi pho brang de yin/ der bzhugs dus rdzong btsan de nyid bka' gnyan zhing btsan pa mnyes po ma byung tshe gnod 'tshe tshad med bskyel gyi yod skad/ dper na sngar skyid chu'i byang phyogs kyi rkyang thang na ga yod sa de nas btsan khang ngam rdzong btsan gyi pho brang dmar ldi rgyang gog de mjal ma nyid du lam seng rta thog nas babs shing dbu zhwa ma phud tshe rang bzhin gyis brgyal gzer rgyag gi yod zer/ des na tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i skabs la/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis rdzong btsan sku gsob ri'i nub ngos khug kyog mig gis mthong sa med par spos 353

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas ras la sku gser sgron te/ de snga'i sku drag po de zhi bar bsgyur cing /zhal ras kyi zhal 'bag de tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i zhal 'khrus skyon sa'i zhal cor las bzhengs pa yin skad/ de ni da lta'i gzhi bdag rdzong btsan ma'i zhal ras de yin la shin tu mtshar po yod/'on te lo rgyus kyi dpe rnying khag gi nang 'khod don/ grib rdzong btsan de nyid shin tu 'jigs su rung ba dang de'i bzhugs yul pho brang ni snang srid lha ma srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa rba klongs drag tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus su gser dang zangs lcags las grub pa'i btsan mkhar dmar po thod skam rlon rnying pa'i kha bad can mi'i rgyu ma dang rus pa'i phreng ba'i dra ba dang dbang po lnga dang yan lag gi dra phyed 'phyang ba/ zhing lpags kyi rgyal mtshan la tsi ta'i tog gis spras pa/ bsur chen gyi dung pa 'thul zhing khrag gi zham chu 'bebs pa/'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i pho brang gi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du gnod sbyin chen po krong ma grib btsan chen mo bzhugs pa bcas bkod 'dug pa ni 'dren byed lam du 'char ba tsam gyis lus kyi ba spu'ang gyen du phyogs dgos pa zhig mchis/de'i sku gtum drag can gyi phyi'i rnam pa ni/ sku mdog pad+ma ra ga'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dmar ba/ yas sos ma mchu mnan pa'i am tshigs bsdams shing dmar zlum spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug pa/ sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/ sku la bse khrab dang dbu la bse rmog dmar po zhol can rgyal mtshan bkra shis dgu brtsegs ru dang dung ru ang sing rmog gcus sogs rgyan rnams kyis spras shing / sgrul mgo gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ sku rgyab tu rgyal mtshan lcog dra 'jar bkra ba/ phyag g.yas me dung dmar po dar 354

༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/gyi cod pan can dang g.yon pa ni tsi ta dmar po rin chen 'phrul gyi lde mig dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs la sag lham dmar po gsol ba/ rta mchog dmar po sga srab gong rmed spu len ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan rnams kyis spras pa la chibs pa 'jigs rung btsan dmar gyi rnam pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig mtshon pas bka' gnyan gyi bkod pa ji ma ji bzhin mchis/de min rdzong btsan chen mo'i g.yas g.yon gyi 'khor sogs 'di lta ste/de'i g.yas su nang sgrub dge bsnyen sngags btsun paṇa zhu 'jol ber can gyi rī rnam pa rta dkar la chibs pa/ phyag g.yas ba dan dkar po dang phyag g.yon rin po che gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du gsang sgrub gnod sbyin gter bdag rgyal po nor lha'i rnam pa can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/phyag g.yas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu dang phyag g.yon rin chen rna'u le'i rkyal ba thogs pa/ stag gzig sogs gcan gzan gtum drag can la chibs pa/ mdun du thugs kyi dgyes dgongs ma sman mo lha mo smin legs rgyan gyis spud pa/ de dag gi 'khor du rang 'dra'i klu btsan drug gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren gshin rje'i phyogs bi btsan dpon kirta dhadza bltas pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs kyi srog 'phrog pa'i gzi brjid can/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren gnod sbyin phyogs kyi btsan dpon grags pa dpal le shug sgra dang rgyob bsod hum phaṭa kyis bstan dgra yongs kyi srog dbugs len pa/ sgra med rnam 'gyur gyi cho 'phrul drag po dag la ston pa'i phyag brnyan chen po khro gtum can/dam nyams srog gcod pa shan pa kha gdangs shig mche ba gtsigs nas srog 'phrog 'o dod drag po 'bod/ btsan 'khor gsum brgya drug cu dkor bdag skyes bu stong sde/ gter bdag bye ba sa ya/ sdom dang sdig pa bya khra la 355

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs pa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba de dag ni kho'i gtso 'khor dag yin/rdzong btsan de nyid rnam pa gcig yin kyang yul lung mi 'dra ba'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rang rang gi mthun rkyen dang bstun nas gsol gyi yod pa ni/ rgya yul zangs thang gnas nas btsan dmag dam nyams dgra la 'gyed phyir gsol zhing / yar lung shel gyi brag phug nas zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo sgrol bar gsol/ 'phyes kyi lha lung mkhar nas dam sri 'gong po thal bar brlags slad gsol/ skyid shod grib rdzong ri nas dam ldan gdul bya bu bzhin skyong bar gsol/ kong po bu chu lha khang gnas nas log smon kla klo tshar gcod mdzad phyir gsol/ spu ri phugs mo che nas rnal 'byor tshe 'dzin drongs nyul mdzad par gsol/ rtse chen brag gi ngos nas gnas chen bstan pa'i srung ma mdzad du gsol/ rdzong btsan pho brang mchog nas nges don bstan pa'i srung ma mdzad phyir gsol/ lho kha'i pho brang dag nas g.yas kyi ru 'dren btsan dpon mdzad par gsol/ byang kha'i pho brang dag nas g.yon gyi ru 'dren btsan dpon mdzad slad gsol ba bcas so/ /grib khul gyi yul lha grib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod ni dus rtag tu tshe bzang dus bzang skabs la gsol kha byed cing / lhag par du bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i dbyar gsol dang bcu pa'i nang la dgun gsol 'bul gyi yod/dus tshes legs po de gnyis kyi skabs su yul mi tshos gsol kha gra rgyas po zhe drag byed kyi yod/ de tshe gzhas pa gzhas ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mos gna' snga mo'i rgyun srol ldan pa'i gzhasarjogatong zhing zhabs bro thun mong ma yin pa 'khrab kyi yod la khong tshos gna' snga mo'i lugs srol bzhin lag tu mda' gri 356

༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/mdung gsum bsnams pa dang lus la khrab rmog cha tshang gyon nas rngam brjid dang sgeg nyams shin tu ldan/ dpa' mo tsho'i dbu la ltag tshar dang spa phrugale rtse bcas gyon zhing lus la e kor dang ga'u sogs rgyan chas cha tshang ba 'dogs kyi yod/ gzhas 'khrab mkhan rkang mi bzhi dang gzhas dpon gcig bcas khyon mi lnga tsam yod/ gzhas dpon de khong tsho'i sne 'khrid yin pas gzhas 'khrab par thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsal lag ldan yod/ deng sang sngar gyi rgyan cha dang mtshon cha sogs med kyang phyag rgya tsam dang rnam pa tsam zhig bstan nas gzhas pa gzhas ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mo yin khul gyis bang rim bsgrigs nas gna' gzhas nyams dang ldan pa dag gtong srol 'dugagana' gzhas khyad ldan gyi nang don gtso bo ni bla ma yi dam dang yul srung ba rdzong btsan po la bstod pa phul ba'am bshad padhirgyag gi yod pa de dag lags/de bzhin lo gsar tshes gsum gyi nyin mo der yul mi tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyis yul lha chen mo grib rdzong btsan la bsang gsol rgyas po 'bul gyi yod/ de nyin thag ring la bzhugs mkhan phud/ de min lha sa'i nye 'khor la bzhugs mkhan grib phyi nang gi mi tshang thams cad der 'dzoms thub pa byed kyi yod/ de tshe mi tshang so so'i zas rigs dang 'thung bya'i rigs kyi phud tshang ma bsnams nas rdzong btsan la mchod cing smon lam 'debs pa dang /mchod dpon gyis srung ba spun dog si shan tshos gzhi dkar rkyang zhig yul mi thams cad la phul gyi yod/ de ni gtang rag rten 'brel mtshon ched dang dngos grub thob pa yin pas tshang mas snang chen byed cing / nyar tshags legs par byas te khyim nang gi phud rtsa chen zhig la 'dzin gyi yod/ de min nyin de'i zhogs par da dung tshogs tshugs nas dung dang rgya gling dkrol ba dang 357

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yi dam 'jigs byed/ lha mo/ mgon po/ dam can chos rgyal/ rdzong btsan chen po sogs kyi bskang bshags bstod 'phrin sogs mnyam 'don byed kyi yod/ de min rdzong btsan de nyid grib pa'i yul lha gtso bo yin pas grib pa tsho'i nam rgyun 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba gting zab yod ⑩cing / khong bzhugs yul lha khang de'i nang la byin can gyi chu rdo sngon po ⑪zhig 'dug la/rdzong btsan zhabs 'og gi sa dmar gshin po thun mong min pa'i byin can bcas 'dug pa de dag la'ang grib pa tshos dad mos chen po byed cing dmigs bsal gyi mthong chen byed par mngon/sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin grib kyi yul lha grib rdzong btsan tshal gung thang la gdan 'dren zhus nas/ dpal ldan lha mo dang mnyam 'dzoms byed du 'jug gi yod/ de tshe yul lha gdan 'dren zhu mkhan de mi tshang bcu gnyis nas yong gi yod/ mi tshang bcu gnyis de dag ni bde skyid rab brtan dang /lha sku shar pa/ phyug po tshogs/ ko smad/ rdzing bkag la yang /'og ma/ dar rgyas tshe ring / sang khug tshe ring khang gsar/ zhang chu 'khor/ khyim ma nub bcas yin/ de ni rus rgyud gzhir bzung gis mi rabs nas mi rabs byas te 'gro dgos kyi yod/ gal te mi tshang der bu rgyud med pa'am tha na byi phrug kyang med par mi rgyud stong tshe yul lha'i rtsar blta ris zhus pa'am mo brgyab pa yang na zan ril bsgril nas mi tshang gnyis tsam gsum gyi nang nas rus gtsang ba'i mi tshang gsar pa zhig gdan 'dren zhu dgos/mi tshang bcu gnyis de dag ni lha yi zhabs phyi zhu mkhan yin gshis skyes pho ma gtogs bud med rtsa ba nas byed chog gi med/ mi tshang bcu gnyis kyi spyi ming la lha gdan 'dren zhu mkhan zhes brjod/ spyir btang byas na kho tshos bod zla 358

༄khya//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun par nyin sum cu so gnyis ring la kha 'dzems dgos pa ste nya sgong phag gsum gyi sha rigs spangs dgos pa dang bud med dang 'khrig spyod byed mi chog gal te spang bya legs po byed ma thub na rdzong btsan gyi sku 'degs dus shin tu lci bas dka' las bzod bsran bral ba myong dgos kyi yod skad/ de la bshags pa phul ba'ang brjod/rdzong btsan gdan 'dren zhu dus mda' dar legs po bsnams kyi yod pa ni khong dang dpal lha mo 'khrungs sa skyon pa'i mtshon rtags yin/ khong gnyis lo gcig dus gcig la thengs gcig las 'phrad yas med pa de ni gung thang me tog mchod pa'i skabs la yin/ de nyid rdzong batren gyi sku gsob der na bza' dang rgyan cha gzab par sgron thog grib pa mi bcu gnyis kyis tshal dgon gyi 'du khang chen mor gdan drangs te zhal shar du gzigs nas bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du mchod sprin bshams/ tshal pa tsho dang grib pa tsho/ de min lha sa nas bcar mkhan tshos bsang gsol gser skyems 'bul ba sogs byed/ de'i dgong mo gung thang dpal ldan lha mo dang zhal sprod kyis bzhugs su gsol/ de yang gung thang lha mo ni lha sa'i dpal lha mo spun gsum gyi ya gyal yin/ gzhan dag gnyis po de lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dbu thog gsum par yod/ gcig ni dpal lha drag mo dang gzhan zhig ni dpal lha sbal gdong yin/ brjod srol la khong gsum pos yum gyi zhal la ma gsan pas nyes chad bcad de so so tha dad du bzhag pa yin zhes brjod/ de min rdzong btsan tshal gung thang dgon du nyin gcig bzhag nas nyin gang lha mo 'khrab pa dang mi ser la mjal kha byed du bcug cing nyin gsum par grib la 359

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gdan drangs te/ de nyin grib pa tshos glu gzhas dang zas rigs sna tshogs kyis skyid pa'i 'tsho ba longs su spyod kyi yod/grib la dus ston che shos gsum yod pa ni dbyar gsol dang dgun gsol/ 'ong skor bcas yin cing 'ong skor skabs la rta rgyug pa sogs lus rtsal byed sgo sna tshogs spel gyi yod/ drug pa tshes bzhi'i skabs la chos dpe sgal bar bsnams nas skor ba rgyag gi yod/ sngar grib pa tshos zhang lha sna bo che zhes zhang lha'i grong tsho'i nang gi lha cig yod pa de yang gsol dgos/ sngar lo rgyus thog la tshe mchog gling dgon pa'i gtor rgyag byed dus zhang lha a bo zhes pa'i gtor rgyag zhig kyang dus mnyam du rgyag dgos/ de dus dgon pa dang zhang lha'i gtor rgyag de shar dang byang phyogs khag so sor rgyag gi yod/zhang lha a bo'i gtor rgyag byang la brgyab tshe dgon pa'i gtor rgyag shar ngos la rgyag dgos/ gang ltar dgon pa'i gtor rgyag dang zhang lha'i gtor rgyag de ldog phyogs la rgyag dgos/mchan/dugrib kyi sa cha'i ming rnying pa dag dang lha lung dpal rdor gyi lo rgyus dbar 'brel ba chen po yod cing sa cha'i ming thun mong ma yin pa dag de dus byung ba ni/ lha lung dpal rdor gyis rta dkar por sol ba nag po byug pa zhig chibs pa dang / gos chas nang sha dkar la phyi sha nag po byas pa cig gyon nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi mdun du bcar te/ rgyal po glang dar bkrongs rjes lhophyogs grib ngos ga la bar bros skabs/skyid chu la brgal bas nag po chus dag pa dang gos chas phyi nang slog pas mi nag rta nag 360

༄7//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/de mi dkar rta dkar la gyur te/ glog 'khyug pa ltar hreb ber brgyugs pas sa cha der hrib bam grib ces thogs skad/ da lung pa'i mda' der 'gro gi 'dug zhus pas yul der mda' pa zhes thogs/ de nas yar tsam la phebs dus da khong lug hrog hrog byed sa der 'gro gi zhes pas sa cha der lug hrog gam lug ro zhes thogs/ de nas tshe mchog gling dgon pa yod sa der slebs dus da khong zhang lha'i srib tu 'gro gi zhes pas zhang lha zhes thogs/ da pha gi gnam g.yer ram gnam la sprin med dwangs gtsang nger bsdad pa de nas 'gro gi zhes pas sa cha der gnam g.yer zhes thogs/ da lung pa de yi phu la 'gro gi zhes pas grib phu pa zhes pa de nas byung / de nas la rgyag dus lha lung dpal rdor chibs pa dkar por chibs yod pas la de yi ming la rta dkar la zhes pa/ lung pa'i phu la dkar mo rong zhes pa'i brag phug cig yod pa der khong sgrub pa mdzad de bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus yod la brag phug de'i nang brag brkos ri mo mang po yod ces grib pas brjod kyi 'dug mdor na grib khul gyi sa ming dag dang lha lung dpal rdor gyi lo rgyus dbar 'brel ba gting zab yod cing sa cha'i ming de tsho dus da lta'ang 'bod bzhin yod pa ni skabs de'i lo rgyus dngos la zhib 'jug byed par sman nges yin pa brjod med red/dugrib la gnas sdod byed mkhan gyi mi ser dag la grib pa gtor ma zhes pa de ni/sgro 'dogs sogs gang yang min par yul de'i lugs srol goms gshis la brten nas byung ba yin/ gang lags she na rtse pho brang dang gtsug lag khang sogs nas lha la phul zin pa'i mchod pa mar bshams dus/ grib pa'i mi tshang che chung dang dbul phyug sogs gang la'ang ma bltos par tshang mas gtor ma nyo ba'i lugs srol yod par grib pa gtor zan ma zhes 'bod/ de'i 'byung khungs sngar srong btsan sgam po'i skabs la blon po mgar ba grib ngos la phyir 'bud btang nas/ grib la mgar tshang shar nub zhes pa de bzhengs te bzang btson lta bur bzhag nas lto chas kyi tshod der gtor ma skyel gyi yod/361

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de nas grib pas gtor ma nyos nas za ba'i rgyun srol dar ba yin/ gtor mde'u dag nyos ma thag lam seng za gi med/ de lo 'khor ma skam rjes chu dang ja dang sbang nas za gi yod/ brjod srol la de ni blon po mgar ba'i byin rlabs yin zhes so/ /medumemedhidus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung srid gsum skye 'gro'i srog bdag mthu stobs yongs kyi bdag po kong ma grib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal gyi gtor chog cha tshang 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rjodapa' bo'i bu ni sog zhwa gyon pa lo bcu gcig tsam yin/ dpa' mo ni bu mo chung chung lo bcu tsam yin/ mda' dar gro so phye mar nang la btsugs pa dang de rdzong btsan gyi sku mdun du phyag gnyis kyis yar bkyags pa dang zhal dkar yar btegs nas bstod pa'i bsngags brjod 'di ltar 'bul gyi yod de/ bshal brag mtho ba'i mgo la/ / thog reg skas 'dzegs btsugs yod/ / dbu rgyan mtshar ba'i mgo la/ /sman rtsa'i yol ba btang yod/ / g.yas la mkha' 'gro bzhugs yod/ / g.yon la lha lcam bzhugs yod/ / bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par/ / khyed kyis gnang rogs gnang dang / / bkris lha yi khang bzang / / kun gyi nyi ma zla ba/ / 'dzam gling sa chu phrad song / / mun pa gsal rogs gnang dang / / la zhus pa'i rtswa legs la/ / rtswa la zil pa khrum khrum/ / chu la nya mo 'khyug 'khyug / bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ / phyag dang mchod pa phul yod/ /yab la dga' yum la dgyes/ /dhirdzong btsan gyi bshad pa/ rmog la gling bzhi zur bzhi/ /dom lpags a sin khra bo/ /gnyen lha tshogs bzhugs dang / / mtshon gri gral bzhugs dang / / rgya gri ngar mos dgra srog / 'phrog byed la bzhugs/ / dpa' dam bzang po sha zas/ /khrag 'thung la bzhugs dang / / brag stod seng ge 'gyings pa ltar/ / dkyil la dngul gyi rdo rje 'dra/ / brag gsham khyung gshog rgyas pa 'dra/ / dgra lha gnyan po brtan du btsugs/ /dga' ba yin dga' ba yin/ / dgyes pa yin dgyes pa yin//bla ma bzang po blo bzang grags pa bzhugs/ /byin rlabs bzhag la red/ / dgos 362

༄༅//lha sa'i grib rdzong btsan gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/'dod shwa ba min yang / / bstan srung zhus pa na/ / dmag zor rgyal mo la zhus/ /mthu btsan gzhan la re dgos de/ / shwa ba zhig min yang / / dgra lha bzang po rdzong btsan/ / snying po la zhus dang / rgyab btsan gzhan la zhu dgos de/ /la shwa ba zhig min yang / / dga' bzhin min nam/ / dgyes bzhin min nam/ / 'ja' mtshon rnam par bkra ba/ / rgyal ba la bso bso/ / gangs ljongs sa yi steng gi/ / dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa/ / dus gsum bzhugs pa'i mgon po/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po/ / rgya mtsho'i mtha' nas bzhugs pa'i/ / me tog tā la'i 'od zer/ / me tog bzhugs sa mtho la 'gyogs/ / 'dzam gling 'od kyis khengs song / / byang nas byang sprin shig shig / lho nas lho sprin shig shig / gter bdag chen mo'i dbu nas//gser gyi nyi zla shar song / / nam mkha'i g.ya' la kha btags dkar po/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma phebs kyi yod pa shes byung / / sa gzhi'i mi la thogs pa'i sgro mdung / / 'go 'dren dpon po phebs kyi yod pa shes byung / / bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs pa/ /a ma chang ma phebs kyi yod pa shes byung / / phyogs bzhi bag gro phebs kyi yod pa shes byung / /megrib rdzong btsan dang grib pa'i dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa ni/ gal te yul la rkun jag byung nas sems can sogs rku 'khyer shor ba'am brlags gtor byung tshe grib rdzong btsan gyi sku mdun du bcar nas/ blta ris zhes cho lo'i mo rgyag gi yod pa de'ang cho lo gru bzhi phyogs brgyad la sngags yig rkang re bris yod de/ cho lo dbyugs ma thag phyogs gang babs pa de'i logs kyi sngags yig gzhir bzung / mo'i dpe char blta bsdur byas nas sems can brlags gtor byung ba de tsho kha phyogs gang sar yod med dang shi zin pa'am bsdad yod med bcas brtag gi yod/⑪grib rdzong btsan bzhugs yul lha khang nang la chu sngon po zhig 'dug pa brjod srol la de ni sngar mi tshang shar sgo nub sgo lho sgo gsum yod par/ nub sgo'i nang la dred mong gi snying rdo red ces chu rdo sngon po zhig yod pa de ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i ’’363

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rjes su dgon pa de bzhengs rjes su mi tshang des der phul pa zhig red/ dbyibs dang tshos gzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i chu rdo sngon po de dgon pa 'dir chos mjal la phebs mkhan yongs kyi lus stod la 'jog tsam byed kyi yod pa ni/ brjod srol la des lus kyi khrag shed nyams pa dang gcong nad sogs phog tshe de'i kha thug la phur tsam byas na mgyogs nas myur du drag skyed du 'gro gi yod pa'ang / nad pa mang po zhig thengs gnyis pa yong dus rdo de legs po yod lugs dang lus po yongs kyang seng nger phyin zhing lus khams gsal dwangs su gyur pa'i lo rgyus bshad kyi yod skad/364

༄khya//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/bod gangs can ljongs kyi lo rgyus thog lha ldan ni chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / chos lugs gang ci'i thad gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i lte gnas shig yin/ lhag don du der mchis pa'i rin thang bral ba'i gna' shul rig gnas sogs bgrang gis mi langs pa'i nang / rtse pho brang po tā la'i zhol gyi gna' shul rig gnas ni mkha' dbyings skar tshogs dbus na rab tu bkra ba'i nam langs skar chen bzhin shin tu mtshar zhing dngar ba zhig lags/ 'on tang da bar de'i lo rgyus sogs la zhib phra'i rtog zhib gnang mkhan cung nyung bar brten/ da lam nga tshos rgyal khab kyi gal che'i gna' shul lo rgyus dang rig gnas sogs myur skyob byed rgyur dmigs te/ zhol na mchis pa'i mkhyen ldan pa'i bdag po rgan rabs 'ga' la bcar 'dri zhus nas/ rgyal rabs lo rgyus sogs kyi nang du ma 'khod pa'i rin thang ldan pa'i gna' shul 'ga' zhig gi lo rgyus rags rim 'di bris pa la 'khrul ba dang nongs pa mang dag mchis pa gdon mi za bas/ mkhyen ldan rnams nas dgongs 'char lhug por gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/zhol zhes pa rtse pho brang chen po'i gsham du gnas yod gshis rjes grub kyi tha snyad cig yin/ zhol na mchis pa'i gna' shul grags can gyi spyaṭ+wāṃ ma

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod gong zhol pa las khungs kyi skor rags tsam brjod na/ de ni sngar lha sa'i gling skor phyi dang zhol 'og rdzong gzhis bco brgyad la khral bsdu khrims gnon byed mkhan gyi srid 'dzin las khungs grags can zhig yin pa dang /lo rgyus kyi deb ther la gzhigs na tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gong / dmar po ri'i 'og zhol lcags ri phyi nang du zhol pa'i khrims 'doms byed mkhan mi sna 'ga' shas las med par snang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos lor (spyi lo 1675)sde srid blo bzang sbyin pas zhol las khungs btsugs pa nas bzung / lha sa'i gling skor gyi phyi phyogs la gnas pa'i yul grong khag dang /rdzong gzhis bco brgyad la gyod don che rigs thag gcod byed mi thub pa dag bka' shag la snyan seng zhu dgos pa phud/ de byings zhol pa las khungs kyi las 'dzin zhol gnyer ser skya thun mong gis thag gcod byed kyi yod/gling skor nang tshud kyi khyim dud dang mi tshang sger pa che 'bring chung gsum la lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngos khrims 'doms byed pa las dus rgyun du snang rtse shag las khungs kyis khrims 'doms bka' bkod byed kyi yod/ zhol pa las khungs kyi rgyun gtan do dam byed mkhan zhol gnyer zhes ser skya gnyis rim pa lnga pa'i go gnas yod cing / lo rgyus thog zhol gnyer rim pa bzhi pa dang dza sag tha'e ji'i go gnas yod pa'ang kha shas byung 'dug kha rgyun la khong tshor sde pa zhol pa zhes brjod kyi 'dugade min yang gnyer chung drung gtogs mi gnyis dang khang gnyer mi gcigadrung yig nyi shu tsam dang de'i 'og la nang zan nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas yod par rtag tu zhol pa ngo las zhes 'bod/ zhol pa las khungs kyi steng shod phyi nang sogs rang khungs so sor gad bdar gtsang sbra dang me rkun srung bya byed mkhan gad pa 366

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/mi brgyad yod la zhol lcags ri phyi nang dang lha sa'i gling skor phyir gnas pa'i mi ser khag la brda lan sprod mkhan gyi bcu dpon mi bzhi bcas yod pa ni zhol pa las khungs kyi spyir btang gi sgrig gzhi lags/de yang zhol pa las khungs kyi bka' bkod khrims 'doms su tshud pa'i rdzong gzhis bco brgyad ni/ 1 tshal/ 2 chos lung / 2 bde chen rdzong /4 'brom thod gzhis ka 5 sne'u rdzong / 6 rnam rgyal sgang gzhi ka 7 shel grong gzhis karjo rdo sbrags gzhis ka kha phreng sgo gzhis ka 1kya lum pa sa tshigs/ 11 'jang gzhis ka 12 gnam/ 12 gdong dkar rdzong / 14 snye thang gser khang gzhis ka 15 glang ru gzhis ka16 lho mos gzhis ka 17 grwa bzhi gzhis ka 1ṭ+wāṃ 'bras bu gling gzhis ka (phalha'i yin/)bcas yin/ gsham du zhol gyi gna' shul lo rgyus rags bsdus shig brjod na/ma ṇi lha khang / lha khang de yab gzhis g.yu thog gis bzhengs par grags/ de'i nang la ma ṇi chen po zhig yod cing de'i phyi phyogs nub ngos kyi gyang ldebs su yig tshang las khungs kyis bkram pa'i rtsa tshig gam bka' rgya sogs gsal po bkod yod la da dung lugs gnyis khrims bdag gi bdag dbang mtshon ched kyi gzhung dam che chung gnyis brgyab 'dug pa gsal po mthong rgyu 'dugadamagaspyi khang / de ni dmag spyi ngo las kyi gzhung las khang yin zhing bod yig ka mad sum cu gzhir bzhag gis rim par bsgrigs pa'i dmag sgar mda' kha che chung yongs kyi lte gnas kyang yin/ kho tshos bka' shag gi 'og tu las ka byed dgos/ de'i 'og khang nang la rdzas mdel dang / mda' gri 367

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdung / me mda' bcas mtshon cha sna tshogs/ ya sor gyi chas gos dbu rmog khrab la sogs pa tshang ma 'jog sa'i bang mdzod phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ dmag spyi khang de khang pa thog brtsegs bzhi ldan brjid chags pa zhig lags/ de'i dbu rtser mgon khang zhig yod cing nang la srung ma dmar nag gnyis yod/ dus rgyun du srung ma de gnyis gsol mkhan dang bskang gso gtong mkhan dag rnying ma'i grags can byang gnas dgon pa ste rdo rje brag nas dge 'dun gnyis gsum tsam yong dgos/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i gtor rgyag skabs su srung ma dmar nag gi rten thug gdan 'dren zhu mkhan 'dam brgya shog brgyad nas mi go thang gnyis dhiyong dgos pa dang chibs ra sbug nas chibs chen gsum dang chibs ra mdo nas dkyus rta 'ga' shas gtong dgos/dgra 'dul khang / de ni dmag spyi khang gi rgyab logs su yod cing de'i thog brtsegs gnyis par las shag 'ga' shas dang rtse drung dkyus ma rta sogs gang yang med pa tsho sdod kyi yod/ shod la dmag spyi khang gi rdzas me sogs 'jog sa yin pas gal 'gangs shin tu che bar 'dzin/zhol par khang shar/ thog brtsegs gnyis can gyi khang bzang de lo rgyus shin tu ring ba'i par khang rnying ma zhig yin/ de'i shod du gangs can mkhas pa du mas dka' ba brgya phrag spyad nas ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum gyi par shing grangs las 'das pa bzhag yod/ de'i steng du rtse drung dang jo lags sogs sdod sa'i shag yod/shar sgo'i thog zhol lcags ri'i rdo bkyag ring po yod sa'i shar sgo der brjod cing de'i steng gi khang pa ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung dmag spyi khang 368

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/gi dmag phogs 'bru rigs 'jos/ sa yin zhing der do dam byed mkhan rtse drung zhig yod/ spyir dmag phogs dus tshod nges med la rgyag dgos pas 'bru rigs sogs gra sgrig ang gsar dgos/ sgo de nas 'grul bzhud byed mkhan mang che ba ni rdo bkyag ring po'i 'khris la sdod mkhan gyi mi ser dang /tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon shar la zhal phyogs nas phebs skabs/ de phyogs nas thon gyi yod kyang rgyun du ltag sgo nas phebs kyi yod/dkyil 'khor rnying pa/ rdo bkyag ring po'i 'og tu yod pa'i skya mi'i khyim tshang dkyus ma zhig gi shag yin/ sngar der tshong khang chung ngu zhig yod kyang phyis su jo lags shig gis de'i nang mi ser gyi phru gu dang nang zan gyi phru gur yi ge slob kyi yod/mkhanazur/ rtse pho brang na mchis pa'i mkhan po tshang gi sku ngo spyi khyab mkhan po'i rjomakhan thog cig gi sdod shag yin pas ming de ltar thogs/khong phyag las la phebs skabs rtse pho brang gi las shag la sdod kyi yod pa las der log yong gi med/ de'i 'khor g.yog phyag mdzod sogs gtan sdod byed sa lte ba'ang de yin/mkhan zur rta ra/ de bde skyid shar gyi byang shar ngos la gnas yod/de mkhan zur sger pa'i rta 'jog sa'i rta ra yin pas ming de ltar thogs/ de snga de'i nang la a drung rta mgrin sdod kyi yod cing de'i 'khris su mkhan zur mdzo ra zhes pa'ang yod/nam mkha' gzhis kha/ de chibs ra g.yung drung lag 'khyud kyi nang du gzhung zhabs pa tshos bsten pa'i lha ste/ rgyal po sku lnga'i nang gses sam gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan gyi sku 'khor chibs ra rgyal po'i sku khog bud med 369

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de'i shag yin zhing / sku khog mtha' ma de'i ming la nyi ma lags zhes khong gi mi tshang de mi rabs du ma'i ring chibs ra'i lha'i sku khog byed myong yod/ nyi ma lags kyi pha ma'i dus su nam mkha' gzhis kha'i sku khog lags zhes skad grags shin tu chen po yod/ yang chibs ra rgyal po gsol dus gzhung gi bla phyag nas ja mar dang sde pa zhol pa nas rtsam pa bcas kyi gtong sgo btang srol yod par grags/spos rdung khang / de ni gzhung gi gzims spos bzo sa yin/ de'i 'gan khur mkhan ni rtse drung las bya zhig yod/ de nas bzos pa'i gzims spos thams cad tshos mdog rgya smug can/ sbom phra snyoms shing spus legs sha stag yod cing / dri bsung shugs che ba/ khang pa'i nang la bdugs tshe dri zhim sgo ra'i nang sogs phyogs gang sar khyab/ nam zhag rgyun du de'i shod la spos rdung sa'i gtun khung chen po bcu grangs shig gral bsgrigs nas bzhag yod/ gzims spos dngos su bzo sa thog brtsegs gnyis pa'i nang la yin zhing bzo mi tshos lag zung gis shugs mnyam par btsir rjes zhal ba'i sgang na legs par bkram/ spos rdung khang gi steng thog la rgyal khang gru bzhi chung chung zhig yod pa/ spos rdung mkhan tshos de'i nang gi spos lha gsol ba'i cho ga rgyas po gtong srol yod/ kho tshos spos lha gsol yas de don chen zhig la brtsis nas dang dod chen po byed srol yod pa de ni spos las legs nyes ji byung thad kar spos lha dang 'brel ba yod par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de nas thon pa'i gzims spos dag bla ma che khag gi gzims chung dang chos phyogs kyi cho ga gang yin la bed spyod byed par ma zad/ lhag don du de ni lha ldan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lag shes thon khungs legs po zhig ste/ phyi rgyal sogs kyi sku 370

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/mgron la ma jal slog gi phyag rtags 'bul yas legs shos shig yin/ spos rdung mkhan tshang ma yar 'brog nas yong zhing spyir mi bcu grangs yod la thad ka'i 'go 'dzin byed mkhan la zhal ngo spos rdung dbu mdzad ces brjod/spyir gzims spos tshang ma dbyar dus rgyag gi yod pas de min dus tshigs nang spos rdung khang de khang stong la 'jog gi yod/ der dgos pa'i rgyu dngos dang 'gro song tshang ma rtse 'phral bde las khungs dang shod bla phyag las khungs gnyis nas gtong srol 'dug spos rdung mkhan khral khungs de gam pa la'i rgyab phyogs kyi yar 'brog la 'khri bas mi tshang ma de nas gtong dgos kyi yod/bzhes spro khang / gzhung gi bzhes spro bkrag sa'i khang chen zhig ste zhol lcags ri'i nang tshud kyi dbus su sgo ra chen po zhig gi nang du yod/ rtse 'phral bde las khungs nas do dam byas te lo gsar sogs kyi mdzad sgo ston chen tshugs dus bzhes spro phon chen sgrig gshom byed dgos pa rnams de nas mkho 'don byed dgos la/ dus rgyun tshes bzang dus bzang sogs kyi skabs su'ang bzhes spro sgrig dgos tshe tshang ma de nas bzos te mkho 'don byed kyi yod/ ston chen de lo gcig dus gcig gi mdzad sgo che ba'i gras shig yin la/ de ni lo legs gra rgyas dang ma nyams gong 'phel/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'am rten 'brel legs po yong ba'i smon 'dun gyi mdzad sgo thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ de'i sbyin bdag ste snum dang gro zhib sogs kyi 'gro songagatong mkhan lo ltar mi tshang mi 'dra ba thon gyi yod/ bzhes spro bkrag mkhan tshang ma zhol gyi mi ser sha stag yin zhing / bzhes spro de dag mdzad sgo'i skabs mi ser sogs la hab thob rgyag tu 'jug gi yod/ de'i go don ni bla ma grags can gyi lus sbyin pa btang ba'i tshul yin/ hab thob rgyag mkhan 371

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mang che ba grib pa dang / mur rtsa/ dkar kun/ ra ma sgang bcas skyid chu'i lho phyogs su gnas sdod bgyis pa'i mi ser dag dang chibs ra'i rta g.yog kyang tshang ma yong gi yod/ dbyar dus nor bu gling kha'i gzims chung dkar spro khang la bzhes spro bkrag mkhan de nas 'gro dgos/ de min tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung dbyar kha nor bu gling kha dang dgun kha rtse pho brang la bzhugs dus kyang bzhes spro phon chen bkrag dgos kyi yod pa tshang ma zhol bzhes spro khang gi las 'gan yin/shing ra/ zhol la shing ra khag gnyis yod/ gcig ni rnam rgyal shing ra ste rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi tshogs shing 'jog sa yin/ de spel bzhi'i gzims shag byang ngos kyi rgyab tsam la yod/ gzhan zhig ni mkhan po shing ra zhes mkhan po tshang gi shing ra yin zhing / de ni sgar chang gi kha sprod du yod/de'i shing gi yong khungs gtso bo mkhan po gling kha ste da lta'i rtse pho brang rgyab ngos kyi phru gu'i rtse mo rtse sa'i gling kha de'i rgyud la yin/ rtse mkhan po tshang ni rtse gsol thab kyi me shing la the jus do dam dang / bdag gnyer/ mkho 'don byed mkhan bcas yin zhing de'i khongs su da dung ku shu gling kha dudang bzhugs khri gling kha rjosogs yod/ des rtse shod gnyis la me shing sogs dgos pa ga dus sam gang du mchis pa mgyogs myur ngang mkho 'don byed dgos/me sgrogs khang / de snga der zangs kyis bzos pa'i me skyogs gcig yod/ lha ldan smon lam gtor rgyag skabs la de rtse drung gling kha'i nang la dbor rting der sa ldel ldel zhig yod pa de'i sgang la bzhag nas glud phyir spyugs byed dus/ skyid chu'i lho phyogs su mchis pa'i bya skyag dkar po zhes ri de tsam gyis mthon po med pa rtse pho brang la rgyab bstan nas yod pa der sdigs 372

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/khungs sprad nas rgyag gi yod/ me skyogs rgyag mkhan tshang mas mi re la gur chung re phub nas de ga rang la sdod/ de yang me skyogs khag gsum tsam yod pa ni srin mo dang / lkugs pa/ si ral bcas yin cing me skyogs lkugs pa de dus rgyun du zhol gyi shar phyogs la 'jog cing de ha cang che bas phar tshur dbor 'dren byed dus mi lnga bcu drug cu tsam med tshe 'gul skyod gtong thub kyi med/ me skyogs srin mo de rta yis 'khyer thub/ me skyogs si ral de'ang ha cang chen po yod pas mi drug cu bdun cu tsam med tshe dbor 'dren byed thub kyi med/ de'i mde'u thon sa'i kha'i nang la mi'i mgo shong thub/ mde'u zha nye ril ril rkang rtsed spo lo'i che chung tsam yod cing grib phyogs la 'phen skabs nam mkha' la 'gro ba dngos su mthong thub/ me skyogs 'phen zin rting de'i mde'u sgrug mkhan ni gar phrug pa dang gzim chung ba yin/ gal te mde'u ri'i mdun ngos la bab yod tshe/ gzim chung bas sgrug pa dang ri'i rgyab ngos la bab tshe gar pas grib pa la bskul nas sgrug tu bcug brjod srol la thengs gcig mde'u zhig rnying ma'i dgon sde grags can rdo rje brag sgo ra'i dbus kyi rdo bcal thog la bab nas sa dong chags pas/ de'i shul la shing shug pa dkar po zhig btab yod pa de da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod skad/dngul par khang / sngar dus rabs bco brgyad dang bcu dgu'i nang bed spyod btang myong ba'i bod dngul bzo sa/ de dag zangs dmar las bzos pa sha stag yin/ de la dbye na kha gang dang kha gang zur brgyad/ phyed brgyad/ zho gang / skar ma bcas yod/ dngul khang de'i nang la sku'ang sna tshogs par 'debs byed kyi yod ces brjod/ (phyis su bed spyod btang myong ba'i bod dngul shog lor de dag ni gra bzhi nas par 'debs byas pa yin/)373

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chab drel/ rtse pho brang gi gsol thab la chab chu skyel mkhan der brjod/lcags po ri'i byang ngos sman chu (deng 'khyag sha'i mdzod khang gi sgo ra'i nang du tshud yod/)zhes chu mig shin tu gtsang zhing byin rlabs can zhig yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung gi chab chu bzhes yas thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin pas tshang mas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu zhes 'bod/ kho tshos de nas chab chu blangs te drel la bkal nas rtse pho brang rgyab kyi ltag sgo'i 'khris su zom chen du ma mchis pa de dag nang blugs shing / gsol thab pas de nas rung khang nang du 'dren/ de'i do dam pa ni chab drel zhal ngo zhes drung gtogs pa mi gnyis dang rta drel lag do gnyis yod/ zhal ngos tshe gang ring de'i 'gan bzhes gtsang len gyis 'phyugs pa med pa byed kyi yod/ kho'i las rogs byed mkhan lag do zhes mi bdun brgyad tsam yod/ kho tshos dus rgyun du snam ser thig gi phyu pa gyon nas chab chu drel la yar bkal ba dang mar 'bebs pa bcas dka' las mang po rgyag dgos kyang / sun 'tsher gtan nas byed lugs med/ tā la'i bla ma phyogs la phebs dus khong tsho'i nang nas 'jon thang che ba khag gcig sku bcar la 'gro dgos/ chab g.yog rgyug mkhan tshor nang khral rgyug mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal yod/ deng sang sngar shul mthong rgyu yod pa tsam las chu spus legs de skam nas thigs pa tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dugabakras khang / de ni gur khang bkris khang gsar zhes thog brtsegs gsum ldan gyi khang bzang legs po zhig yod/ de'i thog brtsegs nyis thog dang gsum thog la sku drag sger pa khag gi sdod gnas dang shod la gzhung gi dbu gur che chung tshos gzhi mi 'dra ba sna tshogs mchis pa'i mdzod khang yin/374

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/lhag don de'i nang tā la'i bla ma phyogs la phebs dus 'bubs byed kyi dbu gur spus legs phying gur sogs yod/ de bzhin spyir mkho'i ca dngos phon chen mchis pa tshang ma der 'jog gi yod/gdan gnyer tshang / zhol dbus kyi bkras khang rgyal sgo'i lho ru yod/thog mar mi tshang dkyus ma zhig gi shag yin/ rjes su mi tshang de gra je rgyas dang phun sum je tshogs su phyin rting / de nas gzhung zhabs rtse mgron dang shod mgron sogs rtse gnyer tshang du las ka byed thub mkhan gyi go gnas gang la gang 'tshams yod pa'i mi chen mang po thon myong yod/ des na khong tsho dbang thang chen po yod cing rtag tu tshong mang po rgyag gi yod stabs rgyu stobs chen po chags/ de bzhin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung gi gsol ja 'bul mkhan yang der gtan sdod byed kyi yod/gzhung sgo rnying pa/ de'i nang dbus ni nag khung yin/ dus rtag tu mi rta sogs 'grul bzhud byed dus de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi lam chung brgyud de 'gro dgos/ thog sa gnyis par tshoms chen zhig yod pa ni gzhung gi zhabs brtan byed sa yin zhing brgya khag ces ser 'bras dang rgyud grwa stod smad dwags po grwa tshang sogs nas dge 'dun brgya bskongs nas tshe sgrub kyi zhabs brtan byed kyi yod/ de'i gtong sgo tshang ma rtse phyag dang bla phyag nas btang gi yod la zhabs brtan mang che ba dbyar dus su sgrub dgos shing /gtso bo'i nang don ni gzhung nas thugs gtan ga re 'khel ba de rang rkang bzung nas byed dgos/ thog brtsegs gsum pa'i mdzod khang nang na zhabs brtan skabs kyi gtong sgo 'bru mar ja tshwa sogs 'jog pa las dus rgyun du stong par 'jog la de'i nub ngos la lo gcig dus bzhir khang gnyer gcig gtan 375

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sdod byed/ de'i las 'gan gtso bo ni khang pa de dag la char chus skyon btang ba'ang rang byung gi skyon chag byung tshe/ lam seng yar gzhung la snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang / nam shag rgyun du khos gad pa bzhin gad phyis gtsang spra'i 'gan 'khur nas sdod kyi yod/dga' byang / de ni sger pa mi tshang chen po zhig yin/ dga' byang bstan pa'i dus la khyung ram dang mnyam du rgyang 'bud btang / khyung ram stod ru thog la phud pa dang bstan pa gsang sngags chos rdzong la phud/ de skabs kho tshos lus la phyu pa dkar po zhig g.yog cing glang gog sgang la bskyon nas lha sa'i khrom la skor ba zhig rgyag tu bcug nas phyir 'bud btang skad/btsan khang / zhol gyi khyim dud khag gcig gis bsten pa'i yul lha ste chu rgyud rgyal po zhes pa de'i sku khog gi sdod shag yin/ lha de'i zhal 'bag dmar po zhig mchis pa de zhol shar sgo'i byang phyogs dmar po ri'i shar ngos brag zur na mkhar sna gdong zhes lha khang chung chung zhig gi nang na mchod yod/sngar 'dzam gling spyi bsangs skabs la zhol btsan khang nas sku khog ngo phebs thog lngags skyems gtong ba dang sku bsang phul nas/ lha dngos su phebs rting bka' lung gnang ba sogs cho ga rgyas po zhig byed kyi yod skad/ de zla re'i tshes gsum la 'char can gsol dgos kyang spyir bod tshes bco lnga'i gong la ma gtogs nyi shu'i nang la gsol ba'i lugs srol mi 'dug de'i sku khog gzhung gi lto zan pa skyes pa zhig yin/spelabazhi/ de ni gzhung gi sku drag cig gi khyim tshang yin cing kho tsho'i khyim rgyud dngos ni gtsang gi pa rnam spel bzhi zhes pa de yin/ dus rabs bcu dgu'i lo rabs bzhi bcu 'go tshugs ma thag la sing dpung 'jug skabs 376

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/mi tshang de nas yin pa'i mda' dpon spel bzhi zhes pa des stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dmag sar byon te byas rjes chen po bzhag pas rim bzhi'i go gnas dang bcas zhabs pad byed myong 'dug de min mi tshang de nas spel bzhi mda' bzang zhes mda' dpon chen po mda' rtsed la mchog tu gyur pa'i zhal ngo zhig kyang byung myong yod/rtsisakha khang / de'i nang la e pa yon bdag ces e pa'i dbu 'dzin dang e pa dkyus ma khag gcig sdod kyi yod/ kho tshos gzhung gi yig tshang sogs kyi dbu can tshang ma bris shing yig gzugs la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan yod/ e phrug ces chung dus nas lha sar 'khrid yong nas dbu can legs po bslab ste rgan lon rjes dbu can tshang ma kho tshor 'bri ru bcugakhong tsho lho kha'i e lha rgya ri nas yin stabs e pa zhes pa'i ming thogs/mu bya/ sngar chang tshang gi khongs su gtogs kyang rjes su mu bya'i khyim rgyud la bdag skad/ gang lags she na lo rgyus thog mi tshang de'i mi thog cig gi skabs la byas rjes chen po bzhag pas de'i yon du chang tshang nub ngos kyi sa cha de byung zhing / der sger shag brgyab rjes rang gi ming de shag ming du thogs pa red/ mdor na de ni sku drag sger pa dkyus ma mu bya zhes pa de'i shag yin/chang tshang / de ni sngar pho brang po ta la bzhengs dus srung ma'i ljags skyems 'bul sa'i chang khang yin pas ming de ltar thogs/ rjes su jo lags tsho gzhung las grol mtshams su rtag tu der yong nas chang btung ba dang sbrags so sos 'khyer ba'i sha khug che chung 'tshams po zhig mchis pa de nas sha skam po bton te rgya gri phor shubs dhikyi gri spyad de byed bzo dod pos phan tshun ngom so 377

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byed bzhin za yi yod skad/gosasku khang / de ni gos sku blugs sa'i lha khang ser po thog brtsegs gnyis ldan zhig yin/ de'i nang la 'od dpag med dang rnam par snang mdzad sman bla gtso bor gyur pa'i gos sku che chung legs zhan sna tshogs yod/de 'grems dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu'i nyin glud 'gong phyir sgyugs byed pa dang tshes sum cu nyin tshogs mchod ser sbreng skabs pho brang chen por gnod pa dang bgegs bar chad sogs mi yong bar de dag g.yol thabs ched du gos sku 'grems kyi yod/mtshams khang / bla ma rgyud pa'i bsnyen mtshams bzhugs yul yin zhing yang der bla ma rgyud pa'i dge slong khag gcig gdan 'dren zhus nas bskang gso gtong ba dang zhabs brtan byed du 'jug gi yod/dam chen khang / de ni thog brtsegs gnyis ldan gyi khang bzang gser mdog can zhig yin/ de'i nang gi rten gtso ste dam can mgar ba nag po'i sku brnyan de thog ma rtse pho brang du yod dus zhal mar zhol la phyogs nas bzhag yod/ brjod srol la de thugs gshis ha cang btsan zhing shin tu drag pas/zhol lcags ri'i nub phyogs brag sgo ka ling nas yar phebs mkhan gyi dpon rigs dag dang tha na a drung dang bong rdzi/ drel pa/ grong gseb kyi mi ser bcas pa tshang ma rta dang bong bu sogs las mar babs shing / phyu pa'i phu thung phud pa yar gyon dgos pa dang zhwa mo gyon pa mar phud pa/ sked par 'dogs pa'i gri mar bkrol ba/ rta bong la btags pa'i g.yer kha'am ling shang dung rag tshang ma bkrol nas yar gnyom chung spam bzo dod cing bab chags kyis yong dgos/ de ltar ma byas pa yin na rta thog nas lhung ba'am 378

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/rang sar brgya la gzer brgyab pa'am kha nas khrag skyugs pa sogs bgegs dang bar chad brjod kyis mi lang ba yong gi yod skad/ rjes su zhol la dam chen khang bzhengs nas/ dam chen mgar ba nag po der gdan 'dren ma zhus thabs med byung skad/ de bzhin zhol la rku shor dang rang byung gnod 'tshe sogs rkyen ngan ci rigs byung tshe zhol pa tshos der bsangs gsol gtong dgos kyi yod/ yang gar pa tshos rtse la gar ma 'khrab gong so so'i gri dag mtshan mo gcig ring dam chen khang nang la bzhag nas gar legs po 'khrab thub pa'i smon lam 'debs kyi yod/ de dang de 'dra ba'i byed sgo tshang ma'i gtong sgo thams cad gzhung nas ched mngags gtong gi yod/ de min zhol pa las khungs nang la'ang dam chen yod pa de la gsol mchod rgyun du chad med gtong dgos kyi yod/ mchod zur bzhugs yul de yang dam chen khang gi 'khris su yod/ khong rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi sku zhabs gras shig yin zhing dus rgyun du mchod pa sna tshogs bzhengs nas dus 'da'/zhol btson khang / de'i ming gzhan la spang steng thog kha zhes brjod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gong la der karma bka' brgyud pa'i chos grwa ka brgyad ma zhig bzhengs yod pas gnas rtsa chen zhig yin/ sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs la sog po'i dmag shugs la brten nas gatreng pa sde srid dang / de'i lag 'brel ba karma bka' brgyud par rgol rdung drag po sprad rjes/ zhol na mchis pa'i karma bka' brgyud pa'i dbang shugs mtshon rtags chos grwa ka brgyad ma de gtor te/ de'i nang na mchis pa'i bzhugs khri'i sgang la nyes can la khrims gcod gtong sa'i zhol btson khang de brgyab skad/ spyir btson pa tshang ma btson khang gi shar ngos der bzhag cing / de'i dbus tsam 379

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la 'dom gang gru bzhi zhes gnam sgo rgyag rgyu yod pa'i khang chung gru bzhi zhig yod/ der nag can tshabs chen tshang ma 'jug par byed/ 'dom gang gru bzhi de cung chung la brlan gsher che ba dang ri mtshams rdo dum du mas gtams gshis/ dug can gyi 'bu sdig pa rwa nyag kyang mang po yod/mdzorma ra/ (gsol mgo ra/)zhol las khungs 'og sgo shar la phyogs pa de yin cing / rtse gsol thab kyi gsol zho dang 'o ma tshang ma de nas mkho 'don byed dgos kyi yod la lo gcig dus bzhi'i ring nyi ma gcig kyang chad med gra sgrig ang gsar byed dgos/ der do dam byed mkhan ni rtse'i gsol thab shar nub gnyis kyi 'gan 'dzin las bya ba zhig yin/ kho'i go gnas rtse drung dang gcig mtshungs lags/ mdzo mo rar khyon bsdoms mdzo mo sum cu lhag tsam yod/ de dag nam rgyun 'dam ra'i dhinub tu dmigs bsal gyi na kha legs po zhig mchis pa der 'tsho yi yod/chibs ra sbyag chibs ra mdo sbug gnyis kyi phyi'i gzugs dbyibs ni rtag pa'am 'gyur ba med pa g.yung drung dbyibs can zhig yod pas dus rgyun chibs ra g.yung drung lag 'khyud ces brjod/ de gnyis kyi 'gan 'dzin gtso bo chibs dpon chen mo gnyis sam drung 'khor gnyis te las tshan pa'i go gnas yod cing / drung yig gcig kyang yod pa des dus rgyun du sde pa zhol la las ka byed cing chibs rar do 'khur gcig lcogs byed/ da dung rta zam zhal ngo gcig bcas yod pas chibs ra mdo sbug gnyis la khyon zhal ngo lnga yod/chibs ra sbug ma'i nang las ka byed mkhan zhal ngo gcig dang lag do bdun tsam yod/ chibs ra sbug ma de ni chibs chen duzhes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung ser 'bras dge sogs phyogs la phebs dus chibs yas kyi chibs 380

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/chen dang / lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs dmag spyi khang gi mgon khang srung ma dmar nag gnyis kyi rten thug gdan 'dren zhu byed chibs chen gsum/gnas chung srid pa'i lha chen gyi sku khog gdan 'dren zhu skabs gser sga bsgron pa'i chibs chen bcas chibs pa legs shos de dag 'jog sa yin/ gal te 'di nas chibs pa btang khom ma byung tshe nor gling chibs ra nas g.yar po zhu dgos/ de'i tshe sngon la spyi khyab mkhan po brgyud nas yar snyan seng 'bul gyi yod pa ni khong gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung su yin la snyan dar dang bcas chibs pa ci tsam dgos min zhus/ gong nas chog mchan thob ma thag chibs chen ga tshod dgos min dus thog tu gtong gi yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung ngam srid skyong chibs byed kyi chibs pa na rgas nad sogs kyi rkyen pas shi tshe dkyil 'khor mthil la skyel ba'am chu la bshams dgos/ chibs ra sbug ma 'di'i nang la chibs pa bcu grangs shig yod/chibs ra mdo/ chibs ra mdo ma de'ang khag gnyis su phye ste sba zhi nub dang sba zhi shar yin/ de gnyis la dbu 'dzin zhal ngo re yod/ shar nub re la rta bco lnga re yod pas khyon bsdoms rta sum cu tham pa mchis/ de snga zhal ngo gnyis pos rta rgyug cing rta 'ul slog pa'i las ka byed dgos kyi yod kyang rjes su so nam las khungs nas lag do bzhi btang / kho tshos sa gnas khag lnga la bka' rgya skyel dgos shing / a drung dang / drung 'khor/ rtse drung sogs phyi la 'gro skabs rta 'ul gyi rta tshang ma chibs ra mdo nas gtong dgos kyi yod/ de dus drung 'khor dang rtse drung su yin rung lam yig nang gsal rta 'ul dgos rigs lam seng gtong gi med/ dbyar gyi dus su gzhes brda rjodang dgun gyi dus su gnangs brda ⑫gtong dgos/ de min lam yig 381

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs skyel mkhan chibs ra'i a drung yitsho phyogs la ga dus thon dgos kyang chibs rta lam seng gtong chog dgos/ dper na bka' shag gam dmag spyi khang ngam rtse yig tshang sogs ga nas thon dgos pa'i bka' brda 'byor ma thag de ma nyid du thon dgos/ chibs ra mdo ma'i nang da dung rta zam zhal ngo gcig kyang yod/ khong gi las 'gan ni bka' shag grol rjes su mtshan gung gi bka' rgya skyel rgyu de yin/ dper na lho ngos gzhis ka dang tshal/ ra ma sgang / shel grong gzhis ka bcas su mtshan thon rkyang rkyang byas te gzhung gi dza drag che ba'i bka' rgya gang mgyogs ci mgyogs ngang skyel thub pa dgos/khong la lag do gcig las med/ gzims drel/ gzhung zhabs drel pa ste tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang sku 'khor phyogs la thon skabs bzhugs sgar gyi gzims mal dang gyon chas sogs yo byad skyel mkhan nam bdag gces byed mkhan gyi drel pa yin/de'i 'gan 'dzin zhal ngo la drung gtogs kyi go gnas yod cing / kho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni zhag sa nas zhag sa'i bar sdog chas rgyag rgyu dang sgrig cha byed rgyu phebs sgug zhu rgyu sogs 'char can bya 'os thams cad go sgrig gtan 'khel byed dgos/ kho tsho rgyun gtan lha sar sdod dus drel nyi shu rtsa grangs la bdag skyong byed dgos kyi yod/gzims drel jo lags/ chibs bcos pa yang zer zhing khong la zhal ngo'i go sa yod/ de'i las 'gan gtso bo ni zhol chibs ra'i chibs chen dang nor bu gling kha'i chibs chen/ chab drel/ gzims drel bcas kyi rta drel tshang mar sha gcod pa dang rta nad sna tshogs bcos kyi yod la/ rta'i rmig lcags rgyag pa sogs rta drel gyi g.yog bcos cha tshang byed mkhan zhig red/382

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/lcog steng / de ni zhol lcags ri'i lho nub mtshams su gnas pa'i lcog chen der zer zhing de'i thog brtsegs gnyis par sa gnas srid gzhung gi ta bla ma drung yig chen mo'i sdod shag yin/nub sgo'i thog de ni zhol lcags ri'i nub sgo'i thog gi khang bzang legs po der zer zhing / sngar rtse yig tshang las khungs kyi las bya rtse drung gi las shag yin/ der mchis pa'i khang mig yod do cog spus ka legs shing cha rkyen yag par brten tshang mas der thugs mnyes po zhe drag gnang gi yod/de'i shod du ni lcags ri'i nub kyi gzhung sgo yin/'dod 'jo'i dpal 'khyil/ bsdus ming la 'dod dpal zhes brjod cing zhol lcags ri phyi'i nub rgyud du yod/ de ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi lag shes bzo grwa gtso bo de yin/ der gser bzo dang dngul bzo/ lcags bzo/ zangs bzo/ tshags pa/ lugs pa bcas cha tshang yod/ gzhung la gser dngul dang lcags rigs sogs dgos mkho ci 'dra dgos kyang tshang ma de nas mkho 'don byed kyi yod/ brjod srol la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa pho brang chen po'i bzhugs khrir ma 'khod gong / der karma bka' brgyud pa'i dgon gsar zhes pa'i dgon pa shin tu che zhing grwa grangs stong phrag zin pa zhig yod skad/ rjes su sog po o rod tsho bzhi'i ya gyal ho hro the tsho pa'i 'go 'dzin chen po gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dge lugs pa'i dbu 'dzin ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor rgyab skyor shugs chen byas nas/ karma bka' brgyud gtor brlag btang ste dgon pa de mgar tshang du bsgyur skad/ de sngon 'dod 'jo dpal 'khyil khang gi sgo 'gram du shing las bzos pa'i seng ge rngam brjid ldan pa gnyis yod/ des sngar 'dir thun mong min pa'i dgon 383

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa zhig chags yod pa gsal po mtshon gyi 'dug de min zhol lcags ri'i nang gi karma bka' brgyud pa'i chos ra gru bzhi ma de btson khang du bsgyur ba dang tshogs tshugs sa de zhol pa las khungs su bsgyur pa red/ lha bab dus chen gong tsam la lha sa ru bzhi'i khang pa yongs la dkar rag gsol ba'i lugs srol mchis kyang / 'dod dpal gyi khang pa de dag la dkar rag rtsa ba nas gsol mi chog par nag po rang 'jags la bzhag srol yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos spyi lo 1754lor rtse slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang dus mtshungs su/ rtse po ta la'i gsham 'og gi zhol du sku brnyan 'bri bzhengs dang mchod chas sne mang 'tshem bzo byed sa'i bzo grwa 'dod dpal zhes pa dngos su gsar 'dzugs mdzad cing / lha ldan yongs nas bris tshugs thig tshad khungs dang ldan pa dang tshags lugs rdung sogs lag shes bzo rigs mkhas pa'i dbu lags che chung mang po bsdu 'gugs thog lag shes sbyong mkhan slob ma mang po gso skyong dang / de dag la 'tsho sdod 'dang nges kyi gla yon sprad cing bzo grwa bdag skyong mkhan dang do dam pa dmigs bsal 'dems bsko byas/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu tsam gyi nang la 'dod dpal de nyid rgyal rtse'i dmag sgar du bsgyur pa red/de min zhol 'dod dpal du bka' shin tu btsan pa'i lha mo grags can zhig yod/ deci ni 'dod dpal a bo zhes khong tsho'i 'go 'dzin zhig yod pa des do 'khur byas nas bsangs gsol dang gsol kha gtong gi yod/nasakhang chen mo/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa pho brang po ta la'i khrir 'khod rjes su sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho der bsdad nas nang bstan chos lugs la slob gnyer dang nyams len byed myong yod skad/ phyis su gzhung gi 384

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/nas 'jog sa'i bang mdzod che shos su gyur/ de na nas khang ngam nas kyi bang mdzod de'i nang bod zhing khul gyi 'bru rigs thon khungs legs shos gang sa nas bsdus pa'i 'bru'i khral rigs yod do cog der 'jog gi yod pas lo mang bed spyod ma btang ba'i dbang gis phon chen zhig rul nas dug 'bu sdig pa ra nyag chung chung grangs las 'das pa du mar gyur/ nas khang chen po'i steng thog la lo ltar lha ldan tshogs mchod chen mo'i skabs ser sbreng ste ser mo ba sha stag gis gtsug lag khang nas mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsnams shing / rgyal chen rigs bzhi la sogs srung ma dag dang bcas der phebs rjes tshogs chen zhal ngo'i srung skyob 'og 'cham cha tshang ba zhig 'khrab tshar rjes/ ra mo che brgyud gtsug lag khang du phyir log gi yod/ de dus da dung dge slong nyi ma ring po zhes dge slong bcu drug tsam gyis nas khang gi sgo ra chen po der 'dzoms nas/ gdangs ring zhing dal po'i ngang zhal 'don gnang gin rtse pho brang chen por kha phyogs te/ phyag 'tshal zhing smon lam 'debs pa'i cho ga ya mtshan can zhig byed rgyu yod/ lhag don du klu khang nang gso skyong byas pa'i mchod rdzas thun mong ma yin pa glang chen gnyis yiyod pa de nyin der 'khrid yong nas phyag 'tshal du 'jug gi yod/ nas khang chen po'i mdun du ser sbreng mdzad sgo'i skabs 'khrug cha chen po zhe drag yod pa phud/ nam shag rgyun du kha khu shin tu sim po yod cing / de'i 'khris kyi rdo bkyag sgang la rtse gsol thab kyi ljags smin gsol rtsam 'thag mkhan zhol pa gnyis yod pa de gnyis kyis so so'i lto chas 'khyer yong ste nyin mtshan ltos med du las ka byed kyi yod/nas khang chen po de'i steng khang la lo ltar ljags gro gtsang sel byed skabs zhol khungs kyi khyim dud re nas mi rkang re don dgos pa de ni lo re'i nang skyong 385

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dgos pa'i khral rigs shig yin/ nas khang chen mo de deng sang shul tsam yang med pa ni spyi lo 1963 lor gtor brlags su phyin skad/zhol par khang nub/ de ni spyi lo 1921lor 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i bla chen sgo 'jog sprul sku nges don bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang pos mthun rkyen bskrun cing tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtshos bka' mngags bzhin bzhengs pa'i par khang thog brtsegs gsum ldan rngam brjid che ba'ikhang bzang zhig yin/ de'i nang na dga' ldan khri thog dgu pa tre hor byams pa chos grags kyis skrun gnang mdzad pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan thog tshad gnyis ldan dang bka' 'gyur par shing / de min gzungs 'dus dang brgyad stong /'bum/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sogs pa'i par shing du ma yod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs la par rgyag mkhan la gla yon bod dngul srang lnga bcu tsam las sprod dgos kyi med/ do dam 'gan 'dzin gzhung gis byas kyang / par 'debs mkhan tshos las zhor la sger don mi nyung ba zhig sgrub kyi yod pa ni phyogs kyi dgon sde che chung dang ri khrod sogs kyi chos dpe phon chen par rgyag rgyu khas len byas nas yong 'bab 'tshol thabs byed kyi yod/ kho tsho sger la yong 'bab byung ba de nas gzhung la khral tog tsam rgyag dgos/'jigs byed lha khang / de ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i nang bzhengs pa'i thog brtsegs bzhi ldan gyi lha khang zhig yin/ par khang nas par brgyab zin rjes dpe cha tshang ma lha khang de'i nang la 'jog gi yod/lha khang der 'jigs byed kyi sku thog brtsegs gsum ldan thun mong ma yin pa 386

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/zhig bzhengs yod pa de ni rten gtso yin/ de min gsang ba 'dus pa dang bde mchog sogs sku gzhan pa'ang 'ga' shas yod/zhol gnyer las khungs/ las khungs de'i skor gong du brjod zin kyang 'dir des sgrub dgos pa'i dmigs bsal las 'gan gzhan 'ga' brjod rgyu ni/ gling skor phyi'i zhol 'og gi rdzong gzhis bco brgyad kyi sa nas rtse gsol thab kyi ljags smin gsol mar dang gsol zhib/ phyur ba/ tshal/ gsol krum la sogs tshang ma bsdu len byas nas dus thog tu mkho 'don byed dgos kyi yod/ dper na ljags smin gsol mar gsol pa dkar lding zhes pa de ljags smin she ma zhes mal gro gzi sbug dang rin chen gling / lcags gshongs/ru thog sogs kyi 'brog khag so sos nam dus res mos su 'bul dgos/nam rgyun zhol chibs ra nas gsol mar bsdus mkhan a khu gnyis bzhon rta dang ljags smin gsol mar blug sa'i dmigs bsal sgam zhig yod pa de 'khyer nas 'gro dgos/ rta'i g.yer kha dang sga chas sogs gtong sgo btang dgos pa tshang ma sa gnas so so'i ljags smin dkar khang nas nyin ltar res mos bzhin gtong dgos kyi yod/ ljags smin gsol mar sogs zhol pa las khungs nas bsdu len byas te nang zan gyis rtse gsol thab tu skyel bar 'gro srol yod/byang mkhar thag shur/ de snga bod zla dang po'i tshes gnyis nyin/ rtse pho brang dmar po nas g.yag ko'i rgyun bu'i thag pa zhig btang ste/ thag sno zhol rdo ring phyi ma'i rtser bsgrogs nas byang mkhar thag shur zhes pa'i cho ga dmigs bsal can zhig byed kyi yod/ thag shur slod mkhan gyi mi de gtsang byang mkhar nas yong bas cho ga de'i ming yang de ltar thogs/ mi des thag 387

༄za//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shur slod dus brag khog ko ba'i sga zhig gi thog tu bzhag nas kha mar thur du phyogs nas btang gi yod pas mi tshang mar skyi g.ya' ba'i zhed snang yod/rjes su tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs la de ltar kha thur du phyogs pa de rtags dang rten 'brel nyams shing bkra mi shis par dgongs nas/lugs srol der sgyur bcos byas te/ dmag spyi khang gi mdun du shing sdong ka ba 'dra ba zhig gi rtse mor yar 'dzegs su 'jug gi yod/ de'i go don ni lugs gnyis kyi rlung rta rgyas shing mdzad 'phrin yod do cog lugs sa/nyis kyi rlung rta rgyas shing mdzad 'phrin yod do cog yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i smon 'dun yin/ de nas bzung yar shing ka ba'i rtse mor 'dzegs te skor lding sna tshogs rgyag pa dang rtsal lag sna tshogs ston gyi yod pas/ de dus ltad mo lta mkhan shin tu mang ba dang gang sa nas bsngags brjod kyi sgra dbyangs lhang lhang sgrog par byed/zhol lcog dpon/ der las ka byed mkhan lcog dpon skya mi bzhi yod pa de tshor lha sa'i bar skor gyi skor bya ba 'dra ba zhwa mo 'bog to re gyon rgyu yod/kho tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo zhol pa'i khungs kyi sa gnas gdan bag dang gnas chung sogs so sor gling mi 'dra ba bgo bsha' brgyab pa de la lan skyel rgyu dang sde pa zhol pa'i bka' sogs khyab bsgrags byed dgos kyi yod/ de bzhin shar lho nub kyi gzhung sgo gsum la dam bsgrags byed cing / dgong mo bod kyi chu tshod bcu tsam la zhol lcags ri'i phyi phyogs gzhung sgo'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i pu li si tshogs khang zhes pa de'i nang nas pu li si dmag mis bod mda' zhig brgyab nas gzhung sgo rgyag rgyu'i brda btang ma thag lcog dpon gyis lam seng phyin nas sgo lcags shin tu che ba zhig yod pa rgyag dgos kyi yod/ des na 388

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/gzhung sgo'i phyi ru yod pa'i zhol pa ba tsho brda mda' ma 'phen gong la lcags ri'i nang la log zin pa byed dgos/ gal te brda mda'i gong la lcags ri'i nang du 'dzul ma thub tshe/ sang nyin ma gtogs de'i dgong mo log thabs bral bas/ de dgong phyi la lus pa tshos gnas tshang g.yar nas nyal dgos pa las/ bshad sa dang zhu sa rtsa ba nas med par khrims shin tu btsan po yod/gzhan yang lcog dpon de tshos grong mi phan tshun dbar 'khrug rtsod byung ba'am rkun ma shor ba tha na bza' tshang dbar 'cham mthun med pa sogs bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul ga re byung yang / tshang ma yar snyan seng zhu ba'i 'os 'gan yod/zhol pa'i nang zan tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni gong gi khrims lugs gzhir bzung nyes can nag chen dag la rta lcag gzhu ba sogs byed dgos kyi yod/ tshes bzang dus bzang dang dus chen che khag la/ nag chen btson pa de tsho nyin mo'i dgung la srung bya gcig tsam gyis rtog zhib kyis khrom la btang nas slong mo rgyag tu 'jug slong mo brgyab pa'i yong 'bab tshang ma btson srung ba la yar sprod dgos pa dang de nas brtson srung bas so so'i dgos mkhor gzhigs nas mar bgo bsha' rgyag gi yod/zhol lcags ri'i nang tshud kyi khyim dud khag gcig la de tsam gyi lo rgyus ring po med pa'am gna' rnying gi rin thang zhe drag med gshis 'dir mchan mdor bsdus shig gam ming tsam las bkod med pa gsham gsal/bde skyid shar/ de ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi sdod shag yin/ dwags po rtsum pa/ sngar sku drag che gras shig gi sdod shag yin rung rjes su khang gla tog tsam blangs nas mi ser dkyus 389

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma mang po bsdad de zhol par khang shar ma'i lho ru yod/ khang gsar steng /'khrungs yul gtsang rnam gling shang nas yin pa'i rtse drung lo tsā ba zer ba dus rgyun du sog chas sprad nas sdod mkhan zhig gi sdod shag yin/ me skyogs shar/de me skyogs khang gi shar ngos su mchis pas ming de ltar byung / gling 'gag stod smad/ gling 'gag lho byang yang brjod/ dkyil 'khor gsar pa/der lha klu'i phyag mdzod bgres pa zhig sdod kyi 'dug pas spyir mi ser dkyus ma'i sdod khang lags shing dkyil 'khor rnying pa nas logs su 'byed pa'i mi tshang gsar pa zhig yin/ dom po/ sku drag cig gi sdod shag ste spang steng gi mdun du yod/ rten khang / thog ma ka gcig lcam gang ma gcig yod/deng sang lha btsugs dang gsang khug stabs bde zhig las med/ de chibs ra'i lha'i mchod gnas yin/ sbra shur/ sngar de'i nang rtse pho brang zhig gso byed yas kyi gdung ma skam po phon chen bcug yod skad/ na lo/ shar byang /shar sgo/ gar dpon rnying pa/ shar sgo'i rdo bkyag 'og zhol khang chung dkar po/ zhol shar/ sgo ra khang chung / nor rgyas khang gsar/ dom po rta ra/ lcang sbug gung thung rta ra/ gzan khang thog kha/ gzhung sgo gsar pa bcas yod/zhol lcags ri'i phyi phyogs kyi skor/ gzhung sgo'i phyi'i shar phyogs su 'bras bu g.yul kha zhes pa'i thang sder dang / gzhung sgo'i phyi'i nub phyogs zhol 'dod dpal sogs kyi rgyud du sger khang du ma mchis/ de dag nang nas khag gcig ming tsam 'god rgyu gsham gsal/ brag ri khug 'grong 'dod khang gsar/ rta zam pa'i khang pa/ bkras khang phyi/ grong pa shar/ tsha khur tshong khang / sding yon/ ri sgang / tshang skyid/ pu li si tshogs khang /390

༄༅//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/tshang khang dkyil/ lcang ma khang gsar/ yung khang sogs yod/ gzhan yang lo rgyus kyi gna' shul zhol rdo ring phyi nang gnyis sogs yod kyang /dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang po'i nang gsal po 'khod yod pas 'dir bris med/mchan/mezho ston sogs mdzad sgo che chung skabs g.yag khrab mkhan tshang ma de nas yong zhing / bcings 'grol ma btang gong yul de'i bud med gcig la skye thengs gcig la bu gsum dang bu mo gsum bcas phru gu drug skyes yod cing kha mig tshang ma thang thang yin la a ma yang god chags ci yang byung mi 'dugadhibaka' blon dag rtse pho brang nas mar zhol la thon yong skabs/ chibs ra'i chibs g.yog tshos 'bras bu gling gi zur nas rta chas ser po bsgron nas spyan phul zhus shing kho tshos chibs chen la 'drog mgo yod med dang sha shed legs min brtag nas 'dam brgya shog brgyad nas yong ba'i srung ma dmar nag gi rten thug gdan 'dren zhu mi hor pa ba skyes pa stobs chen dag la rtsis len rtsis sprod byas shing / khong tshos dmag spyi khang nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang du gdan 'dren zhu dgos pa las mi gzhan gyis tshab byed chog gi med/dude ni rtse drung brgya dang bdun cu don lnga'i 'go 'dzin yin pas tshogs 'du'i skabs dbus la sdod kyi yod cing dbang thang ha cang chen po yod/ khong mkhan po tshang du phyag las gnang dbang gis dbyar dus nor bu gling kha la'ang las shag legs pa zhig yod/mertse pho brang chen po'i rgyab phyogs kyi nub ngos mkhan po gling kha'i lho 'gram du yod/deng sang rgyang bsgrags las khungs dang byis pa'i pho brang sogs kyi 'og tu tshud 'dug391

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rjode snga gling kha de'i rgya khyon ni da lta'i paṇa chen pho brang nas tang ud dang pho brang mdun gyi thang chen cha tshang tshud yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs/ de'i rgyud du shing nags stug pos 'khrigs pa'i gling kha shin tu legs po zhig yod/ de'i nang sku phreng bdun pas dbyar dus rtag tu der phebs te dad ldan mi mang la gsung chos gnang gshis/ mi dbang pho lha sogs kyis khong gsung chos gnang skabs bzhugs gdan 'jags sa'i bzhugs khri legs po zhig bzhengs yod pas gling kha der ming de byung /mesngar sog po thog ma bod la slebs rjes kho tsho'i rked rgyab tu 'dogs rgyu'i gri dang / khol tse/ rgya khug phor shubs bcas kyi spyi ming yin/ rjes su de'i nang nas gri phud de min dag sku drag rnam pa'i rked rgyab tu 'dogs rgyu'i rgyan cha lta bur gyur/mes gnas srid gzhung gi nyer mkho'i sems can nor gling dang chibs ra mdo sbug chab drel/ gzim drel sogs kyi rta glang bong drel dag 'tsho skyong byed sa'i rtswa ra'i bang mdzod che shos de yin/ der rtswa rnga zhing gsog 'jog byed mkhan gyi 'gan 'dzin pa ni/ rtswa gnyer skya ser gnyis dang de 'og gi gshog 'gog de 'og gi 'dam srung gcig bcas yod/ dus rgyun kho tshos gam pa la'i rgyab phyogs yar 'brog rgyud kyi rtswa kha gang legs sar phyin nas sems can 'tsho skyong hur thag byed cing / lha ldanasmon lam chen mo tshugs skabs rta tshang ma tshur bkugs/ de'i gzan chag 'gro song thams cad gzims drel zhal ngosagatong dgos/ kho'i las 'gan ha cang ljid po yod de/ skabs der rta rgyug 'gran tshe ang ki len ma thub na de ma nyid du gnas dbyung gtong gi yod/rjosngar chibs chen de dag gi nang du rti gi lcags zhes chibs pa shin tu chen po zhig yod skad/ spyir gzhung la dgos pa'i chibs chen legs po dag byang spyi gnyis kyis zi ling ba'i lag nas nyos te/ rdzong dam brgyab cing rin gong ci tsam yin min yig thog la kha gsal bkod de lha sar gtong / lha sar 'byor ma thag nor gling chibs 392

༄7//lha ldan zhol gyi gna' shul khag gi skor mdo tsam bstan pa/ra dang zhol chibs ra sbug mas rtsis len byed kyi yod/ yang chibs chen de tsho'i nang la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung la mjal kha zhu mkhan a mdo bas phul ba'i chibs pa'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod/‘ rjodabyar dus gzhes brda zhes pa de yang dbyar dus su gzhes nyin phyogs la thon gyi yin pas rta 'ul gnyis sam gsum thugs rjes gzigs zhes dus bkag sngon du brda gtong dgos/ de yang dbyar dus gzhes brda gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/dbyar kha shar ba dang chibs ra'i rta mang che ba rtswa kha shin tu legs pa'i 'jag ma gling kha'i nang rta hreng la 'jog gi yod/ dbyar dus su char chu rgyas pas rta las sla por skong 'gugs thub kyi med/ des na spyi khyab mkhan por snyan seng zhus shing ko dpon gnyer par ngos 'byor zhu dgos/ ngos 'byor ko dpon gnyer par byung rjes khong tshos ko gru btang nas chibs rta ko gru'i nang la bcug ste tshur dbor yong gi yod dbang gis dus tshod nges can zhig dgos kyi yod/rjodagun dus gnangs brda gtong dgos pa ni dgun kha chibs rta mang che ba gzhung gi 'dam ra chen mo phud de min tshal gung thang 'dam ra dang stod lung skya bo'i 'dam ra bcas cung thag ring tsam la 'tsho dgos kyi yod pas dgun gnangs brda med tshe chibs rta lam seng gtong ba'i lugs srol med/ a drung gi chibs pa de dag gzan chag sprad de dom gsos brgyab nas 'jog pa las phyi la 'tsho bar gtong gi med/⑪chibs ra'i a drung tshos chibs ra mdo nas rdog thon byas te sa tshigs gang du slebs kyang de nas chibs pa gra sgrig ang gsar gyis sgug bsdad yod/ kho tshos dus rtag tu dka' las zhe drag rgyag dgos pa ni stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi smad mdo khams sgang drug sogs bod kyi sa cha yongs la nyin mtshan ltos med kyis bka' rgya skyel bar 'gro dgos/ lhag don du khams phyogs la 'gro dus jag tshogs kyi gnod 'tshe'i khrod la rang srog blos gtong byas nas 'gro dgos shing / stod ru thog sogs la 'gro dus ri lung stong phrag mang po dang chu klung brgya phrag du ma brgal 393

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dgos/ ske rags la thal rtse brgyab yod treng mtshan gar sdod dang nyin gar slebs med par 'gro dgos/ a drung gi thob cha ni lo gcig la dngul srang dgu las med mod/phyogs la 'gro dus mi ser gyis gla rin phran bu sprod kyi yod/ de min so nam las khungs nas lo rer a drung re la 'bru khal bco brgyad dang rtse 'phral bde las khungs nas snam bu bub re sprod kyi yod/yiglang chen de gnyis la dmigs bsal gyi cho ga byed du bcug pa de nyid phud/dus rgyun du nyin ltar 'char can rtse skor la thengs re 'khrid/ glang dzi des rgya gar skad brgyab nas mar bsdad du bcug pa dang / khong rang bzhon zin rjes yang bskyar rgya gar skad rgyag rting des dal bur yar langs nas/ gom bgrod shin tu brtan pos rtse skor la 'gro yi yod pas/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di grang ngar cung che ba'i yul lung zhig yin pa'i dbang gis/ glang chen shin tu nas dkon gshis lha ldan pa dang phyogs nas yong ba'i zhing 'brog mi ser tshang mas glang chen de gnyis la mnyes po dang ya mtshan zhe drag byed kyi yod/ glang rdzis nyin ltar kho gnyis la mar gyi byug pa byas pas/ lus la 'od mdangs chem chem 'char/ de gnyis kyi zas ni gtso bo 'dam rtswa dang 'bras mang che ba ster la mtshams re rtsam pa'am sprod kyi yod/ de gnyis thog ma zhol lcags ri'i lho nub ngos kyi gzan khang 'khris su 'jog gi yod kyang rjes su tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i sku dus su rdzong rgyab klu khang nang la glang khang chen po zhig gsar skrun byas rjes der gnas spos byas 'dug394
