༄//lha ldan rme ru rnying pa dang de'i chos spyong skor phran tsam brjod pa/rme ru'am rmu ru dgon pa ni lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi shar phyogs su gnas shing / gnas chung gi dgon lag yin la sa dge rnying gsum grub mtha' ris med tshul du mchis/ rme ru rnying pa zhes pa ni dus rabs dgu pa'i nang btsan po khri ral pa can gyis lha sa'i phyogs bzhir mchod khang gnyis re bzhengs pa'i shar du mchod khang dmar po gcig dang dkar po gcig bzhengs/ de dus kha skad gzhir bzhag gis dmar po la dmar ru'am rme ru dang dkar po la dkar ru'am ka ru zhes bris pa rjes su snga mo'i skad kyi sgra gdangs bzhin bris pa la 'gyur ldog ma byung ste dgon pa'i tha snyad du gyur nas rme ru dgon pa zhes 'bod do// glang dar gyi skabs su sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan par god chags chen po byung ba'i tshe dgon pa der nyam chag phran bu byung 'dug kyang dus rabs bcu gcig nang jo bo rje dbus su phebs te der mu mthud dge 'dun gyi sde chags shing / tshes bzang dus bzang la zhabs brtan rgyun chad med par byed kyi yod/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang la nyams gso mdzad nas gnas chung dgon pa'i dgon lag tu gyur cing /gnas chung gis bdag 'dzin byas shing / de nas mkhan po zhig mngags gtong gis gtan sdod byed do//lha khang de'i grub cha gsham gsal ltar te3/95

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mgon khang / de'i nang gi g.yas phyogs nas dang po lo gtor zhes lo 'khor mor bshams nas 'jog pa'i gtor ma dang de'i bzhugs sgrom rang 'grig gnyis dang de nas rim pas lho phyogs yon tan rgyal po (dga' gdong dgon pa'i rten srung /) lha mo nyi ma gzhon nu (nyi ma gzhon nu ni slad lung bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i srung ma yin cing khong gis 'dir phul ba red/ gang lags she na/ mo rgyud kyi thog nas 'dir dgos nges shig red/) nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po/ rta mgrin bsam grub/ rten gtso gu ru khams gsum zil gnon/ byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po/ 'jigs rung thog btsan (de ni lha lung dpal rdor gyi bka' srung yin la khong 'jon po dang rgod po yin tsang rdo rje drag ldan gyi blon por bsdus shing rme ru rnying pa'i gnas bdag gtso bo de'ang khong yin/) dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po bcas kyi sman 'dam 'jim sku dang bsam yas rten gtso pe har rgyal po'i bzhugs khang dang sgrom rang 'grig sogs kyang mchis so//'du khang / de'i nang 'dzul ma thag g.yas g.yon gnyis su ma ṇi'i 'khor lo che ba re yod cing / g.yas g.yon gyi gyang ldebs su gnyan chen thang lhas gtsos pa'i bod kyi gal che'i chos skyong srung ma'i bris ris du ma mtshar du dngar ba bzhugs/ 'du khang de'i sgo mchor 'og gi g.yas g.yon gnyis su ma ṇi'i 'khor lo re dang gyang ldebs su rgyal chen sde bzhi'i ldebs bris yod do//'du khang gi dbus cung byang du spyan ras gzigs thugs rje chen po bcu gcig pa'i sku mchod gshom rang 'grig dang de'i g.yon du spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i sku/ de'i mdun du mchod kong che ba gnyis la bzhugs khri rang 'grig de'i rgyab phyogs g.yas su gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan dang a dza ra gnyis/ mdun du ljags skyems sbag gzhong dang phul phor rang 'grig396

༄//lha ldan me ru rnying pa dang de'i chos skyong skor phran tsam brjod pa/g.yon du bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo dang de'i sku 'khor seng ge bcas dang ljags skyems sbag gzhong dang phul phor bcas yod do//dzam bha lha lha khang / khri ral pa can gyis bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus ring shos kyi gras shig lags/ de'i sgo shar la phyogs shing / nang gi rten gtso bo ni sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi 'jim sku dang bzhugs sgrom rang 'grig yod/ de min da dung nor gyi bdag po ar ya dzam bha lha dang byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras bcas kyi 'jim sku dang bzhugs sgrom rang 'grig yod la/ lha khang de'i gyang ldebs la sangs rgyas stong sku dang rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi bris ris rnying ma shin tu legs pa yod/ma ṇi'i skor lam/ der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs yig drug dung phyur ldan pa'i ma ṇi lag skor ba chen po dang de'i skor lam bcas yod/ ma ṇi'i g.yon du kha byang blta'i dur bdag gis gtsos pa'i ldebs ris mang dag bzhugs shing sku rgyu dang tshon mdangs rnying ma'i tshul du 'dugadapal mgon lha khang / grub mtha' rnying ma/ dgon bdag gong dkar chos sde dgon/ sgo 'dzul ma khad de'i lho ru rdo skas se'u gsum dang bzhugs khri bcas yod cing/ dbus su slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo gur gyi mgon/ 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal gyi lha mo bcas gsum gyi 'jim sku rang 'grig g.yon gyi dang po lo gtor bzhugs sgrom rang 'grig de nas dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs kyi sku la sogs pa'i rten mang dag bzhugs/lha khang de'i rten gtso ni gu ru rin po che dang de'i bstan srung ni gnas chung chos skyong yin/ de yang bstan srung gnas chung chos skyong gi lo rgyus bod 397

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag nang 'khod don du sngar chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan skabs bsam yas dgon pa bzhengs grub nas gu ru rin po ches lha 'dre tshang ma dam la btags shing / chos skyong chen po pe har rgyal po de hor nas gdan drangs/ pe har rgyal po de las sla por dam la 'dogs ma thub par mtshams re pha bong la sprul ba dang mtshams re g.yag gi rwa dong nang la 'dzul ba/mtshams re sdig rwa la sprul ba/ tha na phar gu ru rin po che la rdo yi char pa 'bebs pa sogs sprul pa mang dag cig bstan nas las sla por glags ma rnyed/de tshe gu ru rin po ches bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi dbyibs gzugs rngam brjid ldan pa zhig bzhengs gnang bas der pe har rgyal po dbu 'khor nas gzigs bzhugs dus/ gu rus de ma nyid du dam 'dogs gnang zhing /gu rus bka' slob kyang 'di ltar gnang ba la dpe la med pa'i pe har ra zhes brjod stabs/ chos skyong de yi mtshan la pe har zhes thogs skad do//de nas bzung chos skyong chen po des bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lagakhang nang bzhugs nas chos kyi srung ma gnang ba red/ yang lo rgyus deb ther khag nang brjod don du dus rabs bcu gnyis nang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus g.yu brag gis gung thang dgon pa bzhengs skabs/ dgon pa phyag btab yul skor bsam yas kyi chos skyong chen po pe har rgyal po la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshe/ chos skyong gis ri yi sgang na phyag 'debs na legs zhes brjod/ yin na'ang bla ma zhang dang tshal pa khri dpon gyis khong gi bka' la ma gsan par/ de las ldog ste dgon pa de klung la phyag 'debs byas par ma zad/ las gzhug skyong skabs tshon pa mang po zhig mi lag 'khrid de tshon gtong 'go brtsams/ de tshe chos skyong chen po des 'khon 'dzin gyi dbang 398

༄//lha ldan rme ru rnying pa dang de'i chos skyong skor phran tsam brjod pa/gis tshon pa'i las rogs phru gu zhig la sprul nas tshon g.yog la zhabs phyi yang dag pa zhus shing / tshon pa che mo ba rnams la tshon shugs skabs bang rim ma nor bar ji ma ji bzhin gnang ba'i dbang gis tshon pa chen mos gtsos pa'i tshon pa yod do cog thugs dgyes thag chod nas/ kho la smras pa da tshon gtong 'grub grabs 'dug bu khyed la rngan pa ga re dgos zhes dris par khos nga la gzhan gang yang dgos pa med kyang da thengs khyed rnams nas sgo mchor 'og gi lho ngos nas byang la kha gtad de spre'u zhig gi lag par gzim spos bsnams bsdad pa zhig bris rogs zhes lab pas/ kho tsho ya mtshan chen po skyes te phan tshun bka' bsdur byas rjes/ phru gu des tshon g.yog shin tu legs po rgyug dbang gis mthar kho'i thugs 'dod bskong phyir da ga rang bris skad do//rjes su tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi mdzad po bla ma zhang dang tshal pa khri dpon gnyis zhabs lcag dang sbrags gzigs skor la phebs skabs rgyang gzigs gnang ba dang spre'us gzim spos bsnams yod pa de spyan lam du 'char tshe de ltar bris pa tog tsam 'grig med kyang phyis drags pas da de ma bsub par rang 'jags bzhag shog ces bka' gnang ba red/ gang ltar chos skyong gis bla ma zhang la 'khon 'dzin bcangs pa'i dbang gis rjes su gung thang dgon par me skyon chen po byung bar grags/de bzhin lcog pa byang chub dpal ldan gyi rnam thar nang bkod don du/dgon pa'i dbu 'dzin sogs kyis me skyon yong rkyen chos skyong gi 'khon lan yin par bzung nas thabs shes gzhan ma rnyed kyang chos skyong gi gos gzan dag spud nas sgam chung zhig gi nang la blugs nas skyid chu la mar bskur ba red/ de tshe 'bras spungs bde yangs grwa tshang gi mkhan po ste cog pa byang chub 399

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpal ldan zhes pa zhig gis mngon mkhyen rtogs te/ khong rang gi gsol dpon la zhus pa/ sang nyin khyed rang snga po nas thon te dam pag gi gdong der phyin nas skyid chus sgam chung zhig 'khyer yong gi yod pas/ de khyed kyis tshur bzhes pa dang kha ma bsngogs par sgal par 'khyer nas 'dir shog ces bka' slob gnang yod skad/nyin gnyis par gsol dpon des mkhan po'i bka' ltar sgam chung sgal par 'khyer nas yar yong dus/ sgam chung de ljid khog je cher thad gshis ya mtshan chen po skyes shing da lta'i gnas chung dgon pa chags yul te de dus grog dong chen po zhig yod pa der dbugs ngal gsos nas zhal nas bla ma mkhyen zhes brjod bzhin par sgam chung kha phyes skabs de nas 'ang gu zhig thon yong nas grog dong der thims pas khong gis de ga re yin pa ma mkhyen par sgam chung stong pa de kha brgyab te yar bde yangs la bsnams/ de dus mkhan po byang chub dpal ldan gyis gro ma 'bras sil zhig bzos nas phebs sgug zhus nas sdod pa'i skabs la gsol dpon yar slebs nas sgam stong pa yin pa mthong dus khong gis a kha da khyed kyis sgam de kha phye zin pa de tog tsam 'grig mi 'dug kyang da der gnas chung zhes gnas chung chung cig chags kyi red/sgam de 'bras spungs bde yangs la bzhag pa dang chos skyong de'i sems stong de gnas chung grog la thims par grags/ sngar grog de thog so gsum yod kyang ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i ’’skabs gtor nas da lta thog so gnyis tsam las med pa de da lta mjal rgyu yod/lha khang 'di grub mtha' ris med yin pas bskang gso gtong dus bstan srung mang po yod mod kyang spyir mdor bsdus tsam las med/ bskang 400

༄//lha ldan me ru rnying pa dang de'i chos skyong skor phran tsam brjod pa/gso rgyas pa ni bstan srung so so'i gnas su gtong gi yod pa dper na dga' gdong dgon par yon tan rgyal po'i bskang gso rgyas po gtong cing der de'i sku khog kyang yod/ bsam yas su tsi'u dmar po'i bskang gso rgyas shos yod/la mor lha chen tshangs pa'i khri dang sku khog yod/ rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gis dpal ldan lha mo'i cho ga dang bskang gso rgyas shos gtong gi yod cing pe har rgyal po'i gsol khang la'ang mdor bsdus shig gtong ngo // karma shar du sku yi rgyal po'i blon po shan pa bye khri mig gcig pa zhes pa de'i bskang gso rgyas shos gtong ngo // khong sku yi rgyal po'i blon po yin tsang de dang gnas chung chos skyong dbar la'ang 'brel ba yod/'bras spungs bde yangs grwa tshang nang la 'phrin las rgyal po dang btsan mang po zhig yod cing / ka ba'i logs la so so'i chas gos de dag mchod nas cha tshang mthong rgyu yod/ bde yangs grwa tshang nang la rdo rje grags ldan gyi ldebs ris rnying pa gcig yod/ de ni lcog pa byang chub dpal ldan skabs su bzhengs par grags/ der rmi ru dgon pas mthong chen byed kyi yod do//401

༄༅//g.yo ru khra 'drug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/gcig khra 'brug me tog mchod pa'i skor/ khra 'brug me tog mchod pa ni bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gtong gi yod/ me tog mchod pa'i skabs kyi dus ston gtso bo ni 'cham 'khrab yas de yin mod kyang me tog mchod pa 'go ma btsugs gong la gna' srol ldan pa'i gar zhig 'khrab kyi yod/gar 'khrab mkhan gras su gzims chung phyi nang gnyis dang / khar thog nas gar pa bdun dang rtse thang nas gar pa gsum khyon bsdoms pa'i bcu yod par kho tshor gzhas pa gzhas ma zhes zer/ gzhas pas ser chen bog to gyon cing gzhas mas mu tig thod khog gyon pa khong tshor gzhas chen btang mkhan yang brjod do// khong tsho'i snyan 'jebs ldan la 'gyur khug can gyi gzhas shig btang gi yod par de'i gzhas tshig ni 'di ltar te/ nga tsho'i g.yo ru khra 'brugagaser gyi ga'u kha sbyar// ga'u nang gi dam chen// nga tsho'i lha chen tshangs pa//sku stod bla ma yin zer// yar 'gron gnang dgos yod do// sked pa dpon po yin zer// 'go 'dren gnang dgos yod do// rtsa ba pha ma yin zer//byams skyong gnang dgos yod do// star kha'i sdong po g.yas byas// ku shu'i sdong po g.yon byas// bya chen a khu ne tso// sku tshe'i dkyil la slebs song //ma kāsdu2 tshe brtan med de// blo thag chod pas 'grig song // mtho po ri yi rtse

sa༅//g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/nas// nyi ma shar du 'grim song // dma' po rgya mtsho'i gting nas// nor bu len par 'grims song // bod khams bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i// rten 'brel dang po 'grig song // bcas so// gzhas pa gzhas mas gzhas chen gtong sa ni khra 'brug dgon pa'i thog so gnyis pa'i lho phyogs la mchis pa'i lha chen tshangs pa'i lcog gi sku mdun du yin/ de min da dung seng ge gcigayar mda'i lha ste dgon gsar lha/ byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po/ sne gdong drag btsan pa/ sne dkar nyi ma gzhon nu/ khe med lha/ tsha ru drag shul dbang po/ khar thog rdzong btsan/ gos gsar btsan/ tshe spong 'brog lha bcas lha tshogs yod do 'dir 'dzoms nas tshangs par mchod 'phrin byed do//gzhas pa gzhas mas gzhas chen btang zin rting cho ga stabs bde shig byas te lha chen tshangs pa dang khong gi las bya bse sku gnyis 'cham rwar gdan 'dren zhus nas 'cham 'khrab kyi yod/ 'cham rgyag mkhan grwa ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod par de'i nang nas dung chen gtong mkhan gnyis dang rgya gling gtong mkhan gnyis/ spos sna 'dren mkhan bzhi bcas tshud yod/ spyir btang byas na bod zla lnga pa'i tshes gnyis nyin 'brel yod kyi dbu 'dzin mi sna mnyam 'dzoms byas nas 'cham 'khrab mkhan gyi mi sna te zhwa nag 'khrab mkhan dang / seng ge 'khrab mkhan/ spre'u 'khrab mkhan bcas gtan 'khel byas rjes chos skyong tshangs pa'i sku mdun du phul nas 'grig min bcar 'dri zhu skabs gal te sdig sgrib chen po yod pa zhig yin na zhal mdog dung ltar dkar ba de dmar mdangs 'tshub tsam chags kyi yod skad/ tshangs pa'i zhal la 'gyur mdog gang yang ma byung tshe dam phrug dmar mo zhig bskyon nas mtha' ma 403

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thugs gtan 'khel bar mdzad do//de rjes dgon pa'i tshogagatshugs pa'i skabs la 'cham 'khrab mkhan gyi ming tho de dag dge bskos lags la rtsis sprad pa dang khong gis tshes gsum zhogs pa grwa dmangs mnyam 'dzoms thog ljags sgrog gnang nas grwa ba tshang mas thos par byas te rang 'gan ci ltar sgrub dgos min skor la nan bshad gnang gi yod/ de nas bzung tshes bcu gsum bar du so so'i dge rgan btsal nas sngar dgongatshodang / lto chas za ring ngam ngal gso'i bar yod tshad la rang sbyong hur thag byed dgos pa las dpe cha sogs dgon pa'i las la 'thus shor rtsa ba nas mi yong ba byed dgos/ tshes brgyad nas bcu gcig bar nyi ma bzhi yi ring nyin ltar re bzhin sne gdong lcang gseb nang tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyis sbyangs pa byed dgos/ gal srid de dus grwa ba khag gcig gis nyin ma gang 'khyol gyis legs po ma sbyangs pa yin na nyes dag zhe drag gzed dgos pas tshang mas rig pa bsgrims nas nus pa gang yod 'don gyi yod/tshes bcu gnyis nyin 'cham 'khrab mkhan gyi grwa ba tshang mas 'cham chas cha tshang gyon nas dgon pa'i thog so gnyis thog gi yang steng du 'cham cha tshang 'khrab dgos pa de yi ming la grwa dmangs 'cham rgyugs zhes don du snyan 'bul gyi 'khrab tshan byed sgo zhig go/ de skabs rdzong dpon lhan rgyas dang dgon pa'i dbu 'dzin mtho shos sogs kyang der gdan 'dren zhus nas spyan gzigs gnang bas 'cham 'khrab mkhan gyi grwa dmangs dag zhed snang lhad medakhyed kyi yod pa ni dgon pa'i dbu 'dzin tshos bka' bkyon ga re gnang grabs yod dam snyam mo// gal te rang 'khri'i 'khrab sne de legs po ma byung 404

༄za//g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/ngamaskyon cha byung tshe nyin de'i dgong mo lcag tshan gzed dgos pa dang khrims bcad nan po phog gi yod/ dper na dgon pa'i lcags ri sogs la nyams gso byed du 'jug pa dang chu la chu rags rgyag dgos pa bcas so tshes bcu gsum nyin gra sgrig byed dgos pa dang bcu bzhi'i nyin gyi zhogs pa dung skad sgra thun mong ma yin pa zhig gtong gi yod pas de dus so so'i gyon chas dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa tshang ma gra sgrig ang gsar byas nas bsgugs sdod pa dang 'cham gyi dge rgan sogs slebs pa dang dgon pa'i sgo mchor nang la thon nas sdeb rwa zhes pa'i 'cham zhig 'khrab dgos/tshes bcu bzhi'i zhogs pa dgon pa'i mchod pa sgrub mkhan gyis rgyal po sku lnga dang de'i yum lnga blon po lnga'i 'brang rgyas gtor tshogs dang sku lnga'i pho brang shin tu mtshar ba lnga bzhengs dgos/ pho brang de khang pa sngon po dang /dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu bcas khang mig lngas grub la thun mong thog rgyal sgo gcig dang de bzhin shar phyogs dung ltar dkar pa'i khang bzang gi sgo phye ste zla ba bzhon nu'i sku bzhugs su gsol/ lho phyogs gser ltar ser ba'i khang bzang sgo phye ste mgar ba dbang phyug gi sku bzhugs su gsol/ nub phyogs byu ru ltar dmar ba'i khang bzang sgo phye ste be tshar gu ya'i sku bzhugs su gsol/ byang phyogs g.yu ltar ljang ba'i khang bzang sgo phye ste khyung gshog sba ba g.yas la bzhugs su gsol/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin gung nas bzung sku lnga'i mchod pa gsar pa bzhengs sgrub pa de lcog nang la mchod nas sku lnga la sogs dgon pa'i lha tshogs ste dgon pa'i bka' srung yid dam rta mgrin bsam sgrub dang / rgyal po sku lnga/ chos skyong tshangs pa/ dpal ldan lha mo/ chos skyong bse khrab/ drag shul dbang po/ drag btsan thog 405

sa༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bebs/ nyi ma gzhon nu bcas dang yul gyi gnasabyubadag lte ba bse sku/gnod sbyin ma/ lha yon tan dkar po/ gnyan chen thang lha/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bka' srung rdzong btsan/ chu rgyud rgyal po/ sne gdong drag btsan pa bcas kyi bskang ba phul cing cho ga rgyas shing rgyas pa sgrub dgos/tshes bco lnga'i zhogs pa gzhas pa gzhas mas gzhas chen 'khrab zin rting chos skyong tshangs pa'i skur dbu rmog dang na bza' rgyan gos cha tshang sgron nas dgon pa'i thog so gnyis pa lcog khang nas mar gsham 'og la gdan 'dren zhus te cho ga rgyas po zhe drag gtong srol yod/ thog ma rdzong dpon lhan rgyas kyis lha sa'i sde pa gzhung gi bka' rgya sgrog sbyangs byed kyi yod par go don gtso bo ni bod kha ba can gyi chos srid la 'phel 'grib dang gnod bgegs ci yong chos skyong khyod nas srong po'i bka' gnang rogs zhes pa de'o// dus mtshungs da lo lo 'di'i nang bod yul spyi dang yar lung yul la bde skyid dang /sad ser ba/ dmag 'khrugs dang mu ge/ nad yams dang 'khrugs rtsod bcas ci 'dra yong min rtsa ba nas shes kyi med pas khyed nas bka' lung gnang rogs zhes shing khyed la cho ga dang sku rim la sogs pa gang dgos ci dgos tshang ma nga tshos kha zhe gnyis med kyis sgrub chog ces zhu'o// de tshe rkang gling shin tu drag cing ngar ba sing sing zhes bsgrags pa dang sku khog des lha 'bebs kyi yod pa ni/ rang gi bla srog phyir sgyugs nas lha de rang gi lus nang la bzhugs su gsol nas lha'i snang tshul mdzad kyi yod pa dper na dus rgyun du chang rtsa ba nas btung gi med kyang lha bzhugs dus chang lhad med btung ba dang nam rgyun sha za rgyu nyung nyung yin kyang lha 'bebs dus sems can gyi snying khrag dmar po tsha bor kha nang la bcug ste de ma nyid du khyur mid gtong gi yod/406

༄༅//g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/lha 'bebs skabs lha'i sku khog gi khog nang la bzhugs ma thag dbu rmog shin tu ljid cing che ba zhig g.yog kyang zhwa mo yang zhwa g.yogs pa'i snang ba dang lus la thag pas dam thag chod bsdams kyang khong gi lus la na tsha gang yang gtong ba'i tshor ba med par ma zad mchong rgyag tshegs med rgyag gi yod/ brjod srol la lha de'i dpral bar mig gcig 'char gyi yod pas bka' lung ha cang btsan par mngon/ de dus drung yig gis lam seng sam ṭa'i sgang la yi ger bkod nas 'jog pa dang nyin gnyis par gzhi nas shog gu'i steng la phab nas bka' lung gi nang don gsal zhing dag pa bris te rkang mgyogs a drung mngags gtong gis lha sa'i sde pa gzhung la phul gyi yod do// sku khog gi lha sku bsang dus lha g.yog rgyugs mkhan zhig yod pa des brang khog steng gi me long de mar shugs chen mnan nas sdod pas sku khog la na tsha gtong yas de cung nyung ba dang sku ga ler ma gtogs bsang gi med pas sku lus la de ltar gyi gzan po med skad/tshangs pa'i sku khog gis bka' lung gnang zin rjes su chos skyong tshangs pa'i sku dang bka' gnyan bse sku gnyis kar dgon pa'i nub phyogs na mchis pa'i li yul lcang rwa smug po zhes pa'i lcang gseb shin tu legs po zhig yod pa der gdan 'dren zhus te sku bzhugs khri'i sgang la mchod ma khad du seng ge dang / spre'u/ dgra bcom/ sngags pa/ zhwa nag bud med sogs khra chil chil du phebs nas 'cham gzhung cha tshang 'khrab kyi yod pa ni thog ma dur bdag dang de nas rim gyis spre'u/ gying sku/ a tsa ra/ skyes bu gru dkar/dge slong / khye'u dkar nag gnyis gcig la sho dkar po dang gzhan zhig la sho nag po btags yod/ zhwa nag pa/ shwa ba/ seng ge dkar mo/407

༄7/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdud mo/ dur khrod bdag po dang bdag mo bcas thon yong nas 'khrab rtsal sna tshogs bstan nas 'khrab kyi yod pas yul mi'ang thams cad gzigs mor phebs te spro skyid gtong ba dang zhim zas ro bcud ldan pa dag kyang bsnams nas longs su spyod kyi yod do// 'cham gzhung cha tshang 'khrab zin rjes su chos skyong tshangs pa chen mo dang las bya bse sku gnyis dbu lnga zhes mchod rten lnga dang sa lhag rdo lhag las bskrun pa'i dbu drug pa ste khyon bsdoms pa'i mchod rten drug yod pa der gdan 'dren zhus nas mchod rten de tsho'i byang phyogs 'khris su chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bzhugs khri gcig dang khong gi skye lha chos skyong tshangs pa chen po'i bzhugs khri/ blon chen khag cig gi bzhugs khri bcas yod/ lha chen tshangs pa chos skyong rang gi bzhugs khri'i sgang du sdod du bcug pa dang bse sku blon po'i bzhugs khri'i sgang du sdod du bcug nas bskang gso cha tshang zhig gtong ba dang sku bsang gi dud zhag gis mchod rten dag sgrib pa ltar chags/ mtha' mar chos skyong dang / las bya bse sku/ ser sbreng sogs mchod rten la skor ba lan gsum brgyab nas yar dgon pa'i lcog nang la gdan 'dren zhus rjes mdzad sgo cha tshang mjug sgril lo//me tog mchod pa'i skabs la gtong sgo gtong chen dang gtong chung zhes pa gnyis yod de 'gro song mang po zhig lha sa'i gzhung dga' ldan pho brang nas gtong gi yod par gtso che ba ja dang dngul gnang ngo //sne gdong yul la khra 'brug tshangs pa dang bse sku phud da dung yul lha gzhi bdag dang lha che chung sna tshogs yod par shel brag rdzong btsan/(de gter bdag yin cing khong gi lag par gter gyi lde mig ste g.yang dkar lug gi rwa co zhig yin/khar thog rdzong btsan dang sbyar gyi rdzong btsan kyang de ltar ro/)rgyal po sku lnga sogs lha 408

༄za/g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon rba'i dus ston khag gi skor/'bebs mkhan sku khog sna tshogs yod/ lhag don du sne gdong drag btsan (de'i sku khog de skye dman zhig yin/)la do snang chen po zhe drag byed kyi yod/ de ni khams pa btsan la langs pa zhig yin skad/ gang lags she na/ de'i gtor ma bzhengs dus gtor ma'i dbu thod la spag sgor mo gcus ril shig shig cig g.yog gi yod pa de ni khams pa'i skra skor gyi tshul yin par brjod do//de yang brjod srol la sngar lo rgyus thog khams pa zhig yar lung rten gsum/(rtag spyan bum pa/ rgod thang bum pa/ tshes bcu bum pa/) gnas gsum/(bya sa lha khang / khra 'brug btsan thang sgo bzhi/) phug gsum (ras chung phug shel brag phug sbe ro phug) bcas la gnas skor du phebs ste sne gdong la gzhis chags pas yul mi dang ma mthun pa'i rkyen mang dag langs te yul mis kho skog bsad btang / des na kho mi shi btsan la rgyal bas yul la gnod pa chen po gtong gi yod dbang gis tshes bzang dus bzang la gsol te phyis su sne gdong drag btsan zhes pa de'o// brjod srol la des sa skyes rdo skyes min pa'i sne gdong gi mi'am phyogs nas yong mkhan gyi mi la gnod skyel gyi med cing sne gdong rang gi mis de la phog thug 'gro sa med/ des na sne gdong yul gyi 'go dpon sogs phyogs nas yong ba'i mi yin na 'phrod po zhe drag yod skad/dus deng gi dus la'ang sne gdong la 'go 'dzin byed mkhan nam 'jon thang yod pa'i mi tshang ma phyogs nas yong ba sha stag las yul de rang gi mi nyung zhes so// mdor sne gdong drag btsan la gus gus byams byams ma byas tshe bka' gnyan zhing tsub la drag po zhe drag yod skad/gnyis/ dbyar ris cho ga'i skor/ de ni bod zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la sne gdong rdzong dpon dang / sku ngo lho spyi/ gzims khang chu 'khor 'og 409

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas mnyam du lhan 'dzoms kyis gsal sgrog gnang gi yod pa ni de ring nas bzung ste skye dman tshos skra zing du slod mi chog pa dang / stod hreng du thon mi chog 'ong ka'i rgyud la skad shugs chen po rgyag mi chog yul mi phan tshun bar rgyag res brgyab mi chog tha na byi'u la'ang rdo gzhus nas gnod 'tshe gtong mi chog pa bcas dang lhag don du sngags pa tshang mas ri yi sgang la sngags sgrub nas bsdad pa las gang byung gi grong phyogs rgyugs mi chog kho tshos zhogs pa lag ris gsal la mi gsal la yar langs nas mtha' 'khor gyi ri yongs la mig lta dgos/ gal te ri rtse shar lho nub byang gang rung la sprin pa nag po sems can nam mi sogs kyi gzugs ldan pa zhig thon gyi yod tshe de nyin sngags pa tshos so so'i dben yul nas phyi la phyin mi chog par sgom sgrub kyi mthu rtsal bstan nas drag char ser ba sogs med par bzo dgos pa'i gsal sgrog zhig byed yod pa de'i steng na sngags pa tshang mas mdzub thel mnan nas dbyar kha'i ring zhing nang la drag char ser ba sogs kyi gnod 'tshe mi yong ba'i khas len dam bca' 'jog dgos/ lar na sngags pas dus thog tu grub rtags ston ma thub par sprin pa de dag thog ma chung chung zhig nas che ru phyin rjes mthar nam mkha' yongs su khyab nas lo legs tshang ma gtor brlags btang tshe sngags par nyes chad yong nyen yod pas yul thon nas 'gro dgos/grub rtags legs po bstan thub tshe zhing pa dud grangs la zhig te 'bru rigs bsdus nas sngags pa tsho'i lo 'khor mo'i gla rin du sprod/ dper na sne gdong la mtshon na zhing pa dud tshang re nas 'bru khal re skyel dgos par rdzong dpon lhan rgyas nas cha tshad nges can zhig bdag pa dang bzhi cha gcig tsam dgon pa'i grwa ba'i skal bar phul ba phud de byings tshang ma sngags pa so so'i yong 410

༄7/g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/'bab yin no//gsum/ kha 'brug dge 'dzin gtor rgyag gi skor/ sngar yod chos lugs cho ga dge 'dzin gtor rgyag ces pa de ni bod zla dang po'i lo gsar skabs tshugs pa'i dmigs bsal cho ga zhig ste yul gyi gdong 'dre la gla phogs rgyag pa'i dus ston zhig yin/ gdong 'dre zhes pa ni mi shi rjes kyi rnam shes la zer/ de ni mar ngan song la ma lhung ba dang yar mi lus sogs kyang len ma thub par bar dor 'khyams nas gdong 'dre chags pa de'o// dus ston de ni gdong 'drer lto chas sprad pa'ang gla phogs rgyag pa'i dus ston zhig gogadong 'dre de tsho'i sbyin bdag ni bsam yas pe har rgyal po yin/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin mo dgon pa'i lcog nang la lha yon tan dkar pos (sku chas tshang ma dkar rkyang yin/)gtsos pa'i bka' srung dag la bskang gso rgyas po zhig btang dgos kyi yod/ de'i dgong mo gdong 'dre tshang mar phogs rgyag pa'i dus tshod yin/ thog ma yon tan dkar pos bsam yas pe har rgyal por gsol ja phul ba'i mdzad sgo byed cing de nas pe har dang yon tan dkar po'i 'brang rgyas de bzhugs khri mtho dman gnyis kyi sgang la 'jog de rting lha tshogs gzhan gyi 'brang rgyas dag kyang gdan bkyag ring po gnyis yod pa de'i sgang la gsol/ de nas bzhugs khri dang gdan bkyag mdun la lcog rtse gral ltar sgrig te de'i steng la nas dang / gro/ sran ma/ 'bras sogs blugs pa'i 'bru rigs shing sder khag sgrig cing bu ram dang shing tog sna tshogs bkang ba'i dkar yol che chung mang dag sgrig slo ma chung chung sgor mo'i nang la gsol tshigs bshams pa'i cho ga btang / de bzhugs sgril ma khad g.yu dang byu ru/mu tig mchong / spo shel sogs rin chen dag bre dang / nya ga srang 411

༄7khu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la 'degs nas lha so so'i thob thang gzhir bzhag gis mdun gyi lcog rtse'i steng la bsgrigs kyi yod do//cho ga de sgrub zin pa dang lam seng khye'u dkar nag gnyis (gdong 'dre dkar nag gnyis/)gsol ba'i cho ga mgo btsugs/ bskang gso btang mkhan grwa ba brgyad yod pa de tshos dung dang rgya gling 'bud cing spub chal bkrol la rnga brdungs pa sogs dza drag pa dang ru ngar du btang / bzhugs khri mtho dman cha 'dra'i steng la stag gdan dang gzig gdan bting / lcog rtse'i steng na zhim zas rgyas po bsgrigs bshams byas nas sde pa gzhung gi bka' rgya gal chen zhig sgrog sbyang byed cing shar lho nub byang gi gdong 'dre che chung tshang ma gdan 'dren zhus pa'i bskang ba phul ma thag gral mgor bzhugs pa'i grwa ba de yar langs nas mchod 'phrin byed cing shar phyogs rang phebs shig ces gro nas sran gsum shar phyogs la gtor nas grangs 'bor chung ba nas che bar 'don gyi yod de/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur phrag khrig grangs med phul lo zhes ma thag khye'u dkar nag gnyis thon yong nas thugs rje che zhes kyi yod/ yang srong po'i tshad 'dzin mtshon pa'i lag cha srang dang nya ga'i nang la gser dngul g.yu byu ru mu tig phra men spo shel bcas bkyag tsam byas nas nor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa phul bas mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces shing de ma nyid du dar dang gos chen sogs gos gzan sna lnga phul lo zhes dar gos can mtshon pa'i tshags shog gang sar gtor ro// de tshe khye'u dkar nag gnyis kyis 'dod blo khengs pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston cing gar stabs ling ling bsgyur/ mchod pa phul mkhan grwa ba des skad shugs chen po zhe drag rgyag dgos/ gal te skad shugs chung drag na gdon 412

༄7khayoru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/'dres thos kyi med pas go ba log rtogs kyis gro nas sran gsum la g.yu byur mu tig gi snod chas gzed na yul gi rgyu dngos yod do shor nas sa bcud yul bcud nyams ste yul gyi mi tshang yod do dbul cing phongs par 'gyur zer/grwa ba des da dung phar tshur shed shugs chen pos rgyugs dgos/ de min tshe gdon 'dre shed shugs che ba la mang ba dang chung ba tsho la tog tsam las rag med zer ro// de bzhin lho dang nub byang tshang mar cho ga 'dra mtshungs byed cing skad shugs chen pos khrag la dga' ba rnams khrag ces/ ja chang la dga' ba rnams ja chang zhes/ chu dang 'o ma mar khu la dga' ba rnams de tsho ci mnyes ltar zhes la da dung dmigs bsal re 'bod byed par/ steng gi mi la ma gnod/ 'og gi chu la ma gnod/ zhing gi 'bru la ma gnod/ rkang gi brtsi bcud la ma gnod/ nor gyi 'o zho la ma gnod/ sad dang ser bas ma gnod/ nor dang longs spyod la ma gnod/ snyan grags khyab cing bde legs su gyur cig ces ma thag gdon 'dre thams cad 'tshang kha shig shig rgyugs yong nas so so'i dgos pa ci yod kyang bsnams nas 'dod blo khengs bzhin du phun tshogs gra rgyas 'di lta bu byung bar gnod pa gtan nas mi skyel zhes pa'i mtshon rtags khye'u dkar nag sogs nas rnam pa sna tshogs ston gyi yod skad/ gdon 'dre la bla phogs rgyag pa'i mdzad sgo de dgon pa'i grwa ba khag cig gis ma gtogs phyi'i mi ser tshang mas ha ma go ba byed cing /gdon 'dre'i phogs dang gla cha'i 'gro song thams cad sde pa gzhung nas gtong la de'i skor la bka' rgya cha tshang ba zhig kyang yod skad do//bzhi/ kha 'drug sa ga sa ri yi skor/ dpyid dus mgo brtsams la khad skabs khra 'brug dgon par sa ga sa ri zhes pa'i dus ston gyi cho ga zhig 413

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtong gi yod/ cho ga de'i dbu skyong mkhan ni dkon gnyer dpon zhes pa de yin/ de tshe lho spyi dang sne gong rdzong dpon bcas tshang ma der phebs kyi yod/sa ga sa ri zhes pa ni sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang a ce rgya bza' kong jo gnyis bzhugs sa'i chos rgyal lha khang nang la 'bru 'bo gang dang sran ma 'bo gang / nas 'bo gang / chang chang tshod gcig bcas bzhag gi yod skad/brjod srol la sngar btsan po'i skabs sa ga zhes pa'i skar ma de 'char ba dang srong btsan sku mtshams bzhugs 'go tshugs shing de'i ring la 'du khang nang gi gtsang khang (der sgrol ma lha khang yang brjod cing de'i nang la lugs gu dong nas lugs brgyab pa'i nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi 'jim sku mchod yod/ de yang sngar khra 'brug gtsug lag khang bzhengs rjes su rten gyi gtso bo rgyal ba sku lnga mchod cing nye ba'i sras chen brgyad li yul lcang rwa smug po nas gdan drangs kyang sku de dag mtshar po med pas chos rgyal gyis ma 'ong pa'i dus na mi tshang ma je mtshar du 'gro gi yod ngas sku de tsho mtshar po ma bzos na mis dad pa byed kyi ma red ces shing sku dag la yang skyar lugs brgyab dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar dgon pa dang thag nye ba'i shar nub kyi sa stong na lugs rgyag tu bcug pas der lugs gu dong zhes pa'i tha snyad de byung skad/)gi rgyal sgo brgyab te dar tshon sna lngas sgo lcags la lan bu rgyag cing de'i steng du chos skyong tshangs pas dam thel rgyag de nas chos skyong mar srong btsan gyi mtshams khang la gdan 'dren zhus rting mtshams sgo chos skyong sku ngo mas bskyon gyi yod skad/ srong btsan mtshams la bzhugs ring la dgon pa la chos mjal sogs gang yang med/ rjes ma skar ma sa ri zhes pa de shar ma thag yang skyar cho ga zhig byas nas sku mtshams grol skad do// phyis su mtshams khang de'i nang la gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku gdan 'dren zhus nas gnas bcu lha khang zhes 414

༄za//g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/'bod cing lha khang de'i rten gtso ni srong btsan sgam po dang rgya bza' kong jo'i 'jim sku yin pa ma zad sa ga sa ri yi cho ga de mu mthud byed cing srong btsan gyi sku mtshams su bzhugs pa'i tshul byed do//gong du brjod pa bzhin sa ri'i skabs su srong btsan sku mtshams sgrol ba'i dus ston yin pas de tshe dpon sna bo che zhes zhwa nag gi gos gzan 'dra ba zhig gyon nas tsan dan las bzos pa'i sna khug shin tu chen po yod pa'i zhal 'bag mchod(de 'khrab mkhan de khra 'khrug gzims khang gi mdzo g.yog rgyugs mkhan des byed la de 'khrab zin nas sku chas dag sku khog gi gzims khang nang la 'jog gi yod/)de sku ngo chos rje'i zhabs phyir 'khrid nas sa gzhi mar mnan pa'i cho ga stabs bde zhig byed kyi yod pa ni dpon sna bo ches dbyug pa ring po rkyang pa zhig lag par 'khyer yong nas mtshams khang gi sgo yol dang rtsig zur gang sar zhus nas skad sgra chen po grags su bcug de nas lugs gu dong du chang dang nas 'bru'i 'bo che chung sna tshogs bsgrigs nas mchod 'bul zhus/ sku ngo chos rjes (khra 'brug gzims khang lags/)rmon pa rgyag yas glang gog dor zhig 'khrid yong nas dpon sna bo che dang mnyam du zhing nang la byon nas gcig gis 'bru bshos pa dang gzhan zhig gis mthong gshol zin nas lo de'i zhing gi rmo mgo thog ma de nas brtsams/ cho ga de gzhug sgril ma thag yul mis lo der so so'i zhing nang la gro nas sran gsum gang mang ba btabs na legs min brtag pa'i tshe gal te nas mang ma bshos song na lo der nas rkyang 'debs shing nas sran bsres nas bshos yod na de ltar 'debs dgos zhes pa'am gro bshos song na da lo thabs shes gang drag bton nas gro gang mang ba 'debs dgos zhes srol yod pa de ni sa ga sa ri zhes pa de'o// mdor na sa ga ni chos 415

༄7|gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal mtshams la bzhugs 'go brtsams pa dang sa ri mtshams bzhugasasgril rting lo der son ga re mang ba 'debs dgos min brtag dpyad byed pa'i cho ga ya mtshan can de'o//lnga/ gra nang gser gong gi skor/ gra nang yul gyi gser gong zhes pa de khra 'brug dgon pa'i sa ri'i cho ga dang 'dra bar zhing khul so nam pa'i 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i don chen zhig lags/ de skabs chang lo chang btsos pa de kha phye nas chu brgyab cing de khams pa zhig gis mchod phud byed kyi yod pas de'i ming la khams pa lo chang yang brjod do// khams pa des da nga tsho dga' dga' skyid skyid byed dgos zhes lo gcig phyin pa'i chang de yul mi tshang mar mnyam du longs su spyod du bcug chang de lo gcig hril por kha bkug pa'i ldab chang yin tsang shugs ha cang chen po yod pas khams pa de lam seng bzi nas bka' lung gnang zhes skad cha zhe drag bshad do//brjod srol la las kyi dbang gis lo chang kha phye ba'i skabs la khams pa de dus rwa brgyab pa ltar tag tag der slebs kyi yod/ khams pa khos bka' lung gtso bo ni lo gcig nang ston thog ga re btabs na legs min brjod kyi yod/de yang khra 'brug dpon sna bo ches zhing rmos 'debs kyi brtag dang gra nang khams pas bka' lung gnyis sus tig min dang sus bden min la blta gi yod pas de gnyis 'gran rtsod chen po zhig go/ de gnyis gab brgyab na blos 'gel chog pa dang rgyab 'gal phyin na sus tig min blta dgos la yang khag cig dogs char gyi drwa rgyar tshud nas da lo gro dang sran ma bsres nas 'debs ste gang ltar gcig ni skyes bzang po yong rgyu rang red ces pa'ang yod skad/khra 'brug gzims khang zhes lha chen tshangs pa phebs mkhan sku khog gi mi 416

༄༅//g.yo ru khra 'brug dgon pa'i dus ston khag gi skor/tshang der sa cha rgya che zhing yong sgo chen po yod gshis rta g.yog dang bong g.yog mdzod g.yog bcas rgyugs mkhan g.yog po mang dag yod kyang dus rabs nyi shu'i nang la khra 'brug dgon pa'i grwa bas sku khog tshab byas pas khra 'brug gzims khang pa'i khang chen de bgo bsha' shor nas sku khog gi skye dman la cha shas cig sprad pa phud mang che ba de dgon pas nyar tshags byed do// lo rgyus thog skye dmano der dgon pas lo re la 'bru khal nyis brgya sprod pa dang skye dman de shi song na sku khog gi rgyu dngos thams cad dgon par dbang ngo //417

༄7/lha sa'i snang rtse shag las khungs dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon rnam gnyis kyi do 'gan 'khur 'os skor rags tsam brjod pa/snang rtse shag ces pa ni sngar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gong la sde pa snang rtse lha sar sdod sa'i shag yin pas ming de ltar thogs/ de'i gnas yul ni lha sa gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol byang ngos su mchis/ snang shag las khungs kyi khyab khongs ni lha sa'i gling skor nang tshud kyi sa khongs te gling skor lam gyi nub ngos nas/ lho gling skor lam gyi byang rgyud/ nub g.yu thog zam pa'i phyed nas thad drangs pa'i shar ngos/ byang gling skor byang lam gyi lho rgyud bcas kyi nang du yod pa'i grong khul rnams yin zhing / de phan chad zhol gnyer las khungs nas do dam 'gan 'khur dgos pa red/ snang shag las khungs kyi sprod khongs yig rigs su dam dmar nag 'khod pa'i rtsa 'dzin byed sgo'i yig rigs snga phyi cha tshang zhing batren po yod do//dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus dkyil tsam gyi gong la lha sa gtsug lag khang gtso bor gyur ba'i lha ldan khul gyi 'go 'doms bka' bkod gtong mkhan la chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa zhes zer gyi yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phredī ༵8 pa'i skabs mtsho sngon na mchis pa'i sog po cho thu hu yi 'go 'dzin gu shri

༄khya/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'golbadzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/bstan 'dzin chos rgyal la rogs 'degs yong rgyu'i re skul byas pa ltar khos dpung dmag phon chen khrid nas bod dbus gtsang phyogs la bcar te dge lugs pa'i kha gtad du gyur ba'i gtsang pa sde srid kyi chos srid dbang cha rtsa gtor btang rjes snang rtse sde pa la'ang nyes pa byung nas de'i lha sar yod pa'i sdod shag de tshur blangs te dus rabs de'i lo rabs bdun bcu'i nang la snang shag las khungs zhes pa dngos su gsar du btsugs so// de nas bzung lha sa khul gyi khrims 'doms chos rje'am dkon gnyer dpon zhes pa des gtsug lag khang ma gtogs lha sa'i khul yongs la 'go 'doms byed pa'i dbang cha shor ro// dus phyis su gtsug lag khang gi khrims 'doms de'ang shor nas lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs kyis bskyangs/snang rtse shag las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi/ las khungs de'i 'go 'dzin gtso bo ni shod skor gnas lnga pa'i nang gi las tshan mi dpon gnyis ste sngar las tshan pa rim pa lnga pa yin kyang phyis su rim pa bzhi pa chags/ 'dzugs khungs sa tsho pa yin pa'i drung yig gcig sger so so nas bsko bzhag byas pa'i gnyer pa gnyis/ 'dzugs khungs zhol pa las khungs yin pa'i khang gnyer gcig de'i gsham du las ka byed mkhan gad pa gcig btson srung gcig pu li si'i dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon gcig bskor bya ba sogs kyi 'go 'doms 'gan 'khur rags rgyab 'go pa zhes pa gcig da dung 'dzugs khungs so nam las khungs sogs las khungs 'ga' shas dang sde dpon mi drag khag bla brang che khag sogs nas 'dzugs dgos bskor bya ba mi grangs sum bcu tsam yod/ snang shag las khungs kyi las bya ba tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni/ dar chen gzim bzhengs dang / btson pa bros byol 419

༄za//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'tshol zhib/ btsog rigs kyi zhabs brtan/ rdzas cha bsdu nyar/ phyogs nas yong ba'i sprang por bdag skyong / ra kha tsha skur tshul la rtsis sprad mi sna bdag nyar/ nag can khrag sbyor lag bstar byed rgyu sogs yin la de tsho'i 'go dpon ni bskor bya ba'i nang gi rags rgyab dpon po zhes pa de yin mod kyang rags rgyab pa'i nang khul nas rda' yas zer ba zhig yod do// bskor bya ba rnams kyi nang nas sa res bskor bya ba zhes pa de lha sa khul du sa khungs bgo bsha' brgyab yod do// khungs so so'i sa khongs su gnas tshul lhag na sa res bskor bya bas sa khungs de'i 'go 'dzin par gnas tshul shod par yong ngo //so so'i khungs su brda lan skyel dgos pa'i rigs sa res bskor bya ba so sos byed dgos/ sa res bskor bya ba de tshor lha sa'i dmangs khrod kyis ming 'bod bya srol du zhabs chag lags zer ro// de tshos gras bskor bya ba mi nyi shu skor mchis/ de min btson khang btson srung pa gcig kyang yod/ rags stobs 'go pas rags stobs pa dang pi gtong ba rnams kyi 'go 'dzin byed dgos/snang shag las khungs kyi las 'gan gtso bo ste khrims kyi skor/ spyi'i bde 'jags/ dpal 'byor dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i skor/ 'phrod bsten bskor g.yeng skor/ 'bo dang rgya ma gcig gyur yin min skor/ khral 'bab skor/ lha sa'i dar chen sku bzhengs/ snang shag las khungs kyi rten gtso karma shar chos skyong skor/ bsher khang las khungs dang 'brel ba yod skor/ lha sa gnyer tshang dang zung 'brel skor/ gor zhib las khungs skor bcas so//420

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/ mi dpon gnyisaklis dbyar dus lha sa skyid chu'i chu rags la do dam byed dgos skor/ lo re'i dpyid ka'i mtshams su bka' shag lhan rgyas lha sa'i stod dpal grong mas spyi gzhung gis ko gru btang ste rags bskor brgyab nas rags gsos dgos rigs zhib 'jug tho 'god thog skyid chu'i smad rgyud rags gsol do dam mgron zhol gnyis dang stod rgyud du mgron mi sbrel po zhes rtse mgron gcig dang mi dpon gcig zung sbrel bsko bzhag gis chu rags nyams gso byed dgos pa'i dgos dngul lag 'dzin dang 'brel ba zhu len thog dgos mkho ja mar rtse shod phyag mdzod gnyis nas zhu rgyu'i lam ltar bka' 'dzin zhus te len sprod cing lha sa tsho pa sogs rags 'khri so sor bkod khyab kyis nyams gso zhus zin mtshams bka' shag lhan rgyas gzigs zhib tu ko thog tu gong bzhin phebs te gzigs zhib gnang gi yod/ de grub rting gling ka'i nang chu rags do dam so so'i rtsis khongs nas gsol ston gra sgrig gzab rgyas zhu rgyu dang chu rags do dam pa so sos sngar lam gnang cha dngul shog chag dang kha btags bcas yod pa red/ dbyar dus rgyun du sku 'bum thang du rags gnyer pa gcig la 'gan dkri bsko bzhag byas yod/ kho pas dbyar kha gtsang chu rgyas skabs chu che chung gi tshad mtho dma' ji yod skabs so sor chu tshad 'khyer yong ba gtsang po shugs chen rgyas nas chu kha'i tshad mtho shos slebs tshe mi dpon nas thad kar rtse 'gag dang bka' shag tu snyan zhu byed dgos par ma zad rdo mang po dbor 'dren gyis chu rags nyams gso kha gsos rgyag dgos/sngar dus lha sa'i shar phyogs 'o pa gling dhizhes pa'i gtsang po'i chu rags yod sa ste da lta'i gling skor lho lam gyi 'gram nas yin cing / rags de'i rgyab tu rags rgyab dur khrod zhes dur khrod zhig dang mchod rten kyang yod/421

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma gzhi gna' rabs lo rgyus ldan pa'i dur khrod rtsa chen duzhig yin lugs brjod kyang der mi'i phung po tha dag khyi spyang gi rgyud pa yin pas khyi la ster gyi yod pas tshig ngan brjod skabs khyi bal zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin skad/ phung po mchod gtor byed sa'i smad rgyud du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas gtsang chu rgyas pa'i kha gnon du rags smad btsan khang zhes ko ba gtong mkhan mnyan pa gtso bor gyur ba'i gnas lha gzhi bdag ste gnyan mkhar nag gtso 'khor gsum zhes pa de'i rten mkhar ram pho brang bzhengs shing /gnyan mkhar nang gtso 'khor sku phebs mkhan sku khog gi rtsa sgo dbye bar ma zad/gnyer gtad mdzad pa ni gos chen lha chas cha tshang thog zhabs lcag yu ring bcas stsal te smad btsan khang de'i nang la mchod de gsol kha legs po gtong dgos kyi yod/ de ltar ma byas tshe bka' gnyan pas chu log sogs shugs chen yong nyen ha cang chen po yod ces brjod do//bod kyi lo gsar skabs dar chen sku bzhengs kyi do 'gan 'khur 'os skon/ spyir lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi phyi mthar dar chen bzhi rjoyod pa'i nang nas gtso bo gnyis yod pa'i gcig ni dga' ldan dar chen dang gzhan zhig ni shwa ba skya rengs zhes pa rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i phyag 'khar dar chen la rgyan yod gshis bstan pa'i srog shing zhes zhu zhing de min lha sa dang rtse po tā la'i rgyab mdun/ nor gling sogs su dar chen che chung sna mang yod par lo gsar tshes gsum gong la na bza' gsar pa sgron tshar ba byed dgos/ lo gsar tshes gsum nyin dar chen bzhengs skabs sngon la dga' ldan dar chen dang de rjes shwa ba skya rengs bzhengs/ de tshe dar chen gyi dbu tog la rgyal ba'i thugs smon snyan shal dang sbrags rtse shod bka' shag bcas kyi sku tshab dang mi dpon ngo 422

༄༅/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/ma gnyis po bcas dar chen sku bzhengs ma grub bar du mig bltas nas 'grigs min la bkod 'doms byed kyi yod/ des na sku dpon tshor gdan khri brgyab yod par de'i steng la gzab mchor spras nas bsdad/ kho tsho'i mdun gyi lcog tse'i sgang la gro so phye mar dang ja chang sogs sgrig gshom byas yod/ der bcar bzhugs mdzad pa'i sku tshab dge 'dun pa rnams kyis dar chen gnyis kyi nang nas shwa ba skya rengs gtso che bar 'dzin cing skya mi dpon rabs tshos dga' ldan dar chen la do 'khur cher byed kyi yod pa ni srid kyi zil shugs dar cing 'phel ba'i rtags yin no// de'i nyin tshes gsum mdzad sgo zhes drung ja gtong gi yod pa der mi dpon gnyis gtam snyan zhes zhu bar bcar dgos pas phal cher dgong dro'i chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la ma gtogs dar chen sku bzhengs tshar gyi med do// dar chen sku bzhengs sgrub 'phral rtse pho brang gi tshes gsum gzab gsol sar shar rgyag phyin te dar chen sku bzhengs sgrub pa'i gtam snyan zhu bar 'gro dgos pas rtse 'gag tu 'byor 'phral 'gag mjal sar phyag gsum 'tshal te rtse mgron brgyud rgyal bar mjal dar phul nas dar chen sku bzhengs legs zhus zin pa'i bkra shis gtam snyan yin zhes zhu degos/ de ma nyid du yar phul zin pa'i kha btags de mar phyir slog thogaljags mdud dang sbrags kha btags a she spus legs re gnangagi yod pa de ni chu rags zhig gso'i mdzad sgo'i thog der sgron dgos/de nas mi dpon gnyis brel 'tshub chen po'i ngang shar rgyag rdzong rgyab tu bcar te tshes gsum thog mda' zhes sde gzhungardzobaka' shag gi gtsos rtse shod skor yongs rdzogs grol ston mdzad sgo tshugs kyi yod pa der phyin nas dar chen sku bzhengs zhus zin pa'i snyan zhu'i kha btags mgron brgyud phul te gtam snyan 423

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhabs pad lhan rgyas la thad kar snyan seng zhu'o// de tshe bka' shag gis khong gnyis stag gdan steng 'khod du bcug nas mgron ja bkyag cing kha btags rang slog thog dkar spro dgu sder re dang shing 'bras rgya cog re yod par longs su spyod du 'jug lo gsar tshes gsum nyin dar chen sku bzhengs kyi las 'gan ni mi dpon rnam gnyis kyi 'ga' 'khri gtso che'i gras shig yin pas lo ltar rkyen sel zhabs rim rgya che la do nan pa sgrub dgos sogs sems 'khur chen po byed dgos/ gal te dar chen la skyon byung ba'am legs par bslangs ma thub tshe skabs 'phral du mi dpon gnas dbyung gtong ba'ang lo rgyus thog byung myong yod mus lags so//lha sa'i bde 'jags thog the jus byed mkhan pu li si'i dmag sgar la 'go 'doms byed dgos skor/ spyi lo 1921lo ste bod lcags bya lor legs ldan sa heb nas las lugs bslab pa'i srol rgyun gzhir bzung gis phyis su pu li si'i dmag sgar 'go 'doms mi dpon nas gcig lcogs byed dgos shing / dmag sgar nang gi gnad don mi dpon gnyis nas thag chod na dang de min dmag spyi khang gis gnas lugs bshad de las thag gcod kyi yod/ dmag spyi khang gi dmag mi dag tsho khang so so nas res mos kyis sa khungs so sor nyin mtshan ltos med kyis sdod bya dang bde 'jags skor g.yeng byed dgos shing / dmag sgar rang du 'go 'dzin mkhan brgya dpon gcig gtan sdod byed dgos kyi yod/ spyir las khungs so so'i nang gnas tshul ji byung pu li si dmag sgar la zhus rting des las 'gan mnyam sgrub kyis dgos thag gcod pa'am dmag spyi khang la gyodagos/ sngar lo rgyus thog pu li si khrims non che khyad bzo rigs sogs khrims 'go rang btsan ltar dang las 424

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/khungs bskor bya ba rnams nas bskor g.yeng lta rtog byed pas 'thus kyang dus phyis su pu li si'i dmag sgar snang shag khongs su gtogs te des khongs gcig sdud byed dgos pa sogs ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dus su gsar gtod byas pa 'o//lha sa'i 'phrod bsten gtsang sbrar the jus byed dgos skor/ dmigs bsal gtsang sbra'i bskor g.yeng gi las sne che rigs skabs su gnyer drung rnams 'gro ba tsam las nam zhag rgyun gtan gyi bskor g.yeng du pu li si'i tsho khang so sos bskor g.yeng byas nas mi dpon gnyis nas bkod 'doms btang na 'thus mod kyang lo gcig dus gcig gam bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga ste dga' ldan lnga mchod ces shar tsong kha pa chen po sku gshegs pa'i dus chen khyad 'phags de'i skabs su rtse pho brang gi mchod khang khag la mchod 'bul khrus gsol du rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon su rung dang yongs 'dzin dgagazhung zhabs tshang ma gser sdong so so dang lha khang gtso che ba rnams la dgong dro sa srib ma zad skya ser mtho dman yongs rdzogs gzhung zhabs su sdod dgos pas de dus gnam gshis grang ba'i khar nyi 'od med pa'i thog 'og gdan srab cing ar ka grang mo'i steng sdod dgos kyang mi dpon gnyis mgron cher dgongs zhu'i snyan seng zhus te nyin gung yol tsam nas bskor g.yeng du 'gro dgos pas rdog thon thog lha sa'i bar skor sogs sa gnas gal che ba rnams su mi dpon gnyis rta bzhon zhing pu li si dang bskor bya ba sogs las bya rnams kyis kho gnyis kyi rta khrid de bskor g.yeng che mor 'gro dgos/ gang lags she na/ dga' ldan lngamachod dus chen yin gshis dgong mo sa srib mtshams su grong khyer yongs kyi khang pa'i yang thog steng du rang rang 'byor 425

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stobs la gzhigs pa'i mchod me khra thing nger spar gyi red/ de tshe mi dpon ngo ma gnyis gtsang sbra'i bskor g.yeng du phyin nas mchod me rnams gtsang ma yong ched gtsang sbra'i bskor g.yeng la do nan chen por brtsi dgos/ gal te me skyon sogs kyis gnas tshul tshabs chen lhag tshe kho gnyis kyis kha 'khri med pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos par ma zad tha na go gnas shor ba'i nyen kha'ang yod do//de min lha sa'i sa 'og gi chu 'gro'i sa khungs so so'i yur lam gyi tho yig ltar do dam byed rgyu'i 'gan 'khri yang yod la lha sa'i bar skor gyi byang chub byon lam zhes gtsug lag khang gi mtha' 'khor na khyad du 'phags par brtsi ba der rdzab yur yang yang lud yong ba'i nang la za rigs lhag ma dang dor rdzas la sogs tshang pas sa cha de ha cang btsog cing lhag par dgun kha sa cha der mchin 'khyags btsong sa byas tsang rdzor po zhe drags yod do//lha sa'i tshong ra'i do dam las 'gan 'khyer dgos pa'i skor/ de'i thog la 'thus sgo tshang ba'i bya thabs dang bka' khrims legs po zhig med la de tsam gyis dbang shugs mi 'dang bas nus pa chen po thon mi thub/ dper na lha sa'i phyogs 'grul tshong pas tshong 'grems pa'i sa gnas khag na mar dang phyur ba/ rtsam pa/ 'bru rigs sogs brje tshong skabs snang rtse shag las khungs kyis rgya ma dang 'bo/ bre sogs tham 'byar ma sprad nas 'degs gshor drang po byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod mod kyang de dag la mjug gnon dang rtog zhib mtha' 'khyongs byed mkhan med pas khrims 'gal gyi las snol spel mkhan mi nyung ba zhig yod/ lhag par du sku drag dang /dgon sde/ sger pa mi tshang che khag sogs la gcig gyur mkhar 'bo dang mkhar nyag sogs yod kyang 'ga' shas kyis sger gyi rgya ma dang 'bo bed spyod 426

༄7/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/btang ba las gcig gyur rtsis med btang thog 'bru rigs dang / mar/phyur ba sogs rin gong gang mtho sprod mkhan byung na tshong pa dang bla ma su bzang gi dpe ltar so so'i rang 'dod ltar len rkyang las lugs mthun tshad gzhi med khar 'bru mar sogs 'bel nyo dkon tshong dang rin gong 'phar 'gro ba'i skabs yod mkhan rnams nas da dung gang mthor 'phar thabs byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang de tsho che btsan dang 'byor ldan yin dbang gis mi dpon gyis bkag sdom mi thub pa bcas so//nyes can la khrims sdom las 'gan 'khur dgos skon/ spyir na khrims yig thad zhal lce bcu gsum zhes pa rtsa 'dzin yin khul yang skabs 'gar gnas tshul dngos su gzhigs te 'char gzhi phyag rtags 'brel nas thag gcod dang chung rtsag rigs 'phral 'phral mi dpon nas thag gcod byed dgos pa red/ grwa rigs dang dmag mi'i gyod don dgon sde so so dang dmag sgar so sor thag gcod bya rgyur rtsis sprod kyi srol yod do// tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas khrims gcod skor la bsgyur bcos btang yod de dper na srog thog khrims gcod dang dbang po yan lag gcod bregs mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang yod stabs bod khul spyi yongs su mtshon na'ang phyogs mtha'i rdzong khag tu de dang 'gal rigs byung yod srid na'ang lha sar dbang po yan lag gcod bregs byas rigs su byung yod pa ma red/ lha sa'i rgan rabs myong ba can gyi brjod srol ltar na sngar ya mon dmag sgar du nyes can gyi dmag mi gcig gi rkang pa bcad pa'i gnas tshul byung bar sku phreng bcu gsum pas skabs der dmag mi'i 'go par nyes chad gnang yod ces so//'on tang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po gshegs rjes su bka' khrims don thog 427

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tu 'khyol med pa ni rgyal ba'i spyan gsal lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis ka bton pa'i nyes chad drag po bcad pa dang yang thengs gcig se ra'i zhal gzim gyis sgrig khrims 'chal bar spyod pa'i grwa pa gnyis kyi rkang lag bcad pa'i gnas tshul zhig kyang dngos su byung myong yod/ spyir na mi dpon gnyis kyi do 'khur gnang yul du gyur ba'i snang shag las khungs la gnas tshul de 'dra byung yod pa'i skor rgan rabs tshor brjod rgyu med pa ni kho gnyis kyis khrims 'doms srung cha legs po byed par mtshon/snang shag las khungs kyis khal 'bab bsdu ba'i 'gan 'khri'i skor/ lo gsar skabs dar chen slong ba'i tshe om thag dgos pas de'i thag pa'i dgos mkhor nag chu khul nas khul rtsid 'dres ma'i thag pa do po bcu tsam bsdu rgyu yod cing / lo rer dngos su om thag rang la bed spyod btang yas de ni do po gnyis tsam dang las bya rnams la skal ba phran bu re sprod dgos shing /sgrig 'bul la do po gnyis 'bul dgos pa phud/ de 'phros mi dpon sger so sor phyogs bgos brgyab yod skad/ om rgyan gyi om shing dang sdig ra'i yu ba bcas chu shur khul gling ga gar yod nas gnangs chag om shing zhes shing bcag brgyab nas gcod dgos/ lcam shing ring tshad lon pa nyis brgya skor bcad nas skyel 'dren yang chu shur mnga' khongs rang nas byed dgos so//lo rer om shing du dngos 'brel sprod dgos mkho dngos spyir grangs nyi shu skor dgos pa phud 'phros sger so sor phyogs bgos rgyag go/ de min rdza khral zer ba zhig kyang bsdu rgyu yod pa red la rgyun du las khungs su khrims gtugs byed mi su zhig byung rung gnad don che chung la ma bltos pas btang re gtong dgos pa de dag phyir slog byed srol med par len rkyang byed kyi yod/ dus mtshungs 428

༄༅/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/su khrims lugs dbang tshad thog dang 'char gzhi gzhir bzhag phyag rtags 'brel dgos pa dang mi dgos sna tshogs yod/ dper na dga' ldan dgon gyi grwa log 'ar dpon zhes pa kho pas gtso byas mi bcu gnyis tsam sgrig btsugs kyis lam 'phreng bkag nas rku 'phrog byed par ma zad/ da dung mtshan mo lha sa'i bla brang rnying pa'i 'og tu khang stong chen po zhig yod pa de bzung nas mtshan mo tshogs 'dzom gyis bkod jus gtso bo 'ar dpon nas byed pa'i gnas tshul shes rjes dgong mo 'ga' shas bsgugs te dgong mo gcig mi mang tsam 'dzoms pa'i skabs mi bdun 'dzin bzung thub pa dang de 'phros bros shor ba red/ de'i skabs gnad don tshabs che ba brag la'i thog mi gnyis bsad yod/ de dag gi byed gte lag dmar ba 'ar dpon yin pa ra 'phrod byung bar brten tsha 'dri byed dus lag dmar 'ar dpon la rta lcag brgya tham pa btang nas btson 'jug byas pa dang de byings so sor rta lcag bdun bcu re btang nas rags kha tsha skur tshul la rtsis sprod byas pa dang rkun dngos rnams lha khul ngo shes 'ga' shas la bcol 'dug pa rnams bsdu len byed pa ma zad/dngos po bcol khungs so sor nyes pa sgor mo nyi shu nas sum bcu bar btang nas thag gcod byas pa red/ gzhan yang rkun ma che chung gang shor rung rkun tho dngos min kha gsal las khungs su nyin bcu tshun skyel dgos pa rjes su rkun brtsad chod de dngos po thon pa byung na dngos po do bdag la phyir sprod kyis dngos po rin thang la phab pa'i bcu zur dngul 'bab las khungs nas bsdu ba dang nyes pa mgur mo gtong skabs mgur mo re la dngul ṭam ka brgyad re brtsi ba dang snga rabs ṭam dkar dngos mdog sprod kyi yod 'dug kyang rjes su ṭam dkar dza thang mtho ba dang dkon du song bar brten mgur mo re pad shag ṭam 429

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ —ka brgyad re len gyi yod/ khrims sa gong ma zhes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang bka' shag gi bka' phyag rtags 'brel ba'i nyes chad la gser srang 'brel ba'i nyes chad bkod nas gtong ba gser srang gang rer pad shag srang dgu dang tshag drug brtsi ba de yang pho lo mo lo zhes khyad par phran bu yod pa red/gyod gzhi che chung rigs thag gcod byed dgos skor/ gyod gzhi chung tsag la ma bden pa'i gnas tshul byung stabs shing gi sho dkar nag chen po gnyis yod pa dang bden don gyi dpang po yang med pa'i rtsod pa der sho ma brgyab gong slog sprod gtan 'bebs bzos rjes sho mig che chung bltas nas sho mig che ba babs pa der sho dkar shor mkhan nas dkar gsol kha btags gcig dang sbrang slog sprod dngul rnams sprod dgos/ grwa pa dang dmag mi'i dbar rgyab 'dre brgyab nas mi gsod yang yang yong ba dang mi gsod byed gte skabs 'phral 'dzin bzung ma thub par bros byol song tshe rab la chu shur dang rgyal rtse bar kha par gtong ba tsam las mi gsod byed gte kha shas mthar skyel 'dzin bzung thub kyi med pa dang dgong ltar lha sa'i chu tshod dgu pa'i thog dgong mo phyi mda' zhes las khungs sgo rtsa nas rdzas me'i rda kha'o zhes brgyab nas mtshan 'grul byed mi chog pa'i khyab bsgrags byas te mi gcig kyang phyir 'gro mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod pa red/ de min gnas skabs kyi gtan 'bebasagal che'i rigs bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byung su yin gyi chog mchan thob pa byed dgos/ phyi mda' zhes pa phyi logs mtshan 'grul mtshams gcod pa'i brda gtong me mda' yin pas phyi mda' brgyab zin nas mtshan 'grul byed skabs 'phral 'dzin bzung byas nas gnas tshang ra sprod byas te 'jog pa dang gnas tshang ra sprod bya yul med pa yin na de'i 430

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/dgong mo dmag sgar du bkag nyar byas nas sang nyin las khungs su skad btang ste 'dri rtsad byed kyi yod/mi dpon so sor yong 'bab gong gi khral bsdu lhag ma sger 'bab pa gong 'khod dang rkun dngos gzhung bzhes btang ba'i nang gyon chas sogs sna tshogs yod pa dang lhag par dmag sgar nas g.yog khongs dmag mi yod pa de dag dmag mi ngo 'dzugs ma dgos par sger gyi dmag dod len gyi yod cing dmag dod mtho bar ṭam rdo brgyad bcu yod pa red/ zla re'i dmag phogs mi rer 'bru khal gsum re brtsis 'bru khal 'bab kyi yod/de snga'i spyi tshogs thog las rigs tshogs pa khag nang rdo shing spyi pa ni nang khul du khrims 'go rang btsan zhig yin cing gtam dper od gtong dgos pa bzos byung zhes shod pa de ni de'i go don gyi gtam dper zer ba red/od ma btang nas khrims gcod byas chog pa las rta lcag gtong mi chog pa bzo pa khang zir ba 'tshem bzo spyi par yang nang khul gong dang 'dra ba'i nang khrims gcod chog pa zon khe pa de ni zon pa'i las ka tsam ma zad dos po rgyag rgyu sogs kyi las 'gan yod pa der nang khul 'go pa med kyang / 'go 'doms lte ba snang shag las khungs rang nas byed dgos/ rmar mdzo gsang gsum la 'go pa dang gzhung sog 'go pa/ wa gling sha yon/ sing pa'i 'go pa sogs yod cing lha bris par che mo ba drung gtogs zur du yod pa red/lha sar smon lam tshugs skabs snang rtse shag tu yod pa'i btson pa rnams sngon tshud nas zhol las khungs su skyel dgos pa dang bod zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin smon lam khral 'dzin tshugs nas smon lam nyi shu rtsa gcig dang tshogs mchod zhag bcu gnyis rang lha khul khrims dbang 'bras spungs tshogs 431

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen zhal ngos rtsis len gyis gral 'dzin nyin snang shag rdo skas gsham du zhang po shing gnyer dang chab bdag ma gnyis yong nas snang shag mdun gyi sa stong der dge g.yog rnams rdzig rngams gang che'i sgo nas mtha' bskor te sdod pa dang zhang po shing gnyer gyis lag rgyug sa la brdabs te skad shugs chen pos mar thon shog zer skabs bskor bya ba mi bcu tsam zhig las khungs rdo skas nas mar babs yong nas gsham der zhwa mo phud de bka' bsgyur nyan dgos pa de'i thog chab bdag ma gnyis nas smon lam ring bca' yig che mo'i dgongs don ltar bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis dgos don med pas khrims kyi bdag po mi nga gnyis yin zer ba'i khyab bsgrags byed pa dang mi nga gnyis zer ba zhal ngo'i sku tshab yin lugs bstan pa red/ de rjes zhang po shing gnyer gyis dar chen yod sa der rgyug pa gzhu tsam byas nas sdod skabs karma shar mgon po ba de'i sar bka' bsgyur nyan par yong dgos pa dang der chab bdag mas chu shur bstan pa tshe ring shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i blon po bya khri'i spun gcig ni ga la yin/ ring rkyen lam du song ba skye gnas ma phyin par gnas yod par smon lam ring rnga rdung rdung du ba phyur phyur bsangs ab ra'i kha rlangs tsam btang mi chog zer ba de'i rgyu mtshan ni chu shur bstan pa tshe ring 'drer skyes nas gnas chung chos skyong gi sdod gnas 'phrogs pa red zer srol yod pa red/ de nas rdo khung chu mig dang khang pa'i chu mig sogs la gong bzhin phyin te tshogs chu ma chad pa gtsang ma 'bul dgos pa'i tshogs gtam gtong ngo // de tsho ni tshogs chen zhal ngos lha klu mi gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i mtshon byed yin/lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs chogs chen zhal ngor rams 'degs byed pa'i skor/ lha sar smon lam tshogs ring spyir btang khrims dbang 432

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/yongs rdzogs tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis nas 'dzin pa las mi dpon gyis the gtogs byed mi dgos kyang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon smon lam tshogs phebs dang / byams pa gdan 'dren/ tshogs mchod gser sbreng sogs mi dpon gnyis spos sner 'gro dgos par ma zad/ lhag par bco lnga mchod pa'i dgong mo mchod gzigs yod na rtsa ba'i 'gan 'khur zhal ngo gnyis kyis byed kyang mi dpon gnyis kyis kyang bde 'jags sogs 'gan 'khur mnyam du byas nas bskor g.yeng du bskyod dgos shing / de nyin bod dmag rnams sngon tshud nas ru bsgrigs kyis klu sgug pa stong du ang gsar byas te sdod pa nyi ma rtag par bar bskor nas mda' dpon so sos nye khrid ru bsgrigs kyis rnga rdung sbubs chal btang nas gzab mchor ldan pa'i ngang ru sgrig dang pos bar bskor gcig brgyab zin rjes sde dpon rdo ring khang 'gram nas bla steng du kha gtad de tā la'i bla mar ru sgrig gnyis pas bar bskor nang srang lam khag tu dmag mi kha bkrams nas 'jog pa dang gzim chung pa rnams srang lam khag la thag rgya bkrams pa'i skabs bar bskor nang nas phyir thon 'gro mi ma gtogs phyi nas bar bskor nang tshur mi gcig kyang gtong gi ma red/ sa srib nas bar bskor nang las 'gan yod mkhan ma gtogs 'gro mi chog pa dang tā la'i bla ma mchod gzigs su phebs gnang skabs chibs zhabs su gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs cab langs 'gro dgos pa dang mchod pa so so'i 'gram du las khungs dang / dgon sde/ sde dpon khag sogs mchod bdag ngo ma so sos phyag 'tshal dang 'brel kha btags re phul ba mgron blang rang slog gus btud kyi sdod dgos skabs der yig tshang mkhan drung rgan pas mchod pa'i tho klog nas tā la'i bla ma'i bka' ltar ang ki 'god kyi yod/ rgyud stod smad 433

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs mchod pa legs gras kyang mang po yod/tā la'i bla ma rim byon mchod gzigs skabs bskor g.yeng byed dgos skor/ snang shag las khungs kyi mchod pa ni snga lo'i rnying pa der nyams gso phran bu byas nas 'jog pa yin stabs spags phyis 'dra ba zhig yod pa ang grangs dma' ba'i gras red/ tā la'i bla ma mchod gzigs ma grub bar bar bskor nang gi khang pa steng khang tshang ma nas lta mi chog pa'i bskor g.yeng yang yang bya gi yod rung steng khang rnams kyis bzhu mar bsad de ras sang nang nas lkog tu lta mkhan yod pa red/ mchod gzigs skabs tā la'i bla ma'i sku 'gram nas sku srung dmag mis gling bu gtong bzhin sri zhu'i gus bkur thog mchod gzigs zin nas gtsug lag khang du phyir phebs gnang ma thag bar bskor nang gi thag rgya glod kyi yod/ de'i skabs mi sdebs gcig gyur du 'ur nas sa cha dog la skabs re rgan rgon dang byis pa re tsam brdzis nas 'chi ba yang yong gi yod pa dang / nye skor grong gseb phan tshun bar bskor du sgor gzhas 'gran bsdur nam ma gsal bar byed kyi yod/chos skyong karma shar gyi skon/ snang shag las khungs kyis brten pa'i srung ma gtso bo ni chos skyong karma shar red/ de la zla gsol gtong dgos par ma zad/ lha sa khul nas tshes gsum pa dang tshes lnga pa ba zer ba sogs lha mi ba'i skyid sdug yod cing / gtso bo ni bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin 'dzam gling spyi bsang zhes lha gsol dang sbrags gling ka gtong ba'i dus chen du brtsi ba dang de nyin karma shar dang rags rgyab btsan khang gi lha mi lha bdag 'khor bcas nas lding gur chen po phubs nas de'i nang karma shar chos skyong dang de'i 'khor rags rgyab btsan khang chos skyong gnyis snga po nas spyan 'dren zhu sar mi 434

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/dpon gnyis 'gro dgos pas lha gsol zhus nas chang dngul phor gtong ba dang de nyin gur nang khong tshos gsol ston zhig bshams kyi yod kyang mi dpon gnyis so so'i sger gyi gling kar 'gro ba las gsol ston la sdod kyi med kyang las bya ba dang lha mi ba rnams gling kha btang nas sdod/ bod zla drug pa'i zla mjug tu karma shar ru 'dren 'cham rgyag gi ltad mor mi dpon gnyis mgron 'bod ltar bskyod kyi yod/ karma shar chos skyong lha sa'i sa bdag klu btsan dbang gi mdog tu 'bod pa de yin pas snang shag las khungs kyi bsten gsol dgos pa de red/ las khungs yong 'bab thog nas lo re smon lam skabs sgrig 'bul zhu dgos las khungs khag mang po yod pa zhol pa dang / lha sa gnyer tshang / snang shag chibs che/ bsher khang sku gnyer dpon sogs yod pa'i sgrig 'bul las khungs so so'i 'bab che chung la gzhigs pas ang grangs bkod nas de nyin do bdag ngo ma so so jo bo dbu skra'i steng rab gsal du ang grangs gzhir bzung gral 'grigs dgos pa de'i skabs ang grangs dma' po chags na ngo tsha po yod pa red/ sgrig dbus su sprod byed dngos po las khungs rang gi yong 'bab thog gi dngos po sna tshogs yod pa'i thog dngul rkyang yang sprod dgos/lha sa'i bsher khang dang 'brel yod skor/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang nang zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i las khungs btsugs pa'i nang gses drag po'i las khungs bsher khang las khungs red/ de'i ming cha tshang la bsher khang bdud sde tshar gcod ces zer/ bsher khang las khungs yod pa der phyogs mtha'i rdzong khag gi btson pa 'byor pa rnams bsher khang la zur du btson khang med stabs thag gcod ma zin bar snang rtse shag btson khang du 'jog dgos pa 435

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/red/ dga' ldan khri pa dang gnas chung chos skyong sogs la spos sne 'khur dgos gal che'i skabs 'ga' shas su bsher dpang dang mi dpon mnyam bskyod byed dgos/ bsher khang khongs gtogs btson pa rnams bsher khang rang nas thag gcod byed pa ma gtogs mi dpon nas jus gtogs byed dbang yod pa ma red/lha sa gnyer tshang dang zung 'brel byed sgo'i skor/ bod zla drug pa'i tshes pa bzhi nyin rgyas bshad shākya thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin gtsug lag khang gi bar khang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i spyan sngar yod pa'i chos rgyal sku dngos bzhugs skabs bed spyod gnang myong ba'i lo rgyus can gyi gna' rdzas rdza kho'i khrung sa ban ngo ma yod pa de'i nang 'khrungs phud gsar du 'gengs 'bul zhu dgos pas nyin de'i snga dro nam skya rengs skya 'go gtong skabs lha sa'i gnyer tshang dang mi dpon ngo ma rnams bar khang chos rgyal lha khang mdun du 'dzoms nas gdan khrir 'khod de bzhugs gral btang nas gro ma 'bras sil sogs sgrig gshoms kyi rten 'brel gzab rgyas byed skabs dpal gsol mas gzhas chen gyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang gnyer mi dpon ngo las kyis chos rgyal la snyan dar sogs 'bul dgos/ drung ja'i dus su chos rgyal khrung ban gyi khrung phud khyer nas nor gling du tā la'i bla ma'i sar srong btsan gyi khrung phud phul nas mjal kha zhu ba dang bka' shag tu de bzhin khrung ban btegs dgos pa red/ de nas lha khul mi drag khag dang mi dmangs tshos khrung ban nas byin rlabs zhu ba dang 'khrul gsol 'bul gyi yod/ de'i nyin khrung ban gdan zhu'i byed sgo 'di'i ming la dkar me bskul bzhengs zer zhing de'i don sngar lam gtsug lag khang gi dkar me'i kha gso dge bskul byed pa'i ming yin 436

༄/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/pa dang mchod mar zhal 'debs lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs su skyel dgos pas mi drag khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gi mchod rgyun gtong deb la'ang de ltar 'khod yod pa red/lha sa'i 'ong skor gtong ba'i skabs kyi 'gan 'khri'i skor/ bod zla drug pa'i zla smad dam bod zla bdun pa'i tsher shar gang rung la lha sa'i 'ong bskor gtong dgos pas de nyin lha sa gnyer tshang pa dang mi dpon ngo ma 'khor bcas nas dmigs bsal gyi gzab mchor thog jo bo dbu skra'i rab gsal du bka' shag lhan rgyas kyis lha sa gnyer mi dpon la phyogs bzhi'i g.yang 'gugs zhes pa'i 'ong bskor byed sgo'i bka' khyab zhus te gnyer mi dpon gyi gyon chas zhes pa'i mo sbu phru dang snyan pad 'dogs pa/ phyu pa brgyan bzhi/gser skad/ lha sa gnyer tshang pa ser mo bas 'phya gru chab stod thog tshang mas rta sga gser sga rgyag dgos la mgron gnyer yang khrid de g.yog por gos tshos yan gser ma dang gsog rgyab pa'i rta gral gyi sngon la rten mdung dang phyag dar 'khyer mi sogs dang lag stod pas nag gi chas gyon rtse 'phags pa lha khang gi nang rten dang lha sa jo bo na bza' sogs sku gnyer gyis gdan drangs te rta hrag bsgrigs nas lha sa'i 'ong bskor te glang rur gur phub nas gdan khri dang khri lcog sogs gra rgyas par yod par bzhugs gral btang / gro ma 'bras sil sogs bod zas rgyas pa cha tshang btang ste nyin gung lhod por bsdad/ dgong dro gsol ston btang nas dngul phor btegs/ de nas chu tshod bzhi tsam la rta gral 'grigs nas 'ong ga 'phros rnams bskor ba dang sbrags phyir log byed dgos pa red/ 'ong bskor ma tshar bar lha sa'i 'ong gar btsas ma brnga mi chog pa'i sngar srol gtan 'bebs yod pa bcas so//437

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gor zhib las khungs dang 'brel yod skor/ gor zhib las khungs do dam sngar lam mkhan rim thog mi dpon gcig 'gro dgos pa dang rang thog 'khel zhing gor kha'i phyogs nas gal che'i skabs kab tan ngo ma yong ba las rnam kun ḍi ṭa dang tha ka li gnyis yong zhing gor kha'i mi dang bod mi'i dbar gnad don lhag na thun mong nas thag gcod byed dgos pa dang gnad don che rigs bka' shag dang skabs 'gar rtse 'gag tu gnas lugs zhu dgos/gor zhib las khungs su rgyun sdod drung yig gcig ched mngags yod pa las khungs tshugs skabs ja dang zhal tog gtong dgos pa gor zhib dgos cha zhes pa zla re dang rtse shod las khungs khag nas yig rang gis blangs te gtong sgo yang 'gan len byed dgos pa dang yig cha khag dkar chag dang sbrags drung yig la rtsis sprod yod pa bzhin khong rang nas bdag gnyer byed dgos red/mdor na lha sa'i snang rtse shag las khungs kyi mi dpon gnyis kyi las 'gan gtso bo ni/ lha sa grong khul gyi khrims 'doms dang / bde 'jags do dam/ sa cha khag bgos kyis blta mkhan las res bskor bya ba re yod pa des so so'i sa khongs su gnas tshul ji byung dus thog tu gnas tshul snyan seng zhu rgyu/ sa gnas 'gag che sar pu li si dmag mi re nyin mtshan rtag sdod kyis skor g.yeng rgyag rgyus mtshon bde 'jags dang gatreng sbra blta skul byed rgyu/mi gsod gyod don che rigs mi dpon nas bka' shag la dgongs skor snyan seng zhu rgyu dang gyod don chung tsag de ga nas thag gcod byed rgyu/ da dung lha sa grong khul du chang ma khyim tshang dgu bcu tham pa gtan 'bebs kyis chang khral bsdu 'bab sogs gzhung rtsis zhu rgyu bcas yin/ snang rtse shag drung yig gis lha sa tsho pa'i 'go 'dzin byed dgos/ lha sa grong khul du khang pa gsar rgyag 438

༄7/lha sa'i snang rtse shag dang de'i 'go 'dzin mi dpon gnyis kyi skor rags tsam brjod pa/byed dgos tshe lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs su snyan seng tho 'god byed dgos pa sogs yin/mchan/durgya skad de gtsang po'i chu rags zhes pa'i don/ de'i rgyud la sngar rgya kha che mang che ba sdod de lha sa'i sha rigs dang tshal rigs thams cad de nas btsong gi yod la rgya kha che'i gzhis chags sa gtso bo de'i rgyud la yin gshis kha ches rgya skad ming de btags par grags/dude rtsa ba chen po yin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni sngar bod mi rtogs ldan pa'i dpa' bo zhes pa'i bla ma grags can de 'das rjes sku phung dur khrod der bskyal ba'i dbang gis der khyad 'phags yig 'bru a sogs rang byon yod par brjod la/ rags stobs ldan pas spyi rdzas su nyar ba de lo ltar sa zla'i tshes bco lnga nyin gling skor lho lam du chos mjal ba du mar mjal kha gtong ba dang chos mjal zhu mkhan tshos der thod pa gtugs shing /rten 'brel mtshon byed dngul sogs rang rgyur dpags nas phul gyi yod/melha sa'i bar bskor byang chub byon lam gyi shar du dus rabs bcu bdun gyi mjug tsam du sog po'i dmag dpon chen po dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis stod mnga' ris skor gsum phyogs su dpung dmag drangs te la dwags phud skor gsum sa khongs mang che ba sde gzhung mnga' 'og tu bcug pa'i mdzad rjes nam gnas ched dang bod yongs cig tu bsgyur pa'i rten 'brel slad du btsugs pa'i dga' ldan dar chen dang dus rabs bco lnga'i nang ste bod sa glang lor shar tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pas lha ldan smon lam chen mo srol gtod mdzad skabs bar bskor shar lho'i mtshams dung mtsho'i zur du shar skya ring btsugs/ gtsug lag khang gi lho sgo 'gram ste smon lam dang tshogs chen mo'i skabs su tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang dga' ldan khri pa na 439

〉〉//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rim nas bka' chos gnang yul gsung chos ra ba mchis pa de'i mdun du rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol skabs gsar du btsugs pa'i skal bzang dar chen/ gtsug lag khang gi jo bo dbu skra'i nub phyogs sa sbog sgang brgyud gzhung lam du dus rabs bcu bdun nang mtsho sngon na mchis pa'i sog po cho tho hu yi 'go dpon gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis mdo khams bi ri rgyal po cham la phab pa'i gtam snyan dar 'phyar skabs sde pa bsod nams chos 'phel nas btsugs par grags pa'i byus yag dar chen bcas so// 440

༄khya//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos dzi ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/'jig rten chen po'i 'phel 'gyur khrod du sa gzhi ril mo 'di nyid rim gyis chags pa'i dus yun ni 'jig rten khams gzhan dang bsdur na shin tu thung ba zhig red/ 'das zin pa'i lo ngo dung phyur bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam gyi ring 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi mes po rnams gna' bo'i spra rigs nas rim gyis da lta'i mi'i rigs su 'phel 'gyur byung zhing / chos lugs byung ba'i lo rgyus de 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs byung tshul dang bsdur tshe dus yun shin tu thung ba ma zad/ sa gzhi ril mo chags pa'i lo rgyus dang bsdur na de bas kyang dus yun thung ba zhig red/ chos lugs ni mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi cha zhig yin pa'i ngos nas brjod na/ spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs gzhan dang 'dra bar thams cad spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul lam phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi 'du shes kyi rnam pa mtshon byed cig yin dgos mod/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos ni yang dag pa dang dngos yod kyi thog nas phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang mthun pa mtshon thub kyi med par de las ldog ste phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang mi mthun zhing rbad de go ldog pa 'ba' zhig mtshon gyi yod pa ni en ke sis ‘‘chos lugs thams cad 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi rgyun lda~X ḍitsho

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i nang phyi rol stobs shugs kyis mi'i bsam blo'i rtogs 'char nyid kha lo sgyur bzhin pa'i snang tshul tsam red/ snang tshul 'di rigs ni mi yul gyi nus shugs kyis mi yul las 'das pa'i nus shugs bsdu len byas pa'i rnam pa zhig red/’ du ces gsungs pa 'dis bsgrub nus shing / spyir mi'i rigs kyi chos lugs ji ltar byung ba dang / 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba/ mthar med par gyur ba bcas kyi go rim ldan yod par ma zad chos lugs der dad gus dang brtse dung / de dang 'tshams pa'i cho ga sgrig 'dzugs sogs gang yin yang thams cad spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus las byung ba zhig red/ kho bos 'dir gna' bo'i lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen dang de las mched pa'i gna' bo'i chos lugs skor la ma smin pa'i 'char snang kha shas zhu rgyu yin pa la 'gal 'khrul gyi cha gang yod gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas dbang tshos 'khrul sel dag 'don dang dgag gzhag ci rigs gnang bar mkhyen/dang po/ mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi gdod ma'i dus su chos lugs gtan nas byung myong med pa/nye ba'i char grangs las 'das pa'i gna' rdzas sngog 'don dang 'tsho ba'i dngos yod khrod kyi don dngos mang pos ra sprod gsal po thub pa ni srog chags dud 'gro sogs la chos lugs kyi 'du shes lta bzhag mi'i rigs kyi mes po dang srog chags dud 'gro'i 'du shes la he bag gi dbye mtshams phye med pa/shin tu ring ba'i gna' dus spra dang snga rabs spra mi'i skabs la yang chos lugs 'du shes kyi dri mas 'gos med/ en ke sis ‘‘chos lugs ni ches gdod 442

༄7//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/ma'i dus kyi mi rnams dang / rang nyid kyi 'byung ba dang khor yug gi phyi rol yul gyi rang byung gnyis kyi go 'dzol gyi 'du shes dang / ches gdod ma'i 'du shes las thon pa zhig red ’ rjo ces gsungs yod/ gna' snga mo'i dus mi rnams kyi 'du shes kyi tshad gzhi shin tu dma' bas 'du shes kyi lta tshul de dngos po las ches rjes lus thebs yod la mi so so'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i 'jig rten 'dir mi rnams thun mong gis khas len pa'i tha snyad cig de bas yong mi srid la thon skyed lag len yang 'go brtsams ma thag pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs shin tu zhan pa/ thon skyed thabs lam dang khyab khongs kyang stabs bde min pa'i thog shes rig gi chu tshad ches dma' ba dang / mi'i rigs la tshang 'os pa'i bsam gzhigs dang 'du shes nyid kyi kho lag kyang rgyas thub med/ thun mong min pa'i lta grub de'ang tshor snang gi 'du shes kho nar brten dgos shing rang nyid dang phyi'i rang byung khams gnyis nya nyung mnyam bsres ltar las so sor 'byed pa'i nus mthu ma mchis par kho tshor thad kar phrad pa'i rang nyid dang rang byung khams sam de gnyis dang 'brel yod snang tshul sogs ldan pa'i 'char snang kho na las rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i bsam gzhigs ni gtan nas yong mi srid/ kho tshos rang byung khams kyi snang tshul du mas mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho bzhugs gnas sdod thad la rin thang skrun thub par de bas ngos 'dzin byed thub kyi med la der phan re'i skyabs bcol yang zhu thub kyi med/ rang bzhin gyi zol la brten te rang byung khams dang mthun thabs byed rgyu las 'char gzhi ldan pa'i bsam blo ni de bas gtong thub kyi med/de'i tshe rang byung khams kyis mi'i rigs la sprad pa'i gnon shugs je chung je zhan du gtong ba'i 'du shes rim gyis 'char srid la chos lugs kyi thog ma'i 443

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'du shes kyang rim bzhin 'byung srid/ dus yun ring po de 'dra'i nang mi'i rigs kyis rim bzhin bsags pa'i lag len gyi shes bya la brten te mi'i rigs rang gi bde ba bsgrub pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang chos lugs sogs kyi 'du shes kyang rgyun ring lo rgyus 'phel 'gyur khrod bsam gzhigs kyi 'bras bu zhig gi ngos nas 'byung srid pa las mi'i rigs byung nas de nyid la lhan skyes su grub pa'i snang tshul lam 'du shes shig gtan nas min snyam//gnyis pa/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs/en ke sis ‘‘chos lugs ni gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi shes rmongs dus rabs su thon pa zhig yin cing / de'i 'byung rtsa ni shes rmongs dus rabs kyi gu dog blun rmongs kyi lta ba de nyid yin ’ dhi zhes gsungs yod/ mi'i rigs kyi gdod ma'i 'tsho sdod kyi rnam pa ni kho tsho'i rten gzhi'i khor yug dang nya chu ltar rten dgos shing de yang thog mar babs chags kyi ngang tshul du gnas yod pa ni thon skyed nus shugs kyi cha rkyen shin tu zhan pa'i dbang gis yin zhing /'tsho ba'i khrod du mi'i rigs kyis thon skyed yo chas bed spyod dang bzo bkol byas pas 'du shes kyang je rgyas je zab tu song ba dang sbrags rang byung khams la 'dzin pa'i lta tshul de'ang rim gyis ming don mtshungs pa'i tha snyad du gyur/de bzhin kho tsho dus phyi'i spra mi dang bsdur tshe phyogs gang thad nas sngon thon du 'phel 'gyur byung yod pa mtshon thub mod/ rang byung khams kyi 'jigs snang sna tshogs kyi mdun du gnyom chung nus med du gyur yod pa dang /'jigs snang dang nyen kha sna tshogs kyis gtses pa'i dbang gis 'tsho thabs 444
