༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/dang za chas rigs rag thabs byed pa'i nus pa'ang shin tu zhan pas 'jig rten gyi ya mtshan pa'i rang bzhin dang lkog gyur gyi gnad don da dung mu mthud gnas shing rang nyid dang 'jig rten khams kyi dpog par dka' ba'i 'gyur ldog de'ang de ltar rtogs ga la nus/ de ltar 'gog thabs bral ba'i 'gyur ba sna tshogs kyis mi'i rigs kyi sems khams sogs la 'os 'tshams kyi dga' skyo chags sdang 'char la rang byung khams la'ang spyi'i lta ba'am tha snyad cig de bas yong mi srid pa dper na/ kho tsho'i klad pa'i nang ri zhig dang chu zhig kho na'i lta tshul las spyir ri dang chu yi tha snyad kyang yod mi srid/ der brten kho tshosaspyi dang bye brag gi snang tshul gzhir bzhag nas dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi khor yug la ngos 'dzin byed rgyu las bya thabs gzhan gang yang med pa dang rim bzhin chos lugs kyi lta ba byung ba gzhir bzhag chos lugs kyi 'du shes kyis gnad don thams cad thag gcod byed rgyu'ang kho tsho'i byed thabs nyag gcig tu gyur yod pa red/ mdor na rang snang dang / phyogs zhen/ kher rkyang gi 'du shes spyad de rang byung khams kyi dngos yod zil shugs tshad las 'das par sgro 'dogs pa'am stong bsam bcangs pa dang gzugs med grib bzo'i 'du shes bzung nas stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid dpog par dka' bar smra ba/ de min gna' bo'i spra mi'i shin tu dman pa'i myong tshor dang 'du shes las byung ba'i stong bsam gyis rang byung khams kyang rang nyid dang 'dra bar dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'char snang ldan pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta stangs can dang / 'dod blo can/ tshe srog can du ngos 'dzin byas pa'i dbang gis rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs dbar gyi 'brel bar 'khyog bshad dang stong bsam je cher phyin gshis/ mi rnams kyis rang byung khams 445

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la brten pa dang 'jigs snang skye ba/ de las ldog ste rang byung khams ni mi'i rigs kyi nus shugs las brgal ba dang dngos gzhi las brgal ba'i khyad chos can du sgrig par brten gdod ma'i chos lugs kyang mtshams de tsam nas rim gyis byung bar sems/gsum pa/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi nang don gtso bo dang snang tshul/1 rigs rgyud mchon byed dhidu 'dzin pa'i dad mos/ (1) rigs rgyud mtshon byed ni mi'i gdung rgyud kyi mtshon rtags yin/ rigs rgyud mtshon byed du 'dzin pa'i dad mos ni gdod ma'i dus su mi'i rigs kyis rang nyid dang phyi'i rang byung khor yug la 'dzin pa'i ha cang blun rmongs dang shin tu mi gsal ba/ ches gdod ma'i lta ba'i khrod dar ba'i chos lugs dad mos kyi phyi tshul zhig yin la gdung rgyud lam lugs dar bzhin pa'i go rim khrod byung ba zhig kyang red/ de dus gna' bo'i mis gdung rgyud kyi 'byung khungs gnad don der 'grel bshad byed thabs bral bas mi dang dud 'gro'am skye dngos/tha na rang byung khams kyi phyi'i snang tshul dbar dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba zhig yod 'dod par ma zad/ mi'i rigs rang dang srog chags/ yang na skye dngos kyi dbar yang gnyen nye'i 'brel ba yod pa'i stong bsam 'khyer gyi yod la da dung mi'i rigs kyi gdung rgyud kyi khongs mi dag gi 'byung khungs ni srog chags sam skye dngos shig yin par ngos 'dzin byas te srog chags dang skye dngos so so'i mes po dang yang na chos skyong srung ma mtshon byed gcig tu brtsis 446

༄7//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/te dad mos byed pa spyi dang yang sgos rigs rgyud mtshon byed de gdung rgyud kyi mtshon rtags su ngos 'dzin byed pa de la mar khe sis 6‘rigs rgyud mtshon byed ces pa'i tha snyad de ni mi'i gdung rgyud kyi mtshon byed dang rtags mtshan red/dper na spyang ki ni spyang ki'i gdung rgyud kyi rigs rgyud mtshon byed dang hin ṭin ’’ ( 1beb67gabya)mi'i gdung rgyud mang po'i khrod ‘mo ses (lo0byasnubya)mi dang 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud cig dar yod pa der gzhigs na kho tsho'i mes po thog ma de srog chags dang sems med dngos po nas 'phel 'gyur byung ba'i pho dang mo yin zhing de tsho'i gdung rgyud mtshon rtags nas rigs rgyud mtshon byed du gyur yod pa red/ yang kho tshos brjod pa ltar na kho tsho tshe las 'das rjes yang skyar dom dang ri skyes shwa bar gyur bar 'dod ’ duces gsungs yod/ me gling byang ma'i hin ṭin mi'i yul skad du ‘rigs rgyud mtshon byed’ dam ‘ 101bhus/’zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi thog ma'i go don ni ‘kho'i gdung rgyud’ dam ‘kho'i gnyen nye'i rigs ’ zhes pa nyid yin zhing rigs rgyud mtshon byed du 'dzin pa'i dad mos ni 'dzam gling gi rang bzhin can zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu yod pa'i snang tshul zhig kyang red/ nga tshos 'brel yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha du ma las shes rtogs thub pa ni o gling du rigs rgyud mtshon byed gtso bo srog chags dang skye dngos gnyis yod par ma zad da dung sprin pa dang / srug pa/ nyi zla/ 'ja' tshon/ lhag pa/ du ba/ chu/ rgya mtsho bcas kyang yod la/ tsho khag so sor rang nyid kyi rigs rgyud mtshon byed khongs gtogs cha tshang dang / tsho pa khag rer gdung rgyud kyi rigs rgyud bcu grangs nas brgya grangs bar yod pa dang / en ke sis ‘‘mor kan (sa1026(sa) gyis i ro khu'o zi 447

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(1stu'akya01ci)mi'i gdung rgyud dper bkod yod ces dang lhag par du se ne khā(byaskukhosnubus)rigs kyi tsho khag gi gdung rgyud de gna' bo'i gdung rgyud kyi gdod ma'i snang tshul zhig red/ tsho pa der gdung rgyud brgyad yod par tshang mar srog chags kyi ming btags yod ’ rjoces gsungs/ des na gdung rgyud khag so sos ming btags pa'i srog chags ltar brtsi ba'i mes po rang yin zhing hin ṭir mis grong tsho so sor 'dzul sa'i sgo 'gram du mtho tshad h+pho khre (ṣ+ṭa001)sum cu lhag tsam kyi rigs rgyud mtshon byed kyi rtags mtshan bkod yod/ i ro khu'u zi'i mis so so'i rigs rgyud mtshon byed kyi srog chags kyi lpags pa yang sdod khang gi steng la 'gebs srol yod/ dper na o gling du byi ba brang khug can (khulas24200bya)rang gi rigs rgyud mtshon byed du 'dzin mkhan gyi gdung rgyud mi sna la byi ba brang khug can gyi skor gleng tshe kho tshos ‘de ni nga'i gcung po'am ’ ‘nga'i lus steng gi sha yin zhes brjod la/ gna' rabs i ji pha khre (bhutri121)yi gdung rgyud khag gi srung ma mang che bar gdung rgyud de'i rigs rgyud mtshon byed spyad nas mtshon gyi yod pa ni seng ge dang gzigagatsod/ ri bong / chu glang / khyi sogs yin/ de min ke ri si'i (622bhububhu)a ga thi (46salamar)mis ri skyes dom nyid gdung rgyud du 'dod pa dang / gna' rabs a then sa (41yakhrikhobya)yi gzhon nu ma tshos ri skyes dom la phyag 'tshal bkur sti byed skabs dom lpags gyon pa dang da dung mo dom yin zhes brjod/ gnas tshul 'di dag gi thog nas ke ri si'i mi rnams la rigs rgyud mtshon byed 'dzin pa'i dad mos brtan po yod pa mngon/rang rgyal gyi rgya rigs khul du'ang rigs rgyud mtshon byed kyi srol dar khyab chen po byung ba ni dper na rgya'i gna' gzhung grags can 〈〈mo'i yi snyan tshig dang 448

༄7//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/hrang la bstod pa 〉〉zhes par ‘gnam gyis bskos pa'i las dbang nyid kyi bya//sa steng babs nas hrang nyid byung ba yin zhes 'khod yod la/ yang rgya'i lo rgyus mkhas can sku zhabs ko'o mo ros ‘‘srol rgyun gtam rgyud nang hong ti (rjomalo1)la dom rigs kyi ming can dang shon yon (lhar〉rgyu)rigs kyi rtags yod//de nica byang phyogs kyi gdung rgyud tsho pa khag du mas rang so so'i mes po dag hong ti kho nar ngos 'dzin byas pas mngon la ngag rgyun gzhan du hong ti dang yan ti (74nyeblo)sogs dmag 'khrug byed skabs dom dang gzig stag sogs gcan gzan ri dwags spyong brdar byas te dmag 'thab khrod zhugs myong yod/don dngos thog gcan gzan ri dwags la ming btags pa'i gdung rigs dag gi mnyam sgrub byas pa'i tsho pa zhig yin/ hong ti ni dom rigs yin pas/des na dom rigs ni tsho pa de'i nang go gnas mtho shos der slebs pa gsal bshad byed thub/mi’dhi ces gsungs 'dug de bzhin gna' dus bod rigs la'ang rigs rgyud mtshon byed yod pa ni 〈〈thang yig gsar ma'i thu bhod kyi lo rgyus 〉〉su ‘‘ ‘sti zhes pa'i g.yang lug de lha chen du brtsi ba ’’rjozhes ‘sti ’ni skabs der sa mtho'i g.yang lug cig yin zhing de'i sha za ba dang pags pa gyon pa/ de'i lus steng gi bal gyis snam bu sna tshogs bzo chog pa ma zad mtsho bod mtho sgang du med du mi rung ba'i skyel 'dren bya byed kyi bkol spyod dkon po zhig red la de dus bod khul du dud 'gro phyugs zog la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan gyi 'brog pa tshor mtshon na so so'i rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba shin tu zab pa'i phyugs rigs de rigs rgyud mtshon byed du 'dzin pa ni gdod ma'i mi'i dad mos kyi cha zhig dang der ya mtshan byed dgos don ci yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gong du brjod zin pa des 'thus shing / gzhan yang 449

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbyi rigs (tsho'i〉khri)kyi grags can dpe gzhung rnying pa 〈〈chin e the dbyi gangs kyi bu rgyud bcu gnyis〉〉su 'gro ba mi'i rigs dang rtsi shing / nags tshal/sbal ba/ sbrul/ 'ug pa/ dom/ spre'u bcas srog chags dang skye dngos thams cad gangs nas byung ba dang / de dag gangs dmar mo'i bu tsha yin zhes pa'i bshad srol de yang gong dang 'dra zhing / bod ljongs lho khul na 'tsho sdod byed pa'i yul mi lho pa tshos mi'i rigs dang rang byung khams su gzhi grub pa'i srog chags dang skye dngos phan tshun dbar rtogs dka' ba'i khrag rgyud kyi 'brel ba yod cing de dag kho rang tsho'i mes por brtsis te rigs rgyud mtshon byed du ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ rigs rgyud mtshon byed de dag dang lho pa rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i dbar 'brel 'dris dam zab yod/ rang rgyal gyi lho rgyud khul du gnas pa'i pu lang rigs (rkotsholha'i)kyi rigs rgyud mtshon byed ni srog chags chung chung byi la sprug mdog can dang sbal rigs sogs yin la kho tshos byi la smug mdog can mes po'i bla srog la ngos 'dzin byas te srog chags chung chung de khung bu nas phyir thon tshe/ mi mang pos rgyang ring nas gab bsdad pa las/ mig zur tsam yang blta mi nus pa ma zad/ der gnod 'tshe de bas kyang gtong mi nus/ gal te gnod 'tshe gtong rigs byung najimes po'i bla srog la phog thug byung ste rang dang gnyen nye thams cad rtsa med 'gro ba sogs kyi gegs bar chad yong bar bshad/ de la mor gan gyis ‘‘me gling sa gnas khag gi sa skyes rdo skyes yin pa'i yul mi tshos ha lam gdung rigs tshang ma srog chags shig dang skye dngos shig yang na rang byung khams kyi dngos po gzhan zhig so so'i gdung rgyud kyi mtshon rtags su byed kyi yod/ de ni gdung rgyud cig dang gzhan zhig dbar dbye 'byed kyi dmigs bsal 450

༄za//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/mtshon rtags shig yin cing / pha rgyud spyi tshogs su ma slebs gong ro ma (20sa sgru)dang ke ri si sogs kyi gdung rgyud kyang srog chags sam skye med dngos po bcas su ming btags pa zhig red ’ dhices gsungs yod la mdor na gong du bstan zin pa dag las shes gsal ltar rigs rgyud mtshon byed ni chos lugs dad mos kyi snang tshul mngon gsal dod po zhig dang ches snga shos shig yin par mngon/( 2)rigs rgyud mtshon byed gdung rgyud las byung ba/ mi'i rigs kyi 'du shes ni gna' bo'i spra mi'i 'du shes nas rim pas 'phel rgyas su phyin pa zhig yin/ spra nas mir 'gyur ba'i go rim nang rang byung khams kyi yo chas rdo rigs sogs bed spyod gtong bar goms rjes des rang nyid la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i brgyud rim nang mi'i 'du shes kyang rim pas dar 'go brtsams pa dang ngal rtsol nus shugs dang skad cha sogs yar rgyas phyin pa'i dbangagis klad pa'i tshor dbang sna tshogs kyi skye shugs kyang je cher 'gro bar skul 'ded shugs chen thebs te snod kyi bkod par ngos 'dzin byed pa'i go rtogs mtho ru phyin pa dang snod kyi bkod pa sna tshogs ni so so'i 'tsho ba dngos dang thad kar 'brel ba dam zab yod pa shes te/ yo chas rnams so so'i 'dod blo gzhir bzung las snon byas pa dang rim bzhin 'jig rten gyi bya dngos sna tshogs la ngos 'dzin gting zab byung 'go tshugs/ de ni mi'i rigs kho nar mchis pa'i rang rtogs dang rang 'gul gyi dmigs bsal nus mthu zhig yin pa ma zad/ rang byung khams kyi dngos rigs phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba dang srog chags dang rang byung khams dbar gyi 'brel ba rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i ngo bo ldan pa zhig kyang red/ de bzhin ngal rtsol gyi skul 'ded 'og 451

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'du shes la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung yod par ma zad rang byung khams la 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang thon skyed nus shugs dngos zog bzo skrun gyi lag rtsal sogs kyang gong mthor phyin yod/ gzhan yang mi'i rigs kyis rdo chas spyod pa'i dus rabs rnying ma'i dus mjug tu slebs skabs gzugs gzhir 'pho 'gyur chen po byung zhing gna' rabs spra mi'i dus skabs kyi gzugs gzhi de mi'i rigs kyi khyad chos can du 'gyur 'go tshugs shing rgyun ring po'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod sha za ba dang zas btsos ma za bar goms par byas pas klad pa'i grub cha yang rnyog 'dzing je che dang phun sum je tshogs su gyur yod par ma zad/ klad pa'i sgrig gzhi yang je legs su phyin pas mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigs nus pa'ang 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa red/ spyir khrag rgyud khyim tshang nas 'go brtsams te mi'i rigs la spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byed pa'i phyi'i mthun rkyen tshang yod mod/ de nyid cha tshang ba dang brtan po zhig tu 'gyur thub med/ rdo chas spyod pa'i dus rabs rnying ma'i dus mjug tu nya 'dzin pa dang ri dwags rngon pa sogs ni 'tsho ba dngos dang kha bral mi rung ba zhig lags shing 'tsho ba'i spyod lam thams cad sgrig gzhi can du gyur ba'i dbang gis rigs rgyud la'ang zhib bsher byed pa'i 'go tshugs pa dang gnyen sgrig lam lugs la 'gyur ba byung ste phan tshun dbar khrag rgyud kyi 'brel ba gang yang med pa'i mi dang gnyen sgrig byed pa'i lam lugs shig dar ba des mi'i rigs kyi gnyen sgrig lo rgyus dang tshul ldan shes rig gi 'phel rgyas thad sngar med kyi stobs shugs shig byung yod pa red/ de la en ke sis ‘‘de ltar yar rgyas 'gro shugs shin tu che ba ni gdung rgyud 'dzugs pa'i ra sprod gsal po bya byed cig red la gdung rgyud ni yar rgyas de'i thad ka'i 'bras bu zhig yin/ de ni 452

༄༄//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mosaji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/sa gzhi ril mo'i steng gi bya dngos thams cad min kyang kla klo'i gdung rgyud mang che ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi zhig tu grub yod pa red⑫’ ces gsungs yod/ gna' dus mi'i rigs khrag rgyud khyim tshang gi sgrig 'dzugs nasagadung rgyud du yar rgyas phyin pa ni gdod ma'i spyi tshogs skabs thon skyed 'brel ba dang spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs ngos nas 'gyur ba shugs chen phyin pa dang de dus gdung rgyud ni brtan cing gra 'grig pa yin la/ gdung rgyud de'i nang khul phan tshun gnyen sgrig mi byed pa'i khrag rgyud tshogs khag cig yin/gdung rgyud thams cad kyis phyi'i gnyen sgrig lag bstar byed cing gdung rgyud cigagi khongs mis nang khul la phan tshun gnyen sgrig byed mi chog pas gdung rgyud gcig pa'i pho mo na gzhon gyis nges par du gdung rgyud gzhan pa'i nang nas zla bo batrel dgos kyi yod/ gdung rgyud sgrig 'dzugs ni gdung rgyud cig gi khrag rgyud kyi thun mong tshogs pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ dpal 'byor dar 'phel byung ba'i thun mong du sbrel ba'i tshogs pa zhig kyang yin/ gdung rgyud kyi rgyu nor tshang ma gdung rgyud khyon yongs la dbang zhing gdung rgyud gcig pa'i mi tshang ma so so'i gdung rgyud de'i nang mnyam du ngal rtsol dang mnyam du 'tsho ba rol ba/ phan tshun dbar mthun sgril mdza' bshes dang mdza' gcugs che ba ni mnyam 'brel gyi khrag rgyud sgrog thag gis gdung rgyud gcig pa'i khongs su bsdus yod par ma zad/ gdung rgyud kyi sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang na ma 'dus pa gang yang med/ dper na mi rnams kyi dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad brgyud steng gi bkod pa'i skor gyi byed sgo thams cad kyang gdung rgyud khongs mi'i byed sgor 'dus shing so so'i gdung rgyud dang kha bral thabs rtsa ba nas med/ gdung rgyud gcig pa'i mi rnams 'tsho sdod byed dus 453

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mnyam du 'tsho bar rol ba ma zad/ tshe las 'das rjes kyang gdung rgyud gcig pa'i dur sar mnyam du dur sbed kyang byed pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni kho tshos mi rnams tshe las 'das rjes 'jig rten gzhan zhig la slebs par 'dod la/gdung rgyud de'i mi rnams sde khag gcig byas nas thun mong gi byed sgo sna tshogs spel bar yid ches chen po byed kyi yod/ des na gdung rgyud kyi spyi tshogs khrod du mi rnams gdung rgyud de'i khrag rgyud kyi sgrog bus mnyam du dam zhing zab par sbrel bar brten/ kho tshor khrag rgyud kyi 'du shes shin tu zab pa dang rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang thag gcod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i nus shugs chen po thon gyi yod/ kho tsho tshang mas gdung rgyud gcig pa'i mi'i dbar gyi 'brel 'dris ni ches dam shos yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / gdung rgyud gcig pa'i mi'i khrag rgyud thog nas phyi'i gdung rgyud dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan shes shing so so dang mi gcig pa'i mes po'i khongs su gtogs pa'ang shes/ yin na'ang rang gi gdung rgyud kyi mi dang gdung rgyud gzhan mi 'dra bar sems/ khrag rgyud kyi lta shugs shin tu che bas gdung rgyud khag so sor de nyid kyi khongs mi dang gzhan gyi khongs mi dbar khyad par dmigs bsal ldan pa'i rtags mtshan nges par dgos la de 'dra'i khyad par gsal po mtshon thub byed kyang gdung rgyud khag gi mes po mi gcig pa'ang gdung rgyud phan tshun mi 'dra ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen du gyur yod/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i rkyen gyis gdung rgyud mtshon pa'i rigs rgyud mtshon byed kyang glo bur rang bzhin du byung ba zhig min/mdor na don dngos du mas gsal bshad byed thub pa ni gdung rgyud kyi spyi tshogs khrod rigs rgyud mtshon byed de mi'i rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang nus pa shin tu che zhing shugs rkyen gting zab ldan pa ma zad/ mi rnams kyi spyi tshogs 454

༄7//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/'brel 'dris dang / gnyen sgrig cho ga chos lugs sogs kyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel skabs kyang rigs rgyud mtshon byed dang kha bral thabs rtsa ba nas med/ me gling byang ma'i i ro khu'u zi mis ‘‘rgyun ldan cha rgyus med pa'i mi dang 'phrad skabs thog mar pha rol phyogs kyi gdung rgyud ci yin skor 'dri ba dang de'i rjes su gdung rgyud de'i dbu 'dzin mi sna'i gnyen nye su yin dris shing phan tshun dris lan la brten nas kho rang tsho'i dmigs bsal gyi gnyen 'brel lam lugs gzhir bzung phan tshun dbar gyi gnyen nye'i 'brel ba ci tsam yin pa gsal rtogs thub kyi yod/’ ⑪dus mtshungs me gling hin ṭin gyi mi'i gdung rgyud yod do cog la rang nyid kyi khyad chos mtshon nus pa'i gdung ming yod par ma zad/ gdung rigs so sor gdung mi'i ched spyod kyi sger ming yang yod/mor gan gyis ‘‘de ni phal cher yongs khyab kyi lugs srol zhig lags ’ yizhes gsungs shing / spyir mi sger de dag gi ming dang gdung rgyud de'i ming sogs rigs rgyud mtshon byed du thad kar 'brel ba yod cing / gdung rgyud de ga'i dmigs bsal gyi rtags mtshan yang red/ mi de tsho'i so so'i ming gis gdung rgyud gang nas yin pa gsal por shes thub la rigs rgyud mtshon byed kyang su'i khongs mir gtogs pa'ang shes thub/ sa khul zhig gi khongs mi tshor gdung rgyud cig gi ming mchis tshe kho tshor gdung rgyud de'i dbang cha dang thob thang yod tshad longs su spyod dbang yod pa spyi dang yang sgos gdung rgyud de ga'i 'os 'gan thams cad 'khur dgos/ mdor na gong gsal de dag las shes nus pa ni rigs rgyud mtshon byed du gnyer ba'i dad gus kyis gdung rgyud khrag rigs kyi thun mong rtsa 'dzugs brtan cing gdung rgyud khongs mi phan tshun dbar gyi mthun sgril la sman pa'i dge mtshan du ma bskrun yod pa de rigs 455

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud mtshon byed du gnyer ba'i dad gus yod do cog mi'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang 'brel ba dam zab yod la/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed dngos dang kha bral thabs med par mi rnams kyis kyang rnam pa 'dir brten nas chos lugs kyi 'du shes shig gsar skrun dang yid kyi re ba yod tshad de'i phyogs su 'gro bzhin pa'ang mngon gsal red/2 pra phab kyi sgru 'phrul/ pra phab ni rang byung khams kyi nus shugs las brgal ba'i rtog bzo'i stobs shugs spyad nas 'dun pa mngon 'gyur byed pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rnam pa zhig ste/ de ni gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi gdung rgyud dar ba'i dus rim khrod byung ba dang gna' bo'i spyi tshogs kyi dad mos dang gnam dpyad skar rtsis chos lugs sogs kyi 'byung rtsa'ang red/ rang rgyal gna' dus su pra phab mkhan gyi dbang thang shin tu chen po yod kyang de'i las 'gan gtso bo ni lha 'drer mchod 'bul byed rgyu dang mi'i 'tsho sdod slad gsol 'debs rim gro byed rgyu yin pa ma zad/ mo 'debs phywa g.yang 'gugs pa dang skar rtsis mtshan mar brtag pa gtso bor byed/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim khrod du de'i las 'gan gyi khyab khongs rim gyis 'gyur te lha 'bebs 'dre smyug mkhan gyi lta ba zhig tu gyur pa red/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar gna' dus mi rnams rang nyid dang rang nyid las tha dad du gnas pa'i khor yug gi rang byung khams la shes rtogs chen po byed thub med pa dang shes rmongs kyi ngang tshul gyis rtog 'jug byed skabs rang nyid dang rang byung khams dbar dpog par dka' ba'i 'brel ba du ma mchis pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta ba skye srid la thabs lam gzhan zhig brgyud nas rang byung khams dang mi gzhan la shugs rkyen thebs re byed pa dang / mi'i rigs dang rang byung khams dbar shin tu 456

༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/dpog par dka' ba zhig dang mngon sum rjen 'char byed mi nus pa'i gsang ba'i 'brel ba zhig ldan par yid ches brtan po skye bzhin yod la/ rang byung khams kyi snang tshul 'ga' zhig gis mir so so'i nus pa 'don ma thub pa'i shugs rkyen thebs srid cing mis kyang rang byung khams la mi mngon pa'i shugs rkyen thebs shas che bar 'dod pa ma zad/ mi phan tshun dbar la'ang shugs rkyen de 'dra 'byung srid par 'dod/ de lta bu'i stong bsam gyi rmang gzhi'i thog rang byung khams las brgal ba'i nus shugs skor la mi'i rigs kyis smon sems kyi tha snyad sna tshogs btags te dad mos byed srid la de 'dra'i dad mos la shes rab kyi gtan tshigs gang yang med pa ni smos ci dgos/ dper na yun ring than skyon byung tshe myur du char pa 'bab pa'i slad du gang sar chu bshos te smon lam 'debs pa dang / lo legs yong ba'i smon lam du rang nyid kyi mgo skra zang zing du slod pa/ dgra bor dgra lan slog ched du mdung sogs kyi mtshon rtse dgra bo'i rkang rjes la yang yang btsugs nas dmod mo 'debs pa sogs kyis mtshon nus pas de las brling ba'i sgrub byed dang dper brjod 'god ga la dgos/ nga tshos gong du brjod zin pa de dag gi thog nas skabs de dus kyi mi'i rigs kyi gnas tshul nyid ji ltar yin pa gsal rjen du shes nus pa ma zad/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi'i rigs gna' snga mo'i dus skabs su rmongs zhen gyis gtams pa dang dper na pra phab lta bu'i cho ga dang bsam blo'i rigs ni chos lugs der 'phel rgyas byung ba'i thog ma'i rmang gzhi yin pa'ang rtogs nus/2 rang byung khams kyi dad mos/ de yang en ke sis ‘‘rang byung khams 'di nyid dang thog yongs su ldog phyogs dang / zil shugs tshad med dang 457

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ldan pa/ 'dul bar dka' ba'i stobs shugs bcas kyi sgo nas mi rnams kyi kha gtad du langs yod pa zhig red/ 'byung khams 'di dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni dud 'gro dang de nyid bar gyi 'brel ba dang yongs su mtshungs shing / mi rnams kyang dud 'gro ji bzhin de'i dbang 'og tu bsdu dgos kyi yod par brten/ de ni rang byung khams la 'dzin pa'i dud 'gro'i ngang tshul can gyi 'du shes shig red/’ ⑫ ces gsungs pa ltar dus kyi 'phel 'gyur gyi dbang gis gdod ma'i mis spyi tshogs lag len gyi go rim khrod rim gyis nyams myong bsags pa'i bsdoms tshig ni/ pra phab sogs kyi sgyu 'phrul la re stong mu mthud bcangs tshe 'bras bu 'byin dka' ba dang de bas rang byung khams kyi mthu stobs gzhan la brtag dpyad byed 'go btsugs na'ang rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe sogs dang 'thab rtsod byed rgyu'i thad sngar ltar gnyom chung nus med du gyur yod pa red/ dper na bkres skom dang / nad rigs tshabs chen/ gcan gzan gtum po/ dus min 'chi ba bcas kyi rkyen sna tshogs kyis dus rtag tu mi'i tshe srog dang 'tsho gnas la 'jigs skul byed kyi yod par brten mi rnams rang byung khams kyi dngos po'am rang byung khams kyi snang tshul 'dra min la zhed snang tshad med skye bzhin yod par ma zad der skyabs re bcol zhing de'i tshad brgal gyi nus stobs sam ya mtshan gyi mthu sna tshogs la dpyad zhib byas te de dag rang nyid kyi dbang 'og tu bsdu snyam pa'i bsam blo'ang bcangs kyi yod par ma zad/ mi'i rigs la bde ba skrun mkhan gyi rang byung khams kyi snang tshul la dge ba'i lhar ngos 'dzin pa dang mi'i 'tsho sdod thad 'jigs snang skul ba'i rang byung gi snang tshul der gdon 'dre gnod sbyin du ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ kho tshos de ltar bde ba ster ba'i dge ba'i lha la 458

༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/phyag 'tshal skyabs bcol zhu ba dang bsngags brjod dang bstod glu 'bul cing lo legs sogs kyi 'bras bu yod do cog nas mchod rdzas byas te mchod 'bul rgya chen byed srol yod la/ gtum drag can gyi gdon 'dre la glud rdzas sogs brdzangs nas dgongs dwangs gu yangs dang bgegs bar chad las thar thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ de la en ke sis ‘‘mi'i rigs kla klo'i dus rabs kyi ches dma' ba'i dus rim khrod 'tsho ba rol skabs da dung 'dra sku'i zhib bzo dngos mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'dra sku nyid lha mang chos lugs su 'phel rgyas phyin te/ des rang byung khams dang de'i nus shugs la dad gus byed tshul zhig yin pas red/’ ⑫ ces gsungs yod la/ gna' bo'i mis rang byung khams la khyon yongs nas dad mos byed pa ni sa gzhi'i lha dang / nam mkha'i khams/ brag ri g.yang gzar/ chu rgyun/ me sogs skog gyur gyi rgyu mtshan zhig yod pas yin pa dang / de bas phyogs gcig nas rang byung khams der rgyab rten bcol ba dang gzhan zhig nas skrag snang byed pa ma zad mthar der skyabs bcol zhus shing gong bkur zhu ba'am gzungs sngags bzlo ba dang gar 'cham 'khrab pa/ mchod sbyin byed pa bcas kyis smon sems mtshon par byed/ 'on te smon sems che shos ni mi dang rang byung khams dbar gyi 'gal ba zhi bar byed rgyu dang smon 'debs byas pa brgyud lo legs dang phyugs rigs kyi 'phel 'bras legs po yong bar 'bad pa byed rgyu las ma 'das/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na skabs der phyugs las dang zhing las 'phel rgyas byung ba dang sbrags sa zhing la don snying ha cang chen po ldan pa ni mi rnams shing nags khrod nas thang du 'ong ba dang ri dwags rngon pa nas phyugs las su 'phel 'gyur byung ba dang 'brog pa'i rtswa thang gi skyes bzang min thad de tsam 459

༄za//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyis do snang mi byed par sa zhing gshin min ni mi rnams kyi khe phan dang thad kar 'brel ba dam zab yod par ngos 'dzin byed pa'i dbang gis zhing lha la dad gus dang mchod 'bul byed rgyu yang rim bzhin dar rgyas su phyin yod pa dang / de bzhin mi rnams kyi dus rgyun do snang che shos dang 'tsho bar shugs rkyen che shos ni rang nyid kyi stobs shutsos de nyid min par mkha' dbyings kyi nyi ma yin te/ nyi mas dgung sngon dbyings su nyin ltar snga 'char phyi nub dang 'od zer dpag med spros pas skye dngos thams cad 'tshar longs 'byung bar phan nus chen po yod par ngos 'dzin/ 'on te skabs 'gar drod tshad shin tu mtho bas char chu dkon par gyur te lo tog la than skyon dang skye dngos 'tshar longs 'byung mi thub pa dang phyugs zog la'ang gnod 'tshe chen po thebs skabs de ni nyi ma de nyid ma dga' bar snyams ste nyi mar mchod 'bul dang dad gus byed srol shugs chen byung yod/ me gling lho ma'i yul gru'i mi rigs kha shas kyis skye dngos 'tshar longs byung ba ni nyi ma'i rkyen du mi 'dod par zla ba'i nus mthur bsam pa dang 'jam mnyen ldan pa'i zla 'od kyi bsil bser dang zil pa sogs ster cing mi phyugs kyi skye 'phel thad lha lta bu'i dmigs bsal gyi mthu nus shig bskrun gyi yod par sems/ de la gna' bo'i e jeb mis zla lha'i 'od kyis mtshan mor mi'i rigs la 'od snang sbyin par brten zla ba la thugs rje legs smon dang dad gus tshad med byed kyi yod/des na zla bar bcangs pa'i dad mos kyang gna' bo'i dus 'dzam gling yongs su mchis pa'i dad mos rigs shig ma red dam/ de mtshungs mi'i rigs kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi rgyu skar gzhan dag la'ang dad gus chen po byed kyi yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni yangs shing rgya che ba'i mkha' dbyings kyi khyon gang 460

〉〉//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi rīdad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/sar khyab cing grakhas las 'das pa/ kha shas gsal la mi gsal dang kha shas 'od mdangs shin tu 'tsher ba'am dpog dka'i 'gyur ldog gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i skar ma'i tshom bu dang skar ma du ba mjug ring / smin drug byang skar spun bdun sogs ji ma ji bzhin mngon rgyu yod la dgu tshigs skya mo'i 'gul skyod dang skar rdo zags pa sogs ya mtshan du mas gtams gshis de dag la brtag dpyad byed pa'i nus mthu ma mchis pas kho tshos rgyu skar de rnams ni mi'i rigs kyi nus pa las brgal bar sems te dad mos chen po byed/ de bzhin char pa dang dwangs bsil can gyi lhag pa/ 'ar 'ur gyi 'brug sgra/lang long du 'phyo ba'i sprin pa/ mkha' dbyings su reg par snyam pa'i g.yang gzar/ krong nger 'gyings pa'i brag ri/ mun nag 'jigs su rung ba'i nags khrod bcas la'ang dad gus byed srol yod/ de min gting mtha' dpog par dka' ba'i brag rong dbus nas brag cha 'khor ba'am rlung rgyun 'gulaskyod dbang gis sgyu ma'i 'char snang dang bzo lta khyad par can chags tshul sna tshogs ldan pa'i gnas ri sogs dang de'i steng na gnas shing rgyu ba'i gcan gzan thams cad la'ang gna' bo'i mis dad mos shin tu chen po byed/dus mtshungs me ni gna' bo'i mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang med du mi rung ba'i rang byung khams kyi nus shugs yin pa dang yang rang byung khams kyi dngos rigs phan tshun gtsub brdar byas pa las me nus gsar gtod dang bed spyod byas pas me ni zas rigs btso ba dang drod ster ba'i 'byung khungs su gyur yod gshis gna' bo'i mi rnams kyis me ni dmigs bsal nus mthu ldan pa'i lha zhig la ngos 'dzin zhing de dang 'dra bar chu yang skye dngos yod do cog gi zungs khrag lta bu yin la des bskrun pa'i phan nus dang gnod 'tshes gna' mi tsho dus rtag 461

༄༅/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tu ci bya gtol bral gyi gnas su gyar bar brten chu ni lha 'dre lta bu'i lkog gyur mthu nus can du ngos 'dzin gyis de la dad mos lhad med byed kyi yod/phyogs mtshungs mu mtha' ma mchis pa'i sa gzhis 'jig rten gyi dngos po yod do cog 'khur bar snyam ste de nyid shugs drag tshad las 'das pa'i lha chen zhig la sems shing sa gzhi'i thog skye dngos khri khrag mang po 'tshar longs yong skabs de bas re ba tshad med bcol te 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi skyes ma lta bur ngos 'dzin gyis dad gus dang bsngags brjod kyi cho ga'ang sna tshogs spel srol yod/ gzhan yang gna' bo'i rdo chas sogs shin tu zhan pa'i lag char brten nas ri dwags brngon te 'tsho ba skyel ba'i cha rkyen 'og ri dwags kyi sha rigs dang lpags rigs ni 'tsho sdod kyi 'byung khungs gtso che shos shig yin la rang byung khams nas zas za chog chog gi 'bras bu gnas skabs ham gnyer byed pa de shin tu mi brtan pa'i thon skyed nang tshan zhig red/ kho tshos phyogs gcig nas ri dwags la brten dgos pa dang / gzhan zhig nas de tshor dgra 'dzin gyis kha gtad gcog dgos pa sogs kyi 'gal zla'i gnas su gyar ba'am gya tshom gyi dra bar tshud pa de la en ke sis ‘‘mi rnams rang nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i nang gdos bcas kyi dngos po gzhan gyi rgyab skyor thob mod/'on te de dag ni mtho rim gyi gdos bcas min la lha'i pho nya yang min/ de las ldog ste de tsho ni ches dma' ba'i gdos bcas dang dud 'gro yin par brten nas sems can dud 'gror bcangs pa'i dad mos de byung ba yin ’’⑫zhes gsungs/ mdor na rang byung khams dang ri dwags gcan gzan sogs la dad mos byed pa ni gna' bo'i mi'i nyam thag stobs med kyi rnam pa zhig ste mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed nus shugs shin tu dma' zhing rang byung khams bsgyur 462

〉〉//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/bkod dang de'i gnod 'tshe sogs 'gog thabs sogs kyi blo stobs zhan pa'i cha rkyen 'og sems kyi 'jigs snang gis bskrun pa'i dad mos sna tshogs shig yin pa de la le nyin gyis ‘‘gna' bo'i mir rang byung khams dang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i nus pa mi ldan pas dkon mchog dang / gdon 'dre/ yang na ngo mtshar can gzhan la dad mos byed srol byung ba red/’’yi ces gsungs yod//4 bla srog la 'dzin pa'i dad mos/ bu rna han ho bus (ṣ+ṭhashu6'i sa00605)‘‘bla zhes pa ci yin nam bla'i 'du shes gang nas byung ba red/ rmi lam gyi zhing khams dang dran pa thon te 'chi la khad kyi snang tshul gyi 'jig rten der gdod ma'i mis bla srog gi rgyal khams su ngos 'dzin byed kyang bla srog gtso bor smra ba ni gdod ma'i bag chags kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang kla klo'i 'jig rten lta tshul zhig red/’ yi ces gsungs yod/ gna' bo'i chos lugs ni rang byung khams la dad mos byas rjes rim bzhin 'phel rgyas phyin pa yin pa'i sgrub byed ni bya dngos yod rgur bla srog ldan pa'i 'du shes de yin/ dang thog gna' mi tshos mi rang nyid dang rang byung khams tshang mar skye stobs ldan zhing nya nyung mnyam bsres lta bur sems/ phyis su bskyar du dbye 'byed byed 'go brtsams te bla srog dang phung po'i 'du shes skyes shing bla srog dang phung po tha dad dam bla srog logs su gnas pa'i lta tshul byung ba dang / bla srog ni dngos po yin par sems/ bla srog nyid phung po'i gseb tu 'gro thub pa des tshe srog mtshon par bsam zhing dbugs chad pa'i rjes su gzhi nas bla srog nyid phung po dang kha bral zhing tshe srog gi rgyu ba mtshams chad par snyam/ skabs rer mi rnams kyi rmi lam du mi zhig gis sa thag ring po zhig tu 'tsho ba skyel ba dang /'das zin pa'i grogs po sogs rmis tshe de ni mi de'i bla srog mngon par ngos 463

sa༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin byed/ de la en ke sis ‘‘gna' bo'i dus mi rnams kyis so so'i gzugs gzhi'i grub cha ga 'dra yin min gsal por rtogs thub kyi med cing mi lam nang gi 'char snang de dag gis shugs rkyen sprad pa las 'du shes shig byung ba dang kho tsho'i bsam gzhigs dang tshor ba sogs ni gzugs po'i 'gul skyod ma yin par/ khyad par can zhig dang gzugs gzhi'i khrod gnas shing tshe'i 'dukhyed stong skabs bla srog gzugs dang kha bral 'gro ba'i bla srog gi 'gul skyod cig yin pa dang / dus de nas bzung mi rnams kyis bla srog gi phyi'i 'jig rten gyi 'brel ba der bsam gzhigs ma byed ka med byung ba red de 'dra'i 'du shes ni skabs de dus kyi 'phel rim nang sems gso tsam zhig min par 'gog thabs bral ba'i las dbang zhig yin la skabs rer bkra mi shis pa zhig yin pa ni ke ri si'i mi lta bu red/’ ⑫ces gsungs yod/ gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i chu tshad mthon por ma slebs pa des mi gang zhig 'das pa'i rjes su bla srog nyid phung po las kha bral te mu mthud 'gul bskyod byed kyi yod par 'dod pa ma zad/ kho tsho 'jig rten gzhan zhig tu phyin te mi yul gyi 'tsho ba longs su spyod thub par snyam zhing / rang byung khams dang rang byung gi snang tshul so sor khyad du 'phags pa'i bla srog yod kyang bla srog de dag mi mngon pa'i rnam shes su gyur yod par sems/ dper na sa gzhi dang shing nags/ ri dang chu/ khang pa dang gnas yul bcas tshang mar so so'i rnam shes yod pa lta bu red/ me gling byang mar gnas pa'i hin ṭin mi rigs kyi i ro khu'u zi tsho pa'i nang bu mo spun gsum yod pa des lhar dad mos byas pas g.yu dung gi rnam shes dang sran rigs kyi rnam shes chu zan ril bu'i rnam shes bcas kyi skye ba blangs par 'dod kyi yod/464

༄khya//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/5 mes por 'dzin pa'i dad mos/ mes por 'dzin pa'i dad mos ni cho 'brang rigs rgyud kyi dus su byung ba'i gna' bo'i chos lugs kyi snang tshul zhig red/ dad mos bya yul ni dang thog cho 'brang khongs nas 'das grongs su gyur pa'i bgres song ma'i bla srog yin pa de rim pas pha rgyud bgres song gi rnam shes su gyur la cho 'brang rigs rgyud kyi spyi tshogs der dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus ldan zhing rdo chas gsar ma'i dus skabs su dar rgyas byung ba dang /lo rgyus kyi dus rim de'i khrod phyogs gang sar grub 'bras g.yur du za ba thob yod pa ni rdo chas bzos te brdar bzo'i lag shes gsar gtod byas pa dang dus mtshungs rdza chas dang 'khel thag lag shes kyang gsar gtod byas yod/skabs de'i khyo gcig shug mang dang shug gcig khyo mang gi lam lugs dar ba'i cha rkyen 'og gna' mi tsho'i phru gus so so'i skyes ma las pha rgyud ye nas ngos 'dzin byed thub kyi med/ gdung rgyud kyang skyes ma kho nas gtan 'khel byed cing / de'ang gsal por brjod na tshang mas cho 'brang khas len dang de nyid gzhir bzhag gis gdung rgyud dbye 'byed byed la/ gna' bo'i spyi dbang lam lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang phun sum tshogs pa'i dus skabs la slebs te bud med tshos thon skyed khrod nus shugs chen po 'don gyi yod pa ni bza' rigs sogs 'thog pa'am 'thu ba'i 'gan bud med tshos 'khur yod par ma zad/ kho tsho thon skyed kyi bdag por dngos su gyur yod pa red/ skyes pa tshos phyi las gdol ba dang nya 'dzin dang brngon bshas sogs las rigs kyi 'gan 'khur yod la/ de dag gi yo byad ha cang zhan pa'i dbang gis skyes pa tsho'i las ka ni brtan po min par gyur yod par brten za chas mkho 'don gyi thad la bud med tsho'i zhing las thon skyed der blos 'gel chog pa'i don snying 465

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bskrun bzhin yod pa red/ de min skabs der khyim nang gi las 'gan mang po zhig kyang bud med tshos sgrub kyi yod pa dper na zas rigs bzo ba dang /gos 'thag pa/ mi rabs rjes ma gso skyong byed pa sogs 'gan 'khur de dag gis gdung rgyud khongs mi tshor thad kar zhabs 'degs zhu thub la de ni spyi tshogs kyi ngal rtsol 'gangs chen zhig dang gdung rgyud kyi khongs mi thams cad rdog rtsa gcig sgril yong bar nus shugs chen po 'don gyi yod pas skyes ma tshor mi tshang mas brtsi bkur dang gdeng 'jog mthon po byed pa ma zad/ gdung rgyud kyi dbang 'dzin pa dang las 'gan gtso bo 'khur mkhan la 'dems bsko byed kyi yod la de ni mi'i rigs gdung rgyud kyi lo rgyus thog 'gangs che ba'i 'gyur ldog cig dang steng gi bkod pa'i khyab khongs mtshon byed cig kyang red/lhag par du skabs der cho 'brang khyim tshang gi khongs mis mnyam du ngal rtsol dang 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byed pas kho tsho'i phan tshun dbar gyi gdung rgyud kyi lta ba'i langs phyogs de brtan por gyur te brtse sems je cher 'phel ba ma zad bud med khyim rgyud dang bud med bgres song tshor so so'i bu tshas brtsi mthong che zhing lta rtog dang dad mos lhag bsam zol med byed pa dang / kho tsho 'das grongs song rjes de bas dad mos chen po byed par brten cho 'brang rus rgyud spyi tshogs kyi dus dkyil dang dus mjug tsam la mi gshis rang bzhin can gyi lha dang 'dre sogs kyi 'du shes 'byung 'go brtsams pa dang sbrags/ de nas rim bzhin rang byung dngos por dad gus byed pa nas mi la 'dzin pa'i dad mos sam mes por 'dzin pa'i dad mos kyi 'du shes byung ba red/ 'du shes de ni gna' bo'i spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs khrod kyi sngon skyod chen po'i 'du shes shig yin pa ma zad dad mos de ni thon skyed 'brel ba'i rnam pa 466

༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/gsar par brten nas gsar du byung ba'i steng gi bkod pa zhig kyang red/spyi tshogs thon skyed dang gdung rgyud lam lugs 'phel rgyas byung ba dang chabs cig gdung rgyud gcig pa'i gnyen nye'i dbar gnyen 'brel bkag sdom byed pa'i dgos mkho che ru phyin yod pa dang / mi mang po zhig bza' tshang bsgrigs rjes bza' tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba yang cung brtan du phyin te pho mo phan tshun gtso cher 'dzin pa'i ‘cha ldan khyim tshang ’gi nang phru gur gtan 'khel gyi skyes ma bstan rgyu yod par ma zad pa pha yang bstan rgyu yod pa'i spyi tshogs su gong 'phel phyin pa dang / zhing 'brog las dang lag shes bzo las 'phel rgyas phyin pa des thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi las bgos kyang gsar du dar yod pa ni de sngon nya las brngon bshas sogs byed mkhan gyi skyes pa tshos phyugs zog 'dul sbyong dang 'tsho skyong byed pa'i khar zhing las ngal rtsol dang thon skyed yo chas gsar skrun gyi 'gan yang 'khur gyi yod par brten bud med rnams spyi tshogs thon skyed kyi gal che'i gras nas rim gyis zur phud byas yod pa dang / skyes pa tsho ni lag shes bzo las dang khyim las rkang 'dzin byed mkhan zhig tu gyur pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab kyang rim pas je mthor phyin yod pa red/der brten bud med rnams kyis spyi tshogs go gnas dma' ru phyin pa dang chabs cig ngal rtsol thon zog bkod sgrig byed dbang yang skyes pa tshor rtsis sprod byed dgos par gyur pas dus rgyun ‘cha ldan khyim tshang ’ nang cho 'brang gtso bor byed pa'i lam lugs der 'pho 'gyur byung ste rim gyis pha rgyud kyis gtso bor byed pa dang / skyes pa rnams pha rgyud spyi tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin pa dang bkod 'doms mkhan du gyur pa red/ cho 'brang rus rgyud kyi spyi tshogs nas pha rgyud rus rgyud kyi spyi tshogs su 'phel 'gyur byung ba dang sbrags khyim tshang 467

༄༅//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyi dbang nas pha la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyang dar rgyas byung zhing mes por 'dzin pa'i dad mos byed yul nyid sngon gyi skyes mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes las ldog ste skyes pa rnams dad mos bya yul du gyur yod/ mes por dad mos byed tshul thad cho ga mi 'dra ba sna tshogs spel rgyu yod kyang cho ga de'i rigs spel dgos don ni dngos po'i rigs la rnam shes ldan pa'i 'du shes shugs che ru phyin pa'i rkyen gyis yin zhing / de bzhin mi shi ba de kho tshos dang thog gnyid khug par sems nas dus yun nges can ring sems khur gyis lta skyong tshad med byas kyang mthar phung po rul ba'i skabs kho tsho mgo rmongs te ci bya gtol bral du 'gyur gyi yod/ rang gzhan kun gyi sems kyi 'jigs snang gsal ba'i slad 'das por za rigs sna tshogs kyi bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / gson po'i skabs spyod myong ba'i rgyu dngos yo chas phung po'i mdun du sgrig cing mthar sa 'og tu sba ba ma zad 'das grongs ni gzugs phung gi 'gul skyod mjug sgril bar ngos 'dzin byed/ de min dur skyel gyi cho ga de gdung rgyud 'ga' shas kyi nang khul la rim bzhin dar bas gson po'i dus lag rjes chen po 'jog mkhan gyi 'das por (dper na gdung rgyud kyi dbu 'dzin nam dpa' bo byas rjes can sogs/)mya ngan dang mchod 'bul pur 'jug bcas kyi gus lugs mtshon pa'i byed sgo spel nas gus sems mtshon pa dang dad mos zhu ba'i byed sgo spel nas kho tshor gzengs bstod byed kyi yod/ dus mtshungs thun mong ma yin pa'i mi de tsho 'tsho sdod skabs stobs shugs che zhing 'das rjes rnam shes kyang stobs dang ldan zhing so so'i gdung rgyud kyi khongs mir srung skyob byed thub mkhan zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ rang rgyal rgya bod mi rigs kyi goms srol khrod gnyen nye 'das rjes nyin bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i nang nyin bdun re byas te 468

༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/bsnyen bkur zhabs brtan sgrub kyi yod pa la rjes sor lo gcig 'khor rjes lo 'khor 'das mchod rgyas po byed kyi yod/ de ni gna' mis chos lugs kyi cho ga sna tshogs spel zhing mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs pa phul te 'das po de nyid dgyes par byed pa'am rnam shes la sems gso byed pa'i srol yin la rang nyid yun ring gson gnas kyi bya bzhag thams cad kyang legs sgrub yong bar ram 'degs yong re byed pa zhig kyang red/ yang ye shu'i chos lugs pas ye shu'i 'khrungs skar gyi dus chen la bsu ba byed skabs mes po'o rnam shes la dran rten zhu ba'i chos lugs kyi cho ga du ma spel gyi yod cing lam lugs de da dung yang gnas yod/ mdor na mes por 'dzin pa'i dad mos kyis gna' bo'i chos lugs nyid gom rim gsar pa zhig tu 'phel rgyas 'gro bar skul 'ded byas yod par ma zad/ des mi'i rigs kyi dad mos bya yul nyid rang byung khams nas mi rang nyid kyi thog slebs pa mtshon zhing mi rnams kyi 'phrul snang dang de bzhin mgo mjug rbad de ldog pa'i 'char snang sna tshogs kyis mi dang rang byung khams dbar gyi go gnas la shugs snon brgyab pa dang mi'i rang gshis mngon gsal dod du phyin pas deng rabs chos lugs 'du shes kyi gsar skyes ljang bu'i 'bras bu smin pa la mthun rkyen sbyar yod pa ni smos ci dgos/bzhi pa/ gna' bo'i lha mang chos lugs dang lha gcig chos lugs/1 gna' bo'i lha mang chos lugs/ gna' bo'i gdung rgyud spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i dus mjug tu chos lugs de nyid rang byung gi chos lugs nas lha mang chos lugs su 'pho 'gyur byung ba dang / yang gdung rgyud dang tsho 469

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa so sos rang nyid kyi skyabs lha de tshor brten nas phan tshun dbar mthun lam legs shing brtan po yong bar byed pa'i lha mang po byung yod pa dang lha dang lha'i dbar mtho dman gyi dbye ba gang yang med/ lha de dag la mi rnams kyis ‘btang snyoms kyi lta stangs 'dzin pa dang lha sogs kyi gzugs brnyan la yid rton cing smon lam yang 'debs kyi yod la de ni lha mang chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig kyang red/ gna' bo'i gdung rgyud spyi tshogs nang gral rim gyi dbye ba lta ci rgyu nor yang thun mong du dbang ba ma zad mi tshang mar gdung rgyud kyi 'tsho ba longs su spyod dbang yod/ de la en ke sis ‘‘gna' bo'i gdung rgyud spyi tshogs kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni thon skyed ches zhan pa dang /sa rgya che ba'i yul grur 'tsho sdod byed pa'i mi 'bor shin tu nyung bar brten/mi'i rigs ha lam cha med rgyus med dang / kha gtad du langs pa/ rtogs dka' ba bcas yin pa'i phyi rol gyi 'byung khams chen po'i bkod rgya'i 'og 'tsho dgos kyi yod/ de yang byis blo'i ngang tshul can gyi chos kyi 'du shes nang nas mtshon gyi yod/’ ⑫ ces gsungs pa bzhin gang ltar skabs de'i tsho pa zhig gi mi'am de nyid kyi ngos nas brjod tshe tsho pa so so'i gdung rgyud dang de'i lam lugs nyid byed thabs legs shos shig la ngos 'dzin byed pas der phog thug byed ga la nus/ de las ldog ste rang byung chos nyid kyi khor yug mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mi'i rigs so so'i ngos nas brjod tshe bsam blo'i brtse dung dang shes rtogs de bzhin bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas snga phyi bar gsum du gong bkur zhu dgos pa gleng med cig tu gyur yod pa dang / de 'dra'i gdung rgyud mnyam sdeb kyi thun mong 'tsho ba'am mi phan tshun dbar gyi 'dra mnyam 'brel bas gna' bo'i chos lugs kyi mnyam 'brel rang bzhin dang dmangs yongs kyi 470

༄༅//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs thub pa'i rkyen gyis mi rnams kyis lha la'ang rim pa mtho dman gyi dbye 'byed ci la byed/ gal che'i don chen sogs dper na gnam gshis dang gnod 'tshe/ grub 'bras thob pa/ dmag 'thab byed pa bcas kyi skabs su chos lugs kyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel dgos pa ma zad/lhar bde sdug bzang ngan gyi lung bstan dang rogs mgon yong rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhu ba de dag tshang ma thun mong gi ming thog nas chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel te zhu ba ma zad/ mi sger gyi byed sgo sogs kyang tsho pa dang gdung rgyud kyi bya spyod la ngos 'dzin gyi yod la/ lhar ched du skyabs bcol gyi chos lugs cho ga stabs bde zhu don ni mi sger ram mchod dpon gyi rogs skyor yong slad dang / gna' bo'i chos lugs khrod thun mong dang sger gyi chos lugs byed sgo khag gnyis byung don ni gdung rgyud kyi khongs mi thams cad lha dang 'brel ba byed chog pa'i dbang cha 'dra mnyam yin pa gsal bshad dang / de'i dmigs yul yod tshad ni gdung rgyud kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs sra brtan yong ba'i ched du yin la/ phyogs mtshungs gna' bo'i chos lugs rang don du gnyer te dad mos byed mkhan dang gdung rgyud khongs mi tshos 'dems bsko byas pa'i mi de ni mi yul dang lha'i dbar gyi mtshams sbyor byed mkhan du ngos 'dzinacing kho tshor dmigs bsal gyi gla yon gang yang med/ dad mos kyi cha nas brjod tshe lhas mi thams cad la 'dra mnyam gyi sgo nas nyes chad gcod pa dang rogs skyob byed pa yang na mi'i khams dang mos par gzhigs nas 'dod blo skong gi yod pas de 'dra'i 'dra mnyam dang dmangs gtso'i 'du shes ni gdung rgyud nang khul gyi 'dra mnyam dang lta ba mtshon thabs shig red/mdor na de ni gna' bo'i dus mi rnams lhar gus bstod byed pa dang dad mos 471

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byed pa las kha bral thabs med/ dper na gna' bo'i mi'i blo yul la 'char ba'i lha'i 'jig rten khrod du lha'i go rim mtho dman la dbye 'byed med/ de ni gna' bo'i spyi tshogs kyi don dngos 'tsho ba'i nang gral rim gyi dbye 'byed dang rgyu nor gyi he bag sogs gtan nas ma mchis pa'i mtshon rtags shig yin te dngos yod 'jig rten gyi mi ni 'dra mnyam yin pas lha'i 'jig rten gyi lha yang 'dra mnyam yin bzo 'dug la/ skabs der go gnas mtho shos kyi lha gcig da dung byung thub med/2 gna' bo'i lha gcig chos lugs/ thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas phyin pa dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu nor gsog 'jog byed pa'i lam lugs dar ba dang sbrags gdung rgyud mnyam sdeb de khyim tshang so sor dbye 'byed 'go brtsams shing gdung rgyud spyi pa'i rgyu nor bgo bsha' rgyag stangs dang sger dbang lam lugs kyang rim bzhin dar rgyas byung ba dang dus mtshungs/ spyi tshogs kyi las bgos byed stangs je zhib tu phyin pas gdung rgyud spyi tshogs rtsa brlag tu song ba dang bran g.yog bdag po dang bran g.yog kha gtad du langs pa'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs dar 'phel byung ste phan tshun dpung 'jug byed pa'i brgyud rim nang pham nyes byung ba'i bzung dmag thams cad ma bsad par bran g.yog tu bkol spyod byed pa des 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes ni kho tsho dang thag je ring du gyur cing / sger dbang ring lugs kyi 'du shes dar rgyas dang gong 'phel byung ste gna' bo'i gdung rgyud mnyam sdeb lam lugs thor zhig song ba dang phyogs mtshungs gna' bo'i chos lugs kyi 'du shes de rim gyis bran g.yog bdag po'i chos lugs su gyur te lha gcig chos lugs des lha mang chos lugs kyi 'thus tshab byas pa red/ der en ke sis ‘‘'phel rgyas 472

༄cu//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/ches cher phyin pa'i go rim khrod lha mang po'i rang byung gi ngo bo dang spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos tshang ma kun 'jon dang 'gran zla bral ba'i lha gcig gi thog bkod cing lha de nyid kyang rtogs dka'i mi'i mtshan rtags shig tu gyur pa nas lha gcig chos lugs byung ba red/’’② ces gsungs pa ltar sger dbang lam lugs byung ba dang chabs cig de snga'i tsho dpon dang dmag don gyi bkod 'doms pa/ mchod dpon bcas kyang bran g.yog bdag po'am mi dmangs la gnya' gnon byed mkhan zhig tu gyur cing bran g.yog bdag pos rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur nus pa sra brtan du gtong slad lha'i dbang cha yang sger sdom byas te lo rgyus dngos la rdzun bzo'i thabs shes spyad nas gna' bo'i chos lugs la bsgyur bcos byas pa ma zad/ pha rgyud bus 'dzin gyi gdung rgyud de nyid kyi tshab 'dems bsko lam lugs kyis byas te dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi khyab khongs rgya skyed byas pa dang mchod dpon sogs kyi dbang cha nyams par byas te de snga lha dkyus ma dang mi'i dbar gyi mtshams sbyor byed mkhan nas mi phyed lha phyed du gyur te lha'i dbang cha dang nus pa rang nyid la dbang bar byas shing /chos lugs kyi byed sgo sna tshogs kyang kho tsho 'ba' zhig la brten na ma gtogs spel mi chog dus mtshungs mi rnams la bslu brid dang chos lugs lkog gyur ring lugs kyi zhen shugs gting je zab tu btang nas sngar tsho pa dang gdung rgyud thun mong gi lha yang bran g.yog bdag po'i srung mar bsgyur zhing mis lha la thad kar 'brel 'dris byed pa'i dbang cha yang rim bzhin med pa bzos par brten/ spyi tshogs thog gral rim kha thor du gyur pa ji bzhin gna' bo'i chos lugs kyi lha dag kyang kha thor du phyin pa dang lha 'ga' shas kyi gnas bab mtho ru phyin te lha chen chags pa dang 'ga' shas lha chen gyi 'khor du gyur yod pa 473

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/red/ gral rim med pa'i gna' bo'i chos lugs khrod nyi lha dang / zla lha/ri lha/ chu lha sogs so so'i go gnas so sos zin cing rang 'gan rang sgrub bgyis pa las phan tshun dbar do dam the jus byed mkhan med la rim pa'i mtho dman gyi dbye ba'ang med/ 'on kyang gral rim byung ba dang gral rim mtho dman dbar rgyu nor dang dbang cha 'phrog res kyi gnas tshul byung rjes mi'i rigs kyi stong bsam dag lha'i 'jig rten la bcol nas lha tshogs dbar gyi dbang cha dang 'gan nus kyang go rim mtho dman dang che chung gi dbye 'byed byas yod cing / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang dpal 'byor dang go gnas sogs la don snying shugs chen ldan pa'i rang byung khams kyi lha chen nus mthu shin tu che ba de dag rim gyis ches mtho'i lha la gyur pa red/ dper na gna' bo'i chogs lugs nang nyi mar dad gus chen po byed pa ni nyi mas mi'i rigs la 'od snang dang dro skyid ster la/ gna' dus bran g.yog lam lugs rgyal khab kha shas kyis nyi ma ni 'gan nus shugs chen ldan pa'i lha chen zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod de/ dper na/ nyi hong pas nyi ma ni mkha' dbyings kyi lha chen dang yul gyi rgyal po ni nyi ma'i bu ru 'dod la rang rgyal rgya nag gi hrang rgyal rabs kyi bran g.yog bdag po'i sku drag tshos kyang rgyal khab kyi dar rgud dang mi yul gyi bde sdug g.yul 'gyed kyi rgyal pham/ rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog sogs ni bla na med pa'i lha'i dbang po'i 'dod blor brten nas byung bar 'dod la lha gzhan rnams ni lha'i dbang pos las bgos brgyab cing stangs 'dzin gyi 'khor kho na yin par 'dod pa lta bu red/ de bzhin gna' bo'i chos lugs khrod dad gus byed pa'i lha ni rang byung khams kyi stobs shugs tha dad du gyur pa'am gral rim spyi tshogs kyi dad mos bya yul gtso che shos sam 474 ‘

༄7//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/spyi tshogs kyi stobs shugs tha dad pa kho na yin/ gang lags she na gral rim gyi 'gal ba byung ba dang gral rim 'thab rtsod 'phel rgyas su phyin pas spyi tshogs thog mi tshos dus rgyun du rang nyid la kha lo sgyur thub pa'i ches mtho'i lha zhig gnas yod par yid rton byed pa ma zad des mi yul gyi khyab khongs yongs la lta zhib dang kha lo sgyur nus shing dbang cha'ang tshad med ldan par sems/bran g.yog bdag pos ches mtho'i lha de 'drar dad gus byed pa ni kho tshos bde blag ngang bran g.yog la dbang sgyur dang btsan skul byed rgyu'i ched du yin pa dang / bran g.yog bdag po dang bran g.yog phan tshun 'khrug 'dzings byas te bran g.yog tshor rgyal kha thob pa yin na bran g.yog tshos kyang mtho rim gyi lha la dad mos shugs chen byed srid kyang de ni bran bkol gyi gnas bab nas thar slad dang / rang nyid kyi ches dma' ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab la bsgyur bcos yong ched yin pa ma zad lha gcig chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs khyad chos der gnon shugs che ru gtong ba dang lha der spyi tshogs kyi 'gan nus gsar pa zhig sprod ched kyang red/ rang ngos kyi lha de spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo shugs cher gtong ba dang / rang byung khams kyi lha de nyid mi gshis can gyi spyi tshogs kyi lhar 'gyur ba dang / chogs lugs la bsgyur bkod byas nas lha de rang byung khams dang thag je ring dang rang byung dngos po'i phyi shun je nyung du btang nas mi gshis can dang / dngos med can/ kun spyod can bcas kyi lha ru gyur yod/ de yang en ke sis ‘‘gcig gyur gyi rgyal po zhig med na gcig gyur gyi lha yang 'byung mi srid/ lha'i gcig gyur rang bzhin gyi ngos nas brjod tshe de ni shar phyogs kyi gcig gyur srid dbang sger gcod rgyal po'i mtshon rtags tsam yin/ lha des rang byung gi snang tshul 'dra min sna tshogs la dbang sgyur 475

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byed pa ma zad phan tshun dbar 'gal zlar gyur pa'i rang byung gi nus shugs sna tshogs mnyam sbrel byed kyang rgyal po des phyi tshul dang yang na don dngos thog 'gal zlar langs pa'i khe phan gcig sgril byed pa de dper na mi phan tshun dbar 'gal zlar gyur pa lta bu red/’mi②ces gsungs/ mdor na lha gcig chos lugs ni gral rim spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin te/gral rim spyi tshogs su slebs rjes gral rim gyi gnya' gnon yod pa'i rgyal khab nang ches mtho'i dbang sgyur byed mkhan rgyal po zhes pa de byung nas srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi dbang grags mtho shos la srung skyong byed slad mi'i bsam pa'i 'du shes khrod gcig gyur bla med kyi lha chen gtso bo zhig bskrun nas gnam steng gi lha chen gcig pu de yang gnam 'og srid dbang sger gcod rgyal po'i sprul par brtsi ba yin/ mdor na gna' mi tshor thog ma nyid nas chos lugs kyi 'du shes byung ba'ang thon skyed nus shugs kyi chu tshad shin tu dma' ba'i gnas tshul 'og rang byung gi snang tshul la lkog gyur mtshar snang skye ba'i 'bras bu yin pa dang / gdung rgyud spyi tshogs nang rang byung khams dang /rigs rgyud mtshon byed/ mes po/ bla srog bcas la bcangs pa'i chos lugs dad mos kyi rnam pa du ma byung myong la dad mos de dag kyang gna' mi'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen dngos kyis bskrun pa ma zad/ kho tshos 'jig rten thog gi bya dngos yod tshad la ‘rnam shes yod par yid ches shing rang nyid dam mes po dang rang byung khams kyi dngos po 'ga' shas sam srog chags/ tha na skye dngos sogs dbar 'brel ba nges can zhig yod par bsams nas de dag lhar ngos 'dzin byas te dad mos shugs chen byed kyi yod/ dper na rngon las dang / gdol las byed mkhan gyi gna' mis ri dwags 'ga' shas sam 476

༄//gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen skor gleng ba/nya rigs dad mos byed yul du brtsi zhing / zhing las sogs dar rjes de sngon gyi lha'am de'i khyad chos rnams dor te zhing las dang 'brel ba yod pa'i lha gsar du bskyed pa red/ gdung rgyud lam lugs rtsa med song ba dang tsho pa'i sgrig gzhi grub pa'i skabs gdung rgyud kyi lha thams cad rim gyis tsho pa'i lha ru 'pho 'gyur byung ste kho tsho'i dad mos bya yul gyi lha tshogs kyang nus pa mi ldan zhing phan tshun dbar 'brel lam gang yang med pa zhig tu gyur/ lha tshogs kyi dbang thang yang gdung rgyud de rang dang tsho pa de yi khyab khongs nas brgal med pas gdung rgyud dang tsho pa nyams rgud du song ba dang chabs cig lha tshogs kyang ming gi lhag ma lta bur gyur/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs de gral rim spyi tshogs su 'phel gyur byung ba dang sbrags chos lugs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba ni mi tshos rang byung khams kyi rmongs zhen gyi 'du shes la gong bkur dang spyi tshogs lam lugs sogs rjes lus thebs yod pas yin la/ gzhan dbang stobs shugs kyi gnon shugs las thar thub med cing / ngal rtsol pa rnams bshu gzhog lam lugs kyi mnar gcod las kha bral thub med pas 'jigs snang dang stong bsam kho nar re sgug byed rgyu las g.yol thabs bral/ bshu gzhog gral rim gyis chos lugs bed spyad de mi dmangs yongs la btsir gnon dang bslu brid byas pa sogs kyis rgyal khab chags pa dang chabs cig srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal po byung zhing gnam steng gcig gyur gyi lha chen ni gnam 'og mi yul gcig mthun rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i rgyal po chen po'i dgos mkho dang bstun nas rim gyis byung ba zhig dang / gral rim sogs 'phel rgyas je cher phyin pa dang sbrags rgyal khagekhag dang sa gnas khag phan tshun dbar gyi dpal 'byor dang / chab srid/ rig gnas/ tha na dmag don sogs kyi 'brel 477

༄khya//rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus/gu ge tshe ring rgyal po ni spyi lo 1961lor stod mnga' ris sgar rdzong glang bcusrung ri zhes yul lung mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'brog pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu skyes/ rang lo bcu gnyis bar du 'brog rwa'i ri klung khrod du ra lug 'tsho skyong gis sbra gur nag po'i nang 'tshar longs byung / de nas ste dbang gis gtsod tsho chus slob chung dang sgar rdzong slob grwar slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs byung /khong blo rig rno zhing snying rus che bas sbyang 'bras legs po thob stabs bod kyi lte gnas lha sar byon te bod ljongs dge 'os slob grwa chen mo'i zhor gtogs slob 'bring du lo bzhi'i ring slob sbyong byas nas dma' rim slob 'bring thon/spyi lo 1981lor rgyal sa pe cin gyi krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i mi rigs skad yig tshan khag bod yig 'dzin grwar rgyugs lon nas lo bzhi'i ring bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang chen mo dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang /mkhyen rab 'od gsal/ thub bstan dbang po/ blo bzang rdo rje bcas kyi drung nas snyan sum gyi gzhung dang / lo rgyus/ rtsom rig sogs dpyis phyin pa gsan bzhes dang sbyang brtson lhod med byas gshis mthar sbyang 'bras phul du byung ba'i thog nas slob grwa thon te rtsom rig shes rams pa'i yon tshad kyi thob thang byung / spyi lo 1985lo nas bzung lo gsum ring krung go'i spyi tshogs tshan rig khang zhib 'jug slob grwa chen mo'i mi rigs lo rgyus tshan khag na~X ḍib

༄7//gu ge tshe ring rgyal po'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyer la brtson zhing / bod rig pa mkhas can dge rgan chen mo li'u hring chi dang khrang h+phung shen rnam gnyis kyis drung nas bod kyi lo rgyus dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs rig pa bcas la 'bad 'bungs byas mthar sbyang 'bras khyad du 'phags pa'i sgo nas rab 'byams pa'i yon tshad kyi thob thang byung ngo //spyi lo 1988lo nas bzung krung go spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi mi rigs zhib 'jug tshan khag tu lo bzhi tsam ring bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug las ka byas shing / dus mtshungs su mes rgyal nang sa'i zhing chen kong shi dang / ku'u kro'o/ yun nan/ hu nan/ hu pe sogs grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan pa'i sa khul du bskyod nas de ga'i lo rgyus dang yul srol goms gshis bcas la rtogs zhib byas te lta rgya dang mthong rgya je cher song / spyi lo 1992lor lha sar log rjes bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus rtsom sgrig khang rgya yig rtsom sgrig pu'u ru lo gcig dang zla ba bcu tsam ring rtsom sgrig dang rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur gyi las la brtson zhing / zhor du rtsom yig bcu grangs shig bod yig nas rgya yig la bsgyur/ spyi lo 1994lor bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang chos lugs zhib 'jug so'o ru las bsgyur byas nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi zhabs zhur brtson bzhin zhib 'jug pa chen mo'i go gnas thob pa dang sbrags dbu 'dzin gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes gnang bzhin yod/lo rabs dgu bcu'i dus mjug tsam nas bzung snga rjes su yo rob rgyal khab o si khru ri ya dang / su'e tser/ h+pha ran se/ 'jar man/ ho lan ṭi/ dbyin ji bcas kyi slob chen khag la byon nas slob khrid byas pa dang rgyal spyi'i bod rigs pa'i tshogs 'du thengs 'ga' shas kyi nang zhugs par ma zad/482

༄7//rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus/o si khru ri ya'i bod rig pa mkhas can gun ṭam hwa sdo ḍi dang mnyam 'brel gyis 〈g.ya' bzang chos 'byung 〉dang 〈rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa chen po'i rnam thar/〉〈lha bug pa can gyi gdung brgyud 〉bcas bod yig nas dbyin yig tu bsgyur ba'i mu la dpyad rtsom dang mchan 'grel mang dag bkod de 〈gnas chen yar lha sham po'i gsham 'og gi shes rig〉 (〈bu1 5111sku'i༈10sam༈masmo2stu0dutwe01sa/05satwebyastums—bdu〉)zhes yig 'bru khri bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi deb zhig rtsom sgyur byas shing / da dung 〈khra 'brug dgon pa'i sngon byung lo rgyus 〉dang 〈tshal gung thang dgon pa'i dkar chag rgyas pa 〉bcas bod yig nas dbyin yig tu bsgyur te o si khru ri ya'i grags can slob grwa ste lpo ye ṇa ((1ba1961bya1spyosnga01yi1 khusaba'i)slob chen gyis par du bskrun nas 'grems spel byas zin/ de bzhin a me ri kha'i gzhung gnyer slob grwa chen mo h+phu ji nyi ya'i ((1sa1myo61bya1༈501myo1 1spru1 ba1 sku)bod kyi nang bstan rig pa mkhas can ḍi be ṭa je ma no dang mnyam du gangs ljongs glog rdul dpe mdzod khang zhes bod rig pa'i shes rig gi glog rdul dra rgya che shos de gsar 'dzugs byas shing /de'i nang gses stod mnga' ris lo rgyus dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs/dmangs srol goms gshis bcas kyi le tshan bzos/ lhag don du 'dzam gling thog skad grags shin tu che ba'i a me ri kha'i ha h+phu slob grwa chen mos (//sa1521bya1(smo015masamyomangaspu)gdan zhus ltar lo gcig ring zhib 'jug slob mar bod rig pa'i skor gyi slob khrid byas/ de'i ring ne'u yu'e na mchis pa'i a me ri kha'i grags can slob chen ko lum bi ya (/)go1myo61bya1shusnga 01(015bka61 klu)la'ang slob khrid thengs kha shas byed myong yod/khong gis nye ba'i lo bcu'i ring 〈gdod ma'i chos lugs dang de'i 'byung 483
